sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇam | śrīratneśvaraviracitayā ratnadarpaṇākhyayā vyākhyayā sametam
prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ
ekena yasya yaminaḥ pramadeva dehamardhena rājati pumāniva cāpareṇa
tattvakramādatha ca na pramadā pumānvā śreyāṃsi vardhayatu sa smaraśāsano vaḥ
śrīrāmasiṃhadevena dordaṇḍadalitādviṣā
kriyate'vantibhūpālakaṇṭhābharaṇadarpaṇaḥ
kaṇṭhābharaṇamanarghyaṃ vāgdevīratnadarpaṇotsaṅge
asminpaśyatu nibhṛtaṃ prakāśasarvāṅgalāvaṇyam
granthārambhe samuciteṣṭadevatānasaskāreṇa śiṣṭācāramanuvartate—
dhvanirvaṇāḥ padaṃ vākyamityāspadacatuṣṭayam
yasyāḥ sūkṣmādibhedena vāgdevīṃ tāmupāsmahe || 1
dhvaniriti
vācāmadhiṣṭhātrī devī dyotamānā svaprakāśaśabdabrahmarūpā bhāratī
kathamupāsyate
sūkṣmādibhedena dhvanyādibhedena ca vivakṣito namaskāraḥ
śabdabrahmaṇaścatastro bhidā bhavanti
sūkṣmā, paśyantī, madhyamā, vaikharī ceti
tatrāvikāradaśā sūkṣmā
sā hi sarvasya prāṇāpānāntarālavartinī vigataprādurbhāvatirobhāvā sramyakprayogapariśīlanātmanā karmayogena mananādinā jñānayogena ca samyagadhigamyate
‘seyamākīryamāṇāpi nityamāgantukairmalaiḥ
antyā kalā hi somasya nātyantamabhibhūyate
tasyāṃ vijñātamātrāyāmadhikāro nivartate
puruṣe ṣoḍaśakale tāmā-huramṛtāṃ kalām
’ iti
tasya brahmaṇo'nādyavidyāvaśādādyaḥ pariṇāmaḥ paśyantīrūpo jāyate
sa hi varṇavibhāgādakramaḥ svayaṃprakāśaśca
pūrvāpare svāvasthe paśyatīti paśyantītyucyate
tataḥ paramavidyopādānādantaḥ saṃkalparūpakramavān śrotragrāhyavarṇābhivyaktirahitastṛtīyaḥ pariṇāmo madhyamārūpo jāyate
sā kila dvayoḥ pariṇāmayormadhye sadā tiṣṭhatīti madhyametyucyate
antaraṃ dūraprasṛtāyāmavidyāyāṃ sthānakaraṇaprayatnavyajyamānaśrotrasaṃvādivīṇādundubhinādaparicayagadgadāvyaktākārādivarṇasamudāyātmakastṛtīyaḥ pariṇāmo vaikharīrūpo jāyate
viśiṣṭaṃ khamākāśaṃ rāti prayacchatīti vikharo dehendriyasaṃghātaḥ
tathā ca śrutiḥ—‘na ha vai saśarīrasya priyāpriyayorapahatirasti
aśarīraṃ vā va santaṃ priyāpriye na spṛśataḥ
’ iti
tatra bhavā vaikharīti
tadetāsāmavasthānāmādyāstistro nityā atīndriyāḥ
taduktam—‘sthāneṣu vivṛte vāyau kṛtavarṇaparigrahā
vaikharī vākprayoktṝṇāṃ prāṇavṛttinibandhanā
kevalaṃ budhdyupādānakramarūpānupātinī
prāṇavṛttimatikramya madhyamā vākpravartate
avibhāgāttu paśyantī sarvataḥ saṃhṛtakramā
svarūpajyotirevāntaḥsūkṣmā sā cānapāyinī
’ iti
śrutirapyāha—‘catvāri vākparimitā padāni tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ
guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti
’ ityādikamāgamasamuccayādevāvaseyam
kā punastā vāco yāsāmiyamadhiṣṭhātrītyata uktam—‘dhvanirvarṇāḥ padaṃ vākyamityāspadacatuṣṭayam
yasyāḥ’ iti
āspadamadhiṣṭhānamavacchedaḥ
dhvanyādibhiravacchinnā parā vāk tadvyavahārahetuḥ
sāhityaprasiddhābhidhānadhvananalakṣaṇavyavahārakāritvamekasmin varṇe na nirūpyate iti bahuvacanam
padavākyayorasti pratyekamapi tathābhāva iti tābhyāmekavacanamupāttam
tadayamatra tātparyasaṃkṣepaḥ
sāhityasvarūpanirūpaṇāya kilaiṣa granthārambhaḥ
sāhityaṃ ca śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ
tatra śabda eva ka ityapekṣāyāmayaṃ vibhāgo dhvanirityādiḥ
arthastu stambhakumbhādilakṣaṇo soke śāstre ca prasiddhaḥ
saṃbandhaḥ kaścidanādiḥ
sarvasvāyamānastu saṃbandho nānyatretyasminnāyatate
sa caturvidhaḥ—doṣahānam, guṇopādānam, alaṃkārayogaḥ, rasābhiyogaśceti
prekṣāvatpravṛttyaṅgasaṃbandhaprayojane darśayati—
nirdoṣaṃ guṇavatkāvyamalaṃkārairalaṃkṛtam
rasānvitaṃ kaviḥ kurvankīrtiṃ prītiṃ ca vindati || 2
nirdoṣamiti
prītiḥ saṃpūrṇakāvyārthasvādasamuttha ānandaḥ kāvyārthabhāvanāda-śāyāṃ kaverapi sāmājikatvāṅgīkārāt
sahṛdayaślāghayā vā prītistadṛṣṭaṃ prayojanam
kīrtiradṛṣṭadvārā svargaphaletyadṛṣṭam
yadāha—‘kīrti svargaphalāmāhuḥ’ iti
aṅginaḥ kāvyasya prayojanānvākhyānenāṅgabhūtasyāsya prayojanasaṃbandha uktaḥ
yadyapi kāvyaśabdo doṣābhāvādiviśiṣṭāveva śabdārthau brūte, tathāpi lakṣaṇayā śabdārthamātre prayuktaḥ
lakṣaṇāprayojanaṃ cābhidheyānāmuddeśaḥ
tridhā hi sāstraśarīram—‘uddeśaḥ, lakṣaṇam, parīkṣā ce'ti
udāharaṇavyākhyāgranthaḥ sarvatra parīkṣāpara ityasmadguravaḥ
prayojanābhisaṃbandhaparādevoddeśo labhyata iti na virodhaḥ
ata eva doṣādyuddeśakrameṇa paricchedāḥ
nirdoṣaṃ doṣātyantābhāvavat, avayavaikadeśavartinā śvitreṇeva kāminīśarīrasya varṇamātragatenāpi doṣeṇa kāvyavairasyaniyamāt
ata evāmaṅgalaprāyāṇāmapi doṣāṇāṃ prathamamupādānam
ayameva hi prācaḥ kavervyāpāro yaddoṣahānaṃ nāma
guṇavaditi
bhūmri praśaṃsāyāṃ vā matup
alaṃkṛtamityeva vaktavye'laṃkārairiti prasiddhālaṃkāraparigrahārtham
tathālaṃkārairityeva vācye prasiddhānāmapi vakṣyamāṇānāmevopādānārthamalaṃkṛtapadam
rasānvitaṃ rasena nityasaṃbaddham
‘nāstyeva tatkāvyaṃ yatra paramparayāpi vibhābādiparyavasānaṃ na bhavati’ iti kāśmīrikāḥ
etena kāvyalakṣaṇamapi kaṭākṣitam
īdṛśaṃ kāvyaṃ tatkurvan
kaviriti kaverapi lakṣaṇamiti
athoddeśakrameṇa doṣāṇāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ vibhāgaṃ cāha—
doṣāḥ padānāṃ vākyānāṃ vākyārthānāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa
heyāḥ kāvye kavīndrairye tānevādau pracakṣmahe || 3
doṣāḥ padānāmiti
heyā ityanena sāmānyalakṣaṇam
ye heyāste doṣā ityabhiprāyāt
abhimatapratītivyavadhāyakatayā vighnabhūtaḥ śaśvatkāvye heyatāmāsādayati sa eva doṣaḥ
ayamevārthaḥ ‘mukhyārthahatirdoṣaḥ-’ iti padenānyeṣāmabhimataḥ
sa ca pada-vākya-vākyārthaviṣayatayā pūrvaṃ trividhaḥ
padapūrvakatvādvākyasya tatpūrvakatvādvākyārthasya yuktaḥ kramaḥ
varṇamātradoṣo nollekhītyupekṣitavān
avāntaravibhāge tu kriyamāṇe pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirupādhibhiḥ saṃkulamityāha—ṣoḍaśeti
kāvyaprakāśakārādibhiruktānāmadhikānāmihāntarbhāvaḥ
anantarbhāve tu doṣatvameva nāstītyabhiprāyaḥ, na tu deśīyarāganyāyena svamataprakāśanam
pratītivyavadhāyakānāṃ sarvadā tadrūpatvāt
uktamevābhisaṃdhānam—tānevādāviti
vibhāgamantareṇa viśeṣalakṣaṇānavatārātpadadoṣānvibhajate—
asādhu cāprayuktaṃ ca kaṣṭaṃ cānarthakaṃ ca yat
anyārthakamapuṣṭārthamasamarthaṃ tathaiva ca || 4
apratītamatha kliṣṭaṃ gūḍhaṃ neyārthameva ca
saṃdigdhaṃ ca viruddhaṃ ca proktaṃ yaccāprayojakam || 5
deśyaṃ grāmyamiti spaṣṭā doṣāḥ syuḥ padasaṃśrayāḥ
asādhviti
mukhyārthahatau mitho'napekṣāsūcanayā samāsaḥ
ata eva lāghave'nādaraḥ
kathaṃ padapratīkadoṣā na gaṇyanta iti śaṅkāmabhipretyāha—spaṣṭā iti
padasaṃśrayāḥ padānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyinaḥ
evaṃ vākyādāvapi guṇādāvapīdamevāśritatvam
vibhāgaprayojanamāha—
athaiṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ samyaksodāharaṇamucyate || 6
athaiṣāmiti
parīkṣāṃ pratijānīte—samyagiti
lakṣaṇadoṣaśūnyaṃ lakṣaṇānupapattinirṇejanameva hi parīkṣāpadārthaḥ
kathametatsaṃpatsyate ityata āha—sodāharaṇamiti
śabdasvarūpalakṣaṇaḥ prathamanirasyo doṣa ityāśayena prāguddiṣṭasyāsādhorlakṣaṇamāha—
śabdaśāstraviruddhaṃ yattadasādhu pracakṣate
yathā—
‘bhūribhārabharākrānta bādhati skandha eṣa te
tathā na bādhate skandho yathā bādhati bādhate || 1 ||’
atra bādhaterātmanepaditvād ‘bādhate’ iti syāt, na punar ‘bādhati’ iti
śabdeti
śabdāḥ śiṣyante prakṛtipratyayavibhāgaparikalpanayā jñāpyante yena tacchabdaśāstraṃ trimunivyākaraṇaṃ tena viruddhaṃ tadāmnātaprātisvikaviśeṣaparityaktamato na deśīyapadānāmasādhutbam
tathā ca prācyaiḥ—‘nātha te kucayugaṃ patrāvṛtaṃ mā kṛthāḥ’ iti anyakārakavaiyarthyamiti, ‘salīlapāṇidvayalolanālamānartitātāmradalaṃ dadhantīm’ iti ca tādṛśamevodāhṛtam
atra kecidāhuḥ—‘bādhatidhātuṃ saṃskārapracyāvanena bādhate iti bādhatibādhastasya saṃbodhanaṃ bādhatibādheti
te tava
vacanamiti śeṣaḥ’ iti, tadasat
neyārthatvaprasaṃṅgāt
anye tu ‘bādhatirbādhate yathā’ iti paṭhanti
idaṃ tattvam
vidyamānasyārthavattvasyāvivakṣāyāṃ gavityayamāhetyādāviva prātipadikasaṃjñā na pravartate
kavibhirna prayuktaṃ yadaprayuktaṃ taducyate || 7
yathā—
‘kāmacīkamathāḥ ke'mī tvāmajihvāyakīyiṣan
sa sasti kiṃ vacantīme kambaḥ śambaṃ ghariṣyati || 2 ||’
atra ‘acīkamathāḥ', ‘ajihvāyakīyiṣan', ‘sasti', ‘vacanti', 'ghariṣyati', ‘kambaḥ', ‘śambam’ iti śabdānuśāsanasiddhānyapi kavibhirna prayujyante
kavibhiriti
asti hi kiṃcitpadaṃ yatrāprayojyatvenaiva heyatā
yadyevaṃ loke prayujyamānasya sādhutaiva prasaktā ityata uktam—kavibhiriti
kāvye yasyāprayojyatvameva duṣṭatvabījaṃ tadityarthaḥ
tathābhūtā ca padajātiralaṃkārakārasamayādavasīyate
tathā caikena puṃdaivataśabdo'pareṇa cīrṇaśabda udāhṛtaḥ
evamanyadapyaprayuktamityāśayavānkiṃcidudāharati—kāmacīkamathā iti
udāharaṇatvānnaiko'tra śloko gaveṣyaḥ
ekapadamātraprayogastu tyājyaḥ samayavirodhābhāvādityārādhyāḥ
‘acīkamathāḥ’ iti kamerṇiṅantasya luṅi caṅi dvirvacanasanvadbhāvadīrghatvahnasvatvaṇilopeṣu rūpam
kāṃ nāyikāṃ kāmitavānasītyarthaḥ
amī ca ke
tvāmātmano hvāyakameṣitumiṣṭavantaḥ
hvāyakaśabdāt kyac
tataḥ san
tato laṅi ajihvāyakīyiṣanniti rūpam
sa kaścit sasti svapiti
‘pasa sasti svapne’ iti dhāto rūpam
kambaḥ śambamiti
kaṃśaṃśabdau jalavācakau tābhyām
‘kaṃśaṃbhyāṃ vabhayustitutayasaḥ’ iti matvarthīyo vapratyayaḥ
tatrādyena jaladharo jalāśayaṃ sekṣyatītyarthaḥ
‘śambaḥ kamban’ iti kvacitpaṭhyate
tatra kalyāṇavān kapālinaṃ sekṣyatītyartho boddhavyaḥ
‘ghṛ secane’ ityasya dhātorghariṣyatīti rūpam
sa hi dhātuḥ ‘ghṛtaghṛṇāgharmebhyo nānyatra yujyate’ iti pūrvācāryāḥ
kavibhirityanenāsādhuśaṅkā vyāvartitetyāha—śabdānuśāsanasiddhānyapīti
pada śruterasukhadaṃ kaṣṭamityabhiśabditam
yathā—
‘varvarṣṭi jalado yatra yatra durgharṣṭi cātakaḥ
pophullūti nīpaḥ kālo'yaṃ carkarti hṛdayaṃ mama || 3 ||’
atra varvarṣṭyādīni kriyāpadāni śrutyasukhadāni śrūyante
padamityādi
durvacakavarṇārabdhapadaṃ kaṣṭoccāraṇīyatayā kaṣṭamucyate
śruterasukhadamiti dūṣakatābījoddhāṭanam
kadarthitā hi tena śrutiśaktirna tadvākyapratīkaparāmarśakṣameti
kāvyaprakāśakṛtā padaikadeśaḥ kaṣṭa uktaḥ, yathā—‘tadgaccha sidhdyai’, 'apekṣate pratyayamaṅgalabdhyai’ ityatra ‘dhyai’ ‘dhyai’ iti, tatrāha—padamiti
na hi samastavastukaṭutva eva padaṃ kaṣṭatvamāsādayati
kārtārthyamityādau tadudāhṛte tadabhāvāt
ekadeśakaṣṭatayā padakaṣṭatvamiti cātrāpi na daṇḍavāritamiti bhāvaḥ
varvarṣṭi punaḥ punarvarṣati
vṛṣeryaṅlugantasya rūpam
dardharṣṭi punaḥ punardhṛṣṭo bhavati
‘midhṛṣā prāgalbhye’ ityasya tatraiva rūpam
‘dardraṣṭi’ iti pāṭhe dṛśeryaḍlukyamāgame ca rūpam
punaḥ paśyati
nīpaḥ kadambaḥ
pophullūti
‘phulla vikasane’ ityasya tatraiva rūpam
evaṃbhūto varṣāsamayo mama vidūrakāntasya hṛdayaṃ carkarti punaḥ punaratiśayena vā chigatti
‘kṛtī chedane’ ityasya rūpam
bhūyasāṃ kaṣṭapadānāṃ samabhibyāhārādvākyadoṣa iti bhrāntiḥ syāttatrāha—kriyāpadānīti
kathamevaṃ vibhāgo'vasīyata ityata āha—śrūyanta iti
śrotrapratyakṣeṇaiva padamātragāmitayā kaṣṭatvamanubhūyate ityarthaḥ
pādapūraṇamātrārthamanarthakamudāhṛtam || 8
yathā—
‘bibharti yaśca dehārdhe priyāminduṃ hi mūrdhani
sa vai devaḥ khalu tvāṃ tu punātu madanāntakaḥ || 4 ||’
atra ‘ca’ ‘hi’ ‘vai’ ‘khalu’ ‘tu’ ityetāni padāni pādāneva pūrayanti
pādapūraṇeti
dyotanīyamarthamantareṇa prayuktamavyayamanarthakamabhimatam, ata eva prācyaiścādipadamavyayamiti prayogabījakathanārthaṃ nahi nirmūlaḥ prayogaḥ saṃbhavati vṛttinirvahaṇasamarthaḥ
prāyeṇāvyayapadāni kṣiptvā tatpūrayati
taduktam—‘kukavi-prabandha iva śliṣṭapadapracāraḥ
prakaṭatuhinacayo janākīrṇaśca’ iti
bibhartīti
caḥ samuccayādiṣu caturṣu prasiddhaprayogo na ca teṣāmanyatamo'pyatra saṃbhavati
nāpyuccāvacārthakaḥ iti bhāṣaṇenārthāntaramapi
evaṃ hiprabhṛtiṣvavaseyam
etenaitadapyapāstam
yadāhureke—padādiviśeṣānupādānātpadaikadeśo'pyanarthako'bhimataḥ
tathā ca—‘ādāvañjanapuñjaliptavapuṣāṃ śvāsānilollāsitaprotsarpadvirahānalena ca tataḥ saṃtāpitānāṃ dṛśām
saṃpratyeva niṣekamaśrupayasā devasya cetobhuvo bhallīnāmiva pānakarma kurute kāmaṃ kuraṅgekṣaṇā
’ ityatra dṛśāmiti bahuvacanamanarthaṃkaṃ kuraṅgekṣaṇāyā ekasyā evopādānāt
na cātra vyāpāre dṛkśabdo vartate, añjanapuñjalepādīnāmananvayāpatteḥ
tathā ‘kurute’ ityātmanepadamanarthakamakartrabhiprāyakriyāphalāditi
api ca
bahutvakartra bhiprāyaphalābhāve kathanaṃ dvayorasādhutvamiti rājamārga eva bhramaḥ
nahi svarūpata eva kiṃcidasādhu sādhu vā saṃbhavati
rūḍhicyutaṃ padaṃ yattu tadanyārthamiti śrutam
yathā—
‘vibhajante na ye bhūpamālabhante na te śriyam
āvahanti na te duḥkhaṃ prasmaranti na ye priyām || 5 ||’
atra vibhajatervaṇṭane, ālabhatermāraṇe, āvahateḥ karaṇe, prasmaratervismaraṇe rūḍhiḥ
na tu viśeṣasevāyām, abhito lābhe, samantādvahane, prakṛṣṭasmaraṇe ceti
rūḍhicyutamiti
śaktimanapekṣya prayuktaṃ rūḍhicyutam
ata eva yadabhisaṃdhāya prayujyate na kathaṃcana yasyāsāvartha iti anvarthamanyārthamiti nāma
etadeva dhātuviśeṣo'vāntaramupasargaviśeṣayogato yogavānityādinānyairuktam
vibhajanta iti
bhajiḥ sevārtho virupasargastadgataviśeṣadyotakastataśca yathā vidyotata iti
atra viśiṣṭadhātvanurūpaprayogābhidhānaṃ tathātrāpi bhaviṣyatīti bhramo bījamatra śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt
kvacidupasargopasaṃdānena dhāturarthāntara eva vartate
yadāhuḥ—‘upasargeṇa dhātvartho valādanyatra nīyate
prahārāhārasaṃhāravihāraparihāravat
’ iti
tadāha—atra vibhajaterityādi
nanvarthāpekṣitve padārthadūṣaṇamevaṃvidhamiti vāmanaḥ
naitat
padasyaivānvayavyatirekavattvāt
nahyatrānvayasyāparādhaḥ kaścit
kiṃ tu śabda eva vṛttiskhalitādibhiraparāghyati
yadi cārthāpekṣitāmātreṇārthadoṣatvaṃ kathamasādhuprabhṛtīnāmapi śabdadūṣaṇatā
nahi tāni svarūpata eva tathāpi tvarthaviśeṣo viśeṣa evāśvagośvādivaditi
arthadoṣāstu yathā bhavanti tathā vakṣyābhaḥ
yattu tucchābhidheyaṃ syādapuṣṭārthaṃ taducyate || 9
yathā—
‘śatārdhapañcāśabhujo dvādaśārdhārdhalocanaḥ
viṃśatyardhārdhamūrdhāṃ vaḥ punātu madanāntakaḥ || 6 ||’
atra daśabāhuḥ, trilocanaḥ, pañcavakra iti tucchamevābhidheyamatucchaśabdairuktamiti apuṣṭārtham
yattu tucchābhidheyamiti
stokaśabdābhilabhye'rthe bahutaraśabdabahulamityarthaḥ
nahi tathā kriyamāṇamalpīyasīmapi prakarṣatāṃ puṣyati yena tyājyaṃ na syādityapuṣṭapadena sūcitam
śatasyārdhaṃ pañcāśatteṣāṃ pañcatamoṃ'śo daśa
samāse pūraṇapratyayalopaḥ
asaṃgataṃ padaṃ yattadasamarthamiti smṛtam
yathā—
‘jalaṃ jaladhare kṣāramayaṃ varṣati vāridhiḥ
idaṃ bṛṃhitamaśvānāṃ kakudmāneṣa hreṣate || 7 ||’
atra jaladharo meghaḥ, vāridhiḥ samudraḥ, bṛṃhitaṃ gajānām, hreṣitamaśvānāmiti lokaprasiddham
tadiha samudra-megha-aśva-vṛṣabhaviṣayatayā prayujyamānamasaṃgatārthatvādavācakamityasamartham
asaṃgatamiti
kathaṃ punaridamanyārthādbhidyate
atrārādhyāḥ
anyārthe kevalaṃ yogādrūḍhirbalavatī
asamarthe tu kevalayogādyogarūḍhiḥ
tadapare dūṣayanti
tathāpi rūḍhicyutiḥ sādhāraṇyeva tadavāntaraṃ viśeṣadvayamanyaditi
tanna
bhāvānavabodhāt
kiṃciddhi padamapavādakāraṇabalādavagamyamānamapi yogamanapekṣyaiva kvacidarthaviśeṣe vartate
yathā—gauriti
nahi gamanasya vākyārthe praveśaḥ saṃbhavati
kiṃcitpunara-sati bādhahetau budhyamānasya tyāgāyogādyogaviśiṣṭameṃvopādhimabhidhatte
yathā—paṅkajamiti
tatrādyaprakāre rūḍhireva sarvasvamiti tatparityāge rūḍhicyutam
dvitīye tu yogamātre prayuktamasaṃgataṃ śaktiśūnye prayuktaṃ śattkyaikadeśe prayuktamiti bhinno'rthastadetatsarvaṃ vyākhyānena sphuṭayati—atra jaladhareti
jaladharādipadāni jaladhāraṇādiviśiṣṭe meghatvādau rūḍhābhidhānaśaktīni
kathametadavasitamiti cettatrāha—lokaprasiddhamiti
lokādhīnāvadhāraṇatvācchabdārthasaṃbandhasyeti bhāvaḥ
tataśca yadviśiṣṭasya yogasya śaktiviṣayatayā na tena saṃketaḥ
yatra ca samudrādau prayogo na tadupādhibhiḥ samudratvādyaiḥ saṃbhūya śattkyā saṃketaḥ
kṣārādipadopasaṃdānena ca samudrādau prayoga unnīyata ityāha—tadiheti
ata eva na tadavasthasya padaṃ vācakamata eva cākṣamatvādasamarthamiti saṃjñayaiva vyavahriyata iti saṃkṣepaḥ
apratītaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ prasiddhaṃ śāstra eva yat || 10
yathā—
‘kiṃ bhāṣitena bahunā rūpaskandhasya santi me na guṇāḥ
guṇanāntarīyakaṃ ca premeti na te'styupālambhaḥ || 8 ||’
atra rūpaskandha-nāntarīyakaśabdayoḥ śāstraprasiddhatvādanyatrāpratīyamānayoḥ prayogādapratītam
apratītamiti
śāstramātraprasiddhaṃ śāstravyavahārimiḥ saṃketitamityarthaḥ
pratītāpratītasamabhivyāhārarūpaṃ hi vākyamaśāstrajñaviṣayaṃ prayuktamabhimatārthapratītiṃ na janayitumīṣṭe
tatrāpratītānāmevāparādho'taḥ pariskhalanakhedadāyitayā bhavati duṣṭatvam
ata evāprayuktādbahirbhāvaḥ
kiṃ bhāṣiteneti
rūpaskandhavācoyuktiḥ saugatasamayaprasiddhā
teṣāṃ rūpaṃ vedanā saṃjñā saṃskāro vijñānamiti pañcaskandhāḥ
tatrāpi rūpaskandhapadārtha ekādaśapadārthakaḥ
pañcendriyāṇi pañca viṣayā vijñaptirekādaśīti prakriyā
antaramiti vinārthe gahādau paṭhyate
‘tatra bhavaḥ’ iti che svārthike ca kani nañsamāse pṛṣodarāditvānnalopābhāva iti bhāṣyaṭīkā
premṇo vyāpakā guṇā na santi me na ca vyāpakamantareṇa vyāpyaṃ bhavatīti vyāpakānupalabdhiprayuktatvātpremābhāvasya tathopālambhe vācyatā nāstīti bhāvaḥ
śāstra evetyavadhāraṇena yavdyāvartyate tadāha—anyatreti
loka ityarthaḥ
dūre yasyārthasaṃvittiḥ kliṣṭaṃ neṣṭaṃ hi tatsatām
yathā—
‘vijitātmabhavadveṣigurupādahato janaḥ
himāpahāmitradharairvyāptaṃ vyomābhinandati || 9 ||’
atra vinā garutmatā jita indrastasyātmabhavo'rjunastasya dveṣī karṇastasya guruḥ sūryastatpādairabhihato loka ākāśamabhinandati
kīdṛśam
himāpaho vahnistasyāmitro jalaṃ taddhārayanti ye meghāstairvyāptamiti vyavahitārthapratyayaṃ kliṣṭametat
dūra iti
dūraṃ ciraṃ vilamba ityanarthāntaram
kleśo dvividhaḥ—padaviṣayaḥ, vākyaviṣayaśca
ādyaḥ sāmānyaśabdasya prakaraṇādikamanapekṣya kvacidabhipretaviṣaye prayogaḥ
tathā sati vācakatāyāmapi jhaṭiti pratipattirna bhavati
kiṃ tu parasparānvayaparyāṃlocanayā cireṇeti virasatvam
yadāha—‘neṣṭaṃ hi tatprasitānām’ iti, ayamevārtho vyavadhānapadena vāmanādibhiruktaḥ
dvitīyastu vyākīrṇādipadenānyathā vakṣyate—vijiteti
viśabdena pakṣisāmānyavacanena tadviśeṣo garuḍātmā vivakṣitaḥ
tajjito'pi viśeṣa eva
evamanyatrāpi
na cātrāpi kiṃcijjhaṭiti pratītyanuguṇaṃ niyamakāraṇamastīti yuktameva vyavadhānam
himāpaho vahniriti hanterḍapratyaye rūpam
tathā ca candragomī ḍaprakaraṇe ‘hanterḍaḥ’ ityeva sūtritavān
himāpaho vahiriti kvipi vyabhicāraṃ dṛṣṭvā ‘brahmabhrūṇa-’ ityādi sūtritaṃ candragominā
gūḍhārthamaprasiddhārthaṃ prayogaṃ bruvate budhāḥ || 11
yathā—
‘sahasragorivānīkaṃ bhavato duḥsahaṃ paraiḥ
hareriva tavābhānti nānyatejāṃsi tejasi || 10 ||’
sahasraguśabdena sahasrākṣa uktaḥ
na ca gośabdasyākṣṇi bhūyasī prasiddhiḥ
hariśabdena ca sahastrāṃśuḥ so'pi na tena nāmnā bahubhirucyata iti gūḍhatvam
gūḍhārthamiti
yasya padasya dvāvarthau siddhaścāsiddhaśca taccedaprasiddhe prayuktaṃ tadā gūḍhārtham
aprasiddhārtha prayogamiti
aprasidghe'rthe prayogo yasyeti gamakatvādbahuvrīhiḥ
tava tejasi nānyatejāṃsi bhāntīti yojanā
‘gauḥ śarākṣipayaḥsvargapaśumedavacaḥsu ca’ ityāmrāto'pi tathā nākṣṇi prayujyate yathā paśubhedādāvityāha—na ca gośabdasyeti
‘hariḥ kṛṣṇe ca siṃhe ca mekārkabhujageṣu ca’ iti svasaṃketitasyāpi hariśabdasya na tathā ravau prasiddhiryathānyatretyāha—so'pi neti
svasaṃketapraklṛptārtha neyārthamiti kathyate
yathā—
‘mukhāṃśavantamāsthāya vimuktapaśupaṅktinā
paṅktyanekajanāmadhratukā jita ulūkajit || 11 ||’
atra paṅktiśabdena daśasaṃkhyā, anekajanāmetyanena cakram, taṅraityanena rathastābhyāṃ daśarathastasya tuk bālako lakṣmaṇastena jita ulūkajidindrajit
kiṃ kṛtvā
mukhāṃśavantamāsthāya hanumantam
kiṃbhūtena
vimuktapaśupaṅktinā vimukteṣu paśupaṅktinā
atra paśuśabdena gośabdo lakṣyate teneṣavastadidaṃ svasaṃketakalpitārthaṃ neyārthamucyate
svasaṃketeti
kalpitārthaṃ neyārthamiti sūtrayitvā vāmanena vyākhyātam
aśrautasyārthasya kalpanā kalpanākalpitārtham
asyārthaḥ—yatpadaṃ nānārthasvaparyāyalakṣaṇayā vivakṣitapratītiparyantaṃ nīyate tatkalpitārthamiti kecit
tadayuktam
svaparyāyetyasya vyarthatvādavyāpakatvācca
tasmātprayojanaṃ vinā lakṣaṇayā prayuktamityevārthaḥ
yadāha kāvyaprakāśakāraḥ—neyārtheyattvaśaktita iti yasminniṣiddhaṃ lākṣaṇikamiti
prayojanaṃ vinā rūḍhaṃ lakṣaṇāparigrahe na doṣaḥ
tathā ca dvirepharathāṅganāmādipadānāṃ rephadbayānugatabhramarādiśabdalabhaṇādvāreṇa ṣaṭpadādau vṛttirvṛddhavyavahāraparamparānupātinīti teṣāṃ prayogo'yukta eva
ata eva ‘turaṅgakāntāmukhahavyavāhajvāleva bhittvā jalamullalāsa’ ityādikamapi neyārthamiti kāśmīrakāḥ
tadetatkhapadena darśitavān
mukhasyāṃśo hanuratrābhimataḥ
paṅktiriti daśākṣaraṃ chandaḥ daśasaṃkhyā lakṣyate
anekajo dvijaścakravākastasya nāma cakraṃ rathaikadeśastaddhārayatīti dhārayatermūlavibhujāditvātkaḥ
tābhyāmiti
paṅktiranekaja iti nāma yasyetyarthāt
tuk tokaṃ tokmamityapatyanāmāni
upalakṣaṇatayaikadeśaṃ vyācaṣṭe
atra paśuśabdena gośabdo lakṣyata iti prṛtāpekṣayā
teneṣavaḥ pratyāyanta iti śeṣaḥ
na yatpadaṃ niścayakṛtsaṃdigdhamiti tadviduḥ || 12
yathā—
‘nīlalohitamūrtiryo dahatyante jagatrayam
sa eṣa hi mahādevastriṣu lokeṣu pūjyate || 12 ||’
atra vahnirarkaḥ śivo veti na niścīyate
na yatpadamiti
padasvarūpameva saṃdihyamānamatra
tathāhi—sa eṣa hi mahādeva ityatra sa kimeṣa hi mahādeva iti cchedo vidhīyatāṃ mahādeva iti vā sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāve saṃdihyate
na ca viśeṣaṇaniyamahetuḥ
vahnyarkāvapi hi bhagavato nīlalohitamūrtibhūtau himāpahau ca na niścayakṛditi dūṣaṇatābījapradarśanam
yadaiko vivakṣitastadā doṣaḥ
sādhucara ityatrāpi ‘bhūtapūrve caraṭ’ iti caraṭpratyaye kiṃ pūrvaṃ sādhurathavā careṣṭapratyaye sādhuṣu caratīti padameva saṃdihyate tena padāvayavaḥ saṃdigdha iti kenaciduktam, tadapyapāstam
viparītaṃ viruddhārthaprakalpanamihocyate
yathā—
‘anuttamānubhāvasya parairapihitaujasaḥ
akāryasuhṛdo'smākamapūrvāstava kīrtayaḥ || 13 ||’
atra anuttamā ityanena yathotkṛṣṭastathāpakṛṣṭo'pi
apihitamityanena yathā nācchāditaṃ tathācchāditamiti
akāryasuhṛdityanena yathākāryamantareṇa suhṛdevamakārye yaḥ suhṛtso'pyucyate
apūrvāḥ kīrtaya ityanena yathādbhutāḥ kīrtaya evamakīrtayo'pyucyante
viparītamiti
viparītaṃ prakṛtopamardakamarthakalpanaṃ yatra
tathā hi—anuttametyādau prakaraṇādibhiḥ stutiparatve vyavasthite uttamatvābhāvādinā viruddhenārthena tatra paryavasāyayituṃ na śakyate
saṃśayaṃ yugapadvivakṣāyāmapi na virodhaḥ
iha tu stutinindayoryaugapadyamasaṃbhāvitamata evaikasya saṃbhave tvaparasya bādha eva
yathā—‘cirakālapariprāptalocanānandadāyinaḥ
kāntā kāntasya sahasā vidadhāti galagraham
’ iti galagrahaśabdasya kaṇṭhagrahapratidvandvinyarthe vivākṣite pūrvaprakrāntānandadāyitvaṃ bādhyate
atrānuttama iti bahuvrīhitatpuruṣābhyāmapihitamiti ‘vaṣṭi bhāguriḥ’ ityādinā vikalpenākāralopavidhānāt
apūrvā iti pakṣāntare'kārapūrvāḥ
niyāmakasadbhāve tu guṇa eva
yathā—‘apūrva yadvastu prathayati vinā kāraṇakalām’ iti śabdarūpāntarameva viruddhopacāyakamityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdadoṣatāvyavasthitiḥ
aprayojakamityāhuraviśeṣavidhāyakam || 13
yathā—
‘tamālaśyāmalaṃ kṣāramatyacchamatiphenilam
phālena laṅghayāmāsa hanūmāneṣa sāgaram || 14 ||’
atra tamālaśyāmalamityādīni sāgaraviśeṣaṇāni tāni na hanūmato laṅghane'tiśayaṃ sūcayanti
aprayojakamityāhuriti
tadeva hi kavīnāmupādeyaṃ yadvākyārthe prakṛṣṭakāṣṭhāṃ puṣṇāti
anyathānaṅgābhidhāne'vācyavacanameva syātsārthakatvādananvayatvācca
na vṛttapūraṇamātraprayojanatā nātiśayamiti
sāgaralaṅghanadvārā hanūmataḥ prakarṣo vācyaḥ
na ca tamālaśyāmalatvādiviśeṣaṇāni kathaṃcitprakarṣamarpayanti yāni dūratvādīni tathā na teṣāmupādānam
taddeśyamiti nirdiṣṭaṃ yadavyutpattimatpadam
yathā—
‘gallau lāvaṇyatallau te laḍahau maḍahau bhujau
netre vosaṭṭakandoṭṭamoṭṭāyitasakhe sakhi || 15 ||’
atra gallatallādayaḥ śabdā avyutpattimanto deśyā dṛśyante
taddeśyamiti
avyutpattimat prakṛtipratyayavibhāgaśūnyaṃ lokamātraprayuktaṃ pada-manādeyaṃ bhavati
taddividham—abhāgaṃ bhāgavacceti
ādyaṃ deśyam, dvitīyaṃ grāmyamiti vibhāgaḥ
vyutpannānāmanyādṛśī cchāyā deśyānāṃ ca na tādṛśīti deśyavedyapadasamabhivyāhāre prāyeṇa chāyāvairūpyaṃ bandhasya bhavatīti sahṛdayahṛdayasākṣikaṃ doṣabījam
tallamalpasaraḥ, laḍahaṃ manoharam, maḍahaṃ kṛśam, vosaṭṭaṃ vikasitam, kandoṭṭaṃ nīlotpalam, moṭṭāyitaṃ vilāsaḥ
aślīlāmaṅgalaghṛṇāvadartha grāmyamucyate || 14
atrāślīlamasabhyārthamasabhyārthāntaraṃ ca yat
asabhyasmṛtihetuśca trividhaṃ paripaṭhyate || 15
teṣvasabhyārthaṃ yathā—
‘chatrākāraśirāḥ śirālasarasasthūlaprakāṇḍo mahā- nmadhye bhānusutābhrasindhuvipulābhogo vaṭaḥ pātu vaḥ
kāyaikye vikaṭaprasāritamahājaṅghaṃ mahīsuptayo- ryaḥ khaṇḍendukirīṭakaiṭabhajitoḥ kāṭaśriyaṃ karṣati || 16 ||’
tadetacchatrākāraśirāḥ kāṭa ityāderasabhyārthatvādasabhyārtham
aślīleti
deśyātiriktaṃ lokamātraprayuktaṃ grāmyam
tatridhā—vrīḍājugupsātaṅkadāyitvāt
tatrādyamaślīlaṃ śrīryasyāsti tacchlīlam
sidhmāderākṛtigaṇatvāllaca
kapilakādipāṭhāllatvam
na ślīlamaślīlam
vrīḍādāyitvenākāntamityarthaḥ
dvitīyaṃ ghṛṇāvadarthakam
jugupsādāyi pratyāyyamasyeti
tṛtīyamamaṅgalārthamātaṅkadāyijñāpyamasyeti kṛtvāślīlaparyāyo'sabhyaśabdaḥ
sabhāyāṃ sādhurityarthe tenāpi śāstre vyavahāra iti pradarśanārthamasatyaśabdenāślīlamanūdya vyācaṣṭe
tatrāsabhyamiti
arthasyāsabhyatvātpadamapyasabhyam
sa cārthaḥ kvacitprakṛto'prakṛto'pi śleṣopasthita ekadeśātsmṛtimātrārūḍho vā
tatra yathākramamasabhyādayastrayaḥ
evamamaṅgalādayo'pi
sūryasutā yamunā
abhrasindhurgaṅgā
tayormadhye ‘pāre madhye ṣaṣṭhyā vā’ ityavyayībhāvaḥ
ardhaṃ harerardhaṃ harasyeti śarīraikye kāṭaśabdasyāsabhyārthatve tadviśeṣaṇānāmapyasabhyatvamiti tānyādāya vyācaṣṭe—atra chatrākāreti
asabhyārthāntaraṃ yathā—
‘vidyāmabhyasato rātrāveti yā bhavataḥ priyā
vanitāguhyakeśānāṃ kathaṃ te pelabandhanam || 17 ||’
tadetadyā bhavataḥ priyā guhyakeśānāṃ pelabandhanaśavdānāmasabhyārthāntaratvādasabhyārthāntaram
vidyāmiti
yā rātrau vidyāmabhyasato mantramāvartayatastava priyā samāyāti sā yakṣiṇī
ataḥ kathaṃ te dhanaṃ pelavaṃ komalam
khalpamiti yāvat
kiṃ tu yakṣiṇīprasādādbahu dhanaṃ tavocitamityarthaḥ
prakṛtapadāni tvasabhyārthāntarāṇi tānyuddhṛtya vyācaṣṭe—tadetadyā bhavataḥ priyeti
asabhyārthaprakāśanameva ṣaṣṭhyā ākrośa ityarthaḥ
yā bhavataḥ priyeti ekaṃ padaṃ yābho maithunaṃ tadvataḥ priyetyarthāt
yonirvanitāyā guhyastasya keśāḥ
pelaśabdo muṣkayoḥ prasiddhaḥ
tatra bandhanamiti
asabhyasmṛtiheturyathā—
‘utkampayasi māṃ cūta pikavākkāṭavena kim
kṛtaḥ kṛkāṭikāyāṃ te pādaḥ prāṇena yāsyatā || 18 ||’
tadidaṃ kāṭavakṛkāṭikāpādayorasabhyasmṛtihetutvādasabhyasmṛtihetutā
utkampayasīti
he cūtavṛkṣa, kokilasya vācā kaṭutvena duḥkhadāyitvāt kiṃ māṃ bhāpayasi
nanu tava kṛkāṭikāyāṃ prīvāyāṃ pādaṃ dattvā calitā mama prāṇāstena mayā jitam
vyarthastavāyaṃ pariśrama iti vākyārtho vivakṣitaḥ
kāṭavaśabde kāṭa ekadeśaḥ kṛkāṭikāśavde kāṭiketi lopaḥ
kāṭaḥ kāṭikā
lokeṣu yadaśastārthamaśastārthāntaraṃ ca yat
aśastasmṛtihetuścāmaṅgalārthaṃ tridhaiva tat || 16
teṣvaśastārthaṃ yathā—
‘kheṭake bhaktasūpasya valabhyāḥ pattanasya ca
atṛpto'haṃ mariṣyāmi hehale bhāṣitasya ca || 19 ||’
atra mariṣyāmītipadamaśastārtham
kheṭaka iti
atṛptaḥ sukhasyeyattāparicchedābhāvāt
kheṭake grāme yadbhaktaṃ sūpaścotpadyate tasya pattanasya nagarasya yā valabhī tasyāṃ suhitārthayoge ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhālliṅgādanumīyate tṛptyarthayoge ṣaṣṭhī bhavati
anye tu vyācakṣate—bhaktasūpapadanāmā dakṣiṇāpathe viṣayastatsadmani kheṭake valabhīnāma kasyacidvirūpākṣādhiṣṭhānasya tatraiva pattanasya hehale iti strīṇāmavyājamanyonyapremātiśayagarbhasya bhāṣitasyeti
aśastārthāntaraṃ yathā—
‘pravāsayati yā kāntaṃ vasante gṛhasaṃsthitam
vināśapathadānena piśācī sā na cāṅganā || 20 ||’
atra pravāsayati-saṃsthitaṃ-vināśapathadānena-piśācīpadānāmaśastārthāntaratvam
pravāsayatīti
śapathadānena vinā pravāsayati anyatra prahiṇoti gṛhe samyak sthitaṃ priyaṃ sāṅnā na, kiṃ tu piśācīvadanucitakāriṇītyartho'bhimataḥ
anyatra pravāsanamuccāṭanaṃ saṃsthānaṃ vināśaḥ vināśasya panthāstasya dānam
piśitamaśnātīti piśācī
pṛṣodarāditvāt
tadetavdyācaṣṭe—atra pravāsayatīti
aśastasmṛtiheturyathā—
‘mārīco'yaṃ muniryasya kṛtyā kālāntakālaye
patnyāṃ saṃkrandanādīnāṃ sutānāmāptaye'bhavan || 21 ||’
atra mārīcakṛtyā kālāntaka-saṃkrandana-padānāmaśastārthasmṛtihetutvam
mārīco'yamiti
marīcerapatyaṃ mārīcaḥ kāśyapaḥ saṃkrandanādīnindrādīn dvādaśa putrānādityānutpāditavān
tacca kālāntakasya bhagavato mahādevasyālaye yāḥ kṛtyāḥ kriyā bhagavadārādhanarūpāstāsāṃ phalamityarthaḥ
mārīcaśabde mārakadeśaḥ kṛtyā iti subantapade kṛtyetyekadeśaḥ, kālāntakālaya ityatrāntaketi, saṃkrandane śabdakrandaneti

utkauti utkāraṃ karoti

‘bāṣpaklinnāvimau gaṇḍau vipūyāpāṇḍarau tava

atra kākaṃ kṣipati, kūraṃ khādati, kaṇṭhe naptāraṃ gṛhṇāti, śvānaṃ bhīṣayate, ityādau vaktavye yathoktapadavinyāsaḥ saṃkīryate

atra yogyo yaste putro lakṣmaṇena mayā mṛtyuvaśaṃ nīyata iti vākyasya rakṣainaṃ yadi śaktiriti vākyāntareṇa sagarbhatvādgarbhitam
vākyāntareti
madhyapraviṣṭaṃ vākyaṃ pūrvottarabhāgābhyāmekībhūtasya garbhāyamāṇamekakharasaprasūtāṃ pratītiṃ vighnayadātmanā sahaiva samudāyavirasakakṣāmārohayati
vākyāntaravākyasya viśeṣo vivakṣitaḥ pratītivyavadhāyaka iti yāvat
yogya iti
mayeti
kārakavibhakteḥ kriyākāṅkṣaṇaśīlāyāstāmasaṃgamayya madhya rakṣainaṃ śaktirityetāvatā garbhasthānīyena virasīkaraṇamityāha—atra yogyo ya iti
evaṃ vākyarūpatābhaṅgahetūndoṣānabhidhāya tatraiva kāvyabhāvapratyūhahetavo'bhidhātavyāste ca guṇabhaṅgadvārakāḥ, alaṃkārabhaṅgadvārakāḥ, chandobhaṅgadvārakāḥ, yatibhaṅgādvārakāśceti caturdhā viprathante
tataśca yadyapi prathamaṃ guṇabhaṅgadvārakā vaktumucitāstathāpi teṣāṃ bahutvāddurūhatvācca sūcīkaṭāhanyāyena paścātkaraṇamalaṃkārabhedādiṣu ca madhye pratiyogidvārālaṃkārabhaṅgasya prādhānyamiti taddvārā doṣāṃllakṣayati
yatropamā bhinnaliṅgā bhinnaliṅgaṃ taducyate
bhavettadbhinnavacanaṃ yadbhinnavacanopamam || 25
yathā—
‘avigāhyo'si nārīṇāmananyavacasāmapi
viṣamopalabhinnormirāpagevottitīrṣataḥ || 33 ||’
atrāpageva tvamavigāhyo'sīti liṅgabhedaḥ
nārīṇāmuttitīrṣata iti liṅgabhedo vacanabhedaśca
tadidaṃ dvayorekamevodāharaṇam
yatropameti
upamāgrahaṇamupalakṣaṇamityagre vakṣyāmaḥ
upamā upamitiḥ sādṛśyabhinnopamānavācina upameyavācinaśca liṅgaṃ strīpuṃnapuṃsakaṃ yasya sā tathoktā
evaṃ bhinnavacanopamamityatrāpi vyākhyeyam
avigāhyo'sīti
avigāhyatāmātramatra sādṛśyaṃ vivakṣitametadupayuktameva viśeṣaṇamupamānopameyayorupādānayogyamityakasmādeva vikṛtavacanabhedanibandhanaḥ prayojanamākāṅkṣati
tathā tadanusaṃdhānapravaṇasya prakṛtapratītirācchādyata iti dūṣaṇasiddhiḥ
etena dūṣaṇatā vyākhyātā
vibhāgavākye sahitāvasthayoruddeśādiha ca militayorudāharaṇāttathābhāvo doṣatvamiti bhrāntiṃ nirasyati—tadidamiti
ekamudāharaṇaṃ natvekaḥ saṃmitra upādhiḥ pratyekameva tvasti samarthatvādityarthaḥ
etadevānusaṃdhāya vibhāgavākye dve padam
tatkimudāharaṇasya saṃkīrṇatvameva netyāha—
atha bhinnaliṅgasyaiva yathā—
‘vāpīva vimalaṃ vyoma haṃsīva dhavalaḥ śaśī
śaśilekheva haṃso'yaṃ haṃsāliriva te yaśaḥ || 34 ||’
bhinnavacanasyaiva yathā—
‘sarāṃsīvāmalaṃ vyoma kāśā iva sitaḥ śaśī
śaśīva dhavalā haṃsī haṃsīva dhavalā diśaḥ || 35 ||’
atha bhinnaliṅgasyaiveti
dvayamapi nigadavyākhyātam
jātipramāṇadharmato nyūnatā upamānasya nyūnopamatvam
tatra jātipramāṇanyūnatārthadoṣaḥ
dharmanyūnatā tu dharmābhidhāyakapadanyūnatālakṣaṇāśabdadoṣa eva
etenādhikatvaṃ vyākhyātamityāśayavānāha—
nyūnopamamiha nyūnamupamānaviśeṣaṇaiḥ
yathā—
‘saṃhaacakkavāajuā viasiakamalā muṇālasaṃcchaṇṇā
vāvī vahu vva roaṇavilittathaṇaā suhāvei || 36 ||’
[saṃhatacakravākayugā vikasitakamalā mṛṇālasaṃcchannā
vāpī vadhūriva rocanāviliptastanī sukhayati ||]
atra netrabāhūpamāpadānāṃ vadhūviśeṣaṇatvenānuktatvādidaṃ nyūnopamam
nyūnopamamiheti
ihaśabdo yeṣu madhyeṣūpamānasya stokaviśeṣaṇatayopameyanyūnetyuktaṃ tathādhikopamamiti vakṣyati—saṃhatetyādi
atra cakravākayugopamānamapadameva paramupāttama
rocanāviliptastanītyanena kamalasyopamānaṃ netrapadaṃ mṛṇālasyopamānaṃ bāhupadaṃ ca nopāttaṃ tadapi ca saviśeṣaṇamupādeyaṃ bhavati
yena vikāsādisamabhivyāhārasāmañjasyamapi syāditi
padānāmiti bahuvacanābhiprāyaḥ
ata eva dharmāṇāmekanirdeśe'nyasaṃvitsāhacaryāditi nāvatarati vyabhicārāt
kimarthaṃ tasyopamānamanusaṃdheyamityapi na vācyam
mātrāpi nānarthikā kavinopādeyeti sāhityavidāmnāyavyavasthitāvupameyaviśeṣaṇasyopamānaviśeṣaṇatayā prayojanacintāyāṃ pūrvavadeva pratītipratyūhasya sulabhatvādanuktatvāditiśabdapradhānakatāmācaṣṭe
evamuttaratra
adhikaṃ yatpunastaiḥ syāttamāhuradhikopamam || 26
yathā—
‘ahiṇavamaṇaharaviraiavalaavihūsā vihāi ṇavavahuā
kundalaevva samupphullagucchapariṇittabhamaragaṇā || 37 ||’
[abhinavamanoharaviracitavalayavibhūṣā vibhāti navavadhūḥ
kundalateva samutphullagucchapariṇīyamānabhramaragaṇā ||]
idaṃ bhramaragaṇasyopamānaviśeṣaṇasyādhikyādadhikopamānam
adhikamiti
yadyapyekasya viśeṣaṇādhikye viśeṣaṇanyūnatve vānyaviśeṣaṇasya nyūnādhikabhāvo niyatastathāpyupamānagatameva dvayaṃ nirūpyate
tatra hi dṛṣṭamupameye pratibimbakalpamupasthāpyate tenānto nopameye tayornirūpaṇamiti
bhagnacchanda iti prāhuryacchandobhaṅgavadvacaḥ
yathā—
‘yasminpañca pañcajanā ākāśaśca pratiṣṭhitaḥ
tameva dhīro vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvīta brāhmaṇaḥ || 38 ||’
atra pañcamavarṇasya laghoḥ sthāne guroḥ karaṇācchandobhaṅgaḥ
bhagnacchanda iti
vācāṃ śravyo'vacchedaśchandastasyaivopamānayuktādayastenaiva gurulaghuniveśakrameṇa śravyatā bhavatītyāśayāt
tasya viparyāsaśchandobhaṅgo vyakta eva vairasyahetuḥ prāhuriti
pañcodāharaṇatvāvacchedaviparyāsatve ca bhagnavṛttavyavahārādidameva nimittamasyāvadhāryata ityarthaḥ
pañceti
pañcajanāḥ puruṣāste devapitṛgandharvarākṣasāsurabhedātpañca
athavā niṣādapañcamabrāhmaṇādicatuṣṭayabhedāt
tamevātmānaṃ brahmāparaparyāyaṃ vijñāya śravaṇamanananididhyāsanairupāsya prajñāṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ sākṣātkurvīta
atra pañcamavarṇasyeti
‘pañcamaṃ laghu sarvatra saptamaṃ dvicaturthayoḥ
ṣaṣṭhaṃ guruṃ vijānīyāccheṣāstvaniyatā matāḥ
’ ityanuṣṭupchandaso lakṣaṇam
asthāne viratiryasya tattu bhagnayatīṣyate || 27
yathā—
‘brahmendropendrādigīrvāṇavandyo bhaktānāṃ bhūyācchriye candracūḍaḥ
strīṇāṃ saṃgītaṃ samākarṇayanketūdastāmbhodaṃ sadadhyāsta īśaḥ || 39 ||’
atra caturthasthāne yatau kartavyāyāṃ tadanyatra yatikaraṇādbhagnayatīdam
asthāna iti
śravyaḥ paṭhiti vicchedo yatirvicchidya vicchidya paṭhyamānā bhāratī svadate
śravyatopalakṣaṇārthaṃ ca dvimunivedādisaṃjñayā tatra tatra vivicyate
tathā cāsti kaścidviśeṣo yena kriyamāṇāpi viratirna saubhāgyapadaṃ puṣyati
sa ca viśeṣo nāma bhāgabhedo'svarasaṃdhikṛtaśca prāyeṇa eteṣāṃ svabhāvaviśeṣādeva sthāne kriyamāṇāpi viratiranyatraiva paraṃ prakāśate
na tatra kathaṃcana saubhāgyamunmīlayati
sthānaparibhāṣayā vyāvartitatvāt
tadidamuktam—asthāna iti
vāmano'pyāha—‘virasavirāmaṃ kaṣṭam’ iti
sado gṛharūpā sabhā ketūdastāmbhodaṃ dhvajadaṇḍotkṣiptajaladharamityuccaistvam
‘vedacchedā śālinī mo'tha tau gau’ ityupalakṣaṇaṃ śravyarateḥ
atra dvitīyapāde dhātubhāgabhedaḥ śeṣapādatraye nāmabhāgabhedāḥ
na cātra svarasaṃdhānamastīti
kriyāpadavihīnaṃ yadaśarīraṃ taducyate
yathā—
‘selasuāruddhaddhaṃ muddhāṇābaddhabhuddhasasileham
sīsapariṭṭiagaṅgaṃ saṃjjhāpaṇaaṃ pamahaṇāham || 40 ||’
[śailasutāruddhārdhaṃ mūrdhābaddhabhugnaśaśilekham
śīrṣapariṣṭhitagaṅgaṃ saṃdhyāpraṇataṃ pramathanātham ||]
kriyāpadābhāvādaśarīramidam
kriyāpadeti
kriyetyupalakṣaṇam
pradhānapadahīnamiti boddhavyam
pradhānāvimarśe hi vākyaśarīrameva na niṣpannaṃ syāt
śaileti
vākye kriyāpradhānamiti darśane tatpadānupādānādatra pradhānāvimarśaḥ
śailasutayāvaruddhamardhaṃ yasya
muddhāṇo mūrdhā tatrābaddhā bhugnā śaśilekhā yena
śīrṣe pratiṣṭhā gaṅgā yena
yaśca saṃdhyāyai praṇatastaṃ pramathanāthaṃ pramathā gaṇāsteṣāṃ nātham
karmavibhakteḥ kriyāmantareṇācaritārthatvātkriyāyā namaskārarūpāyā vyabhicāreṇārthāpattiviṣayatānupapatteriti
asyāṃ ca gāthāyāṃ strīmayavyāpārarūpatā bhagavataḥ pratīyate iti rahasyamārādhyā manyante
guṇabhaṅgadvārakadoṣanirūpaṇāvasaro'yamityāśayavānāha—
guṇānāṃ dṛśyate yatra śleṣādīnāṃ viparyayaḥ || 28
arītimaditi prāhustattridhaiva pracakṣate
śabdārthobhayayogasya prādhānyātprathamaṃ tridhā || 29
bhūtvā śleṣādiyogena punastredhopajāyate
atra yaḥ śleṣasamatā saukumāryaviparyayaḥ || 30
śabdapradhānamāhustamarītimatidūṣaṇam
tatra—
viparyayeṇa śleṣasya saṃdarbhaḥ śithilo bhavet || 31
yathā—
‘ālīyaṃ mālatīmālā lolālikalilā manaḥ
nirmūlayati me mūlāttamālamaline vane || 41 ||’
atra bhinnānāmapi padānāmekapadatā pratibhāsaheturanatikomalo bandhaviśeṣaḥ śleṣaḥ
tadviparyayeṇa śabdapradhāno'yaṃ śleṣaviparyayaḥ
guṇānāmiti
samādhyādibhaṅgo'pi tarhi doṣaḥ syādityata āha—śleṣādīnāmiti
śleṣaprasādasamatā saukumāryārthavyaktimādhuryakāntyudārataujasām
etadyogādvākyaṃ vakrarūpatāmāsādya kāvyavyapadeśaṃ labhate
teṣāṃ guṇānāṃ bhaṅgaḥ kāvyābhāsatvaparyavasāyī doṣaḥ
te ca śleṣādayo navaiva
teṣāmanyatamābhāve kāvyasyābhāsatvāt
teṣāṃ hi viparyaye rītiravaśyaṃ bhajyate
tasyā guṇavatpadaracanārūpatvāt
ata eva pānakarasanyāyena saṃbhūyacitrāsvādaparyavasānakṣamaṃ guṇasaṃvalanameva rītiriti locanakāraḥ
rītiḥ sārarūpatayā kāvyasyātmetyucyate
yathā citrasya lekhā uttuṅgapratyaṅgalāvaṇyonmīlanakṣamā, tathā rītiriti dvitīye vistaraḥ
tattridheti
taditi kākākṣigolakavatpūrvāparābhyāmabhisaṃbadhyate
yatra guṇānāṃ viparyayastadarītimat
tattridhetyarthaḥ
tridhābhūtaṃ bhūyastridhā pracakṣate
tena navabhedāḥ
tadetadvivṛṇoti—śabdārtheti
yogaśabdaḥ pratyekamanvīyate
śabdapradhānatvamarthānapekṣaśabdanirūpyatvam
vākyaguṇasya śleṣāditrayasya
evaśabdānapekṣārthanirūpaṇīyatvaṃ tādṛśasya kāntyāditrayasya
etenaujaḥprabhṛtitrikasyobhayapradhānatā vyākhyātā
tenāyamarthaḥ śabdārthobhayapradhānatayā sāmānyatastridhā bhūtvā śleṣāditrikavivakṣayā pratyekaṃ tridhā bhavatīti
teṣu śabdasya prāthamyāttatpradhānakaguṇabhaṅgaḥ prathamaṃ vivektavya ityāha—tatreti
arītimatīti nirdhāraṇe saptamī
jātyabhiprāyamekavacanam
viparyayeṇeti
śleṣaḥ saṃdhānaṃ ghaṭanamityanarthāntaram
na caitāvataiva guṇatvaṃ vākyamātrasādhāraṇatvāt
tena bahūnāmapi padānāmekatāpratibhāsahetutvamanatikomalatvaṃ ca viśeṣaṇamicchanti
viśeṣamarthaguṇakāṇḍe vakṣyāmaḥ
evaṃbhūtaviśeṣaṇaviparyāse śithilo bandho'tikomalo vikīrṇaprāyaścetyarthaḥ
ālīyamityādau dantyavarṇaprāyatayātikomalatvaṃ vikīrṇatā ca vyaktaiva
nāsya nirūpaṇe kvacidapyarthāpekṣeti sphuṭayannāha—atra bhinnānāmiti
śleṣasya śabdapradhānatayā tadviparyayo'pi śabdapradhāno bhavatītyāha—śabdapradhāno'yamiti
anyataraviśeṣaṇahānāvapi śleṣābhāvo bhavatyeva
tena pūrvārdhasya leśata aikyapratibhānasaṃbhave'pyatikomalatayā duṣṭatvam
bhavetsa eva viṣamaḥ samatāyā viparyayāt
yathā—
‘kokilālāpavācālo māmeti malayānilaḥ
ucchalacchīkarācchācchanirjharāmbhaḥkaṇokṣitaḥ || 42
atra pūrvārdhasya mṛdubandhatvāduttarārdhasya ca gāḍhabandhatvātsamabandheṣu viṣamamiti viṣamo nāma śabdapradhānaḥ samatāviparyayo doṣaḥ
bhavediti
sa eva saṃdarbho mṛdumadhyakaṭhoravarṇanirvyūḍhāstistro bandhajātayastatraikarūpe vākyārthe ekaiva jātirupādeyeti tadviparyāso vairāgyahetureva
utchalantaḥ śīkarā yasmāttathācchācchamatyaccham
dvayamapi nirjharāmbhoviśeṣaṇam
malayamārutasyoddīpanavibhāvabhūtasya varṇamātravairūpyamasyetyāśayavānāha—atra pūrvārdhasyeti
śabdapradhānatāmasya vivṛṇoti—samabandheṣviti
saukumāryaviparyāsātkaṭhora upajāyate || 32
yathā—
‘asitartitugadricchitsvaḥ kṣitāṃpatiradvidṛk
amidbhiḥ śubhradṛgdṛṣṭairdviṣo jeghnīyiṣīṣṭa vaḥ || 43 ||’
atrātikaṭhoratvādasaukumāryaṃ supratītameva
saukumāryaviparyāsāditi
akaṭhorākṣaraprāyatābandhasya sukumāratvaṃ tadviparthaye kaṭhoratā śrutikaṭutvaṃ bhavati
asitatīṃti
‘ṛ gatau’ iti dhātvanusārādṛtirvartma
asitā kṛṣṇā ṛtirvartma yasya kṛṣṇavartmā vahnistasya tugapatyam
adricchiditi krauñcadāraṇatvāt
svarge kṣiyanti nivasanti ye devāsteṣāṃ patiḥ senānītvāt
advidṛgdvādaśalocanatvāt
sa evaṃbhūto bhagavān kumāro'midbhirasnigdhai rūkṣaiḥ śubhradṛgdṛṣṭairdhavalākṣivilokitaiḥ sakrodhanibhālane tārakābhāgasyordhvatayā nayanāttathābhāvo jātirvo yuṣmākaṃ dviṣaḥ śatrūñjeghnīyiṣīṣṭa
atyarthaṃ punaḥ punarvā vadhyādi- tyarthaḥ
hanteryaṅi ghnībhāve āśīrliṅi rūpam
svatantrasya padasya śrutikaṭutā padadoṣaḥ
iha tu padānāmatathābhāve rti dri cchi ityādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ parasparasaṃnidhāne ghaṭanaiva kaṭhoretyāha—atrātikaṭhoratvāditi
yā tu kāntiprasādārthavyaktīnāmanyathā gatiḥ
arthapradhānaḥ proktaḥ sa vākye guṇaviparyayaḥ || 33
aprasannaṃ bhavedvākyaṃ prasādasya viparyayāt
yathā—
‘anaṅgakamalaṃcakre mayamānā marālikā
yasyānatyarjunābjanma sadṛkṣāṅko valakṣaguḥ || 44 ||’
atra śabdānāmanatiprasiddhatvādanatiprasannatvamiti so'yamarthapradhānaḥ prasādaviparyayo doṣaḥ
yā tu kāntīti
‘kāntiprasādārthavyaktīnām’ iti pramādātpāṭhaḥ
vivaraṇakramānurodhena ‘prasādārthavyaktikāntīnām’ iti paṭhanīyam
aprasannamiti
śrutamātrasyaiva yasyārthaścitte pratiphalati sa prasannaḥ śabdaḥ
tathā cārthasya prākaṭyaṃ jhaṭiti pratibandhayogyatvam
‘paścādiva gatirvācaḥ purastādiva vastuna’ iti sahṛdayavyavahārārthaviṣayatvaṃ prasādo'rthanirūpaṇīya iti bhavatyarthapradhānaḥ
na cāsau padamātramullikhatīti vākyāṃśo bhavati
tena tadviparyayo'pi vākyagāmī
‘arthasya yanna jhaṭiti pratītirupajāyate
tatra tatra mahārāja śabda evāparādhyati
’ iti vākyadoṣeṣu parigaṇanamabhyacchatayā ca śabdānāṃ pratītiḥ skhalantī dūṣaṇatāmasya sthāpayati—anaṅgakamiti
na vidyate'ṅgaṃ yasyetyanaṅgakamākāśaṃ mayamānā gacchantī
ayamayeti daṇḍakeṣu paṭhitānmayadhātoḥ śānac
marālikā haṃsī
alaṃcakre śobhitavatī
nanu haṃsyāgamanapathālaṃkaraṇakālo rātristasyāṃ ca tuṣārakiraṇa eva tadalaṃkārakārī kimanayā varākyetyata āha—yasyeti
yadanatyarjunaṃ na bhavati abjanma toyabhavam
nīlotpalamiti yāvat
tatsadṛśalāñchano valakṣagurvalakṣo gauḥ kiraṇo yasya śubhrāṃśuścandraḥ
tenāsau sakalaṅkatayā na tathālaṃkārāya yatheyamityarthaḥ
paśyeti vākyārthakarmakameke paṭhanti
tanna yuktam
cakra iti parokṣatayā svarasabhaṅgāpatteḥ
uktayuktyā vākyadoṣatvamāha—atra śabdānāmiti
na ca mayamānādīnāṃ śliṣṭatā
tallakṣaṇāvirahāt
nāpi gūḍhārthatvaṃ tata eva
vākyaṃ bhavati neyārthamarthavyakterviparyayāt || 34
yathā—
‘mahī mahāvarāheṇa lohitāduddhṛtodadheḥ
itīyatveva nirdiṣṭe neyā lauhityahetavaḥ || 45 ||’
tadidaṃ nigadenaiva vyākhyātamityarthapradhāno'yamarthavyaktiviparyayaḥ
vākyamiti
saṃpūrṇaṃ vākyatvamarthavyaktiṃ karotīti vakṣyati
sarvasya vākyasya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvabodhakatvaniyame yāvatāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo'bhimatastāvatpratipādakapadopādānaṃ saṃpūrṇatā
sā ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvānurūpārthanirūpaṇīyatayārthapradhāneti tadviparyayo'pi tatpradhāna iti pūrvavanneyam
ata eva vivakṣitavākyānyathānupapattyā neyaḥ kalpanīyo'rtho yasyeti neyārthamityartho'pi ghaṭate
mahīti
pūrvārdha eva kāvyaṃ nirvartitam
na ca tāvatā vivakṣitārthalābhaḥ
tathā hi—samudramadhyātpṛthivyāmuddhriyamāṇāyāṃ mahāsuravimarde teṣāṃ daṃṣṭrayā pāṭanena rudhiraśabalatayā lohitatvamudadheriti vākyārtho'bhipretaḥ
lakṣaṇāyā abhāvānna neyārthatvaṃ padadūṣaṇamatra saṃbhāvanāmārohati
dūṣaṇatābījaṃ cātra sphuṭameva
aśarīraṃ tu kriyāpadaśūnyamityuktam
tadetatsarvamabhipretyāha—tadidaṃ nigadenaiveti
kānterviparyādvākyaṃ grāmyamityapadiśyate
yathā—
‘virahe te viṣīdantaṃ niṣīdantaṃ tavāntike
kanye kāmayamānaṃ māṃ tvaṃ na kāmayase katham || 46 ||’
idamuktergrāmyatayā kāntihīnamityarthapradhāno'yaṃ kāntiviparyayo doṣaḥ
kānteriti
rasasya dīptiḥ kāntiragre vivariṣyate tenārthapradhānatā vyaktā
tasyāmasti vākyavācyayorvyāpāraḥ
vākyaṃ vidagdhoktikaṃ vyāpriyate
atathābhūtasya rasāvyañjakatvaniyamāt
tathāhi—kanye iti saṃbodhanena rasavirodhinīvilasitā kṣamatā pratīyate
kāmayamānamityanenānāvaraṇamucyamāno'rthaḥ kathaṃ na vairasyamāvahatītyādikamunneyam
tadidamāha—idamuktergrāmyatayeti
ojomādhuryamaudāryaṃ na prakarṣāya jāyate || 35
yasmiṃstamāhurubhayapradhānaṃ tadviparyayāt
vākye yaḥ khaṇḍayanrītiṃ bhavatyojoviparyayaḥ
asamastamiti prāhurdoṣaṃ tamiha tadvidaḥ || 36
yathā—
‘smaraḥ kharaḥ khalaḥ kāntaḥ kāyaḥ kopadhanaḥ kṛśaḥ
cyuto māno'dhiko rāgo moho jāto'savo gatāḥ || 47
atra satyasamastapadāmidhāne satyapi cārthasaukumārye śleṣādiguṇasāmapryabhāvānna vaidarmī rītiḥ
nāpi yathoktalakṣaṇābhāvādgauḍīyādaya iti
khaṇḍitarītitvādayamojoviparyayaḥ śabdārthapradhāno guṇaviparyayo doṣo bhavati
yadāha—
ityādibandhapāruṣyaṃ śaithilyaṃ ca niyacchati
ato nainamanuprāsaṃ dākṣiṇātyāḥ prayuñjate || 37
vākye ya iti
nanu samāsabhūyastvamojo'bhidhāsyate tatkathamasyābhāvo'rthapradhāno'pi kathaṃ ca doṣa ityata āha—khaṇḍayanrītimiti
rītirbhaṅgaparyavasāyī tasyābhāvo dūṣaṇam
na tu tanmātramityarthaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati
śabdārthayorucitā prauḍharojaḥ
yadāha—‘raudrādayo rasā dīptyā lakṣyante kāvyavartinaḥ
tavdyaktihetuśabdārthāvāśrityaujo vyavasthitam
’ iti
tatrārthavyaktimarthaguṇeṣu vivecayivyāmaḥ
śabdasya tu pāruṣyaśaithilyavyatikaralakṣaṇā sā ca kvacitsamāsadīrghatayā vyajyate
yathā—‘caścandbhujabhramitacaṇḍagadābhighātasaṃcūrṇitoruyugalasya suyodhanasya
’ iti
kvacit anyathāpi prakāśyate
yathā—‘yo yaḥ śastraṃ bibharti’ ityādi
tadevaṃ tattvavyavasthitau pūrvācāryavyavasthityā guṇakāṇḍe samāsabhūyastvamojolakṣaṇaṃ vyabhicaritaguṇamadhye samāsaratanāsauṣṭhavaṃ vaktṛkṣamatayā guṇa ityabhiprāyādviśeṣaṃ tatra vakṣyāmaḥ—tadidamiti
rītiṃ khaṇḍayatīti
nahi prauḍherabhāve guṇasaṃbandhanātmikā rītirnāmeti viparyayapadena sādhāraṇena pāruṣyaśaithilye darśayati—atreti
etadevācāryamatena draḍhayati—yadāheti
yadyapyatrānuprāso'sti tathāpi rītimantareṇa mṛtaśarīra iva kāvye nālaṃkaraṇatāmadhyāste
tataśca na prakṛtaḥ ko'pi camatkārāvirbhāva iti nāsyaiva kāvyatāṃ prayojayatītyarthaḥ
dākṣiṇātyā vaidarbhīmāhuḥ
pārāvarīṇāste hi viśiṣṭarītisvarūpamavadhārayituṃ kṣamā iti
mādhuryavyatyayo yastu jāyate rītikhaṇḍanāt
tadanirvyūḍhamityuktaṃ kāvyasarvasvavedibhiḥ || 38
yathā—
‘nakhināṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca śṛṅgiṇāṃ śastrapāṇinām
viśvāso naiva kartavyaḥ strīṣu rājakuleṣu ca || 48 ||’
atra nakhināṃ ca nadīnāṃ ceti pṛṣṭhyantaccakāreṇa rīterupakrame śṛṅgiṇāṃ śastrapāṇināmiti cakārānirvāhāt strīṣu rājakuleṣu ceti ṣaṣṭhīparityāgādamadhurārthatvācca mādhuryaviparyayanāmāyaṃ śabdārthapradhāno guṇaviparyayo doṣaḥ
yadāha—
madhuraṃ rasavadvāci vastunyapi rasasthitiḥ
yena mādyanti vīmanto madhuneva madhuvratāḥ || 39
yayā kayācinchrutyā yatsāmānamanubhūyate
tadrūpā hi padāsattiḥ sānuprāsā rasāvahā || 40
mādhuryavyavatyaya iti
śabdārthayościttadrutividhrāyitvaṃ mādhuryam
niculitatvamivārdratāpadābhidheyā cetaso'vasthā tatkāritā mādhuryam
sā ca śṛṅgārakaruṇānyataraprakāśānuguṇavyāpārāveśena bhavati
yadāha—‘śṛṅgāra eva madhuraḥ paraḥ prahlādano rasaḥ
tanmayaṃ kāvyamāśritya mādhuryaṃ pratitiṣṭhati
śṛṅgāre vipralambhākhye karaṇe ca prakarṣavat
mādhuryamātratāṃ yāti yatastatrāghikaṃ manaḥ
’ iti
tatra śabdasya mādhuryaṃ pṛthakpadatayā vyajyate
dīrghasamāsasya yatnāntarasādhyatayā sukumārarasaprakāśasāmaprīvahirbhāvāt
tataśca śabdadūṣaṇaprastāve pṛthakpadatāmātrapratyayo yadyucyate gauḍīyā dṛṣṭā syāt, iti rītikhaṇḍanaparyavasāyitayābhidhānām
bhavati hi kadācitkaveḥ śaktivaśātsollekhe'pi samāse rasavyaktiḥ
yathā—‘yāte dvāravatīṃ tadā madhuripau laddattasaṅgānatāṃ kālindītaṭarūḍhavañjulalatāmāliṅgya sotkaṇṭhayā
udgītaṃ gurubāṣpagadgadagalattārasvaraṃ rādhayā yenāntarjalacāribhirjalacarairapyutkamutkūjitam
’ evaṃ cāskhalitapratītiviṣayasyaiva saṃdarbhasya rasatvaṃ padaghaṭanārūpasya ca saṃdarbhasyānirvāhādeva pratītiḥ skhalatītyāha—tadanirvyūḍhamiti
kāvyasarvasvaṃ rasaprakāśastadvedibhistadupāyabhūtaghaṭanāsvarūpavedibhiḥ
etadeva vyākhyānena sphuṭayati—atreti
nakhināṃ ca nadīnāṃ ceti cakāreṇottaratra tatparityāge'nupapattirjāgarti tadeva pratīteḥ saṃvala- nam
evamuttaratrāpi
astu tarhi vastvasattve'pyekadiḍyādhuryasaṃpattau kāvyatāpratilambha ityata āha—amadhurārthatvācceti
spaṣṭametacchabdārthapradhānatā
mādhuryasya pūrvācāryasaṃmatyā draḍhayati—yadāheti
mādyanti ārdracittā bhavanti
madhurasādṛśyādayaṃ vyavahāra ityata āha—madhuneti
idaṃ ca ghaṭanāyā mādhurye paramaṃ rahasya-mityāha—yayā kayāciditi
auṣṭhyakaṇṭhyādikaṃ vā tadrūpasamānaśrutikamādau yasya tathābhūtasya padasya pratyāsattiḥ
‘tadrūpā hi’ iti pāṭhe vyakta evārthaḥ
ata eva sānuprāsā tataśca rasāvahetyarthaḥ
yadāha—‘kaṅkaṇādivimuktāpi kāntā kimapi śobhate
kuṅkumenāṅgarāgaścetsarvāṅgīṇaḥ pravartate
’ iti
vikaṭatāmātrabhāvasyādoṣatvādviśeṣayannāha—
yastu rīteranirvāhādaudāryasya viparyayaḥ
vākyaṃ tadanalaṃkāramalaṃkāravido viduḥ || 41
yathā—
‘dīrghapucchaścatuṣpādaḥ kakudmāṃllambakambalaḥ
gorapatyaṃ balīvardastṛṇamatti mukhena saḥ || 49 ||’
tadidamapuṣṭārthatvādanutkṛṣṭaviśeṣaṇamanudāraṃ niralaṃkāramācakṣate so'yamaudāryaviparyayo nāma śabdārthapradhāno guṇaviparyayo doṣaḥ
yadāha—
ślāghyairviśeṣaṇairyuktamudāraṃ vākyamiṣyate
yathā līlāmbujakrīḍāsarohemāṅgadādayaḥ || 42
utkarṣavānguṇaḥ kaścidukteryasminpratīyate
tadudārāhvayaṃ tena sanāthā kāvyapaddhatiḥ || 43
yastu rīteriti
kāvyarūpatāprayojakaṃ śabdārthayorvakratā udāratā nahi vakratāmantareṇa kāvyapadavīprāptistadāha—‘yattu vakraṃ vacaḥ śāstre loke ca vaca eva tat
vakraṃ yadanurāgādau tatra kāvyamiti śrutiḥ
’ iti
tadetadalaṃkārasāmānyamasyābhāve niralaṃkāratā bhavatītyāha—analaṃkāramiti
dīrghapuccha ityādau prakṛtodāharaṇe dvayoravakratvaṃ sphuṭayati—yatheti
vivicya guṇaprastāve kathayiṣyāmaḥ
arthapoṣamāha—utkarṣavāniti
ubhayapradhānatāmupasaṃharati—kāvyeti
tadevaṃ vākyadoṣā~llakṣayitvā kramaprāptā vākyārthadoṣā lakṣaṇīyā iti tānvibhajate—
apārtha vyarthamekārthaṃ sasaṃśayamapakramam
khinnaṃ caivātimātraṃ ca paruṣaṃ virasaṃ tathā || 44
hīnopamaṃ bhaveccānyadadhikopamameva ca
asadṛkṣopamaṃ cānyadaprasiddhopamaṃ tathā || 45
niralaṃkāramaślīlaṃ viruddhamiti ṣoḍaśa
uktā vākyārthajā doṣāsteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam || 46
samudāyārthaśūnyaṃ yattadapārtha vacaḥ smṛtam
yathā—
‘jaradgavaḥ kambalapādukābhyāṃ dvāri sthito gāyati maṅgalāni
taṃ brāhmaṇī pṛcchati putrakāmā rājanrumāyāṃ laśunasya ko'rthaḥ || 50 ||’
atra samudāyārthaḥ ko'pi nāstītyapārthamidam
apārthamiti
uddeśe doṣāṇāṃ vyāsenoktiḥ pūrvoktaprayojanānurodheneti
samudāyipadānāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ samudāyārthaḥ
tena śūnyaṃ padajātamapārthakaṃ padārthānāmasaṃsargeṇa padānāmasaṃsargo'bhidhīyate
tenārthadoṣatvam
jaradgava iti
kambalapādukābhyāmiti lakṣaṇe tṛtīyā
na ca tābhyāṃ vṛddhokṣasya saṃbandhaḥ
kathaṃ ca tasya maṅgalānāṃ dhavalādīnām
‘madrakāṇām’ iti pāṭhe gītakaviśeṣāṇāṃ vā saṃgatiḥ, kathaṃ vā putrakāmāyāstatpraśnasaṃsargaḥ, kathaṃ ca rājanniti saṃbodhanaṃ ghaṭate, putrakāmāyāśca rumālavaṇārthapraśnaḥ
rumā lavaṇākaraḥ
tathā ca prayogaḥ—‘rumādhāsakāntādilavaṇātmavara’ iti
vyarthamāhurgatārtha yadyacca syānniṣprayojakam || 47
yathā—
‘āhiṣātāṃ raghuvyāghrau śarabhaṅgāśramaṃ tataḥ
svāmahauṣīttanuṃ vahnau dṛṣṭvā tau rāmalakṣmaṇau || 51 ||’
atrāhiṣātāṃ dṛṣṭvetyetābhyāmeva tāviti, raghuvyāghrāvityanenaiva rāmalakṣmaṇāviti, tanumityanenaiva khāmiti, ahauṣīdityanenaiva vahnāviti, gamyata iti gatārthatvam
na ca śarabhaṅgāśramagamanaṃ tanuhomo vāgrataḥ kathāśarīropayogīti niṣprayojakatvam
ato'yaṃ vyarthanāmā vākyasya mahāvākyasya ca doṣo bhavati
ārthyā ca vṛttyā labdhasya śāstretihāsādau śabdavṛttyā bhaṇanamapaunaruttayāyetyarthapunarukterbhidyate
vyarthamiti
vijñāto vā vigato vārtho'bhidheyaṃ prayojanaṃ yasya tavdyarthaṃ svatantraṃ ca dūṣaṇamiti vaiśeṣike vaktavyam
tathā hi—āhiṣātāmiti
aṃhergatikarmaṇo luṅi rūpam
sa ca prācuryaprayogaḥ prāptyavacchinnaṃ vyāpārapracayamabhidhatte
tathā cārthasiddhāyāṃ prāptau śabdenopādānamanucitaṃ lokānusāreṇa kāvye dṛśiścākṣuṣa eva jñāne prayujyate
yathā—‘mayā tāvaddṛṣṭo na khalu kalikandarpandarpanṛpaterguṇaistulyaḥ ko'pi kvacidapi kimaśrāvi bhavatā
iti praśnaṃ śrutvā kvaṇitamiva karṇāntikamagānmṛgākṣīṇāṃ cakṣuścaṭulabhavatā cāntataralam
’ yathā vā—‘naivādarśi na cāśrāvi phalaṃ malayabhūruhaḥ
’ cakṣuśca prāptameva gṛhṇātītyarthalabdhāyāṃ prāptau kathaṃ śabdenopādānam
tadidamuktam—etābhyāmeveti
raghuvyāghrādiprakaraṇādikamāsādya viśeṣaparyavasāyi yaugikatvānna tu viśeṣa eva śaktam
‘upagamya raghuvyāghraḥ kacchabhūbhāgacāriṇīm
lulubhe munidhenuṃ tāṃ velāmiva mahārṇavaḥ
’ iti maharṣiprayogāt
etena puṣpavadādipadavadvacanamedo'pyapāstaḥ
evaṃ ca prakaraṇādinā raghuvyāghrapadaṃ rāmalakṣmaṇaparameveti pūrvārdhe tayoreva prakrāntatvāduttarārdhe sarvanāmnā parāmarśo yujyate, na tu svaśabdena
tanuprabhṛtiśabdānāṃ saṃbandhiśabdatvātsamabhivyāhṛtaśabdārthasaṃbandhakatvaṃ loke vyutpannam
yathā—‘karau dhunānā navapallavākṛtīrvṛthā kṛthā mānini mā pariśramam
’ iti śabdāntarasaṃnidhāne tu kvacittādrūpyāvagamo bhavati
yathā—‘umāstanodbhedamanupravṛddho manoratho yaḥ prathamaṃ babhūva
tameva menāduhituḥ kathaṃcidvivāhadīkṣātilakaṃ cakāra
’ tadihānyasyānupādānāccharabhaṅgasaṃbandhinyeva tanuḥ pratīyate
juhotiśca vahnyādhārakameva havirdravyatyāgamabhidhatte tena ‘vahnau’ ityapi na vācyam
gatārthaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe—gamyata iti
asminnevodāharaṇe niṣprayojanatvamāha—na ceti
śarabhaṅgāśramagamanaṃ tanuhomaścātra vākyārthadvayaṃ na prayojanavat
asya vākyasya caritārthatvāt
kiṃ prayojanāntaragaveṣaṇayetyata āha—ata iti
yadvākyapoṣaṇādyanaupayikapadamaprayojakavacasā prāguktaṃ tathā ca prabandhādyarthapoṣaparyavasāyi vākyameva
ihāpyavācyavacanasya sphuṭatvāt
na cāśramagamanatanuhomau kariṣyamāṇavīrarasocitakathāśarīre kāmapi śobhāmātrāmarpeyata iti vākyasya mahāvākyasya ceti yathāsaṃkhyamanvayaḥ
kathaṃ punargatārtha prasādhitasyetyāderarthapunaruktādbhidyata ityata āha—ārthyā ceti
śabdavṛttyaivāvagatasya śabdavṛttyā punaruktam
arthaṃto labdhasya śabdavṛttyā maṇanamiṃtyekaḥ prakāraḥ
arthato lābhaṃ vyutpādayati—śāstreti
asya raghukulabhuvaḥ śarabhaṅgāśramagamanamitihāsāccakṣuṣaḥ prāptasyaiva jñānajanakatvaṃ śāstrāt
śarabhaṅgasaṃbandhinyeva tanurlokavyutpattestena niyamena hyarthataḥ prāptirbhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ
uktyabhinnārthamekārtha
yathā—
‘prasādhitasyātha muradviṣo'bhūdanyaiva lakṣmīriti yuktametam
vapuṣyaśeṣe'khilalokakāntā sānanyakāntā hyurasītarā tu || 52 ||’
ityuktaikārthamevāha—
‘kapāṭavistīrṇamanoramoraḥsthalasthitaśrīlalanasya tasya
āliṅgitāśeṣajanā babhūva sarvāṅgasaṅginyaparaiva lakṣmīḥ || 53 ||’
anayoḥ ślokayorabhinnārthamekaṃ vākyaṃ mahāvākye duṣyati
uktyabhinnārthamiti
vākyāntaroktyābhinnastātparyārtho yasya tattathoktam
tathā hi—‘prasādhitasya-’ ityādiśloke śleṣopahitena vyatirekeṇa kāpyapūrvā kṛṣṇasya lakṣmīstatkāle babhūveti tātparyārthaḥ
tenaiva prakāreṇaṃ ‘kapāṭa-’ ityagrimaślokeṃ sa evāsti
tulyārthatva upādānaṃ bhinnārthatve'pi
tadidamāha—anayoḥ ślokayoriti
mahāvākye ślokadvayarūpe ekam, anyataradduṣyati
heyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ
saṃdigdhārtha saṃsaśayam
yathā—
‘manorathapriyālokarasalolekṣaṇe sakhi
ārādvṛttiriyaṃ mātā na kṣamā draṣṭumīdṛśam || 54 ||’
atrārātprabhṛtiśabdānāmubhayārthatvānmātā drakṣyati na veti saṃdigdham
saṃdigdhārthamiti
śabdasvarūpaniścaye'pi vākyārtho dolāyita ityarthadoṣatvam
tathā hi—manorathetyādau manorathe yaḥ priyo vallabhastadālokarasena lolekṣaṇe capalalocane tava māteyamārādvṛttirdūravārtinī
ato naitādṛśaṃ sānurāgāṅganājanayogyaṃ draṣṭuṃ kṣamā iti vyavasthāpanānnāvalokayituṃ śaktā tato niḥśaṅkamālokasveti vākyārtha uteyamāradvṛttiḥ samīpadeśavartinī
‘ārāddūrasamīpayoḥ’
tathā cedṛśaṃ kulāṅganānucitaṃ cāritrakhaṇḍanaṃ draṣṭuṃ na kṣamā na sahiṣṇuratomānayanacāpalaṃ kāṣīṃriti
nānārthapadaprakṣepātsādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvācca saṃdihyata ityāha—atrārātpramṛtiśabdānāmiti
na ca mitho virodhinorekatra vivakṣā saṃbhavati
na cāsti prakaraṇādikamekaniyāmakaṃ
na ca mātuḥ prakopaśaṅkayā priyavilokanarasotkāyā manorathabhaṅgo na bhavatītyarthaḥ
vākyaṃ yattu kramabhraṣṭaṃ tadapakramamucyate || 48
yathā—
‘kārāviūṇa khauraṃ gāmaulo majjio a jimio a
ṇakkhattattihivāre joisiaṃ pucchiuṃ calio || 55 ||’
[kārayitvā kṣauraṃ grāmapradhāno majjitaśca bhuktavāṃśca
nakṣatratithivārāñjyautiṣikaṃ praṣṭuṃ calitaḥ ||]
atra kṣurakarmaṇo'nantaraṃ nakṣatrādipraśnādidamapakramam
vākyaṃ yattviti
kārayitvā kṣauraṃ gāmaulo grāmapradhānapuruṣa iti deśīyāḥ
grāme'pi vā yaḥ kuṭo'vyutpannaḥ
majjio a susnātaśca jimio a bhuktavāṃśca tato nakṣatraṃ tithivārau ca jyautiṣikaṃ praṣṭuṃ calitaḥ
tithivārajñānāntaraṃ kṣurakarma, tataḥ snānabhojane, iti laukikaḥ kramastasya viparyāso vyakta eva śrutivacanāt
kriyamāṇe'pi racanāvaiparītyena kramabhraṃśaḥ samādhīyata iti nāsau śabdadoṣaḥ
atra pūrvārdhopāttānāṃ kramo na viparyastaḥ kiṃtu kṣaurottarārdhoktayorityāha—atra kṣurakarmaṇa iti
jātyādyuktāvanirvyūḍhaṃ khinnamāhurmahādhiyaḥ
yathā—
‘vevāhiūṇa vahuā sāsuraaṃ doliāi ṇijjantī
roai diaro taṃ saṃṭhavei pāsseṇa vaccanto || 56 ||’
[vivāha vadhūḥ śvāśurakaṃ dolikayā nīyamānā
roditi devarastāṃ saṃsthāpayati pārśvena vrajan ||]
atra prakrāntasya navapariṇayavatīsvarūpabhaṇanasyānirvyūḍhatvātkhinnatvam
jātyādīti
vākyārtho dvividhaḥ—svataḥsaṃbhavī, kaviprauḍhoktinirmitaśca
tatrāsati viśeṣahetau yajjātīyamartha budhdyā vyavasthāpya vacanopakramastajjātīyasyaiva samastavākyanirvāho yukto na tvantareṇa parityāgena bhedaḥ
upakrāntamirvāhāśakto loke khinna ityucyate
tadidamuktam—jātyādīti
ādipadena svataḥ saṃbhaviviśeṣāṇāmupamādīnāṃ kaviprauḍhinirmītānāṃ ca rūpakādīnāṃ parigrahaḥ
vivāhya navavadhūḥ sāsuraaṃ śvaśuragṛhaṃ dolikayā nīyamānā roditīti svataḥsaṃbhavī
navapariṇītāsvabhāvalakṣaṇārthastāvadupakrāntastathā sati yo janmābhyastapitṛgṛhaviyogavedanādūnamānasāyā atyantāpariśīlitena devareṇa saṃsthāpanaprakāraḥ sa na jātau niviśate
pariśīlitabhartṛkulāyā kulāyāṃ vā
tasyaucityāttasyā eva hi kiṃcana vaktavyaṃ bhavatītyāha—atra prakrāntasyeti
yatsarvalokātītārthamatimātraṃ taducyate || 49
yathā—
‘bhṛṅgeṇa kalikākoṣastathā bhṛśamapīḍyata
vavarṣa vipinotsaṅge goṣpadapraṃ yathā madhu || 57 ||’
atra kalikākoṣe goṣpadapramadhuvarṣasyāsaṃbhavādatimātratvam
yatsarvaloketi
goṣpadapramiti pūrerṇijantād ‘varṣapramāṇa ūlopaścāsyānyatarasyām’ iti ṇamul, ūlopaśca
kalikāmakarandapariṇāmasyaitāvato loke na prasiddhiḥ
na caitatkhinnameva
kalikākusumasyānupakramāt, kiṃ tu svarūpabhramāllokamaryādātiriktavṛttamupāttamiti pṛthageva doṣaḥ
yattu krūrārthamatyarthaṃ paruṣaṃ tu taducyate
yathā—
‘khāhi visaṃ, pia muttaṃ, nijjasu mārīa, paḍau de vajjam
dantakkhaṇḍiathaṇaā khiviūṇa suaṃ savai māā || 58 ||’
[khāda viṣaṃ, piba mūtraṃ, nīyasva māryā, patatu te vajram
dantakhaṇḍitastanī kṣiptvā sutaṃ śapati mātā ||]
atra khāda viṣamityādīnāṃ krūrārthānāmabhidhānātpāruṣyam
yattviti
‘khāda viṣaṃ, piba mūtraṃ, nīyasva māryā, patatu te vajram’ itthaṃ mātā putramākośati
kiṃ kṛtvā
kṣighvā bhūmau nirasya
kutaḥ
dantakhaṇḍitastanī
yato bālo dantairmātuḥ stanaṃ daśatīti jātistasyāḥ punarevaṃvidhaṃ paruṣābhidhāyitvamanucitam
atipāruṣyameva cātra virasatāhetuḥ
tenātimātrādbhedaḥ
aprastutarasaṃ yatsyādvirasaṃ tannigadyate || 50
yathā—
‘tava vanavāso'nucitaḥ pitṛmaraṇaśucaṃ jahīhi kiṃ tapasā
saphalaya yauvanametatsamamanuraktena sutanu mayā || 59 ||’
atra pitṛmaraṇasaṃtaptāyāḥ saṃbhogapravartanamaprakṛtarasatvādvirasam
aprastuteti
aprastutaḥ prastāvamantareṇa sūcico raso yatra tattathā
ekarasaprakrame hi virodhirasāntaraprastāva eva kriyamāṇo naucityavān
na caucityama- ntareṇa rasasya padasaṃbandhaḥ saṃbhavati
yadāha—‘anaucityādṛte nāsti rasabhaṅgasya kāraṇam
prasiddhaucityabandhastu rasasyopaniṣatparā
’ iti
tava vanavāsa ityādau pitṛmaraṇānubhavaprāptaśokaprakarṣāyāḥ śṛṅgāraprastāvanā virasāyate
sā hi svabhāvata eva karuṇena sahaikavākyasamāveśavirodhinī
na caikasya bādhyatvamaṅgabhāvo vāvagamyate
nāpyubhayoranyaguṇībhāvo'vagamyate
yenāyaṃ virodhaḥ samādhīyatām
yuktiratra vidagdhaiva
arthastu rasātmāvirodhena padaṃ badhnāti tataḥ kāntiviparyayādbhedaḥ
na ca karuṇoktirupakrāntā yatastadanirvāhe khedasaṃbhāvanā syāt
kiṃtu pitṛmaraṇaśucaṃ jahīhītyanena śokāviṣṭāyāṃ śṛṅgāraprastāvanā
tathā ca bhinnameva duṣṭatābījaṃ tadetatsarvamapi saṃdhāya vyācaṣṭe—atreti
idānīmanaucityarūpadūṣaṇaprastāvaḥ
arthālaṃkāreṣūpamāpradhānamiti prasidhdyā tasyāmevopalakṣaṇatayānaucityaṃ prapañcayati—
hīnaṃ yatropamānaṃ syāttattu hīnopamaṃ smṛtam
yathā—
‘kvacidagre'prasaratā kvacidāplutya nighnatā
śuneva sāraṅgakulaṃ tvayā bhinnaṃ dviṣatkulam || 60 ||’
atra śauryaśālinaḥ śunopamitatvāddhīnopamamidam
hīnamityādi
hīnamapakṛṣṭamasajjātīyamupamānamityupamānaprasiddhā viśeṣā upameye pratibimbakalpāśca pratīyanta ityuktam
utkṛṣṭajātīyasyopameyasya hīnajātīyena sāmānyamabhidhīyamānaṃ śābdanyāyena bodhayadanucitameva bhavati
yathā—‘raṇāśvamedhe paśutāmupāgatāḥ’ iti
nanvatra rūpakabalena varṇanīyasya paśutāvagamyata iti yuktamanaucityam
kvacidagra ityādau prakṛtodāharaṇe tu katham
nahyatra prastutopaślokasya sārameyatāvagamyate agre prasaraṇamāplutya nihananaṃ ca sādṛśyamupāttamucitameveti naitat
tattvapratibimbe sādṛśyapratītirapi śabdena kriyamāṇā loke kāntiṃ prati puṣṇāti
na hi kadāpi hīnena sādṛśyoktau varṇanā sajīvā pratīyate
pratītimātraparamārthaṃ ca kāvyadarśanamiti
tadeva yasminnadhikaṃ tadbhavedadhikopamam || 51
yathā—
‘ayaṃ padmāsanāsīnaścakavāko virājate
yugādau bhagavānbrahmā vinirmitsuriva prajāḥ || 61 ||’
atra cakravākasya jagatsraṣṭrā brahmaṇopamitatvādadhikopamamidam
tadeveti
hīnenotkṛṣṭaṃ yathā nopamīyata iti lokamaryādā tathotkṛṣṭena hīnam
tathā hi—cakravākopamitimanusaṃdadhatāṃ viśeṣāvagatividhurāṇāṃ ca sahṛdayānāṃ pratītiḥ skhalantī janayatyeva vairasyamiti sūkṣmekṣikayā dūṣaṇam
idamaparamāyātamanaucityaṃ yatsādṛśyabudhdyā nibandhe'pyasādṛśyaparyavasānamityāha—
yattvattulyopamānaṃ tadvadantyasadṛśopamam
yathā—
‘ṇamaha haraṃ rosāṇalaṇiddaddhamuddhamammahasarīram
vitthaaṇiambaṇiggaagaṅgāsottaṃ vaṃ himavantam || 62 ||’
[namata haraṃ roṣānalanirdagdhamugdhamanmathaśarīram
vistṛtanitambanirgatagaṅgāsrotasamiva himavantam ||]
atra kopānalanirdagdhamugdhamanmathaśarīrasya harasya nitambanirgatasrotasā himavadgiriṇā sahāsādṛśyādidamasaṃdṛśopamam
yattviti
yadyapi balavattvādinā pratīyamānaṃ himavadbhagavatorasti sādṛśyam, tathāpi vācyopamābhrameṇāyaṃ nibandhaḥ, sā ca na saṃpannā, nahi roṣeṇa vidagdhamanmathaśarīradāho vistṛtanitambanirgatagaṅgāsrotaḥpratibimbabhūtaḥ
dhāturaṅgarañjito gaṅgāpravāho'bhimatasya bhavati lalāṭanetrāgnijvālāpratibimbamityapi na vācyam, yenāndhatvaprasaṅgāt
nitambasaṃbandhoktiśca na saṃgatā syāt
kathaṃ ca manmathaśarīradāhaḥ pratibimbāyata ityāśayena vyācaṣṭe—atreti
viśeṣaṇayorbimbapratibimbabhāvābhāve viśiṣṭayorupamānaṃ saṃbhavatīti matvā viśeṣaṇadvayamadoṣāyaiveti vyākhyātavān
idānīṃ kavisamayabahirbhūtatvenopamānaucitīmāha—
aprasiddhopamānaṃ yadaprasiddhopamaṃ hi tat || 52
yathā—
‘kumudamiva mukhaṃ tasyā gauriva mahiṣaḥ śaśīva kāvyamidam
śaradiva vibhāti taruṇī vikasitapulakotkarā seyam || 63 ||’
atra kumudamukhayorgomahiṣayoḥ kāvyaśaśinośca pratīyamāne śarattaruṇyośca vidhīyamāne sādṛśye upamānopameyasyāprasiddhatvādaprasiddhopamamidam
aprasiddheti
kamalamukhayoriva kumudamukhayorgogavayayoriva gomahiṣayoḥ kāvyaśabdayoriva kāvyaśaśinorasti sādṛśyaṃ saurabhādikamevānupāttamapi prasiddhatayā pratīyamānam
śarattaruṇyostu na tathā prasiddhamiti vikasitapulakāṅkurā bhātītyetābhyāmupāttam
pulaka ivāṅkurā iti tatrāśayāt
viśiṣṭabhānasya ca dvayānugatatvenaiva pratīyamānatvāttathāpi pada ivālaṃkāre'pi kavibhiraprayujyamānatvameva doṣa iti vyācaṣṭe—atreti
pratīyamāna iti
ivaśabdasya dyotakamātratvāt
abhidhīyamānaṃ vyākhyātam
vakratāviśeṣaviśiṣṭasyaivārthasya kāvyakoṭiniveśādavakro heya ityāha—
yadalaṃkārahīnaṃ tanniralaṃkāramucyate
yathā—
‘kolā khaṇanti motthaṃ, giddhā khāanti mauamaṃsāiṃ,
uluā haṇanti kāe, kāā ulue vi vāanti || 64 ||’
[kolāḥ khananti mustāḥ(n), gṛdhrāḥ khādanti mṛtakamāṃsāni
ulūkā dhnanti kākān, kākā ulūkānapi vāyanti
atra kolādeḥ kharūpādyanabhidhānājjātyādyalaṃkārāsaṃbhave niralaṃkāranāmāyaṃ vākyārthadoṣaḥ
saviśeṣaṇādgorapatyamityādervākyadoṣādbhidyate
yaditi
vakratāvyatireke'laṃkārasāmānyameva na syaditi niralaṃkāramityuktam
vāyanti kṣipanti khādanti
‘vī gativyāptiprajanakāntyasanakhādaneṣu’ iti dhātvanusārāt
nanvasti kolādisvarūpamatra
tato jātyalaṃkāreṇa vakratvamākṣipyate
viśeṣasya ca sāmānyamāntarīyakatvātkathamucyate niralaṃkāramityata āha—atreti
svaṃ rūpaṃ camatkārakāri kavipratibhāmātraprakāśanīyaṃ rūpaṃ tadevālaṃkārakakṣāmadhiśete
na cātra tathā kiṃcidabhihitamato na jātyalaṃkāraḥ
evamanyo'pyalaṃkāro nāsti
kathaṃ tarhi vakratābhāvarūpadīrghapuccha ityādeḥ śabdadoṣādbhidyate tadāha—saviśeṣaṇāditi
tatra viśeṣaṇaprayoge śabdānāmeva vakratāvyatirekeṇāpavāda iti śabdadūṣaṇamiha tu na tathā
kiṃ tūktameva svarūpaṃ na vakramiti vākyārtha eva duṣṭaḥ
aślīlamiti nirdiṣṭamaślīlārthapratītikṛt || 53
yathā—
‘udyatasya paraṃ hantuṃ stabdhasya vivaraiṣiṇaḥ
patanaṃ jāyate'vaśyaṃ kṛcchreṇa punarunnatiḥ || 65 ||’
atrodyatasya paraṃ hantumiti saṃbhogārambhaviṣayā, stabdhasya vivaraiṣiṇa iti varāṅgaviṣayā, patanaṃ jāyate'vaśyamiti retovisargaviṣayā, kṛcchreṇa punarunnatiriti naṣṭarāgapratyānayanaviṣayā aślīlavākyārthaviṣayā pratītirbhavati
aślīlamiti
udyatasyeti
paramanyaṃ hantumudyatasya vivaraiṣiṇa iti pramādakṛtāvadhānasya stabdhasyātmanyutkarṣābhidhānenānyānavadhīrayataḥ patanamāvaśyakamudgamaḥ kṛcchrāditi saṃsargo'bhimataḥ
eṣāmeva padārthānāṃ saṃsargāntaramaślīlamevetyāha—atrodyatasyeti
etena padadoṣādbheda uktaḥ
deśakālādeḥ kāvyāṅgatvāttadvirodhenārtho duṣṭaḥ
virodhaśca bādhaḥ
sa pramāṇenaiva tato lokādivirodhasyālaṃkārasamayasiddhasya pramāṇavirodhaparyavasāyitvaṃ vivakṣannāha—
viruddhaṃ nāma tadyatra virodhasrividho bhavet
pratyakṣeṇānumānena tadvadāgamavartmanā || 54
yo deśakālalokādipratīpaḥ ko'pi dṛśyate
tamāmananti pratyakṣavirodhaṃ śuddhabuddhayaḥ || 55
tatra deśavirodho yathā—
‘surāṣṭreṣvasti nagarī mathurā nāma viśrutā
akṣoṭanārikerāḍhyā yadupāntādribhūmayaḥ || 66 ||’
atra surāṣṭreṣu mathurā nāsti
tatparyantādibhūmiṣu cākṣoṭanārikerāṇāmabhāvāt
deśe'drivanarāṣṭrādirityayaṃ deśakṛtaḥ pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
viruddhamiti
tatra deśakālādau pratyakṣata eva varṇyamānasyābhāvo niścīyate iti deśādivirodhaḥ pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
śūraseneṣu mathurā na surāṣṭreṣu
tatparyantabhūmiṣvakṣoṭā nālikerā vā na saṃbhavanti
adrīṇāṃ kathaṃ deśatvamityata āha—deśo'drivanarāṣṭrādiriti
kālavirodho yathā—
‘padminī naktamunnidrā sphuṭatyahni kumudvatī
madhurutphullaniculo nidāgho meghadurdinaḥ || 67 ||’
atra padminyā naktaṃ kumudvatyā ahni madhau niculānāmunnidratvādyabhāvānnidāghasya cāmeghadurdinatvāt
kālo naktaṃ dinartava iti kālakṛto'yaṃ pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
padminīti
naktaṃ rātrau
madhurvasantaḥ
niculā hijjalāḥ
te varṣāsu puṣpyanti na vasante
yadyapi kālasvarūpamapratyakṣaṃ tathāpi tadupādhīnāṃ vyavahārāṅgateva pratyakṣatā cetyāha—kālo naktaṃ dinartava iti
lokavirodho yathā—
‘ādhūtakesaro hastī tīkṣṇaśṛṅgasturaṅgamaḥ
gurusāro'yameraṇḍo niḥsāraḥ khadiradrumaḥ || 68 ||’
atra hastihayairaṇḍakhadirāṇāṃ kesarādisadbhāvasya pratyakṣeṇānupalambhāt
jaṅgamasthāvaro loka iti lokakṛto'yaṃ pratyakṣavirodhaḥ
ādhūteti
ante pratyakṣavirodhaśabdārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe—pratyakṣeṇānupalambhāditi
kathamayaṃ laukikavirodha ityata āha—jaṅgameti
jaṅgamasthāvaraṃ jīvaccharīraṃ lokaḥ
tatra jaṅgamaṃ gāvāśvādi sthāvaraṃ latāvṛkṣādi rāṣṭrādāveva deśaparibhāṣā idaṃ prakārāntareṇa deśaśabdenābhidhīyate
yuktyaucityapratijñādikṛto yastviha kaścana
anumānavirodhaḥ sa kavimukhyairnigadyate || 56
tatra yuktiviruddhaṃ yathā—
‘surahimahupāṇalampaḍabhamaragaṇābaddhamaṇḍalībandham
kassa maṇaṃ ṇāṇandai kummīpuṭṭhaṭṭhiaṃ kamalam || 69 ||’
[surabhimadhupānalampaṭabhramaragaṇābaddhamaṇḍalībandham
kasya mano nānandayati kūrmīpṛṣṭhasthitaṃ kamalam ||]
atra kūrmīpṛṣṭhe kamalodgaterayuktiyuktatvādyuktiviruddhamidam
yuktīti
sāmānyatastāvadanumānavirodho yatpramāṇābhāvaḥ
nahi prameyābhāve pramāṇaṃ prasiddham
tadayamartho yuktiḥ pramāṇam
ādhūtakesaretyādau udāharaṇe kvacideva vyaktiviśeṣe kesarādisaṃbandhapratipādanaṃ kathamanyathā teṣāmeraṇḍaṃ nirdiśati
tato bhavati pratyakṣeṇaiva virodhaḥ
iha tu na tathā
nahi viśeṣataḥ kāpi kūrmapṛṣṭhavyaktirastīti sāmānyākāreṇa vivakṣitam
tataśca kamalajāteḥ paṅkajaprabhavāyā eva niścayātkūrmapṛṣṭhādudgame na kaścitpramāṇaṃ kadāpi kasyāpyavataratītyāśayavān vyācaṣṭe—atreti
ayuktiyuktatvāditi
yukteḥ pramāṇatvenāsaṃbaddhatvādityarthaḥ
aucityaviruddhaṃ yathā—
‘paṭṭaṃsuuttarijjeṇa pāmaro pāmarīऍ paripusai
aigaruakūrakumbhībhareṇa seulliaṃ vaaṇam || 70 ||’
[paṭṭāṃśukottarīyeṇa pāmaraḥ pāmaryāḥ proñchati
atigurukakūrakumbhībhareṇa svedārdritaṃ vadanam ||]
atra pāmarasya paṭṭāṃśukottarīyābharaṇānaucityād aucityaviruddhamidam
aucityaviruddhamiti
aucityaṃ yogyatā tasya parābhṛśyamānasya vivakṣitaviparītaparyavasānamanyo'numānavirodhaḥ
tathā hi—paṭṭāṃśukottarīyeṇa pāmaraḥ pāmaryā proñchati
atigurukakūrakumbhībhareṇa svedārdritaṃ vadanamityatra pūrvavatsaṃbandhagrāhakapramāṇābhāvaḥ
kadācidrājaprasādādinā tathā saṃbhavāt
kiṃ tu pāmaraucityapratisaṃdhāne paṭṭāṃśukāvaguṇṭhanamanucitam
vidagdhanepathyaparigrahādināgaravṛttāparicaya eva pāmaratvam
tataścāyamartho bhavati—paṭṭāṃśukasaṃbandhāyogyeyaṃ pāmaratvāditi
kūraṃ bhaktam
kumbhī kalaśī
pratijñāviruddhaṃ yathā—
‘yāvajjīvamahaṃ maunī brahmacārī ca me pitā
mātā ca mama vandhyāsītsmarābho'nupamo bhavān || 71 ||’
atra svayaṃ vaktureva ‘yāvajjīvamahaṃ maunī’ ityādipadānāmuktyā pratijñāvirodhātpratijñāviruddhamidam
pratijñāviruddhamiti
abhyupagamavākyaṃ pratijñā
yathā—‘yadyadādiśati svāmī tatkaromyavicārayan’ iti
sādhyanirdeśaśca—‘ayaṃ sa raśanotkarṣī pīnastanavimardanaḥ
nābhyūrujaghanasparśī nīvīvisraṃsanaḥ karaḥ
’ iti
dvayamapi pratijñāpadenābhimatam
tatrādye ‘yāvajjīvamahaṃ maunī’ ityudāharaṇam
avyāhāro maunam
tadabhyupagamavākyenaiva bodhyate
tathā hi—nāyaṃ maunī vacanavattvādityabhyupagamya maunābhāvaparyavasannamiti tṛtīyo'yamanumānavirodhaḥ
dvitīyapakṣakakṣīkaraṇena caturthodāharaṇe ‘brahmacārī ca me pitā, mātā ca mama vandhyā’ iti vaktā yasyaurasaḥ sutaḥ sa pitṛpadenābhimato na ca tasya brahmacāritvaṃ saṃbhavati
mātā jananyevābhidhīyate na ca tasyā vandhyātvaṃ saṃbhavati
parasparavyāghāto virodhaḥ
ayaṃ ca pañcamaprakāro yadvyāpakadvārā virodhaḥ
yathā—smarābho'nupama iti
nahi smarābhatvaṃ loke prasiddhaṃ kitu smaratulyatāṃ vadan sopamānatvamabhyupagacchati
taccānupamatvena viruddham
tato vyāpakavirodho'yam
yathā—vahniranuṣṇa iti
ādigrahaṇāddṛṣṭāntadvārako'numānavirodhaḥ saṃgṛhītaḥ
dharmārthakāmaśāstrādivirodhaḥ ko'pi yo bhavet
tamāgamavirodhākhyaṃ doṣamācakṣate budhāḥ || 57
teṣu dharmaśāsravirodho yathā—
‘asāvanupanīto'pi vedānadhijage guroḥ
svabhāvaśuddhasphaṭiko na saṃskāramapekṣate || 72 ||’
atrānupanītasya vedādhyayanānadhikārāddharmaśāsravirodhaḥ
dharmārtheti
vedādhyayanānadhikārāditi
‘akṛtavratabandhe tu gurāvuparate sati
nābhivyāhārayed brahma svadhāninayanādṛte
’ iti dharmaśāsram
arthaśāsravirodho yathā—
‘kāmopabhogasākalyaphalo rājñāṃ mahījayaḥ
ahaṃkāreṇa jīyante dviṣantaḥ kiṃ nayaśriyā || 73 ||’
atra mahījayasya phalatvena kāmopabhogānāmarthaśāsrakārairananumatatvācchatruvijaye cāhaṃkārasyāhetutvādarthaśāsravirodhaḥ
kāmeti
atra mahījayasyeti
mahījayasya dharmaḥ phalamiti nītiśāsre sthitam
ahaṃkāro mānaḥ sa na śatruvijaye sādhanam
ariṣaṅvargatyāge hīndriyajayaḥ
tathā vijigīṣutā
tayā ca śatruparibhava iti
yadāha—sa raghurāṣṭro vilalāsa ityupakramya kauṭilyācāryaḥ mānādrāvaṇaḥ paradārānaprayacchan duryodhano rājyāṃśaṃ ceti
kāmaśāsravirodho yathā—
‘tavottaroṣṭhe bimboṣṭhi daśanāṅko virājate
pūrṇasaptasvaraḥ so'yaṃ bhinnagrāmaḥ pravartate || 74 ||’
atrottaroṣṭhe daśanāṅkasya kāmaśāsrakārairananujñānātkāmaśāsravirodhaḥ
bhinnagrāmāṇāṃ ca pūrṇasaptasvaratvānupapatteḥ
kalāvirodhe'pi tadaṃśatvātkāmaśāsravirodha eva
taveti
atrottaroṣṭha ityuparitana oṣṭha uttaroṣṭhamantaramukhaṃ nayanāntaṃ ca muktvā cumbanavaddaśanacchedyasthānānīti kāmasūtram
bhinnagrāmarāgāṇāmiti
bhinnamārgeṣu saptasvarāṇāṃ samavāyo nopanibaddhaḥ
tathā ca ‘prāṃśustu dhaivatanyāsaḥ pañcamarṣabhavarjitaḥ
ṣaḍjo dīvyatāṃ jā(yā)to bhinnaṣaḍja udāhṛtaḥ'
tamaṅgo'pyāha—‘ṣāḍavauḍavike jātī bhinnagrāma udāhṛtaḥ’ iti
tataśca ṣaḍvā pañca vā svarā bhavanti bhinnagrāme na tu sapta
kāmaśāsravirodhaprastāve kathaṃ kalāvirodha udāhriyata ityata āha—tadaṃśatvāditi
gītādikalācatuḥṣaṣṭeḥ kāmāṅgatayā kāmasūtrakārairupadeśādbhavati tadvirodhe kāmaśāsravirodha ityarthaḥ
ādigrahaṇāddevatābhaktito muktirna tattvajñānasaṃpadetyādikaṃ mokṣādiśāstraviruddhamudāharaṇīyam
doṣāṇāṃ prathamamuddeśo'yamabhisaṃdhāya kṛtastaṃ viśeṣasaṃhāravyājena sphuṭayati—
evaṃ padānāṃ vākyānāṃ vākyārthānāṃ ca yaḥ kaviḥ
doṣānheyatayā vetti sa kāvyaṃ kartumarhati || 58
alaṃkṛtamapi śravyaṃ na kāvyaṃ guṇavarjitam
guṇayogastayormukhyo guṇālaṃkārayogayoḥ || 59
trividhāśca guṇāḥ kāvye bhavanti kavisaṃmatāḥ
bāhyāścābhyantarāścaiva ye ca vaiśeṣikā iti || 60
bāhyāḥ śabdaguṇāsteṣu cāntarāstvarthasaṃśrayāḥ
vaiśeṣikāstu te nūnaṃ doṣatve'pi hi ye guṇāḥ || 61
caturviṃśatirākhyātāsteṣu ye śabdasaṃśrayāḥ
te tāvadabhidhīyante nāmalakṣaṇayogataḥ || 62
śleṣaḥ prasādaḥ samatā mādhuryaṃ sukumāratā
arthavyaktistathā kāntirudāratvamudāttatā || 63
ojastathānyadaurjityaṃ preyānatha suśabdatā
tadvatsamādhiḥ saukṣmyaṃ ca gāmbhīryamatha vistaraḥ || 64
saṃkṣepaḥ saṃmitatvaṃ ca bhāvikatvaṃ gatistathā
rītiruktistathā prauḍhirathaiṣāṃ lakṣyalakṣaṇe || 65
tatra
guṇaḥ suśliṣṭapadatā śleṣa ityabhidhīyate
yathā—
‘ubhau yadi vyomni pṛthakpravāhāvākāśagaṅgāpayasaḥ patetām
tadopamīyeta tamālanīlamāmuktamuktālatamasya vakṣaḥ || 75 ||’
atra bhinnānāmapi padānāmekāpadatāpratibhāsahetutvena saṃdarbhasya suśliṣṭatvādayaṃ śleṣo nāma śabdaguṇaḥ
evamiti
tadevaṃ doṣalakṣaṇe vṛtte kramaprāptā guṇā lakṣayitavyāḥ
tadevamojaḥ prasādādayo guṇāḥ
yamakādayastvalaṃkārā iti pūrvaprasiddhau satyāṃ vicāryate
kimeṣāṃ mitho bhedanibandhanam, kathaṃ cālaṃkārebhyo guṇānāṃ pūrvanipātaḥ, rasasya hi doṣābhāvāditrayasaṃskṛta eva padalābha ityasti paścādbhāve nibandhanamiti tatrāha—alaṃkṛtamapīti
rasāvalambino guṇāḥ, śabdārthāvalambinastvalaṃkārā iti kāśmīrakāḥ
tadagamakam
tathā hi—yadi kāvyasya rasapradhānātmakatāmāśrityāyaṃ vibhāgaḥ, alaṃkārā api tarhi tatpravaṇā eva
atha nāyaṃ niyamo yatsarvatra rasaḥ pradhānamiti, tadātra guṇeṣvapi kathaṃ tadālambananiyamaḥ
kiṃ cātra prasādādivat śleṣādayo'pi śabdārthagatā eva pratyabhijñāyante tatkathamayaṃ vibhāgaḥ
yadyapi śabdārthā jñāyante, tathāpi rasapravaṇā iti cet
kimidaṃ rasapravaṇatvaṃ, rasāśritatvaṃ tāvanna saṃbhavatyeva
rasapratītiparyavasānaṃ ca yathākathaṃcidalaṃkāreṣvapi tulyamityavicāritaramaṇīyo'yaṃ mārgaḥ
lokaśāstravacanātigāmī kaścidviśeṣaḥ śobhāpadābhilapyo bhavannasmiñśravyaśabdaḥ śabdārśau viṣayīkaroti
tataśca tathābhūtaśobhāniṣpattihetavo guṇāstadutkarṣahetavastklaṃkārāḥ
yadāha—‘kāvyaśobhāyāḥ kartāro dharmā guṇāstadatiśayahetavastvalaṃkārāḥ’ ityanye, tadapi na
asya rasādivadavyāpteḥ
nahi teṣāṃ rītiśarīrāntarniveśaḥ kaiścidabhyupagamyate, tasmādālaṃkārikasamayānupātī śleṣādyanyatamo guṇaḥ
jātyādyanyatamaścālaṃkāra iti vibhāgaḥ
tata eva ca śobhākāritvena guṇānāmapyalaṃkārapakṣanikṣepaṃ kariṣyati
udbhūtaguṇaṃ tu sphuṭālaṃkārahīnamapi camatkāramāvahatyeva
yathā—‘kā tvaṃ śubhe kasya parigraho vā kiṃ vā madabhyāgamakāraṇaṃ te
ācakṣva matvā vaśināṃ raghūṇāṃ manaḥ parastrīvimukhapravṛtti
’ yato guṇayogo mukhyastataḥ prathamamuddiṣṭo lakṣitaścaiṣaḥ
sāmānyaguṇasthitau guṇā-nvibhajate—trividhāśceti
śabdaḥ śarīrasthānīyo'dhiṣṭheyatayā prathamapratisaṃdheyatayā ca bāhyaḥ
tatastadāśritā guṇā api bāhyāḥ
arthastvātmatulyo'dhiṣṭhāyakatayā paścādgrahyatayā cāntarastena tadāśritā guṇā apyāntarāḥ
athedānīṃ yeṣāmagre doṣatvaṃ tato guṇabhāvaḥ
kecidviśeṣamāsādyante vaiśeṣikāḥ
pūrvaṃ doṣā api viśeṣayogena guṇībhavantītyabhiprāyāt
‘mādhuryaujaḥprasādāstraya eva guṇāḥ’ iti dhvanikārasya mataṃ nirasyati—caturviṃśatiriti
parasparasaṃkīrṇatvādupādhīnāmiti bhāvaḥ
na caitadasmākaṃ manīṣāmātreṇa kalpanamityāha—ākhyātā iti
niṣṭhāpratyayenedaṃprathamatā dyotyate
uktaviśeṣādeva śabdaguṇānāṃ pūrvabhāva ityāha—teṣviti
abhidhānaṃ dvividhaṃ vibhāgataḥ, lakṣaṇataścetyāha—nāmalakṣaṇayogata iti
padaghaṭanavyavasthitau guṇāntaragaveṣaṇam
ataḥ prathamaṃ śleṣalakṣaṇamāha—tatreti
śliṣṭāni ghaṭitāni padāni yatra tasya bhāvastattā
na ca ghaṭanāmātrasya guṇabhāva iti śaṅkyam
supadaṃ śobhanā ghaṭanetyarthaḥ
śobhanatvaṃ ghaṭanāyā masṛṇatvamekatāpratibhānasāmarthyaṃ yadbrahmaṃ sūtramuraḥsthala iti
bījaṃ cātra śrutyanuprāsavattvamalakṣitasaṃdhitā ca
tathā hi prakṛtodāharaṇe ubhāvityukārabhakārāvoṣṭhyau
yadi ‘vya’ ityādyantau vakārayakārau tālavyau
na cāyaṃ varṇānuprāsaḥ
īṣatspṛṣṭatvādibhedāt
madhye dakāravakārau dantyoṣṭhyau
‘mni’ ityatra makāro bhakāreṇa, nakāro dakāreṇa samānaśrutika ityādi boddhavyam
tathā ‘pṛthakpravāhau’ iti kakārasya pavargagamanaikatā pratibhāsate, ‘pravāhāvākāśa’ ityaukārasyāvādeśena varṇāntaraniṣpattyā
evaṃ ‘payasaḥ patetām’ ityādāvunneyam
pṛthagiti pārśvadvaye
tena vakṣaḥsthaladakṣiṇavāmabhāgayorlambamāno dvisaro hāra iti labhyate
asya vakṣa iti
atrāsyeti padena nānyasya hāra itthamanupamo na cānyasya vakṣaḥsthalamākāśavadunnatavistīrṇamiti bhagavataḥ sakalajagadvilakṣaṇatvadhvanirityārādhyāḥ
prasiddhārthapadatvaṃ yatsa prasādo nigadyate || 66
yathā—
‘gāhantāṃ mahiṣā nipānasalilaṃ śṛṅgairmuhustāḍitaṃ chāyābaddhakadambakaṃ mṛgakulaṃ romanthamabhyasyatu
viśrabdhaiḥ kriyatāṃ varāhapatibhirmustākṣatiḥ palvale viśrāmaṃ labhatāmidaṃ ca śithilajyābandhamasmaddhanuḥ || 76 ||’
atra ‘gāhantāṃ mahiṣā nipānasalilam’ ityādiprasiddhārthapadopādānātprasādaḥ
prasiddhārtheti
asyārthaḥ prāgeva vivṛtaḥ
prasādo dvidhā—vācyaviṣayaḥ, pratīyamānaviṣayaśca
tatra pratīyamānaviṣayo yathā—‘evaṃvādini devarṣau pārśve pituradhomukhī
līlākamalapatrāṇi gaṇayāmāsa pārvatī
’ atra śrutāvagatādeva vākyāllajjādayo hastadattā iva prakāśante
vākyaviṣayo dvidhā bhavati
grāmyaireva grāmya upanāgarairvā, padaiḥ saṃdarbhanirvāhe
ādyo yathā—‘candre kalaṅkaḥ sujane daridratā vikāśalakṣmīḥ kamaleṣu cañcalā
mukhāprasādaḥ sadhaneṣu sarvadā yaśo vidhātuḥ kathayanti khaṇḍitam
’ dvitīyamudāharati—gāhantāmiti
atra prathamapāde gāhantāṃ mahiṣā iti grāmyam
nipānasalilamityupanāgaram
śṛṅgairiti grāmyam
muhurityupanāgaram
tāḍitamiti grāmyam
dvitīyapāde kadambakaromanthaśabdāvupanāgarau śeṣāṇi grāmyāṇi
evaṃ ca caramayorapi svato vivecanīyam
gāhanaṃ viloḍanaṃ tanniḥśaṅkameva bhavatīti visrambhadhvaniḥ
ata eva trāsābhāvātprakṛtipratyāpattau
śṛṅgābhyāṃ paryāyeṇa jalatāḍanaṃ mahiṣajātiḥ
chāyāśrayaṇaṃ yūthabandhaśca mṛgajātiḥ
ciraparasparavārtānabhijñānāddivā niṣpalāyanena romantho'paricita ivāsīttasyedānīṃ śikṣākrameṇa yadi paricayaḥ syādityabhyasyatviti dhvaniḥ
varāhapatibhiriti na yādṛśatādṛśānāmasmanmṛgayāsaṃrambhagocaratvamiti prakāśyate
nanu cātra kartṛprakramabhedo dūṣaṇaṃ kasmānna bhavati
naitat
āpātaśauṇḍeṣu pariṇatibhīruṣu ca mahiṣeṣu svabhāvabhīteṣu mṛgeṣu na tathāyaṃ saṃrambhate yathā punarāvṛtticatureṣu prakārakovideṣu ca varāheṣu
tataśca teṣāmucitakriyāsu kartṛtāmātrameva na soḍhavāniti sāṃprataṃ kartṛtābhyanujñānena vyajyate
tatastṛtīyāyāmaucityaniveśinyāṃ prakramabhedo'pyucita eveti vyaktivivekakārādīnāmapi saṃmataḥ panthāḥ
idaṃ ceti cakāreṇa cedasmaddhanurārūḍhamavatīrṇaṃ vā tadaiva saṃrambhagocarāṇāṃ bhayavisrambhāviti kopaprakarṣaḥ
ata evāsmaditi bahuvacanaṃ sajīvam
yanmṛduprasphuṭonmiśravarṇabandhavidhiṃ prati
avaiṣamyeṇa bhaṇanaṃ samatā sābhidhīyate || 67
yathā—
‘yaccandrakoṭikarakorakabhārabhāji babhrāma babhruṇi jaṭāpaṭale harasya
tadvaḥ punātu himaśailaśilānikuñja- jhāṅkāraḍambaravirāvi surāpagāmbhaḥ || 77 ||’
atropakramādāsamāpti sphuṭabandhasya nirvāhātsamatvam
yaditi
pratītyantena mārgo vyākhyātaḥ
avaiṣamyeṇa bhaṇanamityanena vāgbhedaḥ svareṣu hrasvāntyāḥ, vyañjaneṣu vargāntyā dantyāśca mṛdavaḥ komalā varṇāḥ
dīrghāḥ svarāḥ vyañjaneṣu ṇakāravarjaṭavargarephaśaṣahā adantyasaṃyogāśca prasphuṭāḥ
śeṣāṇi vyañjanāni dantyasaṃyogāśconmiśramadhyamā varṇāsteṣāmanyatamairvarṇairyo bandhanavidhistaṃ prati yadavaiṣamyeṇa upakramanirvāhādinā karaṇena bhaṇanamuktiḥ sā samatā
na ceyaṃ doṣābhāvamātramekajātīyavarṇaparicayaprabandhapraveśanirvāhāṇāṃ siddhiḥ śaktivyutpattirūpatayā pradhānotkarṣaparyavasānāt
na ca doṣābhāvasyaivaṃrūpatā kenacitpratiṣiddhā
ata eva śleṣaprasādayorapi guṇabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ
nanu ‘raktāśokakṛśodarī kva nu gatā tyaktvānuraktaṃ janaṃ no dṛṣṭeti mudhaiva cālayasi kiṃ vātābhibhūtaṃ śiraḥ
utkaṇṭhāghaṭamānaṣaṭpadaghaṭāsaṃghaṭṭadaṣṭacchadastatpādāhatimantareṇa bhavataḥ puṣpodgabho'yaṃ kutaḥ
’ ityatra vaiṣamyaṃ doṣa eva syāt
na hyatra muktasthāne sphuṭatā
tasmādyatkiṃcidetat
tadevaṃ nirvāhyatraividhyātsamatā trirūpā bhavati grāmyā paruṣā upanāgarikā ca
tatronmiśraprāyasaṃdarbhanirvāhe grāmyā
yathā—‘puraḥ pāṇḍucchāyaṃ tadanu kapilimnā kṛtapadaṃ tataḥ pākodrekādaruṇaguṇasaṃvardhitavapuḥ
śanaiḥ kośārambhe sthapuṭanijaviṣkambhaviṣame vane pītāmodaṃ vadaramarasatvaṃ kalayati
’ paruṣā yathā—yaccandreti
bālendumayūkhamukulajālaniculitāsu parameśvarajaṭāvallarīpu bhramaṇādhyāsādivādyāpi himādrikuñjeṣu jhāṅkārigaṅgāmbha iti pratīyamānotprekṣā
upanāgarikā yathā—‘vasane paridhūsare vasānā niyamakṣāmamukhī dhṛtaikaveṇiḥ
atiniṣkaruṇasya śuddhaśīlā mama dīrghāṃ virahavyathāṃ vyanakti
’ atrāsmatsahādhyāyinaḥ pūrvārdhamevopanāgarikodāharaṇaṃ manyante
uttarārdhe hi viṣketyādivarṇaniveśanādunmiśratvameva
iyamaparonmiśrā saṃdarbhajātiryatkomalakaṭhoravarṇatulyatayā nirvahaṇamiti
yā pṛthakpadatā vākye tanmādhuryamiti smṛtam
yathā—
‘sthitāḥ kṣaṇaṃ pakṣmasu tāḍitādharāḥ payodharotsedhanipātacūrṇitāḥ
valīṣu tasyāḥ skhalitāḥ prapedire cireṇa nābhiṃ prathamodabindavaḥ || 78 ||’
atra padeṣu saṃhitābhāvātpṛthakpadatvena mādhuryam
yā pṛthagiti
pṛthagiva padāni yatra bhāsante sa pṛthakpadaḥ saṃdarbha ityupamāgarbho bahuvrīhiśca
tasya bhāvastattā
mādhuryamuktasvarūpaṃ tacchabdagataṃ pṛthakpadatayāvicchidyata iti
tadeva mādhuryayuktam
aucityena hi samāsavyatireka ākṛṣyate kadācidanuddhato vā samāsaḥ
anuddhatiranullekhaḥ
taduktam—‘avṛttirmaghyavṛttirvā mādhurye ghaṭanā tathā’ iti
ata eva ‘samāsanivṛttiparametat’ iti vāmanaḥ
kaścitsamāso rasaucityenākṛṣṭaḥ paribhāvyamāno manīṣibhiścamatkārakāraṇaṃ bhavati
yathā—‘teṣāṃ gopavadhūvilāsasuhṛdāṃ rādhārahaḥsākṣiṇāṃ kṣemaṃ tatra kalindaśailatanayātīre latāveśmanām
vicchinne smaratalpakalpanamṛducchedopayoge'dhunā te nūnaṃ jaraṭhībhavanti vigalannīlatviṣaḥ pallavāḥ
’ atra tacchabdo yeṣāṃ vilāsasaṃpattisvabhāvalabdhaprakarṣāṇāmanubhava eva sākṣīti viśeṣaprādhānyavivakṣayā nasamāsenānigamanāt
na yā kāpi vadhūḥ, api tu gopasaṃbandhinī kṛtagopācāracāturīparādhīnā
nānyatra nīrasaprāye kvacana sauhārdaṃ kiṃ tu vilāsa eva
so'pi na yaḥkaścit, api tu gopavadhūsaṃbandhītyevaṃ bahūnāṃ piṇḍībhāvavivakṣayā samāsa evocitaḥ
etāvataivācchedo'pyucita eva
sarvasvāyamānatvāttatsaṃbandhajanitasya viśeṣasya pṛthagevoktirucitā
rādhārahaḥsākṣiṇāmityatrāpi samāsaḥ pūrvavat
yadyapi rādhāsaṃbandhasya vaivakṣikaṃ prādhānyamiti na samāsaḥ pratibhāsate tathāpi yadanyasya rādhārahasi niveśaḥ kṣama iti bhāvayansuhṛdāmityapahāya sākṣiṇāmityuktavān
sākṣī hi taṭastha eva vyāpriyate
tenāvaśyakartavyasākṣitāprādhānyavivakṣayā saṃbhavati virodhādityavaseyam
sthitā iti
pakṣmāvasthāne'dharatāḍane stanataṭanipāte valibhaṅgaskhalane nābhinimnapnāptau jalabindūnāṃ kartṛtānirdeśātsvācchandyamunmīlitam
tathā ca—gauryā bāhyasaṃvedanābhāvastena bhagavadgato'nurāgaprakarṣaḥ prathamapādena
nidāghatāpacchidā rajoharaṇena vasuṃdharā saurabhonmīlanena mayūrakekāyitādinā tribhuvanasyāpi ye camatkārāspadamiti dhvanitam
tathābhūtānāmatha saṃvedane pūrva evābhiprāyaḥ
tāḍitetyākāreṇa cchedonmeṣaḥ payodharetyādāvokāraḥ
dhakāratakārau
aniṣṭhurākṣaraprāyaṃ sukumāramiti smṛtam || 68
yathā—
‘maṇḍalīkṛtya barhāṇi kaṇṭhairmadhuragītibhiḥ
kalāpinaḥ pranṛtyanti kāle jīmūtamālini || 79 ||’
atra sarvakomalatve'sati śleṣaviparyayadoṣaśaithilyābhāvādbāhulyādvarṇānāmanaiṣṭhuryātsaukumāryam
aniṣṭhureti

tatra pūrvaprakārabhedo na ghaṭate
ataḥ sābhiprāyāṇāmevotprekṣaṇaṃ sā vācyā
tathā hi—vandata iti jāyamānamātrābhivādyatayā tribhuvanamātṛtā
yajata iti samastadevatārupatvam
upaitīti sarvopagamyatayā jagaccharaṇyatvam
