ālokata iti viśvavarti yāvanmanoharatvam
stautīti samastābhimatadāyitā
manyata iti nikhilajñeyasvarūpatā
manuta ityavadhāraṇīyatayā tattvātmakatā
adhyetīti kāntārādismartavyatayā durgādibhedena prapañcyamānatvam
dhyāyatīti nididhyāsanaviṣayatayā pratyagjyotīrūpateti parāparabhedabhinnā bhagavatī stutā bhavati
manyate manute iti yathā sāmānyaviśeṣābhidhāyinau tathādhyeti dhyāyatītyapi
tiṅantānāṃ ca durghaṭo'pi paraspara-manvayaḥ kenāpi prakāreṇa ghaṭita iti pūrvavadvoddhavyaḥ
tadetadāha—atretyādipadamubhābhyāṃ saṃbadhyate
tena jīvitavargo janivargaścābhimataḥ
matiḥ sakṛdevāvṛtta iti noktaḥ bhūyasā hi loke vyapadeśo dṛśyata iti
samādhiḥ so'nyadharmāṇāṃ yadanyatrādhiropaṇam || 72
yathā—
‘pratīcchatyāśorkī kisalayaparāvṛttimadharaḥ kapolaḥ pāṇḍutvādavatarati tālīpariṇatim
parimlānaprāyāmanuvadati dṛṣṭiḥ kamalinī- mitīyaṃ mādhuryaṃ spṛśati ca tanutvaṃ ca bhajate || 88 ||’
atra pratīcchati—avatarati—anuvadati—ityādicetanakriyādharmāṇāmacetaneṣvadharādiṣūpacāreṇādhyāropaṇaṃ samāghiḥ
samādhiriti
samyagādhānamāropaṇaṃ samāghiḥ
samyaktvaṃ ca kakratālokātigatvaṃ na tadadhikabhāvaḥ
tadidaṃ lakṣaṇe sphuṭam
‘kamalāni nimīlanti kumudānyunmiṣanti ca’ ityādau vyabhicārācca
tena saṃbandhitā na dharmaviśeṣaṇamatrābhimatā
alaṃkārādbhedaścaturthe vakṣyate—pratīcchatīti
pratyeṣaṇaṃ dīyamānasya grahaṇaṃ cetanadharmaḥ sa virahavatyā acetane'dhare samāropitaḥ
kisalayakāntimito mandībhūtatāmavagamayati
deyasya dāturapasaraṇe'nyatra saṃkrāntau ca pratyeṣaṇanirvāhācca
tathā cāśokakisalayebhyo'pi komalapāṭalatvamadharasyeti mādhuryapoṣaḥ
tadabhimukhapravartanamavataraṇamapi cetanadharmaḥ so'cetane kapole samāropitaḥ kiṃcitpāṇḍutāmavadyotayati
na ca pratyeṣaṇavatsāmastyena grahaṇamapi tu saṃmukhībhāvamātramityāśayāt
tathā ca pūrvavanmādhuryaṃ puṣṇāti, anuvādo'pi cetanadharma eva so'cetanāyāṃ dṛṣṭāvāropitaḥ paryuṣitakamalacchāyāmakhaṇḍāmevātra bodhayati
paraprakarṣābhimukhe'pi vipralambhe kadācitsaṃkalpopasthitaprāṇanāthāyāṃ dṛṣṭau kāntī bhavatīti prāyaḥpadena sūcitam
sparśasya mādhuryaviṣaye'saṃbhavātspṛśatītyapyāropaḥ
prathamavigrahaśobhāvirbhāvamabhivyanakti—cetanakriyeti
prakṛtāpekṣayā kriyākriyāvatoḥ sādṛśyābhāvānneyaṃ gauṇī kiṃ tūpacaritaiva śuddhetyāha—upacāreṇeti
etena rūpakādibhyo bhedaḥ samarthitaḥ
antaḥ saṃjalparūpatvaṃ śabdānāṃ saukṣmyamucyate
yathā—
‘kevalaṃ dadhati kartṛvācinaḥ pratyayāniha na jātu karmaṇi
dhātavaḥ sṛjatisaṃhṛśāstayaḥ stautiratra viparītakārakaḥ || 89 ||’
atra śrutāvagatavākyārthasya sṛjati—saṃharati—śāsti—stūyate—iti śabdānāmantaḥsaṃjalparūpeṇa sūkṣmatayā sūkṣmatvam
antariti
yathā karituragādirūpakāṇāṃ pāṣāṇaśilādāvabhivyaktamavasthitau sūkṣmarūpatā tathā śabdānāṃ śrūyamāṇānāmapi kathamanyathā vākyārthabhāvanadaśāyāṃ śeṣaniyamenonmeṣaḥ
kevalamityādau sṛjati—saṃharati—śāstayo dhātavaḥ kartaryeva bhagavadviṣaye prayujyamānāḥ pratyayānprayojayanti na karmaṇīti vākyārtho yadā bhāvyate tadaivāyaṃ sṛjati saṃharati śāsti, na tu sṛjyate saṃhriyate śiṣyate iti śabdāḥ prakāśante
evaṃ stautirviparītakārakaḥ
atra stautiḥ karmaṇyeva pratyayaprayojako na kartarīti vākyārthabhāvanāsamaya eva nāyaṃ kiṃcitstauti kiṃtu sarvaiḥ stūyata eveti śabdā unmiṣanti
tadetadāha—atra śrutāvagateti
yāvadeva vākyaṃ śrūyamāṇamavagamyate tasyaiva bhāvanāpallavaḥ paścādavasīyata iti vaṭabījanyāyamupodbalayati
so'yaṃ sahṛdayapratītisākṣiko'rthaḥ
dhvanimattā tu gāmbhīryam
yathā—
‘maulau dhāraya puṇḍarīkamamitaṃ tanvātmano vikramaṃ cakrāṅkaṃ vaha pādayugmamavanīṃ doṣṇā samabhyuddhara
lkṣamīṃ bhrūnikaṭe niveśaya bhava jyāyāndivaukaspate- rviśvāntaḥkaraṇaikacaura tadapi jñātaṃ hariḥ khalvasi || 90 ||’
atra nābhyāṃ puṇḍarīkadhāraṇaṃ parimitavikramatvaṃ cakrāṅkitakaratvaṃ daṃṣṭrayā vasudhoddhāraṇaṃ vakṣaḥsthalaniveśitalakṣmīkatvamindrāvarajatvaṃ ca dhvanayatīti gāmbhīryam
dhvanimatteti
dhvananaṃ dhvanirvyañjanātmā vyāpāraḥ
sa dvividhaḥ—śabdadhvaniḥ arthadhvaniśca
yena śabda eva dhvanyate sa śabdadhvanirabhimata iti kecit, tanna
śabdasyaiva dhvanyatānaṅgīkārāt
nābhyāṃ puṇḍarīkadhāraṇamityādi vyākhyāgranthabhaṅgaprasaṅgācca
tasmācchabdāśritaṃ dhvananaṃ śabdadhvanirarthāśritaṃ cārthadhvaniriti vaktavyam
prabhūtadhvanisaṃbaddhapadakadambakasya gāmbhīryam
athavā dhvanayatīti dhvaniḥ śabdātmako yatrāsti padasamudāyastadgāmbhīryam
tathā hi puṇḍarīkapadaprastāvātsitacchatre niyatābhidhānaśaktikaṃ kāṃsyatālānusvānasthānīyāṃ sitāmbhojavyaktimupajanayaccopalabhyate
anekārthaniyatābhidhānaśaktikatvācca
tadāha—‘anekārthasya śabdasya vācakatve niyantrite
saṃyogādyairavācyārthadhīkṛvdyāpṛtirañjanam
’ iti
evaṃ vikramādiṣu
tathāpi vikramaḥ paurūṣaṃ pariśiṣṭaḥ pādavikṣepaśca
cakraṃ cakravarticihnaṃ rekhāsaṃniveśalakṣaṇamāyudhaviśeṣaśca
abhyuddharaṇaṃ samyaglābhapālanaprāpaṇamutthāpanaṃ ca
lakṣmīḥ saṃpaddevatāviśeṣaśca
jyāyān praśasyataro vayojyeṣṭhaśca
idamevābhisaṃdhāya divaukaspaterityantaṃ vyācaṣṭe—atreti
tadapītyapiśabdena virodhadyotinā haribhāvamācaranniti pratīyate puṇḍarīkadhāraṇāderubhayatulyatvānmaulāvityādiviruddham, atastadviparītasthānīyaṃ viṣṇau dhvanayatprasiddhibalānnābhyādikameva dhvanayati
prasiddhirapi hi viśiṣṭārthapratipattau kāraṇamevetyabhipretya śabdadhvaniprastāve'pyanyavdyākhyātavān
anyathā tu prakṛtāsaṃgatiśaṅkayā na vācyārthapuṣṭiḥ syāt
so'yaṃ virodharūpamūlaḥ pratīyamānavyatireko vākyārthaḥ śabdadhvaniścātra jīvabhūtaḥ
viśvāntaḥkaraṇaikacora ityanena tribhuvanamanoharatā
divāniśamantaḥkaraṇāni corayannabhyāsakauśalādivātyantaprasiddhāni nārāyaṇacihnāni gopāyasīti pratīyamānotprekṣā
nanu vastudhvaniṃ śabdaśaktimūlameke na manyante
kathaṃ tarhi ‘panthia na ettha sattharamatthi maṇaṃ pattharatthale gāme
unnaapaoharaṃ pekkhia uṇa jai vasasi tā vasasu
’ ityādau vastuvarṇanaṃ? na hyatra śleṣanyāyo na vā samāsoktinyāyaḥ saṃbhavati
kiṃ cālaṃkāra dhvanāvapi śabdaśaktirevopayuktetyakṣuṇṇaḥ śabdadhvaniḥ
ye tu vadanti śabdasyābhidhāvyatiriktā vṛttireva nāstīti, lakṣaṇāpi tairanaṅgīkaraṇīyā syāt
na cānaṅgīkartavyeti vācyam
"gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ" ityatra saptamyananvayāpatteḥ
prakṛtyanugatasvārthābhidhānaṃ hi vibhaktīnāṃ vyutpannamiti ghoṣapratiyogikādhikaraṇabhāvayogyaḥ kaścidartho gaṅgāpadasya vaktavyaḥ
tathā ca kānyā nāma lakṣaṇā
evaṃ puṇyatvādi- pratītistata eva bhavantī dhvananamupasthāpayatītyādikamasmābhiḥ kāvyaprakāśavivaraṇe prapañcitam
iha tu granthagauravabhiyā viramyate
vyāsenoktistu vistaraḥ || 73
yathā—
‘janaḥ puṇyairyāyājjaladhijalabhāvaṃ jalamuca- stathāvasthaṃ cainaṃ nidadhatu śubhaiḥ śuktivadanaiḥ
tatastāṃ śreyobhiḥ pariṇatimasau vindatu yathā ruciṃ tanvanpīnastani hṛdi tavāyaṃ viluṭhati || 91 ||’
atra kathamahaṃ tvatkucataṭe viluṭhāmītyabhiprāyasya vistareṇa prakāśitatvādayaṃ vistaraḥ
vyāseneti
yatra stoke'pi vācye vacanapallavaścamatkārakārī tatra sa eva guṇakakṣādhirohaṇakṣama iti śabdaguṇeṣu yukto vivektumata evoktiṃ viśeṣyatayā nirdiśati
janaḥ puṇyairityādau kathamahamityādau nirdiṣṭo'pi vakrābhiprāyarūpo'rtha uktipallavena prakarṣamānīyate
tathā hi jana iti taṭasthoktyā na mamedṛśāni bhāgagheyāni yenāhatya mano nirvahati
puṇyairiti bahuvacanenānekajanmopāttānāmevedaṃ phalam
yāyāditi saṃbhāvanābhiprāyeṇa liṅā muktāphalapariṇatiyogyajaladhijalaprāptisaṃbhāvanāpi kasyacideva dhanyajanmana iti prakāśite ko'pi kāraṇaprakarṣaḥ
jalamuca ityanena yeṣāṃ na jaladānameva vyāpāraḥ, api tu viśvasaṃtāpacchidurāṇāmanyopakārapravaṇatayā śuktimukhaparyantamapi nayanamupapadyata iti
tathāvasthamityanena yadaiva smarāvasthā tadaiva jaladharaiḥ pānamāśaṃsāmātragocaro na tu pūrvavatsaṃbhāvanāmātragocaraḥ, ata eva śubhairiti samayavilambanasya prāktanapuṇyamānahetukatvādityādi svayamavaseyam
etena ‘padarthe vākyaracanam’ iti yadanyairguṇāntaramabhihitaṃ tadvistāramekameva
ghaṭanāsauṣṭhavamātropayuktastu pallavo viśeṣaguṇeṣvasmābhirabhidhāsyate
tvatkucataṭe luṇṭhanamatyalpapuṇyasya na saṃpadyata ityetāvānevārtho vivakṣāviṣaya iti kāryavikāsasyaiva camatkārārpaṇe prāgalbhyamiti śabdapradhānakatayā yuktamatra parisaṃkhyānamiti
samāsenābhidhānaṃ yatsa saṃkṣepa udāhṛtaḥ
yathā—
‘sa mārutisamānītamahauṣadhihṛtavyathaḥ
laṅkāstrīṇāṃ punaścake vilāpācāryakaṃ śaraiḥ || 92 ||’
atra kathāvistarapratipādyasyārthasya prakṛtasaṃgrāmarasavicchedāśaṅkayā ślokārdhamātreṇoktatvātsaṃkṣepaḥ
samāseneti
asti kaścidviśeṣo yatra vākyasaṃkocaḥ prakṛtaucitīvaśena camatkārakāraṇam
tathā hi—sa mārutītyādau mārutinā yadoṣadherānayanam, yacca tayā vyathāharaṇam, tadubhayamapītihāsakathāvistareṇa pratipāditamiha tu ślokārdhamātreṇeti śabdadattabhara evāyaṃ guṇo yadyapi bhavati, tathāpi yāvadvivakṣitopādānakāvyarūpeṇārthasaṃkoco vaktavyaḥ
sa ca tathāvidhavakroktisaṃkroca eva bhavatītyuktāveva saṃkoca ullikhati
kathamayaṃ saṃkocaḥ prāptocitabhāva ityāha—prakṛteti
ata evopakṣiptamapītihāsārthamapahāya tvarāviṣṭena kavinā prakṛtamuttarārdha evāsaṃhitaṃ pūrvottarārdhasāmañjasyāya saṃkṣipyaiva prakṛtamapyuktam
yāvadarthapadatvaṃ ca saṃmitatvamudāhṛtam || 74
yathā—
‘kecidvastuni no vāci kecidvāci na vastuni
vāci vastuni cāpyanye nānye vāci na vastuni || 93 ||’
atrārthasya padānāṃ ca tulāvidhṛtavattulyatvena saṃmitatvam
yāvaditi
yāvanti varṇāni vinā prakṛtamanusartumeva na śakyante tāvanmātramayatvaṃ vākyasya saṃmitatvam
ataḥ saṃkṣepādbhedaḥ
kaveḥ śaktivyutpattibhyāmasatyapi pallave kadāciddhaṭanālāvaṇyamunmiṣatyeva
yathā pūrvamudāhṛtam—‘kā tvaṃ śubhe kasya parigraho vā’ ityādi
arthavyaktisaṃkaraśaṅkāpyata eva nirākṛtā
'astyuttarasyāṃ diśi devatātmā’ iti kecidudāharanti tadayuktam
anena nāmapadayoḥ pallavarūpatvātsaṃmitatvābhāve kathamābhāsatvaṃ bhavatīti visbhṛtavyamicāriguṇaprakaraṇasya bhāṣitamupekṣaṇīyam
keciditi sarvanāmna evābhimatakaviviśeṣe parya-vasānaṃ sāmarthyena saṃbhavatīti nādhyāhāraśaṅkā
śaktā ityādikriyāpi sāmarthyenāvasīyate tadetatsarvamabhipretyāha—tulāvidhṛtavaditi
bhāvato vākyavṛttiryā bhāvikaṃ tadudāhṛtam
yathā—
‘ehyehi vatsa raghunandana pūrṇacandra cumbāmi mūrdhani ciraṃ ca pariṣvaje tvām
āropya vā hṛdi divāniśamudvahāmi vande'thavā caraṇapuṣkarakadvayaṃ te || 94 ||’
atra harṣavaśādanaucityenāpi ‘vande'thavā caraṇapuṣkarakadvayam’ ityādīnāmuktatvād bhāvikatvam
bhāvata iti
bhāvanādṛśāpannā cittavṛttirbhāvaḥ
bhāvanā vāsanāvyāptirityanarthāntaram
tathā hyucyate—anena gandhena rasena vā sarvaṃ bhāvitamiti
harṣādibhāvitacetaso hi vīciprāyā uktibhedāḥ prādurbhavanti yairapratyūhameva bhāvo'bhivyajyate tadidamuktaṃ yā bhāvato vācaḥ kāvyarūpāyāḥ pravṛttirniṣpattiḥ saiva bhāvikam
bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ
tathā hi—prakṛtodāharaṇe ehītyekenaiva yuṣmadarthāvinābhāvinābhimukhīkaraṇe vṛtte dvitīyasya yadupādānam, pūrṇacandreti yadagrimakriyāsvanupayuktasyaivābhidhānam, cumbāmīti kariṣyamāṇasyāpi yo vartamānopadeśaḥ, cumbāmītyatra viśeṣaṇamanupādāya pariṣvaja ityatra ciramiti yadviśeṣaṇopādānam, tvamiti yogyārthasyāpi prayogaḥ pūrvopāttavaduttarakriyāspardhitayā yadekasyaiva vahanasya bhāṣaṇameva samastasamakakṣatayaiva yadvahanābhidhānam, vatsetyabhidhāya caraṇau banda iti yā virūddhoktiḥ, yacca te ityasyāvagatārthasyāpi vacanam, tatsarvamadharmasiddhameveti bhāvārthasya niṣpāditayā svādaheturbhavati
pravartante hi laukikānāṃ snehārthānāmutkalikāprāyā vācaḥ svadante ca
yathā—‘iyaṃ gehe lakṣmīriyamamṛtavartirnayanayorasāvasyāḥ sparśo vapuṣi bahalaścandanarasaḥ’ iti
tadetadabhipretya vyācaṣṭe—atreti
udbhaṭatvāttena śeṣāṇyupalakṣayati—anaucityenāpi vanda iti
gatirnāma kramo yaḥ syādihārohāvarohayoḥ || 75
yathā—
‘varāhaḥ kalyāṇaṃ vitaratu sa vo yasya śaśabhṛ- tkalākoṭīkāntaṃ kramavigaladabhyudbhṛtibhiyā
mithaḥ saṃmūrcchadbhiścaturudadhikallolapaṭalai- ranāmṛṣṭaṃ daṃṣṭrāśikharamadhiśete vasumatī || 95 ||’
atra pūrvārdhe svarasyārohāduttarārdhe cāvarohādgatiḥ
gatiriti
kecivdyācakṣate
yatīnāmārohāvarohau vivakṣitau kvacitkaviśaktivaśādyadyavdyārūḍhā avarūḍhā iva prakāśante
yathā—‘bhuvo nīcairnīcairavaṭaparipāṭīṣu patatāṃ sphuratyarvāgarvāgakhilabhuvane bhogitilakaḥ
kramāduccairuccairgiriśikharabhājāmapi nṛṇāmayaṃ dūre dūre bhavati bhagavānambaramaṇiḥ
’ atra yatī nānārohāvarohau tilatandulavatprakāśete
iyaṃ tu vṛttaucitī vakṣyate
tathā ca dvitīye saṃgatā syāt
tasmādayamarthaḥ—svarāṇāmakārādīnāmuparyuparitayā bodhaḥ saṃnikṛṣṭānāmiva prakāśanaṃ gatiriti
tathā ca vyākhyāsyati—svarasyeti
tathā hi prakṛtodāharaṇe varāhaḥ kalyāṇamityatrākāradvayaṃ tulyajātīyaṃ nirdiśya sa vo ityatrokāreṇa tuṅgatvamiva vidhāya dvitīyapādopakrame kalākoṭīkāntamityatrābhinnajātīyārohaparamparā vihitā
uttarārdhe tu tathā nāsti
śete ityatrāpi na sollekha ārohaḥ so'yamānubhaviko guṇaḥ ślokārdhaślokapādaślokāṃśakrameṇa narasiṃhavadbhavati
atropalakṣaṇatayādyamudāharati—atra pūrvārdha iti
kramairitastataścaraṇavinyāsairvigalantī asaṃpadyamānā yābhyuddhṛtirabhyuddharaṇaṃ tasyā yā bhīrbhayaṃ tayeti kecit
anye tu vadanti—krameṇa vigaladabhyuddhṛtibhayamūrdhvanayane sphuṭanādibhayaṃ yasyāḥ sā kramavigaladabhyuddhṛtibhiyeti
upakramasya nirvāho rītirityabhidhīyate
yathā—
‘grāvṇā nāsi gireḥ kṣatā na payasā nārtāsi na mlāyitā na śvāsaiḥ phaṇino'si na tvadanugā nāyāsitā kvāpi na
svaṃ veśma pratigacchatoriti muhuḥ śrīśārṅgiṇoḥ saspṛhaṃ sā praśnottarayugmapaṅktirubhayoratyāyatā pātu vaḥ || 96 ||’
atra pratyekapadānantaraṃ naño viniveśātkamābhedo rītiḥ
upakramasyeti
yādṛśī padasaṃniveśatvenopakramyate tādṛśyā vṛttanirvāhaḥ kvacidviśeṣaśobhāvaho bhavati
ata evātra nātyantanirvāho'bhimataḥ
ekādaśavṛtterapyabhiprāyasamagrakāvyajīvabhūtatvādetasyā eva nātiprasaṅgo'pi tathā prakṛtodāharaṇe prathamotthitāyā abdhiduhituravyājasarvāṅgīṇalāvaṇyamavalokayitā kṛṣṇaḥ svacakṣuṣoḥ kṛtārthatāṃ gamitavān
idānīmadharoṣṭhamudrābhedena yadi varṇamātrāmapi bhāratīṃ niścarantīmākarṇayāmi tadā śrotrayoḥ saphalatā bhavediti manyate
na cetthameva mugdhāṅganānāmālāpaḥ pravartate api tu nāyakasannidhau bhayādeveti prathamaṃ pṛcchati—grāvṇā nāsi gireḥ kṣateti
anantaraṃ ca yadi na vakṣyāmi tadā dhṛṣṭāmākalayiṣyatīti jānatyā dvayamuttaramaucityāpannaṃ syāt śiraḥkampa ekākṣaraṃ ca
tatrādyaḥ kālidāsena prayukto ‘mūrdhakampamayamuttaraṃ dadau’ iti
dvitīyaṃ kavinā viniveśitam—netiḥ
evaṃ śrutajalpitābhṛtastadanubandhena kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ manyamāno'dhikatrāsahetuṃ smārayanpṛcchati—payaseti
tadidamuktam—ārteti
prakārāntareṇottaradānāsaṃbhavātpunarapyāha—neti
tadanantaraṃ vyājarasāyāḥ kiyadadhikavacanaśravaṇotkaṇṭhitaḥ sarvaṃ lokaprasiddhaṃ bhayahetuṃ smārayanpṛcchati—mlāyiteti
abhimatasyāniṣṭaṃ svapne'pi na sajjata iti dṛṣṭāsīti noktam
evaṃ prasiddhamapi vacanapallavanena samastamugdhāṅganāprasiddhena vacanonmudraṇaprakāreṇa pṛcchati—tvadanugeti
sarvākāreṇottamatāmabhijñāyamāno dṛptaḥ svaveśma pratyeva gatavān na tu pṛṣṭavāniti
tadidaṃ sarvamabhipretya vyācaṣṭe—atreti
viśiṣṭā bhaṇitiryā syāduktiṃ tāṃ kavayo viduḥ || 76
yathā—
‘kuśalaṃ tasyā jīvati kuśalaṃ pṛcchāmi jīvatītyuktam
punarapi tadeva kathayasi mṛtāṃ nu kathayāmi yā śvasiti || 97 ||’
atra kuśalaṃ tasyā iti pṛṣṭe kuśalamakuśalaṃ veti vaktavye yo'yaṃ jīvatītyādyuktibhaṅgyā jīvitamātraśeṣatāpratipādanaprakāraḥ sa kāvye śabdaguṇeṣūktisaṃjñāṃ labhate
viśiṣṭeti
lokottarāḥ santi hi bhaṇitiprakārā lokaprasiddhāḥ
yathā supto'sīti praśne gṛhe devakule vetyādi
etatprasiddhivyatikrameṇa tu yā kācitkavipratibhayā bhaṇitirākṛṣyate sā bhavati lokottarā
tathā ca pratibhākṛṣṭatayā camatkāritvādguṇatvam
ata eva kavaya ityāha
kavisahṛdayānāmeva tādṛśoktiparicayasaṃbhavāt
tathā hi—prakṛtodāharaṇe kuśalapraśne kuśalaṃ veti lokaprasiddhamatastadeva vaktumarhati
yattu tadapahāya jīvatītyupāttamaparatrāpi praśne tathaivoktaṃ tatpratibhākṛṣṭatayā sāmiprāyamunnīyata ityāha—atra kuśalamakuśalamityādi
saṃprati prakarṣakāṣṭhālakṣaṇaṃ vākyasya guṇaṃ lakṣayati—
ukteḥ prauḍhaḥ parīpākaḥ procyate prauḍhisaṃjñayā
yathā—
‘abhyuddhṛtā vasumatī dalitaṃ ripūraḥ kṣiptakramaṃ kavalitā balirājalakṣmīḥ
atraikajanmani kṛtaṃ yadanena yūnā janmatraye tadakarotpuruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ || 98 ||’
atra prakṛtisthakomalakaṭhorebhyo nāgaropanāgaragrāmyebhyo vā padebhyo'bhyuddhṛtādīnāṃ grāmyādīnāmubhayeṣāṃ vā padānāmāvāpodvāpābhyāṃ sanniveśacārutvena yo'yamābhyāsiko nālikerapāko mṛdvīkāpāka ityādirvākyaparipākaḥ sā prauḍhirityucyate
tathā caitadvākyaṃ nālikerapāka ityucyate
evaṃ sahakāramṛdvīkāpāke apyudāharaṇīye iti
ukteriti
uktervākyasyāyaṃ pākaḥ sā prauḍhiḥ
śabdānāṃ paryāyaparivartāsahatvaṃ pākaḥ
yadāha—‘yatpadāni tyajantyeva parivṛttisahidhṇutām
taṃ śabdanyāyaniṣṇātāḥ śabdapākaṃ pracakṣate
’ iti
prauḍha iti
upakramopasaṃhārayornirvyūḍhaḥ sa cāyaṃ nāyaṃ nālikerasahakāramṛdvīkopalakṣaṇaistrividho gīyate
tadyathā—nālikeraphalaṃ pakvaṃ tvaci kaṭhinaṃ śirāsvavivṛtakomalaprāyaṃ kapālikāyāṃ kaṭhinataraṃ tathā kaścitsaṃdarbho mukhe kaṭhinastadanantaraṃ mṛduprāyastataḥ kaṭhinataro nālikerapāka ityucyate
tathā hi—prakṛtodāharaṇe prathamapāde'bhyuddhṛteti varṇacatuṣṭayamāramme kaṭhinaṃ ‘vasumatī dali’ iti varṇaṣaṭkaṃ komalaṃ ‘taṃ ripūraḥ’ ityanusvārarephadīrghairakṣaracatuṣṭayaṃ kaṭhinataram
atrāpi tamiti mṛduprāyāniveśanena komalakapālikāmukhabhāgasārūpyaṃ draḍhayatītyasmadārādhyāḥ
evaṃ dvitīyādipādatraye catuṣkaṣaṭkacatuṣkairnālikeraphalasāmyamutreyam
kathaṃ punarevaṃvidhaḥ pākaḥ saṃbhavatītyata āha—atreti
abhyāsena nirvṛtta ābhyāsikaḥ
kāvyaṃ kartuṃ vicārayituṃ ca ye jānanti tadupadeśena karaṇe yojane ca paunaḥpunyena pravṛttirabhyāsaḥ
asāvapi kathaṃ pākaviśeṣo bhavatītyata āha—sanniveśacārutveneti
sanniveśo racanā tasyāṃ cārutvam
tadapi kathamityata āha—āvāpodvāpābhyāmiti
saṃdarbhānupraveśanamāvāpaḥ
tataḥsamuddharaṇamudvāpaḥ
keṣāmityata uktam—padānāmiti
uddhṛtānāmiti budhdyā pṛthakkṛtānām
kebhya ityata uktam—prakṛtisthādityādi
tenāyamarthaḥ—prakṛtisthādipadato'pyetadevoddhartavyaṃ yad ghaṭanāsauṣṭavena paryāyaparivartanaṃ na sahate
bhavati hi sahṛdayānāmevamanyatpadaṃ nāstīti vyavahāraḥ
so'yaṃ racanāsiddhiviśeṣaḥ kathamanyathā tajjātīyameva padamanyatra saṃdarbhe niveśitaṃ na tathā svadate
ata evāsau vākyaguṇaḥ
kāṭhinyaṃ ca saṃyogairdīrghairvā svarairbhavati
yathātraivodāharaṇe ripūra ityādau
suptiṅvyutpattilakṣaṇastu vārtākapākaḥ kaiściduktaḥ, sa tu suśabdatālakṣaṇaguṇa eva
evamiti
yathā drākṣāphalaṃ tvaca ārabhya komalamantarā dvitricaturāsthisaṃpāditaṃ kiṃcitkāṭhinyamevaṃ kaścitsaṃdarbhamupakramopasaṃhārayoḥ komala eva madhye kaṭhina eva
saṃyogadīrghasvaramātrakṛtamanākkaṭho rabhāvo mṛdvīkāpāka ityucyate
yathā—‘ayi tvadāvarjitavārisaṃbhṛtaṃ pravālamā- sāmanubandhivīrudhām
cirojjhitālaktakapāṭalena te tulāṃ yadārohati dantavāsasā
', yathā ca—‘anavaratanayanajalalavanipatanaparipītahariṇamadatilakam
vadanamapayātamṛgamadaśaśikiraṇaṃ vahanti loladṛśaḥ
’ ata eva kavikalpalatākārādibhirukto nīlakapitthapākaścaturtho nāsti
yadvacca pariṇataṃ sahakāraphalamāramabhādeva komalamasthani tu kaṭhoraprāyamevamaparaḥ saṃdarbho mukhādāramya mṛdurantare kaṭhinataraḥ sahakārapāka ityucyate
yathā—‘kamalini kuśalaṃ te suprabhātaṃ rathāṅgāḥ kumudini punarindāvudgate tvaṃ ramethāḥ
sakhi rajani gatāsi tvaṃ tamo jīrṇamuccairiti taralitapakṣāḥ pakṣiṇo vyāharanti
’ atraivodāharaṇe'pi dvidhā kaṭhoratvamavaseyam
te'mī traya eva śuddhapākāḥ
vyatikarajanmānastu bhūyāṃsaḥ
eta evārthapākāḥ pañcame prakārāntareṇa pratipādayiṣyante
sūtrakāra evārthaguṇaprakaraṇe saṃgatiṃ karoti—
uktāḥ śabdaguṇā vākye caturviṃśatirityamī || 77
athaitāneva vākyārthaguṇatvena pracakṣmahe
teṣāṃ śleṣa iti proktaḥ saṃvidhāne susūtratā || 78
yathā—
‘dṛṣṭvaikāsanasaṃsthite priyatame paścādupetyādarā- dekasyā nayane nimīlya vihitakrīḍānubandhacchalaḥ
īṣadvakritakandharaḥ sapulakaḥ premollasanmānasā- mantarhāsalasatkapolaphalakāṃ dhūrto'parāṃ cumbati || 99 ||’
atraikāsanasaṃsthitayoḥ priyatamayorvilāsinā hyekā nayanamīlanakelikarmaṇā vañcitā
anyā tu vadanacumbanena rañjiteti
seyaṃ saṃvidhāne susūtratā
śleṣo nāma vākyārthaguṇaḥ
uktā iti
vṛttakīrtanaṃ hetubhāvapradarśanārtham
etāneva śleṣādināmakāniti
eṣāmiti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī
‘vākyārthaśarīrabhūtaḥ śleṣaḥ prathamaṃ lakṣyata iti
ghaṭanāśleṣaḥ’ iti sūtrayitvā ‘kramakauṭilyānulbaṇatvopapattiyogo ghaṭanā’ iti vāmanena vyākhyātam
asyārthaḥ—idaṃ kṛtvā idaṃ kartavyamiti kramastatraiva kauṭilyaṃ lokātigāminī vakratā
avakrayoḥ śabdarthayoḥ vacanamātratvāt
atimātratayā pratibhāsābhāvo'nulbaṇatvam
kathamevamarthaḥ saṃgacchata ityanupapattisamādhānaupayikaviśeṣaniveśanamupapattiḥ
tathā ca kameṇa kauṭilyenānulbaṇatayā upapattyā yojanamarthasya śleṣa iti tatra saṃvidhānakramānulbaṇatvena sūtraśabdenopatte svapadena kauṭilyamuktamaghaṭamānasyeva vākyārthasya buddhicāturyeṇa ghaṭaneti vākyārthaḥ
dṛṣṭveti
ekā nāyikā
aparā nāyikā ca tatsakhī pracchannanāyakapremapātraṃ tenaikāsanasaṃgatiḥ
priyatame iti tadanurañjanameva jīvitasarvasvamiti manyamānasya yugapatpravṛttiḥ
ādareṇa nimṛtapadanyāsatā tathā bhūtvā yugapatkarābhyāṃ nayanadvayapidhānaṃ lokaprasiddhā keliḥ
īṣaditi kandharāmātraṃ yathā calate na tu śarīramapi
anyathā calanajñāne nāyikāyāḥ kaṣāyabhāvaḥ syāt
nibhṛtarāgonmudraṇāt pulakodgamaḥ
ata eva premṇā svagocaralokottaratvābhimānarūpeṇa tattadanekabhāvormibhirāndolanaṃ manasa ullāsaḥ
sādhuvañcanaṃ na jānātītyabhiprāyikasapatnīgatadhikkārabhāvanayā nibhṛtahāsonmeṣaḥ
vañcanācāturyeṇa svamanīṣitasaṃpādanaṃ dhūrtatā
tadetavdyācaṣṭe—atraikāsaneti
yattu prākaṭyamarthasya prasādaḥ so'bhidhīyate
yathā—
‘ayamudayati mudrābhañjanaḥ padminīnā- mudayagirivanālībālamandārapuṣpam
virahavidhurakokadvandvabandhurvibhinda- nkupitakapikapolakroḍatāmrastamāṃsi || 100 ||’
atra padminīvikāsakaraṇe udayaśailāvataraṇe kokaśokaharaṇe tamovidāraṇe cānukto'pi sūryalakṣaṇo'rthaḥ prakaṭamupalakṣyate
yattu prākaṭyamiti
samabhivyāhṛtapadārthasaṃsargātmani vākyārthe darpaṇatala ivānupāttasyāpi vivakṣitasya vastunaḥ pratibhāso'rthaprasādaḥ
na cedamanumānaṃ samānasaṃvitsaṃvedyatvāt
tadāha—anukto'pi sūryalakṣaṇo'ryaḥ prakaṭamupalakṣyata iti
avaiṣamyaṃ kramavatāṃ samatvamiti kīrtitam || 79
yathā—
‘agre strīnakhapāṭalaṃ kurabakaṃ śyāmaṃ dvayorbhāgayo- rbālāśokamupoḍharāgasubhagaṃ bhedonmukhaṃ tiṣṭhati
īṣadbaddharajaḥkaṇāgrakapiśā cūte navā mañjarī mugdhatvasya ca yauvanasya ca sakhe madhye madhuśrīḥ sthitā || 101 ||’
atra madhuśriyo maugdhyatyāgayauvanārambhakṛtānāṃ viśeṣaṇānāmavaiṣamyātsamatā
avaiṣamyamiti
yena rūpeṇa loke'rthaḥ pratītastadanatikrameṇa tasyoktiḥ samatā
vakratā cātra viśeṣaṇamūhanīyam
anyathā muktvā vrajatītyataḥ ko viśeṣaḥ syāt
agre iti
mugdha iti koṣātprathamamudbhidyamānā kurabakakalikā kāntānakhavatpāṭalā bhavatīti madhuśriyo bālyam
tataḥ prauḍhimāpadyamānāsu kalikāsu śyāmo vantabhāgaḥ sphuṭitatvāddvidhāvatiṣṭhata iti yauvanam
evaṃ bālāśokamityādau krameṇa bālyayauvanacihnopadarśanamavaseyam
mādhuryamuktamācāryaiḥ krodhādāvapyatīvratā
yathā—
‘bhrūbhede sahasodgate'pi vadanaṃ nītaṃ parāṃ namratā- mīṣanmāṃ prati bhedakāri hasitaṃ noktaṃ vaco niṣṭhuram
antarbāṣpajaḍīkṛtaṃ prabhutayā cakṣurna visphāritaṃ kopaśca prakaṭīkṛto dayitayā muktaśca no praśrayaḥ || 102 ||’
atra vāsavadattālakṣaṇasyārthasya kope'pi yo'yaṃ vinayāvambanena kopacihnanihnavastanmādhuryam
mādhuryamiti
śṛṅgārakaruṇau hi madhurau tatastavdyañjako'rtho'pi madhurastasya śarkarādirasasodaraṃ mādhuryam
yathā hi—śarkarārasaḥ sahṛdayasyāsahṛdayasya vā, susthasyāsusthasya vā, jhaṭiti rasanāgramarpitaścamatkāramāvahati, tathā cittadrutisāracarvaṇaikaprāṇarasavyañjako'rthastena tavdyañjanaśaktisamudraikanirvahaṇaṃ vākyārthasya mādhuryamiti paryavasito'rthaḥ
tatra vāsanāparipākavaśādudayavyayavatīṣu dīptacittavṛttiṣu jāgarūkāsvapi samastanyagbhāvanayā virodhaḥ saṃpadyata iti krodhādāvapyatīvratā ityuktam
tathā hi—bhrūmede ityādau gātraskhalitādinā kadācidaparāddhe nāyake premasvabhāvādīrṣyāroṣalakṣaṇavyabhicāriprādurbhāvāttadanubhāvabhrūbhedodgamo ratiprakarṣādbhaviṣṇunāvahitthena nyagbhāvyate
virodhivijaye hi bhūyānprakarṣaḥ parasya bhavati
ata eva parāmityuktam
evaṃ ‘īṣanmāṃ prati bhedakāri hasitam’ ityādau mādhuryamunneyam
tadidamāha—atra vāsavadattālakṣaṇasyeti
aniṣṭhuratvaṃ yatprāhuḥ saukumāryaṃ taducyate || 80
yathā—
‘sadyaḥ purīparisare'pi śirīṣamṛdvī sītā javātricaturāpi padāni gatvā
gantavyamasti kiyadityasakṛdbruvāṇā rāmāśruṇaḥ kṛtavatī prathamāvatāram || 103 ||’
atra sītāyāḥ purīparisare'pi kiyadasti gantavyamiti vacanaṃ śṛṇvato rāmasya śirīṣamṛdutadaṅgāvalokanenāśruṇo'vatāraḥ saukumāryamāha
aniṣṭhuratvamiti
sāmagrīsaṃbhave'pi cittadrutimanāsādayannīrasaḥ kaṭhoro'bhidhīyate
atathābhūtastu jhaṭiti tanmayībhavanayogyāntaḥkaraṇaḥ sukumārastadidamuktamaniṣṭhuratvamiti
prāhurityanena prasiddhiṃ dyotayati—sadya iti
sahagantumutsukā kathamevaṃ sukumāraprakṛtiḥ kāntāreṣu bhaviṣyasīti vāryamāṇāpi hṛdayavaimukhyena pabhdyāmatitvaritaṃ gamiṣyāmīti snehamūḍhā tricaturāṇi padāni javādgatavatī
aśruṇaḥ prathamāvatāro bhaviṣyadaśruparamparāpracārabhūtaḥ
saukumāryamāheti aśrupātenānubhāvāśrunimittabhūtā cittadrutiḥ karatalāmalakavatprakāśyate
arthavyaktiḥ svarūpasya sākṣātkathanamucyate
yathā—
‘pṛṣṭheṣu śaṅkhaśakalacchaviṣu cchadānāṃ rekhābhiraṅkitamalaktakalohitābhiḥ
gorocanāharitababhrubahiḥpalāśa- māmodate kumudamambhasi palvalasya || 104 ||’
atra kumudasvarūpasya sākṣādiva pratīyamānatvena yatspaṣṭarūpābhidhānamasāvarthavyaktiḥ
arthavyaktiriti
svarūpaṃ svamasādhāraṇaṃ kavipratibhaikagocaraṃ camatkārirūpaṃ tasya sākṣātkathanam
kaviśaktivaśātsākṣātkārasodarapratītijanakapadavattvaṃ saṃdarbhasyārthavyaktināmā guṇaḥ
artho yathoktastasya vyaktiḥ pratyakṣāyamāṇatā
jāterbhedastṛtīye vakṣyate
pṛṣṭheṣviti
īṣadvikasvarasya kumudasya kiṃcidvighaṭamānavahiḥ palāśasaṃbandhiṣu śītātapāsaṃparkādatyantaviśadānāṃ dalānāṃ pṛṣṭhāni pākalohitarekhāṅkitāni dṛśyante
ata evāmodate kiṃcidudbhidureṇa mukhena garbhapiṇḍitamāmodaṃ muñcatīti
kāntirdīptarasatvaṃ syāt
yathā—
‘mā garvamudvaha kapolatale cakāsti kāntasvahastalikhitā mama mañjarīti
anyāpi kiṃ na sakhi bhājanamīdṛśīnāṃ vairī na cedbhavati vepathurantarāyaḥ || 105 ||’
atra nāyikāyā sapatnyāmīrṣyānubandhena pratipāditasya priyatamānurāgalakṣaṇasya śṛṅgārasya dīptarasatvaṃ kāntiḥ
kāntiriti
raso'bhimānātmā śṛṅgārastasya dīptatvaṃ vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicāribhiḥ samyak saṃcalitena sthāyinā nirantaramupacīyamānasya paramakoṭigamanam
tathā hi—mā garvamityādau yatra bhaṅgeṣu bahutarasūkṣmabhaṅgaviśeṣamayamañjarīlikhitena bahirviṣayātirodhānalakṣaṇatādavasthyāt prakāśanena nāyakasya sapatnyāmanurāge vicchāyabhāvoktiḥ
svātmani tu sahasāvirbhavatsāttvikapratipādanena jīvitasarvasvābhimānātmakratisthāyibhāvaprakāśane tasyā: sāpekṣabhāve nāyikāyā api tadavasthaiva sā pratīyate
tadidamāha—priyatamānurāgeti
anurāgeṇa lakṣyate saptārcirivārciṣopacīyata ityanurāgalakṣaṇaḥ
bhūtyutkarṣa udāratā || 81
yathā—
‘prāṇānāmanilena vṛttirucitā satkalpavṛkṣe vane toye kāñcanapadmareṇukapiśe puṇyābhiṣekakriyā
dhyānaṃ ratnaśilāgṛheṣu vibudhasrīsaṃnidhau saṃyamo yadvāñchanti tapobhiranyamunayastasmiṃstapasyantyamī || 106 ||’
atra mārīcāśramasya satkalpavṛkṣādipadairvaibhavotkarṣasya pratipādanamudāratā
bhūtītyādi
bhūtiḥ saṃpattasyā utkarṣo lokātigaprakarṣastasyaiva sahṛdayacamatkārārpakatatyā guṇadhurādhirohaṇakṣamatvāt
prāṇānāmiti
ucitā tapoyogyā
vanasya kalpatarusaṃbandhaḥ saṃpat, tatraiva satpadena muktāstabakamāṇikyamañjarīcīnāṃśukakisalayādiviśeṣadyotinā prakarṣaḥ
padmaprakarastoyasaṃpat, tatraiva kāñcanamayatvena padmānāṃ prakarṣaḥ
bahutvaṃ śilāveśmasaṃpat, tatraiva ratnarūpatāprakarṣaḥ
saṃnidhi srīpratiyogikatāsaṃpat, tatraiva vibudheti prakarṣaḥ
tadidamāha—satkalpavṛkṣādipadairiti
āśayasya ya utkarṣastadudāttatvamiṣyate
yathā—
‘pātre purovartini viśvanāthe kṣodīyasi kṣmāvalaye'pi deye
vrīḍāsmitaṃ tasya tadā tadāsīccamatkṛto yena sa eva devaḥ || 107 ||’
atra sakalakṣmāvalayapradāne'pi jātavrīḍatayā balerāśayotkarṣapratiṣādanādudāttatvam
āśayasyeti
utkarṣaḥ pūrvavat
uccāśayo loke udātta iti pratītaḥ
pātra iti
viśvanātha iti yadājñāvaśaṃvadā trilokī so'pi yatprārthayata iti, valaye'pītyapiśabdena yasyaikadeśaḥ kurupāṇḍavanidhananidānatayā vikhyātastasyāpi deye lajjata iti
devāsurakinnarādirayaṃ jaṅgamasthāvaraprapañco yaducchvāsavilasitaṃ so'pi camatkṛta iti padārthānabhihitaḥ prakarṣo'bhidheyaḥ
ojaḥ svādhyavasāyasya viśeṣo'rtheṣu yo bhavet || 82
yathā—
‘tānyeva yadi bhūtāni tā eva yadi śaktayaḥ
tataḥ paraśurāmasya na pratīmaḥ parābhavam || 108 ||’
atra paraśurāmo vijayata evetyasminnarthe svādhyavasāyapratipādanamojaḥ
oja iti
adhyavasāyo niścayastatra viśeṣaḥ pūrvavat
svapadena vaktābhimataḥ
tānīti
yadi hantavyajātīyameva na viparyaṃstam
tā eveti
prabhāvotsāhamantrajāstadvadarthanibarhaṇaprauḍhiprakhyātakīrtayaḥ śaktayo yadi na vilīnatāmayāsiṣuḥ
paraśurāma iti
arjunabhujasahasracchedādinā yasya paraśu(rāma)rvaradānena tribhuvane'pi prasiddha ityādi
rūḍhāhaṃkārataurjityam
yathā—
‘umā vadhūrbhavāndātā yācitāra ime vayam
varaḥ śaṃbhuralaṃ hyeṣa tvatkulodbhūtaye vidhiḥ || 109 ||’
atreme vayamityātmānvitavratacaryādisamutthaprauḍhāhaṃkārapratipādanādaurjityam
rūḍheti
ūrjitaśabdo'haṃkṛte prasiddhastātkālikanimittopanipāte vāsanāvikāsāttamonirbhedasthāneṣu suptaprabuddha iva sthāyibhirasaṃsṛjyamānaḥ prathamaprādurbhūto'bhimāno'haṃkāra ityucyate
rūḍhaḥ sūkṣmāvasthāto dvitīyāmāvirbhāvadaśāmāpanno'haṃkāro yasya sa rūḍhāhaṃkārastasya bhāvastattā
sugamamudāharaṇam
preyastvartheṣvabhīṣṭatā
yathā—
‘rasavadamṛtaṃ kaḥ saṃdeho madhūnyapi nānyathā madhuramadhikaṃ cūtasyāpi prasannarasaṃ phalam
sakṛdapi punarmadhyasthaḥ sanrasāntaravijjano vadatu yadihānyatsvādu syātpriyādaśanacchadāt || 110 ||’
atrāmṛtaprabhṛtimyaḥ priyādaśanacchadasyābhīṣṭatāpratipādanaṃ preyaḥ
preya iti
śabdaguṇe tu nippāditavarṇanīyaprītijanakatvaṃ padānāmuktam
iha tu vākyārthasya vaktṛprītigocaratvamucyata iti viśeṣaḥ
prītiruktapūrvā
tatraivābhiśabdena prakarṣo dyotitaḥ
abhīṣṭatā preya iti preyaḥpadapravṛttinimittam
rasavaditi
praśaṃsāyāṃ matup
amṛtamiti yasya prasādāttridaśairamaratvamāsāditaṃ nānyatheti pratyakṣasākṣike vastuni pramāṇāntarānusaraṇam
prasannarasamiti amlatālakṣaṇakāvyārthāpagamena pariṇatirityādi
adāruṇārthaparyāyo dāruṇeṣu suśabdatā || 83
yathā—
‘devavrate vāñchati dīrghanidrāṃ droṇe ca karṇe ca yaśo'vaśeṣe
lakṣmīsahāyasya tavādya vatsa vātsalyavāndrauṇirayaṃ sahāyaḥ || 111 ||’
atra mumūrṣāmaraṇādīnāṃ dāruṇārthānāṃ dīrghanidrāṃ vāñchati yaśo'vaśeṣa ityādibhiḥ suśabdaiḥ paryāyeṇa bhaṇanaṃ suśabdatā
sā ca mukhyārthavyatikramasya vākyārthatvānna śabdaguṇaḥ
adāruṇetyādi
jhaṭityātaṅkadāyī dāruṇastasya sākṣādabhidhāne vivakṣitapratītiskhalanakhedasaṃbhavāttadupanītasya vastunastadadhyāsāntaritasya vākyārthatvāditi
sarvatraiva hi lakṣaṇāyāmarthādhyāso'ṅgīkriyate
laukikī ceyaṃ lakṣaṇeti na prayojanagaveṣaṇamapīti
sugamamudāharaṇam
vyājāvalambanaṃ yattu sa samādhiriti smṛtaḥ
yathā—
‘darbhāṅkureṇa caraṇaḥ kṣata ityakāṇḍe tanvī sthitā katicideva padāni gatvā
āsīdvivṛttavadanā ca vimocayantī śākhāsu valkalamasaktamapi drumāṇām || 112 ||’
atra gamane sati priyajanāvalokanābhilāṣiṇyāḥ śakuntalāyā darbhāṅkuracaraṇakṣativalkalavyāsaṅgādivyājāvalambanaṃ samādhiḥ
vyājeti
cittavṛttiṣu balādāvirbhavantīṣu prakṛtarasaucityavirodhiprakarṣātprakaṭamanāvaraṇīyāsu ca yadanyathā samarthanaṃ tavdyājāvalambanaṃ prastutocitasamādhānātmakatvāt
tathā hi—pūrvānurāge trapāsādhvasavivaśāyāstāvannāyakasamīpādapasaraṇamaucityāpannam
anantaraṃ tūtkaṇṭhātaralitāyāḥ kathamālokamātreṇāpi kṛtārthaḥ syāditi parāvartanam
tatra ca maugdhyabhaṅgaśaṅkāyāṃ darbhāṅkurakṣatiprabhṛtivyājāvalambanameva kāryasarvasvabhābhāsata iti
saukṣmyamityucyate tattu yatsūkṣmārthābhidarśanam || 84
yathā—
‘anyonyasaṃvalitamāṃsaladantakānti sollāsamāviralasaṃ valitārdhatāram
līlāgṛhe pratikalaṃ kilakiñciteṣu vyāvartamānavinayaṃ mithunaṃ cakāsti || 113 ||’
atrānyonyasaṃvalitamāṃsaladantakāntītyādivākye daṃpatyoranurāgalakṣaṇasya sūkṣmārthasya darśanātsaukṣmyam
saukṣmyamiti
sūkṣmamityādivākyaikagocaro'rthaḥ kuśāgrīyabuddhitayā sūkṣma- stasya darśanamupāyavailakṣaṇyāttattadviśeṣavataḥ pratyakṣāyamāṇatā
sūkṣmālaṃkārādbhedastṛtīye kariṣyate
sa cāyaṃ bhāvyo vāsanīyaśca
bhāvanāmātragamyo bhāvyo yathā—
‘uccai āgamahi āvaḍḍha sijjantaro sapariāram
pāṇau pasarantamattācaṃvaphalihacasaambhuhaṃ bālā ||’
ekāgratāprakarṣagamyo vāsanīyastamudāharati—anyonyeti
vyājāpasṛtaparivāre līlāveśmani tatkālakalitamanmathonmāthaṃ vidagdhamithunamuttarottaramapanīyamānatrapāsādhvasatayā pratikalaṃ navenduvatkāntiviśeṣamāsādayati
vicitramavyabhicāryanupraveśe harṣaruditasmitādīnāmavyavasthitatayā vyatirekarūpakilakiñcitākhyaśṛṅgārabhāvonmeṣaḥ
śāstrārthasavyapekṣatvaṃ gāmbhīryamabhidhīyate
yathā—
‘maittryādicittaparikarmavido vidhāya kleśaprahāṇamiha labdhasabījayogāḥ
khyātiṃ ca sattvapuruṣānyatayādhigamya vāñchanti tāmapi samādhibhṛto nirodhdum || 114 ||’
atra maittryādipadānāṃ śāstrārthasavyapekṣatvādgāmbhīryam
śāstrārtha iti
ekapuruṣārthaprayojanakapadārthavyutpādanaṃ vidhiniṣedhavyutpattiphalakaṃ śāstraṃ tadarthasavyapekṣatvam
taduktaprakriyānirūpaṇādhīnanirūpaṇatvaṃ vākyārthasya gāmbhīryam
maitrīkaruṇāmuditopekṣā iti catastraścittasaṃmārjanāḥ
avidyāsmitārāgadveṣābhiniveśāḥ pañca kleśāḥ
cittavṛttinirodho yogaḥ; sa eva vyutthānahetubhiranāskandanīyaḥ sabījaḥ
sattvaṃ pradhānam, puruṣaścidrūpastayorbhedaḥ prathākhyātiriti sāṃkhyaprakriyā
atra maitrryādipadānāmiti
vākyārthasyaiva yathoktarūpatve tatpratipādakapadānāmavaśyaṃ tathābhāvo bhavatīti vaiśeṣikādbhedo vakṣyate
vistaro'rthavikāsaḥ syāt
yathā—
‘saṃgrāmāṅgaṇamāgatena bhavatā cāpe samāropite devākarṇaya yena yena sahasā yadyatsamāsāditam
kodaṇḍena śarāḥ śarairariśirastenāpi bhūmaṇḍalaṃ tena tvaṃ bhavatā ca kīrttiranaghā kīrtyā ca saptābdhayaḥ || 115 ||’
atra vipakṣavadhātsaptābdhivyāpinī kīrtirarjitetyetāvato'rthasya bahuvidhaṃ vikāsitatvādvistaraḥ
vistara iti
vākyārthasya pallavabhūtatattatsahṛdayacamatkāriviśeṣaprasāraṇaṃ saṃvṛtavivṛtapaṭavat vistarākhyo guṇaḥ
vistara iva vistaraḥ śabdaprapañcavadityarthaḥ
anyathā vistāra iti syāt
saṃgrāmāṅgaṇetyādau tu śatruśiraśchedātsaptābdhivyāpinī tvayā kīrtirārjitetyetāvānvākyārtho laukikasādhāraṇatayā ca camatkārāspadamiti saṃgrāmāṅgaṇasaṃgatireva na tathā yathā vīramātrasyocitā tatrāpi cāpasamāropaṇamiti kāpyutsāhaśaktiḥ
ata eva balavadāśrayaprasaktaluṇṭākavadhena yadavasitaṃ tenaiva tadāsāditamiti sopaskārakartṛkarmaprapañcena vikāsanameva kāvyapadavīprāptibījam
tadidamāha—bahuvidhaṃ vikāsitatvāditi
nātra śabdavikāsādhīnaḥ prakarṣa iti śabdavistarādbhedaḥ
saṃkṣepastasya saṃvṛtiḥ || 85
yathā—
‘śrūyatāṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ śrutvā caivāvadhāryatām
ātmanaḥ pratikūlāni pareṣāṃ na samācaret || 116 ||’
atra śāstre vistarapratipāditasya dharmasya ślokārdhenoktatvādayamarthasaṃkocaḥ saṃkṣepaḥ
saṃkṣepa iti
tasyetyarthasya samāse guṇībhūtasyāpi budhdyā vibhajya parāmarśaḥ
yathā—‘atha śabdānuśāsanam
keṣāṃ ? śabdānāmi'ti
aśeṣaviśeṣopagrāhakapuraskāreṇa vākyārthasyābhidhānaṃ vivṛtasaṃvṛtapaṭavatsaṃkṣepaḥ
śrūyatāmiti
atra tena tena viśeṣeṇa vistarataḥ pratipādayitavyasya dharmasya yatkiṃcidātmanaḥ pratikūlamanyasya nācaraṇīyamiti sāmānyenābhidhānamapravṛttapravartane pragalbhāyamānamatisundaramābhāsate
nātra racanāsaṃkocapratiṣṭhitaṃ kāvyamiti śabdaguṇādbhedaḥ
śabdārthau yatra tulyau staḥ saṃmitatvaṃ taducyate
yathā—
‘indurmūrdhni śivasya śailaduhiturvakro nakhāṅkaḥ stane deyādvo'bhyudayaṃ dvayaṃ tadupamāmālambamānaṃ mithaḥ
saṃvādaḥ praṇavena yasya dalatā kāyaikatāyāṃ tayo- rūrdhvadvāravicintitena ca hṛdi dhyātaḥ svarūpeṇa ca || 117 ||’
atra praṇavalakṣaṇasyārthasya tulyatvena yathāvadvibhajya viniveśanaṃ saṃmitatvam
śabdārthāviti
śabdasyārthau tayorvibhajya viniveśanaṃ saṃmitatvamiti kecit, tanna
śabdagrahaṇavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt
dvitvāvivakṣāprasaṅgācca
‘pallaviaṃ via karapallavehiṃ papphulliaṃ va muṇahaacchehim
phaliaṃmiva pīṇapaoharehiṃ ajjāi lāvaṇṇam ||’
ityādau dviprabhṛtīnāmarthānāmavibhajya viniveśanamiṣyate
tasmācchabdaścārthaśca śabdārthau
tayostulyatvaṃ yāvaduddeśaśabdārtham
arthasya vibhajya tulādhṛtavatpratiniveśaḥ saṃmitatvamiti
arthamuddiśya śabdatulanaṃ kāvyabhāvabījaṃ śabdaguṇaḥ, śabdamuddiśya tvarthatulanamarthaguṇaśca
tathāhi—parameśvarasya mūrdhni bālenduḥ, pārvatīstane nakhāṅka iti pṛthakśabdenoddiśya tadupamāyogyatayā kāyaikatāyāṃ dalanaṃ hṛtpadmanavamadvārayordhyānena yugapatsaṃnidhānamiti samyagvibhajya tulitasyeva praṇavasya pratinirdeśa iti
tadidamāha—atreti
yathāvaditi
yena prakāreṇa saṃgacchata iti tadanatikrameṇeti
sābhiprāyoktivinyāso bhāvikatvaṃ nigadyate || 86
yathā—
‘dṛṣṭiṃ he prativeśini kṣaṇamihāpyasmadgṛhe dāsyasi prāyeṇāsya śiśoḥ pitā na virasāḥ kaupīrapaḥ pāsyati
ekākinyapi yāmi tadvaramitaḥ srotastamālākulaṃ nīrandhrāstanumālikhantu jaraṭhacchedā nalagranthayaḥ || 118 ||’
atra tamālamālāvalayitasarittīrakṛtasaṃketāyāḥ kulaṭāyāḥ svatanau bhāvināṃ parapuruṣanakhakṣatānāṃ nalagranthyālekhavyājagopanena sābhiprāyabhaṇanaṃ bhāvikam
sābhiprāya iti
abhiprāyaviśeṣapratibaddhasya vākyārthasyoktivinyāsa uktyā viśeṣo nyāsaḥ
śabdaguṇe padānāṃ bhāvyarthaniṣpāditā iha tvarthasyeti viśeṣaḥ
tathā hi—dṛṣṭimityādau tanumālikhantu jaraṭhacchedā nalagranthaya ityuktyā vinyasyamāna eva bhāvinalagranthyālekhyarūpārthaḥ kulaṭāsvarūpānusaṃdhānadattāntaḥ karaṇasya pratipatturanantarameva svaiṃravihāracihnagopanamabhivyanakti
gatiḥ sā syādavagamo yo'rthādarthāntarasya tu
yathā—
‘śubhe ko'yaṃ vṛddho gṛhaparivṛḍhaḥ kiṃ tava pitā na me bhartā rātrau vyapagatadṛganyacca badhiraḥ
hu huṃ huṃ śrānto'haṃ śiśayiṣurihaivāpavarake kva yāminyāṃ yāsi svapihi nanu nirdaṃśamaśake || 119 ||’
atra praśnādarthamavagamya uttarādarthāntarāvagamo gatiḥ
gatiriti
arthādarthaviśeṣāt
hṛdayasaṃvādina iti yāvat
arthāntarasya tathābhūtasya
tena yatra sahṛdayahṛdayaṃgamādarthātkāṃsyatālānusvānusvānanyāyena tādṛśamarthāntaramavagamyate sā gatiriti lakṣaṇārthaḥ
śubhe ko'yaṃ vṛddha iti
sarvākāramanavadyāyāstāvaddāsyamapi nāyamarhatīti hṛdayānukūlamarthaṃ praśnādavagatya gṛhaparivṛḍha ityuttaram
asmādapi mama nāyaṃ ko'pi kiṃ tu gṛhasvāmīti hṛdayasaṃvādinamarthamavadhārya kiṃ kava pitetyādikamapraśnottaraśṛṅkhalā gaveṣaṇīyā
tadetavdyācaṣṭe—uttarāditi
uttarapratyuttaravākyāt
uttaraṃ tu padaṃ praśnapadameva
rītiḥ sā yastvihārthānāmutpattyādikriyākramaḥ || 87
yathā—
‘prathamamaruṇacchāyastāvattataḥ kanakaprabha- stadanu virahottāmyattanvīkapolataladyutiḥ
prabhavati punardhvāntadhvaṃsakṣamaḥ kṣaṇadāmukhe sarasabisinīkandacchedacchavirmṛgalāñchanaḥ || 120 ||’
atrodayādārabhya candrasyotpattyādikriyākramo rītiḥ
rītiriti
utpattyādīnāṃ kriyāṇāṃ kramaḥ kāvyaśobhāvahatvena guṇaḥ
nedaṃ vastusvabhāvavarṇanamiti jāterarthavyakteśca bhedaḥ
sugamamudāharaṇam
uktirnāma yadi svārtho bhaṅgyā bhavyo'bhidhīyate
yathā—
‘tvamevaṃsaundaryā sa ca ruciratāyāḥ paricitaḥ kalānāṃ sīmānaṃ paramiha yuvāmeva bhajathaḥ
api dvandvaṃ diṣṭyā taditi subhage saṃvadati vā- mataḥ śeṣaṃ cetsyājjitamiha tadānīṃ guṇitayā || 121 ||’
atrābhīṣṭasya nāyakanāyikāsaṃgamasya bhaṅgyā bhaṇanamuktiḥ
uktiriti
svīyo'bhīṣṭo'rthaḥ svārthaḥ
tasya sākṣātpratipādanamanucitamiti arthāntarabhaṅgibhiḥ pratipādanamarthaguṇaḥ
bhavyo manoharaḥ
sugamamanyat
nāyakanāyikāsaṃgamasyeti
nāyakasya nāyikayā tasyāśca nāyakeneti parasparotkaṇṭhāprakarṣo vivakṣitaḥ
tenaikaśeṣo na bhavati
vivakṣitārthanirvāhaḥ kāvye prauḍhiriti smṛtā || 88
yathā—
‘tvadvaktrenduvilokanākuladhiyā dhātrā tvadīyāṃ śriyaṃ nikṣipya pratirājakeṣu viduṣāṃ lakṣmyā tvamāpūritaḥ
tenaite niyataṃ daridrati gṛheṣveṣāmiyaṃ dṛśyate naināmādriyase tvamicchasi nu tāṃ tvāmeva sā dhāvati || 122 ||’
atra tvadvaktravilokanākulena dhātrā tvadīyā lakṣmīḥ śatruṣu nikṣipya viduṣāṃ ca lakṣmīstvayyāropitā
atastvaṃ vipakṣalakṣmīmādriyase sā ca tvāmanudhāvati
yā ca viduṣāṃ lakṣmīstayā tvamāpūritastena te daridrāḥ
ata eva tvamenāṃ nādriyase
iyaṃ ca vidvadgeheṣveva dṛśyate ityetāvataḥ prabhūtasyārthasyānekavākyena pratipāditatvādvivakṣitārthanirvahaṇaṃ prauḍhiḥ
vivakṣiteti
kaverabhimatasya bhūyaso'pyarthasya svalpenaiva vākyena pratipādanaṃ prauḍhiḥ
tathā hi—tvāṃ nirmāya jagadvilakṣaṇavastunirvahaṇacamatkṛtasya dhātustvadvaktrenduvilokanaṃ tadāsaṅgena tvadarthanirbhitāyāḥ śriyaḥ pratirājakeṣu bhramaṇakrameṇa saṃcāraṇaṃ tatpūrvāparapratisaṃghāta (na)balādvidvabhdyo lakṣmīmākṛṣyetyādiko bhūyānarthaḥ stokena vākyenopanīta iti
saṃpratyatiprasaṅgavāraṇārthaṃ kramaprāptā vaiśeṣikaguṇā lakṣitavyāḥ
te ca doṣā api santo guṇībhāvamāpannā ucyante
tatraiṣa kavīnāmālāpaḥ—
‘sāmaṇṇasundarīṇaṃ vibbhamamuvvahai aviṇaoccea
dhūmoccia pajjaliāṇaṃ bahumao surahidārūṇam ||’
dāruṇānāṃ guṇatvamiti śaṅkāṃ darśayannāha—
padādyāśritadoṣāṇāṃ ye cānukaraṇādiṣu
guṇatvāpattaye nityaṃ te'tra doṣaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 89
trividhā api te bhūyaścaturviṃśatidhā budhaiḥ
proktā yathā guṇatvena pravibhajya tathocyate || 90
yā mliṣṭamlecchitādīnāṃ padadoṣeṣvasādhutā
nirūpitānukaraṇe guṇatvaṃ sā prapadyate || 91
yathā—
‘unnamayya sakacagrahamāsyaṃ cumbati priyatame haṭhavṛttyā
huṃ hu muñca mamameti ca mandaṃ jalpitaṃ jayati mānavatīnām || 123 ||’
atra huṃ hu mamametyasādhvorapi mliṣṭamlecchitayoranukaraṇatvādguṇatvam
padādīti
padavākyavākyārthadoṣāṇāṃ guṇatvāpattaye nityaṃ ye bhavanti, te'nukaraṇādiṣu madhye doṣaguṇāḥ smṛtā iti saṃbandhaḥ
yadyapi cānukaraṇādikā eva na guṇāḥ, tathāpyanukriyamāṇādyabhedopacāreṇoktam
padādidoṣeṣvantyāntyasyaikasya navadhāmede caturviṃśatiprakārāḥ
yatheti
yenopādhinā guṇībhavanamācāryairupapāditaṃ tattadupādhivibhāgapradarśanaṃ kariṣyata iti
yā mliṣṭeti
iha dvaye doṣā nityā anityāśca
tatrānukaraṇamātrānapavadanīyadoṣabhāvāścyutasaṃskārāprayuktādayo nityāḥ
anukaraṇīyānukaraṇānapavādakahetukāḥ śrutikaṭutvaprabhṛtayastvanityāḥ
yeṣu padadoṣeṣu mliṣṭamlecchitaprabhṛtīnāṃ yāsādhutā nirūpitā, sā guṇatvamanukaraṇe prapadyata ityanvayaḥ
luptaikadeśaṃ mliṣṭam
avyaktarūpaṃ mlecchitam
ādigrahaṇena grastanirasto-paghmātakampitādayaḥ
huṃ hu iti dvitīyahuṃkāre binduproñchanānmliṣṭam
mamameti kiṃ muñca muñceti mliṣṭamuta mameti na niścīyate
anukaraṇatvāhuṇatvamiti
arthaviśeṣe hi sādhutvavyavastheti
yaccāśaktijamasādhurūpam, tasyānukaraṇe sādhutvamiṣyata ityuktam, anukriyamāṇaṃ tu svarūpapadānukaraṇatayā pūrvārthatyāgena sāghveva
tasyaivānukaraṇasya tatkālarañjakamānavatīmamamavacanānukāratayā ca guṇīkaraṇasāmarthyamiti
guṇatvamaprayuktasya tathānukaraṇe bhavet
yathā—
‘divaṃ patkāṣiṇo yānti ye'cīkamata bhāṣiṇaḥ
patkāṣiṇo'pi no yānti ye vacanti prayuñjate || 124 ||’
atrācīkamata vacantītyādipadānāṃ kavibhiraprayuktānāmapyanukaraṇatvādguṇatvam
guṇatvamiti
patkāṣiṇa iti pādamapi kaṣantaḥ
‘himakāṣihatiṣu ca’ iti pādaśabdasya padbhāvaḥ
vacervacantītyeva rūpamaprayuktam
na tvanyathāpi
‘satyaṃ nāma na vacmi’ ityāderanumatatvāt
ityādipadānāmityudāharaṇāntarābhiprāyeṇa
yacchrutervirasaṃ kaṣṭaṃ tasya durvacakādiṣu
guṇatvamanumanyante sānuprāsasya sūrayaḥ || 92
yathā—
‘tvāṣṭrāstvāṣṭrārirāṣṭre na bhrāṣṭre nādaṃṣṭriṇo janāḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ surāṣṭre na mahārāṣṭre ca noṣṭriṇaḥ || 125 ||’
atra śrutivirasattvāt kaṣṭatve'pi durvacakatvādguṇatvam
yacchruteriti
durvacakayogā iti vyāvahārikacatuḥṣaṣṭyāṃ durvacakaprayogo'numataḥ
tasyānuprāsaghaṭakatve'laṃkāranirvahaṇakṣamatayā kaviśaktivyañjakasya guṇībhāvaḥ
ādipadena raudrādirasānupraveśaḥ
yadāha—
‘śaṣau sarephasaṃyogau ṭavargaścāpi bhūyasā
virodhinaḥ syuḥ śṛṅgāre tena varṇā rasacyutāḥ
ta eva viniveśyante bībhatsādau rase yadā
tadā taṃ dīpayantyeva tena varṇā rasacyutāḥ
’ iti
tvāṣṭrā rākṣasāstvaṣṭurapatyaṃ vṛtrastasyāririndrastasya rāṣṭre svarge na santi
bhrāṣṭre caṇakādibharjanasthāne na kuṇṭhadaṃṣṭrā bhavanti
asitacañcucaraṇā haimā dhārtarāṣṭrā va vidyante
uṣṭriṇa uṣṭropajīvinaḥ
yatpādapūraṇādyarthamanarthakamudāhṛtam
guṇatvamanumanyante tasyāpi yamakādiṣu || 93
yathā—
‘yoṣitāmatitarāṃ nakhalūnaṃ gātramujjvalatayā na khalūnam || 126 ||’
babhau mukhenāpratimena kācana śriyādhikānāṃ prati menakā ca na || 127 ||’
atra khaluśabdasya caśabdasya ca pādapūraṇamātre'pi prayojane yamakatvādguṇatvam
yatpādapūraṇeti
dyotanīyamarthamantareṇa prayuktamavyayapadamanarthakamityuktam
pādapūraṇārthatvaṃ tu dūṣaṇatābījam
ādigrahaṇādgadyapūraṇam
sati tūpayoge tasya tadbijābhāvāddoṣabhāvaviraho'laṃkārārambhe ca guṇatvam
tadidamuktam—yamakādiṣviti
ādiśabdo'nuprāsacitrādiparaḥ
vākyālaṃkārārthatvamapi śabdālaṃkārārambhakatvameva
yadāha—‘ārṣārṣiputrakarṣikavaidikādivākyānāmalaṃkārahetavo vākyālaṃkārārthāḥ’ iti
tena—
‘utphullakamalakesaraparāgagauradyute mama hi gauri
abhivāñchitaṃ prasidhyatu bhagavati yuṣmatprasādena
’ iti
atra hi pra ityetayorna vākyālaṃkāraprayojakatvamityuktaprāyam
yoṣitāmityādābatitarāṃ nakhalūnaṃ yoṣitāṃ gātramujjvalatayā nonamityeva paryāpte dvitīyapāde tadubhayamapi yamakārambhakaṃ satprastutopayogitayā kavivyutpattipuraskāra pravṛttamapajahāti doṣabhāvamupādatte ca guṇatvamiti
yattu rūḍhicyutatvena proktamanyārthasaṃjñitam
prahelikādiṣu prāyo guṇatvaṃ tasya yujyate || 94
yathā—
‘khātayaḥ kani kāle te sphātayaḥ sphārhavalgavaḥ
candre sākṣādbhavantyatra vāyavo mama dhāriṇaḥ || 128 ||’
atra khātaya ityādīnāṃ ghargharikādau dhṛṅaścānavasthāne na rūḍhiḥ
gūḍhārthe tu prahelikādau tanna duṣyatīti teṣāṃ doṣaguṇatvam
yattviti
rūḍhicyutatvena dvitīyāṃ saṃjñāṃ prayojayati
ākīrṇāmantraṇādyupayoginī prahelikā
tathā ca—tadvidyasaṃbhāṣāyāṃ vidagdhairupanyāsaiḥ svārthāpratyāyakatvalakṣaṇabījābhāvānna doṣaḥ, guṇastu bhavati
anukaraṇādikamādipadena gṛhyate
khātayo ghargharikāḥ
kanīti kanyāsaṃbodhanam
kālaścaraṇaḥ karṇāṭadeśabhāṣānusārāt
sphātayaḥ sphītāḥ
sphārho manoharaḥ
valgurdhvaniḥ
candra āhlādakaḥ
vāyavaḥ prāṇāḥ
dhāriṇo'navasthitāḥ
tadayaṃ vākyārthaḥ—he kani kanye, tavāhlādakacaraṇabaddhā yathoktaviśeṣaṇā ghargharikāḥ sākṣādbhavanti śrotreṇa pratyakṣīkriyante
atra prastāve mama prāṇā uddīpanaprakarṣamasahiṣṇavo dhāriṇo'navasthitā iti
vraṇaprarohasthānādau khātyādiśabdānāṃ rūḍhirna tu ghargharikādāvityāha—atreti
nāmadhātuvivakṣayā dvidhā vyākhyātam
tucchavācyamapuṣṭārthamiti yatprākprakāśitam
tasya cchando'nurodhādau guṇatvamavadhāryate || 95
yathā—
‘dviraṣṭavarṣākṛtimenamarthināmuśanti kalpopapadaṃ mahīruham
yamindraśabdārthaniṣūdanaṃ harerhiraṇyapūrvaṃ kaśipuṃ pracakṣate || 129 ||’
atra dviraṣṭavarṣākṛtimiti kalpopapadaṃ mahīruhamiti hiraṇyapūrvaṃ kaśipumityasya tucchārthatve'pi cchando'nurodhādguṇatvam
tuccheti
śabdapallavanasya prakṛtarasānanuguṇatvena doṣatvaprasaṅge kvacidananyagatikatayā kaverutpādyate
tathā hi—bhinnasargāntairityādinā sargāṇāmautsargikaikavṛttanirvāhaucitye sa yathoktasaṃkṣiptaśabdāpraveśātpararūpeṇa tadarthatvasya vivakṣitatvācca śabdavikāse na doṣaḥ, kiṃ tu guṇa eva
prakṛtodāharaṇe dviraṣṭavarṣākṛtimiti kalpopapadaṃ mahīruhamiti ca nidarśanaṃ manyante
ṣoḍaśādiśabdānāmapi vaṃśasthapraveśatvādananyagatikatvābhāvāt
hiraṇyapūrvaṃ kaśipumiti tu saṃgacchate
nahi hiraṇyakaśipuśabdo'tra praviśati
pradarśanārthaṃ tu dvayamanyadapyupāttam
evaṃvidhaḥ śabdavistaro guṇatāmāsādayatītyāśayāt
tenāyamarthaḥ—pallavākhyaśabdaguṇe tāvattucchatā camatkārakāritayā guṇadhurādhirūḍhaivāvistaraviviktaviṣayatayā kva viśeṣaguṇasya bhavatīti jijñāsāyāṃ tu chando'nurodho vihitaḥ
so'pi hi kādācitkaḥ karotyeva doṣabhāvavyāvṛttimiti
pratipāditamādau yadasamarthamavācakam
tasyāpi khalu manyante guṇatvaṃ sītkṛtādiṣu || 96
yathā—
‘āśu laṅghitavatīṣṭakarāgre nīvimardhamukulīkṛtadṛṣṭyā
raktavaiṇikakarāhatatantrī maṇḍalakvaṇitacāru cukūje || 130 ||’
atra kūjitasya pakṣiṇo'nyatrāvācakatve'pi kāmaśāstre'numatatvādguṇatvam
pratipāditamiti
asti kaścidevaṃ viṣayo yatrāsamarthasya cārutayā guṇabhāvaḥ
tathā hi—yadyapi gaṇapāṭhādavyaktaśabdaḥ kūjitam, tathāpi loke pakṣiviṣaya eva niyatam, tathā cābhimataviṣaye prayuktaṃ pakṣivirutākāramāvedayati
'hārītaprabhṛti—‘ ityādinā kāmaśāstrakāraiḥ sītkāropadeśanāt
sītkārasya ca catuḥṣaṣṭikalātvena pravaṇatayātyantamupādeyatvāt
tadāha—‘anyānyapyākṛtigrahaṇānyupalakṣayet’ iti
śāstramātrapratītatvādapratītaṃ yaducyate
guṇatvaṃ tasya tadvidyasaṃbhāṣādau vidurbudhāḥ || 97
yathā—
‘sarvakāryaśarīreṣu muktāṅgaskandhapañcakam
saugatānāmivātmānyo nāsti mantro mahībhṛtām || 131 ||’
atrāṅgaskandhapañcakamityasya śāstramātraprasiddhasyāpi tadvidyasaṃbhāṣāyāṃ guṇatvam
śāstreti
śāstramātraprasiddhānāmāhatyapratītyajananena vivakṣitavākyārthapratyayapariskhalanaṃ khedadāyī nānāmṛduduṣṭatābījam
yadi tu kutaścidviśeṣājjhaṭityeva pratītiṃ janayettadā kathaṃ doṣaḥ
asti ca pratipattivyutpattyatiśayalakṣaṇo viśeṣaḥ
tadidamuktam—tadvidyeti
mantraṇādyavasare aucitīvaśāttattatpadānāṃ guṇatvamapi nirvahati
śāstraprakiyāpekṣitvaṃ gāmbhīryam
śāstravyavahārasaṃketitapadānāṃ guṇatvamityanyaḥ prakāraḥ
yathāvadviniyogaḥ kāryastasya prakārasākalyaṃ śarīram, śabdacchalātkāyaḥ, ātmā sārabhūtaḥ kṣetrajñaśca
karmaṇāmārambhopāyaḥ puruṣadravyasaṃpaddeśakālavibhāgo vinipātapratīkāraḥ kāryasiddhiriti pañcāṅgāni
rūpaṃ saṃjñā saṃskāro vedanā vijñānamiti pañca skandhāḥ
arthapratītikṛddūre kliṣṭaṃ nāma yaducyate
jhaṭityarthapratītau tadguṇatvamanugacchati || 98
yathā—
‘athātmanaḥ śabdaguṇaṃ guṇajñaḥ padaṃ vimānena vigāhamānaḥ
pituḥ padaṃ madhyamamutpatantī kāñcīguṇasthānamaninditayāḥ || 132 ||’
atrātmanā padaṃ śabdaguṇamiti pituḥ padaṃ madhyamamiti cākāśaviṣayā kāñcīguṇasthānaṃ nitambaviṣayamiti sarvaprasiddherjhaṭityeva pratītiṃ karotīti kliṣṭasyāsya guṇatvam
arthapratītikṛditi
ihāpi tadeva dūṣaṇatābījaṃ jhaṭiti pratītijanane sati samādhīyate
samādhānopāyaśca padāntarasaṃnidhānamatiprasiddhiḥ prakaraṇaṃ vā
tathā hi—prakṛtodāhaṟaṇe uttarārdhe harirityabhidhānādātmanaḥ padamiti hareḥ padamiti saṃpannam, asya ca sāmānyaśabdatvādākāśaviṣayā pratītiryadyapi jhaṭiti notpattumarhati, tathāpi śabdaguṇamiti viśeṣaṇena padārthāntarādyavacchidya vivakṣitābhimukhī pratītirupajanyate
pituḥ padamiti
yadyapi padamiti sāmānyaṃ tathāpyākāśasyaiva madhyamacaraṇavinyāsasthānatvena prasiddherna tathocitapratītivyavadhānam
kāñcīguṇasthānamiti
caraṇādārabhya varṇanākrame nitamba eva kāñcīniveśanasyocitatvānna pratī-tivyavadhānam
tadidamudāharaṇatrayaprayojanamudāharaṇāderaneko'tra vākyārtho gaveṣaṇīyaḥ
kathaṃ tarhi sarvaprasiddheriti bravīti
itthaṃ śabdaguṇaśabdasya bahuvrīhitvādavaśyaṃ viśeṣaparyavasānāya prasiddhiranusaraṇīyā
avaśyaṃ na varṇanakrame'pi kāñcīguṇasthānamaninditāyā ityatra kāñcīguṇasthānaśabdasya nitambaviśeṣaparyavasānārthaṃ kavīnāmaucityaprasiddhiraṅgīkartavyeti
nanu cātmanaḥ padaṃ śabdaguṇatvamityatra prasādaḥ kasmānna bhavati
evamāha na bhavatīti
udāharaṇasyādūṣaṇatvātsāmānyaśabdasya viśeṣaparyavasānam, anyacca samabhivyāhṛtapadārthasaṃsargarūpe vākyārthe svacchasalila ivābhimataviśeṣapratibimbanamityupādhidvayasya saṃkarācca
aprasiddhārthasaṃbandhaṃ yadgūḍhārthamiti smṛtam
tavdyākhyānādiṣu prāyo guṇatvena tadiṣyate || 99
yathā—
‘amhārisā vi kaiṇo kaiṇo halibuḍhḍhasālipamuhā vi
maṇḍukkamakkaḍā vi hu honti harīsappasiṃhā vi || 133 ||’
[asmādṛśā api kavayaḥ kavayo harivṛddhaśālipramukhā api
maṇḍūkamarkaṭā api khalu bhavanti harisarpasiṃhā api ||]
atra maṇḍūkamarkaṭasarpasiṃheṣvaprasiddhaprayogatvādgūḍhasyāpi hariśabdasya svayaṃ vyākhyātatvādguṇatvam
aprasiddhārthasaṃvandhamiti
tasya guṇārthasya vyākhyānaṃ tavdyākhyānam
atrāpyatiprasidhdyākṛṣṭasyānatiprasiddhārthapratītyakaraṇaṃ duṣṭatābījamabhidhānīyam, tattu pratītiparyavasānādeva nivartate
bhavati cābhidhānakopa iva vyākhyāne jhaṭiti pratyayaḥ
asmādṛśā api mandapratibhānāḥ kavayaḥ kaviśabdavācyā harivṛddhaśālipramukhāśca lokottarapratibhāśālinastadavayavatāṃ vikhyāte cāvikhyāte ca śabdāḥ sādhāraṇā bhavanti
tadyathā—hariśabda eveti vyākhyānam
tato doṣatvābhāvaḥ prativastulakṣaṇālaṃkāraparyavasāyitayā ca prakṛtārthānuguṇatvena guṇatvalābhaḥ
tadetavdyācaṣṭe—svayaṃ vyākhyātatvāddoṣābhāvo guṇatvaṃ punarābhiprāyikātprakṛtānuguṇabhāvāditi boddhavyam
neyārthaṃ yatsvasaṃketaklṛptavācyaṃ nirūpitam
prahelikādiṣu prājñaistadguṇatvena gaṇyate || 100
yathā—
‘moru kalāveṇa vahai taha ṇāmaha sariṇāu
ussīsā pāantigao aṇuṇattirhi jaṇu ṇāu || 134 ||’
[mayūraḥ kalāpena vahati tasya nāmnaḥ sadṛśanāmā
ucchīrṣātpādāntagato'nunaktaṃ yathā naukā ||]
atra mayūrabarhacandrakasaṃketena kalpitasya candranāmno neyārthatve'pi prahelikātvādguṇatvam
neyārthamiti
atrāpi pūrvavadeva vāsanā
ākīrṇāmantraṇādau vidagdhānāṃ lakṣaṇādayaḥ prahelikāviśeṣānunmīlayanta upayujyante
tathā hi—mayūreti
'jianāu’ iti pāṭhe jitanauka iti sa evārthaḥ
mayūro barhabhāre candrakaṃ vahati
anena saṃketena candranāma labhyate
saṃviṣṭasya śirodeśa ucchīrṣam, caraṇadeśaḥ pādāntaḥ
ucchīrṣeṇa prācī diglakṣyate
‘prākśirāḥ śayīta’ iti vacanāt
arthātpādāntena pratīcī
tataśca ‘prācyāḥ pratīcimardhacandro gataḥ’ iti prātaḥkālodbhedo vākyārthaḥ
‘aṇuṇenti ajiṇaṇāu’ iti pāṭhe subhagamāninaṃ kāntamanunayantyā mayā jñāta hati khaṇḍitakāminīkhedoktiḥ
na caitāsāṃ lakṣaṇānāmasti kiṃcitprayojanamiti neyārthatvaprasaktau prahelikābhāva eva samādhānahetuḥ
nanu cocchīrṣapādāntarapadayorastu, mayūrakalāpa ityādau tu katham
yamiti hi sarvanāmābhimatameva tāvadupasthāpayati
barhe bahūnāṃ bahule kathamekasya pratītirityabhidhāne'pi kadācitkliṣṭasya viśeṣaguṇaḥ syāt
nātra neyārthatā, kiṃ tu tena saṃketena kalpitasya candranāmna iti
tasya nāmnaḥ sadṛśanāmetyanena mukhyavṛttyaiva vivakṣitasadṛśalābhāditi
atredaṃ vaktavyam—tasya nāmna ityanena candrakapadamupasthāpitam, na ca tena sahāsti candrapadasya sādṛśyamiti
tatra lakṣaṇāśrayaṇīyā
tadidamuktaṃ candrasaṃketena kalpitasya candranāmna iti
upalakṣaṇatayā ca ekadeśavyākhyānam
yadaniścayakṛtproktaṃ saṃdigdhaṃ tadguṇī bhavet
bhavedviśeṣāvagamo yadi prakaraṇādibhiḥ || 101
yathā—
‘mahībhṛtaḥ putravato'pi dṛṣṭistasminnapatye na jagāma tṛptim
sa śārṅgacakrāsigadābjapāṇirmeghacchaviḥ pātu jaganti śauriḥ || 135 ||’
atra tasminnapatye ityaniścitasyāpyapatyaviśeṣasya saṃdigdhatve'pi gauryāmiti prakaraṇena gamyate
meghacchavirityasya ca navaśyāmādipadānupādāne'pi śaurisaṃbaddhatvānnavameghacchavirmeghaśyāmacchaviriti vā viśeṣo niścīyata iti tasyāpi guṇatvam
yaditi
saṃśāyakajātīyasya saṃdehajanakatvaṃ nāma dūṣakatābījam
tadyadikutaścidviśeṣādvivakṣitapratītirapratyūhamupapadyate tadā bhavatyeva doṣābhāvaḥ
viśeṣāvagamo viśeṣadarśanaṃ tasyaiva saṃśayavirodhitvāt
mahībhṛta ityādāvapatyaśabdo yadyapi gaurīśabdo'pi taditaradattapada iti saṃśāyakajātīyo bhavati, tathāpi tacchabdopasthāpita eva vivakṣitaviśeṣe paryavasyannapajahāti doṣatvam
tacchabda eva kathaṃ tamarthamupanayatītyatra tu prakaraṇameva jāgradavasthamasti
meghacchavirityatra tu yadyapi meghapadaṃ śyāmāśyāmadattapadatayā saṃśāyakajātīyam, tathāpi prasiddhapadanīlavarṇārthagaurīpadasamabhivyāhārācchabdāntarasaṃnidhirapi viśeṣe niyamayati tadvā chavipadaṃ vā viśeṣe paryavasyati
atra prakaraṇādīnāṃ viśeṣasmṛtihetutvāt
ata eva sūtre bahuvacanādipadānupādānādanupāttāstadetadabhisaṃdhāya vyācaṣṭe—atretyādi
evaṃ navameghacchaviriti cokte yathā niyamenārthapratītirapratyūhā bhavati tathā meghacchavirityukta iti
ata eva kavisamayaprasiddhaviśeṣāvagamasāmagrīsaṃpādanena guṇatvamiti
kathaṃ punaridaṃ kliṣṭasya vaiśeṣikaṃ na bhavati ko vākyabhūtena bhavati
kiṃ tu saṃśāyakatvamāpādayataḥ pratibhāso'pyuktayuktyā nivartata ityabhimatam
na caivaṃrūpatā kliṣṭavaiśeṣike saṃbhavati
ekasyaiva citrapadasya saṃśayaśaktiriti na vākyārthagāmitā
yattadviruddhamityuktaṃ viparītaprakalpanam
tathābhūtābhidhānena guṇatvaṃ pratipadyate || 102
yathā—
‘abhidhāya tadā tadapriyaṃ śiśupālo'nuśayaṃ paraṃ gataḥ
bhavato'bhimanāḥ samīhate saruṣaḥ kartumupetya mānanām || 136 ||’
atra viparītārthakalpanaṃ viruddhatve'pi saṃdhyarthavigrahārthayoḥ sphuṭabhinnārthatvenābhidhānādguṇatvam
yattaditi
evaṃ vastu prakṛtamabhisaṃdhāya vākyaracane tadupamardakavastvantarapraveśo virodhaḥ
yatra dve api vastunī prakṛte vastvantarameva vā prakṛtaṃ tadyathoktarūpābhāve kathaṃ doṣaḥ
tathā hi—abhidhāyetyādau dūtavākye saṃdhivigrahayormitho virodhinorapi vivakṣitaṃ sa doṣaḥ
saruṣaḥ sakrodhasya tava mānanāṃ pūjāṃ śiśupāla icchati
anuśayaḥ paścāttāpaḥ
abhimukhaṃ sotkaṇṭhaṃ mano yasya sa tatheti saṃdhipakṣe
vigrahapakṣe tvanuśayaḥ krodho bhavataḥ sakāśādabhi bhayaśūnyaṃ mano yasyeti nityasāpekṣatvātsamāsaḥ
saruṣo mānanā upayogastadiha nisṛṣṭārthasyobhayopanyāso yadrocate tadvidhīyatāmityabhisaṃdhāya racita iti guṇatvamityubhayavivakṣāpakṣe vyākhyānam
yadā tu śāsanaharo dūtastadodyateṣvapi śastreṣu yathoktavaktāro dūtā bhavantīti nyāyena vigraharthamevābhimataḥ vipakṣasyāpi prarocanā dūtakartavyeti mukhe saṃdhiḥ paryāyabhūto yukta eva
tadidaṃ vyākhyānena sphuṭayati—atreti
saṃdhirūpo'rthaḥ saṃdhyarthaḥ, vigraharūpo'rtho vigrahārthaḥ
tayorabhidhānena sphuṭa eva bhinno'rthaḥ prayojanam
pakṣadvaye'pi yatprayojanamuktaṃ tadabhiprāyeṇaitavdyākhyānam
aprayojakamityuktamaviśeṣavidhāyakam
svarūpamātre vaktavye tasyāpi guṇateṣyate || 103
yathā—
‘te'pyākāśamasiśyāmamutplutya paramarṣayaḥ
sāgraṃ varṣasahasraṃ sa tapastepe mahāmanāḥ || 137 ||’
atrāsiśyāmamityākāśaṃ prati, sāgramityanena ca varṣasahasraṃ prati viśeṣānabhidhāne'pi dūrotpatanaciratapaścaraṇayorupayogavivakṣāyāṃ guṇatvam
aprayojakamiti
tadeva kavibhirupādīyata iti yadabhipretasaṃdhimādhatte
yatra vākyārthapraviṣṭamapi na tathābhāvamāsādayati tadaprayojakamityuktam
tasya yadi viśeṣasvarūpābhidhāne paryavasānena prayogo na tarhi doṣaḥ
tathā hi—ākāśamityādau nātiśyāmatārūpaṃ viśeṣamākāśe kāṃcidapi viśeṣamātrāmunmudrayati, ākāśasya sarvadā tadrūpānapāyāt
evamasamagrasya sahasratvābhāvātsāgramityapi na viśeṣādhāyakam
ākāśasahasrayostu yadeva rūpabhāvedanīyamityatraitāvanmātrābhiprāyeṇa nāsti dūṣaṇam, tathāpi nāntarīyakayorabhidhāne kiṃ prayojanaṃ yenānayorguṇabhāvasaṃpattirityata āha—dūra iti
atidūre śyāmatvamadhikaṃ pratibhāti
kṣaṇamātramapi na viratirāsīditi sāgrapadābhiprāyo'ta eva nātra paunaruktyam
tarhi vākyārthe viśeṣādhāyakatvamevānayoriti kathaṃ dūṣaṇatvasaṃbhāvanā
ittham
yasminnanupādīyamāne'pi nābhimatanyūnatā tatpadamaprayojakam
asti cātra dvayorapi tajjātīyatāyāṃ doṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ
sa prakṛtopayogavivakṣāyāmeva nivartate
sarvathā prakṛtānupayoge dūṣaṇatvānapāyitā
asti cātrocita evopayogo yo vivakṣitumarhatītyāha—vivakṣāyāmiti
yadavyutpattimaddeśyamiti pūrvaṃ nirūpitam
mahākavinibaddhaṃ sattadapyatra guṇī bhavet || 104
yathā—
‘ṣaṇḍeṣūddaṇḍapiṇḍītagarataralanāḥ prāpire yena velā-
mālambyottālatallasphuṭitapuṭakinībandhavo gandhavāhāḥ || 138 ||’
‘pātālapratimallagallavivaraprakṣiptasaptārṇavam || 139 ||’
‘kirantaḥ kāverīlaḍahalaharīśīkarakaṇān || 140 ||’
atra tallagallalaḍahalaharīprabhṛtīnāmavyutpattimattvenoddeśyatve'pi mahākavibhiraṅgīkṛtatvādguṇatvam
yaditi
saṃdarbhacchāyāvaiṣamyamatra kaṣṭatābījamiti pūrvamuktaṃ tatra yadi samānacchāyaśabdamadhyaniveśanena pratikṣipyate tadā kathaṃ doṣaḥ
tathābhūtānāmeva padānāṃ saṃdarbhanirvāhakatayā mahākavinibaddhamiti
ata eva śabdagamakatayā guṇatvalābhaḥ
uddaṇḍatvena piṇḍītagarāṇāṃ kaṭhoratā
tādṛśānāmapi taralanena prauḍhiḥ
uttāle-tyādyanuprāsavatproḍhapadasajātīyameva tallapadam
evaṃ galletyādau boddhavyam
tadidamāha—atra tallagalletyādi
grāmyaṃ ghṛṇāvadaślīlāmaṅgalārthaṃ yadīritam
tatsaṃvīteṣu gupteṣu lakṣiteṣu na duṣyati || 105
tatra saṃvīte yathā—
‘tasmai himādreḥ prayatāṃ tanūjāṃ yatātmane yojayituṃ yatasva
yoṣitsu tadvīryaniṣekabhūmiḥ saiva kṣametyātmabhuvopadiṣṭam || 141 ||’
atra tadvīryaniṣekabhūmirityaślīlasyāpi saṃvītatvādguṇatvam
yadāha—
‘saṃvītasya hi lokeṣu na doṣānveṣaṇaṃ kṣamam
śivaliṅgasya saṃsthāne kasyāsabhyatvabhāvanā ||’
grāmyamiti
atra kecidyathāsaṃkhyaṃ vyācakṣate—ghṛṇāvadādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ krameṇa saṃkhyānagopanalakṣaṇāni doṣatvābhāvabījānīti, tadasat
ghṛṇāvadarthādimātra evāgre pratisaṃbhedatrikamupādāya saṃvyānāditrikasyopadarśanāt
etādṛśayathāsaṃkhyasūcanāyaiva lakṣaṇātikrameṇa ghṛṇāvataḥ prathamamupādānam
tasmātsaṃkhyānamiva saṃkhyānaṃ lokānumatiḥ
kiṃcitpadaṃ duṣṭajātīyamapi loke nopādānāttādrūpyaṃ jahātyeva
prāyeṇa lokānusāri kāvyadarśanaṃ bhavatyataḥ pratisvaṃ bhedatritayasaṃbandhādupapannaṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ syādityabhidhāya pūrvakrameṇodāharati—atreti
etena saṃvīteṣvityādikaṃ bahuvacanaṃ vyākhyātam
yathā śivaliṅgasya saṃsthāna ityatra yadyapi mukhyavidhaiva śivaliṅgapadamślīla evārthe, tathāpyavigānenādiprayogayogitvānna vrīḍādānakṣamaṃ tathehāpi taddhīryeti
śivaliṅgetyatra bhagavatsaṃbandhaḥ prayojaka iti tu tulyamatrāpītyāha—taditi
atra hi jagadantaryāmiṇo bhagavatastadvirodhitayā prasiddhirupajīvyā tadupajīvane vrīḍādāyinī pratītiranutthāyinyeva
atraivācāryamataṃ likhati—saṃvītasya hīti
kasyāsabhyatveti
bhāvanā sakalalokasādhāraṇaṃ jñānam
gupte yathā—
‘sudumtyajā yadyapi janmabhūmirgajairasaṃbādhamayāṃbabhūve
sa te'nuneyaḥ subhago'bhimānī bhaginyayaṃ naḥ prathamābhisaṃdhiḥ || 142 ||’
atra janmabhūmisaṃbādhasubhagabhaginīśabdānāmaślīlārthāntaratve'pi prathamārthaprabhāvabhāvanāguptatvādguṇatvam
yadāha—
‘vastumāhātmyaguptasya padārthasya vibhāvanāt
bhaginībhagavatyādi nāsabhyatvena bhāvyate ||’
yasya padasya vyutpattilabhyamarthāntaraṃ grāmyam, yasya vā samabhivyāhāralabhyam, tatra gopanaṃ samādhānabījam
tadubhayaṃ bhavati rūḍhervā balavattvaṃ jaladharādiṣviva tathā tātparyonnayanapratibandhena viparītārthatātparyonnayanaparyavasānaṃ vā
yathodāhariṣyamāṇe tathā ca pratīterapratyūhe dūṣaṇatābījābhāvastatra prathamakakṣāpakṣīkaraṇenādyamudāharati
rūḍhyupasthāpitaḥ prāthamiko'rthastasya bhāvo jhaṭiti vākyārthajñānaṃ tasya bhāvanā vāsanā tayā gopanaṃ camatkārārpaṇamatirodhānam
amumevārthamācāryamatena svahastayati—vastumāhātmyeti
avibhāvanāditi
viruddhaṃ vrīḍādāyitayā bhāvanaṃ tasyābhāvāt
tena kvacidyogopādāne'pi tathābhāvasaṃpattau na doṣaḥ
etadevodāharaṇena sphuṭayati—bhaginīti
etena bhagavatīti pūrvānupāttamudāharaṇaṃ vyākhyātam
dvitīyagopanamaśastārthāntare vyaktībhaviṣyatīti
lakṣite yathā—
‘brahmāṇḍakāraṇaṃ yo'psu nidadhe bījamātmanaḥ
upasthānaṃ karomyeṣa tasmai śeṣāhiśāyine || 143 ||’
atra brahmāṇḍopasthānaśabdayorasabhyasmṛtihetutve'pi anyatra lakṣitatvādguṇatvam
yasya padasyaikadeśo grāmyānugāmī tasya smṛtihetutā
tatra kutraciduktivaicitryādekadeśo jhaṭiti smārakaḥ, kvacittathaiva samudāyaśaktyā viparītārthopasthāpanājjhaṭiti svārthaṃ samudāya eva pratipādayati
ādyo dūṣaṇam
dvitīyastu vaijātyābhāvādguṇaḥ
tadevaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yatrādye grāmyatvaṃ tato'nyatraiva bahudhā lakṣaṇāttadidamuktam—anyatra lakṣitatvāditi
evamaśastādīnāmapi guṇatvam
yathā—
‘bhadre māri praśastaṃ vada sadasi mudā nṛtya kṛtye muhūrtaṃ mṛtyo ratnaiścatuṣkaṃ viracaya racayārātrikaṃ kālarātri
cāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālāmupanaya vinayasvāyatāṃ bhairavīrṣyā- mevaṃ deve bhavānīṃ vadati parijanavyāhṛtistrāyatāṃ vaḥ || 144 ||’
atra mārīkṛtyādīnāmaśastārthānāmapi padānāṃ samastamaṅgalāyatanasya bhagavato viśveśvarasya saṃbandhenoktatvādguṇatvam
punarapareṇa prakāreṇa saṃvyānaṃ bhavatītyapraśaste sphorayati
parameśvarasya maṅgalāyatanatvaṃ tatsaṃbandhimātrasyaiva maṅgalībhavananiyamena śāstretihāsādau prasiddhatvāt
taduktam—‘tathāpi smartṝṇāṃ varada paramaṃ maṅgalamasi’ iti
ayaṃ ca prakāro'praśastārtha eva bhavati
māryādayo mātṛviśeṣāḥ
ārātrikaṃ nīrājanadīpavyāsaṅgapātram
parijanapadaṃ saṃbandhaṃ puṣṇāti
dvitīyaṃ gopanaprakāramaśastārthāntaraṃ vyañjayati—
yathā vā—
‘satpakṣā madhuragiraḥ prasādhitāśā madoddhatārambhāḥ
nipatanti dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ kālavaśānmedinīpṛṣṭhe || 145 ||’
atra dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ kālavaśānmedinīpṛṣṭhe nipatantītyasyāmaṅgalārthāntaratve'pi ‘haṃsānahaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāniti vyapadiśāmi’ iti vakṣyamāṇavākyaguptatvādguṇatvam
yathā veti
pakṣaḥ patatraṃ parikaraśca
āśā dik pratyāśā ca
madaḥ kṣībatā darpaśca
nipāta āgamanaṃ śastrādihatānāṃ medinīsaṃgatiśca
raṅgamaṅgalāntaḥ svastyayanapravṛttasya sūtradhārasya maṅgalārthādhikāravastuprastāvanaṃ tāvadbuddhipūrvakamatra na saṃbhavati haṃsānahamityādinā tātparyasya niyamitatvāt
svaśaktyā tu padārthāntaramā- bhāsayanti padāni doṣatayā na pratibhāsate
tatra vīthyaṅgaviśeṣopakṣepasyāmukhaśarīratvādaucityaniveśa eva sphuṭaṃ kāraṇamityāśayo boddhavyaḥ
aucityavirodho na sārvatrika iti nātiprasaṅga
yathā ca—
‘ko'bhipretaḥ susaṃsthānastasyā iti na niścayaḥ
āśāpiśācikaiṣā tu kumārī māṃ variṣyati || 146 ||’
atrābhipretasusaṃsthānāśāpiśācikā kumārīti padānāmaśastasmṛtihetūnāmapi lokairanyatra lakṣitatvādguṇatvam
ko'bhipreta ityādau pūrvavadeva vāsanā
evaṃ ghṛṇāvadarthādīnāmapi guṇatvam
tatra ghṛṇāvato yathā—
‘padmānyarkāṃśuniṣṭhyūtāḥ pītvā pāvakavipruṣaḥ
bhūyo vamantīva mukhairudgīrṇāruṇareṇubhiḥ || 147 ||’
atra—
‘niṣṭhyūtodgīrṇavāntādi gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayam
atisundaramanyattu grāmyakakṣāṃ vigāhate ||’
ghṛṇāvadarthāntarasya yathā—
‘kāminīgaṇḍanisyandabindurindurmato mama
anyathā kathametasya jagaduddyotinī dyutiḥ || 148 ||’
atra rāgātiśayahetubhūtayoḥ kāminīkapolacandramasoḥ svarūpabhāvanāmāhātmyenārthāntarabhāvanā gupteti gaṇḍanisyandabindurityasya ghṛṇāvadarthāntarasyāpi na doṣatvam
athāparaṃ saṃkhyānaprakāraṃ ghṛṇāvadarthe kathayati—yatheti
guṇavṛttivyāpārāśrayeṣvavāntarādipadeṣu prathamata evānyakriyādidharmāṇāmanyatrārope samādhiprādurbhāvā-danutthānaṃ doṣābhāvatvadvāraṃ, tataśca mukhya eva sthāne jugupsādāyitvaṃ pūrvācāryaślokenaiva vyācaṣṭe—atretyādi
guṇagrastatvamabhipretyātiśayasaṃpattau prakṛtaucityātkapolasyaiva pratibhāsastadidamuktam—rāgātiśayahetubhūtayoriti
tathā ca jagannayanānandabhūtasya niḥśeṣitāśeṣatamasaścandramaso yadidamabhipretakāminīkapolalāvaṇyabindumātratayā bhānaṃ taducitameveti
prācyānāmeva vāsanāmabhisaṃdhāya smṛtihetumudāharati—
ghṛṇāvatsmṛtiheturyathā—
‘vipūyaraśanāvantaḥ palāśāṣāḍhadhāriṇaḥ
brahmavarcasvino yānti dvijapogaṇḍakā ime || 149 ||’
atra vipūyapalāśabrahmavarcasapogaṇḍaśabdānāṃ ghṛṇāvatsmṛtihetutve'pyanyatra lakṣitatvādadoṣatvam
yatheti
āṣāḍho daṇḍa;
brahmavarcasina iti
‘brahmahastibhyāṃ varcasaḥ’ iti samāsāntastato matvarthīya iniḥ
pogaṇḍo bālaḥ
evamanyaprakāramapi saṃkhyānādikaṃ svayamunneyamityāha—
evamanyadapi draṣṭavyam
atra ca—
kiṃcidāśrayasaṃbandhāddhatte śobhāmasādhvapi
kāntāvilocananyastaṃ malīmasamivāñjanam || 106
tadyathā—
‘antraprotabṛhatkapālanalakakūrakvaṇatkaṅkaṇa- prāyapreṅkhitabhūribhūṣaṇaravairāghoṣayatyambaram
pītaccharditaraktakardamaghanaprāgbhāraghorollasa- vdyālolastanabhārabhairavavapurdarpoddhataṃ dhāvati || 150 ||’
atrāśrayasya bībhatsaraso citatvādadoṣatvam
evamiti
anityo'yaṃ doṣaḥ
tena yatra doṣatā nāsti tatra viṣaye rasaprakāśasāmagryābhantarbhāvātkathaṃ na guṇatvam
antarbhāvaśca dvidhā—prayogaviṣayaucityena vā, vāganubhāvaucityena vā
tatra prathamaṃ darśayati—kiṃciditi
yathāñjanasya nāñjanavallyādisaṃgatatvena śataśo bhāvyamānasyāpyuddīpanavibhāvanā
bhavati tu kāntāvilocanacumbitayānusaṃdhīyamānasya
tathāpadasyāpi viṣaye'tadviṣaye ca prayujyamānasya
tadetavdyācaṣṭe—atrāśrayasyeti
saṃniveśavaśātkiṃcidviruddhamapi śobhate
nīlaṃ palāśamābaddhamantarāle srajāmiva || 107
tadyathā—
‘antraiḥ kalpitamaṅgalapratisarāḥ strīhastaraktotpala- vyaktottaṃsabhṛtaḥ pinahya sahasā hṛtpuṇḍarīkasrajaḥ
etāḥ śoṇitapaṅkakuṅkumajuṣaḥ saṃbhūya kāntaiḥ piba- ntyasthisnehasurāḥ kapālacaṣakaiḥ prītāḥ piśācāṅganāḥ || 151 ||’
atra śrṛṅgāriṇo hi jagadapi śrṛṅgāramayaṃ paśyantīti bībhatsarase'pi mādhavenāntrādiyadānāmantarāleṣu niveśitānāṃ maṅgalapratisarādipadānāmadoṣaḥ
dvitīyamantarbhāvaprakāraṃ vyutpādayati—saṃniveśavaśāditi
saṃniveśo vāganubhāvaḥ
aucityākṛṣṭapadaghaṭanā tadvaśatvaṃ tadākṛṣṭatvamata eva virodhisaṃgatatayā vijātīyayorapyaucitīvaśena kāntiviśeṣonmīlakatvāt patrapuṣpavyatikarajamālāsādṛśyaṃ darśayati—nīlamiti
antrairityādau pratyutpannadoṣonmattapretāṅganāvalokasya mādhavasyālambanoddīpanavibhāvādiprakarpe bībhatsarasotsekastāvadupapannaḥ
yastvayamakasmādeva maṅgalādipadānāṃ śṛṅgārānuyāyināmiha niveśaḥ sa kathaṃ doṣabhāvādapanetavyaḥ, kathaṃ vā guṇatvamāsādayitavyamityato hetugarbhaṃ vyācaṣṭe—atra śrṛṅgāriṇa iti
śrṛṅgāravāsanāniviṣṭaḥ śrṛṅgārī
tathā ca pūrvaṃ bībhatsarasānvaye'pi prakṛta śrṛṅgārabhaṅgo mā bhūdityetadarthameva kavinā ‘mama hi’ ityādinā pratijñāya ‘līneva’ ityādivāsanādṛḍhatvamupapāditam
ata eva pratipadaṃ rūpakamāviṣṭābhiprāyamevaṃ śrṛṅgāramayaṃ śrṛṅgārāṅga-tayā rasatāpannam
upapadyate ca taccittasya sādṛśyamātreṇa tadrūpatānusaṃdhānam
tataśca kathaṃ noddīpanatā vastusattvasyānupayogitvāt
ata eva sūtritasya bībhatsasya prakṛtena bādhāt prakṛtārthānupoṣa iti
nanu kathamuddeśe caturviṃśatidhetyuktam
doṣā hi pūrvaṃ ṣoḍaśaiva vibhaktā ityata āha—
aślīlāderamī bhedā bhidyante yattridhā tridhā
bhavanti nava tenaite pūrvoktā daśa pañca ca || 108
caturviṃśatirityeṣā proktā padasamāśrayā
samāsātpūrvanirdiṣṭadoṣāṇāṃ guṇaklṛptaye || 109
ityetatpadadoṣāṇāmadoṣatvamudīritam
aślīlāderiti
nigadavyākhyātam
caturviṃśatirityeṣeti
ā daśabhyaḥ saṃkhyā saṃkhyeye bartate, tataḥ saṃkhyāne saṃkhyeye cābhidhānāt kevalasaṃkhyānavacanatvena gavāṃ viṃśatiritivatpadasamāśrayetyupapannam
idānīṃ vākyadoṣāṇāṃ guṇatvamabhidhīyate || 110
kramaprāptavākyadoṣaguṇībhāvavyutpādanamavatārayati—idānīmiti
tatra śabdavihīnasya vivakṣāvaśataḥ kvacit
nisargasundaratvena guṇatvaṃ parikalpyate || 111
yathā—
‘ākṣipantyaravindāni mugdhe tava mukhacchavim
kośadaṇḍasamagrāṇāṃ kimeṣāṃ khalu duṣkaram || 152 ||’
atra ‘na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatṛnām’ iti kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhe kimeṣāṃ duṣkaramityapabhāṣaṇe'pi saṃbandhamātravivakṣāto guṇatvam
yadāha—
‘idaṃ hi śāstramāhātmyadarśanālasacetasām
apabhāṣaṇavadbhāti na ca saubhāgyamujjhati ||’
yasya vastuno nānārūpāṇi vijātīyarūpāṇi tatra tadrupavivakṣāvaicitryācchabdacaicitryaṃ saṃgacchata iti doṣatvābhāvaḥ
evaṃ rūpatā gamitavatītyādau kadāpi nāstītidoṣarūpataiṣā
kvacitpunarasti rūpāntaramityāha—kvaciditi
bhavatvevam
guṇatvaṃ tu kathamityata āha—nisargeti
niyatarūpavivakṣā hi mahākavīnāṃ na lāvaṇyamanusaṃdhāya bhavitumarhati
tathāhi—ākṣipantītyādau eṣāṃ duṣkaramityatra khalarthayoge ‘na lokāvyayaniṣṭhākhalarthatunām’ ityanena ṣaṣṭhīpratiṣedhādeṣāmiti kathaṃ ṣaṣṭhīti duṣṭajātīyatāmādāya śeṣarūpaviśeṣavivakṣā samādhānahetuḥ
asti hi ṣaṣṭhyarthasya saṃbandhasya dvarūpyam—saṃbandhasāmānyaṃ viśeṣaśca janyajanakabhāvādiḥ
tatra saṃbandhaviśeṣavihitaṣaṣṭhīmupādāya ‘na loka—‘ ityādinā niṣedhaḥ
saṃbandhasāmānyarūpamupādāya ṣaṣṭhī kena vāryate
ayameva saṃbandhaḥ śeṣa ityucyate
evaṃ tāvanna doṣatvam
yathā koṣasamagrāṇāṃ rājñāṃ vipakṣaśrīharamupadiśya yatkimapi saṃbandhimātrameva na duṣkaraṃ tathā padmānāmiti samarthayāmahe
kathamanyathā durāpatvadvadanaśrīharaṇamiti prakṛtapoṣalābhādguṇatvamatisulabhaṃ tadetavdyācaṣṭe—atreti
nanu saṃbandhamātravivakṣāyāṃ doṣatā mā bhūt, guṇatvaṃ tu kathamiti yathoktamabhisaṃdhāya paramataṃ likhati—idaṃ hīti
śāstramāhātmyaṃ vidhiniṣedhayoḥ parasparāsaṃkīrṇaviṣayatvam
yatnaḥ saṃbandhanirjñānahetuḥ ko'pi kṛto yadi
kramalaṅghanamapyāhurna doṣaṃ sūrayo yathā || 112
bandhutyāgastanutyāgo deśatyāga iti triṣu
ādyantāvāyatakleśau madhyamaḥ kṣaṇikajvaraḥ
ādyantau madhyama iti saṃbandhanirjñānahetorvidhānānna śābdakramalaṅghanaṃdoṣaḥ
vaktuśca bandhutyāgadeśatyāgayostanutyāgādgrīyastvenābhimatatvādityarthakramalaṅghanasyāpi guṇatvam
yatna iti
kramabhraṃśe hi yathābhimatānvayapratītipratyūho dūṣakatābījam
tadyadi kutaścidviśeṣādaskhalitaiva pratītirupajāyate tadā bījābhāvena tathābhāvo nivartata eva
sa ca viśeṣaḥ pratipadamanukramituṃ na śakyate iti ko'pi yatna iti sāmānyena pratipāditam
so'yaṃ śabdakramalaṅghanāpavādaḥ
arthakramalaṅghane tvabhi-prāyaviśeṣaḥ
tathā hi—bandhutyāga ityādau bandhutyāgatanutyāgadeśatyāgānkameṇoddiśya tathaivānudeśo'pyarhati na tvādimamuddiśya tato'ntyastato madhya iti uddeśānudeśalakṣaṇaśāstrakramabhraṃśajātīyatve'pi saṃbandhajñānahetuyatnakaraṇādadūṣaṇatvaṃ vyavasthāpyate
yatnaścāyameva yadādipadairullekhaḥ
tāni hi tattatsthānaviśeṣagāmina eva pratītimupajanayanti
avaśyaṃ cānena krameṇātra vaktumucitaṃ tanutyāgasya vijātīyatāvivakṣayā pṛthageva vaktumarhatvāt
evaṃ cānupapattirloke bandhutyāgāpekṣayā śarīratyāgasyātikṛcchratvena prasiddhiḥ
ataśca ‘madhyama āyatakleśa ādyantau kṣaṇikajvarau’ iti vacanamucitamiti ārthakrabhamabhraṃśaḥ kathaṃ na bhavati tatrāha—vaktuśceti
abhimatamityanenābhiprāyaviśeṣo'pavādahetuḥ—‘yathāruci yathārthitvaṃ yathāvyutpatti bhidyate
ābhāso vyartha ekasminnanusaṃdhānasādhitaḥ
’ ita nyāyādupapannamevaitaditi
virūpasaṃdhi yatpūrvaṃ visaṃdhi ca nirūpitam
na ca durvacake prāyaḥ pragṛhyādau ca duṣyati || 113
tatra durvacake virūpasaṃdhiryathā—
‘jayanti varṣāsviti bhargadurgayoḥ sudurvacā durvacakaprayuktayaḥ
abheṇnageḍje khamapograbhograrugdhruḍbhramabruṇmukhi sadhryagedhi naḥ || 153 ||’
atrottarārdhasya virūpasaṃdhitve'pi durvacakatvena kalāvidbhirāddatatvādguṇatvam
yadāhuḥ—
‘śukastrībālamūrkhāṇāṃ mukhasaṃskārasiddhaye
prahāsāya ca goṣṭhīṣu vācyā durvacakādayaḥ || 154 ||’
pragṛhyādau vigatasaṃdhiryathā—
‘kamale iva locane ime anubadhnāti vilāsapaddhatiḥ
sa ito'bdaṛtāvṛtapriyo na ṛcastvaṃ na yajūṃṣi ūhase || 155 ||’
atra visadheḥ pragṛhyādihetukatvādguṇatvam
yadāha—
na saṃhitāṃ vivakṣāmītyasaṃdhānaṃ padeṣu yat
tadvisaṃdhīti nirdiṣṭaṃ na pragṛhyādihetukam || 114
virūpeti
virūpo durvacako visaṃdhirvigataṃ saṃhitākāryaṃ durvacake kalāviśeṣarūpatayānumate saṃhitākāryaniyamaḥ
dvitīye kutrādūṣaṇamityāha—pragṛhyādāviti
pragṛhyaṃ ‘īdūdevddivacanaṃ pragṛhyam’ ityādinā yatra pragṛhyasaṃjñā vihitā, ādigrahaṇādvināpi pragṛhyasaṃjñayā yatra prakṛtibhāvavidhānaṃ tathodāhariṣyate
yatra vā vaktuḥ khedādinā vicchidya pāṭhe viratirbhavati
yathā—kā ekaśiroruheti
tadevaṃ durvacakapragṛhyādi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ virūpavisaṃdhivigatasaṃdhānayorapavādakāraṇe ityāha—atreti
prayujyanta iti prayuktayo durvacakāśca tāḥ prayuktayaśceti durvacakaprayuktaya iti karmadhārayaḥ
sudurvacā iti anyenoccārayitumaśakyāḥ
svayameva kaviḥ pratijñāya uttarārdhe durvacakānyāha—ameḍityādi
he nageḍje parvatarājaputri, khamākāśaṃ bheḍ bhānāṃ nakṣatrāṇāmīḍīśvaraścandraḥ so'vidyamāno yatra
tirodhānādasatkalpanā candramasaḥ
kena punastirodhānamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ dvitīyaṃ viśeṣaṇam—apogreti
apagatogradīptirbha ugrarucirādityastadīyadrohakāriṇo'bhrapadavācyā meghā yatra
apsu rohatītyabruṭ padmaṃ tadvanmukhaṃ yasyā iti devīsaṃbodhanam
cedīdṛśaṃ tarhi sadhryaṅ sahacaro bhavāsmākamiti gauryā uttaram
kalārūpatvena virūpasaṃdhānasya guṇatvamityāha—kalāvidbhirādṛtatvāditi
kamale ivetyādāvudāharaṇatvānnaikaḥ ślokārdhaḥ
pūrvārdhe kamale ityāditritayaṃ pragṛhyasaṃjñodāharaṇam
uttarārdhe vinaiva pragṛhyasaṃjñāṃ prakṛtibhāvavidhānaṃ yatra tattritayodāharaṇam
tathāhi—abdaṛtāviti
‘na ṛca’ iti ca ‘ṛtyakaḥ’ ityanena prakṛtibhāvaḥ
yajūṃpi ūhasa iti 'iko'savarṇe śākalyasya hrasvaśca’ ityanena
aparamādipadagrāhyaṃ pūrvamudāhṛtam
atrāpi sa iti voddhavyam
tadetacchāstrānumatamapi ghaṭanāsauṣṭavena niveśanīyam
na tvanyathā
uktaṃ ca pūrvameva yatpragṛhyādihetukamapi nāsakṛtprayoktavyamiti
anukampādyatiśayo yadi kaścidvivakṣyate
na doṣaḥ punarukte'pi pratyuteyamalaṃkriyā || 115
yathā—
‘hanyate sā varārohā smareṇākāṇḍavairiṇā
hanyate cārusarvāṅgī hanyate mañjubhāṣiṇī || 156 ||’
atra hanyate hanyata iti śabdapunaruktaṃ cārusarvāṅgī varārohetyarthapunaruktaṃ tadubhayamapyanukampādyatiśayavivakṣāyāmadoṣa iti guṇatvam
anukampeti
saṃbhramādau yāvadbodhamityādinā padadviruktyāderanumatatvānna doṣatvam
abhiprāyavyañjananaiyatyena prakṛtipoṣānuguṇatayā guṇatvam
tathāhi—hanyata ityādau hanyata iti yadyapyabhidheyatātparyamiti śabdapunaruktajātīyaṃ bhavati, yadyapi ca varārohetyabhidhāya cārusarvāṅgītyabhinnābhidheyatātparyaṃ paryāyarūpatvādarthapunaruktajātīyam, tathāpi virahavedanādūnāyāmanukampātiśayādasakṛdupādānamahirahirbudhyasveti lokānusārāt
anukampābhayādyasya hi tādṛśī padadviruktirabhiprāyaviśeṣārthaniṣpāditayā guṇakakṣādhirohaṇakṣamaivetyāśayavānvyācaṣṭe—tadubhayamapīti
padānāṃ vyutkamo yatra krameṇa vyutkameṇa vā
tavdyākīrṇaṃ vidustasya na doṣaḥ kvāpi tadyathā || 116
‘jugupsata smainamaduṣṭabhāvaṃ maivaṃ bhavānakṣatasādhuvṛttaḥ
itīva vāco nigṛhītakaṇṭhaiḥ prāṇairarudhyanta maharṣisūnoḥ || 157 ||’
atra ‘mā sma jugupsata’ iti vaktavye ‘jugupsata smainamaduṣṭabhāvaṃ maivam’ iti padavyatikramasya ‘vyaste'pīcchanti kecit’ iti luṅlaṅorviśeṣalakṣaṇatvādguṇatvam
padānāmiti
ekasmin vākye padānāmucitasaṃniveśaviparyāsaḥ kramabhraṃśaḥ
sa dvidhā bhavati—pūrvāparabhāvaniyatānāṃ tādṛśakramapracyāvanena vā
yathā bahutṛṇamityanyo'rthaḥ, tṛṇaṃ bahvityanyaḥ
pūrvāparaniyamaśūnyānāmiti tādṛguccāraṇaviparyāsena vā
yathā kapālamanulimpati, dukūlaṃ paridadhātītyatra kramaniyamo'bhimataḥ
anulimpati kapālam, paridadhāti vastramityapi kṛtena tasyaivārthasya lābhāt
yadā tu kapālaṃ paridadhāti dukūlamanulimpatīti kriyate tadā bhavati saṃnidhiviparyāsastadetavdyākīrṇasaṃkīrṇayostulyaṃ, tadidamuktam—krameṇa vyutkrameṇa vā
nanu ‘smotare laṅ ca’ ityanena māśabdāduttaraṃ yatra smaśabdaprayogastatra luṅlaṅorvidhāne padakramaniyamaḥ kṛtastatkathaṃ sma mameti prayukte so'rthaḥ pratyetavya ityata āha—vyasta iti
viśeṣeṇa lakṣyata iti viśeṣaṇalakṣaṇaṃ tasya bhāvastattvam
paryāyeṇa dvayoryatra vākyaṃ praśnottarādiṣu
saṃkīrṇaṃ tanna doṣāya vākovākyavido viduḥ || 117
yathā—
‘bāle nātha vimuñca mānini ruṣaṃ roṣānmayā kiṃ kṛtaṃ khedo'smāsu na me'parādhyati bhavānsarve'parādhā mayi
tatkiṃ rodiṣi gadgadena vacasā kasyāgrato rudyate nanvetanmama kā tavāsmi dayitā nāsmītyato rudyate || 158 ||’
atra saṃkīrṇatve'pi vākovākyatvānna doṣaḥ
paryāyeṇeti
yatra vākyaikavākyatāyāmavāntaravākyeṣu parasparapadārthapraveśena yathābhimatasaṃsargapratītiḥ skhalitā bhavati tatra saṃkaro dūṣaṇam, pratīteraskhalane tu na doṣaḥ
skhalanaṃ cānekavaktṛkaparyāyapravṛttavākyāvayavamiśraṇena bhavati
tadapi miśraṇaṃ praśnottararūpamanyādṛśaṃ vā bhavatītyāha—praśnottarādiṣviti
viṣayasaptamīyam
vākye vākyaṃ vākovākyaṃ pṛṣodarāditvātsādhu
tatra praśnottarādirūpaṃ vākovākyamudāharati—bāle iti
atra ‘bāle vimuñca māṃ prati ruṣam’ iti prathamapraśnavākyam
‘nātha roṣānmayā kiṃ kṛtam’ iti tādṛśamevottaravākyam
tatra bāle iti vākyapratīkānantarameva nātheti vākyāntarapratīkasya nirdeśaḥ saṃkīrṇajātīyatāmākārayitumudyataḥ praśnottaraprabhāvādapodyate
saṃkīrṇayorapi vākyayoḥ paryāyanirdeśe bhavatyeva vākovākyamiti cet, na
vyatikarasyābhiprāyaviśeṣavyañjakatayā camatkārakāritvena vijātīyatvāt
ata eva guṇatvam
tathā hi bāle iti padaṃ paracittānabhijñāyāḥ kṣudrasahacarīvacasi viśvāsabhājaḥ sopālambhaṃ saṃbodhanamāviṣkaroti
etadākarṇyānantarameverṣyākaṣāyakāminīvacanamucitamiti nātheti saṃbodhanaṃ sābhiprāyam, prabhurasi na punarasmāsu dattāśayo na vā svādhīnatāsaubhāgyabhāgiti vivakṣitatvāt
evamuttaratra svayamunneyam
upalakṣaṇaṃ ca dvayoriti ekasyāpi vaktuḥ prahelikādau tadvidyaviṣaye tadābhāṣaṇasyocitatvāt
vijātīyavākyadvayasaṃdaṃśapatita-pade kimidamanenānvīyate'nena veti saṃdehasaṃkīrṇatāsaṃśayo'pi saṃkaramadhyāsīna eveti guravaḥ
ayameti putro rājñaḥ puruṣo'pasāryatāmityatra rājapadaṃ saṃdaṃśapatitaṃ kiṃ pūrveṇātha pareṇānvīyata iti saṃdihyate
rājagokṣīrādau dvayenānvayo gopadasya niścita iti
prakṛtisthādibhedena grāmyādibhirathāpi yā
apadaṃ tasya cānujñā bhāṣācitre vidhīyate || 118
yathā—
‘hā to jo jjaladeu naiva madanaḥ sākṣādayaṃ bhūtale tatkiṃ dīsai saccamā hatavapuḥ kāmaḥ kila śrūyate
ai dūe kialeu bhūtapatinā gaurīvivāhotsave aiseṃ sacca ji bollu hastakaṭakaḥ kiṃ darpaṇenekṣyate || 159 ||’
atra grāmyaḥ praṣṭā nagaramāgato rājānaṃ dṛṣṭvā grāmyaiḥ prakṛtisthaireva vā padaiḥ prākṛtena pṛcchati—‘hā to jo jjaladeu’ iti
nāgaraśca tamanujighṛkṣurupanāgaraiḥ komalairvā padaiḥ savakrokti pratyācaṣṭe—‘naiva madanaḥ sākṣādayaṃ bhūtale’ iti
atha grāmya āhitapratibhaḥ pūrvapadānurodhādardhaprākṛtenaiva grāmyopanāgaraiḥ prakṛtisthakomalairvā padaistamupālabhate—‘tatkiṃ dīsai saccamā hatavapuḥ kāmaḥ kila śrūyate’ iti
atha nāgaro jñātatatprāvīṇyaḥ pādānurodhādeva ardhaprākṛtena grāmyopanāgaranāgaraiḥ prakṛtisthakomalakaṭhorairvā padaiḥ samādhatte—‘ai dūe kialeu bhūtapatinā gaurīvivāhotsave’ iti
atha grāmyaḥ ślokasamāpteḥ pādasya taduttarasya cānurodhādgrāmyāṇi prakṛtisthāni vā tricaturāṇi padāni prākṛte noktvā pādārdha eva tiṣṭhati—‘aiseṃ sacca ji bollu’ iti
atha nāgaro jitakāśī grāmyo-panāgaranāgaraiḥ prakṛtisthakomalakaṭhorairvā padaiḥ ślokamuttaraṃ ca pūrayati—'hastakaṭakaḥ kiṃ darpaṇenekṣyate’ iti
tatra ca prākṛtānāṃ sarveṣāmapi grāmyatvam
praṣṭuḥ saṃskṛtapadeṣu vapurityupanāgaraṃ śeṣāṇi grāmyāṇi, prativaktuśca hastavivāha gaurīpadāni grāmyāṇi, bhūtapatineti nāgaram, śeṣāṇyupanāgarāṇi
tadidamīdṛśi prameye tathaivopakramādetanna duṣyati
prakṛtistheti
‘vibhinna-’ ityādāvapadalakṣaṇasūtre ṣaṇṇāmiti vyatikara ekatvena nābhipretaḥ
api tu grāmyāditrikasya vā prakṛtisthāditrikasya veti vikalpenopanyāsaprayojanamanujñāsaṃpattistena doṣatābhāvaguṇībhāvau pratipāditau
viṣayaṃ darśayati—bhāṣācitra iti
saṃskṛtādivyatikarasyāpadatvenābhipretatvāt saṃskṛtādayo grāmyādayaḥ prakṛtisthādayaśca bhāṣāśabdenābhimatāḥ
yathā hi—nānāvarṇārabdhamālekhyacitraṃ yathā vā bhinnaprakāratantunirvātaḥ paṭaścitrapaṭastathā nānābhāṣābhirārabdhaṃ kiṃcitkāvyaṃ citramucyate
citramāścaryaṃ tatkāri ca citram
tena rūpadvayasaṃpattau yuktipoṣaḥ syādevaṃ yathaucityākṛṣṭanānābhāṣāvyatikarajamekaṃ saṃbhavatītyāśaṅkya/ saṃkṣepātsarvaṃ bhāṣāsaṃkaramevodāharati—yatheti
saṃkaramācitīṃ ca vyākhyānena sphuṭayati—atra grāmya iti
grāmavāsī kiṃcivdyutpannaśca
grāmyāśca nagaravastunyadbhutacamatkāravanto jijñāsavaśca bhavantīti jātiḥ
tatra rājānaṃ dṛṣṭveti adbhutavastukathanena camatkāraḥ
pṛcchatīti jijñāsā bahumāna ādaraścamatkāreṇaiva
yadvā yānpṛcchati teṣveva bahumāno dhanyāste ye nāmagotrādikametasya jānantaḥ satatamenamavalokyanta ityāśayāt
prastutagrāmyaprakṛteścāsya prākṛtapadaireva praśno yogyaḥ
tadetatsarvamādarśayituṃ praśnaṃ pṛthakkṛtya darśayati—hā to ityādi
‘hā to’ iti mahārāṣṭrabhāṣāyāṃ praśnakākurayaṃ sa ityarthe
sa iti yo nāmaitannagaranāyakatvenāsmadgrāme'pi vahuśo vikhyātakīrtiriti camatkāraḥ
jo jjaladeu iti
jijñāsāsāmānyataśca nagarasaṃcariṣṇujanagocaro'yaṃ praśnaḥ
atra sarvāṇyeva padāni nātihīnapātre grāmye prakṛtibhavānyapabhraṃśapadāni deśīpadatvena sarveṣāṃ grāmyatā
‘hā to’ ityanena svarakṛtagauravam
‘jo jjaladeu’ ityekasaṃyogavarṇāpāditagauravaṃ ca prakṛtisthaṃ tadatra prākṛtagrāmyayoraucityākṛṣṭam
prakṛtisthe tu naucityamupayujyate
api tu saṃdarbhārambhastena prakrānta iti vivakṣitam
adhikasya praṣṭavyasyābhāvādetatpraśnānantaramevottarāvasaraḥ
tataśca nānaucityam
praśno-ttaropanyāso hi prakṛtyaiva ca nāgarakā grāmyamatavirodhino vakroktirasikā bhavanti
yadi tasya grāmye jaghanyabuddhiḥ kimityuttarameṣa dāsyatītyata uktam—anujighṛkṣuriti
sabahumānaṃ pṛcchati
grāmye yasya dayā tadānīmāsīt
jijñāsānivartakrajñānajananamanugrahaḥ
yadyapi nāgarasya nāgarāṇi padāni prayoktumarhanti, tathāpi grāmyānugrahe kartavye tadbodhayogyamevābhimataṃ na tu nāgarakatvam
tarhi grāmyaireva kuto na bravītītyapi na vācyam
sahasaiva tathākaraṇe grāmyamatavirodhaḥ
api tūpanāgarakarūpabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt, tato madhyamānyupanāgarāṇi prayogayogyānītyāha—upanāgarairiti
svabhāvata eva prākṛtaprakṛtisthānāṃ saṃskṛtaprakṛtisthānāṃ prauḍhatvaṃ bhavati
