tena yadyapi grāmyaprayuktajātīyānyeva saṃdarbhaikarūpatāsidhdyarthaṃ ghaṭayitumucitāni tathāpyaucitīprāptasaṃskṛtapadaniveśane yadi prakṛtisthatvamādriyeta tataśchāyāvairūpyaṃ syādityāśayena komalaprāyāṇyeva niveśitānītyāha—komalairveti
bhūyasā vyapadeśo bhavatīti lokanyāyānusārāt ‘sākṣāt’ ityekasya prakṛtisthatve'pi komalairityuktam
sākāṅkṣapraśne ca kimarthaṃ lokottaro ‘jo jjaladeu’ nānyaḥ kaścittādṛgiti bhāvo vivakṣitastatra netyevoktenānugrahaḥ kṛtaḥ syādityadhikamapi kiṃcidvaktumucitamityāha—savakroktīti
etena nāgarakavṛttirupabṛṃhitā
naivetyevakāreṇa manuṣya evāyaṃ na bhavati dūre tadviśeṣarūpo ‘jo jjaladeu’ iti prakāśitam
sākṣāditi pratyakṣeṇāvadhāryamāṇaḥ kiṃcivdyutpannatvena grāmyasyoktatvāt
kāmavyāvṛttasākṣādbhāvalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmānusaṃdhānena madanadāhavyatikaratā saṃbhavatīti labdhāvasaraṃ grāmyānuyogamavatārayati—atheti
śikṣāviśeṣasparśinī buddhiḥ pratibhā
māmekāntato nāgarakavṛttaparicayaparādhīnaṃ mā śaṅkiṣṭhā ityāśayaśauṭīryeṇa nāgarakaprayuktajātīyaireva padaiḥ praśno yogyo na caitāvataiva sarvathā prakṛtityāgo'rhatītyataḥ svaprayogayogyānyapi prayogamarhanti tatrārdhaṃ prakṛtivaiśasenārdhaṃ prākṛtamardhaṃ grāmyaṃ ca praśnavākyānucitamityāha—pūrvapadānurodhāditi
pūrvaṃ paraprayuktaṃ padaṃ tarkitam
saccimā satyaḥ
yāvatī grāmyasya vyutpattirarhati tāvatīmupanyasyati—śrūyata iti
aitihāsikamukhādevamākarṇitaṃ punaradyāpi nirṇayo vartata ityarthaḥ
tarkitamiti prakṛtistham
dīsaīti komalam
saccimeti prakṛtistham
hatavapuriti komalam
kāmaḥ kiletyapi tathā
śrūyata iti prakṛtisthamiti
anantaraṃ nāgarikasyottarā-vasaraḥ
kathaṃ paramārthavādinyuttaraṃ dātavyamityanupapattāvayaṃ samādhānaprakāro bhavati
asti grāmyasya ‘kila śrūyate’ ityetābhyāṃ saṃdihānatvaṃ kiṃcivdyutpannatvaṃ connītamiti kimapyalīkameva buddhikauśalāttathā pratīyamānamabhidhāya pratāraṇamupapadyate
tanmātraparatvācca sarvākāramadhikāvyutpattirāhatya darśayitumarhatīti tarkitamityādipade yāvatī grāmyasya vyutpattistābadanukaraṇaṃ kiyadadhikavyutpattipuraskāramarhatītyāśayavānuttaramavatārayati—atheti
pādastarkitamityādigrāmyaprayuktastasyānurodho vyutpattyanukaraṇam
pacchā paścāt
ai eṣaḥ
‘ai dūe’ iti pāṭhe dūaṃ vyājo'nena vyājena
bhūtapatiḥ paśupatiḥ
nanu na kvacidevaṃ śrūyate tatkathaṃ grāmyasya prabodho bhavatītyāha—gaurīvivāhotsava iti
mā śrūyatāmupapattyā tu siddho dvitīyo yadi kāmaprādurbhāvo na syātkathaṃ gaurīpāṇigrahe bhagavata utsāha ityatastenaiva karuṇāsaṃtānaśāntātmanā bhūyaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ syādityarthaḥ
paccheti prakṛtistham, ai iti kaṭhoram, kialeu iti komalam, bhūtapatineti tathā, gaurīvivāhotsava iti prakṛtistham
'e~dūe~’ iti pāṭhe dvayamapi kaṭhoram
tadatra kaṭhoraniveśanaṃ vyutpattyādhikyasūcanāya
etāvatyukte parīkṣaṇavyutpattirna kiṃcidgrāmyaṃ pratibhāti
na ca tasyādyāpi niḥśaṅkatā vartate
tato nāgarakaprāmāṇyadattabharaḥ praśno ghaṭata ityāśayavānavatārayati—atha grāmya iti
prakṛtyāpanna eva, tena yathā prathamaṃ ‘hā to’ ityādipraśne gatistathātrāpīti grāmyaprakṛtisthayorupanyāsaḥ
bhāṣācitreṇa parasparasaṃgharṣādekakāvyaracanāpravṛttayorgrāmyasyāpi ślokaślokasamāptipadārambho yogya eva
yadi cāyameva samastaṃ nirvāhayannaśeṣaśaṅkānivṛttyupayuktamuttaraṃ nāgarasya niveśitaṃ syāditi taduttarānurodhena pādārdha eva vilambo'pyucitaḥ
‘aiseṃ’ evamityatrārthe kākugarbham
‘sacca ji bollu’ iti jiravadhāraṇe
satyamevaitaduktam
yadi satyapuraḥsaraṃ brūyāstadā pratyemītyarthaḥ
evaṃ grāmyatāpratāraṇasiddhau kimatra sarvalokasākṣike vastuni vakroktyaiva pūrvavyutpattimātraniveśanenottaraṃ dattvā ślokapūraṇameva nāgarasyocitamityāśayenottaramavatārayati—atheti
haste iti prakṛtistham, kaṭakamiti komalam, darpaṇenekṣyate ityete prakṛtisthe, iti prakṛtisthādīnāṃ supariceyatvādgrāmyādīnyeva vyācaṣṭe—tatra ceti
prakṛtivyatikarāvyatikaratvayoraucityāpannatvādbhāṣāsaṃkaraḥ śobhāvahatvena guṇa eva bhavatītyuktamupasaṃharati—taditi
vākyāntarasagarbhaṃ yadvākyaṃ tadvākyagarbhitam
rasāntaratiraskāre tadiṣṭaṃ neṣṭamanyathā || 119
yathā—
‘diṅmātaṅgaghaṭāvibhaktacaturāghāṭā mahī sādhyate siddhā sā ca vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ paśyata
viprāya pratipādyate kimaparaṃ rāmāya tasmai namo yasmādāvirabhūtkathādbhutamidaṃ yatraiva cāstaṃ gatam || 160 ||’
atra ‘yathoktā mahī sādhyate, siddhā sā ca viprāya pratipādyate iti vaktavye, yeyaṃ vīrādbhutarasavaśapravṛttena ‘vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romā ñcitāḥ paśyata’ iti vākyena prakṛtavākyokterasamāptāveva ‘viprāya ityādipadavicchittiḥ sā rasāntaratiraskṛtirityucyate
tayā cedaṃ vākyāntarasagarbhamapi vākyaṃ na doṣāya bhavati
vākyāntareti
rasāntaraṃ rasaviśeṣaḥ prakṛtarasānusaṃhito rasastena tiraskāro doṣabhāvasya, tasmin sati tathākṛtaṃ vākyamiṣṭameva kavīnāmupādānayogyameva anyathā neṣṭaṃ duṣṭamevetyarthaḥ
tenāyamartho bhavati—prakṛtarasatirodhāyakatvaṃ kila dūṣaṇatābījaṃ tadatirodhānenaiva nivartate
pratyuta dvitīyaparicchede vakṣyamāṇagarbhādivākyayojanaprakārasaṃpattāvalaṃkāralābhe guṇatvaṃ bhavati
tathā hi—diṅmātaṅgānāṃ ghaṭayā vibhaktāḥ pṛthagudbhidya vyavasthāpitāścatvāra āghāṭā yasyāṃ sā, tathā tena ‘saptadvīpā vasumatī sādhyate’ iti vivakṣitam
ye tāvadbharatabhagīrathaprabhṛtayaḥ prathitapratāpātiśayāsteṣāṃ taddūṣaṇapariniṣṭhitaśaktīnāmekasyāpi samastakṣattravaṃśonmūlanena navakhaṇḍamedinīsiddhau notsāhaśaktiḥ śravaṇagocaratāmayāsīditi lokottarā paraśurāmasyotsāhaśaktirāvedyate
'siddhā sā ca’ ityanena yāvadabhilaṣitaṃ tāvadeva siddhamityaho vijigīṣuteti pūrvavadevābhiprāyaḥ
na cedasau siddhimabhisaṃdhāya pravṛttaḥ
anupadameva sā saṃpanneti cakāreṇa dyotyate
evamabhihite ‘viprāya’ ityādikamasti vākyaśeṣabhūtam, tadvicchidyaiva madhye ‘vadanta eva hi vayaṃ romāñcitāḥ’ iti vākyena sagarbhatā, sā na doṣāya
anena hi vākyena lokottaravastubhāvanātmakavibhāvasaṃpattau prādurbhavan vaktumabhimato raso vyajyate
sa ca vīrānusaṃdhānaheturvīrādbhutayoḥ samānabhūmikayoranyonyānugamanena pratikūlatā virahatā
tatra yathā śṛṅgāraraudrabībhatsānāmeka-praghaṭṭakena sūtreṇa saṃnipātitairapi hāsyakaruṇabhayānakairna tiraskāraḥ, ‘svāṅgamavyavadhāyakam’ iti nyāyāt, tatheha vīrasyādbhutenāta evādbhutādudvelasya prādurbhūtaputrakāṅkuralakṣaṇānubhāvapradarśanam—‘paśyata’ iti
na cātra doṣodāharaṇe ‘mayā’ iti kārakavibhakterutthitākāṅkṣāyā ‘rakṣainam’ ityādinā svarasaṃbādhastathātra saṃbhavati, 'siddhā’ ityetāvatyapi darśite vākyārthaparyavasānāt
na ca saṃpūrṇe rase ‘vadanta eva’ ityādikamabhidhātumarhati
adbhutatā ca pārthivānubhāvasya tanmātrapūraṇāpekṣatvāt
evaṃ rasānubhāvanātṛptasya tatraiva punaḥ punarutkaṇṭhāyāṃ jigīṣukaraṇīyalavdhapātrapratipattiviśeṣasphoraṇe ‘viprāya pratipādyate’ ityuktam
dānavīro'pi vīra eva
ata evādhikasya kartavyasyābhāve kimaparamityādirupasaṃhāraḥ
tadetatsarvaṃ vyācaṣṭe—atreti
yadbhinnaliṅgamityuktaṃ vibhinnavacanaṃ ca yat
upamādūṣaṇaṃ tanna yatrodvego na dhīmatām || 120
yathā—
‘anyadā bhūṣaṇaṃ puṃsaḥ śamo lajjeva yoṣitaḥ
parākramaḥ paribhave vaiyātyaṃ surateṣviva || 161 ||’
atra ‘puṃso yoṣita iva’ ‘śamo lajjeva’ ‘parākramo vaiyātyamiva’ iti liṅgabhedaḥ
‘paribhave surateṣviva’ iti tu liṅgabhedo vacanabhedaśca dṛśyate
sa caiṣāmeva parasparamupamānopameyabhāvavivakṣāyāṃ paryāyāntarābhāvādanyathākartuṃ na śakyata iti sahṛdayānudvejakatvānna duṣyatīti doṣasyāpi guṇatvam
tadidaṃ dvayorapyekamudāharaṇam
atha bhinnaliṅgasyaiva yathā—
‘yasya trivargaśūnyāni dinānyāyānti yānti ca
sa lohakārabhastreva śvasannapi na jīvati || 162 ||’
atra prāgvadeva paryāyāntarābhāvāt ‘sa lohakārabhastreva’ iti liṅgabhedasya na doṣaḥ
yadbhinneti
doṣaprakaraṇānurodhena samastavyastodāharaṇaṃ boddhavyam
sahṛdayodvejakatvena hi doṣatā
yatra tu kathaṃcittathābhāvo na bhavati, tatra doṣatvahānirucitaiva
tathā hi strīpuṃsayoreva prakṛtānuguṇopamānopameyabhāvavivakṣāyāmāvaśyakaṃ liṅgavaṃcanabhedayoranyataradekasya puṃsa upameyatvena dāraśabdasya bhinnavacanatvaniyamātkalatrapadaṃ bhinnavacanameva
paryāyāṇāmapi liṅgabhedo niyataḥ
na ca puṃvacanaṃ kiṃcitsamānasvabhāvamasti yenāyaṃ prakāro nivarteta
na caivaṃvidhopamāmantareṇa prastutavākyārthapoṣaḥ
evamananyagatikā bhinnaliṅgatā bhinnavacanatā vā sāhityasamayavidāmudvegaṃ notpādayati
ata evālaṃkāraucitīsaṃpadā guṇatvasiddhiḥ
evaṃ śamalajjayoḥ parākramavaiyātyayoḥ paribhavasuratayośca boddhavyamityāśayavān vyācaṣṭe—atreti
‘rataṃ, rahaḥ, śayanaṃ, mohanam’ iti suratavācināṃ sarveṣāmeva napuṃsakatā na duṣyatīti sahṛdayahṛdayānudvejakatvāditi heturguṇatvetvābhiprāyikaḥ
sa ca darśita eva
atheti
dharmārthakāmāstrivargaḥ
vahnividhmāpanacarmapuṭo bhastrā sā yathā vātena pūryate, vātaṃ ca muñcati, na tu kiṃcitpuruṣārthamāsādayati, tathā trivargaśūnye'pi bhastrāparyāyasya samānaliṅgasyābhāvena sahṛdayānāmanudvegālaṃkārasaṃpattyā guṇatvamupapannamityāha—atra prāgvadeveti
adoṣa ityupalakṣaṇam, guṇaśca bhavatītyapi boddhavyam
bhinnavacanasyaiva yathā—
‘prājyaprabhāvaḥ prabhavo dharmasyāstarajastamāḥ
muktātmā naḥ śivaṃ nemiranye'pi dadatāṃ jināḥ || 163
atra ‘nemiranye'pi’ iti vacanabhedadoṣe'pi ‘dadatām’ iti kriyāpadādervacanaśleṣamāhātmyādguṇatvam
na cedaṃ vācyamatrevādirna vidyata iti nopamātvam
ivasyāpinā samuccayārthena tulyadharmāṇāṃ tu ‘dharmasya prabhavaḥ’ ityādibhirvacanaśleṣairviṣayāpahārāt
yathā agrato dyotakalopa upamāyām—'komalāpāṭalau tanvi pallavaścādharaśca te
’ nanveṣo'pi śleṣaḥ kasmānna bhavati
ucyate—‘yatra dvayoḥ sadṛśayorabhidhānaṃ sa śleṣaḥ
yatra sadṛśātsadṛśapratipattistadupamānam, yatra dvayoḥ sādṛśyamabhidhīyate pratīyate vā sopamā’ iti prabandhenāgrato vakṣyāmaḥ
upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat—yadupamāyāmeva liṅgavacanabhedo na dūṣaṇamiti
tasya sarvālaṃkārasādhāraṇatvātkevalaṃ sādṛśyamalaṃkāra iti darśane upamāyāmudāhriyate
prājyeti
ārhatānāṃ nemināmā jinaviśeṣo'nye jinā ṛṣabhanāthaprabhṛtayaḥ prājyamucitaṃ tathābhūtaḥ prabhāvaḥ siddhirūpo yasya tādṛśo nemiḥ śivaṃ dadatāṃ dadātu
'dada dāne’ iti dhātvanusārāt
kasmai ityapekṣāyāṃ muktātmā ityatra naḥ
pakṣe vo yuṣmabhyaṃ śivaṃ dadatāṃ dadatviti
dharmasya prabhavamutpattinimittaṃ nemiḥ
prabhavaḥ prabhutā yathāvadanuśāsanena jināḥ
rajaśca tamaśca rajastamasī te aste kṣipte yena sa tathābhūto nemiḥ
astaṃ rajo yaiste'starajasasteṣu prakṛṣṭāstamapyarajastamāḥ
mukto nirāvaraṇa ātmā ātmaśabda ātmavacanaḥ svarūpavacana iti vā bahuvrīhistādṛśo nemiḥ
jināstu muktātmāna iti spaṣṭam
tadiha vacanabhedamantareṇa vacanaśleṣābhāvādbhinnavacanatvasyāvaśyakatvena doṣaḥ
śleṣalakṣaṇālaṃkāraghaṭanayā guṇatvam
nanu ca liṅgādibheda upamāyā dūṣaṇatvamuktam, iha tvalaṃkārāntara udāhriyate, tatkathaṃ pūrvāparasamañjasatvam
na cātropamā saṃbhavati, tatsāmagryasaṃbhavāt
upamānopameyasādhāraṇadharmevādiśabdāḥ kila taddhaṭakāḥ
tadatra tritayasaṃbaddhe tvapīvavadvāprabhṛtiṃśabdānupādānātkathamupameti śaṅkāmutthāpya nirasyati—na ceti
ivādayo hi śabdāḥ sādṛśyadyotakāḥ
tathā ca kvacitprasiddhasya prakṛte saṃbandhapratītistebhyo bhavati bimbapratibimbanyāyāśrayaṇāt
evaṃ ca na yugapattulyarūpasaṃbandhaḥ
apiśabdastu yugapattulyarūpasaṃbandhaṃ bodhayatīti vibhinnaviṣayatvam
nahīvādiśabdābhāve sādṛśyameva na pratīyate, luptopamāprapañjabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt
anyata eva pratītisiddherupāyāntaravaiyarthyāt
kimitīha nevādipadaṃ prayuktamiti praśno'vaśiṣyate tatredamuttaram—ivasyetyādi
nemiranye'pītyapiśabdena samuccayo'pyavasīyate
sa ca yugapadekasaṃbandhābhidhāne nirvahati
tenānekamuddiśya kiṃcidekasaṃbandhābhidhānaṃ samuccayābhidhāyino viṣayaḥ
ekamuddiśya prasiddhānyadharmavidhānaṃ tu yathevādiriti viṣayavirodhānna prayujyata iti
syādetat— ivavadvāyathādiśabdā yatparāstasyaivopamānatāpratītistathā cānenedaṃ tulyamiti sādhāraṇadharmavidhirūpā kathamupametyata uktam—tulyadharmāṇāṃ tviti
nātra vacanaśleṣatulyadharmāgamaḥ, api tu tathā ‘vyavasthitānāmeva śabdatantratā’ iti ‘dharmasya prabhavaḥ’ ityādibhirdvivacanaśleṣaistathāpi viṣayopahṛta iti
yadi cevādimantareṇa nopamāpratītistarhi prasiddhamupamodāharaṇaṃ bhajyetetyāha—yatheti
agrataścaturthaparicchede
atrāpyupamāmanaṅgīkurvato matamāśaṅkate—nanviti
ihāpi cakārābhyāṃ yugapatpallavādharayorekadharmavidhānasya tulyatvāditi deśyābhiprāyaḥ
uktayuktayā dūṣayati—ucyata iti
tarhi prakṛtodāharaṇe nāstyevopamā, kathaṃ vacanabhedasya guṇībhāva udāhriyata ityāha—yatreti
yadyapyabhidhīyamānaṃ nāsti sādṛśyam, tathāpi pratīyamānopamā vyavahriyatāmityarthaḥ
śabdamātrasāmyaṃ śleṣasaṃkīrṇamevetyupekṣitavān
nanu yatropamayā kāvyavyapadeśastatra pratīyamānamapi sādṛśyamūrīkriyate
yatra tvalaṃkārasvabhāvavyavasthāpitameva kāvyaṃ na tatrāpītyāha—upalakṣaṇamiti
pratipattivairūpyasyālaṃkārāntarasādhāraṇyādupamāto'nyatrāpi liṅgavacanabhedo dūṣaṇameva
tadyathā 'mukhaṃ padmam’ iti rūpake, ‘mukhaṃ padmaṃ vā’ iti saṃśaye, ‘na mukhaṃ padmameva’ ityapahnave
evamanye'pi
ata eva dve bhinnaliṅgavacane ityatra nopamāgrahaṇam

tatprapañcanamātraṃ tu punaranyairalaṃkārakāraiḥ kṛtamupamāyāḥ prabhūtaviṣayatayā prādhānyāccodāhṛtamatisphuṭaṃ bhavatīti saṃkṣepaḥ
yatropamānadharmāḥ syurnopameyena saṃmitāḥ
taddhīnopamamityāhustatprasiddhau na duṣyati || 121
yathā—
‘sa mārutākampiṃtapītavāsā biṃbhratsalīlaṃ śaśibhāsamabjam
yadupravīraḥ pragṛhītaśārṅgaḥ sendrāyudho megha ivābabhāse || 164 ||’
atra sendrāyudha iti kārmukamātrasyopādānaṃ vāsaḥśaṅkhyostvanupādānādūnopamatvam
tatrenduvidyutoratiprasiddhatvādadoṣatvam

‘sarvaṃ sarveṇa sārūpyaṃ nāsti bhāvasya kasyacit
yathopapatti kṛtibhirupamānaṃ prayujyate
akhaṇḍamaṇḍalaḥ kvenduḥ kva kāntānanamadyuti
yatkiṃcitkāntisāmyāttu śaśinaivopamīyate ||’
yatropamāneti

’ iti
na caivaṃ stanitādīnāmiti kathaṃ pratītiriti vācyam
pratīyamānasyāpi pratipattivairūpyasamādhāvānaupayikasthānākāṅkṣitatvenādarādityāha—sarvaṃ sarveṇeti
yathopapattiparyanto yāvatopamānaviśeṣaṇatvena prakṛtamupameyaviśeṣaṇapratibimbatā nīyate tadatikrameṇaikapratītyanurodhe kalpitenāpyupameyaviśeṣaṇenetyarthaḥ
anyathā candramukhādīnāṃ nopamā paryavasyetetyāha—akhaṇḍeti
amumeva prakāramadhikopameye yojayannāha—
krameṇānena kṛtibhireṣṭavyamadhikopamam
viśeṣastūpameyāṅgamanumānātpratīyate ||122
yathā—
‘sa pītavāsāḥ pragṛhītaśārṅgo manojñabhīmaṃ vapurāpa kṛṣṇaḥ
śatahradendrāyudhavānniśāyāṃ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ śaśineva meghaḥ || 165 ||’
atra śaśino grahaṇādadhikopamatve'pyupamānatvenāvivakṣitatvādguṇatvam
yadi vopamāne dharmoddhāṭanānumānāt ‘śaṅkhacakragadādharo viṣṇuḥ’ iti prasiddheḥ śārṅgamanumeyam
krameṇeti
yatropamāne'dhikaviśeṣaṇasaṃkṣepastadvākyamadhikopamamityucyate tatra jhaṭiti pratibimbabhūtopameyaviśeṣaṇapratisaṃdhānena doṣaḥ
tadeva tu kathamata uktam—viśeṣastviti
upameyāṃśe viśeṣaviśeṣaṇamupādānā(?)dupamānaviśeṣaṇātpratīyate
śatahradā vidyut
upamānatvenāvivakṣitatvādityāpātataḥ
upamānaviśeṣaṇānāṃ yāvatpratīti na grahaṇamiti prakāśayituṃ pāramārthikastvayaṃ siddhānta ityāha—yadi veti
upamānadharmasyādhikasyoddhāṭanamabhidhānaṃ tasyānu paścānmānaṃ jñānam
kathametadityāha—iti prasiddheriti
yadā tīvraprayatnena saṃyogāderagauravam
na cchandobhaṅga ityāhustadā doṣāya sūrayaḥ || 123
yathā—
‘jaha ṇhāuṃ oiṇṇe abbhantamulhāsiamaṃsuaddhantam
taha a ṇhāā si tumaṃ sacche golāṇaītūhe || 166 ||’
[yathā snātumavatīrṇe ārdrībhūtamullāsitamuṃśukārdhāntam
tathā ca snātā bhavasi tvaṃ svacche godānadītīrthe ||]
atra dvitīyaikādaśatrayoviṃśativarṇānāṃ saṃyogaparatvādgurutve'pi ṇhālhādisaṃyogasya tīvraprayatnoccāraṇena pūrvalaghutve na chandobhaṅga iti guṇatvam
yadeti
prayatanaṃ prayatnaḥ sthānakaraṇavyāpārastasya tīvratvamudrekastata eva hi piṇḍākṣarādīnāmakaṭhoratvamābhāsate
ādigrahaṇādivahikārau sānusvārau ca kevalau padānte vartamānau tattadbhāṣāviṣaye'vaseyau
kvacideva hi varṇe tathāvabhāsate na tu sarvatra
tadupalakṣaṇameva ‘raha vaṃjaṇasaṃjoe’ [ ‘rahau vyañjanasaṃyoge’ ] ityādikaṃ chandovicitau darśitam
jaheti
snātumavatīrṇe tvayi aṃśukārdhamudbhraṣṭaṃ sadabbhantamārdrobhūtaṃ yathā calatvaṃ sthitestathāvagamyate na tvantarjalaṃ jalakelisthānamavatīrṇa ityabhiprāyaśeṣaḥ
kathamanyathā godāvarīnadyāḥ svacchaṃ jalaṃ dṛśyate iti
tūhaṃ tīrtham
atra dvitīyaikādaśādisthāneṣu yadyapi saṃyogātpūrvabhāve gurutvaṃ vidyate-rtathāpi tīvraprayatnoccāraṇīyaśakārahakārādisaṃyogamahimnā nāvacchedaśravyatā kaluṣīkriyata iti
evamanyadapyudāhāryam
yathā—
‘dhabalāiṃ galetti dhavalehiṃ aṇañjaṇasāmalehi ṇisālaāe
ṇakhavattakusumāiṃ ṇahaalāo osarai ||’
ityādi nāmadhātubhāge svarāsaṃdhāne ca paṭhitivicchedo na bhavatītyuktaṃ sa tadullaṃṅghanamātreṇa samādhīyate śobhāṃ puṣyatīti
vākyamasthānavirati prāgbhagnayatisaṃjñayā
samuddiṣṭaṃ yadadhunā guṇatvaṃ tasya kalpyate || 124
yathā—
‘śobhāṃ puṣyatyayamabhinavaḥ sundarīṇāṃ prabodhaḥ kiṃcidbhāvālasamasaralaprekṣitaṃ kāminīnām
kāryākāryāṇyayamavikalānyāgamenaiva paśya- nvaśyāmurvīṃ vahati nṛpa ityasti cāyaṃ prayogaḥ || 167 ||’
atra pādatraye caturthasthāne yatau kartavyāyāṃ pañcamasthāne kṛtatvādaparatra ca pādasya madhyabhāge niviṣṭakevalasvaratvād yatibhraṃśe'pi svarasaṃdhikṛtatvādavibhinnanāmadhātuśarīratvācca na doṣatvam
yadāha—
‘svarasaṃdhyakṛte prāyo dhātubhede tadiṣyate
nāmabhede ca śeṣeṣu na doṣa iti sūrayaḥ
lupte padānte śeṣasya padatvaṃ niścitaṃ yathā
tathā saṃdhivikārāntaṃ padameveti varṇyate ||’
vākyamiti
.........................................
śobhāmiti
..........................................
kāryākāryeti ca nāmabhāgamullaṅghya vicchedaśravyatā ca parasya yaṇādeśena ‘kiṃcidbhāvā’ iti ‘nṛpa’ iti ca svarasaṃdhāne vicchedo'ta eva śravyatvamapi
tadetavdyācaṣṭe—atreti
‘mandākrāntā mabhanatayugaṃ gadvayaṃ vedadigbhiḥ’ iti caturthadaśamayoryatirāmnātā
pañcamasthāna iti
prathamatṛtīyayordvitīye tu ṣaṣṭhe yatikaraṇāditi boddhavyam
nanu padacchede svarasaṃdhānapaṭhitivirāmaḥ sollekho lakṣyate, na tu catuṣpāde tathāstīti kathaṃ śravyatvamata āha—lupta iti
saṃdhau vikāro yatvayalopādikaṃ kāryaṃ, tathā ca padānte sati padaccheda evāyamikāro'vatiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ
aśarīraṃ kriyāhīnaṃ kriyāpekṣā na yatra tu
yatrāstyāderapekṣā vā na doṣastatra tadyathā || 125
yathā—
‘kiyanmātraṃ jalaṃ vipra jānudaghnaṃ narādhipa
tathāpīyamavasthā te nahi sarve bhavādṛśāḥ || 168 ||’
atra triṣu pādeṣu padāni kriyāpadaṃ nāpekṣante
sāpekṣaṃ cāsamarthaṃ bhavati
caturthe tu nahītyādibhiḥ santītyapekṣate na caitāvatāmīṣāmasāmarthyaṃ bhavati
yadāha—‘yatrānyat kriyāpadaṃ nāsti, tatrāsti bhavatīti padaṃ prathamapuruṣe prayujyate’ iti
aśarīramiti
pradhānāvimarśe hi dūṣaṇamityuktaṃ tadupāttānāmeva padārthānāṃ pradhānagarbhīkaraṇe tatpratibandhe'vaśyavidheyamanyaṃ prati guṇībhāve vā samādhīyate
ata eva viśeṣādguṇatvam
tathā hi—‘kiyanmātraṃ’ ‘jānudaghnam’ ityanayoḥ parimitam
kriyā pradhānagarbhabhūtā
‘nahi sarve bhavādṛśāḥ’ ityatra tu sattākriyāyāḥ sakalapadārthāvyabhicārāt ‘apekṣyate’ iti siddhiḥ
tadidamācāryamatenāha—yatrānyaditi
bhavantī vartamānā
tadetadvākyaṃ kriyāpradhānamiti dadarśa ‘sa pradhānaṃ viśeṣyamātraṃ tu vākyārthe’ iti paramārthaḥ
tena ‘rādhā rahaḥ sākṣiṇām’ ityādāvāvaśyakavidheyasākṣibhāvādiguṇatayā rādhāsaṃbandhādīnāṃ vaivakṣikaprādhānyānāmapi pradhānatvāvimarśo na doṣa ityuktaṃ bhavati
śliṣṭamaspṛṣṭaśaithilyaṃ śithilaṃ tadviparyayaḥ
gauḍīyairiṣyate tattu bandhaprāśastyagauravāt || 126
yathā—
‘līlāvilolalalanā lalitālakalālasāḥ
viluptamālatīmālā jalakālānilā vavuḥ || 169 ||’
atra śaithilyadoṣe'pi bandhaprāśastyena gauḍairādṛtatvādguṇatvam
śliṣṭamiti
pāruṣyaśaithilyābhyāṃ vinā kṛtaṃ śliṣṭamityuktaṃ tasya viparyayo viparītaṃ vākyaṃ śithilaṃ bhavati
paruṣamalpaprāṇākṣarottaraṃ vetyarthaḥ
evaṃvidhamapi caitadanuprāsasauṣṭhavātpadānāmekatāpratibhāse samādhīyata udbhaṭānuprāsatayā ca kāntiprādhānye gauḍīyarītiprādhānyena guṇatvamāsādayati tadidamuktam—bandhaprāśastyagauravāditi
gauḍīyairgauḍīyarītigocarahetuvākprakarṣaśālibhiḥ
līleti
atra dantyavarṇamayatvenālpaprāṇākṣarottaratāyāmapi padaikatāpratibhāsānuprāsayorudrekaḥ kāntiprakarṣo'vaseyaḥ
na doṣaḥ kvāpi vaiṣamye'pyarthālaṃkārakāraṇāt
paurastyairādṛtatvācca śabdāḍambarato'pi vā || 127
yathā—
‘candanapraṇayodgandhirmando malayamārutaḥ
spardhate ruddhamaddhairyo vararāmānanānilaiḥ || 170 ||’
atra satyapi vaiṣamyadoṣe śabdālaṃkāraguṇādarthālaṃkāraguṇātpaurastyairādṛtatvācca guṇatvam
na doṣa iti
arthālaṃkārakāraṇādarthālaṃkārarūpam
yatra hiśabdasyārtho'nyathānyathārūpaṃ bhajate tatrāvaśyaṃ tadanuyāyinā padasaṃdarbheṇa bhinnarūpeṇa bhāvyam
evamapi chāyāvairūpyaṃ vairasyamevāvahatītyāśaṅkya ‘śabdāḍambara’ ityuktam
āḍambara udbhaṭatā
‘tasyāpyekarītyanirvāho dūṣaṇamityatra ‘paurastyaiḥ’ ityuktam
śarāvatyāḥ prāgdeśabhavāḥ paurastyāstadīyahevākaprācuryabhāja eva hi khaṇḍarītayaḥ
candaneti
atra yadyapi malayānila eka eva vākyārthastathāpi candanapraṇayena pravṛddhasaurabhe manda ityābhyāṃ śṛṅgārāṅgatāpratītāvunmiśraḥ saṃdarbhaḥ
malayamāruta iti komalaḥ, vararāmāmukhānilairityapi tathā, tatrāpyārabhaṭīprakāśane spardhata iti sphuṭam
evaṃ rūddhamaddhairya iti
tadevaṃ samatāviparyāse'pi viśeṣaṇānāmarthānāṃ bhinnabhinnarasānupraveśe pṛthagarthālaṃkāraḥ prakāśante
asti cātra śabdāḍambaravaśādeva chāyārūpāpratibhāsaḥ
lāṭīyā ca rītiḥ
kaṭhoramapi badhnanti dīptamityapare punaḥ
teṣāṃ matena tasyāpi dūṣaṇaṃ naiva vidyate || 128
yathā—
‘nyakṣeṇa pakṣaḥ kṣapitaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ kṣaṇādayam
atra kaṭhoratve'pi dīptatvādguṇatvam ||’
kaṭhoramiti
sukumāratāviparyāsaḥ kaṭhoraḥ saṃdarbhaḥ prasphuṭataravarṇāpradhānamiti yāvat
so'yaṃ dīptarasānupraveśādaucityena guṇatvaṃ bhajata iti vyaktam
apare paurastyāḥ
nyakṣeṇa sāmastyena
avidvadaṅganābālaprasiddhārthaṃ prasādavat
viparyayo'syāprasannaṃ citrādau tanna duṣyati || 129
yathā—
‘yāśritā pāvanatayā yātanācchidanīcayā
yācanīyā dhiyā māyāyāmāyāsaṃ stutā śriyā || 171 ||’
atrāprasādadoṣe'pi citratvādguṇatvam
avidvaditi
viparyayaḥ pratyanīkabhūtaṃ vākyam
ādigrahaṇādyamakaśleṣaprahelikāprakaraṇāni
yā devī pavitratvenāśritā
anīcayā tuṅgyā budhdyā māyāyāmasya avidyāvistārasyāyāsaṃ glāniṃ vicchedaṃ yācanīyā prārthanīyā
yato yātanaṃ narakā-nubhavanīyaṃ duḥkhaṃ chinatti
śriyāpi stuteti
aṣṭadalakamalabandho'yam
tadiha tathā varā(?)saṃniveśasya camatkārakāritvena prasādo'pi sahṛdayaślāghāviṣayo guṇatāmadhyāsta iti
adhyāhārādigamyārthaṃ neyārthaṃ prāgudāhṛtam
sa gamyate prasiddhaścenna taddoṣavadiṣyate || 130
yathā—
‘māṃ bhavantamanalaḥ pavano vā vāraṇo madakalaḥ paraśurvā
vāhinījalabharaḥ kuliśaṃ vā svasti te'stu latayā saha vṛkṣa || 172 ||’
atra dahatvityādīnāmadhyāhāryatayā neyatve'pyatiprasidhdyā pratīyamānatvādguṇatvam
adhyāhāreti
asaṃpūrṇaṃ vākyaṃ neyārthamityuktaṃ tasyaivaṃrūpatā jhaṭiti śrutārthāpattiprādurbhāvaparihnavakasaṃdhānātsamādhīyate
tathā hi—‘mā bhavantamanalaḥ’ ityādau vṛkṣasamabhivyāhāreṇa dahanādīnāṃ yogyatayā śīghrameva dhākṣīdityādikriyānvayo'vasīyate
svastivacanena cāmaṅgalaprastāvanirāsāttathābhūtakriyānupādānaṃ vakrakṣamatayā guṇa iti
asabhyāryaṃ mataṃ grāmyaṃ tadgrāmyottkyaiva duṣyati
vidagdhoktau tu tasyāhurguṇavattvaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ || 131
yathā—
‘kāmaṃ kandarpacāṇḍālo mayi vāmākṣi nirdayaḥ
tvayi nirmatsaro diṣṭyā so'yamasmāsvanugrahaḥ || 173 ||’
atra grāmyatve'pi grāmyārthasya vidagdhoktyā tiraskṛtatvādguṇatvam
asabhyārthamiti
rasasyādīptiḥ kāntiviparyayo vacanāparādhena dūṣaṇatāmadhyāste, sa samādhīyate'tra grāmyoktiparihāreṇaiva
ata evoktisamarpitacchāyāviśeṣayoge guṇatvalābhaḥ
sahṛdayasabhāyāṃ na sādhurasabhyaḥ
vaidagdhyavidhuraṃ grāmyam
ojaḥ samāsabhūyastvaṃ taddīptārtheṣu vadhyate
viparyayo'syāḥ samastaṃ taddīptaṃ cenna doṣabhāk || 132
yathā—
‘yo yaḥ śastraṃ bibharti svabhujagurumadaḥ pāṇḍavīnāṃ camūnāṃ yo yaḥ pāñcālagotre śiśuradhikavayā garbhaśayyāṃ gato vā
yo yastatkarmasākṣī carati mayi raṇe yaśca yaśca pratīpaḥ krodhāndhastasya tasya svayamiha jagatāmantakasyāntako'ham || 174 ||’
atrāsamastatve'pi prauḍhabandhatvādguṇatvam
oja iti
dīptarasānupraviṣṭārthapratipādakasaṃdarbhaucityena samāsabhūyastvamojaḥ
asya viparyayo dīpterapratyūhādeva samādhīyate
tadidamuktam—‘dīptārthaṃ badhyate yatra taddīptaṃ cenna duṣyati’ iti
sugamamudāharaṇam
vyūḍhaḥprauḍhaḥ
samastamasamastaṃ vā na nirvahati yadvacaḥ
tadanirvyūḍhamasyāpi na doṣaḥ kvāpi tadyathā || 133
yathā—
‘prasīda caṇḍi tyaja manyumañjasā janastavāyaṃ purataḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
kimarthamutkampitapīvarastana- dvayaṃ tvayā luptavilāsamāsyate || 175 ||’
atrāsamastarītyanirvāhādanirvyūḍhatve'pi rasāntaraparigraheṇa rītyantaraparigrahādguṇatvam
samastamiti
upakrāntarīteranirvāhe madhurarasaparyantā pratītiḥ skhalatīti dūṣaṇatābījamuktam
tathābhūtarasānuguṇavyabhicāryanupraveśavyañjanaucityādupakramanirvāhaḥ sarvasvāyamāno guṇatāmāsādayati
tathā hi—prasīdetyādau praṇayakelikupitakāminīprasādanāyāṃ śṛṅgāravirodhisamāsavyatikareṇa rīterapyapakrame roṣalakṣaṇabhāvānubhāvabhūḥ stanakampavarṇanāyāṃ samāso'nupraviṣṭa iti vyaktaḥ pūrvarīteranirvāhaḥ
rasāntaraṃ prakṛtavijātīyarasasaṃbaddho vyabhicārī bhāvaḥ
analaṃkāramityāhuralaṃkārojjhitaṃ vacaḥ
pūrvottarānusaṃdhāne tasya sādhutvamiṣyate || 134
yathā—
‘niśamya tāḥ śeṣagavīrabhidhātumadhokṣajaḥ
śiṣyāya bṛhatāṃ patyuḥ prastāvamadiśaddṛśā || 176 ||’
asyānalaṃkāratve'pi pūrvāparānusaṃdhānaprayojanabhūtatvādguṇatvam
analaṃkāramiti
anutkṛṣṭāpraviṣṭaviśeṣaṇavadvākyaṃ niralaṃkāraḥ pūrvottaravākyasaṃgatikaraṇaprayojanakatayā na doṣaḥ
kathaṃ tathābhūtasya kāvyatvamityapi na vācyam
anugatena vakrībhāvena tatsamarthanāt
vyaktamudāharaṇam
sūtrakāra eva vākyārthadoṣaguṇībhāvavivecanaṃ saṃgamayati—
vākyāśrayāṇāṃ doṣāṇāṃ guṇībhāvo'yamīritaḥ
atha vākyārthadoṣāṇāmadoṣaḥ kathyate'dhunā || 135
samudāyārthaśūnyaṃ yattadapārthaṃ pracakṣate
tanmattonmattabālānāmukteranyatra duṣyati || 136
yathā—
‘kvākāryaṃ śaśalakṣmaṇaḥ kva ca kulaṃ bhūyo'pi dṛśyeta sā doṣāṇāmupaśāntaye śrutamaho kope'pi kāntaṃ mukham
kiṃ vakṣyantyapakalmaṣāḥ kṛtadhiyo rekhaiva sānyādṛśī cetaḥ svāsthyamupehi kaḥ khalu yuvā dhanyo'dharaṃ dhāsyati || 177
atra samudāyārthaśūnyatvenāpārthasyāpyunmattavacanatvādguṇatvam
vākyāśrayāṇāmiti
sattādivacanānyanukriyamāṇāni camatkāramarpayanti
ata eva chāyālaṃkāraprādurbhāvādguṇaḥ
anityadoṣatayā cānukaraṇādanyadapi guṇībhavanabījamunneyamityudāharaṇena vyañjayannāha—kvākṛtyamiti
atra śrutiśālino nāyakasya vāsanāparipākavaśādvipralambhāveśe'pi prathamaṃ prādurbhāvaḥ—‘kvākṛtyaṃ śaśalakṣmaṇaḥ kva nu kulam’ iti
tadevaṃ śāntarasānuyāyinamanantarameva bādhitvā cittānurañjakaprakṛtarasāvyabhicāriṇā autsukyasya prādurbhāvaḥ—‘bhūyo'pi dṛśyeta sā’ iti
evaṃ ‘doṣāṇāmupaśāntaye śrutam’ ityādyaucityādīnāṃ pūrvapūrvaprādurbhūtānāmuttarottarabhāvibhiścintāprabhṛtibhirapavāde prakṛtavāsanā prauḍhiravaseyā
unmattavacanatvāditi
rasāviṣṭacetasastadutkalikāprāyāṇāṃ bhāvānāmavyavasthayā kīrtanamunmādaḥ
yadaprayojanaṃ yacca gatārthaṃ vyarthameva yat
tasyāpi kvāpi nirdoṣaḥ prayogo dṛśyate yathā || 137
yathā—
‘gītā viduravākyāni dharmāḥ śāntanaveritāḥ
na śrutā bhārate yena tasya janma nirarthakam || 178 ||’
atra gītāviduravākyādīnāṃ kathāyāmaprayojakatve'pītihāsavyājena caturvargapratipādanasyārambha eva pratijñānādguṇatvam
tadidamaprayojanam
yadprayojanamiti
prabandhārthapoṣānādhāyakavākyamaprayojanam
arthaṃlābhapratipādakatayā kṛtakaraṃ vyartham
evakāro bhinnakramastacchabdānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
dṛśyata ityanena tatra tatra prakṛtasaṃgatau satyāṃ doṣābhāvo'vaseya iti darśitam
yadyapi bhagavadgītāyāṃ mokṣādhikāriṇāmastyeva prakṛtaśāntarasaparipoṣakatvam, tathāpi tadantargatānāṃ bhūyasāmāhatya nāsti
bhīṣmaviduravākyānāṃ tu dharmādhikāre prakṛtānāṃ vyakta eva niṣprayojanaprastāvaḥ
so'yaṃ yathā samādhīyate tadvivṛṇoti—atreti
itihāsarūpe prabandhe satyapi śāntasya vākyārthābhāvena bahūnāmitihāsānāṃ trivargādhikāritvāccaturvargapratipādanameva maharṣerabhimatam, dharmāditritayasya ca prāsaṅgikatayā na pūrvavadasyārthaikatāvirodhaḥ
tadidamuktam—vyājeneti
evaṃ ca vyutpādayitavyaviṣayajijñāsopādāne dharmārthapravṛttaye vākyamidaṃ saphalatāmāsādayadguṇa eva bhavati
evaṃ gatārthamapi yathā—
‘hṛtkaṇṭhavaktraśrotreṣu kasya nāvasthitaṃ tava
śrīkhaṇḍahārakarpūradantapatraprabhaṃ yaśaḥ || 179 ||’
atraikenaivopamānena śauklyapratītau śeṣopamānapādānāṃ vyarthatve'pi yaśasaḥ smaryamāṇatvagīyamānatvastūyamānatvaśrūyamāṇatvairhṛdayādiṣu śrīkhaṇḍādivadanasthānasya pratīyamānatvādguṇatvam
evaṃ gatārthamapīti
śrīkhaṇḍenaivopamāne yaśasaḥ śuddhatvamavagataṃ śleṣopamānapadāni kevalakṛtakarāṇīti vyarthatvaprasaṅge smaraṇādiviśeṣavivakṣayā tiraskriyate, yathāsaṃkhyādibhaṅgisaubhāgyena ca guṇībhāva iti
aviśeṣeṇa pūrvoktaṃ yadi bhūyo'pi kīrtyate
tadekārthaṃ rasākṣiptacetasāṃ tanna duṣyati || 138
yathā—
‘asāraṃ saṃsāraṃ parimuṣitaratnaṃ tribhuvanaṃ nirālokaṃ lokaṃ maraṇaśaraṇaṃ bāndhavajanam
adarpaṃ kandarpaṃ jananayananirmāṇamaphalaṃ jagajjīrṇāraṇyaṃ kathamasi vidhātuṃ vyavasitaḥ || 180 ||’
'asāraṃ saṃsāram’ ityuktvā ‘paribhuṣitaratnaṃ tribhuvanaṃ nirālokaṃ lokam’ ‘jagajjīrṇāraṇyam’ iti yaduktam, tasya viśeṣānabhidhāyakatve'pi rasākṣiptena vaktrābhihitatvādguṇatvam
aviśeṣeṇeti
pūrvoktapūrvoktābhinnatātparyakamaviśeṣeṇa tātparyāvṛttiprayojanamantareṇa tanmayībhavanaṃ cetasa ākṣepaḥ
‘asāraṃ saṃsāram’ ityanena sthāvarajaṅgamaprapañcasya niḥsāratāṃ pratipādya ‘jātau jātau yadutkṛṣṭaṃ taddhi ratnaṃ pracakṣate’ iti
'paribhuṣitaratnam’ ityatrāpi tāvāneva tātparyārthaḥ
evaṃ ‘nirālokaṃ lokaṃ', ‘jagajjīrṇāraṇyam’ ityatrāpi draṣṭavyam
sugamamanyat
saṃśayāyaiva saṃdigdhaṃ yadi jātu prayujyate
syādalaṃkāra evāsau na doṣastatra tadyathā || 139
‘kutto lambhai panthia sattharaaṃ ettha gāmaṇigharammi
uṇṇaapaohare pekkhiūṇa jai vasasi tā vasasu || 181 ||’
[kuto labhyate pathika srastarakamatra grāmaṇīgṛhe
unnatapayodharānprekṣya yadi vasasi tadā vasa ||]
atra kenāpi pathikayūnā prāvṛḍārambhe grāmaṇīvadhūḥ pīnonnatastanī sattharaamiti srastarakavyājena śastarataṃ yācitā
taṃ pratyācakṣāṇeva yathoktaṃ brūte—‘kuto'tra grāmaṇīgṛhe srastarakaḥ, kuto vā śastaṃ ratam
unnatau payodharau mama hṛdaye nabhasi vā payodharāndṛṣṭvā yadi vasasi tadā vasa’ iti tadetasya gopanāya vdyarthaireva padaiḥ prayuktamiti saṃdigdhasyāpyasya guṇatvam
saṃśayāyaiveti
miśro viruddhārthavākyaṃ saṃśayāpādanena duṣyatītyuktam
yadā tu saṃdeha eva tātparyamavadhāryate tadā sa eva rañjakatayālaṃkāratāmārohatīti katthanaṃ guṇībhāva iti, tadidaṃbhuktam—syādalaṃkāra eveti
kuto labhyate pathika srastaraḥ śastarataṃ cātra grāmaṇīgṛhe
grāmaṇīrgrāmapradhānam
unnatapayodharānmedhān payodharau stanau vā dṛṣṭvā yadi vasasi tadvasa
atra praṣṭuḥ saṃdehajanakatvena nibhṛtānurāgaprakāśanaṃ pathikaviṣaye pratīyate
dvyarthairiti
taduktam—‘vdyarthaiḥ padaiḥ piśunayecca rahasyavastu’ iti
vākye prabandhe cārthānāṃ paurvāparyaviparyayaḥ
doṣaḥ sopakramo nāma citrahetau ca duṣyati || 140
yathā—
‘paścātparyasya kiraṇānudīrṇaṃ candramaṇḍalam
prāgeva hariṇākṣīṇāmudīrṇo rāgasāgaraḥ || 182 ||’
atra paurvāparyaviparyayādapakramadoṣasya candrodayaṃ prati rāgoddīpanaprakarṣaprakāśanatvādadoṣaḥ
vākya iti
arthānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhūtānāṃ teṣāmeva paurvāparyaniyamādya iti pūrvārdhe'dhyāhāryam
citrahetāviti prasiddharūpaviparyāsena hetuvacanadvārā prakṛtavākyārthaparipoṣādhānaṃ citrahetuḥ
paryasya vistārya candrodayarāgoddīpanayoḥ satyapi hetuhetumadbhāvena paurvāparye prathamaṃ rāgasāgaraḥ paścāccandramaṇḍalamudīrṇamiti viparyāsapratītisamasamayamuddīpanavibhāvanānusaṃdhānād himāṃśoratiśīghrakāritāprakāśanāt prakṛtaśṛṅgāraraso dīpyate
evaṃ kulakādirūpaṃ prabandhāntargatavākyeṣvapi guṇatvamavaseyam
yasminrīteranirvāhaḥ khinnaṃ tadabhidhīyate
na doṣastasya tu kvāpi yatra cchāyā na hīyate || 141
yathā—
‘abhinavavadhūroṣasvāduḥ karīṣatanūnapā- dasaralajanāśleṣakrūrastuṣārasamīraṇaḥ
galitavibhavasyājñevādya dyutirmasṛṇā rave- rvirahivanitāvakraklaibyaṃ bibharti niśākaraḥ || 183 ||’
atropamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ samasyanta iti prakrāntarīteranirvāhe'pi samāsavyākhyāparatvenaiva ivaśabdataddhitayoḥ prayoge pratyuta cchāyotkarṣa iti guṇatvam
yasminniti
vākyārthasya dharmiṇo yadalaṃkārabhaṅgyā prakramasthayā nirvahaṇābhāvaḥ khedaḥ
sa tu pūrvālaṃkāraviśrāntau pratīteraskhalane na doṣaḥ
guṇatvaṃ ca tasya bhaṅgyantarairapi prakṛtālaṃkāre dhvananāt
tathā hi—‘abhinavavadhūroṣasvādu asaralajanāśleṣa iva krūraḥ’ ityupamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ samasyanta iti samāsadvayenopamāmupakramya malinavibhavasyājñeveti samāsatyāgādvirahivanitāvakraklaibyaṃ bibhartīti cāntaradharmāropeṇa copamātyāgātsatyapi rīteranirvāhe upamāyāmeva paryavasānaṃ samādhānahetuḥ
guṇatvahetumāha—vyākhyāparatveneti
galitavibhāvājñāmasṛṇeti samāse kartavye yo'yamivaśabdaprayogaḥ sa ivārthe pūrvau samāsau bodhayati
klaibyaṃ bibhartīti sāmānyālaṃkāre kathamanyadharmamanyo vahatīti pratisaṃdhānasamasamayaṃ vakraklaibyamasyetyantargatopamāprakaṭībhāve upamāsamāsapadayorapi sā pratīyate iti seyaṃ kavicāturīpratīyamānacchāyāmeva puṣṇāti
tadidamuktam—pratyuteti
lokātīta ivārthe yaḥ so'timātra iheṣyate
vārtādau tena tuṣyanti vidagdhā netare janāḥ || 142
tacca vārtābhidhāneṣu varṇanāsvapi vidyate
kāntaṃ jagati tatkāntaṃ laukikārthānuyāyi yat || 143
laukikārthamatikramya prasthānaṃ yatpravartate
tadatyuktiriti proktaṃ gauḍānāṃ manaso mude || 144
yathā—
‘deva dhiṣṇyabhivārādhyamadya prabhṛti no gṛham
yuṣmatpādarajaḥpātadhautaniḥśeṣakalmaṣam || 184 ||’
atrātimātrākhye doṣe'pi vārtābhidhāne'bhidheyasya kāntiguṇasyā- bhyanujñānādguṇatvam
yathā vā—
‘alpaṃ nirmitamākāśamanālocyaiva vedhasā
idamevaṃvidhaṃ bhāvi bhavatyāḥ stanajṛmbhaṇam || 185 ||’
atrātimātratve'pi varṇanārthatvādguṇatvam
athānatimātraṃ kīdṛk
ucyate—
vārte tāvadyathā—
‘gṛhāṇi nāma tānyeva taporāśirbhavādṛśaḥ
saṃbhāvayanti yānyevaṃ pāvanaiḥ pādapāṃsubhiḥ || 186 ||’
atha varṇanāyāṃ yathā—
‘anayoranavadyāṅgi stanayorjṛmbhamāṇayoḥ
avakāśo na paryāptastava bāhulatāntare || 187 ||’
lokāṃtīta iti
‘anāmaye priyālāpe vārtaṃ vārtā ca kīrtyate
varṇanāsvapi’ ityādipadavivaraṇaṃ dṛśyate
kāntamityabhisaṃbandhaḥ
laukikārthānuyāyi yajjagati loke kāntamucyate tathābhūtamatikramya yatkavīnāṃ prasthānaṃ pravartate tadapi gauḍānāṃ manaso mude proktam
śabdāḍambarātmakagauḍarītipriyāṇāṃ vidagdhakāmājñāpakaṃ sadguṇī bhavatīti ślokārthaḥ
dhiṣṇyaṃ gṛham
nanu priyālāpavarṇanayorevaṃvidhā eva loke kāvye ca vacanasaṃdarbhā iti nāstyatimātratānatimātratayorbheda iti pṛcchati—atheti
sugabhamanyat
parūṣaṃ niṣṭhurārthaṃ tu yadatīva vigarhitam
viruddhalakṣaṇādyāsu taduktiṣu na duṣyati || 145
yathā—
‘hālāhalaṃ viṣaṃ bhuṅkṣva sakhi mā tatra viśvasīḥ
yadvā na dahyase kāṣṭhaiḥ svalpaistvamiti me matiḥ || 188 ||’
atra pāruṣye'pi viruddhalakṣaṇayārthāntarasya lakṣitatvādguṇatvam
paruṣamiti
viruddhalakṣaṇā laukikī tasyā hi jhaṭityabhidhānāvinābhāvādaparuṣārthapratīterabhidhānataḥ pāruṣyaṃ na doṣo lakṣaṇāparigraheṇa ca guṇatvam
tadāhuḥ—‘abhidheyāvinābhāvapratītirlakṣaṇeti yā
saiṣā kāvye dagdhavakrā jīvitaṃ vṛttiriṣyate
’ iti
aprastutarasaṃ prāhurvirasaṃ vastu sūrayaḥ
aprādhānye tadeṣṭavyaṃ śiṣṭaiḥ syādrasavastunoḥ || 146
yathā—
‘kṣipto hastāvalagna: prasabhamabhihato'pyādadānoṃ'śukāntaṃ gṛhṇankeśeṣvapāstaścaraṇanipatito nekṣitaḥ saṃbhrameṇa
āliṅganyo'vadhūtastripurayuvatibhiḥ sāśrunetrotpalābhiḥ kāmīvārdrāparādhaḥ sa dahatu duritaṃ śāṃbhavo vaḥ śarāgniḥ || 189 ||’
atra karuṇe śrṛṅgārasyāprakṛtatve'pi śaṃbhuprabhāvavarṇanāṅgabhūtatvena dvayo- rapyaprādhānyādavairasyena guṇatvam
aprastuteti
aprādhānya ityupalakṣaṇaṃ bādhyatve'pīti ca boddhavyam rasavastunoḥ parasparavirodhirasavyañjakayoḥ
yadvā mithovirodhirasarūpayoreva vastunaḥ
tadāha—‘bādhyānāmaṅgabhāvaṃ vā prāptānāmavimuktatā’ iti
hīnaṃ yatropamānaṃ syādupameyaṃ guṇādhikam
hīnopamaṃ tadasyāhuḥ kavayaḥ kvāpyaduṣṭatām || 147
yathā—
‘tataḥ kumudanāthena kāminīgaṇḍapāṇḍunā
netrānandena candreṇa māhendrī digalaṃkṛtā || 190 ||’
atropamānasya hīnatāyāmapi rāgātiśayahetutvādguṇatvam
hīnamiti
jātipramāṇābhyāmapakṛṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ candrāpekṣayā kāminīkapolasyāpakarṣe ātmanastulyatāmuddīpanasya pratipādyamānaḥ prakṛtaśṛṅgāraprakarṣamarpayiṣyatīti guṇatvam
evamadhikopame'pi
yatropamānamutkṛṣṭamupameyaṃ nikṛṣyate
jñeyaṃ tadadhikaupamyamasyāpi kvāpyadoṣatā || 148
yathā—
‘kāntyā candramasaṃ dhāmnā sūryaṃ dhairyeṇa cārṇavam
rājannanukaroṣi tvaṃ saubhāgyenāpi manmatham || 191 ||’
asyādhikaupamye'pi rājño lokapālāṃśatvena śiṣṭairādṛtatvādguṇatvam
'
upamānasya vaiṣamyādbhavedasadṛśopamam
tasyābhyanujñāmicchanti vyatirekopamādiṣu || 149
yathā—
‘prahitaḥ pradhanāya mādhavānahamākārayituṃ mahībhujā
na pareṣu mahaujasaśchalādapakurvanti malimlucā iva || 192 ||’
asyāsadṛśopamatve'pi vyatirekopapādakatvādguṇatvam
upamānasyeti
upamānena vaiṣamyamanvayena sādṛśyābhāvāt
vyatirekopamādītyādigrahaṇāvdyatirekadṛṣṭāntottkyādiparigrahaḥ
yasyopamānaṃ lokeṣu na prasiddhaṃ tadiṣyate
aprasiddhopamaṃ nāma tatkvacinnaiva duṣyati || 150
yathā—
‘udgarbhahūṇaramaṇīramaṇopamarda- bhugnonnatastananiveśanibhaṃ himāṃśoḥ
bimbaṃ kaṭhorabisakāṇḍakaḍāragaurai- rviṣṇoḥ padaṃ prathamamagrakarairvyanaktiḥ || 193 ||’
asthāṃ prasiddhopamatvena dūṣaṇatve'pi dvayorapi śrṛṅgāroddīpakatvasāmyādguṇatvam
yasyopamānamiti
lokaprasiddhameva kavibhirupamāne kāntaṃ bhavati tena yatra loke prasiddhaṃ tena sahopamāvarṇane saṃbhavadapyaprasiddhopamatvaṃ rasānupraveśena guṇī bhavati
udgarbhatvena stanāgraśyāmikā tayā lāñchanānukaraṇamabhilaṣitam
niralaṃkāramityāhuralaṃkārojjhitaṃ vacaḥ
arthaurjityeṣu tasyāpi kvacinnirdoṣatā matā || 151
yathā—
‘yācñāṃ dainyaparābhavapraṇayinīṃ nekṣvākavaḥ śikṣitāḥ sevāsaṃvalitaḥ kadā raghukule maulau nibaddho'ñjaliḥ
sarvaṃ tadvihitaṃ tathāpyudadhinā naivoparodhaḥ kṛtaḥ pāṇiḥ saṃprati me haṭhātkimaparaṃ spraṣṭuṃ dhanurvāñchati || 194 ||’
atra niralaṃkāratve'pi arthaurjityādguṇatvam
niralaṃkāramiti
dainyaparābhavapraṇayinīmityādyutkṛṣṭapuṣṭiviśeṣaṇayogādastiśabde'spaṣṭe vakratārthe tu nāsti vakratvaṃ cālaṃkāra iti
yadyapi vākyārtho niralaṃkāra iva bhāsate, tathāpi viśeṣato'laṃkārādhyavasāye'pi sāmānyena vakratā prakāśata eva
nahi laukikaśāstrīyavacanārthavaiparītyamiha pratīyate
tadidamuktamarthaurjityāditi
asti hi vayaṃ yācāmaha ityukte yācñā ca bhikṣākarānālakṣitā(?)ityuktau nāyakaprakarṣābhivyañjako viśeṣa ityāha—
asabhyārthaṃ yadaślīlaṃ tadarthāntaravāci vā
tasyeha dṛśyate bhūmnā prayogo nāpi duṣyati || 152
yathā—
‘adyāpi tatkanakakuṇḍalaghṛṣṭagaṇḍa- māsyaṃ smarāmi viparītaratābhiyoge
āndolanaśramajalasphuṭagharmabindu- muktāphalaprakaravicchuritaṃ priyāyāḥ || 195 ||’
atrāślīlārthe'pi kavibhiravigītatvādguṇatvam
asabhyārthamiti
kvacitprāthamika eva padārthasaṃsargo'ślīlaḥ
kvacittu na tasmiṃstathābhūte'pi saṃsargāntaramiti yadaślīlamarthāntaravāci vetyuktam
kavibhiravigītatvāditi
aviparītādviparītaṃ ratamutkṛṣyata iti śāstrakārairāmnānāttasya śṛṅgāroddīpanatayā kavibhirādṛtatvādityarthaḥ
deśo'drivanarāṣṭrādiḥ kālo rātriṃdivartavaḥ
nṛtyagītaprabhṛtayaḥ kalāḥ kāmārthasaṃśrayāḥ || 153
carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ pravṛttirlokasaṃjñitā
hetuvidyātmako nyāyaḥ saṃsmṛtiḥ śrutirāgamaḥ || 154
teṣu teṣvayathārūḍhaṃ yadi kiṃcitpravartate
kaveḥ pramādāddeśādivirodhītyetaducyate || 155
virodhaḥ sakaleṣveva kadācitkavikauśalāt
utkramya doṣagaṇanāṃ guṇavīthīṃ vigāhate || 156
tatra deśaviruddhasya guṇībhāvo yathā—
‘tasya rājñaḥ prabhāveṇa tadudyānāni jajñire
ārdrāṃśukapravālānāmāspadaṃ suraśākhinām || 196 ||’
atra deśaviruddhatve'pi tasya rājñaḥ prabhāveṇeti kāraṇopanyāsādguṇatvam
deśo'drīti
ādipadena dvīpādiparigrahaḥ
kāmārthasaṃśrayāḥ, arthasaṃśrayāḥ pravṛttayo'vasthāviśeṣāḥ
hetuvidyā ānvīkṣikī
ayathārūḍhaṃ aprasiddham
kālaviruddhasya yathā—
‘rājñāṃ vināśapiśunaścacāra kharamārutaḥ
cumbankadambakusumaiḥ saha saptacchadodgamān || 197 ||’
atra kālaviruddhatve'pi rājñāṃ vināśapiśuna ityaniṣṭasūcakotpāta rūpatvādguṇatvam
kālaviruddhasyeti
upaghāta utpātaḥ
lokaviruddhasya yathā—
‘aindavādarciṣaḥ kāmī śiśiraṃ havyavāhanam
abalāvirahakleśavihvalo gaṇayatyalam || 198 ||’
atra lokaviruddhatve'pi kāmibhistathā saṃvedyamānatvādguṇatvam
yuktiviruddhasya yathā—
‘sa saṃkocaścandrādiva kumudarāśeraśaraṇaḥ sa sūryātkokānāṃ viraha iva luptapratividhiḥ
guṇebhyaste khedapraśamanakarebhyo'pi yadayaṃ khalānāmudvegastadidamamṛtādeva maraṇam || 199 ||’
atra yuktiviruddhatve'pi chekottkyā saṃbhāvyamānopamayā tathāpratīterguṇatvam
sa saṃkoca iti
yadi candrādibhyaḥ kumudasaṃkocādayo bhaveyustadā bhavadguṇebhyaḥ khalānāmudvega upamīyeta na tu tathā saṃbhavati tenāyamalaukikatvādāścaryamarpayatīti vākyārthaparipoṣāttathopanyāso guṇa eveti
aucityaviruddhasya yathā—
‘tenātha nātha durudāharaṇātapena saumyāpi nāma paruṣatvamabhiprapannā
jajvāla tīkṣṇaviśadāḥ sahasodgirantī vāgarciṣastapanakāntaśileva sītā || 200 ||’
atra strītvādaucityavirodhe'pi tatsamayocitatvādguṇatvam
vacanaviruddhasya yathā—
‘paradārābhilāṣo me kathamāryasya yujyate
pibāmi taralaṃ tasyāḥ kadā nu radanacchadam || 201 ||’
atra vacanavirodhe'pi vaktustathāvidhāvasthatvādguṇatvam
vacanaviruddhasyeti
aṣṭamī kāmāvasthāṃ
dharmavirodhasya yathā—
‘pañcānāṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ patnī pāñcālakanyakā
satīnāmagraṇīstvāsīddaivo hi vidhirīdṛśaḥ || 202 ||’
atra dharmavirodhe'pi daivo vidhirityanenābhihitatvādadoṣaḥ
dharmavirodhasyeti
daivo hīti
siddhādeśācca satītvaṃ pāñcālakanyakāyāḥ
tiraskṛtamityata eva vā pañcadhā vivakṣita ityāgamaḥ
arthaśāstraviruddhasya yathā—
‘nītirāpadi yadgamyaḥ parastanmānino hriye
vidhurvidhuṃtudasyeva pūrṇastasyotsavāya saḥ || 203 ||’
atrāpanna: śatrurabhiyātavya iti nītiḥ, tacca mānino hriye bhavatītiviruddhamapi uddhatapuruṣabhāṣitatvānna duṣyatīti guṇatvam
arthaśāstreti
uddhatapuruṣabhāṣitatvāditi
pūrvapakṣatayā siddhāntopoddhātatvādityarthaḥ
kāmaśāstraviruddhasya yathā—
‘dolātipreraṇatrastavadhūjanamukhodgatam
kāmināṃ layavaiṣamyādgeyaṃ rāgamavardhayat || 204 ||’
atra trāsato layavaiṣamyeṇa geyasya rāgahetutve'pi kāminīmukhodgīrṇatvādrāgavivardhanatvena guṇatvam
kāmaśāstreti
layavaiṣamyāditi gītasya kalāprakathanāttasya ca viṣamalayasyārañjakatvātkathaṃ rāgavardhanamiti dūṣaṇaṃ dolāgatāgatatrastakāminīgītaprabhāvokteścamatkāritvāttirodhīyata iti guṇabhāvaṃ ca nīyate
bhāvāntarālavartī kāmo layaḥ
itthaṃ guṇāśca doṣāśca kāvye doṣaguṇāśca ye
ākhyātāste sphuṭaṃ saṃpratyalaṃkārānpracakṣmahe || 157
nanu guṇaireva śabdārthayoḥ sanāthīkaraṇe kimalaṃkāravivecanaprayāsenetyata āha—
yuvateriva rūpamaṅga kāvyaṃ svadate śuddhaguṇaṃ tadapyatīva
vihitapraṇayaṃ nirantarābhiḥ sadalaṃkāravikalpakalpanābhiḥ || 158
yuvateriti
aṅgetyākṣepasaṃbodhane
alaṃkārasāhityabuddhisaṃgatiḥ praṇayaḥ
vikalpo viśeṣastarhi kimuttarasiddhau pūrveṇeti nyāyena tyajyantāṃ guṇā ityata āha—
yadi bhavati vacaścyutaṃ guṇebhyo vapuriva yauvanabandhamaṅganāyāḥ
api janadayitāni durbhagatvaṃ niyatamalaṃkaraṇāni saṃśrayante || 159
yadi bhavatīti
vivṛtametat
te cālaṃkārā yathāsthānaṃ niveśyamānā eva sahṛdayarañjanakṣamā iti kavīñśikṣayati—
dīrghāpāṅgaṃ nayanayugalaṃ bhūṣayatyañjanaśrī- stuṅgābhogau prabhavati kucāvarcituṃ hārayaṣṭiḥ
madhye kṣāme vapuṣi labhate sthānakūrpāsalakṣmīḥ śroṇībimbe guruṇi raśanādāma śobhāṃ bibharti || 160
dīrgheti
tena śabdādiviṣayavibhāgenālaṃkāravivecanaṃ saprayojanameveti tātparyārthaḥ
śeṣamatirohitam
iti śrīmiśraratneśvaraviracite ratnadarpaṇanāmni sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇavivaraṇe guṇavivecano nāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ
iti śrīmahārājādhirājabhojadevena viracite sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇanāmni alaṃkāraśāstre guṇavivecanaṃ nāma prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ
dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ
kṣetramadhyaṃ viśālākṣī yasyādhivasati priyā
avimuktapratiṣṭhāya tasmai kāmadruhe namaḥ
ādyaṃ sphuratu vāgdevyāḥ kaṇṭhābharaṇakautukam
mayi prahvamanovṛttau tanvāne ratnadarpaṇam
evaṃ doṣaguṇeṣu nirṇīteṣvalaṃkārāḥ prāptāvasarāstatrālaṃkārasāmānyalakṣaṇamādyaparicchede tadvibhāgaṃ darśayanparicchedatrayaṃ saṃgamayati—
śabdārthobhayasaṃjñābhiralaṃkārānkavīśvarāḥ
bāhyānābhyantarānbāhyābhyantarāṃścānuśāsati || 1
śabdārthobhayasaṃjñābhiriti
itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā
madhyamapadalopīsamāsaḥ
tena śabdālaṃkārārthālaṃkārobhayālaṃkārasaṃjñābhirityarthaḥ
guṇaprastāve bāhyatvādikaṃ vivṛtaṃ śabdo'vacchedakatayā prathamapratisaṃdheyabhāvena ca śarīrasthānīyo bāhyastatastadāśrayā alaṃkārā api bāhyāḥ
artho vicchedyatayā paścādanusaṃdheyatayā cātmatulya ābhyantarastena tadāśrayā alaṃkārā apyābhyantarāḥ
etena bāhyābhyantarā vyākhyātāḥ
āśrayāśrayibhāvaśca yathātathoktameva
ubhayālaṃkāreṣu yogasya prāyikatvamāśritya kavīśvarāṇāmanuśāsanamuktam
etadvivecayiṣyate caturthārambhe
śabdālaṃkārasāmānyalakṣaṇamāha—
ye vyutpattyādinā śabdamalaṃkartumiha kṣamāḥ
śabdālaṃkārasaṃjñāste jñeyā jātyādayo budhaiḥ || 2
ye vyutpattīti
viśiṣṭā utpattirvyutpattirlopāgamavikārādiprapañcaḥ
ata eva hi saṃskṛtādijātayo vyavatiṣṭhante
ādigrahaṇādgurulaghusaṃniveśādayo gatyādyavacchedāstrayoviṃśatirupāttāḥ
bāhyakaṅkaṇādisāmyādiyaṃ saṃjñā pravṛttetyāha—śabdālaṃkārasaṃjñā iti
jātirgatī rītivṛtticchāyāmudroktiyuktayaḥ
bhaṇitirgumphanā śayyā paṭhitiryamakāni ca || 3
śleṣānuprāsacitrāṇi vākovākyaṃ prahelikā
gūḍhapraśnottarādhyeyaśravyaprekṣyābhinītayaḥ || 4
te ca prati viśeṣaṃ vakṣyante—
caturviṃśatirityuktāḥ śabdālaṃkārajātayaḥ
athāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ samyaksodāharaṇamucyate || 5
śabdālaṃkārajātayaḥ śabdālaṃkārasāmānyāni
svarūpasthitau rūpāntaragaveṣaṇamanucitam
ato jāteḥ prādhānyātprathamaṃ lakṣaṇamityāha—
tatra saṃskṛtamityādirbhāratī jātiriṣyate
sā tvaucityādibhirvācāmalaṃkārāya jāyate || 6
tatreti
saṃskṛtamiti bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ
bhāratīgrahaṇaṃ spaṣṭārtham
nanvavaśyaṃ śabdena saṃskṛtādyanyatamena bhavitavyam
tatko'tra kaveḥ śaktivyutpattyoraṃśo yenālaṃkāratā syādityata āha—seti
aucityākṛṣṭa evālaṃkāraḥ
asti ca saṃskṛtāderapi tathābhāva iti bhāvaḥ
yadyapyarthaucitī pūrvaṃ darśayitumucitā tathāpi prādhānyamāvedayituṃ pṛthaktaucitīmāha—
saṃskṛtenaiva ke'pyāhuḥ prākṛtenaiva kecana
sādhāraṇyādibhiḥ kecitkecana mlecchabhāṣayā || 7
viṣayaucitīmāha—
na mlecchitavyaṃ yajñādau strīṣu nāprākṛtaṃ vadet
saṃkīrṇaṃ nābhijāteṣu nāprabuddheṣu saṃskṛtam || 8
na mlecchitavyamityādi
mlecchanamapaśabdaḥ
prākṛtaṃ saṃskṛtabhavam
abhijātaḥ śuddhānvayaḥ
atha ke saṃskṛtādyucitavaktāra ityata āha—
devādyāḥ saṃskṛtaṃ prāhuḥ prākṛtaṃ kinnarādayaḥ
paiśācādyaṃ piśācādyā māgadhaṃ hīnajātayaḥ || 9
devādyā iti
ādigrahaṇena ṛṣibhūmipatiprabhṛtayaḥ
vācyaucitīṃ darśayati—
saṃskṛtenaiva ko'pyarthaḥ prākṛtenaiva vāparaḥ
śakyo racayituṃ kaścidapabhraṃśena jāyate || 10
saṃskṛtenaiveti
yathā hi—devatāstutyādau saṃskṛtaṃ pragalbhate na tathā prākṛtādi
yathā ca sūkṣmavastusvarūpoṭṭaṅkane prākṛtasya sauṣṭhavaṃ na tathā saṃskṛtāderityādi
paiśācyā śaurasenyānyo māgadhyānyo nibadhyate
dvitrābhiḥ ko'pi bhāṣābhiḥ sarvābhirapi kaścana || 11
paiśācyeti
dvitrābhiḥ ko'pi kāvyasamasyābhedasyārthaḥ
sarvābhiḥ kaścana prakaraṇāderarthaḥ
viṣayaucityameva kvacidviśeṣe kāntiprakarṣamarpayantīmāha—
nātyantaṃ saṃskṛtenaiva nātyantaṃ deśabhāṣayā
kathāṃ goṣṭhīṣu kathaya~lloke bahumato bhavet || 12
nātyantamiti
samānabuddhiśīlavayasāṃ vinodārthamāsanabandho goṣṭhī
deśaucitīmāha—
śṛṇvanti laṭabhaṃ lāṭāḥ prākṛtaṃ saṃskṛtadviṣaḥ
apabhraṃśena tuṣyanti svena nānyena gurjarāḥ || 13
śrṛṇvantīti
laṭabhaṃ manojñam
svena gurjarajātīyena
brahmanvijñāpayāmi tvāṃ svādhikārājihāsayā
gauḍastyajatu vā gāthāmanyā vāstu sarasvatī || 14
brahmanniti
bahmannityādinā nindārthānuvādena gauḍeṣu prākṛtānaucityaṃ rājaśekhareṇa vyañjitam
samayaucitīṃ darśayati—
ke'bhūvannāḍhyarājasya rājye prākṛtabhāṣiṇaḥ
kāle śrīsāhasāṅkasya ke na saṃskṛtavādinaḥ || 15
ke'bhūvanniti
āḍhyarājaḥ śālivāhanaḥ
sāhasāṅko vikramādityaḥ
granthakṛtpūrvajatayā śrīpadam
tā imāḥ parasparasaṃkīrṇāḥ ṣaḍeva saṃskṛtādibhāṣā bhavantīti sāmānyavibhāgametadviracanaprayojanaṃ copasaṃharati—
giraḥ śravyā divyāḥ prakṛtamadhurāḥ prākṛtadhurāḥ subhavyo'pabhraṃśaḥ sarasaracanaṃ bhūtavacanam
vidagdhānāmiṣṭe magadhamathurāvāsibhaṇiti- rnibaddhā yasteṣāṃ sa iha kavirājo vijayate || 16
gira iti
divyāḥ saṃskṛtāḥ
bhūtavacanaṃ paiśācam
mathurāvāsibhaṇitiḥ śaurasenī
teṣāmiti
tacca bhūtavacanaṃ sa cāpabhraṃśastāśca divyādyā iti ‘napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena’ ityekaśeṣaḥ
pākṣikaṃ bahuvacanam
pratibhārthaprāṇānāṃ jīvadvarṇanānipuṇo hi kaviḥ, sa eva hi sarvapathīnatādṛguktisiddhisaṃpannaḥ kavirājaḥ, ata eva vijayate sakalalokaśāstravacananirmātṛbhyaḥ prakarṣeṇa vartata iti
saṃskṛtādiṣu yathāyogaṃ śuddhādibhedena jātiḥ ṣoḍhā bhidyata ityāha—
śuddhā sādhāraṇī miśrā saṃkīrṇā nānyagāminī
apabhraṣṭeti sācāryairjātiḥ ṣoḍhā nigadyate || 17
śuddhā sādhāraṇīti
iha bhāṣārūpaviṣayabhedena bhinnāḥ saṃskārā yānadhikṛtya pāṇini-vararuci-prabhṛtīnāmanuśāsanāni vyavatiṣṭante
tadyatraika eva saṃskāraḥ pratyabhijñāyate sā śuddhā
saṃskārāntarāgrahaṇāt
yatra tu lakṣaṇasaṃbhedena nānāsaṃskārasaṃpātaḥ kṣīranīravatsā sādhāraṇī
rūpasādhāraṇyānnarasiṃhavadbhāṣābhedavya-vasthitabhāgadvayātmikā miśrā
rūpamiśraṇāttilataṇḍulanyāyena saṃkīrṇā
vijātīyavastvantaravyatireka eva loke saṃkīrṇavyavahārāt
yā punaḥ prakṛtibhāvenāpi bhāṣāntarasaṃparkaṃ na sahate sānanyagāminī
saṃskārasaṃbhedena vā prakṛtibhāvena vā nānyaṃ gacchati yato'paśabdarūpā sāpabhraṣṭā
tāsūttamapātraprayojyā saṃskṛtajātiḥ śuddhā yathā—
‘unnamitaikabhrūlatamānanamasyāḥ padāni racayantyāḥ
kaṇṭakitena prathayati mayyanurāgaṃ kapolena || 1 ||’
tāsūttameti
pātralakṣaṇamuttamādibhedaśca pañcame vakṣyate
unnamitaiketi
padāni prakṛtānaṅgalekhocitāni nirvyājapremagarbhāṇi
ata evāvāpodvāpapratisaṃdhānanimagnamānasāyāścintānubhāvarūpaṃ bhrūlatāvirecitamivāsīt
hastatalanihitaikakapolāyāstādṛkpulakitaikakapoladarśanādatimānātmā śṛṅgāraḥ suprabuddha iva tatkālaṃ nāyakasyāpīti mitho'nubandhalakṣaṇāpūrvānurāgakakṣāmadhirūḍhā ratireva kāvyasarvasvāyate
atra ca kasyacitpadasya bhāṣāntarasādhāraṇye'pi bhūyasāmudāharaṇatvam
evamanyatrāpi
madhyamapātraprayojyā prākṛtajātiḥ śuddhā yathā—
‘tujjha ṇa āṇe hiaaṃ mama uṇa maaṇo diā a rattiṃ a
ṇikkiva tavei valiaṃ tuha juttamanorahāiṃ aṅgāiṃ || 2 ||’
tava na jāne hṛdayaṃ mama punarmadano divā ca rātriṃ ca
niṣkṛpa tapati balavattvayi yuktamanorathānyaṅgāni ||]
tujjheti
valiaṃ balavatkṛtamabhimukham
hīnapātraprayojyā māgadhikā yathā—
‘śada māṇaśamaṃśabhālake kumbhaśahaśśa vaśāhi śaṃcide
aṇiśaṃ ca piāmi śoṇide valiśaśade śamale huvīadi || 3 ||’
śataṃ mānuṣamāṃsabhārakāḥ kumbhasahasraṃ vasābhiḥ saṃcitam
aniśaṃ ca pibāmi śoṇitaṃ varṣaśataṃ samaro bhaviṣyati ||]
śada māṇuśeti
śataṃ mānuṣamāṃsabhāraḥ kumbhasahasraṃ vasābhiḥ saṃcitam
aniśaṃ ca pibāmi śoṇitaṃ varṣaśataṃ samaro bhaviṣyati
’ atra māṃsādilābhahetutayā samarāśaṃsanaṃ bībhatsamunmudrayaddhīnapātratāṃ draḍhayati
nātyuttamapātraprayojyā paiśācī śuddhā yathā—
‘panamata panaapakuppitagolīcalanaggalaggapaḍibimbam
dasasu nahadappanesu eādasatanudhalaṃ luddam || 4 ||’
[praṇamata praṇayaprakupitagaurīcaraṇāgralagnapratibimbam
daśasu nakhadarpaṇeṣvekādaśatanudharaṃ rudram ||]
nātyuttameti
uttamādapakṛṣṭaṃ madhyamādutkṛṣṭaṃ nātyuttamam
‘praṇamata praṇayaprakupitagaurīcaraṇāgralagnapratibimbam
daśasu nakhadarpaṇeṣvekādaśatanudharaṃ rudram
’ evaṃ nāma devīkope bhagavataḥ praṇayakātaratā yena yugapadiva sarvābhirapi mūrtibhiḥ praṇamatīti pratīyamānotprekṣā
nātimadhyamapātraprayojyā śaurasenī śuddhā yathā—
‘tuṃ si mae cūaṅkura dipṇo kāmassa gahidadhaṇuhassa
juvaimaṇamohaṇasaho pañcabbhahio saro hohi || 5 ||’
[tvamasi mayā cūtāṅkura dattaḥ kāmasya gṛhītadhanuṣaḥ
yuvatimanomohanasahaḥ pañcābhyadhikaḥ śaro bhava ||]
natimadhyameti
hīnādutkṛṣṭaṃ madhyamādapakṛṣṭaṃ nātimadhyamam
tuṃ sīti
kāmasya
kāmāyetyarthaḥ
caturthyāḥ ‘saṃbandhasāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī’ iti sūtrāt ṣaṣṭhī
nātihīnapātraprayojyo'pabhraṃśaḥ śuddho yathā—
‘lai vappula pia duddhaṃ katto amhāṇahuṃ chāsi
puttahumatthe hattho jai dahi jammevi jaa āsi || 6 ||’
[gṛhāṇānukampya piba dugdhaṃ kuto'smākaṃ takram
putrakamastake hasto yadi dadhi janmanyapi jātamāsīt ||]
prāyikaṃ caitat
tena kaverabhiprāyaśaktyādibhyaḥ sarvā api sarvaprayojyā bhavanti
tā imāḥ śuddhāḥ ṣaḍeva
nātihīneti
hīnātkiṃcidutkṛṣṭaṃ madhyabhādapakṛṣṭaṃ nātihīnam
lai vappuleti
lai gṛhāṇa
vappuletyanukampāsaṃbodhane
piba dugdham
kuto'smākaṃ chāsi-padābhidheyaṃ takram
puttahumatthe iti śapathaḥ, putrasya mastakenāhaṃ śape yadi takrasya vyāpakaṃ daghi janmanyapi jātamāsīditi vyāpakānupalabdhiḥ prayuktā
nanu prākṛtādiṣūttamādipātravyatikaradarśanātkathameṣā vyavasthā ghaṭata ityata āha—prāyikamiti
yatra prakṛtinirvahaṇocitaviśeṣābhisaṃdhānena kaviranyathā pravartate
yathā mālatyāṃ saṃskṛtamāśritya ‘eṣo'smi bhoḥ kāryavaśātprayogavaśācca prākṛtabhāṣī saṃvṛttaḥ’ ityādi
yatra vā kavervyutpattikṛto bhāṣāviparyāsaḥ śaktyā tiraskriyate
yathā mṛcchakaṭike viṭasya madhyamapātrasyāpi saṃskṛtoktiḥ
yatra vā prabandhaucitīparavaśāḥ saṃskṛtādijātayo viparyasyante
yathā sargabandhādau madhyamāderapi saṃskṛtameva, khaṇḍakathāparakathādau uttamāderapi prākṛtameva, bṛhatkathādau paiśācameva, vastubandhādāvapabhraṃśa eveti, tatra saṃdhisaṃdhyaṅgaghaṭanāsauṣṭhavena rasaḥ puṣyatīti bharatamuniprabhṛtīnāmatiprakāśa eva panthāḥ
sādhāraṇyādayaḥ punaranantāḥ
tāsu madhyamapātrabhūmikāsthottamapātraprayojyā saṃskṛtaprākṛtayoḥ sādhāraṇī yathā—
‘sarale sāhasarāgaṃ parihara rambhoru muñca saṃrambham
virasaṃ virahāyāsaṃ soḍhuṃ tava cittamasahaṃ me || 7 ||’
sādhāraṇyeti
saṃskṛtasya prākṛtādisādhāraṇye pañca prakārāḥ, prākṛtasya śaurasenyādisādhāraṇye catvāraḥ, śaurasenyāḥ paiśācyādisādhāraṇye trayaḥ, paiśācyā māgadhyādisādhāraṇye dvau, māgadhyā apabhraṃśasādhāraṇye eka iti
dvivikalpe pañcadaśa prabhedāḥ, trivikalpe viṃśatiḥ, caturvikalpe pañcadaśa, pañcavikalpe ṣaṭ, ṣaḍvikalpe ekaḥ, iti sarvamilane saptapañcāśatprakārā sādhāraṇī
evaṃ miśrādāvapi loṣṭaprastāvakrameṇa bahavo bhedā iti tāvadudāharaṇe granthagauravaṃ syāditi diṅmātramudāharati—tāsviti
saṃbhinnasaṃskārā bhāṣāprayoge hi prayoktṛprakṛtisaṃbhede bhavati
na ca prakṛtisaṃbhedastāttvikaḥ svabhāvasaṃkaraprasaṅgāt
ata uktaṃ madhyamapātrabhūmikāstheti
bhūmikā varṇikā
madhyamapātraprakṛtyucito rāgādyabhinayastatra tiṣṭhati tatparigraheṇa tricatura(?)gavatsāmājikānāṃ samyaṅmithyāsaṃśayasādṛśyapratītivilakṣaṇapratipattipadavīmavataratīti madhyamapātrabhūmikāstham, upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam
uttamabhūmikāsthamadhyamaprayojyāpīyameva
evamuttaratra
tava virahāyāsaṃ soḍhuṃ mama cittamasahamiti yojanā
nātyuttamabhūmikāsthottamapātraprayojyā saṃskṛtapaiśācī sādhāraṇī yathā—
‘campakakalikākomalakāntikalāpātha dīpitānaṅgī
icchati gajapatigamanā capalāyatalocanā lapitum || 8 ||’
evaṃ saṃskṛtāpabhraṃśādisādhāraṇyaḥ prākṛtādibhāṣāntarasādhāraṇyaśca draṣṭavyāḥ
nātyuttameti
anaṅgasyeyamānaṅgī
vaktṛviṣayaucityādiprayojyā miśrā yathā—
‘jayati janatābhivāñchitaphalapradaḥ kalpapādapo giriśaḥ
jaai a tamalliantī giritanayā paṇaikappalaā || 9 ||’
[jayati ca tamālīyamānā giritanayā praṇayikalpalatā |]
evaṃ bhāṣāntarāṇāmapi miśrībhāvo draṣṭavyaḥ
vaktṛviṣayeti
yadottamādiṣu nānāvaktṛbhirekā kāvyasamasyā kriyate, bhinnabhāṣocitavarṇanīyaviṣayaṃ vā kāvyamekamupakramyate, yadā vā śaktinirūpaṇāya kavereva nānābhāṣāmayaṃ kāvyamārabdhaṃ syāt, tadā kathaṃ nālaṃkārapadavīmadhyāste
ata āha—miśreti
tamalliantī tamālīyamānā
durvidagdhādipātraprayojyā saṃkīrṇā yathā—
‘akaṭagumaṭī candrajyotsnā kalaṃ kila koilo lavai a muhuryāmyo vāyurnivāara vāi a
avi sakhi alā raktāśokastavāpi manomude na kaja na kajaṃ mānenādya priyaṃ pratijāhudā || 10 ||’
so'yaṃ saṃskṛtamahārāṣṭrāpabhraṃśayogastilataṇḍulavatsaṃkīrṇā jātiḥ
evaṃ prākṛtāpabhraṃśasaṃkaro'pi draṣṭavyaḥ
durvidagdhādīti
nāgarakabhāvamavāptastadbhūmikāmavalambamāno durvidagdhaḥ
ādipadātpūrvoktāḥ samasyādayaḥ
akaṭamāścaryam
gumaṭī manojñā

tathā ca prayogaḥ—‘lavai a vijjūmaṇoharī’ ityārādhyāḥ
anye tu lapatītyarthamāhuḥ
evaṃ ca kalaśabdaḥ puṣyatīti
yāmyo dakṣiṇaḥ
nivāara nirvañcako vārakaśūnyo vā idāvāraka iti
alā āgataḥ
yadiha māno na kriyeta jyotsnādayo manomudamevādhāsyantīti prarocanā
yadā tu ‘manonude’ iti pāṭho'piśabdena nāyakasādhāraṇamutkaṇṭhākāritvamuktaṃ candrajyotsnādīnāmiti
ato nakajanakajannārtho nārtha īrṣyāroṣalakṣaṇena pratikūlabhāvāvalambinā mānena, tasmātpriyameva pratijāhudā yāmaḥ, yadāmananti svayaṃ vā tatra gamanamiti
krīḍāgoṣṭhīvinodādyarthānanyagāminyasādhāraṇī yathā—
‘bhīṣmaproktāni vākyāni vidvadvakktreṣu śerate
gose tiviñchiriñcholī tallaṃ tūhe vivallidā || 11 ||’
atra pūrvārdhapadāni saṃskṛta eva, uttarārdhapadāni prākṛta eva
seyamasādhāraṇyananyagāminī ca jātirucyate
bhāṣāntarāṇāṃ punarasādhāraṇyaṃ nāsti
krīḍeti
kāvyasamasyā krīḍā, uktapūrvā goṣṭhī, tatra vinodo manonukūlena samayātivāhanam
ādipadaṃ pūrvavat
nanu mā bhūtprakṛtibhāvena bhāṣāntarasaṃbhedaḥ saṃskārasaṃpāte tu bhaviṣyati, tathā ca kathaṃ sādhāraṇīto bhidyata ityata āha—asādhāraṇī ceti
gose prabhāte, taviñchiriñcholī kamalarajaḥpaṅktiḥ
tallamalpasaraḥ
tūhaṃ tīrtham
vivallidā prasāritā
nātra pūrvottarārdhayoraikamatyamudāharaṇatvāt
ārādhyāstu yathā sarastīre kamalarajaḥpaṅktiḥ prasṛtā śobhate tathā vidvadvaktreṣu bhīṣmavākyānītyupamākalpanayā kathaṃcidekavākyatāmāhuḥ
atra pūrvārdhapadānīti
na bhīṣmādayo'nabhidhānāditi bhāṣāntarasthānibhāvasya pratiṣedhāt
evaṃ vācaspativiśiṣṭarasavaśapracetasapotādayo draṣṭavyāḥ
prākṛta eveti
mahārāṣṭradeśīyatvāddeśīpadānāṃ ca sthānibhāvāsaṃbhavāt
bhāṣāntarāṇāṃ punariti
siddhirmahārāṣṭrītaḥ, siddhiḥ śaurasenītaḥ, ityupakramyānuśāsanāttadbhavarūpataiva sphuṭā
tatsamānāṃ tu sādhāraṇyameveti
apabhraṣṭā yathā—
‘muddhe gahaṇaaṃ geṇhau taṃ dhari muddaṃ ṇie hatthe
ṇicchau sundari tuha uvari mama suraappahā atthi || 12 ||’
[mugdhe grahaṇakaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dhāraya mudrāṃ nije haste
niścayaḥ sundari tavopari mama surataspṛhāsti ||]
seyamapaśabdaprayogato'pabhraṣṭāpyavidvadbhiḥ śrotriyādyaiḥ prayujyata ityapabhraṣṭā jātiḥ
asyā api cānukaraṇe sādhutvamiṣyate
apabhraṣṭeti
atra tavopari surataspṛhāstītyādikāpaśabdabahulatvenāpabhraṣṭā spaṣṭaiva
sā tu kathamalaṃkāra ityata āha—seyamiti
śrotriyaśchāndasaḥ
ādyapadena bālādayaḥ
sarva eva hi laukikaḥ padārtho'bhinayakakṣāmadhirūḍhaḥ parityajya grāmyamabhimukhībhūto vibhāvādiṣu kathaṃ nālaṃkārastadidamuktaṃ prayogata iti
na cāpaśabdānāṃ doṣatvameveti vācyam
anukaraṇe tu sarveṣāmiti doṣasāmānyāvalambinā guṇībhāvenāsya viṣayīkṛtatvāditi
nānāvacchinnajātiḥ kāvyaśarīre niviśata iti tadavacchedarūpāṃ gatimanantaraṃ lakṣayati—
padyaṃ gadyaṃ ca miśraṃ ca kāvyaṃ yatsā gatiḥ smṛtā
arthaucityādibhiḥ sāpi vāgalaṃkāra iṣyate || 18

paṭhiteḥ padātpadāntarasaṃcāro gatiḥ
sā kenacidaucityopanipātinā saṃdarbhaparimāṇena niyamyate
tatastadapyupacāreṇa gatiḥ
paṭhitiparimāṇaṃ ca kāvyaṃ samāśrayata iti tadapi gatistacca padyādibhedena trividhamiti saṃkṣepaḥ
ata eva gadyabandhe tu kaiścidvṛttamāśritaṃ vṛttaṃ vartanamiyatteti yāvaditi
sarvanāmaśabdā hi kadāciduddeśyasya liṅgamāśrayante kadācitpratinirdeśyasyeti kāvye yatsā gatirityuktam
tatra padyaṃ catuṣpadīti na lakṣaṇamullālamātrādau dvipadapañcapadādiśarīre tadabhāvāt
apādaḥ padasaṃtāno gadyamityapi na
apādatvaṃ hyapratyabhijñāyamānavṛttabhāgatvaṃ, vivakṣātaścatuṣpadīvyatiriktatvaṃ vā
ādye vṛttigandhipadyaṃ na syāt
dvitīye tvatiprasaṅgaḥ
tasmācchandoniyamavatī kāvyam, atathābhūtā tu gadyamiti vibhāgaḥ
gadyapadyātmakaṃ kāvyaṃ miśram
tadasyā gateralaṃkāratvamupapādayati—arthaucityādibhiriti
tatrārthaucitīmāha—
kaścidgadyena padyena kaścinmiśreṇa śakyate
kavituṃ kaścana dvābhyāṃ kāvye'rthaḥ kaścana tribhiḥ || 19
kaścidgadyeneti
yathā hyaṭavīvarṇanādau gadyaṃ pragalbhate tathā na padyam, yathā ca kāvyaśāstratānirvahaṇocite'rthe padyamutsahate na tathā gadyamityādi
evaṃ kathākhyāyikādau gadyameva, campūprabhṛtau miśramevetyādipadopāttabandhaucitī draṣṭavyā
āstāṃ tāvadarthādyaucityagaveṣaṇaṃ svarūpeṇaiva padyādikaṃ parisphuratkavipratibhāviśeṣāvedanena sahṛdayāvarjakamavasīyate

yādṛggadyavidhau bāṇaḥ padyabandhe'pi tādṛśaḥ
gatyāṃ gatyāmiyaṃ devī vicitrā hi sarasvatī || 20
yādṛgiti
gatyāṃ gatyāmiti
padye gadye miśre cetyarthaḥ
vicitrā avyavasthitasiddhikā
prayogavyavasthāmupapādayati—
yathāmati yathāśakti yathaucityaṃ yathāruci
kaveḥ pātrasya caitasyāḥ prayoga upapadyate || 21

matirvyutpattiḥ
yuktāyuktaviveka iti yāvat
śaktiḥ kavitvabījabhūtaḥ prāktanaḥ saṃskāraḥ
aucityaṃ darśitameva

aucityaṃ pātrasyaiva
rucirubhayorapīti
sa cāyaṃ saṃdarbhāvacchedo gurulaghusaṃniveśenaiva śobhata iti tamāśritya vibhāgamāha—
drutā vilambitā madhyā sātha drutavilambitā
drutamadhyā ca vijñeyā tathā madhyavilambitā || 22
druteti
ādyāstisraḥ śuddhāḥ
āsāmeva mithovyatikareṇottarāstistraḥ saṃkīrṇāḥ
kathameṣāṃ vyavasthetyata āha—
sā laghūnāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca bāhulyālpatvamiśraṇaiḥ
padye gadye ca miśre ca ṣaṭprakāropajāyate || 23
sā laghūnāmiti
bāhulyamalpatvaṃ miśraṇaṃ ca tulyavatpratibhānam
na gadyādikameva gatiḥ kiṃtu tadādhāraḥ paṭhitisaṃcāra iti vyanakti-padye gadye ca miśre ceti
tatra vṛttaṃ ca jātiṃ ca padyamāhuratho pṛthak
samaṃ cārdhasamaṃ caitadviṣamaṃ ca pracakṣate || 24
tatreti
varṇaniyataṃ chandovṛttam
mātrāniyataṃ jātiḥ
samaprastāvaṃ samam

ubhayabahirardhaṃ viṣamam

utkalikā kallolastatprāyam
uccāvacamiva pratibhāsamānamityarthaḥ
yathā—‘salīlakarakamalatālikātaralavalayāvalīkam’ iti
vṛttagandhi pratibhātavṛttaikadeśam
tadetadalpākhyāyāmutpannena samāsāntena vyañjitam
tadayamarthaḥ— sāmānyataḥ padyādibhedena gatistridhā
tatrāpi jātyādibhedena ṣaṭprakārāḥ
te'pi drutādibhedena ṣaṭtriṃśaditi
nanu lalitādayo gadyabhedāḥ kaiścidalaṃkārakāraiḥ parisaṃkhyātāste kasmānnocyanta ityata āha—
lalitaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ cūrṇamāviddhaṃ ceti yo'paraḥ
viśeṣaḥ sa tu gadyasya rītivṛttyorbhaviṣyati || 26

sukumārasaṃdarbhaṃ lalitam
yathā—‘kamalinīvanasaṃcaraṇavyatikaralagnanalinanālakaṇṭake vane kvacinnirbharaṃ padamādadhāti’ iti

udbhaṭasabhāsamāviddham

rītivṛttyoriti viṣayasaptamī
tathā lalitaṃ kaiśikyādau, niṣṭhurabhārabhaṭyādau, cūrṇaṃ vaidarbhyādau, āviddhaṃ gauḍīyāprabhṛtau, yathāyathamantarbhavatīti noktabhedāḥ parisaṃkhyātā ityarthaḥ
uktaprakāreṣu kiṃcidudāharati—
tatra padyabhedeṣu samavṛtte drutā gatiryathā—
‘ayi vijahīhi dṛḍhopagūhanaṃ tyaja navasaṃgamabhīru vallabham
aruṇakarodgama eṣa vartate varatanu saṃpravadanti kukkuṭāḥ || 13 ||’
seyaṃ samavṛtte laghusaṃyuktākṣarabhūyastvāddrutā gatiḥ
tatreti
navasaṃgamabhīrviti saṃbodhanam

‘praṇamya hetumīśvaraṃ muniṃ kaṇādamanvataḥ
padārthadharmasaṃgrahaḥ pravakṣyate mahodayaḥ || 14 ||’

praṇamyeti

evaṃ vyutkrameṇa samānikāyāmapi vilambitaiva

mattaṣaṭpadākulāni paśya bhīru paṅkajāni
’ iti
tadidamāha—seyamiti

‘āsīddaityo hayagrīvaḥ suhṛdveśmasu yasya tāḥ
vadanti sma balaṃ bāhvoḥ sitacchatrasmitāḥ śriyaḥ || 15 ||’

āsīditi

avatu va iti

vaidarbhādayo vidarbhādideśaprabhavāstaiḥ kṛtamukhahevākagocaratayā prakaṭito na tu tattaddeśaiḥ kāvyasya kiṃcidupakriyate
panthā iti
pratiṣṭhante hi mahākavipadavīlābhārthina iti
īdṛśameva rītilakṣaṇamānandavardhanādīnāmapi matam
etadupalakṣaṇatayā sūtraṃ vyākhyātam
kathaṃ punaruktamupamāde rītipadaṃ pravṛttamityata āha—rīṅ gatāviti
riyante paramparayā gacchantyanayeti karaṇasādhano'yaṃ rītiśabdo mārgaparyāya ityarthaḥ
evaṃ siddhe sāmānyalakṣaṇe vibhāgamāha—
vaidarbhī sātha pāñcālī gauḍīyāvantikā tathā
lāṭīyā māgadhī ceti ṣoḍhā rītirnigadyate || 28
vaidarbhīti
vakṣyamāṇarītyā vaidarbhīprādhānyamabhipretyāha—
tatrāsamāsā niḥśeṣa śleṣādiguṇagumphitā
vipañcīsvarasaubhāgyā vaidarbhī rītiriṣyate || 29
tatreti
asamāsā anullikhitasamāsā
niḥśeṣaśleṣādīti
śleṣādayo nava guṇāstairgumphitā
mithomilanena saṃmūrcchitairanupalabhyamānānyatabhamātrakairapi parasparavibhaktasvarūpabhāvena sahṛdayahṛdayasaṃvādagocarairārabdhā
evaṃ vipañcīsvarasaubhāgyā
vipañcī vāgrūpā sarasvatī bimbapratibimbabhāvena dvividhā
pratibimbādhiṣṭhānatayā dārvādiyantramapi vipañcītyucyate
tadīyāḥ svarāstantrīkaṇṭhotthitāḥ sthānakramavaiparītyānumeyaśārīrāḥ pratibimbabhāvāḥ ṣaḍjādayasteṣu śrutasaṃmūrcchanarūpeṣvapi mithovibhaktāḥ śrutayaḥ śrotrarañjakasvarāvasthāmāpannāḥ samastagāndharvavitsākṣikāḥ prakāśante
ata eva vīṇaiva pradhānaṃ samastasya svarajātasya tatraiva śrutimaṇḍalonmeṣāditi
yadā tu pānakādinyāyena kaścidaṃśa udito bhavati tadā rītyantaramuttiṣṭhatītyāha—
samastapañcaṣapadāmojaḥkāntivivarjitām
madhurāṃ sukumārāṃ ca pāñcālīṃ kavayo viduḥ || 30
samasteti
ojaḥkāntivivarjitām ojaḥkāntyorviśeṣeṇa varjitām
nyagbhūtaujaḥkāntiguṇāmiti yāvat
yatastatpratidvandvinormādhuryasaukumāryayostatrodbhavastadetadāha—madhurāṃ sukumārāṃ ceti
ata evaujaḥprakāśakaḥ ṣaḍadhikeṣu padeṣu samāso na kriyate
samastātyudbhaṭapadāmojaḥ kāntiguṇānvitām
gauḍīyeti vijānanti rītiṃ rītivicakṣaṇāḥ || 31
samasteti
atyudbhaṭāni sollekhasamāsāni yasmādojaḥkāntyorudbhave nyagbhūtaguṇasaptakeyaṃ rītiḥ
antarāle tu pāñcālīvaidarbhyoryāvatiṣṭhate
sāvantikā samastaiḥ syāddvitraistricaturaiḥ padaiḥ || 32
antarāla iti
mādhuryasaukumāryayoḥ kiṃcidudbhavena nimīlanāṅgaprādhānyena vāntarālakalpanā tāṃ vyanakti—dvitrairiti
dve trīṇi vā trīṇi catvāri veti vārthe bahuvrīhiḥ
samastarītirvyāmiśrā lāṭīyā rītirucyate
pūrvarīteranirvāhe khaṇḍarītistu māgadhī || 33
samasteti
yadyapyupakrāntarītyanirvāho'trāpyasti tathāpi tilataṇḍulavadyāvadvibhaktarītisaṃvalanasya kavisaṃrambhagocarasyottararīteḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ
pūrvarīteriti
ekāṃ rītimupakramya yadanyayā saṃdarbhanirvahaṇamasāvanya eva prakāraḥ
na cānirvāho doṣaśchāyāvairūpyābhāvāt
rītikhaṇḍane'pi hi saṃdarbhasaubhāgyasaṃpattiḥ śaktimevāviṣkaroti
tāsu vaidarbhī yathā—
‘manīṣitāḥ santi gṛheṣu devatāstapaḥ kva vatse kva ca tāvakaṃ vapuḥ
padaṃ saheta bhramarasya pelavaṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ na punaḥ patatriṇaḥ || 25 ||’
seyamasamastapadā samagra śleṣādiguṇavatī vaidarbhī rītiḥ
manīṣitā iti
atra dīrghasamāsābhāve kathamoja iti kasyacitkudeśyamaparītimatprakaraṇa evetyapāstam
etena guṇanavakasya samakakṣatayā saṃbhedaḥ kṣaṇa iti
asamastapadetyanullekhasamāsapadetyarthaḥ
samagrā nava
guṇavatīti nityayoge matup
pāñcālī yathā—
‘gātrāvighātadalitāṅgadajarjarāṇāṃ gaṇḍasthalīlulitakuṇḍalatāḍitānām
kṣobhasphuṭanmukuṭakoṭivighaṭṭitānāṃ nādo'bhavajjhaṇajhaṇāmukharo maṇīnām || 26 ||’
seyamojaḥkāntyabhāvādāśliṣṭaślathapurāṇacchāyāmādhuryasaukumāryavatī samastapañcaṣapadā pāñcālī rītiḥ
gātrāvighāteti
atrādyatṛtīyayoḥ ṣaḍ dvitīye ca pañca padāni samastāni
ojaḥkāntyabhāvāditi
īṣadarthe nañ
ata eva mādhuryasaukumāryayorunmeṣaḥ
śliṣṭā prāptā yathāsaṃkhyamojaḥkāntinimīlanalabdhaprādurbhāvā ślathā purāṇī ca cchāyā yayeti vigrahaḥ
gauḍīyā yathā—
‘yasyāvaskandalīlāvalitabalaparispandakharvīkṛtorvīsaṃrambhottambhanāyonnamitabharanamatkandharāsaṃdhirāsīt
śeṣo visphāraphullasphuṭapṛthulaphaṇāphūtkṛtāgnisphuliṅgasphūrjatsaṃdohasaṃdehitavikaṭaśikhāmaṇḍalīratnakhaṇḍaḥ || 27 ||’
seyamojaḥkāntimatī samastodbhaṭabhūripadā ca gauḍīyā rītiḥ
yasyeti
avaskando dhrāṭakaḥ
samastodbhaṭabhūripadeti
udbhaṭatā prauḍhiprakarṣaḥ
āvantikā yathā—
‘etāni niḥsahatanorasamañjasāni śūnyaṃ manaḥ piśunayanti padāni tasyāḥ
ete ca mārgataravaḥ prathayanti tāpa- mālambitojjhitapariglapitaiḥ pravālaiḥ || 28 ||’
seyaṃ samastadvitricaturapadā vaidarbhīpāñcālyorantarālavartinyāvantikā nāma rītiḥ
etānīti
‘niḥsahatanorasamañjasāni’ ‘mārgataravaḥ’ iti dve dve pade, ‘ālambita-’ ityādau trīṇi padāni samastāni
mādhuryasaukumāryayormanāgunmeṣaḥ pāñcālībhāgaḥ
itareṣāṃ samakakṣatā vaidarbhībhāgaḥ
anayoḥ saṃbhedenāntarālakalpanā vyaktaiva
lāṭīyā yathā—
‘ayamudayati mudrābhañjanaḥ padminīnāmudayagirivanālībālamandārapuṣpam
virahavidhurakokadvandvabandhurvibhindankupitakapikapolakroḍatāmrastamāṃsi || 29 ||’
seyaṃ samastarītimiśrā lāṭīyā nāma rītiḥ
ayamiti
mudrābhañjana iti dvābhyāṃ samastābhyāmāvantī
udayagirītyādinā pañcakena pāñcālī
prauḍhiprakarṣeṇa gauḍīyā
ayasudayatītyādyasamāsena vaidarbhī ca pratyabhijñāyata iti pūrvoktasamastarītisaṃbheda iti
māgadhī yathā—
‘karikavalanaśiṣṭaiḥ śākaśākhāgrapatrairaruṇasaraṇayo'mī sarvato bhīṣayante
calitaśabarasenādattagośṛṅgacaṇḍadhvanicakitavarāhavyākulā vindhyapādāḥ || 30 ||’
seyamārabdharīteranirvāhātkhaṇḍarītirmāgadhī
karikavalaneti
atra pūrvārdhe yathoktābhāvantīmupakramya caramārdhe gauḍīyāparigrahādupakrāntarīteranirvāhaḥ khaṇḍanam, tathāpi ca na cchāyāvairūpyamiti kaviśaktivyañjakatvādalaṃkārabhāva iti
śāko vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ
yā vikāse'tha vikṣepe saṃkoce vistare tathā
cetaso vartayitrī syātsā vṛttiḥ sāpi ṣaḍvidhā || 34
yā vikāsa iti
vṛttirvartanaṃ rasaviṣayo vyāpāraḥ kāvyasya rasapravaṇatvāt
sa ca vyāpāraḥ sattvādyudrekalakṣaṇo janmāntarānubhavabhāvitavāsanāsamutthaḥ paripūrṇībhaviṣyadrasāsvādasarvasvāyamānacittāvasthanidānabhūto'rthagataḥ pañcame'bhidhāsyate
śabdagataḥ punaratra saṃgataḥ saṃdarbhasya rasaprakāśakāraṇeṣu pradhānatvāt
yadāha—
‘kavivāgabhineyaśca tadupāyo dvidheṣyate
vastuśaktimahimnā tu prathamo'tra viśiṣyate ||’
vartate'nayā cittamiti karaṇasādhano'yaṃ vṛttiśabda iti vartayitrītyanena prayojakavyāpārapradhānena darśitam
tatra viṣayavaicitryādvikāsādyāścatasraścittāvasthāḥ
viṣayo hi dīptamasṛṇamadhyamabhedena trividhaḥ
vibhāvādyupadhānamahimnā tanmayībhavanayogyaṃ hi cetaḥ kadācidvikasati
sattvāvirbhāvo vikāsaḥ
nyagbhūtarajastamoguṇaṃ hi cetaḥ sattvodrekaprakāśānandamayasaṃvidviśrāntimāsādayati
tataḥ sattvabhāgapratiṣṭhitaḥ śṛṅgārastadābhāso'pi tāmeva bhūmikāmālambate
ata eva śuktirajatavadbhāvodaye'pi doṣamahimnaiva kāvyamahimnā tavdyañjanāt
tatsamānabhūmikayā hāsyo rasaḥ prādurbhavatītyabhisaṃdhāyāha—‘śṛṅgārāddhi bhaveddhāsyam’ iti bharatamuniḥ
tena vikāsabhūmikau śṛṅgārahāsyau
vikāsātpracyutamaprāptaguṇāntaraprādurbhāvaṃ vikṣiptaṃ cittamucyate
tatrocitavibhāvādivaicitryādāvirbhavadrajoguṇasya cetaso vikṣepapracyutidaśāyāṃ raudrarasonmeṣaḥ
ata eva samānabhūmikayā ‘raudrācca karuṇo rasaḥ’ ityāha
yadā tu sattvatamonimīlanena kevalarajaḥpratiṣṭhaṃ cetastadā bahumukhavyāpāronmeṣādvistarākhyāmavasthāmāsādayati
tadbhūmiko vīrarasastadavasthāmevāsthāyādbhuto'pi prathata iti ‘vīrāccaivādbhutotpattiḥ’ ityuktam
nyagbhūtarajoguṇasya prabuddhatamasaścetaso'vasthāviśeṣaḥ sasaṃkocastamālambya bībhatsaḥ prādurāste tadekabhūmikaśca bhayānaka iti ‘bībhatsācca bhayānakaḥ’ ityāha
te'mī catvāraścittāvasthāviśeṣāḥ kathamaviśeṣaṇādeva saṃdarbhādbhavantītyāśaṅkya vibhāgenottaramāha—
kaiśikyārabhaṭī caiva bhāratī sātvatī parā
madhyamārabhaṭī caiva tathā madhyamakaiśikī || 35
kaiśikyeti
śuddhisaṃkarābhyāṃ rītivadatrāpi ṣaṭ prakārāḥ
sukumārārthasaṃdarbhā kaiśikī tāsu kathyate
yā tu prauḍhārthasaṃdarbhā vṛttirārabhaṭīti sā || 36
komalaprauḍhasaṃdarbhā komalārthātha bhāratī
prauḍhārthāṃ komalaprauḍhasaṃdarbhāṃ sātvatīṃ viduḥ || 37
komale prauḍhasaṃdarbhā tvarthe madhyamakaiśikī
prauḍhārthā komale bandhe madhyamārabhaṭīṣyate || 38
sukumāreti
cittadrutikāritvaṃ saukumāryaṃ sukumārāvarthasaṃdarbhau yasyāmiti vigrahaḥ
evaṃ prauḍhārthasaṃdarbhetyapi
cittadīptividhāyitā prauḍhiḥ
arthasaukumāryādinā viśeṣyamāṇasaṃdarbhaḥ sukumāratvādiḥ śabdālaṃkāratāṃ prayojayati
komalaprauḍho madhyamaḥ
prakārāntaravirahācca madhyamabhāratyādayo na saṃbhavanti
tatra kaiśikī yathā—
‘śaśiruciṣu daleṣu nāgavallyā vicakiladāmani candane ca hṛdye
kuvalayini purāṇasīdhupātre taraladṛśāmapatandṛśaḥ priye ca || 31 ||’
seyamarthasya ca saṃdarbhasya ca saukumāryātkaiśikī nāma vṛttiḥ
śaśiruciṣviti
niyamitādiṣu mugdhāṅganācumbanarasotsukānāmatimanojñādhararāgasamarpakeṣu nāgalatādaleṣu, tato mānaparigrahe valitakādicumbanaviśeṣārthinīnāṃ kacagrahasaubhāgyasundare mallikādāmni, tataḥ sarvāṅgīṇāśleṣasaubhāgyārthakacandanarase'nantaramīrṣyāroṣavāsanāniḥśeṣakeliyantraṇaratotkaṇṭhitānāṃ sīdhupātre, tataḥ sarvopakaraṇajīvitasarvasve priyatame samakakṣatayaiva dṛṣṭayaḥ peturiti
‘kuvalayini’ iti yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ
‘kuvalayita—’ iti pāṭhe viśeṣaṇāṅgaprādhānyavivakṣāyāṃ samāse guṇībhāvasyānucitatvāt
seyaṃ kaiśikī masṛṇe śṛṅgārādau viniyujyata iti
ārabhaṭī yathā—
‘yo yaḥ śastraṃ bibharti svabhujagurumadaḥ pāṇḍavīnāṃ camūnāṃ yo yaḥ pāñcālagotre śiśuradhikavayā garbhaśayyāṃ gato vā
yo yastatkarmasākṣī carati mayi raṇe yaśca yaśca pratīpaḥ krodhāndhastasya tasya svayamiha jagatāmantakasyāntako'ham || 32 ||’
seyaṃ prauḍhārthasaṃdarbhārabhaṭī nāma vṛttiḥ
yo ya iti
ojaḥpradhānatayā prauḍhaḥ saṃdarbhaḥ
yasmādiyamārabhaṭī dīpte raudrādau viniyuktā, tena yuktaṃ śabdārthayoḥ prauḍhatvamiti
bhāratī yathā—
‘uttiṣṭhantyā ratānte bharamuragapatau pāṇinaikena kṛtvā dhṛtvā cānyena vāso vigalitakabarībhāramaṃse vahantyāḥ
bhūyastatkālakāntidviguṇitasurataprītinā śauriṇā vaḥ śayyāmāliṅgya nītaṃ vapuralasalasadbāhu lakṣmyāḥ punātu || 33 ||’
seyamatisukumārārthe nātisukumārasaṃdarbhā bhāratī nāma vṛttiḥ
uttiṣṭhantyā iti
sarvāṅgīṇāśleṣasamutsuke priyatame bahirvyāvartanamantaranuvartanaṃ ca mugdhāṅganājātiriti nyāyena nīvībandhakeśapāśasaṃyamārthinyā nirbharakelikhedena bhujalatālasaṃ lasatyeva na tu vyāpārayitumapi śakyeti tatkāliko'tipoṣaḥ
atra masṛṇe'pi rase vṛttyaucityena saṃdarbhasya prauḍhirucitaiva
dīrghasamāso hi śrṛṅgārādau niṣiddho na tu prauḍhiḥ
rephahakārādivarṇaniveśāttu komalatā saṃdarbhasyeti
evamuttarodāharaṇeṣvapi viśeṣaḥ svayamūhanīya iti
sāttvatī yathā—
‘vandyau dvāvapi tāvanāryacaritaprāptapratāpodayau bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ sa ca munirbhāsvatkuṇṭhārāyudhaḥ
ekenāmṛtavadvidārya karajaiḥ pītānyasṛñji dviṣāmanyenāpi hatāhitāsrasarasi snātaṃ krudhaḥ śāntaye || 34 ||’
seyaṃ prauḍhārthā nātiprauḍhasaṃdarbhā sāttvatī nāma vṛttiḥ
madhyamakaiśikī yathā—
‘kiṃ dvāri daivahatake sahakārakeṇa saṃvardhitena viṣapādapa eṣa pāpaḥ
asminmanāgapi vikāsavikārabhāji bhīmā bhavanti madanajvarasaṃnipātāḥ || 35 ||’
seyaṃ sukumāre'rthe prauḍhasaṃdarbhā madhyamakaiśikī nāma vṛttiḥ
madhyamārabhaṭī yathā—
‘tvaṃ nāgarāja bahumasya nitambabhāgaṃ bhogena gāḍhamupaveṣṭaya mandarādreḥ
soḍhā'viṣahyavṛṣavāhanayogalīlāparyaṅkabandhanavidhestava ko'tibhāraḥ || 36 ||’
seyaṃ prauḍhe'rthe sukumārasaṃdarbhā madhyamārabhaṭī nāma vṛttiḥ
anyoktīnāmanukṛtiśchāyā sāpīha ṣaḍvidhā
lokacchekārbhakonmattapoṭāmattoktibhedataḥ || 39
anyoktīnāmiti
loke bimbapratibimbayoḥ pratibimbaṃ camatkāritayā prasiddham
ata eva ‘śravyātprekṣyaṃ jyāyaḥ’ ityāha
śabdālaṃkārakāṇḍe vākyānukaraṇameva pratibimbavācinā chāyāpadena guṇavṛttenākhyāyate
tadetadanukaraṇamanukāryabhedādeva ṣoḍhā vyavatiṣṭata ityāha—cheketi
chekādīnāṃ lokaviśeṣāṇāmeva śobhākāritvena pṛthagupādāne'rthāttaditarānekavicitratattadanukāryaparo lokaśabdaḥ
chekā vidagdhāḥ
‘poṭā strīpuṃsalakṣaṇā'
sahajakeliriti prasiddhā poṭā
bhujiṣyā dāsītyanye
atra kecidanyacchāyāyonijamapi kāvyaṃ chāyālaṃkāravyavahārabhūmimāhuḥ
prakṛtipariṇāmaḥ, parapurapraveśaḥ, khaṇḍasaṃghātyam, cūlikā, parimala iti pañca yonijakāvyabhedāḥ
tatra kiṃcidvikṛtārthaḥ prakṛtipariṇāmaḥ
yathā—
‘dhuamehaṃ mahuarānuvvaṇasamaahiyao ṇaavimukkāo
ṇahayā avasāhāo ṇia avvāṇa vayaḍi gaāo disāo ||’
yathā ca—
‘sisirapaḍirohamukkaparihuttampaa avaliakkam
iharai arayā aliaṃ vittharadi disāhiṃ kaṭṭhiaṃ vaṇahaalam ||’
atrākāśadiśāṃ vistārabhaṇanaṃ manāgvikṛtamupalakṣyata iti prakṛtipariṇāmanāmāyaṃ yonijakāvyabhedaḥ
bhāṣāmātrabhinnaḥ parapurapraveśaḥ
yathā—
‘devādhipo vā bhujagādhipo vā dharādhipo vā yadi haihayaḥ syām
saṃdarśanaṃ te guṇakīrtanaṃ te sevāñjaliṃ te tadahaṃ vidadhyām ||’
yathā ca—
‘savimo aṇajjuṇamiaṃ amahindamavāmuia appāṇam
seḍaṃ jāladaṃsaṇa guṇakahāmuta ijaṇūpajjattam ||’
atra bhāṣāmātraṃ bhinnamiti parapurapraveśanāmāyaṃ yonijakāvyabhedaḥ
vikīrṇamasamāhāraḥ khaṇḍasaṃghātyam
yathā—
‘dvitrāṇyambujinīdalāni sarasāmutsaṅgamadhyāsate maulau kiṃśukaśākhinastricaturānābibhrate korakān
garbhagranthiṣu pañcaṣāḥ sumanaso badhnanti cūtadrumāḥ saṃprāptāḥ prakaṭībhavanti kurarīkaṇṭheṣu kūjormayaḥ ||’
atra kāvyacatuṣkāducchidya pādacatuṣṭayaṃ grathitamiti khaṇḍasaṃghātyanāmāyaṃ yonijakāvyabhedaḥ
tāvantamarthamupādāyādhiko vāpaścūlikā
yathā—
‘kamalamanambhasi tatra ca kuvalayametāni kanakalatikāyām
sā ca sukumārasubhagetyutpātaparamparā keyam ||’
yathā ca—
‘ubhau rambhāstambhāvupari viparītau kamalayo- stadūrdhvaṃ ratnāśmasthalamapi durūhaṃ kimapi yat
tataḥ kumbhau paścādvisakisalaye kandalamatho tadanvindāvindīvaramadhukarāḥ kiṃ punaridam ||’
atra sthāne sthāne'dhikāvāpasya pratyabhijñānāccūlikānāmāyaṃ yonijakāvyabhedaḥ
bandhacchāyāmātrasaṃvādī parimalaḥ
yathā—
‘anena yūnā saha pārthivena rambhoru kaccinmanaso ruciste
siprātaraṅgānilakampitāsu vihartumudyānaparamparāsu ||’
yathā ca—
‘yātrāprasaṅgādupavīṇayantī tasyāṃ mahākālamavipratiṣṭham
kṛśāṅgi vīṇāguṇasāraṇāsu cirātkalābhyāsaphalaṃ labhethāḥ ||’
atra saṃdarbhacchāyāmātramanukṛtamiti parimalanāmāyaṃ yonijakāvyabhedaḥ
tāsu lokokticchāyā yathā—
‘śāpānto me bhujagaśayanādutthite śārṅgapāṇau māsānetāngamaya caturo locane mīlayitvā
paścādāvāṃ virahaguṇitaṃ taṃ tamātmābhilāṣaṃ nirvekṣyāvaḥ pariṇataśaraccandrikāsu kṣapāsu || 37 ||’
seyaṃ locane mīlayitveti lokokteranukṛtirlokokticchāyā
śāpānta iti
locane mīlayitvetyanena lokoktyanukāreṇa nayananimīlanavadāśubhāvitā samāgamasamayasya pratipādyate
tathā ca—sukumāratarakāntājī vitādhyavasāyābhiprāyaḥ pravāsavipralambhāviṣṭacetasaḥ prakāśito bhavatīti
upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat
varṣākāle caturo māsānityapi lokoktireva
chekokticchāyā yathā—
‘yo hi dīrghāsitākṣasya vilāsalalitabhruṇaḥ
kāntāmukhasyāvaśagastasmai nṛpaśave namaḥ || 38 ||’
seyaṃ tasmai nṛpaśave nama iti vidagdhokteranukṛtiśchekokticchāyā
yo hīti
kāntāmukhameva jīvitasarvasvamabhimanyamānastatrālaṃpratyayaśālinaḥ paśūniva prati śṛṅgārī vidagdhaḥ
arbhakokticchāyā yathā—
‘kiṃ sa svargataruḥ ko'pi yasya puṣpaṃ niśākaraḥ
te vṛkṣāḥ kīdṛśā mātaryeṣāṃ muktāphalaṃ phalam || 39 ||’
seyamavyutpannaśiśujanokteranukṛtirarbhakokticchāyā
kiṃ sa iti
nūnaṃ trijagadvartisakalārthisārthakīkaraṇavikhyātakīrteḥ pārijātapramukhasya kasyacidekaḥ stabakaḥ sudhābhirāhlādayannayamavaloke dṛśyata ityādi
unmattokticchāyā yathā—
‘dṛṣṭaḥ kathaṃ sutanu kiṃ kurute kimasmadvārtāṃ sa pṛcchati śrṛṇoti nivedyamānām
āstāṃ kimasya kathayā kathayāśu tāvadatrāgamiṣyati na vā khalu so'bhimānī || 40 ||’
seyamasamañjasāyā unmattokteranukṛtirunmattokticchāyā
dṛṣṭa iti
kathamityādinā tadekatānatāmāviṣkṛtya sahasaivāstāmityādinā saṃprahāṇam, kathaya tāvadityādinā ca punarādānamasamañjasam
poṭokticchāyā yathā—
‘tilakamasahāsmi soḍhuṃ ghanasāreṇātisāradoṣo me
lambhayati ca daurbalyaṃ kuṅkumarāgo mamāṅgāni || 41 ||’
seyamuttamapadāropitanīcayuvatyukteranukṛtiḥ poṭokticchāyā
uttamapadasthānīyayuvatimanukurvāṇā uttamapadāropitanīcayuvatiḥ
mattokticchāyā yathā—
‘pi pi priya sa sa svayaṃ mu mu mukhāsavaṃ dehi me ta ta tyaja du du drutaṃ bha bha bha bhājanaṃ kāñcanam
iti skhalitajalpitaṃ madavaśātkuraṅgīdṛśaḥ prage hasitahetave sahacarībhiradhyaiyata || 42 ||’
seyaṃ skhalantyā mattokteranukṛtirmattokticchāyā
pi pi priyeti
avyaktavṛttirūpaṃ skhalitajalpitam
sābhiprāyasya vākye yadvacaso viniveśanam
mudrāṃ tāṃ mutpradāyitvātkāvyamudrāvido viduḥ || 40
sābhiprāyeti
yadyapi saṃpūrṇameva kāvyaṃ vaktrabhiprāyapraticchandakabhūtam, uktaṃ ca—‘vakrabhiprāyaṃ sūcayeyuḥ’ iti, tathāpi nāsminnitarasādhāraṇatayā vākyārthagocaramabhiprāyamāvedayatyeva kāvyasanāthīkaraṇakṣamavakrabhiprāyaviśeṣapratirūpaka ekadeśaniveśo dṛśyate
ata evāṅgulīyādimudreva mudretyucyate
niruktimāha—mutpradāyitvāditi
mudyupapade rāterdānakarmaṇaḥ ke rūpam
mudraiva padādiprakāśyadhvanivyavahārabhūmiranyeṣām
sāsminpadasya vākyasya vibhaktervacanasya ca
samuccayasya saṃvṛtyā ṣoḍhā nyāsena jāyate || 41
sāsminniti
padaṃ prātipadikaṃ kṛttaddhitasamāsarūpam
vibhaktivacanayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣabhāve'pi pṛthakpṛthagabhiprāyavyañjakatayā nirdeśaḥ
āstāmityādivacanasaṃkocaḥ saṃvṛtiḥ
tāsu padamudrā yathā—
‘nirmālyaṃ nayanaśriyaḥ kuvalayaṃ vakrasya dāsaḥ śaśī bhrūyugmasya sanābhi manmathadhanurjyotsnā smitasyāñcalaḥ
saṃgītasya ca mattakokilarutānyucchiṣṭameṇīdṛśaḥ sarvāṅgīṇamaho vidheḥ pariṇataṃ vijñānacitraṃ cirāt || 43 ||’
atra nirmālyaṃ, dāsaḥ, sanābhi, añcalaḥ, ucchiṣṭamiti padānāṃ gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayeṇa mutpradāyināṃ sābhiprāyaniveśādiyaṃ padamudrā
gauṇavṛttivyapāśrayeṇeti
nirmālyādipadānāmatyantatiraskṛtavācyānāmativicchāyatvādilakṣaṇādvāreṇa lāvaṇyaviśeṣadhvananātsahṛdayahṛdayāvarjakānāṃ niveśo dṛśyate
evam—
‘tālā jāanti guṇā jālā te sahi~aehi~ dheyyanti
ravikiraṇāṇuggahiāi~ honti kamalāi~ kamalāi~ ||’
tathā—
‘amṛtamabhṛtaṃ candraścandrastathāmbujamambujaṃ
ratirapi ratiḥ kāmaḥ kāmo madhūni madhūnyapi |’
ityādāvarthāntarasaṃkramaṇādinā tatprakāśyo dhvaniranusaṃdheyaḥ
vākyamudrā yathā—
‘yatsvacche salilātmani pratiphaladdeve triyāmāpatau pīyūṣākṛti paryavasyati kila jyotsneti tattvāntaram
tigmaṃ dhāma ciraṃ cakāsti divi yattatrāsti divyaḥ pumānyaṃ vijñātavatāṃ truṭanti nikhilā bhūyo bhavagranthayaḥ || 44 ||’
atra ‘tatrāsti divyaḥ pumān’ ityādervākyāntarasya pūrvavākyopakāritvena mutpradāyakasyābhiprāyapūrvaniveśādiyaṃ vākyamudrā
yatsvaccha iti
ādityakalā eva prati phalitāścandravyapadeśaṃ labhanta ityāgamaḥ
tadāha—
‘salilamaye śaśini raverdīdhitayo mūrcchitāstamo naiśam
dalayanti darpaṇodaravihatā iva mandirasyāntaḥ ||’
iti
pūrvavākyopakāritveneti
deve pīyūṣākṛti tattvāntaraṃ tigmaṃ dhāma cakāstīti ca yadagādhatayā tarkitamiti kilaśabdakaṭākṣitamabhidhānam
tatra kiṃ saṃbandhamityākāṅkṣāvipūrakaṃ tatrāstītyādi vākyam
tathā hi—‘ya eṣa ādityapathaṃ vyāpya puruṣo dīpyate’ ityādyupaniṣadarthaniveśanamabhiprāyapūrvakamābhāsate
etenānye'pi vākyaprakāśyaprakārāḥ parigṛhītā boddhavyāḥ
pūrvaṃ vākye'ntarbhāvitadvitvamavaseyamiti

‘maṇiratnaṃ prasenasya taccānāryeṇa viṣṇunā

pratīyate viśiṣṭo'rthaḥ soktiratrābhidhīyate || 42

uktirabhidhā
sā dvayī bhāvābhāvaviṣayatvāt

loke gṛhītavyutpattibalena bhāvābhāvānyatarasaṃvitsaraṇimāruhya kāvyaikagocare rasādyātmani paryavasyantī bhavatyuktiralaṃkāra iti bhāvaḥ

vidheriti
upādhirviśeṣaṇam
vidhyadhikārau śuddhabhāvabhedau
niṣedhaniyamau śuddhapratiṣedhabhedau
vikalpaparisaṃkhye saṃkīrṇabhedāviti

prasaktapratiṣedho niṣedhaḥ
kriyāphalasaṃbandho'dhikāraḥ

vyāvṛttiphalako vidhirniyamaḥ

‘śuśrūṣasva gurūnkuru priyasakhīvṛttiṃ sapatnījane’

ata evocyate—‘vidhiratyantamaprāptau’ iti

‘bharturviprakṛtāpi roṣaṇatayā mā sma pratīpaṃ gamaḥ |’

prāptau nivāraṇamiti

‘bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhava dakṣiṇā parijane bhogeṣvanutsekinī

vidhiniṣedhajñānāditi

dikkālātmatulyaṃ sarvamūrtaṃ saṃyogāśrayatālakṣaṇaṃ vibhutkmākāśasyaiva tasminnarthākṣipte yacchabdo'yamuddeśyagāmī niviśate tamupajīvya tacchabdena pratinirdeśo yuktaḥ
