karṇagatyā pratiphalitāḥ sūryakiraṇāḥ salilamayeṣṭāśinyeva sudhāvyapadeśaṃ labhante, tatraiva yacchabdo niviṣṭastadupanītamarthamuttarastacchavdo viṣayīkarotītyādi—apāmeva rāśeścandro jātastāsāṃ pittaṃ vanhistasya sāyaṃprātarāhutaye yajamānaḥ sa vāyunā jīvati
sa ca pṛthivīguṇaṃ gaṃndhaṃ vahatīti pūrvapūrvasaṃkalanenottaravākyārtharacanā vihiteti
yadyapi cārthagumphe śabdagumpho dhruvabhāvī, tathāpi prathamānusaṃdheyamarthagumphanamevātra pradhānamiti tenaiva vyapadeśo yukta ityāśayavānvyācaṣṭe—atreti
yadīyaṃ śṛṅkhalā na pratisaṃdhīyate kathaṃ parameśvaramūrtayo'ṣṭau labhyanta iti bhāvaḥ
kramakṛtā yathā—
‘nīlābjānāṃ nayanayugaladrāghimā dattapatraḥ kumbhāvaibhau kucaparikaraḥ pūrvapakṣīcakāra |’
bhrūvibhrāntirmadanadhanuṣo vibhramānanvavādī- dvakrajyotsnāśaśadhararucaṃ dūṣayāmāsa yasyāḥ || 67 ||’
atra patrapradānapūrvapakṣopanyāsānuvādadūṣaṇodbhāvanānāṃ budhajanaprasiddhakrameṇa racitatvādiyaṃ kramaracanā
nīlābjeti
patradāne spardhā vyajyate
sā ca sādṛśyaparyavasāyinīti pratīyamānopamā
ibhakumbhapūrvapakṣīkaraṇena kucābhogasya siddhāntabhāvo'vagamyate
tathā ca vyatireko dhvanitaḥ
anuvādenāpyupamā pratīyate dūṣaṇena vyatireka iti prakṛtaparyavasāne samāsoktyā yatra dānādīnāṃ vidvadvādiprasiddhānāṃ śabdānabhidheya eva krama upādhibhūto grathita ityudāharaṇavyākhyānagranthārthaḥ
paryāyakṛtā yathā—
‘kaṇailli ccia jāṇai kuntapalassāi kīrasaṃlavaī
pūsaabhāsaṃ muñcasu ṇa hu re haṃ dhavvavāāḍī || 68 ||’
[śukyeva jānāti śukapralapitāni kīrasaṃlāpinī
kīrabhāṣāṃ muñca na khalu re'haṃ dhṛṣṭaśukī ||]
seyaṃ śukanāmaparyāyāṇāmarthānuguṇyena racitatvātparyāyaracanā
kaṇailli ccia iti
kenacidviṭena śukabhāṣāmanukurvatā priyāyāḥ parihāsa ārabdhaḥ
sā tasya durvidagdhatvamākalayantī taducitamuttaramadāt śukapralapitāni kila śukī jānāti nānyā
na cāhaṃ śukī
tato viphalastavāyaṃ prayāsa ityarthaḥ
atra kunta-kīra-pūsa-śabdāḥ śukaparyāyāḥ
kaṇaillī-vāāḍī-śabdau śukīparyāyau
tatrāpi kīraśabdastatsamaḥ
anye deśīrūpāḥ
tadeteṣāṃ paryāyāṇāṃ yathoktarūpānuguṇānāmekatravākye gumphanameva kavisaṃrambhagocara iti
padakṛtā yathā—
‘lolallāṅgūlavallīvalayitabakulānokahaskandhalolairgolāṅgūlairnadadbhiḥ pratirasitajaratkandarāmandireṣu
khaṇḍeṣūddaṇḍapiṇḍītagarataralanāḥ prāpire yena velāmālambyottālatallasphuṭitapuṭakinībandhavo gandhavāhāḥ || 69 ||’
atra lāṅgūlavallīvalayitabakulairnadadbhirgolāṅgūlaiḥ pratirasitajaratkandarāmandireṣu khaṇḍeṣu uddaṇḍapiṇḍītagarataralanāḥ puṭakinībandhavo gandhavāhā velāmālambya yena prāpire ityato'dhikānāmapuṣṭārthānāmapi padānāmanuprāsāya cchandaḥpūraṇāya cārthānuguṇyena racitatvādiyaṃ padaracanā
lolallāṅgūlavallīti
lāṅgūlavallīvalayitetyādi yathoktavākyaviracanamātreṇaiva prayojanaparigrahe siddhe yadadhikānāṃ loladvallīprabhṛtipadānāmāvāpastena vinā nocitānuprāsasiddhirnaca tayā vinā vṛttaucitī samāpyate
na vā tāmantareṇa lāṅgūlādīnāmabhimatāste te viśeṣāḥ pratīyanta iti pallavapratiṣṭhaiva hi sarasvatī sahṛdayānāvarjayatīti—‘vākyapratītimātrārthamupātteṣu padeṣu yaḥ
upaskāraḥ padairanyaiḥ pallavaṃ taṃ pracakṣate
apallavaṃ tu yadvākyaṃ kavibhyastanna rocate
prayujyate tathābhūtamudīcyaiḥ kavigarhitam
’ tadidamāha—atretyādi
vākyakṛtā yathā—
‘patiśvaśuratā jyeṣṭhe patidevaratānuje
madhyameṣu ca pāñcālyāstritayaṃ tritayaṃ triṣu || 70 ||’
iha mahato'rthasyālpīyasā granthenābhidhānamiti vyutkrameṇāpi granthalāghavāya vākyārtho racita itīyaṃ vākyaracanā
vākyeti
vākyaracanā tu mahāvākya eva bhavatīti
tathāhi
patiśvaśuratetyādikamalpākṣarameva vākyaṃ mahato'rtharāśeḥ samarpakamiti bhāvayatāṃ sahṛdayānāṃ kavitvaśaktirapratyūhaiva prakāśate
ata eva śaktitiraskārādādyantāvabhidhāya madhyamābhidhāne kramabhraṃśo'pi tiraskriyata ityāha—atreti
śayyetyāhuḥ padārthānāṃ ghaṭanāyāṃ parasparam
sā prakrāntena kasmiṃścidaprakrāntena kutracit || 54
śayyeti
kiṃcidekaṃ vastu buddhau samādhāya tadadhikāraprabandharacanāyāmadhikasyāntarāntarā prakṛte yojanā śayyā
padārthānāṃ prastutāprastutavastūnām
tacca yojanīyaṃ śabdārthabhedena dvividham
tatra vastuvākyayoreva yojanā mahākaviprabandheṣu dṛśyate
arthastu prākaraṇikārthopayogī tadanuyogī ceti dvividhaḥ
dvitīyo'pyatikrānto'tathābhūtaśceti pūrvavadvibhāgavākyaṃ vyākhyeyam
atikrāntena kutrāpi padārthaṃ varṇayoḥ kvacit
vākyārthe vākyayoḥ kvāpi prakīrṇānāṃ ca dṛśyate || 55
atīti
padārthaṃ padasidhdyartham, evaṃ vākyārthamiti
tāsu prakrāntaghaṭanā yathā—
‘sa tatheti pratijñāya visṛjya kathamapyumām
ṛṣīñjyotirmayānsapta sasmāra smaraśāsanaḥ || 71 ||’
seyaṃ saptarṣīṇāmāgamanasya prakrāntasyaiva ghaṭanā
seyaṃ saptarṣīṇāmiti
gaurīpariṇayaprāpakatayā prakaraṇasaṃgatasaptarṣivṛttāntaḥ
aprakrāntaghaṭanā yathā—
‘atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam
niṣādasya ca saṃvādamṛṣeḥ saṃvaraṇasya ca || 72 ||’
seyamaprakrāntasya niṣādasaṃvaraṇasaṃvādasya ghaṭanādaprakrāntaghaṭanā
iyamaprakrāntasyeti
saṃvaraṇaniṣādasaṃvādasya pūrvāparaprakaraṇānupayoge'pītihāsarūpeṇa saṃgatiḥ
atikrāntaghaṭanā yathā—
‘tasya cakruścamatkāraṃ vyatītasamayā api
smitārdramukulodbhedāḥ kadambavanarājayaḥ || 73 ||’
iyamatikrāntasyāpi kadambavanarājīnāmārdramukulodbhedasya virahimanaścamatkārakāriṇo rāmasya smṛtidvāreṇa ghaṭanādatikrāntaghaṭanā
iyamatikrāntasyāpīti
kadambakusumodbhedasya pratyakṣasyaiva virahijanatātaṅkadāyitvaṃ saṃbhavatīti kathamatītasya tadbhayasyetyuktaṃ ‘smṛtidvāreṇa’ iti
saṃkalpavaśena pratyakṣāyamāṇasyetyarthaḥ
evamanāgatayojanāpi guṇādinā boddhavyā
padaghaṭanā yathā—
‘chinnena patatā vahnau yanmukhena haṭhātkṛte
svetiheti hareṇokteḥ svāhāsītsaiṣa rāvaṇaḥ || 74 ||’
iyaṃ svetihetivarṇābhyāṃ svāheti padasya ghaṭitatvātpadaghaṭanā
iyaṃ sveti
svāhākārapradāno homastatra sadyaśchinnena śirasā prāṇaśeṣayogāt padārdhamātre niṣpādite tadaiva bhūtakaruṇāsaṃtānaśāntātmanā parameśvareṇa khedāviṣkāravācī hāśabdaḥ prayuktastenaiva nirantaramuccaratā svāhāpadaṃ siddhamiti
vākyaghaṭanā yathā—
‘haṃsa prayaccha me kāntāṃ gatistasyāstvayā hṛtā
vibhāvitaikadeśena steyaṃ yadabhiyujyate || 75 ||’
iyaṃ pūrvaśāstranibaddhasyottarārdhasya tadarthānanuyāyināpi prastutārthāviruddhena pūrvārdhenaikavākyatayaiva ghaṭitatvādvākyaghaṭanā
iyaṃ pūrvaśāstretyādi
sugabham
prakīrṇaghaṭanā yathā—
‘ekkiṃhiṃ acchihiṃ sāvaṇu aṇṇahiṃ bhaddavau māhau mahialasatthari gaṇḍatthala sarau
aṅgahiṃ gimha suhacchii tilavaṇa maggasiru muddhihiṃ muhapaṅkaasari āvāsiu sisiru || 76 ||’
[ekasminnakṣṇi śrāvaṇo'nyasminbhādrapadaḥ mādhavo mahītalasrastare gaṇḍasthale śarat
aṅge grīṣmaḥ sukhāsikā tilavane mārgaśīrṣaḥ mugdhāyā mukhapaṅkajasarasi āvāsitaḥ śiśiraḥ ||]
atra śrāvaṇādīnāmayugapadbhāvitvena viprakīrṇānāṃ ghaṭanādiyaṃ prakīrṇaghaṭanā
prakīrṇaśabdaścāyaṃ śeṣavācī
tenānyāsāmapi prakīrṇaghaṭanānāmihāvakāśo bhavati, tena yā imā mahākaviprabandheṣu mukhyagauṇīlakṣaṇāstadbhāvāpattirupacaritā lakṣitalakṣaṇeti śabdavṛttayastā apīha śrūyante
yatrāditaḥ ṣaṭsvādhāravacaneṣu mugdhāyā iti saṃbandhipade ca mukhyā
śeṣayordvayorādhāravacanayorgauṇī
śrāvaṇādiṣu caturṣu māsavacaneṣu lakṣaṇā
ṣaṭsvapi cādheyavacaneṣu varṣādiṣu lakṣitābhihiteṣvapi yugapadasaṃbhavatsu śrutārthāpattilabhyā tāvadbhāvāpattiḥ
āvāsita iti kriyāpadaṃ copacaritāvyaktameva pratīyate
lakṣitalakṣaṇāpi caitāsveva vyākhyānata unmiṣati
tathāhyāvāsitaśabdo'yamabhimatapradeśaniveśitamahāparicchade mahārājādau nirūḍhābhidhānaśaktiḥ
sa upacāreṇa śrāvaṇādiṣu prayujyamānasteṣāmapi mahattvamabhilakṣya mahāparicchadatāṃ mahāsaṃbhavatvaṃ ca lakṣayan prastutāyā api pravṛttermahāntamanubandhaṃ lakṣayati
te ca yugapallocanādau cānupapadyamānasthitayaḥ svaśabdaśaktitastatra tatra ca niveśyamānāḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ pratyāsannāyāṃ taddharmasaṃpadamupalakṣayanti
asāvasau virahavatyā api viyogavedanātiśayaṃ lakṣayantī kamitari snehātiśayaṃ lakṣayati
tatra śrāvaṇo bhādrapada ityetābhyāmavayavābhyāṃ varṣarturlakṣyate
sa ca locanayoranupapadyamānasthitirapi vibhaktiśrutyā niveśitaḥ payaḥpṛṣatpravāhalakṣaṇāyāḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ pratyāsannāmavicchinnāśrusaṃpadamupalakṣayansamāgamotkāyā utkaṇṭhātiśayaṃ lakṣayati
mādhava ityuttarāvayavena vasanto lakṣyate
so'pi mahītalasrastare'nupapadyamānasthitiḥ prāgvadeva śabdaśaktyā niveśitaḥ kusumakisalayamṛṇālakamalinīdalādikāyāḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ samāsannāṃ śiśiropakaraṇasāmagrīmupalakṣayankāmavatyāḥ śarīrāntastāpaṃ lakṣayati
śaradityanena ṛtuviśeṣo'bhidhīyate
sā gaṇḍayoranupapadyamānasthitiḥ praśaṃsāvacanasyāpi sthalaśabdasyānusmaraṇaśattkyā samākṛṣyamāṇakāśakusumahaṃsāgamanakumudasaraḥprasādacandrātapādikāyāḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ samāsannaṃ gaṇḍayoḥ pāṇḍubhāvaṃ lakṣayanmṛgekṣaṇāyā virahakārśyamupalakṣayati
grīṣma ityanenāpi ṛtuviśeṣa evocyate
so'pyaṅga-nāṅge'nupapadyamānaḥ sūryāṃśukārkaśyaprataptapāṃsutāpaparuṣoṣmānilatvadāvāgnikāluṣyādeḥ svadharmasaṃpadaḥ samānānīkabhūtābhūtapūrvānaṅgajvaraliṅgasaṃpadamupayannaṣṭamīṃ kāmāvasthāmupalakṣayati
mārgaśīrṣa ityanena tu pūrvāvayavena hemanto lakṣyate
tena ca yathā hemante tilavanaṃ lūyate tathā tasyāḥ sukhāsikā sāṃprataṃ lūyata iti lakṣitenātiśayinī manaḥpīḍopalakṣitā bhavati
kā punaḥ sukhāsikā tilavanayoḥ samānadharmatā yeyaṃ snehanirbharatā nāma
abhisārikāṇāṃ ca prāyeṇa tilavanābjinīkhaṇḍayoreva bahumānaprasiddhiḥ
yaditthamāhuḥ—
‘attantaharamaṇijjaṃ amhaṃ gāmassa maṇḍaṇīhūam
luatilavāḍisaricchaṃ sisireṇa kaaṃ bhisiṇisaṇḍam || 77 ||’
[atyantaramaṇīyamasmākaṃ grāmasya bhaṇḍanībhūtam
lūna tilavāṭīsadṛśaṃ śiśireṇa kṛtamabjinīkhaṇḍam ||]
ata evāyamuttaravākye kamalasaraḥśabdenābjinīkhaṇḍamapi nirdiśati
tadyathā—
‘muddhihi muhapaṅkaasari āvāsiu sisiru'
[mugdhāyā mukhapaṅkajasarasi āvāsitaḥ śiśiraḥ |]
tatra śiśira ityanena ṛtuviśeṣeṇa mugdhāmukhe'pi padmasarasīva śabdaśaktyā niveśitena kamalavanopaplavādeḥ svadharmasaṃpado lokapratītāyāḥ pratyāsannā mugdhāmukhāmbhoruhalocanotpalasmitakusumadaśanakesarādeśchāyāparimlānirlakṣyamāṇā vipralambhānubhāvaprakarṣamupalakṣayati
śiśiralakṣmīvarṇanaprastāvācca ‘mukhamardhaṃ śarīrasya sarvaṃ vā mukhamucyate’ iti prasthānaprādhānyalakṣaṇayā sarvartubhyaḥ śiśira eva pradhānamityapi lakṣitaṃ bhavati
atra śrāvaṇādīnāmiti
prakīrṇaṃ vikīrṇamanekatra pratītamiti yāvat
taddvividham—kālataḥ, deśataśca
atra hi śrāvaṇādimāsartuṣaṭkasya yugapadasaṃbhavata ekatra virahiṇīśarīre yugapadbhāvo nibaddhaḥ, saguṇavṛttivyapāśrayeṇa śrāvaṇādipade pratipādyamānaḥ pravāsavipralambhaprakarṣamāvedayatīti
evaṃ deśavikīrṇaghaṭanāpyudāhāryā
yathā—‘amṛtamabhṛtaṃ candraścandrastathāmbujamambujaṃ ratirapi ratiḥ kāmaḥ kāmo madhūni madhūnyapi
iti na bhajate vastuprāyaḥ parasparasaṃkaraṃ tadiyamabalā dhatte bhāvānkathaṃ sakalātmakān
’ yastvatra siddhādibhedaḥ kaścidupavarṇitaḥ sa tathā na camatkārakārīti granthagauravabhayādupekṣito'smābhiḥ
tattadanekāsādhāraṇarūpāṇyapi prakīrṇāni prakīrṇapadena grāhyāṇi
teṣāmanuktānya (?) tayā vopagraho'pi prayujyata ityāha—prakīrṇaśabdaścāyamiti
vyākhyānāntaraprayojanamāha—teneti
śabdasyārthapratipādanaśaktirabhidhā
sā tridhā—mukhyā, gauṇī, lakṣaṇā ca
tāsu mukhamiva prathamaṃ yasyāmarthaḥ pratīyate sā mukhyā, tathābhūtārthā tadbhāvāpattiśca
tatrāvāntarārthasaṃbandhaviṣayā tathābhūtārthā
yathā—‘svātmenduvahnipavanārkamahīpayobhiraṣṭābhireva tanubhirbhavatā samaste
vyāpte jagatyaparamicchati yo'tra vaktuṃ ko'nyo gatatrapatayā sadṛśo'sti tena
’ saivārthāntarasvārthasaṃbandhaviṣayā tadbhāvāpattiḥ
atathābhūtasya tathātvāpādanaṃ hi sā
ata eva svato'nyato vā svārthāvacchinnasya sākṣādabhidhānaśaktireva mukhyetyācāryāḥ
yathā—‘kamalā aṇṇasaṇīā haṃsā uḍḍāviāṇa api ucchā
keṇa vi gāmataḍāe abbhaṃ uttāṇaaṃ vūḍham
’ guṇavyavahitārthā gauṇī
[sādvidhā] guṇanimittā upacāranimittā ca
tatra dvayordravyavacanayoryatra sāmānādhikaraṇyena vaiyadhikaraṇyena vā prayoge viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvānyathānupapattyā pratīyamānābhidhīyamānaguṇadvārakasaṃbandho bhavati sā guṇanimittā
yathā—‘paḍivakkhamaṇṇupuñje lāvaṇṇakuḍe aṇaṅgagaakumbhe
purisasaahiaabharie kīsa khalantī thaṇe vahasi
’ mukhyayā gauṇyā vānyaviśeṣaṇasyānyatra prayoga upacaritā sāpi guṇayogamupajīvantī guṇavṛttireva
etāvāṃstu viśeṣo yadguṇanimittāyāmabhidheyaguṇayogaḥ, iha tu svābhidheyaviśeṣyaguṇayoga iti
yathā—‘parārthe yaḥ pīḍāmanubhavati nirvyājamadhuro yadīyaḥ sarveṣāmiha khalu vikāro'pyabhimataḥ
na saṃprāpto vṛddhiṃ sapadi bhṛśamakṣetrapatitaḥ kimikṣordoṣo yanna punaraguṇāyā marubhuvaḥ
’ svārthasaṃbandhavyavahitā lakṣaṇā
taduktam—‘abhidheyāvinābhūtapratītirlakṣaṇeti yā
saiṣā vidagdhavakroktijīvitaṃ vṛttiriṣyate
’ sā dvidhā—śuddhā, lakṣitalakṣaṇā ca
tatra sākṣātsvārthasaṃbandhyavinābhūtaviṣayā śuddhā
yathā—‘yattālīdalapākapāṇḍuvadanam’, 'abhinavakaridantacchedapāṇḍuḥ kapolaḥ’ iti
yayā pūrvapūrvalakṣitameva lakṣyate sā lakṣitalakṣaṇeti kecit
yathā—‘madhu dvirephaḥ kusumaikapātre’, ‘bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ’ iti
atra hi dvirephādinā śabdena lakṣita eva bhramaraprabhṛtirlakṣyate na tu kurarādiḥ
anye tu lakṣaṇāvyavahitā lakṣaṇā lakṣitalakṣaṇetyāhuḥ
yathā—‘suvarṇapuṣpāṃ pṛthivīṃ cinvate puruṣāstrayaḥ
śūraśca kṛtavidyaśca yaśca jānātiṃ sevitum
’ tadbhāvāpattyādiviśeṣasamabhivyāhāreṇa mukhyādiśabdāstaditaratathābhūtatvāgocarā iti pūrvavavdyākhyeyam
kva punaḥ padaikāvṛttirityata āha—atreti
‘ekkahi acchihiṃ aṇṇahiṃ mahialasatthare gaṇḍatthale aṅgahiṃ’ ityādi ṣaḍādhāravacanāḥ
atra yadyapi gaṇḍasthalapadaṃ gauṇameva, tathāpyanādiprayogayogitayā mukhyakalpamiti ṣaṭsvādhāravacaneṣvityuktam
aṅgādipadāni ca svārthaviśiṣṭānyaparāṇyeva prayuktānīti mukhyaiva vṛttiḥ
evaṃ mugdhāyā iti saṃbandhipade'pi
'suhacchitilavaṇe muhapaṅkaasari’ iti dvāvādhāravacanau śeṣau
atra tilavanasaraḥpadayoḥ snehanirbharatvasarasatvalakṣaṇaguṇadvārakaiva sukhāsikāmukhapaṅkajayorvṛttiḥ
mukhapaṅkajasarasītyatra yadyapi padadvayaṃ gauṇaṃ tathāpi paṅkajapadasya vṛttirabhidhātulyeti na kavisaṃrambhagocarastena vyavahāro'yuktaḥ
‘sāvaṇa-bhaddavaa-māhava-maggasiru’ iti catvāro māsavacanāḥ
te ca svārthasaṃbandhavyavahitaṃ varṣāprabhṛtisabhudāyaṃ lakṣayantīti vakṣyamāṇarītyā varṣādayaḥ ṣaḍādheyavacanāste ca virahavatīśarīre yugapaccāsaṃbhavadavasthitayo jalādisaṃpadādisvasvapravṛttinimittādhyāsena prayujyamānāstadbhāvāpattirūpāṃ vṛttimāsādayanti

sa svaviśeṣaguṇavyavahite'rthāntare prayukto gauṇīvṛttimanubhavan vasantāderapi viśeṣaṇatāmāsādayati

sa iha prastutāyāṃ virahavatīsaṃtāpalakṣaṇāyāṃ pravṛttau lakṣyata ityekalakṣaṇāvyavadhāneneyaṃ lakṣaṇā

śrāvaṇādayaḥ svadharmasaṃpado nirantaravarṣaṇādeḥ svārthāvinābhāvena lakṣitāyāḥ pratyāsannā sadṛśī teṣāṃ locanādīnāṃ dharmasaṃpadaśruprabhāvādilakṣaṇā lakṣyata iti dvitīyā lakṣaṇā

rāgaṃ rāgiṇi muñca mayyavanate dṛṣṭe prasīdādhunā satyaṃ tvadvirahādbhavanti dayite sarvā mamānghā diśaḥ || 79 ||’

aśanādayo hi dvayoḥ sādhāraṇā eveti śleṣopādānameveti
evaṃ hrasvasya dīrghakaraṇena dīrghasya hrasvakaraṇenārthāntarapratītiravaseyā

piṇḍākṣaravibhāgaścūrṇam

‘yena dhvastamanobhavena balijitkāyaḥ purā'strīkṛto yo gaṅgāṃ ca dadhe'ndhakakṣayakaro yo barhipatrapriyaḥ
yasyāhuḥ śaśimacchirohara iti stutyaṃ ca nāmāmarāḥ so'vyādiṣṭabhujaṅgahāravalayastvāṃ sarvadomādhavaḥ || 81 ||’

tayośca dvayorapi prādhānyenopapādanādaṅgāṅgibhāvena prakṛtāprakṛtarūpatayā cānavasthānātparasparamasaṃbandhenāyaṃ śleṣaḥ
padabhedena tu pāṭhe paryāyato'rthadvayapratīteriyaṃ śleṣopasarjanā padabhedapaṭhitiḥ
yeneti
dhvastamanobhavena dagdhakāmena balijito nārāyaṇasya kāyaḥ purā tripuradāhavyatikare'strīkṛtaḥ śaratāṃ nītaḥ, gaṅgāṃ bhāgīrathīṃ dadhe, andhako daityaviśeṣastasya kṣayo vināśaḥ, barhipatro mayūravāhanaḥ kārtikeyaḥ, śaśimaccandrakalāṅkitaṃ śiro viśvamohacchidurasya hara iti stutyaṃ ca nāma, bhujaṅgā eva hāravalayāni yasya, sarvadā sarvakālamiti umādhavapakṣe
mādhavapakṣe tu—yena dhvastaṃ vināśitamana: śakaṭam, abhavena saṃsārabandharahitena,baliṃ jitavānyaḥ kāyaḥ sa pūrvaṃ samudramathanāvasare'bhṛtagṛhayāludaityavyāmohanāya strīrūpatāṃ nītaḥ, agaṃ govardhanākhyaṃ gāṃ pṛthivīmekārṇavamagnāmuddhṛtavān

‘kiṃ tātena narendraśekharaśikhālīḍhāgrapādena me kiṃ vā me śvaśureṇa vāsavasabhāsiṃhāsanādhyāsinā
te deśā girayaśca te vanamahī sā caiva me vallabhā kausalyātanayasya yatra caraṇau vandāmi nandāmi ca || 91 ||’
seyamevaṃprakārā paṭhitiḥ
bhāṣābhedena kathaṃ strīpuṃsavacanatā gamyata ityata āha—tadaitacchaurasenīti
vibhāganyūnatāmāśaṅkya yathoktaprakāreṇa samādhānamabhisaṃdhāyāha—seyamevaṃprakāra paṭhitiriti
vibhinnārthaikarūpāyā yā vṛttirvarṇasaṃhateḥ
avyapetavyapetātmā yamakaṃ tannigadyate || 58
athāvṛttyupajīvino'laṃkārā lakṣayitavyāḥ
teṣāṃ samagrakāvyaparyantāvṛttisamāśrayaṇādyamakaṃ pradhānamityāśayenāha—vibhinneti

āvṛttirdvidhā—anāvṛttā vyavahitāvyavahitā ceti

‘rājīvarājīvaśalolabhṛṅgaṃ muṣṇantamuṣṇaṃ tatibhistarūṇām

kānto manojño'lakāntaścūrṇakuntalacchaṭā yāsāṃ tāḥ
yasmādrakṣobhī rākṣasairakṣobhitamadharṣitam

mahitaṃ pūjitam

śanairmandam

‘ghanāghanābhasya mahīmahīyasaḥ surāsurāṇāṃ dayitasya tasya sā
dharādharākāragṛhā gṛhārthino babhūva bhūmernagarī garīyasīḥ || 95 ||’

mahī pṛthivī tasyāṃ mahīyān pūjyaḥ
dharādharaḥ parvatastadākāragṛhāḥ
ādyantayamakaṃ yathā—
‘drutaṃ drutaṃ vahnisamāgataṃ gataṃ mahīmahīnadyutirocitaṃ citam

citaṃ nibiḍena saṃniveśena sthāpitam
samantātsarvataḥ samaṃ salakṣmīkamasthapuṭaṃ vā
paraiḥ śatrubhiḥ paraiḥ śreṣṭhairanirākṛtaṃ yadāsīttadeva vahninā hemamayaṃ puramapagopuramapagatadvāraṃ mahīṃ gataṃ ca kṛtamiti saṃbandhaḥ
madhyāntayamakaṃ yathā—
‘udayi te dayite jaghanaṃ ghanaṃ stanaktī navatīrthatanustanuḥ

ghanaṃ māṃsalam
navena tīrthena rajasā tanūkṛtā

devādevāptarakṣaḥkṛtabhava bhavato'gre na dīno nadīno muktāmuktāccharatnaḥ sitarucirucirollāsamudraḥ samudraḥ || 98 ||’
sīmā maryādā tasyāmāsanaśīlaḥ
mānaṃ parimāṇātiśayaḥ mānaḥ pūjā vā, tadbhūmiḥ

hārītāḥ pakṣiviśeṣāstadyuktaiḥ

devādevāḥ devāsurāstairabhṛtalābhenāntaravasthānena cāptā rakṣā yasmātsa tathā kṛtabhavaḥ saṃpāditodbhavaḥ

viśadā dhavalā

sārasaṃ saraḥsaṃbandhi
manmathonmāthadāyitayā kutsitaṃ rutaṃ kurutam

‘karoti sahakārasya kalikotkalikottaram

utkalikā utkaṇṭhā taduttaraṃ taṭaṃ kūlam

naro'rjunaḥ

yāmatrayādhīnāyāmayā praharatrayaviśrāntiyāvaddīrghatāprakārayā niśā rātryā maraṇaṃ yāmeti viyogakhinnasya prārthanā

tathaiva madhyayamakaṃ yathā—
‘sthirāyate yatendriyo na hīyate yaterbhavān

āyatiruttarakālaviśuddhiḥ

‘bhavādṛśā nātha na jānate nate rasaṃ viruddhe khalu sannatenate

nahi prabhavo namanti

‘kāñcipratolīmanu kāminīṃ tāṃ kāñcisravantīvanamātariśvā

‘akhidyatāsannamudagratāpaṃ raviṃ dadhāne'pyaravindadhāne
bhṛṅgāvaliryasya taṭe nipītarasā namattāmarasā na mattā || 132 ||’
atra mā bhūdavyapetaprasaṅga ityekamevākṣaraṃ vihāya sthūlāvṛttidvayena ślokapādayorvyāptatvādādimadhyāntatā na saṃbhavatītyasthānayamakamidaṃ sthūlavyapetamucyate
akhidyateti
yasya girestaṭe ravimādityamudagratāpaṃ dadhāne'pi bhṛṅgāvalirbhramaramālā nākhidyata
yato'ravindadhāne padmānāṃ nidhānabhūte nipītarasā āsvādita-makarandā
ata eva mattā namanti tāmarasāni yasyāḥ sakāśātsā tathā
bharanamitapadmakuharapraveśānmadhurasasevayā ca bhramaramālayā khedo nādhigataḥ
atra dvitīyacaturthapādayoḥ ‘raviṃ dadhāne ravindradhāne’ iti, ‘rasā namattā rasā na mattā’ iti dvābhyāmeva vṛttibhyāṃ vyāptatvādādyādivibhāgāsaṃbhave asthānayamakamevedam
vyapetaṃ tu kathaṃ bhavatītyata āha—mā bhūditi
pāda eva sūkṣmavyapetaṃ yathā—
‘kareṇuḥ prasthito'neko reṇurghaṇṭāḥ sahasraśaḥ
kare'ṇuḥ śīkaro jajñe reṇustena śamaṃ yayau || 133 ||’
atra viṣamapādayoḥ kareṇuḥ kare'ṇurityādāvāvṛttam
samapādayostu reṇureṇuriti
tattu svāpekṣayā na madhyamanyāpekṣayā nādirityasthānayamakamidaṃ sūkṣmavyapetamucyate
kareti
kareṇurhastī prasthitaścalitastena ghaṇṭā reṇuraśabdāyanta
sahasraśa iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam
sthūlahaste'ṇuḥ sītkāravikīrṇatayā paramāṇusādbhūtaḥ
tena śīkareṇa
nanu viṣamapādayorādyakṣareṇa vinākaraṇena madhye samapādayoḥ punarādāveva reṇurityāvṛttirasti tatkathamasthānayamakamidamityata āha—tattviti
anto vṛttairasaṃbhāvitatvādādau madhye vā sā vācyā
na ceyamapi saṃbhavati
reṇureṇuriti śabdabhāgamapekṣya pravṛttāyāmāvṛttau tadvirahāt
śloke sthūlavyapetaṃ yathā—
‘jayanti te sadā dehaṃ namasyanti jayanti te
bhavānyato namasyanti sadādehaṃ bhavānyataḥ || 134 ||’
atra sthūlavyapetāvṛtticatuṣṭayena śloko'pi vyāpta ityādimadhyāntābhāvādasthānayamakamidaṃ sthūlavyapetamucyate
he jayanti, ye tava dehaṃ durgātārādirūpeṇa prapañcamānāṃ mūrtiṃ sadā namasyanti te jayanti sarvotkarṣeṇa vartante
yatasta eva bhavānsaṃsārasaraṇimasyanti kṣipanti
bhavātparameśvarāt anyatā bhedastenonamataḥ śreyasa ādānaṃ grahaṇaṃ yatra tādṛśī īhā ceṣṭā yatreti dvayamasanakriyāviśeṣaṇam
atra jayanti te iti prathamadvitīyayorādyantau sadādehamiti prathamacaturthayorantādī namasyantīti dvitīyatṛtīyayorbhavānyata iti ca tṛtīyacaturthayorādyantau ca sthūlāvṛttyā vyāptāviti anāvṛttabhāgābhāvācchloke sthūlavyapetamasthānayamakamidam
śloka eva sūkṣmamavyapetaṃ yathā—
‘yāmānītānītāyāmā lokādhīrādhīrālokā
senāsannāsannā senāsāraṃ hatvāha tvā sāram || 135 ||’
atra yadyapi yāmāyāmetyādau vyapetamādyantayamakaṃ nītānītetyādau ca madhyayamakamavyapetaṃ vidyate, tathāpi maṇḍūkaplutyā gatapratyāgateryateśca naitadullikhati api tu śloko'pi dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmakṣarābhyāṃ sūkṣmavṛttyā vyāpta iva lakṣyate
tenāsthānayamakamidamādimadhyāntānāmabhāvātsūkṣmāvṛtteḥ sūkṣmavyapetamucyate
yāmeti
mānibhiritā saṃgatā
yadvā yāmena praharamātreṇānītā prāpitā
śatrūñjitvetyarthaḥ
ānītaḥ prāpita āyāmo vṛddhiryasyāḥ sā tathā
pālanena lokānāmādhimīrayati kṣipatīti lokādhīrādhīrairaprāptasamarasaṃbhramairālokyata iti dhīrālokā
saha inā senānyā vartata iti senā, asannā avasādarahitā evaṃbhūtā yā senā sā āsannā nikaṭavartinī satī āramarisamūhaṃ hatvā tvā tvāṃ sāraṃ kāryasiddhiṃ āha bravīti
nanu yāmā yāmā, lokāloketyādikamādyantayornītānītetyādikaṃ tu padacatuṣṭayasyāpi madhya iti vyapetam, ādyantavyapetayamakaṃ tu madhyayamakamiti sthānayamakamevedam
saṃkaro'pi na pṛthag yamakatāṃ prayojayatītyata āha—atra yadyapīti
yāmetyādikamādāvanusaṃdhāya varṇacatuṣkavyavadhinā pādānte'nusaṃdhīyamānaṃ maṇḍūkaplutiṃ prayojayatīti na tathā sollekham
yāmānītetyādisthūlacatuṣkapratyāgatena nītāyāmetyādinātyantamudbhaṭena yamakacchāyā tirodhīyata iti ca na sollekham
madhyādikamavyapetaṃ sollekhamityapi na vācyam
yāmānītetyādibandhacchāyārthakayatikaraṇenānullekhatvāt
ślokastu dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmāvṛttibhyāṃ vyāpta iti samudāyasollekhataiva
tadidamuktaṃ maṇḍūkaplutyā gatapratyāgateryateśceti madhye yatikṛto vyavāyo boddhavyaḥ
atrāpi vṛttaucityamanusaraṇīyam
pādasaṃdhau sthūlavyapetaṃ yathā—
‘haṭhapītamahārāṣṭrīdaśanacchadapāṭalā
pāṭalākalikānekairekaikā lilihe'libhiḥ || 136 ||’
atrāpi prāgvadeva yativicchedātpūrvottarārdhayorasaṃhitāyāṃ pāṭalā pāṭaletyāvṛtternāvyapetayamakatvam
na caitatpādayorādāvante vā śakyate vaktum
api tvekasyādāvanyasya vāntyasthāne yamakamidaṃ sthūlāvṛtteḥ sthūlavyapetamucyate
na caitadvācyamupoḍharāgetyādau kāñcīyamake'pyayaṃ nyāya iti
tasyaiva tathābhūtalakṣaṇatvāt
haṭheti
haṭhapānena tāmbūlarāgo niḥśeṣitastena prāptaparabhāgasahajarāgonmeṣaḥ
vyavadhāyakaśabdābhāve kathamidaṃ vyapetamityata āha—atrāpi prāgvaditi
nanūpoḍharāgetyādau pūrvodāhṛte'pi yativicchedādasti vyavadhānātko'sya viśeṣa ityāśaṅkyāha—na ceti
kāñcīyamaka evāvyapetāsthānayamakabhede sūkṣmavyapetaṃ yathā—
‘dharādharākāradharā dharābhujāṃ bhujā mahīṃ pātumahīnavikramāḥ
kramātsahante sahasā hatārayo rayoddhurā yānadhurāvalambinaḥ || 137 ||’
atrāntyapāde dhurā dhureti sūkṣmavyapetaṃ vartate
dharādharaḥ śeṣo mahīṃ pātuṃ sahata ityanvayaḥ
svabhedānyabhedayoḥ sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca yathā—
‘sālaṃ vahantī suratāpanīyaṃ sālaṃ taḍidbhāsuratāpanīyam
rakṣobharakṣobharasatrikūṭā laṅkākalaṅkākalikādrikūṭā || 138 ||’
atra sālaṃ sālamiti svabhede suratāpanīyaṃ suratāpanīyamiti sthūlaḥ
rakṣobharakṣobha laṅkākalaṅketi anyabhede kūṭā kūṭeti sūkṣmavyapete bhedo vartate
tadidamasthānayamakaṃ sthūlasūkṣmamucyate
sālamiti
sālaḥ prākāraḥ
surāṇāṃ tāpanaṃ saṃtāpajananaṃ tasmai hitamala-matyarthaṃ sā laṅkā
tapanīyaṃ suvarṇam
tāpanīyaṃ ca tadbhāsuraṃ ceti karmadhārayaḥ
rakṣasāṃ bharaḥ samūhastasya kṣobhaḥ prakarṣajaḥ kolāhalaḥ
trikūṭaḥ suvelaḥ
akalaṅkā doṣarahitā
akalikāni kalirahitānyadrikūṭāni suvelaśikharāṇi yasyāṃ sā tathā
yatsūkṣmaṃ bhāgaṃ bahvāvṛtti tadapi sthūlasūkṣmameva
yathā—
‘madhurayā madhubodhitamādhavī madhusamṛddhisamedhitamedhayā
madhukarāṅganayā muhurunmadadhvanibhṛtā nibhṛtākṣaramujjage || 139 ||’
yatsūkṣmaṃ bhāgamiti
bhāgaśo vivicyamānaṃ sūkṣmameva, vṛttibhūyastayā tu sthūlamiva prathata iti sūkṣmekṣikayābhidhānam
sthānāsthānavibhāgo'yamavyapetavyapetayoḥ
krameṇoktastayoreva pādabhedo'tha kathyate || 65
kramaprāptamidānīṃ pādayamakamudāhiyata ityāha—sthānāsthāneti
tatra vyapetabhedeṣu prathamapādayorāvṛttiryathā—
‘na mandayāvarjitamānasātmayā namandayāvarjitamānasātmayā
urasyupāstīrṇapayodharadvayaṃ mayā samāliṅgyata jīviteśvaraḥ || 140 ||’
na mandeti
mandayā tatkālocitapratipattividhurayā āvarjito māna īrṣyāroṣalakṣaṇo yayā sā tathā
sātmā ātmavatī
anayoḥ karmadhārayaḥ
namanpādānte luṭhannapi dayāvarjitau mānasātmānau yasyā iti bahuvrīherḍāp
tatraiva dvitīyatṛtīyayoryathā—
‘dṛśyastvayāyaṃ purataḥ payasvānānākalālī rucireṇa netrā
nānākalālī rucireṇanetrā devī yadasmādajani svayaṃ śrīḥ || 141
ānākaṃ svargāvadhi lalanamullāsastacchīlaḥ rucireṇa manohareṇa netrā nāyakena nānākalānāṃ cātuḥṣaṣṭikīnāmālī paramparā
eṇanetrā hariṇalocanā
dvayamapi śrīviśeṣaṇam
evaṃ tṛtīyacaturthayorapi yathā—
‘smarānalo mānavivardhito yaḥ sa nirvṛtiṃ te kimapākaroti
samaṃ tatastāmarase kṣaṇena samantatastāmarasekṣaṇe na || 142 ||’
samaṃ samakālaṃ kṣaṇena tato vistīrṇastāmanubhavaikasākṣicintānuvṛttilakṣaṇāṃ nirvṛtimarase iti sopālambhasaṃbodhanam
samantataḥ sarvatastāmarasekṣaṇe kamalanetre na kimapākarotīti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ
vyapetabhedeṣu prathamatṛtīyayoryathā—
‘sabhā surāṇāmabalā vibhūṣitā guṇaistavārohi mṛṇālanirmalaiḥ
sa bhāsurāṇāmabalā vibhūṣitā vihārayannirviśa saṃpadaḥ purām || 143 ||’
abalā balākhyena dānavena rahitā vibhunā śakreṇādhyāsitā surāṇāṃ devānāṃ sabhā mṛṇālanirmalaistava guṇairārohi yataḥ, ataḥ sa tvaṃ purāmabalā vibhūṣitāḥ striyo'laṃkṛtā vihārayan bhāsurāṇāṃ satāṃ saṃpado nirviśetyāśaṃsā
tatraiva prathamacaturthayoryathā—
‘kalaṃ kamuktaṃ tanumadhyanāmikāstanadvayīṃ ca tvadṛte na hantyataḥ
na yāti bhūtaṃ gaṇane bhavanmukhe kalaṅkamuktaṃ tanumadhyanāmikā || 144 ||’
kalaṃ madhurāvyaktaṃ uktaṃ bhāṣitaṃ tanormadhyasya bhareṇa nāmikāstanadvayīṃ ca tvāṃ vihāya kaṃ nāyakaṃ hanti vaśīkaroti
ato jitendriyeṣu prathamagaṇanīye tvayi sati kalaṅkamuktaṃ nirdoṣaṃ tanumadhi śarīramadhikṛtya bhūtamanāmikā'nāmikāṅguliḥ na yāti parasya tvatsadṛśasyābhāvāt
nirdoṣo hi loke ūrdhvāṅgulyā nirdiśyate
evaṃ dvitīyacaturthayorapi yathā—
‘yā bibharti kalavallakīguṇasvānamānamatikālimālayā
nātra kāntamupagītayā tayāsvānamā namati kālimālayā || 145 ||’
vallakīguṇasvāno vīṇāśabdastasya mānaṃ yā bibharti
kālimnaḥ śyāmatāyā ālayā kajjalaprabhṛtīnatītya varṇaprakarṣeṇa yā sthitā, tayā gātumupakrāntayā bhramaramālayā hetubhūtayā kā nāmātra parvataṃ kāntaṃ na namati na praṇamatīti na, na sukhena ānamyate iti asvānamā yā prāgāsīt sāpyuddīpanaprakarṣe niḥśeṣitamānā namatītyarthaḥ
ardhābhyāsaḥ samudgaḥ syāttasya bhedāstrayo matāḥ
vyapetaścāvyapetaśca ubhayātmā ca sūribhiḥ || 66
teṣu vyapeto yathā—
‘anekapādabhramadabhrasālaṃ mānye dṛśābhīrupatattrikūṭam
anekapādabhramadabhrasālaṃ mānye dṛśā bhīru patattrikūṭam || 146 ||’
anekeṣu pādeṣu pratyantaparvateṣu bhramantyabhrāṇi meghā eva sālo varaṇaḥ prākāraḥ, mānyāḥ pūjārhā īdṛśā yathādṛśyaṃ tathaiva manohāriṇo'bhīravo bhayarahitāḥ patattrikūṭāḥ pakṣisaṅghā yatra, anekapā hastinasteṣāmadabhra utkaṭo madastaṃ bharanti dhārayantīti mūlavibhujāditvātkapratyaye anekapādabhramadabhrāḥ sālā vṛkṣā yatra
mānye bhīrviti saṃbodhanadvayam
mānaḥśṛṅgārabhāvastadarhā dṛśā trikūṭaṃ parvatamālokayeti
avyapeto yathā—
‘ghanaṃ vidāryārjunabāṇapūgaṃ ghanaṃ vidāryārjunabāṇapūgam
sasāra bāṇo'yugalocanasya sasārabāṇo'yugalocanasya || 147 ||’
vidārī kandabhedaḥ, arjunaḥ kakubhaḥ, bāṇo gulmaviśeṣaḥ, pūgo guvākaḥ
vṛkṣadvandvatvātpākṣika ekavadbhāvaḥ
arjunaḥ pārthastasya bāṇapūgaṃ śaṟasamūhastaṃ vidārya bhittvā
ayugalocanastrinetraḥ kirātasvarūpadharastasya sasāra gataḥ sārabāṇa utkṛṣṭaśabdastena sahito'yugadvitīyaḥ, alocanasya durjñānasya
vyapetāvyapeto yathā—
‘kalāpināṃ cārutayopayānti vṛndāni lāpoḍhaghanāgamānām
vṛndānilāpoḍhaghanāgamānāṃ kalāpināṃ cārutayo'payānti || 148 ||’
pādatrayābhyāsastu nātisundara iti tadbhedā nodāhriyante
ke pānīye lapanaśīlā haṃsāsteṣāṃ vṛndāni cārutayā manojñabhāvenopayānti saṃgacchante
lāpena parasparasaṃlāpamātreṇoḍhaḥ prāpto ghano nirantara āgama āgamanaṃ yeṣām
vṛndānilo vātyā tenāpoḍho nirākṛto ghanāgamo meghadurdinaṃ kalāpino mayūrā ārutayaḥ samantataḥ kekāyitāni apayānti tirobhavanti
ekaśloke pādatrayābhyāsasyāsaṃbhavācchlokāntare ca tathā saundaryābhāvātpādatrayābhyāso na cintanīya ityata āha—pādatrayeti
ekākāracatuṣpādaṃ mahāyamakamucyate
ślokābhyāsaśca tatrādyaṃ punarabhyāsamarhati || 67
idānīṃ kramaprāptaṃ mahāyamakaṃ lakṣayannāha—ekākāreti
dvividhamekākāraṃ bhavati
ekabhāvṛtticatuṣkeṇa, aparabhāvṛttyaṣṭakena
tadidamuktamādyaṃ punaranāvṛttamiti
pratipādamavāntarāvṛttibhedenaivāṣṭakanirvāhāt
tatrāvyapetabhede mahāyamakaṃ yathā—
‘sabhāsamānāsahasāparāgātsabhāsamānā sahasā parāgāt
sabhāsamānā sahasāparāgātsabhāsamānā sahasāparāgāt || 149 ||’
bhāsaḥ kāntiḥ, mānaścittasamunnatiḥ pūjā vā, āsaḥ śatruvidhūnanam, hasaḥ smeratā, etaiḥ saha vartate iti sabhāsamānāsahasā yato'parāgaṃ cittakāluṣyamatti
bhāsamānaiḥ śobhamānaiḥ saha vartate sabhāsamānā
sahasā mārgaśīrṣeṇa hetunā prāvṛḍvi cchedaprādurbhūtān parāgān rajaḥkaṇānatati prāpnotīti parāgāt
bhā kāntistayā samānā sarūpāstaiḥ saha vartata iti sabhāsamānā
ṣo'ntakarmaṇi
syanti parāniti sāḥ, taiḥ saha vartata iti sahasā
evaṃbhūtā asamānā anupamā sabhā janasamavāyo'parāgādaparasmātparvatāt sahasā śīghraṃ parāgātparāgateti
vyapetabhede dvitīyaṃ mahāyamakaṃ yathā—
‘pravaṇamadabhramadacaladviparājitamūḍhavimalamahitataraṅgaṃ virasaṃ sadātimiśritamacyutadhāma pratītaśikhicaritavanam
pravaṇamadabhramadacaladviparājitamūḍhavimalamahitataraṅgaṃ virasaṃ sadātimiśritamacyutadhāmapratītaśikhicaritavanam || 150 ||’
pravaṇaṃ prakṛṣṭataravanam
‘pranirantaḥśara—’ ityādinā ṇatvam
adabhreṇa mahatā madena darpeṇa calanto ye vayaḥ pakṣiṇastaiḥ parājitā mūḍhavayobālāḥ pakṣiṇo yatra tam, alamatyarthaṃ pūrvoktarūpānamūḍhān vīn pakṣiṇo malate dhārayatīti vā
ahitataraṅgaṃ bhujaṅgavyāptāvartasthānam
virasamatalasparśatayā bhūbhāgarahitam
sadā sarvakālaṃ timibhirmahāmatsyaiḥ śritamāśritam
acyutasya bhagavato nārāyaṇasya dhāma viśrāntisthānam
pratītaḥ prakhyātaḥ śikhī vaḍavānalastena caritavanaṃ bhakṣitajalotpīḍamiti prathamaḥ ślokārthaḥ
pravaṇamadāḥ madāyattadarpāḥ satatanisyandamānamadajalāśca bhramanto ye mainākaprabhṛtayo'calā dvipāḥ karimakarāśca taiḥ śobhitam
ūḍhā vimalā svabhāvanirmalā mahitāḥ pūjitāstaraṅgā yena tam
virasaṃ kṣāram
satībhiḥ śobha-nābhirātibhiḥ pakṣiviśeṣairbhiśritaṃ karambitam
na cyutaṃ dhāma tejo yasya tam
pratītāḥ pratyāgatāḥ śikhino mayūrāstaiścaritavanaṃ bhrāntatīrakānanaṃ samudraṃ paśyeti vākyāntaravartikriyayā saṃbandha iti dvitīyaḥ ślokārthaḥ
avyapetabhede ādyasya punarabhyāso yathā—
‘samāna yāsamānayā sa mānayā samānayā
samānayāsamānayā samānayāsamānayā || 151 ||’
samāneti
he samāna sakhe, yāsamānayā avinayavatīnāṃ dhuri gaṇanīyayā anayā samānayā samāno yāsaḥ prayatno māna īrṣyāroṣastau samānau yasyāstayā, tathā samānayā cittānusbhṛtisārūpyaṃ bhajamānayā pūjāsihatayā asamānayā anupamayā sa tvaṃ mā māṃ samānaya saṃgamayeti manmathonmādāviṣṭasya kasyacidvayasyasya prārthanā
ekarūpeṇa vākyena dvayorbhaṇanamarthayoḥ
tantreṇa yatsa śabdajñaiḥ śleṣa ityabhiśabditaḥ || 68
bandhāvṛttisāmānyādyamakānantaraṃ śleṣaṃ lakṣayati—ekarūpeṇeti
arthabhedena śabdā bhidyanta iti naye kathamekena vākyena dvayoruktirityata āha—tantreṇeti
śleṣo hi saṃbhedalakṣaṇaḥ
sa cātra bhinnānāmapi śabdānāmuccāraṇasāmyena pravartate
anekasaṃbandhānāmaikarūpyeṇa vartanaṃ tantramityucyate
prakṛtipratyayotthau dvau vibhaktivacanāśrayau
padabhāṣodbhavau ceti śabdaśleṣā bhavanti ṣaṭ || 69
dvayoriti saṃkhyā na vivakṣitā, triprabhṛtīnāmapi śleṣasaṃbhavāt
vibhāgavākye vibhaktīnāṃ sākṣādupādānātpratyapadaṃ tadanyaparaṃ, viśeṣaśobhākaratvaṃ ca viśeṣopādānaprayojanam
teṣu prakṛtiśleṣo yathā—
‘ātmanaśca pareṣāṃ ca pratāpastava kīrtinut
bhayakṛdbhūpate bāhurdviṣāṃ ca suhṛdāṃ ca te || 152 ||’
atra kīrtinudityatra nauti-nudatyorbhayakṛdityatra karoti-kṛntatyoḥ prakṛtyoḥ kvipi tulyaṃ rūpamiti prakṛtiśleṣo'yam
ātmanaḥ kīrti nauti stauti
pareṣāṃ śatrūṇāṃ ca nudati kṣipati
dviṣāṃ bhayaṃ karoti janayati
suhṛdāṃ ca bhinattīti dhāturūpaprakṛtibhedādevārthabhedaḥ kvippratyayasya sādhāraṇyāt
liṅgaśleṣo'pi prakṛtiśleṣa eva
sa yathā—
‘kuvalayadaladyutāsau dṛśā ca vapuṣā ca kaṃ na darśayate
adharīkṛtapravālaśriyāṅghriṇāsyena na natabhrūḥ || 153 ||’
atra dṛgvapuṣorāsyacaraṇayośca kuvalayadaladyutetyadharīkṛtapravālaśriyeti ca liṅgabhede'pi tulyarūpe viśeṣaṇe iti liṅgaśleṣo'yam
nanu ‘varṇapadaliṅgabhāṣāprakṛtipratyayavibhaktivacanānām’ iti kaiścitparisaṃkhyātam, tataścāṣṭadhā śleṣo bhaviṣyatītyata āha—liṅgaśleṣo'pīti
tadidamudāharaṇīyamityāha—sa yatheti
darśayata ityātmanepadena taṭasthamapi kaṃ na haṭhāddarśanāya prerayatīti vyajyate
adharīkṛtā jitādharatvamāpāditā ca
nanu ca kuvalayadaladyuteti adharīkṛtapravālaśriyeti ca prakṛtibhāgo na bhidyate, tatkathamayaṃ prakṛtiśleṣa iti
naitat
āviṣṭaliṅgadvayaviśeṣyaliṅgadvayasaṃnidhānādanāviṣṭaliṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇamavaśyamubhayaliṅgagrāhi vācyam
pañcakaprātipadikārthapakṣe vibhaktirdyotikaiva tathā ca liṅgabheda iti vibhinne viśeṣaṇaprakṛtī mithaḥsaṃśliṣṭe iti
atretyādi
pratyayaśleṣaḥ sodbhedo nirudbhedaśca
tayorādyo yathā—
‘tasyā vināpi hāreṇa nisargādeva hāriṇau
janayāmāsatuḥ kasya vismayaṃ na payodharau || 154 ||’
atra hāriṇāviti iniṇinipratyayayorekarūpatvādvināpi hāreṇeti ca matvarthīyodbhedātsodbhedapratyayaśleṣo'yam
tadvākyasthaśabdāntaraprakāśitaḥ sodbhedaḥ, atathābhūto nirudbhedaḥ
matvarthāyenipratyaye hāravantau hāriṇau
āvaśyakārthaṇinipratyaye sahṛdayānāṃ mano harata iti hāriṇau
ānandaghanarasacarvaṇārūpo vismayo'dbhutaṃ ca
apiśabdena virādhadyotakena hārahīnayorapi hārasaṃbandho vismayarasārpaka iti matvarthīyonmudraṇātsodbhedaḥ
pratyayaśleṣastu kathaṃ bhavatītyata āha—iniṇinipratyayoriti
dvitīyo yathā—
‘tvaduddhṛtāmayasthānarūḍhavraṇakiṇākṛtiḥ
vibhāti hariṇībhūtā śaśino lāñchanacchāviḥ || 155 ||’
atra hariṇībhūteti cverṅīpaśca tulyarūpatāyāṃ tadudbhedo nāstītyanudbhedaḥ pratyayaśleṣo'yam
vraṇarūḍhisthānaṃ śyāmaṃ bhavatīti lāñchanacchāyābhūtā kīdṛśī hariṇī haritā
varṇādanudāttāttopadhātto naḥ’ iti ṅīpi nādeśe ca rūpam
seyaṃ pratīyamānaguṇanotprekṣā
ahariṇarūpāpi vyavahārārūḍhahariṇatāmāpanneti cvipratyaye ca hariṇībhūte rūpam
atra ḍīpaścvervā na kiṃcidbhedakaṃ nibaddhamiti nirudbhedaḥ pratyayaśleṣo'yam
haritahariṇarūpe prakṛtī api saṃbhinne eva
saṃkarasyādūṣaṇatvāt
evaṃ pūrvodāharaṇe'pi
vibhaktiśleṣo dvidhā—bhinnajātīyayoḥ, abhinnajātīyayośca
tayorādyo yathā—
‘viṣaṃ nijagale yena babhre ca bhujagaprabhuḥ
dehe yenāṅgajo dadhre jāyā ca sa jayatyajaḥ || 156 ||’
atra yenaviṣaṃ nijagale, bhujagarājaśca nijagale babhre, aṅgajo dehe, jāyā ca dadhre iti tiṅsubvibhaktyoḥ liḍātmanepadaprathamapuruṣaikavacanasaptamyekavacanāntayorekarūpatvādvibhinnārthakatvādbhinnajātīyasuptiṅvibhaktiśleṣo'yam
nijagala iti girateḥ karmaṇi liṭi rūpam
yena viṣaṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ nigīrṇam, nije ca gale kaṇṭhe bhujagarājo dhṛtaḥ
deha iti dahatestatraiva [karmaṇi liṭi] rūpam
aṅgajaḥ kāmo yena dagdhaḥ, nije ca dehe śarīre jāyā pārvatī dhṛtā sa jayatīti
vivaraṇagranthaḥ subodha eva
dvitīyo yathā—
‘tvameva dhātuḥ pūrvo'si tvameva pratyayaḥ paraḥ
anākhyātaṃ na te kiṃcinnātha kenopamīyase || 157 ||’
atra dhāturiti prathamāntasya ṣaṣṭhyantasya caikarūpatvādbhinnārthakatvāccābhinnajātīyasubvibhaktiśleṣo'yam
dhāturjagannirmāturapi pūrva ityanenānāditvamuktam
paraḥ pratyayaḥ kāraṇatrayarūpaṃ na kiṃcidanākhyātam
śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣu prasiddhāvadānatvāt
dvitīyasyābhāvānna kenacidupamānam
arthāntare tu dhātuḥ kriyāvacanaśabdarūpaḥ pūrva eva prakṛtitvāttataḥ paraḥ pratyayaḥ tiṅādiḥ
ataḥ sarvamākhyātameva padaṃ niṣpadyate
tena ca kathaṃ tiṅantenopamānamasti bhinnārthatvācceti śabdamedadṛḍhīkaraṇārthamuktam
evaṃ tiṅāmapi saṃbheda udāharaṇīyaḥ
yathā—
‘mādyantu nāma kavayastathāpi viditaśramāḥ
veda vidyā patirvācāmahaṃ vācorivāntaram ||’
atra vedeti prathamottamayoḥ puruṣayorekavacane śliṣyete
vacanaśleṣo dvidhā—sodbhedaḥ niruddhedaśca
tayoḥ sodbhedo yathā—
‘prājyaprabhāvaḥ prabhavo dharmasyāstarajastamāḥ
muktātmā naḥ śivaṃ nemiranye'pi dadatāṃ jināḥ || 158 ||’
atra nemirityanye'pīti ekavacanabahuvacanābhyāṃ dadatāmityatra tiṅante prājyaprabhāvaḥ prabhava ityādiṣu ca subanteṣvekavacanabahuvacanayorudbheda ityayaṃ sodbhedo nāma vacanaśleṣaḥ
nirudbhedo yathā—
‘tanutvaramaṇī yasya madhyasya ca bhujasya ca
abhavannitarāṃ tasyā valayaḥ kāntivṛddhaye || 159 ||’
atrābhavanniti valaya iti padayostiṅantasubantayorekavacanabahuvacane anudbhinne eva śliṣyete ityayaṃ nirudbhedo nāma vacanaśleṣaḥ
ekavacanabahuvacanābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇeṣu saṃbandhayogyatākṣepāttiṅvacaneṣu subvacaneṣu ca yathāyathamarthadvayonmīlanācchabdarūpadvayodbhedaḥ
ekavacanena valayaḥ kaṅkaṇaṃ bahuvacanena ca madhyarekhā iti subantapade
etadaucitye tiṅantapade cābhavanniti vacanadvayalābhaḥ
na cānayoḥ kiṃcidudbhedakaṃ nibaddhamiti nirudbhedo'yam
tadetadāha—atretyādi
padaśleṣo yathā—
‘aribhedaḥ palāśaśca bāhuḥ kalpadrumaśca te
bālevodyānamāleyaṃ sālakānanaśobhinī || 160 ||’
atra prakṛtipratyayavibhaktivacanānāṃ pṛthagabhidhānādabhidhānamāloktāni prātipadikānyeva padaśabdenocyante
tena pūrvārdhe śatrubhedomāṃsādaste bāhurityarthenāribhedapalāśākhyavṛkṣanāmnī śliṣyete
uttarārdhe ca sālānāṃ kānanena śobhata ityevaṃśīleyamudyānamāleva vdyarthena sālakenānanena śobhata ityevaṃśīlā bāletyupamānārthaḥ śliṣyate
sa eṣa padaśleṣā nāma śabdaśleṣaḥ
arīṇāṃ bhedaḥ śarīradhātubhedaḥ, palaṃ māṃsamaśnāti yaḥ sa tathā, cakāra uttaravākyāpekṣayā
aribhedo viṭkhadiraḥ palāśaḥ kiṃśukaḥ sālāstaruviśeṣāsteṣāṃ kānanam, alakāścūrṇakuntalāstatsahitamānanaṃ ca
pūrvottarārdhayornaikavākyatvamudāharaṇatvāt
nanu vibhaktyantānnānyatpadaṃ tatra pūrvabhāgena prakṛtiśleṣa uttarabhāgena ca pratyayaśleṣa uddiṣṭa eva, tatko'nya, padaśleṣa ityata āha—atreti
prakṛtipratyayabhāvavivakṣāvirahe nāmamāloktāni prātipadikānyevāvaśiṣyanta ityarthaḥ
varṇaśleṣo'pi padaśleṣa eva
sa yathā—
‘tvameva deva pātālamāśānāṃ tvaṃ nibandhanam
tvaṃ cāmaramarudbhūmireko lokatrayātmakaḥ || 161 ||’
atra tvameva pātālamityakāraḥ pāścātye, tvaṃ ca amaramarudbhūmiriti cakāraḥ paurastye'kṣare śliṣṭaḥ pātālaṃ cāmare iti ca padaṃ racayati
so'yaṃ padaśleṣa eva varṇaśleṣa ityucyate
‘alaṃkāraḥ śaṅkākaranarakapālaṃ parijano viśīrṇāṅgo bhṛṅgī vasu ca vṛṣa eko bahuvayāḥ
avastheyaṃ sthāṇorapi bhavati sarvāmaraguro- rvidhau vakre mūrdhni sthitavati vayaṃ ke punaramī ||’
iti varṇaśleṣaḥ kāśmīrakaiḥ pṛthagudāhṛtaḥ
ata āha—varṇaśleṣo'pīti
avayavābhede samudāyasaṃbhavādavayavabhede ca samudāyabhedadhrauvyātpadaśleṣavyavasthitau tatraivāsyāntarbhāvo yukta iti bhāvaḥ
alamatyarthaṃ pātā rakṣitā, āśānāṃ nibandhanaṃ manorathasaphalīkaraṇabījaṃ, āśānāṃ diśāṃ saṃśleṣasthānam, cāmaramarudbhūmiḥ svarloko'marāṇāmindrādīnāṃ bhūmiramarāvatyādirmarutāṃ ca vivahādīnāṃ bhūmirvaimānikapathaścāmaramarudbhūmiścāmaramarutāmāśrayaśca
kathamatra varṇaśleṣa ityata āha—atretyādi
‘paticaṇḍibhyāmālañ’ iti paterālañpratyaye pātālamiti rūpasiddhāvākāra eva madhyavartivarṇaḥ, tatraiva punarekadeśapratisaṃdhāne pātālamityākāraśca pratīyate
atra ca ‘ekaḥ pūrvaparayoḥ’ iti vacanādākāra eva śrūyate tenottaraḥ paurastyena saṃbhinnaḥ
evaṃ cakārasyottarasaṃbhedo vyākhyeyaḥ
bhāṣāśleṣo yathā—
‘kuru lālasabhūlehe mahimohahare tuhārivicchinne
hariṇārisāradehe vare varaṃ hara ume bhāvam || 162 ||’
atra—
‘dhyānānītāṃ ca rudrāṇīṃ kāntāṃ ca purataḥ sthitām
raṇecchuḥ kaścidānarca divyaprākṛtayā girā || 163 ||’
tatra rudrāṇīpakṣe—he ume, hare bhave varaṃ śreṣṭha bhāvaṃ kuru
kiṃbhūte
lālasabhūlehe lālasabhūḥ kāmastaṃ leḍhi yastasmin
tathā mahimnā prabhāveṇohaṃ vitarkamapaharati yastasminmahimohahare
maheśvarasaṃnidhau hi sarvajñānābhibhava iti śrūyate
ataeva tohanti ardayanti tuhā arayastairvicchinne virahite
aparamapyarīṇāṃ vicchedakāraṇamāha—hariṇārisāradehe hariṇāriḥ siṃhastasya sāro balaṃ sa dehe yasya tasmin
vare pari-ṇetarīti
umāyā eva vā imāni saṃbodhanaviśeṣaṇāni
kāntāpakṣe tu—he kānte, tava yo'yaṃ harināryāḥ śriyāḥ sāra utkṛṣṭo dehastatra yadvaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vilocanānanastanajaghanādi tanme bhāvamabhilāṣaṃ haratu
kāmānpūrayatvityarthaḥ
kiṃbhūte dehe
kuṭilālasabhrūlekhe mahimohahare gṛhe hāriṇi vicchinne ca tanumadhyatvādibhiriti
divyā saṃskṛtā
prākṛtā mahārāṣṭrī
bhāvaścetaso layaḥ
lālasa icchā tasmādbhavatīti lālasabhūḥ saṃkalpayonitvātkāmastaṃ leḍhīti karmaṇyaṇ
ūhastarkaḥ saṃśayapṛṣṭhabhāvī viparītapratyayaviśeṣaḥ
kathaṃ taṃ haratītyata āha—maheśvarasaṃnidhāviti
saṃnidhiḥ sākṣātkārarūpaḥ
sarvajñānāni saṃskārapravartakāni
‘tuhira ardane’ tohatīti igupadhatvātkapratyaye tuhā arayaḥ
te dvidhā-āntarāḥ, bāhyāśca
āntarā madamānādayaḥ ṣaṭ, bāhyāḥ kṣetrāpahārakādayaḥ
tatra pūrvāvacchede ca hariṇārisāradehatvaṃ heturuktaḥ
hariṇārisāra iva sāro yasyetyuttarapadalope hariṇārisāro deho yasyeti vigrahavākyamavaseyam
yathāśrutyarthakathanamātramumāyā evetyatra lālasabhūleha ityacpratyaye vyākhyeyam
tuśabdastavārthe
‘tutuvatuhmatubbhatujjhā ḍasaḥ’ iti sūtrāt
harinārī lakṣmīstasyāḥ sakāśāt sāraḥ prakarṣaśālī dehaḥ
‘pañcamī’ iti yogavibhāgātsamāsaḥ
kurulāścūrṇakuntalāḥ
mahīśabdena bhūgolavartinaḥ prāṇino'bhimatāsteṣāṃ mohagṛha iti vyākhyeyam
vicchinno vibhaktāvayavaḥ
yathā vā—
rucirañjitārihetiṃ jananamitaṃ sāmakāyamakalaṅkam
santamamitaṃ ca mānaya kamalāsanamabhivirājantam || 164 ||’
‘bhūtasaṃskṛtabhāṣābhyāṃ dvirnamaskṛtya mādhavam
jagāma samaraṃ ko'pi kasya śreyasi tṛptayaḥ || 165 ||’
tatra bhūtabhāṣāyāṃ yathā—
ruciraṃ manoharaṃ jitārihetiṃ bhagnasapatnāyudhaṃ janairnamitaṃ śyāmakāya-makalaṅaṃka śāntaṃ śāntarūpaṃ amitamanantam
caḥ samuccaye
kamalāsanaṃ brahmāṇamabhilakṣīkṛtya virājantaṃ śobhamānaṃ mānaya pūjayeti
saṃskṛtabhāṣāyāṃ yathā—
rucibhī rañjitā ārihetayaścakradīptayo yena tam, jananairdaśabhiravatārairbhitaṃ paricchinnam, sāmāni kāyati gāyati yaḥ sa sāmakāyastam, na vidyate kalā yasya so'kalastam, kaṃ santaṃ brahmāṇaṃ aṃ viṣṇumitaṃ gatam, abhivirājaṃ garutmantamabhi taṃ prasiddhaṃ kamalāsanaṃ śriyā saṃsaktaṃ mā māṃ naya prāpayeti
evaṃ paiśācādibhirapi saṃskṛtasya prākṛtādeśca parasparasaṃbhedanācchleṣo gaveṣaṇīya ityāśayavānāha—yathā veti
akalaṅkaṃ doṣarahitaṃ mānayeti dhātvarthasya bhāvyatvenānvayātpūjāṃ kurvityarthaḥ
brahmāṇamabhilakṣīkṛtyeti
rucaya ātmīyāḥ
arā vidyante yasya tadari cakram
hetayaḥ kiraṇāḥ
jananaṃ janma
sāmāni kāyati kīrtayatīti ‘apavādaviṣaye kvacidutsargaḥ pravartate’ iti karmaṇyam
kalā avayavāḥ prasiddhāḥ
vīnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ rājā garuḍastabhabhi itaṃ gatam
kamalā lakṣmīstasyā āsanamadhiṣṭhānaṃ mā māṃ nayeti
āvṛttiryā tu varṇānāṃ nātidūrāntarasthitā
alaṃkāraḥ sa vidvadbhiranuprāsaḥ pradarśyate || 70
anudbhaṭāvṛtteścitrādudbhaṭāvṛttimanuprāsaṃ pūrvaṃ lakṣayati—āvṛttiriti
varṇānāmiti vacanamatantram
‘sāraḥ sārasvatī mūrttiḥ’ ityādāvekavarṇāvṛtterapyanuprāsatvāt
tena yamakavyatiriktā varṇāvṛttiranuprāsa iti lakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati
na ca śleṣe'tiprasaṅgaḥ
tantrābhyāṃ viśeṣāt
pūrvajātipratibimbanena bandhacchāyārthakatayānuprāso'laṃkārapadavīmadhyāste
naca nirnimittameva pratibimbanamata āha—nātidūreti
asti kaściduñcāraṇasya jñānasya vā viśeṣo yaḥ śīghrameva saṃskāramudbodhayatīti tadvatī varṇāvṛttirabhipretā
ata eva prācīnavarṇajātyanugataḥ sahṛdayāvarjakatayā prakṛṣṭaśca varṇānāmanuprāsa iti kāśmīrikā niruktiḥ
śrutibhirvṛttibhirvarṇaiḥ padairnāmadviruktibhiḥ
lāṭānāmuktibhiścāyaṃ ṣaṭprakāraḥ prakāśate || 71
evaṃ sthite sāmānyalakṣaṇavibhāgamāha—śrutibhiriti
āvṛttirdvidhā—varṇamātrāvalambinī, samudāyagocarā ca
ādyāpi dvidhā—sāmānyataḥ rūpataśca
sāmānyamapi dvidhā—sthānataḥ, vyāpārataśca
tatra sthānaṃ kaṇṭhādilakṣaṇaṃ saiva śrutiḥ
śrūyate hi tayābhivyakto varṇavyāpāro'bhivyañjanarūpaḥ, sa eva rasaviṣaye vartanaṃ vṛttirucyate
śrutibhirityādau itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā
prāyeṇa śrutyanuprāsasteṣvanuprāsanāyakaḥ
sanāthaiva hi vaidarbhī bhāti tena vicitritā || 72
prāyeṇeti
śrutyanuprāso hi śleṣaghaṭakaḥ
śleṣaśca guṇāntarasamakakṣatayāvatiṣṭhamāno vaidarbhī prayojayati
anuprāsāntaraṃ tu prauḍhiṃ vā mādhuryaṃ vā prakarṣayatīti na tathānukūlyam
kaviśaktivaśāttu kvacittadapi prayojayatīti prāyapadena sūcitam
sthitiprayojako loke nātha ityucyate, teṣu nāyaka ityeva vaktavye punaranuprāsapadamanuprāsāntarasādhāraṇyenaiva śabdālaṃkāratvaṃ darśayitumiti samādheyam
vicitritā ālekhyamiva lekhayā camatkārakāritvamānītā
niveśayati vāgdevī pratibhānavataḥ kaveḥ
puṇyairamumanuprāsaṃ sasamādhini cetasi || 73
kathaṃ punarasyānuprāsasya pṛthakprayatnānusaṃdheyasyāpi rasaprakāśasāmagryāmantarbhāva ityata āha—niveśayatīti
akliṣṭapadavākyārthasphuraṇaṃ pratibhānam
tadeva kathamityata āha—sasamādhinīti
puṇyairiti
tena rasavattvavyavasthitasya kaverahaṃpūrvikākṛṣṭo'nuprāso na pṛthakprayatnanirvartya iti tātparyam
grāmyādibhedo'gre vivariṣyate
sa tridhā—grāmyaḥ, nāgaraḥ, upanāgaraśca
teṣu grāmyaścaturdhā—masṛṇaḥ, varṇamasṛṇaḥ, varṇotkaṭaḥ, varṇānutkaṭaśca
teṣāṃ masṛṇo yathā—
‘eṣa rājā dayālakṣmīṃ prāptavānbrāhmaṇapriyaḥ
tadā prabhṛti dharmasya loke'sminnutsavo'bhavat || 166 ||’
atra sthānataḥ samānaśrutīnāṃ mūrdhanyatālavyadantyauṣṭhyakaṇṭhyavarṇānāṃ prathamatṛtīyapādayornirantarā dvitīyacaturthayośca sāntarā paṭa iva sragdāmnīva vā varṇapradānānmasṛṇaivāvṛttiḥ
so'yaṃ śrutyanuprāso masṛṇa ityucyate
ekapadapratibhāsamātrānumeyo masṛṇaḥ
rūpasājātye'pi masṛṇatānyagbhūto varṇamasṛṇaḥ
udbhaṭarūpasājātyānuviddho varṇotkaṭaḥ
anudbhaṭasājātyānurodhena kiṃcidabhibhūtamasṛṇabhāvo varṇānutkaṭaḥ
eṣa rājetyādāvudāharaṇe ṣakārarephau mūrdhanyau, jakārayakārau tālavyau, dakāralakārau dantyāviti prathamapāde
takāradakārau dantyau, pakārabhakārāvauṣṭhyau, takāradhakārau dantyāviti tṛtīyapāde ca
nirantaraṃ dvitīyapāde rephaṇakārau mūrdhanyau
caturthapāde lakārasakārau dantyāvityādi
vinā krameṇa sāntaramāvartanaṃ navarūpasājātyaṃ kvacidullikhatīti masṛṇa evāyam
varṇamasṛṇo yathā—
‘sthitāḥ kṣaṇaṃ pakṣmasu tāḍitādharāḥ payodharotsedhanipātacūrṇitāḥ
valīṣu tasyāḥ skhalitāḥ prapedire cireṇa nābhiṃ prathamodabindavaḥ 167’
atra dantyau mūrdhanyāvoṣṭhyau ḍalayoraikyena dantyapañcakaṃ mūrdhanya ityādinā krameṇa yadyapi pūrvavatsthānataḥ samānaśrutitayā masṛṇaivāvṛttiḥ, tathāpi citrapaṭa iva mālyagrathana iva vā yo'yaṃ kṣaṇaṃ pakṣmasu tāḍitādharāḥ, payodharaḥ, valīḥ, skhalitāḥ prapedire cireṇa nābhiṃ prathamodabindavaḥ, iti nānāvarṇātmakaḥ sūtrāntarasyeva puṣpāntarasyeva vā sthānabhedena masṛṇa eva niveśastenaiṣa śrutyanuprāso varṇamasṛṇa ityucyate
atra citratantumayaḥ paṭaḥ
ekajātīyakusumagrathanātprāk sthitā ityādi
atra thakāratakārau dantyau, ṣakāraṇakārau mūrdhanyau, pakāramakārāvoṣṭhyau
tāḍitetyatra ḍakāre lakārakalpanayā sanalatadhāḥ pañca dantyāśca repho mūrdhanya iti prathamapāde
dvitīyapāde ca dhakārasakārau nakāratakārau dantyāvityādinā krameṇa sāntarā nirantarā ca śrutita eva varṇāvṛttiḥ pūrvavadupalabhyate
kiṃtu takārādīnāṃ rūpato'pi sthāne sthāne pūrvamasṛṇatānyagbhūtaivāvṛttistenāyaṃ varṇamasṛṇaḥ
śrutisājātyaṃ ca na kvacidvighaṭate
atraiva nidarśanadvayam
varṇotkaṭo yathā—
‘vimucya sā hāramahāryaniścayā viloladṛṣṭiḥ praviluptacandanā
bavandha bālāruṇababhruvalkalaṃ payodharotsedhaviśīrṇasahatiḥ || 168 ||’
atra sarvaṃ pūrvavat
kiṃtu tṛtīyapāde babandha bālāruṇababhruvalkalamiti varṇādhikyayogaḥ
so'yaṃ varṇotkaṭo nāma śrutyanuprāsaḥ
vimucyeti
hārocitasaṃniveśayorapi stanayoranucitavalkalabandhasaṃbhāvane heturahāryaniścayeti
ata eva sā māṃ ko'pi vārayediti kātaratāprādurbhāvāditastato viloladṛṣṭiḥ
atra hakāramakārāvoṣṭhyau, cakārayakārau tālavyāvityādinā krameṇa masṛṇā hakārādīnāṃ rūpasājātye'pi masṛṇatāprādhānyādvarṇamasṛṇā cāvṛttirityāha—atra sarvamiti
varṇotkaṭatvaṃ vyācaṣṭe—varṇādhikyayoga iti
udbhaṭaṃ hi rūpasājātyaṃ varṇotkaṭatvam
tacca sarūpavarṇāvṛttyādhikyenetyarthaḥ
varṇānutkaṭo yathā—
‘tataḥ prabhṛtyunmadanā piturgṛhe lalāṭikācandanadhūsarālakā
na jātu bālā labhate sma nirvṛtiṃ tuṣārasaṃghātaśilātaleṣvapi || 169 ||’
atra dantyavarṇaprāyatayātimasṛṇatve śilātaleṣviti dantyavarṇābhyāmeva varṇastomo dattaḥ
so'yaṃ varṇānutkaṭo nāma śrutyanuprāsaḥ
te'mī catvāro'pyatiprasiddhatayā grāmyā ucyante
tataḥ prabhṛtīti
tāpodrekāddattaṃ dattameva candanamāśyānabhāvena reṇubhiralakacchaṭāsu viśīryata iti dvitīyakāmāveśo dhvanitaḥ
atra takāranakārau dakāranakārāvityādinā krameṇa ślokasamāptiṃ yāvadbahavo dantyāḥ
tenaikaśrutivyāptasya saṃdarbhasya masṛṇatāyāmatiśayaḥ
śilātaleti rūpasājātyena lakārāvudbhūtaśrutikau
na cādhikāvṛttiratrāstītyanutkaṭatā
na ca śruterudbhave'pi masṛṇatā na prakṛṣyata iti varṇānutkaṭo'yam
grāmyatvaṃ vyācaṣṭe—te'mī catvāro'pīti
śrutisājātyasya śabdānuśāsane'pi prasiddheratiprasiddhatvam
grāmyavaiparītyena nātiprasiddho nāgaraḥ
yathocyate—
ekatvabuddhirbhede'pi tattve'pyekatvanihnavaḥ
yasya varṇasya taṃ prāhuranuprāsasya jīvitam || 74
tatra bhede'pyekatvabudhdyā samānasthānayoryathā—
‘harerlaṅghitagharmāṃśurvyomni dīrgheṇa raṃhasā
balibandhanaghoro'ṅghriraṃhaḥsaṅghaṃ nihantu vaḥ || 170 ||’
atra hakārasya tulyasyātulyasthānena ghakāreṇa saha bhede'pyekatvabuddhestulyaśrutitvamiti bhede'pyekatvabudhdyā nāgarānuprāso'yam
grāmyavaiparītyeneti
grāmyaviruddhasvabhāvo hi loke nāgara ityucyate
atiprasiddherabhāvo virodhastenālaṃkārasamayopajīvipañcaṣaprasiddhiranatiprasiddhirityuktaṃ bhavati
etadeva pūrvācāryamatena viśadayati—yathocyata iti
ekaśrutikatayā bhānaṃ hi śrutisājātyamabhimatam
śrutiśca vāstavī pratipādanamātrārūḍhā veti na kaścidviśeṣaḥ
tato bhede'pyekatvabudhdyānuprāsasiddhiḥ
tattve ekatve
āpātataḥ sājātyānavabhāse'pi sahṛdayapraṇidhānenāvabhāsanaṃ śrutyanuprāsaprayojakameva
anuprāsasya
anuprāsavataḥ saṃdarbhasyetyarthaḥ
vijātīyayorekajātyapratibimbanaṃ dvidhā bhavati sthānasāmye tadasāmye ca
tayorādyamudāharati—tatreti
dīrgheṇa raṃhaseti, ghoro'ṅghririti, raṃhaḥsaṅghamiti, ghakārahakārāṇāṃ sthānasāmye'pi vaijātyamastyeva
tathā paṭhitau tulyavacchrutiḥ pratibhātīti sahṛdayahṛdayasākṣiko'yamarthaḥ
tathaivāsamānasthānayoryathā—
‘ucchalanmatsyapucchāgradaṇḍapātāhatāmbhasi
jagadudyānamambhodhāvunmamajja mamajja ca || 171 ||’
atrocchalanmatsyapucchāgretyatra tsyacchakārayoriva tsyakārasyāpi tulyaśrutitvamityasamānasthānatvena bhede'pyekatvabudhdyā nāgarānuprāso'yam
atra tsyacchakārayoriti
cachau tālavyau, tasau dantyāviti sthānabhedaḥ prakāśa eva
tathāpi piṇḍībhūtābhyāṃ ca stambībhūtamadhyapatitau tasau samānaśrutikāviti paṭhitau saubhāgyamarpayataḥ
tenāyamasamānasthānayorekatvabudhdyā nāgarānuprāsa iti
tattve'pyekanihnavena ḍakāravakārayakārāṇāṃ yathā—
‘kroḍe mā ḍimbhamādāya caṇḍi pīḍaya vakṣasā
karṇe brūhi vayasyāyā yuvā yadayamucyate || 172 ||’
atra ḍakārādīnāmīṣatspṛṣṭatādibhirekatve'pi bhedāvabhāsa iti tattve'pyekatvanihnavena nāgarānuprāso'yam
tattve'pīti
drutādau vṛttimātraṃ bhidyate, na tu rūpamiti mahābhāṣyakāroktadiśā yeṣāmekasthānatve'pīṣatspṛṣṭataratvādikṛtā bhedaprathā te ḍakārādayaḥ
katipaye'sya viṣayāstānuddiśya krameṇodāharati—kroḍa ityādi
aṅkagatasya bālakasya vakṣasā pīḍanaṃ saṃkrāntakamāliṅganamāmananti
anena kila pracchannapriyagocaro gāḍhāliṅganamanorathaḥ prakaṭito bhavati
karṇayorupāṃśu yadabhidhīyate tena tulyamidamiti vidagdhasahacarīparihāsoktiriyam
atra ca kroḍaḍimbhetyādau ḍakāravakārayakārāṇāmīṣatspṛṣṭataratvādibhedaḥ śrutisājātyaṃ ca suprasiddhameveti
tathaiva ḍhakāravakāralakārāṇāṃ yathā—
‘navoḍhe tvaṃ kucāḍhyāpi nopagūḍhāya ḍhaukase
vahanbāhulate hrīṇo varaḥ pulakalaṅghite || 173 ||’
atra ḍhakārādīnāmīṣatspṛṣṭatādibhirekatve'pi bhedāvabhāsa iti tattve'pyekatvanihnavena nāgarānuprāso'yam
ḍhakāravakāralakārāṇāmiti
vakārodāharaṇaṃ dattamapi varṇāntarasaralatayā punardīyate
upagūḍhamāliṅganam
apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ
upagūḍhāyāpi na ḍhaukase
dūre patataḥ kacagrahādikeliṣu pravṛttirlaṅghanena sarvāṅgīṇaḥ pulakodbhedo bahirvyāvartanamantaranuvartanaṃ ca mugdhāṅganājātiḥ
atrāpi ḍhakārādīnāmīṣatspṛṣṭatādibhedaḥ subodha eva
ubhayaguṇayogānnātyaprasiddha upanāgaraḥ
yathocyate—
ḍalayoraikyamityādivākyairyasyānumīyate
samānaśrutitānyonyaṃ so'nuprāsaḥ praśasyate || 75
sa ḍalayoraikyena yathā—
‘śayane yasya śeṣāhiḥ sanīḍe vaḍavānalaḥ
mahāsāhasināmagryaṃ tamīḍe jaḍaśāyinam || 174 ||’
so'yamupanāgaraḥ śrutyanuprāsaḥ
ubhayaguṇayogāditi
prasidhdyaprasiddhī dvau guṇau
atra pratyakṣānumānarūpopāyabhedādavirodhaḥ
tadetadanyamatena vivṛṇoti—ḍalayoraikyamiti
sanīḍaḥ samīpaṃ jalamajjanaśeṣāhivaḍavānalānāmanarthanidānatayā prakhyātānāmapi sevayā mahāsāhasikānāmagryatā
atra ḍakāralakārayorbhinnaśrutitā pratyakṣata eva
śrutisāmyaṃ punaranumānātpratīyate
evamuttarodāharaṇeṣvapi boddhavyam
naṇayoraikyena yathā—
‘bāṇaiḥ kṣuṇṇeṣu sainyeṣu tvayā deva raṇāṅgaṇe
hataśeṣāḥ śrayantīme śūnyāraṇyāni vidviṣaḥ || 175 ||’
atra kṣuṇṇeṣu sainyeṣu śūnyāraṇyānīti nakāraṇakārayoḥ svalpaśrutitvamekatvaṃ vā bhāsata iti upanāgaro'yaṃ śrutyanuprāsaḥ
kṣuṇṇeṣu sainyeṣviti
granthimahimnā nakāraṇakārayoḥ sāmyapratibhāsaḥ
raṇāṅgaṇa iti
madhyavartināṃ saṃyogena sāmyonmudraṇam
aṅgaṇaśabdo'dhikaraṇalyuḍantaḥ
pṛṣodarāditvāṇṇatvavyutpādanamanārṣam
evaṃ śūnyāraṇyānītyatra vyākhyeyam
ādyantavyākhyānamupalakṣaṇamavaseyam
ralayoraikyena yathā—
‘vibhinnavarṇā garuḍāgrajena sūryasya rathyāḥ paritaḥ sphurantyā
ratnaiḥ punaryatra rucā rucaṃ svāmāninyire vaṃśakarīranīlaiḥ || 176 ||’
atra karīranīlairiti rephalakārayoraikyena tulyaśrutyā caturṣvapi pādeṣvanuprāsanirvahaṇamityupanāgaro'yaṃ śrutyanuprāsaḥ
nirantararephagrathanālīḍhasyeva lakārasya śrutisājātyamullikhatīti tadidamāha—atra karīranīlairiti
etadanuprāsasidhdyā caturṣvapi pādeṣu rephānuprāsanirvahaṇamapi kaviśaktivyutpattivyañjakamupapannaṃ bhavatītyāha—caturṣvapīti
dantyatālavyānāmaikyena yathā—
‘vidyāsyando vāgvidāṃ yaḥ prasannaḥ puṇyāṃ vācaṃ devatāṃ tāṃ namāmaḥ
yāṃ brahmāṇaścintayante viśokāḥ sā no deyātsūnṛtā sūnṛtāni || 177 ||’
atra dantyatālavyānāmaikyena tulyaśrutinetyupanāgaro'yaṃ śrutyanuprāsaḥ
sarve'pi cānuprāsāḥ prāyeṇa visadṛśavarṇāntaritā eva svadante ityauṣṭhyakaṇṭhyādīnāmihānupraveśo bhavati
vidyāsyandaḥ sārasvatapravāhaḥ saiva vāgdevatā śabdabrahmarūpā taccintayā parabrahmādhigamaniḥśreṇībhūtayā śokasya iṣṭahānijakhedasya vicchedaḥ
atra syandaḥ prasanna iti dantyau sakārau, brahmāṇaścetayanto viśokā ityādeśānādeśau śakārau tālavyau, punarante sā sūnṛtāmīti trayo dantyāḥ, sarveṣāṃ saṃbhūya pāṭhe tulyaśrutitaiva pratibhāsata iti
nanu sajātīyānāṃ nirantaramāvāpe kartavye kimiti vijātīyavyavahitairāvṛttirudāhriyata ityata āha—sarve'pīti
yathā jyotsnā candramasaṃ yathā lāvaṇyamaṅganām
anuprāsastathā kāvyamalaṃkartumayaṃ kṣamaḥ || 76
śleṣanirvāhakatayā śrutyanuprāso'laṃkāra ityuktam, tacca saṃdarbhavyāpakatayaiva nirvahatītyāha—yatheti
jyotsnālāvaṇyayoḥ sarvāṅgīṇā śleṣasubhagayorevālaṃkāratāprasiddhiḥ
anuprāsaḥ kavigirāṃ padavarṇamayo'pi yaḥ
so'pyanena stabakitaḥ śriyaṃ kāmapi puṣyati || 77
nanvevamanuprāsāntaraviṣaye'pi śrutyanuprāsaḥ prasaktastatra ca kimanena kariṣyata ityata āha—anuprāsaḥ kavigirāmiti
uktaṃ hi—‘na ghaṭanāmantareṇa kāvyabhāvaḥ
na ca kāvyamapahāya varṇānuprāsādīnāmātmalābhaḥ’ iti
muhurāvartyamāneṣu yaḥ svavargyeṣu vartate
kāvyavyāpī sa saṃdarbho vṛttirityabhidhīyate || 78
svavargyeṣviti
svaśabda ātmīyavacanaḥ
svavarge bhavāḥ svavargyāḥ kaca ṭatapāntaḥsthoṣmopalakṣitāḥ saptavargāḥ
svavargyeṣu vartata ityarthakathanam
māṇikyastabakitahāralatāvadanyonyālambanena parabhāgalābha ityabhiprāyatayā ca kāvyavyāpakenaiva saṃdarbheṇa nirūpyamāṇā vargyā vṛttirvṛttyanuprāsa iti paryavasito'rthaḥ
kārṇāṭī kauntalī kauṅkī kauṅkaṇī bāṇavāsikā
drāviḍī māthurī mātsī māgadhī tāmraliptikā || 79
auṇḍrī pauṇḍrīti vidvadbhiḥ sā dvādaśavidheṣyate
atha lakṣaṇametāsāṃ sodāharaṇamucyate || 80
varṇānuprāsādbhedo vakṣyate—karṇāṭādiprabhavakavihevākagocarāḥ kārṇāṭīprabhṛtayo na tu vṛttīnāṃ deśaiḥ kaścidupakāraḥ
baṇavāsanāmā dakṣiṇāpathe ratnābhagavatīcihnito deśaḥ
[bhrama dhātoriti
vidhimiti iti parāyaṇam
]
tāsu varṇānuprāsavatī kārṇāṭī yathā—
‘kānte kuṭilamālokya karṇakaṇḍūyanena kim
kāmaṃ kathaya kalyāṇi kiṃkaraḥ karavāṇi kim || 178 ||’
cavargānuprāsavatī kauntalī yathā—
‘jvalajjaṭiladīptārcirañjanoccayacāravaḥ
campakeṣu cakorākṣi cañcarīkāścakāsati || 179 ||’
avahitthaprastāve karṇakaṇḍūyitamoṭṭāyitākhyaḥ śrṛṅgārabhāvajo vikāraḥ
ṭavargānuprāsavatī kauṅkī yathā—
‘kumbhakūṭāṭṭakuṭṭākakuṭilotkaṭapāṇiruṭ
hariḥ karaṭipeṭena na draṣṭumapi ceṣṭyate || 180 ||’
kumbhakūṭaṃ kumbhāgraṃ tadeva aṭṭo'ṭṭālakaḥ
‘ruṣa hiṃsāyām’
yathoktena pāṇinā ruṣatīti kkip
peṭaḥ samūhaḥ
tavargānuprāsavatī kauṅkaṇī yathā—
‘madhurmadhūni gāndharvamandiraṃ madirekṣaṇā
induraindīvaraṃ dāma kāmamānandayanti naḥ || 181 ||’
madhurvasantaḥ
gāndharvaṃ gītam
atra dhakāradakārānuprāsairāsamāpti nirvahaṇam
pavargānuprāsavatī bāṇavāsikā yathā—
‘priyā pragalbhā tāmbūlaṃ parisrutphullamutpalam
pṛṣatkāḥ pañcabāṇasya pañcamaḥ pañcamadhvaniḥ || 182 ||’
parisrut madirā
pṛṣatkā bāṇāḥ
pañcamaḥ svaraviśeṣastadbhūyiṣṭho dhvaniḥ pañcamadhvaniḥ
antaḥsthānuprāsavatī drāviḍī yathā—
‘priyālalavalītālatamālailāvanāvalī
bhāti patralahintālakṛtapuṇḍrā vadhūriva || 183 ||’
patralāḥ sāndrapatrāḥ
sidhmāderākṛtigaṇatvāllac
puṇḍraṃ tilakaḥ
atra lakāravakārānuprāsābhyāṃ saṃdarbhanirvāhaḥ
ūṣmānuprāsavatī māthurī yathā—
‘puṣṇatī puṣpadhanuṣaṃ muṣṇatī ploṣavipruṣaḥ
miṣantī nirnimeṣeṇa cakṣuṣā mānuṣī na sā || 184 ||’
ploṣo virahadāhastasya vipruṣastīkṣṇā bhāgāḥ
te'mī sapta śuddhā eva vṛttyanuprāsāḥ
dvitrivargānuprāsavatī mātsī yathā—
‘kokilālāpavācālo māmeti malayānilaḥ
ucchalacchīkarācchācchanirjharāmbhaḥkaṇokṣitaḥ || 185 ||’
saṃkīrṇāḥ punaranye pañca bhavanti
tatra saṃkaro dvidhā—vijātīyasaṃvalanam, mithaḥ saṃbhedena saṃyogarūpatā ca
kokilālāpetyādau kavargāntaḥsthacavargānuprāsāḥ sphuṭā eva
saṃyogastu vidyamāno'pi na vivakṣitaḥ
dvābhyāṃ vidarbhitaikavargyā māgadhī yathā—
‘aghaughaṃ no nṛsiṃhasya ghanāghanaghanaghvaniḥ
hanyāddhurughurāghoraḥ sudīrgho ghoraghargharaḥ || 186 ||’
vidarbhitaḥ svāntarāyeṇa vaidarbhīprapañcaśobhāmānītaḥ
ghurughuretyavyaktānukaraṇam
atrāsamāpti kavargānuprāsastavargāntaḥsthānuprāsābhyāṃ vidarbhitaḥ
evamanyatrāpi vaidarbhī gaveṣaṇīyā
svāntyasaṃyogivargyā tāmraliptikā yathā—
‘śiñjānamañjumañjīrāścārukāñcanakāñcayaḥ
kaṅkaṇāṅkabhujā bhānti jitānaṅga tavāṅganāḥ || 187 ||’
saṃyogo dvividhaḥ—sajātīyena, anyena ca
ādyastrividhaḥ—svargyāntasarūpatadanyasaṃyogabhedāt
ete yathākramaṃ vṛttitrayaṃ prayojayantītyāha—svāntyetyādi
śiñjānā madhuraṃ śabdāyamānāḥ
mañjīrā nūpurāḥ
atra pūrvārdhe svāntyasaṃyoginau cavargau, uttarārdhe tu kavargāviti
sarūpasaṃyogigrathitauṇḍrī yathā—
‘sallatāpallavollāsī cittavi(vṛ)ttaharo nṛṇām
majjatījjalasajjāsu nadīṣu malayānilaḥ || 188 ||’
santaḥ kamanīyā latānāṃ pallavāstadullāsanamātrapravīṇatayā tīvratāvyatirekaḥ
ata eva nṛṇāṃ vidagdhamithunānāṃ cittameva sarvasvabhūtaṃ vittaṃ haratīti
ijjalā niculāstaiḥ sajjāḥ sannaddhāḥ
niculanikuñjasannaddhanadīmajjanena śītalatvamunmīlitam
asarūpasaṃyogagrathitā pauṇḍrī yathā—
‘astamastakaparyastasamastārkāṃśusaṃstarā
pīnastanasthitā tāmrakamravastreva vāruṇī || 189 ||’
asto'stācalaḥ
kamraṃ kamanīyam
akaṭhorākṣarādānaṃ nātinirvahaṇaiṣiṇaḥ
aśaithilyaṃ ca satkartuṃ vuttyanuprāsamīśate || 81
vṛttyanuprāsarasikasya kaveḥ prasajamānaṃ doṣamapākartuṃ śikṣāmāha—akaṭhoreti
taduktam— ‘paruṣābhidhāyivacanādanukaraṇāccāparatra no paruṣam
racayedathāgatiḥ syāttatrāpi hrādayo hreṣāḥ
’ atinirvāhe vyaktameva vairasyam
taduktam—‘sarva evānuprāsāḥ prāyeṇe'tyādi
komalamātravargyanirvahaṇe tu śaithilyasaṃbhāvanamiti
kvacidasti kvacinnāsti kvacidasti na cāsti ca
varṇānuprāsa eṣā tu sarvato'stīti bhidyate || 82
nanvanuprāsād vṛttīnāṃ ko viśeṣa ityata āha—kvaciditi
kvacidavṛttibhāge caraṇādyātmake bhavatyeva
kvacitpunaraṃśabhedena bhavati na bhavati ca
tāvataiva tasyālaṃkāratvam
vṛttiśarīravyāpakatayā nirūpyamāṇastu vargyānto'nya eva
ayaṃ varṇānuprāsādvṛttyanuprāsa ityarthaḥ
anye punaranyathā vṛttiṃ vyācakṣate—
sparśādīnāmasaṃbandhaḥ saṃbandho vāpi yo mithaḥ
sphuṭādibandhasaṃsidhdyai seha vṛttirnigadyate || 83
anye punariti
varṇānāṃ vartanaṃ vartanādhiṣṭhānaṃ ca vartipadenābhimatam
ādye saṃghaṭanavighaṭanābhyāṃ dvidhā
samastavyastabhedena saṃghaṭanavighaṭane dvidhā
kādayo māvasānāḥ sparśāḥ
ādigrahaṇādantaḥsthoṣmaṇoḥ saṃghaṭanabahulaḥ saṃdarbhaḥ prasphuṭaḥ
vighaṭanabahulaḥ komalaḥ
ubhayabahula unmiśraḥ
kāvyavyāpī ca saṃdarbho vṛttirityabhidhīyate
saukumāryamatha prauḍhirmadhyamatvaṃ ca tadguṇāḥ || 84
gambhīraujasvinī prauḍhā madhurā niṣṭhurā ślathā
kaṭhorā komalā miśrā parūṣā lalitāmitā || 85
dvitīyaṃ vṛttiśabdārthamāha—kāvyavyāpī ceti
atrāpi doṣaprasaṅgāpākaraṇārthamāha—saukumāryamiti
ata eva [saukumāryaprauḍhimadhyamatvāni] guṇāḥ
śaithilyaparuṣatve tu doṣāvityarthaḥ
iti dvādaśadhā bhinnā kavibhiḥ paripaṭhyate
kāraṇaṃ punarutpattesta evāsāṃ vijānate || 86
yogāsaṃyogayoḥ pratiyogivyavasthāvirahātkathaṃ dvādaśaprakāratā vyavasthitirityāśayavānāha—kāraṇaṃ punariti
tāsu gambhīrā yathā—
‘apphundanteṇa ṇahaṃ mahiṃ ca taḍi uddhamāiadiseṇa
dundubhigambhīraravaṃ duṇḍuhiaṃ ambuvāheṇa || 190 ||’
[āspandatā nabho mahīṃ ca taḍidudhmāpitadiśā
dundubhigambhīraravaṃ dundubhitamambuvāhena ||]
saiṣā prāyastavargapavargayostṛtīyacaturthānāṃ pakāraphakārayośca svasaṃyogabinduyogāmyāṃ jāyate
dūṣaṇapratipattisaukaryāttatprasidhdyaiva pṛthagudāhriyata ityāha—tāsviti
apphundanteṇa vyāptavatā
uddhamāiaṃ vyāptam
dundubhirantargatakāṃsyabhājano niḥsvānaviśeṣaḥ
duṇḍuhiaṃ śabdāyitam
dakāradhakārau tavargasya bakārabhakārau pavargasya tṛtīyacaturthau
ojasvinī yathā—
‘pattā a sībharāhaadhāuśilāalaṇisaṇṇarāiajalaam
sañjaṃ ojjurapahasidadarimuhaṇimmahiavaulamairāmodam || 191 ||’
[prāptāśca śīkarāhatadhātuśilājalaniṣaṇṇarājitajalajam
sahyaṃ nirjharaprahasitadarīmukhanirmathitabakulamadirāmodam ||]
seyaṃ mūrdhanyānāṃ prathamacaturthapañcamadvitraistadāvṛttyā ca prāyo jāyate
satataśīkarasicyamānagairikaśilātalaluṇṭhanena jaladānāṃ rañjanam
viśīrya patanenātyantadhavalā nirjharā eva hāso yasya tādṛśena darīmukhenāntaḥprarūḍhabakulakusumāmodaniḥsaraṇarañjitajaladharapratibimbabhūtatāmranayanonmudraṇāt
hāsabakulāmodābhyāṃ ca kṣībatāroparūpā samāsoktirdhvanyata ityārādhyāḥ
ojjuro nirjharaḥ
ṇimmahiaṃ niḥsṛtam
prauḍhā yathā—
‘kṛtvā puṃvatpātamuccairbhṛgubhyāṃ mūrdhni grāvṇāṃ jarjarā nirjharaughāḥ
kurvanti dyāmutpatantaḥ smarārtaṃ svarlokastrīgātranirvāṇamatra || 192 ||’
saiṣā prāyeṇa mūrdhanyānāmantaḥsthānāṃ saṃyogātpūrvagurutvena jāyate
bhṛgavastaṭāḥ
bhṛgupātasya surastrīsaṃgamaḥ phalam
atra kurvansvarlokanirvartyeteṣu mūrdhanyānāmantaḥsthasaṃyogā uccaiḥśabda ityādau svabhāvagurūṇāmapi pūrvarūpasaṃyogasannidhau chāyāviśeṣo bhavatītyāhuḥ kecit
madhurā yathā—
‘kiñjalkasaṅgiśiñjānabhṛṅgalāñchitacampakaḥ
ayaṃ madhurupaiti tvāṃ caṇḍi paṅkajadanturaḥ || 193 ||’
saiṣā prāyo'nusvārapurovartisparśatayā jāyate
anusvārapurovartīti
anusvārasvarūpatadādeśāvanusvārapadena gṛhyete
tena śamitahāsetyādāvanusvārābhāve'pi na lakṣaṇamudāharaṇam
niṣṭhurā yathā—
‘svāṅgaśliṣṭādrijanmānaṃ netrārciḥ pluṣṭamanmatham
staumi tryakṣaṃ dyuṣajjyeṣṭhaṃ daityaśreṇyarcitāṅghrikam || 194 ||’
saiṣā prāyaḥ saṃyogabhūyastvenotpadyate
svāṅgeti
divi sīdantīti dyuṣado devāḥ
suṣāmāditvātṣatvam
atraikāntaritāḥ saṃyogāḥ saṃdarbhavyāpakāḥ pratīyante
so'yamasyāḥ saṃyujyamānāviśeṣe'pi vṛttyantarādviśeṣo niṣṭhurādvaiparītyena śleṣodāharaṇaṃ sugamam
ślathā yathā—
‘dayitajanavirahavigalitanayanodakapītahariṇamadatilakam
vadanamapagatamṛgamadaśaśikaraṇiṃ vahati loladṛśaḥ || 195 ||’
seyaṃ prāyo vyañjanā nāma saṃyogena janyate
karaṇiḥ sādṛśyam
kaṭhorā yathā—
‘nisarganirgatānarghaghargharadhvanihāstikam
cakre cakraṃ yudhi krāmannalarkaḥ karkaśārkaruk || 196 ||’
saiṣā prāyaḥ kaṇṭhyarephādisaṃyogādutpadyate
saiṣā prāyaḥ kaṇṭhyeti
kaṇṭhyarephayoḥ kvacidanyasyāpyādipadopāttasya saṃyogo'vaseyaḥ
komalā yathā—
‘dāruṇaraṇe raṇantaṃ karidāraṇakāraṇaṃ kṛpāṇaṃ te
ramaṇakṛte raṇaraṇakī paśyati taruṇījano divyaḥ || 197 ||’
seyaṃ rephaṇakārādyasaṃyuktakomalavarṇaviracanayā niṣpadyate
miśrā yathā—
‘pinaṣṭīva taraṅgāgrairudadhiḥ phenacandanam
tadādāya karairindurlimpatīva digaṅganāḥ || 198 ||’
saiṣā prāyaḥ kaṭhorāṇāmoṣṭhyakaṇṭhyamūrdhanyānāṃ bāhulyādibhirupalabhyate
bāhulyādibhiriti
bāhulyālpatvamiśraṇaiḥ prādeśikairityarthaḥ
paruṣā yathā—
‘jahre nihrādihrādo'sau kahlārāhlāditahradaḥ
prasahya mahyā garhyatvamarhaṇāhaḥ śaranmarut || 199 ||’
saiṣā prāyeṇoṣmaṇāmantaḥsthādisaṃyogairavasthāpyate
lalitā yathā—
‘drāviḍīnāṃ dhruvaṃ līlārecitabhrūlate mukhe
āsajya rājyabhāraṃ svaṃ sukhaṃ svapiti manmathaḥ || 200 ||’
saiṣā prāyeṇa dantyauṣṭhyatālavyānāṃ madhye'ntaḥsthādisaṃyogaiḥ sthāpyate
drāviḍīnāmiti
kiṃcidunnamanaṃ recitam
tenādhijyakodaṇḍakriyākāribhrūlatāsanāthe duḥkharājyabhārāropaḥ
sugamamudāharaṇam
amitā yathā—
‘bakulakalikālalāmani kalakaṇṭhīkalakalākule kāle
kalayā kalāvato'pi hi kalayati kalitāstratāṃ madanaḥ || 201 ||’
seyamamitayoreva kakāralakārabandhayoranuprāsena prasūyate
iti dvādaśadhā vṛttiḥ kaiścidyā kathiteha sā
na guṇebhyo na vṛttibhyaḥ pṛthaktvenāvabhāsate || 87
tadetatsarveṣāṃ mataṃ dūṣayati—na guṇebhya iti
samatāsaukumāryādiguṇeṣu bhāratīprabhṛtiṣu ca vṛttiṣu yathāyathamantarbhāvo'vagantavyaḥ
śrutyanuprāsavarṇānuprāsayorapi duṣkarāḥ
kvacidbhedāḥ pṛthakkartumasyāsteneha neṣyate || 88
śrutyanuprāsavarṇānuprāsayoriti
viṣayasaptamī
varṇāvṛttervṛttyanuprāsasādhāraṇatvāt
yathāmrātakapuṣpādisragādervarṇa ucyate
varṇāvṛttistathā vācāṃ varṇānuprāsa ucyate || 89
tato varṇānuprāsaṃ viśeṣayannāha—yathāmrātaketi
sragādervarṇasthānīyā varṇāvṛttirvarṇānuprāsaḥ
tatropamānabhūtavarṇavivaraṇaṃ samānajātīyakusumādiviracitamālāpaṭaprabhṛtiṣu yadantarāntarā vijātīyāmrātakakusumādisaṃniveśanaṃ tadvarṇa ityucyate
tadvatyā vācā varṇāvṛttiḥ
saiva varṇānuprāsa iti sūtrārthaḥ
sa dvidhā—saṃyuktāsaṃyuktavarṇanirūpyatvāt
yathāyathametadubhayaprapañcanam
sa tu stabakavānsthānī garbho vivṛtasaṃvṛtaḥ
gṛhītamuktaḥ kramavānviparyasto'tha saṃpuṭaḥ || 90
stabakavadādayo dvādaśa prakārāsteṣu kvacitkvacitsaṃyogāvṛttiḥ stabakavān
anuprāsavinyāsāditi saṃyogānuprāsavinyāsataḥ
mithunaṃ veṇikā citro vicitraśceti varṇyate
varṇāvṛttiprayogebhyastebhyastebhyo manīṣibhiḥ || 91
teṣu sthāne sthāne'nuprāsavinyāsataḥ stabakavānyathā—
‘yasyāvāsīkṛtahimagirerguñjatāṃ kuñjarāṇā- māviścakre vanagajamadāghrāṇaghorāyitāni
darpotphullasphuraṇavikaṭākāṇḍakaṇḍūlagaṇḍa- svecchākāṣavraṇitasaralānokahaskandhagandhaḥ || 202 ||’
atra guñjatāṃ kuñjarāṇāmityādervarṇastabakasya sthāne sthāne vinyāsādayaṃ varṇānuprāsastabakavānityucyate
guñjatāṃ kuñjarāṇāmakāṇḍakaṇḍūlagaṇḍaskandhagandha ityatrāvṛtticatuṣkeṇa stabakanirvāhaḥ
niyatavivakṣitasthānaviśeṣaḥ sthānī yathā—
‘bāle māleyamuccairna bhavati gaganavyāpinī nīradānāṃ kiṃ tvaṃ pakṣmāntarālairmalinayasi sudhāvakramaśrupravāhaiḥ
eṣā prodvṛttamattadvipakaṭakaṣaṇakṣuṇṇavindhyopalābhā dāvāgnervyomalagnā malinayati diśāṃ maṇḍalaṃ dhūmarekhā || 203 ||’
atra prathamatribhāgasthāneṣu bāle māleyamityādiniyamena vṛttiḥ
so'yaṃ varṇānuprāsaḥ sthānītyucyate
sthānīti
ślokapāde'pi prathamādibhāgakalpanayā sthānaniyamavivakṣā
tathāhi—bāle māleyamiti
prathamo bhāgo nīnī iti pratibhāsārūḍhastṛtīyādi prathamapāde
evaṃ pakṣmāntarālamalinasudhāśruprabhṛtīnāṃ dvitīyādipādeṣu prathamādibhāgakalpanāvaseyā
āvṛttervarṇāntarāyeṇa garbho yathā—
‘kālaṃ kapālamālāṅkamekamandhakasūdanam
vande varadamīśānaṃ śāsanaṃ puṣpadhanvanaḥ || 204 ||’
atra kālaṃ kapālamāleti, aṅkamekamiti, vande varadamīśānaṃ śāsanamityādiṣu pakārarephakakāragarbhādhānādayaṃ varṇānuprāso garbha ityucyate
kālaṃ kālasvarūpam
ekamadvitīyam
kālaṃ kapāletyatra lakārāvṛttiḥ kakāreṇa vyavadhāne prakṛte kapāle'nyatra pakāro
varṇāntaragarbhāyamāṇa upalakṣyate
evaṃ mālāṅkamityādau lakārādigarbhīkaraṇamavaseyam
vivṛtasaṃvṛtau nigadenaiva vyākhyātau
sthāne sthāne vikāsasaṃkocābhyāṃ vivṛtasaṃvṛto yathā—
‘na mālatīdāma vimardayogyaṃ na prema navyaṃ sahate'parādhān
mlānāpi na mlāyati kesarasragdevī na khaṇḍapraṇayā kathaṃcit || 205 ||’
atra prathamapāde na mālatīdāmetyādibhirvikāsaḥ, dvitīyapāde premetyākārāvṛttyā saṃkocaḥ, tṛtīyapāde mlānāpi na mlāyatītyetābhyāṃ ca vikāsaḥ, caturthe neti saṃkocaḥ
so'yaṃ varṇānuprāso vivṛtasaṃvṛta ityucyate
na mālatīdāmetyādau prathamapāde makārāvṛttirdvayena vivaraṇam, dvitīyapāde sakṛtprayogeṇa tasyaiva saṃvṛtiḥ tṛtīyapāde nakārasakārayorāvṛttyā vivṛtiḥ, caturthe neti saṃvaraṇam
tadiha bhūyovikāsa-kiṃcitsaṃkoca-kiṃcidvikāsa-sarvathāsaṃkocaparipāṭyā saṃdarbhanirvahaṇaṃ śobhākaramiti vyācaṣṭe—atreti
cakravālavaddhānopādānābhyāṃ gṛhītamukto yathā—
‘lolallavaṅgalavalīvalayā nikuñcakūjatkapiñjalakulā mukulāvanaddhāḥ
adhyūṣire kanakacampakarājikāntā yenāparāntavijaye jaladherupāntaḥ || 206 ||’
atra cakravālakramaḥ suvyakta eva
so'yaṃ varṇānuprāso gṛhītamukta ityucyate
loladiti
kapiñjalo gauratittiriḥ
aparānto deśaviśeṣaḥ
pūrvavalanenottaragrahaṇaṃ cakravālaṃ vyañjanamātravalanamabhipretam, tena valī valetyatrāpi cakravālasiddhiḥ
evamuttaratra
krameṇa dvitrāṇāṃ tricaturāṇāṃ varṇānāmasaṃyogasvaravarṇānāmāvṛttiḥ kramavānyathā—
‘nitambagurvī guruṇā prayuktā vadhūrvidhātṛpratimeva tena
cakāra sā mattacakoranetrā lajjāvatī lājavimokamagnau || 207 ||’
atra gurvī guruṇā prayukteti, vadhūrvidhātṛ iti, cakāra cakoreti, lajjāvatī lājavimokamiti dvayostrayāṇāṃ ca svarasaṃyogavarṇānāṃ krameṇāvṛttiḥ, so'yaṃ varṇānuprāsaḥ kramavānityucyate
krameṇeti
dvāvārabhyaiva kramasaṃbhava ūrdhvaṃ caturbhyo virasāyate
tena pañcaṣāṇāmityādinoktamasaṃyogasvarāṇāmityavivakṣitasaṃyogasvarāṇām
guruṇetyanullaṅghanīyājñatā
tathā calatpraktyā durvahanitambabhārālasāyā api kathaṃcitpadavinyāsena kāntiviśeṣo dhvanyate
svabhāvatāmrayorapi netrayostatkāle dhūmāśleṣād dviguṇo rāga iti upamāne mattapadapoṣaḥ pūrvārdhe dvayordvayorūttarārdhe trayāṇāmanullaṅghitakramāṇāmeva vyañjanānāmāvṛttiriti sphuṭaṃ vivaraṇam
kramavatāṃ viparyayopanyāsādviparyayo yathā—
‘praṇavaḥ pravaṇe yatra prathamaḥ pramatheṣu yaḥ
raṇavānvāraṇamukhaḥ sa vaḥ pātu vināyakaḥ || 208 ||’
atra vyutkramo vyakta eva
so'yaṃ varṇānuprāso viparyaya ityucyate
kramavatāmupakrāntakiṃcitkramāṇāmāvṛttau tatkramaviparyāso vyutkramaḥ
svādyavarṇavartinā svareṇa saha pādamadhyāntayoranuprāsaḥ saṃpuṭaṃ yathā—
‘sthirāpāyaḥ kāyaḥ praṇayiṣu sukhaṃ sthairyavimukhaṃ mahārogābhogaḥ kuvalayadṛśaḥ sarpasadṛśaḥ
gṛhāveśaḥ kleśaḥ prakṛticapalā śrīrapi khalā yamaḥ svairī vairī tadapi na hitaṃ karma vihitam || 209 ||’
tadetallakṣaṇenaiva vyākhyātam
so'yaṃ varṇānuprāsaḥ saṃpuṭa ityucyate
svādyeti
āvartanīyo varṇaḥ svapadenābhimatastasya pūrvo yo varṇastadvartinā svareṇa saha tasyāvṛttiḥ
pādamadhyāntayoriti
madhyasaṃśliṣṭoparitanabhāgaghaṭitasamudgakatulyatayā saṃpuṭo'nuprāsaḥ
antapādamupasaṃhāropakramayorvivakṣitaḥ sasvarānuprāso mithunaṃ yathā—
‘tyaja manasi sadāhe he smara sthānamasmi- nnanu kirasi śarīre re kimindo mayūkhān
api parihara vāyo yogamaṅgairmadīyaiḥ praṇayini samavete te bhavantaḥ sakhāyaḥ || 210 ||’
tadetannigadenaiva vyākhyātam
so'yaṃ varṇānuprāso mithunamityucyate
antapādamiti
vṛttaucitīvaśācca dvikhaṇḍalabdhaśobhāviśeṣeṣu pādeṣu mithunasiddhiravaseyā
tadidamuktamupakramopasaṃhārayoriti
mithunaṃ dvandvam
āvākyaparisamāptervarṇānuprāsanirvāho veṇikā yathā—
‘vidrāṇe rudravṛnde savitari tarale vajriṇi dhvastavajre jātāśaṅke śaśāṅke viramati maruti tyaktavaire kubere
vaikuṇṭhe kuṇṭhitāstre mahiṣamatiruṣaṃ pauruṣopaghnanighnaṃ nirvighnaṃ nighnatī vaḥ śamayatu duritaṃ bhūribhāvā bhavānī || 211 ||’
tadetannātidurbodham
so'yaṃ varṇānuprāso veṇiketyucyate
vidrāṇa iti
upaghna āśrayaḥ
nighnaḥ paravaśaḥ
anuprāsajāterāsamāpti nirvāho'bhimataḥ
vyaktayaḥ punaranyā anyā evābhimatāstena vṛttyanuprāsādbhedaḥ
ata eva veṇītulyatā
tatra hi kila keśagrathanā nirvyūḍhaiva bhaktiḥ punaranyānyeti
uktalakṣaṇebhyo'nyaścitro yathā—
‘nīte nirvyājadīrghā maghavati maghavadvajranidrānidāne nidrā drāgeva devadbiṣi muṣitaruṣaḥ saṃsmarantyāḥ svabhāvam
