‘jayati jayati devaḥ śyāmakaṇṭhaḥ pinākī jayati jayati devī lokamātā bhavānī
jayati jayati dhanyaḥ so'pi bhaktastayoryaḥ kimaparamiha dhanyaṃ varṇyate tāvadeva || 233 ||’
na cāvaśyaṃ dvāveva śabdau prayoktavyau kiṃtu yāvadbhirabhimato'rthaḥ pratīyate tāvanto'bhīkṣṇyaśabdāḥ prayoktavyāste nāvyayakṛtsu dṛśyante kiṃtu tiṅpadeṣvevetyāha—kriyāpadeti
yadyapyekavākyārthasaṃgatyā kriyāpadasya dvayamevoccāraṇaṃ tathāpi kāvyāpekṣayā bāhulyamavaseyam
ādigrahaṇena nimūlasaṃbhramādayaḥ parigṛhyante
teṣu nimūlādiryathā—
‘nimūlakāṣaṃ kaṣati svāntamanta smarajvare
lājasphoṭaṃ skuṭantyāśu hṛdaye hārayaṣṭayaḥ || 234 ||’
ādigrahaṇeneti
tattaditaraprakaraṇaprāpitānāṃ dviruktiprakārāṇābhādipadenopagraho vidheyaḥ
tadyathā—‘arvāgarvāgbalavadupalagranthayaḥ kṣetraśailā dūre dūre maṇimayadṛṣanmekhalo ratnasānuḥ
ārādārānnidhirayamapāṃ yaddavīyo davīyāndugdhāmbhodhistadayamasadṛkchilpa evādiśilpī
’ atrānupūrvye dve bhavata iti dviruktiḥ
evaṃ svārthe'vadhāryamāṇe ityādayo'pi dviruktiprakārāḥ svayamavaseyā ityāśayavānupalakṣaṇatayā kiṃcidudāharati—nimūlakāṣamiti
‘kaṣādiṣu yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ’ iti tasminneva prayukte dviruktisiddhiḥ
saṃbhrameṇa yathā—
‘asthīnyasthīnyajinamajinaṃ bhasma bhasmendurindu- rgaṅgā gaṅgoraga uraga ityākulāḥ saṃbhrameṇa |’
bhūṣāveṣopakaraṇagaṇaprāpaṇavyāpṛtānāṃ nṛtyārambhapraṇayini śive pāntu vāco gaṇānām || 235 ||’
saṃbhrameṇeti
bhayasaṃvegādarātmakaḥ saṃbhramaḥ saṃvegastvarā
saiva prakṛtodāharaṇe dviruktiṃ prayojayati
harṣāvegavismayādayo'pi saṃbhramasyopādhayo bhavanti
teṣu harṣasaṃbhrameṇa yathā—
‘rurudhuḥ kautukottālāstatastāmamarāvatīm
kvārjunaḥ kvārjuna iti bruvantyo nākayoṣitaḥ || 236 ||’
nanu harṣādīnāṃ mahākaviprabandheṣu dviruktirupalabhyate
sā kathamupagrāhyetyata āha—harṣeti
harṣādayo'pi saṃbhramaprayojakāstairasādhāraṇatāmāpannairavacchidyamānaḥ saṃbhramo'nyonyo bhavati na ca saṃbhramatā jahātīti saṃbhramadviruktiprakāra evāyamityarthaḥ
āvegasaṃbhrameṇa yathā—
‘kañcukaṃ kañcukaṃ muñca hāraṃ hāraṃ parityaja
hā hā dahati dāvāgnirvastraṃ vastramapākuru || 237 ||’
atra muñca parityaja dahati apākuru iti kriyāpadeṣvāvegasaṃbhramānnadvirukteḥ
tathāhi—araṇyānīpraveśe vijigīṣudviṣāṃ yoṣiddāvāgnisaṃbhramāvegātkayāpyevamucyate, tatra prathamaṃ kañcuka evāvegasaṃbhramaḥ
sa hyāgate dāvāgnāvuttārayitumaśakyaḥ
tatastavdyāsaṅgahetau hāre, anantaraṃ parāpatitadāvāgnidīpte vāsasīti
nigūḍhagambhīra udvega āvegaḥ
nanu kañcukaṃ kañcukamitivanmuñcetyādikamāvegasaṃbhramaprabhavameva tatkathaṃ na dvirucyata ityata āha—atreti
kañcukasya hāreṇa hārasyottarīyavāsasā vyāsaṅgasaṃbhāvanā saṃbhramahetuḥ
vismayasaṃbhrameṇa yathā—
‘aho rūpamaho rūpamaho mukhamaho mukham
aho madhyamaho madhyamasyāḥ sāraṅgacakṣuṣaḥ || 238 ||’
eteṣu samasteṣvapi saṃbhrameṣu yāvadbodhamiti dviruktiḥ
evaṃ triruktirapi draṣṭavyā yathā—
‘jaya jaya jaya śrīmanbhoja prabhāti vibhāvarī vada vada vada śravyaṃ vidvannidaṃ hyavadhīyate
śṛṇu śṛṇu śṛṇu tvadvatsūryo'nurajyati maṇḍalaṃ nahi nahi nahi kṣmāmārtaṇḍaḥ kṣaṇena virajyate || 239 ||’
saṃbhrameṣu yāvadbodhamiti yāvacchabdārthamāviṣkurvāṇaḥ pūrvoktamabhipretyāha—evaṃ triruktirapīti
upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam
caturādidviruktiradaṇḍavāritaiva
kriyāsamabhihāraśca kriyābhyāsaśca yaḥ purā
yuktāvudāhṛtaḥ so'pi nāmānuprāsa iṣyate || 100
samabhihāro bhṛśatvam
jāyate na ca doṣāya kāvye'laṃkārasaṃkaraḥ
vibhūṣayati hāro'pi stanau grīvaṃ mṛgīdṛśām || 101
nanu vākyārthaprayuktyaiva kāvyasya sanāthīkaraṇātkimanuprāsenetyata āha—jāyate na ceti
udāharaṇenālaṃkāryasaṃkaravadalaṃkārasaṃkaro'pi lokaprasiddha eva śobhāheturityabhimatamiti
arthābhede padāvṛttiḥ pravṛttyā bhinnayeha yā
sa sūribhiranuprāso lāṭīya iti gīyate || 102
kramaprāptaṃ lāṭānuprāsaṃ lakṣayati—arthābhede iti
lāṭajanavallabho'nuprāso lāṭānuprāsaḥ
arthabhede kathaṃ na punaruktidoṣa ityata uktam—pravṛttyā bhinnayeti
tātparyabhedenetyarthaḥ
ata eva yamakādbhedaḥ
sa cāvyavahito vyastaḥ samasta ubhayaḥ punaḥ
ubhayaṃ cakravālaṃ ca garbhaścaivābhidhīyate || 103
sa cetyanuktavyavahitasamuccaye cakāraḥ
lāṭānuprāsaḥ sāmānyato dvidhā—avyavahitaḥ, vyavahitaśca
anāvṛttaśabdānantarito'vyavahitaḥ, tadantaritaśca vyavahitaḥ
tayoravyavahitaḥ ṣoḍhā bhavati
vyastaḥ samasto dvāvubhayāviti tāvacca tvāraḥ
tatrobhayadvayaṃ dviprakārakamiti sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvābhyāṃ ṣaḍbhedā vyākhyeyāḥ
ubhayaḥ punariti
punaḥśabdo vyāvṛttau
pūrvasmādanya evāyamekaśabdābhilaṣya ityarthaḥ
ādyobhayadvayamagre vakṣyate
yastu vyavahito nāma neyatā tasya śakyate
kartumekādigaṇanā padavṛttyādibhaṅgibhiḥ || 104
dvitiyaṃ tu cakravālai garbhaścetyukta vyavahitasya tarhi kiyanto bhedā ata āha—yastviti
tena bahubhāvāvāntaraviśeṣatayā nāyaṃ samaśīrṣikayā gaṇita ityarthaḥ
teṣvavyavahitabhedeṣu vyasto yathā—
‘uahissa jaseṇa jasaṃ dhīraṃ dhīreṇa garuiāi vi garuam
rāmo ṭhiea vi ṭhiiṃ bhaṇai raveṇa a ravaṃ samupphundanto || 240 ||’
[udadheryaśasā yaśo dhairyaṃ dhairyeṇa gurutayāpi gurutām
rāmaḥ sthityāpi sthitiṃ bhaṇati raveṇa raveṇa ca ravaṃ samabhikrāman ||]
atrāvyayānāṃ dyotakāditvādivādibhirvyavadhānaṃ nāśrīyate
na hīvādeḥ prakṛte'pi pṛthakpadatvamasti
yadyevāmidamihodāharaṇaṃ yujyate—
‘tvanmukhaṃ tvanmukhamiva tvaddṛśau tvaddṛśāviva
tvanmūrtiriva mūrtiste tvamiva tvaṃ kṛśodari || 241 ||’ iti
astyevaitat
kiṃ tu yathā—‘amṛtamamṛtaṃ candraścandraḥ—’ ityādikamabhede'pi bhedopacārānnāmadviruktistatheyamityutprekṣate
teṣviti
dviruktaśabdarūpeṣu pūrvaparayornaikamapi samāsāntargatamiti vyastaḥ
etena samastādayo vyākhyātāḥ
dhairyagurutāsthitigāmbhīryānuniṣpādī vāganubhāvo rasapūrṇakumbhocchalananyāyena sākṣādiva tattatprakarṣamarpayan śobhāvikāsahetuḥ
samupphundanto samabhikrāman
nanu jaseṇa dhīreṇa garuiāi vi i raveṇa a iti yadapañcake vibhaktyā taduttarayoścakāradvayena ca vyavadhānātkathamavyavahitabheda udāhriyata ityāha—atreti
avyayānāmityupalakṣaṇam
dyotakatvāditi vibhaktisādhāraṇo hetuḥ
pañcakaprātipadikārthatvapakṣe vikṣaktirdyotikaiva
śākalyo'pi avyayavācakatvavādī
so'pyasattvārthānāmivādīnāṃ svātantryeṇa vācakatvaṃ na manyate
yato na pṛthakpadatvamanuśiṣṭavān
tathā ca dyotakānāṃ paraśaktisahakāritvena tadanupraveśātsvāṅgamavyavadhāyakamiti nyāyāt
nanu kimatra kliṣṭakalpanayā
astyavyavahitodāharaṇamapyanyadapīti śaṅkate—yadyevamiti
atra pūrvārdhavartidvayamudāharaṇamuttarārdhavartino dvayasya pūrvatulyatvāt
pariharati—astīti
ananvayamātramatrodāharaṇam
tatra cāvaśyabhedakalpanayā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvī vācyastathā ca gauṇī nāma dviruktiḥ syāditi saṃkaraśaṅkanāyodāhṛtamiti siddhāntatātparyasaṃkṣepaḥ
samasto yathā—
‘apahastitānyakisalaya kisalayaśobhaṃ vilokayāśokam
sakhi vijitā parasumanaḥsumanaḥ subhaga ca madhutilakam || 242 ||’
atra ‘kisalaya kisalaya’ iti, ‘sumanaḥ sumanaḥ’ iti ca samastānāmevāvyadhānādayaṃ lāṭīyo'nuprāso'vyavahitasamastaḥ pūrvaḥ punaravyavahitavyasta ityucyate
pūrvaḥ punariti
samastānantaraṃ vyastavivaraṇaṃ pratipattisaukaryārtham
ubhayastu dvidhā—prathamaḥ samastoparo vyastaḥ
dvitīyo vyasto'paraḥ samasta iti ca
tayoḥ prathamo yathā—
‘jitalāṭāṅganāvakraṃ vakraṃ tasyā mṛgīdṛśaḥ
ksya na kṣobhajanakaṃ janakaṃ puṣpadhanvanaḥ || 253 ||’
tadidaṃ lakṣaṇenaiva vyākhyātam
dvitīyo yathā—
‘nalinī nalinīnāthakarasaṃnatisaṃgamāt
vikacā vikacāsyānāṃ kāntānāṃ harati śriyam || 244 ||’
asyāpi lakṣaṇenaivokto'rthaḥ
svāpekṣayā vyasto'nyāpekṣayā ca samastaḥ, dvitīyo vyasto'paraḥ samasta iti sa dvitīyobhayaśabdavācyaḥ
so'pi dvidhā—pratipādamantādyorgarbha ivānuprāsavinyāsāt
tayoḥ prathamaścakravālaṃ yathā—
‘jayati kṣuṇṇatimirastimirāndhaikavallabhaḥ
vallabhīkṛtapūrvāśaḥ pūrvāśātilako raviḥ || 245 ||’
atra timiravallabhapūrvāśetiśabdāstimirādiśabdāpekṣayā vyastāḥ yathā—svapūrvottarapadāpekṣayā ca samastāḥ padāntādyorviniveśitā iti yathoktalakṣaṇānugamāllāṭīyānuprāso'yamavyavahito vyastasamastaścakravālamityucyate
dvitīyamubhayaṃ vivecayati—svāpekṣayeti
timirāndhāścakravākāḥ
yatha śrutidviruktaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrveṇottaraścottareṇa samasta iti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ
etena pādamadhye'nuprāsavinyāsādgarbho'pi vyākhyātaḥ
yathā—
‘samādhavā mādhavadattadṛṣṭiḥ sakautukā kautukamandire stāt
savibhramā vibhramadāyinī vaḥ sapaṅkajā paṅkajalocanā śrīḥ || 246 ||’
sakautukā kṛtakaṅkaṇabandhādipariṇayamaṅgalā
vyavahitabhedeṣu vyasto yathā—
‘prakāśo yaśasā devaḥ prakāśo mahasā raviḥ
du saho vidviṣāṃ svāmī duḥsahastamasāṃ ca saḥ || 247 ||’
tadetannātidurbodhamiti na vyākriyate
so'yamekaguṇo vyastaśca lāṭīyānuprāso vyavahita ityucyate
vyastaścānekaguṇo yathā—
‘kiṃcidvacmi na vacmi vacmi yadi vā kiṃ vacmi vacmīdṛśaṃ dṛśyante na bhavādṛśeṣu patiṣu sveṣāmadoṣe damāḥ
te kiṃ santi na santi santi yadi vā ke santi santīdṛśāḥ sarvasteṣu guṇairgṛhītahṛdayo lokaḥ kuto vartate || 248 ||’
atra vacmīti santītyetayoranekaguṇāvṛttiḥ
anekaguṇā iti
āvṛttidvaiguṇyādinānekaguṇatvam, na ca guṇanāyāmiyattāvadhāraṇakāraṇamastītyabhisaṃdhāya tasyeyattā na śakyate kartumiti pūrvamuktam
sveṣāmātmīyānāṃ madhye yaḥ kaściddoṣastatra damā daṇḍaprakārā na dṛśyanta iti
samasta ekaguṇo yathā—
‘candrānana candradinaṃ mṛgalocana mṛgaśiraśca nakṣatram
tithiratithipriyadaśamī paratastvekādaśī praharāt || 249 ||’
nanviha tithirityasamastam
na kevalamasamastaṃ bhinnārthatayā lāṭīyānuprāse'pi na saṃgacchate
saṃgate ca kenacitpadānuprāsena
na ca lāṭīyānuprāso vā nāmānuprāso vā padānuprāsādbhidyata iti
yadyapyekaparihārākārodāharaṇadvayamucitameva tathāpi kiṃcidviśeṣaṃ vivakṣannākṣipya samādhatte—nanviti
mā bhūdatrāsamāso'nyathāpi nedamudāharaṇamiha saṃgatamityāha—na kevalamiti
tatkimanuprāsa evāyaṃ na bhavatīti pṛcchati—kena tarhīti
uttaram—padānuprāseneti
padānuprāsenārthabhedābhedau vivakṣitau
kiṃtu padāśrayeṇāvṛttimātraṃ padānuprāsāvṛttiśca lāṭānuprāse'pyastīti saṃgatyātredamudāhṛtamityarthaḥ
samasto'nekaguṇo yathā—
‘brahmāṇḍacchatradaṇḍaḥ śatadhṛtibhuvanāmbhoruho nāladaṇḍaḥ kṣoṇīnaukūpadaṇḍaḥ kṣaradamarasaritpaṭṭikāketudaṇḍaḥ
jyotiścakrākṣadaṇḍastribhuvanavijayastambhadaṇḍo'ṅghridaṇḍaḥ śreyastraivikramaste vitaratu vibudhadveṣiṇāṃ kāladaṇḍaḥ || 250 ||’
atrānekaśo daṇḍa ityasyāvṛttiḥ
ābhyāṃ vyastasamastabhedo'pi vyākhyātaḥ
yathā—
‘daśaraśmiśatopamadyutiṃ yaśasā dikṣu daśasvapi śrutam
daśapūrvarathaṃ yamākhyayā daśakaṇṭhāriguruṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 251 ||’
atrānekadhā daśaśabda āvartate
śatadhṛtirbrahmā tasya bhuvanabhūtamambhoruda padmaṃ tasya, kṣoṇī pṛthvī tadrūpā yā naustaristasyāḥ kūpadaṇḍaḥ guṇavṛkṣaḥ
daśasviti
eko daśaśabdo vyastaḥ, anye trayaḥ samastāḥ
avyavahite'pi dvaiguṇyāderna virodhaḥ
yathā—
‘vastrāyante nadīnāṃ sitakusumadharāḥ śakrasaṃkāśakāśāḥ kāśābhā bhānti tāsāṃ navapulinacarāḥ śrīnadīhaṃsahaṃsāḥ
haṃsābhāmbhodamuktakṣaradamṛtarucirmedinīcandracandraścandrāṅkaḥ śāradaste jayakṛdupanato vidviṣāṃ kālakālaḥ || 252 ||’
nanu vyavahita eva kiṃ guṇanādibhedo netyāha—avyavahite'pīti
vastrāyanta ityādau kāśapadaparihāreṇodāharaṇam
tatra hi prathamaḥ kāśaśabdo bhinnārtha eva
vyavahitāvyavahitabhede'pi dṛśyate
yathā—
‘dhanairduṣkulīnāḥ kulīnāḥ kriyante dhanaireva pāpānnarā nistaranti
dhanebhyo hi kaścitsuhṛnnāsti loke dhanānyarjayadhvaṃ dhanānyarjayadhvam 253’
yatra vyavahitāvyavahitayorekavākyānupraveśo'sti tatrāpi guṇanābheda udāharaṇīyaḥ
dṛśyata ityanena yadvavdyavahite bhūyasī guṇanā mahākaviprabandheṣu pratīyate na tadvadavyavahite'pīti pūrvaṃ vyavahitamātre guṇanādikamupanyastamiti tātparyam
dhanairiti
atra dhanapadavyavadhānena bahvīṃ guṇanāmavalambamānameva caturthapāde tvavyavahitā tvanuprāse'pi praviṣṭamiti bhavati vyavahitāvyavahitabhedatā
so'yaṃ padābhyāso darśitaḥ
yo'pi cārdhābhyāsaḥ so'pi vyavahitāvyavahitabheda eva
yathā—
‘yaistvaṃ sākṣātkṛto nātha teṣāṃ kāmeṣu ko grahaḥ
yaistvaṃ sākṣātkṛto nātha teṣāṃ kāmeṣu ko grahaḥ || 254 ||’
atra pādāpekṣayā vyavahitatvamarghāpekṣayā punaravyavahitatvaṃ bhavati
evaṃ ślokārdhābhyāso vyavahitāvyavahitabheda eva bhavatītyāha—yo'pīti
dvibhāgābhyāsastu vyavahita eva svadate
yathā—
‘śraddhāyatnau yadi syātāṃ medhayā kiṃ prayojanam
tāvubhau yadi na syātāṃ medhayā kiṃ prayojanam || 255 ||’
śraddhāyatnāviti
atra yadi syātāmiti pādabhāgena saha padāvṛttistribhāgāvṛttirbhavati
padābhyāsaḥ punaravyavahito vyavahitaśca dṛśyate
tayoravyavahito yathā—
‘santaḥ śrṛṇudhvaṃ hṛdaye nidhaddhvamutkṣipya bāhuṃ parirāraṭīmi
na subhruvāṃ tulyamihāsti ramyaṃ na subhruvāṃ tulyamihāsti ramyam 256’
vyavahito yathā—
‘mukhena lakṣmīrjayati phullapaṅkajacāruṇā
dakṣiṇena kareṇāpi phullapaṅkajacāruṇā || 257 ||’
mukheneti
phullapaṅkajamiva cāru phullena paṅkajena cāruriti yadyapi vṛttyarthau bhidyete, tathāpi padānāmabhinnārthatvādudāharaṇatā
ivādyāvṛttayo'pi cātraiva draṣṭavyāḥ
yathā—
‘līneva pratibimbiteva likhitevotkīrṇarūpeva ca pratyupteva ca vajralepaghaṭitevāntarnikhāteva ca
sā naścetasi kīliteva viśikhaiścetobhuvaḥ pañjabhi- ścintāsaṃtatitantujālanibiḍasyūteva lagnā priyā || 258 ||’
arthābheda iti nārthaśabdo'bhidheyavacanaḥ kiṃtu śabdapratipādyamātravacana ityāśayavānāha—ivādīti
yamakānāṃ hi yāvantyo varṇyante bhedabhaktayaḥ
anuprāsasya lāṭānāṃ bhidāstāvantya eva hi || 105
nanvanye'pi padāvṛttiprakārāḥ kimiti nodāhṛtā ityata āha—yamakānāṃ hīti
bhedabhaktayo'vāntaraprakāravicchittayaḥ sthānāsthānapādabhedalakṣaṇā ślokāvṛttiḥ paramatra nāstīti yamakādapakarṣaḥ
upamādiviyuktāpi rājate kāvyapaddhatiḥ
yadyanuprāsaleśo'pi hanta tatra niveśyate || 106
prakaraṇānte'nuprāsavyutpādanaprayojanamāha—upamādīti
anuprāsaleśo'pīti
varṇādyanuprāsaḥ
kuṇḍalādiviyuktāpi kāntā kimapi śobhate
kuṅkumenāṅgarāgaścetsarvāṅgīṇaḥ prayujyate || 107
śrutivṛttyanuprāsau tu saṃdarbhavyāpakāveva praśastāvityudāharaṇavyājenāha—kuṇḍalādīti
śrutivarṇānuprāsāvekavidhau kuntaleṣu gauḍeṣu
padayorniranuprāso dvedhā tredhā ca lāṭeṣu || 108
etadeva khaṇḍasarasvatīṣu kaviṣu na tathā kāvyasiddhiriti darśayandraḍhayati—śrutivarṇānuprāsāviti
'varṇasthānasvarākāragatibandhānpratīhayaḥ

nanviti pūjāsaṃbodhane
tvā iti tvām
anunayan vinayaṃ kurvāṇo'yam
nyāsamāha—prākkarṇikāmiti
pūrvaṃ karṇikāyāmādyo nakāro grāhyaḥ, tataḥ śeti parṇamadhye, śīti parṇāgre, parāvṛtya parṇakarṇikayoḥ śakāranakārau, punaḥ karṇikāto dalāgragamāgame'pi
ayameva kramaścaturdalapadme
tayoścatuṣpattraṃ yathā—
‘sāsavā tvā sumanasā sā natā pīvarorasā
sāradhāmaiti sahasā sāhasardha suvāsasā || 290 ||’
karṇikāto nayedūrdhvaṃ patrākārākṣarāvalīm
praveśayetkarṇikāyāṃ padmametaccaturdalam || 291
sāsavetyādi
sāsavā āsvāditamadirā
pīvareṇa stanāḍhyenorasā natā sāradhāmā utkṛṣṭakāntiḥ sahasā sahāsyā akasmādvā śrṛṅgāroddīpanasvabhāvena mārgaśīrṣeṇa hetunā śobhanena vāsasā ca lakṣitā he sāhasardha sarvaniśīthābhisaraṇa sāhasarasika, tvāmeti upagacchatīti
nyāsamāha—karṇiketi
subodhametaditi
ṣoḍaśapattraṃ yathā—
‘namaste mahimaprema namasyāmatimaddama
kṣāmasoma namatkāma dhāmabhīma samakṣama || 292 ||’
gomūtrikākrameṇa syurvarṇāḥ sarve samāḥ samāḥ
madhye mavarṇavinyāsātpadmo'yaṃ ṣoḍaśacchadaḥ || 293
ṣoḍaśapattramāha—namasta ityādi
mahimani premā yasya tat
namasya amatimato dāmyatīti amatimaddama
kṣāmaḥ kalāmātreṇa cūḍāsaṃgataḥ somo yasya
naman bhagnaḥ kāmo yasmāt
dhāmnā tejasā bhīma bhayānaka
samā sakalavyutthānahetusādhāraṇī kṣamā yasya
yasyaitāni saṃbodhanaviśeṣaṇāni te tubhyaṃ namaskurute kaściditi
nyāsamāha—gomūtriketi
varṇā makāravyatiriktāḥ samāḥ makārasahitāḥ
samāḥ samā iti vīpsā prativarṇaṃ makārasāhityabodhanārthā
aṣṭapattrameva kavināmāṅkaṃ yathā—
‘rātāvadyādhirājyā visarararasavivdyājavākkṣmāpakārā rākā pakṣmābhaśeṣā nayanananayanasvā [sā] khayā stavyamārā
rāmā vyastasthiratvā tuhinananahituḥ śrīḥ karakṣāradhārā rādhā rakṣāstu mahyaṃ śivamamamavaśivyālavidyāvatārā || 294 ||’
niviṣṭāṣṭadalanyāsamidaṃ pādārdhabhaktibhiḥ
aspṛṣṭakarṇikaṃ koṇaiḥ kavināmāṅkamambujam || 295
tatrāṅkaḥ—‘rājaśekharakamala’
etena cakramapi vyākhyātam
aṣṭapattrameva kavināmāṅkamāha—rātāvadyeti
‘gīrvāṇasubhaṭaḥ kaścidyuyutsurdaityasenayā
tatkālakṛtasāṃnidhyāṃ māyādevīmapūjayat
’ tathāhi—vyājo māyā saiva vāgrūpā vyājaśabdopapadaṃ vāgabhidhānaṃ yasyāḥ sā mahyaṃ rakṣāstviti saṃbandhaḥ
rātaṃ dattamavadyaṃ doṣabahulamādhirājyam, avadyā ādhayo yatra tādṛśaṃ vā rājyaṃ yayā
viśiṣṭaṃ saraṇaṃ visarastaṃ rāti prayacchati yo raso'rthādvīrastaṃ vetti vindati vā
yā kṣmāyāṃ pṛthivyāmapakāraḥ putrakalatrādirūpo yasyāḥ sakāśāditi gamakatvādvahuvrīhiḥ
rākā pūrṇimā, dvādaśavarṣadeśīyakanyārūpā vā
pakṣmābhaḥ śarīrasaṃlagnaḥ śeṣaḥ sarpaḥ
yasyā nayanaṃ nītistānnayatīti yannayanaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ
jñānamiti yāvat
tadeva svamātmā yasyāḥ
khe vyomni yātīti khayā
stavyo māro māraṇaṃ kāmo vā yasyāḥ
sā rāmā ramaṇīyā strīrūpā vā
vyastaṃ vināśitaṃ sthiratvaṃ yayā
tuhinaṃ nayati prāpayatīti nayaterḍapratyaye tuhinanaścandrastasya nahiturjaṭājūṭe bandhayituḥ parameśvarasya śrīḥ śaktirūpā
nahyati badhnātīti nahervici nahaṃ stutimāsādayatīti
‘sarvaprātipadikebhyaḥ kvibvaktavyaḥ’ iti kvipi tṛjantasya rūpam
kaṃ sukhaṃ rāti dadātīti karastasya kṣārabhūtā dasyavasteṣāṃ khaṅgādidhāreva dhārā chettrī
rādheti devyāḥ paurāṇikaṃ nāma
mametyavyayaṃ bhāvapradhānam
śive manatvaṃ mānti paricchindanti ye vaśino yoginasteṣāmapi vyālavidyāṃ kṣudravidyāmavatārayati yā sā tathā
nyāsamāha—niviṣṭeti
aṣṭabhiḥ pādārdhairaṣṭadalaviracanā
yadvarṇāṣṭakaṃ nāmno-ttiṣṭhati tadāha—‘rājaśekharakamala’
kavikāvyanāmalābhādaṃvibhaktikatvamapyadoṣaḥ
eteneti
nāmāṅkapadmakathanena cakramapi nāmāṅkamavaseyam
cakraṃ yathā—
‘sa tvaṃ mānaviśiṣṭamājirabhasādālambya bhavyaḥ puro labdhāghakṣayaśuddhiruddharataraśrīvatsabhūmirmudā
muktvā kāmamapāstabhīḥ paramṛgavyādhaḥ sa nādaṃ hare- rekaughaiḥ samakālamabhramudayī ropaistadātastare || 296 ||’
puraḥ puro likhetpādānatra trīnṣaḍarīkṛtān
turyaṃ tu bhramayennemau nāmāṅkaścakrasaṃvidhiḥ || 297
atrāṅkaḥ—‘māghakāvyamidaṃ śiśupālavadhaḥ'
sa tvamityādi
harernādaṃ siṃhanādaṃ ropairbāṇairājirabhasātsaṅgrāmaharṣāduddharataraśrīvatsabhūmirunnatahṛdayaḥ sa tvamālambya mānena tadviśiṣṭamiti viśeṣaṇam
prāptapāpavināśo mudā harṣeṇa apagatabhīḥ śatrurhariṇavyādho'bhramākāśaṃ pidadhe tadā tasminkāle siṃhanādamuktveti saṃbandhaḥ
nyāsamāha—pura iti
puraḥ puro likhitvānyānagre likhedyathā ṣaḍarāḥ saṃpadyante
evaṃ caturaṅkamapi yathā—
‘śuddhaṃ baddhasurāsthisāraviṣama tvaṃ rugjayātisthira bhraṣṭoddharmarajaḥpadaṃ gavi gavākṣīṇena cañcadbhuvā
tathyaṃ cintitaguptirastavidhidigbhedaṃ na cakraṃ śucācāro'prāṃśuradabhramugra tanu me ramyo bhavānīrucā || 298 ||’
atrāṅkaḥ—‘śubhrataravācā baddhaciticakraṃ rājaguruṇedaṃ sādaramavādi'
yathā vā—śuddhamityādi
cakraṃ me mama gavi vāci śuddhamakaluṣam, dharmādutkāntamuddharmamīdṛśaṃ yadrajo rājasabhāvastasya padaṃ sthānaṃ tadbhraṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ yasmāt
astā vidhidigdaivapāratantryaṃ yatra tathāvidhaṃ, śucā śokena ca na vakrīkṛtamanapahatamadabhramupacitaṃ yadbhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ tattanu vistārayeti prārthanā
baddhairalaṃkārīkṛtaiḥ surāṇāṃ brahmādīnāṃ sāraṃ śirastadasthibhirbaddhamuṇḍamālābhirbhayānaka
rujāṃ rogāṇāṃ jayenāti-sthira
akṣīṇenopacitena cañcadbhuvā sāhlādena gavā vṛṣeṇa lakṣita
tathyamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam
cintitā guptirbhūtānāṃ rakṣā yena
cāro ramaṇīyaḥ
ugro mahādevaḥ
tvamaprāṃśuḥ sarvasmāduccaiḥpade sthitaḥ
bhavānīrucā vāmārdhasthitapārvatīkāntyā ramyastanviti saṃbandhaḥ
atra pūrvavadeva nyāsaḥ
aṅkāstu catvāra iti viśeṣaḥ
gaticitreṣu gatapratyāgataṃ yathā—
‘vāraṇāgagabhīrā sā sārābhīgagaṇāravā
kāritārivadhā senā nāsedhāvaritārikā || 299 ||’
atrāyukpādayorgatiḥ, yukpādayoḥ pratyāgatiḥ
idānīṃ gaticitraprastāvaḥ—vāraṇetyādi
vāraṇā eva agāḥ parvatāstairgabhīrā duravagāhā
sārā śreṣṭhā
bhiyaṃ yena yānti tādṛśānāṃ gaṇānāmāravo yatra
sāro vā bhīgagaṇāravo yatra
kāritaḥ kṛto'rīṇāṃ vadho yayā
svārthe ṇic
āsedhaḥ paraiḥ pratiṣedhastena hīnā
varitāḥ subhaṭairyuddhārthamāhūtā arayo yasyāṃ sā tathā
‘vara īpsāyām’ iti dhātoḥ ktapratyaye variteti rūpasiddhiḥ
atrāyukpādayoḥ prathamatṛtīyayorānulomyena varṇāvalīṃ gṛhītvā tatpratilomarūpau yukpādau dvitīyacaturthau gṛhyete
paṭhitervarṇādvarṇāntarasaṃcāro gatistanniyamanena citraṃ gaticitraṃ sa cātra yathoktarūpa eva
tadakṣaragataṃ yathā—
‘niśitāsirato'bhīko nyejate'maraṇā rucā
cāruṇā ramate janye ko bhīto rasitāśini || 300 ||’
atra gatapratyāgatābhyāṃ sa eva ślokaḥ
he amaraṇā maraṇarahitāḥ, niśitakhaṅgarato bhayaśūnyaśca rucā tejasā nyejate na kampate
yo hi bhītaḥ sa kathaṃ śabdāyamānāśanaśīlarakṣaḥpiśācādisaṃkule janye saṅgrāme cāruṇā karituragādinā ramate
na kathaṃcidityarthaḥ
atra saṃdarbhasamāptiparyantaṃ yā varṇamālā gṛhītā saiva samāpterārabhya pratyāgatyā yāvadārambhaṃ samāpyata iti pūrvaṃ tvardhenaivamiti
ślokāntaraṃ yathā—
‘vāhanājani mānāse sārājāvanamā tataḥ
mattasāragarājebhe bhārīhāvajjanadhvani || 301 ||’
atra prātilomyenāparaḥ śloko bhavati
yathā—
‘nidhvanajjavahārībhā bheje rāgarasāttamaḥ
tatamānavajārāsā senā mānijanāhavā || 302 ||’
vāhaneti
tato'nantaraṃ vāhanā senā'namā natiśūnyājani jātā
sārājāvutkṛṣṭasaṅgrāme mānāse paramānakṣepake mattāḥ sāragāḥ sotkarṣagatiśālino rājebhā rājadantino yatra
bhāriṇaḥ svāminārpitasamarabharāḥ ata eva yathocitaceṣṭāvantasteṣāṃ janānāṃ dhvaniḥ siṃhanādo yatreti kriyāviśeṣaṇamityanulomaślokārthaḥ
nidhvanantaḥ stananto javena vegena hāriṇa ibhā yatra
tato vistīrṇo mānavajārāsaḥ sainikakṛta ārāvaḥ kolāhalo yatra
mānijanānāṃ sāhaṃkārāṇāṃ vīrāṇāmāhavo dvandvayuddhaṃ yatra
īdṛśī senā rāgarasātparalakṣmīharaṇarasena tamo bheje krodhamavāpeti pratilomaślokārthaḥ
bhāṣāntaragataṃ yathā—
‘iha re bahalā lāse bālā rāhumalīmasā
sālakā rasalīlā sā tuṅgālāli kalārata || 303 ||’
atra prātilomyenāparaḥ prākṛtaśloko bhavati
yathā—
‘taralā kalilā gātuṃ sālālī sarakālasā
sāmalī mahurālāvā selālā hava rehai || 304 ||’
iha re ityādi
lāse nṛtye bahalā asaṃkucitā rāhumalīmasā śyāmā sālakā bhrūkarṇādiparabhāgārpakacūrṇakuntalavatī rasācchṛṅgārāllīlā yasyāḥ sā, tathā tuṅgā uccavyavahārā evaṃvidhā sā bālā he catuḥṣaṣṭikalārata, alāli lālitā tvayeti saṃskṛtaślokārthaḥ
kalā gītavādyanṛtyānāṃ saṃkarīkaraṇasahitā paṭīyasī gātuṃ taralā tvaritā sālālī nānāvṛkṣapaṅktistadīyena sarakeṇa madhunā alasā
śyāmā madhurālāpā selā uttamā nārī
‘selā syāduttamā nārī’ iti deśīkośe
saha irayā madirayā vartante selā vā
ralayorekatvasmaraṇāditi kecit, taccintyam
alā bhūṣayitrī
hava dhaveti saṃbodhanam
rehai rājate
prākṛtaślokārthaḥ
evaṃ bhāṣāntarāṇāmapi gatapratyāgatī boddhavye
tadarthānugataṃ yathā—
‘vidite divi ke'nīke taṃ yāntaṃ nijitājini
vigadaṃ gavi roddhāro yoddhā yo natimeti na || 305 ||’
atra prātilomyena sa eva padārthaḥ
vidita ityādi
vidite svarvāsināmapi prasiddhe nijitāḥ pareṣāmājayo yuddhāni yena tādṛśyanīke samare prāptaṃ gavi parāhvānarūpāyāṃ vāci vigadaṃ hṛdayajvararahitaṃ ke nāma bhaṭā yoddhāraḥ
na ke'pi santītyarthaḥ
taṃ kam
yo yoddhā sankathamapi natiṃ namratāṃ naiti na yāti
atra tadarthaka eva pratilomaślokaḥ
sa yathā—‘natimeti na yoddhā yo roddhāro vigadaṃ gavi
nijitājinitaṃ yātaṅkenīke vidite divi'
turaṅgapadaṃ yathā—
‘bālā sukālabālā kā kāntilālakalālitā
sasvā sutavatī sārā darpikā vratagardhita || 306 ||’
kramātpādacatuṣke'sya paṅktiśaḥ parilekhite
turaṅgapadayātena śloko'nya upajāyate || 307
yathā—
‘bālā lalitatīvrasvā sukalā rāgatarpikā
sudantikā vardhitāvāsā kālā talalāsakā || 308 ||’
bāletyādi
bālā ṣoḍaśavarṣadeśīyā śobhanakṛṣṇakeśī kāntipradacūrṇakuntalaśobhitā sasvā ātmasaṃpadyuktā sutavatī putrayuktā utkṛṣṭābhimānātmakaśṛṅgāravatī abhilaṣitasvavivāhādivratākāṅkṣā atastaṃ bhajasveti
hṛdaye iti śeṣaḥ
nyāsamāha—kramāditi
lalito manojñastīvraḥ pravīṇaḥ sva ātmā yasyāḥ
rāgeṇa premṇā tarpayati yā
śobhanadantayuktā
vardhitāvāsā saṃpūrṇīkṛtasakalasthānā
kālo bhṛṣāvyāhārastena saha vartate yā
tale lāsakā nartakā yasyāḥ sā tathābhūtā
adhaḥkṛtasakalanartakaloketyarthaḥ
evaṃbhūtā sā bālā tvayopabhukteti vākyārthaḥ
āhurardhabhramaṃ nāma ślokārdhabhramaṇaṃ yadi
tadidaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvato bhramaṇaṃ yadi || 110
tayorardhabhramaṃ yathā—
‘sasatvaratide nityaṃ sadarāmarṣanāśini
tvarādhikakasannāde ramakatvamakarṣati || 309 ||’
sasatveti
sadarāḥ sabhayāḥ
tvarādhikānāṃ kasannitastataḥ saṃcarannādo yatra
ata eva vīrānprati ramakatvamakarṣati
sarvatobhadraṃ yathā—
‘devākānini kāvāde vāhikāsvasvakāhi vā
kākārebhabhare'kākā nisvabhavyavyabhasvani || 310 ||’
‘kanī dīptau’
devānākanituṃ śīlaṃ yasya
kāvāda īṣadvādo yatra
kasya mastakasya sannā saṃgatā ādā grahaṇaṃ yatreti vā
vāhikā paryāyavahanam
‘paryāyārhaṇotpattiṣu’ iti ṇvuc
saiva svaṃ vittabhūtā yeṣāmevaṃvidhā ye svakā ātmapakṣīyāstānājihīte iti vic
kaṃ madajalamākirati iti kākārastādṛśa ibhabharo hāstikaṃ yatra
he'kākāḥ sāttvikā iti saṃbodhanam
kākāḥ saṅgrāmalolubhā vā
kvacitkartaryapi ghañū
niḥsvā nirātmāno bhavyā ādheyaguṇāstānapi vyayanti svabalenopabṛṃhayanti ye te nisvabhavyavyāsteṣāṃ bhasvani bhartsanaśīle
‘bhasa bhartsane’ ityataḥ kvanip
bandhacitreṣu dvicatuṣkacakrabandho yathā—
‘jayadeva narendrāde lambodara vināyaka
jagadedhana candrābhālaṅghidantavibhāyate || 311 ||’
‘iha śikharasaṃdhimālāṃ bibhṛyādardhaṃ samāśritairvarṇaiḥ
dvicatuṣkacakrabandhe nemividhau cāparaṃ bhramayet || 312
jayada ityādi
natā indrādayo yasmai sa tathā
jagatāmedhana vardhana
candrābhālaṅghinī candrakāntivijayinī dantaprabhāṇāmāyatiryasya sa tathā
nyāsamāha—iheti
śikharamālāṃ saṃdhimālāṃ ca pūrvārdhavarṇaiḥ krameṇa bibhṛyātpūrayet
nemividhau cāparamuttarārdhaṃ bhramayet
dviśrṛṅgāṭakabandho yathā—
‘karāsañja vaśeśaṃ khagaurava sya kalārasam
saṃdhāya valayāṃ śaṅkāmagaurīṃ me vanātmaka || 313 ||’
‘śrṛṅgādgranthiṃ punaḥ śrṛṅgaṃ granthiṃ śrṛṅgaṃ vrajediti
dviśrṛṅgāṭakabandhe'sminnemiḥ śeṣākṣarairbhavet || 314
atrāṅkaḥ—‘rājaśekharasya'
dve śṛṅgāṭake mitho vaiparītyena yatra śikharaṃ dviśṛṅgāṭakam
karaiḥ kiraṇairāsañjayatīti karāsañjaḥ
khe vyomni gauravaṃ yasya sa tathā
vanātmaka jalasvarūpa
candrakalāsu rasamanurāgaṃ saṃdhāya kṛtvā antaḥsvacchatayā dṛśyanabhobhāganemimadvalayākārollekhinīṃ me mamāgaurīṃ śyāmāṃ śaṅkāmapanaya
sya iti kriyāpadam
pūrṇo bhaveti yāvat
vaśeśamāyattaśaṃkaramiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam
nyāsamāha—śrṛṅgāditi
śeṣākṣarairiti
ādyātkakārādārabhya yāvatsamāpti śeṣāṇyakṣarāṇi tairnemiriti nyāsaḥ
atra granthivarṇaireva ‘rājaśekharasya’ iti nāmāṅkavarṇāvalī labhyate
viviḍitabandho yathā—
‘sā satī jayatādatra sarantī yamitātrasā
sāraṃ paraṃ sa ca jayī śamitāsyandanenasā || 315 ||’
‘śikharādanyatarasmātpratiparva bhramati rekhayādyardham
nemau taditaramardhe viviḍitacakrābhidhe bandhe || 316
viviḍitabandhastu pañcaśṛṅgacakram
taddevatāmnāye darśitam
‘karpūrakundagaurīṃ tanumatanuṃ kārmukabhrūkām
varadānasundarakarāṃ viviḍitacakrasthitāṃ vande
’ seti
prasiddhānubhāvā satī gaurī sarantī nirargalaprasarā na trasyatītyatrasā
asyandanena sthireṇa enasā kalmaṣeṇa śamitā viklavībhūtā
rahiteti yāvat
‘śama vaiklavye'
atra jagati paraṃ sāraṃ yaṃ bhagavantamitā saṃgatā
sa ca jayī maheśvaro jayatāditi
nyāsamāha—śikharāditi
‘anyatamādvā’ iti pāṭhaḥ
‘anyatamasmāt’ iti pāṭhe tu sarvanāmatvaṃ cintyam
kecittu ‘kiṃyattadekānyebhyaḥ’ iti paṭhitvā ḍatama-dvārikāṃ sarvanāmatāmāhuḥ
gaṇe cānyataraśabdaṃ na paṭhanti
avyutpattimātraṃ cedam
anirdhāritaikābhidhāyakastvanyatamaśabdaḥ
śarayantrabandho yathā—
‘namaste jagatāṃ gātra sadānavakulakṣaya
samaste'ja satāṃ nātra mudāmavana lakṣaya || 317 ||’
‘caturṣvapi ca pādeṣu paṅktiśo likhiteṣviha
āderādestu raṅgasya pādaiḥ pādaḥ samāpyate || 318

jagatāṃ nāmarūpaprapañcasya gātrabhūta dānavakulakṣayeṇa sahita mudāṃ harṣāṇāṃ rakṣaka aja viṣṇo, atra jagati satāṃ madhye na ko'pi te tava samaḥ

padavicchedinīti
padānyatra pratipādaṃ sudhākalaśābhidhāne chandasi ṣaḍ vibhajyante
yadyapi dvitīyatṛtīyapādayoścakārābhyāṃ nakāreṇa caturthapāde taveti padādhikyaṃ tathāpyādyapadārthānurodhena samuccīyamānaniṣidhyamānārthānurañjakatvena saṃbodhyamānārthānuyāyitayā cakāranakārayostaveti ca tatpādāvayavarūpā eveti tadasatkalpameva
tathā ca ṣaḍbhyaḥ padatraya upādīyamāne saptadaśākṣarāyāṃ jātau yathāsaṃkhyānurodhenādye'rdhe prastāraracanākrameṇa daśa vikalpāḥ, tṛtīyacaturthayośca pādayostāvantastāvanta eveti daśabhirāhatairdaśabhiḥ śatam
śatena cāhatairdaśabhiḥ sahasraṃ tarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ samutpadyanta itīyaṃ sahasradhenuḥ
ayutadhenuryathā—
‘kriye jayasi jṛmbhase sṛjasi jāyase trāyase stuṣe mṛṣasi mṛṣyase hṛṣasi pīyase prīyase

eṣeti
iha pṛthvīnāmani chandasi ṣaḍbhyaḥ saṃbodhanānuge padacatuṣṭaye upādīyamāne ekādaśākṣarāyāṃ jātau prastārālpatvena yadi vā chandobhedasya śabdenāpratipāditatvāt tadbhedo'pyudāharaṇīya iti tasyāmeva rathoddhatābhidhāne chandasi daśasu vikalpeṣu pratipādaṃ bhavatsu daśabhiḥ śataṃ śatena sahasraṃ sahasreṇa ca daśasahasrāṇi tarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ samutpadyante itīyamayutadhenuḥ
lakṣadhenuryathā—
‘durge bhadrepsubhadre'diti surabhidite saiṃhike gauri padme nitye hṛdye vareṇye kalikamalikale kālike caṇḍi caṇḍe
dhanye puṇye śaraṇye śaci śabari śive bhairave rājñi sandhye chāye māye manojñe'vani janani jaye maṅgale dhehi śaṃ naḥ || 342 ||’

saṃbodhanairiti
atra hi sragdharābhidhāne chandasi pādatrayapadānurodhenāntyapādadvayenaikaikameva padaṃ turyapāde parikalpyamiti sarvatra navasu padeṣu sthiteṣu padacatuṣṭaye padapañcake copādīyamāne prathame āpātalikāyāṃ pañcaviṃśatau dvitīye ekayā prācyavṛttyā saha vaitālīyake yadi vā pañcabhiḥ prācyavṛttibhiḥ samamaupacchandasike caturviṃśatau tṛtīyavaitālīya eva caturviṃśatau caturthe ca pāde prācyavṛttidvaye samamāpātalikāyāṃ ṣoḍaśabhirekayā prācyavṛttyā vaitālīyaprācyavṛttyā saha vaitālīyaiḥ ṣaṅbhistathaivaupacchandasike dvābhyāmiti caturviṃśatau vikalpeṣu prabhavatsu pañcaviṃśatyāhateṣu caturviṃśatau śatāni ṣaṭ
ṣaṅbhiśca śatairāhateṣu pañcaviṃśatau sahasrāṇi pañcadaśa
tairāhateṣu caturviṃśatau lakṣāṇi trīṇi sahasrāṇi ca ṣaṣṭiḥ tarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ samutpadyanta itīyaṃ lakṣadhenuḥ
eṣeti
tathā hyatra pādatraye navasu turyapāde ca daśasu
traye padacatuṣke padapañcake copādīyamāne prathama aupacchandasika ekasya padasya dviruktyā viṃśatau yadi vā āpātalikāyāṃ daśa
vaitālīye pañcadaśasu aupacchandasike udīcyavṛttidvayena yad vaitālīye catasṛbhirudīcyavṛttibhiḥ samamekonaviṃśatiriti ca pañcaviṃśatau tṛtīyasminnaupacchandasike pañcabhiḥ prācyavṛttibhiḥ samamekādaśa
vetālīye tathaiva caturdaśa aupacchandasike tisṛbhiḥ prācyavṛttibhiḥ saha ṣaḍiti viṃśatau tṛtīyāsminnaupacchandasike tisṛbhirudīcyavṛttibhiḥ samaṃ pañcaviṃśatau caturthe tvāpātalikāyāmeka eva
dviruktyādinā ṣoḍaśabhiḥ prācyavṛttibhiḥ samamaśītau vikalpeṣu prabhavatsu viṃśatyāhatapañcaviṃśatau pañcaviṃśatyā dvāviṃśatau pañcaśatādhikāni dvādaśasahasrāṇi tairapyāhateṣu aśītau daśalakṣāṇi tarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ samutpadyanta itīyaṃ prayutadhenuḥ
koṭidhenuryathā—
‘sthūlaṃ datse sūkṣmaṃ dhatse bhuvi bhavasi rabhasi ramase rame divi modase chintse bāḍhaṃ bhintse gāḍhaṃ ruṣimiṣasi dhanuṣi manuṣe jaye puri jṛmbhase
svalpaṃ śeṣe kalpaṃ preṣe'citi carasi yaśasi yatase cale yudhi galbhase brūṣe vāmaṃ śrūṣe kāmaṃ hṛdi viśasi vacasi sacase ruce dṛśi dīpyase ||’
saṃbodhanairdvitīyāntaiḥ saptamyantaiḥ kriyāpadaiḥ
ślokakoṭiriyaṃ tisraḥ sārdhā dhenuḥ prasūyate || 122
yadā tu saṃbhramādibhyo bhavantyasyā dviruktayaḥ
sthūlādinā tadā caiṣā daśakoṭīḥ prasūyate || 123
sthūlamiti
preṣa iti iṣa gatāvityasya, citi caitanye, gṛdhu gārghye
sacase vacase rame jaye cale ruce iti devyāḥ saṃbodhanapadāni
saṃbodhanairiti
atra bhuñjaṅgavijṛmbhite chandasi ekādaśabhyaḥ padebhyaḥ pañcasu ṣaṭsu ca padeṣu upādīyamāneṣu jagatījātau prasiddhākṣarojjvalā jaladharamālā navamālinī chandaḥsu saptatau
dvitīye pūrveṣu candravartmadrutavilambitamaṇimālāprabhavatsu ca śate tṛtīye'smin prathamapādacchandasyeva pañcāśati caturthapāde dvitīyapādacchandasyeva śateṣu vikalpeṣu prabhavratsu saptatyāhateṣu śateṣu saptatisahasrāṇi śatairāhatāyāṃ saptatilakṣāṇi, saptatisahasraiṃrāhateṣu pañcāśallakṣāṇi trīṇi sahasrāṇi ca pañcaśatairāhate śate koṭyastisraḥ sārdhāstarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ saṃpadyanta itīyaṃ koṭidhenuḥ
yadā tviti
tathāhi padatraye padacatuṣke padapañcake copādīyamāne pūrvasyāmeva jātau prathamadvitīyacaturtheṣu pādeṣu pratyekaṃ jaladharamālāprabhācchandasorekasya dvayordviruktyā śate tṛtīyasmiṃśca pūrvasyāṃ maṇimālojjvalānavamālinītāmaraseṣu chandaḥsu tathaiva śate vikalpeṣu prabhavatsu śatenāhate śate daśa sahasrāṇi taiścāhate śate daśa lakṣāṇi tairapyāhate śate koṭyastarṇakāḥ ślokāḥ saṃpadyanta itīyameva daśakoṭidhenuḥ

‘payodharabharākrāntā saṃnamantī pade pade

atra vihaṅgikā kāhāreṇa varjitā na yātīti vaktavye hāreṇa varjitetyuktam
ataḥ kā ityakṣarasya cyutatvāccyutākṣareyam
dattākṣarā yathā—
‘kāntayānugataḥ ko'yaṃ pīnaskandho madoddhataḥ
mṛgāṇāṃ pṛṣṭhato yāti śambaro rūḍhayauvanaḥ || 359 ||’
atra śabara iti śambara ityanusvārākṣarasya dattatvāddattākṣareyam
cyutadattākṣarā yathā—
‘vidagdhaḥ saraso rāgī nitambopari saṃsthitaḥ
tanvaṅgyāliṅgitaḥ kaṇṭhe kalaṃ kūjati ko viṭaḥ || 360 ||’
atra viṭa ityasminpade vikāre cyute ghakāre datte ghaṭaḥ kūjatīti dvitīyo'rtho bhavatīti seyaṃ cyutadattākṣarā
akṣaramuṣṭikā yathā—
‘atiḥ atiḥ anmaalaṃ prīdya radya jadya phadya
melā melā melaṃ melaṃ phasa phasa phasa phasa || 361 ||’
seyamakṣarāṇāṃ muṣṭirityakṣaramuṣṭikā
atra pādaśaścatuḥpaṅktilikhitacaturbhirmurajabandhaiḥ śloka uttiṣṭhati
tadyathā—
‘adya me saphalā prītiradya me saphalā ratiḥ
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ phalam || 362 ||’
bindumatī yathā—
‘tavāvavādaḥ pratyabdhi patākā pratisaṅgaram
phalaṃ pratyadbhutopāyaṃ yaśāṃsi natu na kvacit || 363 ||’
ityanena ślokenoktārthasya yathāsthitasvarānusvāravisarjanīyasaṃyogasya ślokottarasya bindubhireva sūcanākrama iti bindumatī
tadyathā—
‘u॰āu॰āāā ṃue ṃue ॰ḥ
ā॰e ā॰e iiḥ ॰॰॰ ॰॰ ī॰ḥ ||’
nirbhedaḥ
‘udadhāvudadhāvājñā saṃyuge saṃyuge jayaḥ
sāhase sāhase siddhiḥ sarvatra tava kīrtayaḥ || 364
arthaprahelikā yathā—
‘uttaptakāñcanābhāsaṃ saṃdaṣṭadaśanacchadam
sarasaṃ cumbyate hṛṣṭairvṛddhairapi kimujjvalam || 365 ||’
seyamapi sūcitasyaiva pakvāmraphalamityasya vdyarthapadaprayogeṇāvagaterarthaprahelikā
kriyākārakasaṃbandhe padābhiprāyavastubhiḥ
gopitaiḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ prāhurgūḍhaṃ gūḍhārthavedinaḥ || 135
teṣu kriyāguptaṃ yathā—
‘stanajaghanabharābhirāmamandaṃ gamanamidaṃ madirāruṇekṣaṇāyāḥ
kathamiva sahasā vilokayanto madanaśarajvarajarjarā yuvānaḥ || 366 ||’
atra jaghanabharābhirāmamandaṃ madirekṣaṇāyā gamanamavalokayanto he yuvānaḥ, kathamiva yūyaṃ madanaśarajvarajarjarā na stheti kriyāpadasya stanaśabdena jaghanasāṃnidhyādgopitena kriyāgūḍhamidam
kārakaguptaṃ yathā—
‘pibataste śarāveṇa vāri kahlāraśītalam
kenemau durvidagdhena hṛdaye viniveśitau || 367 ||’
atra śarāviti karmakārakasya gūḍhatvātkārakagūḍhamidam
saṃbaṃndhagūḍhaṃ yathā—
‘na mayāgorasābhijñaṃ cetaḥ kasmātprakupyasi
asthānaruditairebhiralamālohitekṣaṇe || 368 ||’
atra na me āgorasābhijñaṃ ceta iti saṃbandhipadasya mayeti tṛtīyābhrāntyā gopitatvādidaṃ saṃbandhagūḍham
pādagūḍhaṃ yathā—
‘dyuviyadgāminī tārasaṃrāvavihataśrutiḥ
haimīṣu mālā śuśubhe’ (vidyutāmiva saṃhatiḥ) || 369 ||’
atra pūrvārdhasthitairdvitīyaprathamasaptamapañcamaikādaśanavamatrayodaśaṣoḍaśākṣaraiścaturthapādo gūḍha utthāpyaḥ
yathā—‘vidyutāmiva saṃhatiḥ’ iti
idaṃ pādagūḍham
abhiprāyagūḍhaṃ yathā—
‘jai deareṇa bhaṇiā khaggaṃ ghettūṇa rāulaṃ vacca
tā kiṃ sevaavahue hasiūṇa valoiaṃ saaṇam || 370 ||’
[yadi devareṇa bhaṇitā khaṅge gṛhītvā rājakulaṃ vraja
tatkiṃ sevakavadhvā hasitvāvalokitaṃ śayanam ||]
atra nirīkṣitamanenātra puruṣāyitalakṣma pādalākṣādikaṃ, tena niyuṅkte māṃ na karmaṇītyabhiprāyeṇa vadhvāḥ śayanāvalokanamityabhiprāyagūḍham
vastugūḍhaṃ yathā—
‘pānīyaṃ pātumicchāmi tvattaḥ kamalalocane
yadi dāsyasi necchāmi no dāsyasi pibāmyaham || 371 ||’
atra dāsyasīti dāsīlakṣaṇasya vastuno gūḍhatvādidaṃ vastugūḍham
yastu paryanuyogasya nirbhedaḥ kriyate padaiḥ
vidagdhagoṣṭhyāṃ vākyairvā taṃ hi praśnottaraṃ viduḥ || 136
antaḥpraśnabahiḥpraśnabahirantaḥsamāhvayaiḥ
jātipṛṣṭottarābhikhyaiḥ praśnaistadapi ṣaḍvidham || 137
teṣvantaḥpraśnaṃ yathā—
‘kāhamasmi guhā vakti praśne'muṣminkimuttaram
kathamuktaṃ na jānāsi kadarthayasi yatsakhe || 372 ||’
atra ‘kadarthayasi’ iti padaṃ kathamuktaṃ rephayakārayuktaṃ darthayasīti, ato vākyāntare praśnottarasyoktatvādantaḥpraśnamidam
bahiḥpraśnaṃ yathā—
‘bhadra māṇavakākhyāhi kīdṛśaḥ khalu te pitā
velāndolitakallolaḥ kīdṛśaśca mahodadhiḥ || 373 ||’
atra ‘majjanmakaraḥ’ ityasyottarasya praśnādbahiruktatvādbahiḥpraśnamidam
bahirantaḥpraśnaṃ yathā—
‘subhadrāṃ ka upāyaṃsta praśne'muṣminya uttaraḥ
sa kīdṛkkapimācaṣṭe vyomni pūrṇasthitiḥ kutaḥ || 374 ||’
atra ‘vāyutaḥ’ ityuttareṇa praśnādbahiruktena vāyuto naro vānaro bhavati, subhadropayantāpyucyate
tenaitadbahirantaḥpraśnaṃ bhavati

‘kīdṛśā bhūmibhāgena rājā snāto'numīyate
prāṅgaṇaṃ kurutetyuktāḥ kimāhustadanicchavaḥ || 375
'haimavāra karañjinā’ ‘nājiraṃ karavāmahai’ ityuttarābhyāṃ gatapratyāgatābhyāṃ praśnottarajātirabhidhīyate
tena jātipraśnamidam
pṛṣṭapraśnaṃ yathā—
‘ko so joaṇavāo ko daṇḍāṇaṃ duve sahassāiṃ
kā kālī kā madhurā kiṃ śukapṛthukānanacchāyam || 376 ||’
atra ya eva praśnāḥ kaḥ sa yojanapādaḥ kaḥ sa yo daṇḍānāṃ dve sahasre ityādayaḥ ta eva ‘krośo yojanapādaḥ’ ‘kodaṇḍānāṃ dve sahasre’ ityādīnyuttarāṇi bhavanti
evaṃ ‘kā kālī kā madhurā kiṃ śukapṛthukānanacchāyam’ ityuttaraṃ kimabhihitaśeṣasya praṣṭavyamiti pṛṣṭapraśnam
uttarapraśnaṃ yathā—
‘kiṃ vasantasamaye vanabhakṣaḥ pṛṣṭavānsa pṛthulomavilekhaḥ
uttaraṃ ca kimavāpaturetau kānanādatimirādapi kālī || 377 ||’
atra praśnasya he kānanāda he timirāda pikālītyetadevottaraṃ bhavatītyuttarapraśnamidam
yadvidhau ca niṣedhe ca vyutpattereva kāraṇam
tadadhyeyaṃ vidustena lokayātrā pravartate || 138
kāvyaṃ śāstretihāsau ca kāvyaśāstraṃ tathaiva ca
kāvyetihāsaḥ śāstretihāsastadapi ṣaḍvidham || 139
teṣu kāvyaṃ yathā—
‘yadi smarāmi tāṃ tanvīṃ jīvitāśā kuto mama
atha vismṛtya jīvāmi jīvitavyasanena kim || 378 ||’
tadidamuktiprādhānyātkāvyamityucyate
śāstraṃ yathā—
‘snigdhonnatāgratanutāmranakhau kumāryāḥ pādau samopacitacārunigūḍhagulphau
śliṣṭāṅgulī kamalakāntitalau ca yasyā- stāmudvahedyadi bhuvo'dhipatitvamicchet || 379 ||’
atra snigdhatvādeḥ śabdasya prādhānyamiti śāsanācchāstramidam
itihāso yathā—
‘hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo yāṃ yāṃ smitvāpyudaikṣata
bhayābhdrāntaiḥ suraiścakre tasyai tasyai diśe namaḥ || 380 ||’
so'yamatītārthaprādhānyāditihāsaḥ

‘nāndīpadāni ratanāṭakavighnaśāntā- vājñākṣarāṇi paramāṇyathavā smarasya
daṣṭe'dhare praṇayinā vidhutāgrapāṇi sītkāraśuṣkaruditāni jayanti nāryāḥ || 381 ||’
atra kāvyena śāstramabhihitamitīdaṃ kāvyaśāstram

‘sa saṃcariṣṇurbhuvanāntareṣu yāṃ yadṛcchayāśiśrayadāśrayaḥ śriyām
akāri tasmai mukuṭopalaskhalatkaraistrisandhyaṃ tridaśairdiśe namaḥ 382’

‘dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca bharatarṣabha
yadihāsti tadanyatra yannehāsti na tatkvacit || 383 ||’
atra dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmitihāsaniveśitatvādayaṃ śāstretihāsaḥ
śravyaṃ tatkāvyamāhuryannekṣyate nābhidhīyate
śrotrayoreva sukhadaṃ bhavettadapi ṣaḍvidham || 140

ākṣiptikā dhruvā ceti śeṣo dhyeyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 141

‘bhūyādvaḥ śreyase devaḥ pārvatīdayito haraḥ
pātu vaḥ paramaṃ jyotiravāṅmanasagocaraḥ || 384 ||’
atrāśaṃsāyāṃ liṅ loṭ ca
tadidaṃ vākyadvayamāśīḥ
nāndī yathā—
‘bhaddaṃ bhodu sarassaīa kaiṇo ṇandantu vāsāiṇo aṇṇāṇaṃ pi paraṃ paaṭṭhadu varā vāṇī chaillappiā
vacchobhī taha māahī phuradu ṇo sā kiṃ a pañcāliā rīdīyo vilihantu kavvakusalā joṇhaṃ caorā via 385
[bhadraṃ bhavatu sarasvatyāḥ kavayo nandantu vyāsādayaḥ, anyeṣāmapi paraṃ pravartatāṃ varā vāṇīvidagdhapriyā
vaidarbhī tathā māgadhī sphuratu naḥ sā kiṃ ca pāñcālikā rītikā vilihantu kāvyakuśalā jyotsnāṃ cakorā iva ||]
seyaṃ raṅgamaṅgalāntaṃ svastyayanaṃ nāndī
namaskṛtiryathā—
‘jayati brahmabhūḥ śaṃbhurvandemahi maheśvaram
idaṃ gurubhyaḥ pūrvebhyo namovākaṃ praśāsmahe || 386 ||’
seyaṃ stutirnamaskriyā ca namaskṛtireva bhavati
vastunirdeśo yathā—
‘astyuddāmajaṭābhārabhrāntagaṅgāmbuśekharaḥ
ādidevo haro nāma sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇam || 387 ||’
so'yaṃ kathāśarīravyāpino vastuno nāyakasya nirdeśo vastunirdeśaḥ
ākṣiptikā yathā—
‘paapīḍiamahisāsuradehehiṃ bhuaṇabhaaluāvasasilehiṃ
surasuhadettavaliadhavalacchihiṃ jaai sahāsaṃ vaaṇu mahalacchihiṃ 388
[padapīḍitamahiṣāsuradehairbhuvanabhayalāvakaśaśilekhaiḥ
surasukhadātṛvalitadhavalākṣairjayati sahāsaṃ vadanaṃ mahālakṣmyāḥ ||]
seyamabhidhitsitarāgaviśeṣaprayogamātraphalaṃ vacanamākṣiptikā
dhruvā yathā—
‘ma avahaṇimittaṇiggaamaindasuṇṇaṃ guhaṃ ṇieūṇa
laddhāvasaro gahiuṇa mottiāiṃ gao vāho || 389 ||’
[mṛgavadhanimittanirgatamṛgendraśūnyāṃ guhāṃ nirūpya
labdhāvasaro gṛhītvā mauktikāni gato vyādhaḥ ||]
seyaṃ pātrapraveśarasānusandhānādiprayojanā dhruvā
yadāṅgikaikanirvartyamujjhitaṃ vācikādibhiḥ
nartakairabhidhīyeta prekṣaṇākṣveḍikādi tat || 142
tallāsyaṃ tāṇḍavaṃ caiva chalikaṃ saṃpayā saha
hallīsakaṃ ca rāsaṃ ca ṣaṭprakāraṃ pracakṣate || 143
teṣu lāsyaṃ yathā—
‘ucciu vālīyia panthahiṃ jantau
pekkhami hatthaṃ hoi jai loaṇavantau || 390 ||’
[uccā pāliḥ priyaḥ pathā yāti
prekṣe hastaṃ bhavati yadi locanavān ||]
tadidaṃ śṛṅgārarasapradhānatvāllāsyam
tāṇḍavaṃ yathā—
‘suavahavaiaraṇisuṇia dāruṇurosavisaṭṭhapahāraruhirāruṇu
jaliu jāṇai ṇaru riusantāvaṇu aṇalasariccha jai hoi mahāraṇu 391’
[sutavadhavyatikaraṃ niśamya dāruṇaroṣavisṛṣṭaprahārarudhirāruṇaḥ
jvalito jāyate naro ripusaṃtāpano'nalasadṛśo yadi bhavati mahāraṇaḥ ||]
idaṃ vīrarasapradhānatvāttāṇḍavam
chalikaṃ yathā—
‘ṇisuṇiu pacchā tturaarau bhuṇḍi hiṃsi hasanti
ṇiakantaṃ ḍāḍhajualehiṃ puṇu puṇu ṇa a balanti || 392 ||’
[niśamya paścātturagaravaṃ śūkarī hiṃsārthaṃ hasati
nijakāntaṃ daṃṣṭrāyugalena punaḥ punarna ca daśati ||]
idaṃ tu śṛṅgāravīrarasapradhānatvācchalikam
sampā yathā—
‘vīhesi harimuhi avi hohi maṃ gale lehi sai
kandai riṭṭāsuramāriu kaṇṭhavaliu ṇa pai || 393 ||’
[vibheṣi harimukhi api bhava māṃ ca gale gṛhāṇa sadā
krandati riṣṭāsuramāritaḥ kaṇṭhavalito na patiḥ ||]
tadidaṃ chalikameva kinnaraviṣayaṃ sampā
hallīsakaṃ yathā—
‘candaṇadhūsaraaṃ āhulialoaṇaaṃ hāsaparammuhaaṃ ṇīsāsakilāliam
dummaṇadummaṇaaṃ saṅkāmiamaṇḍaṇaaṃ māṇiṇiāṇaṇaaṃ kiṃtuhmakaraṭṭhiaam
[candanadhūsaramākulitalocanaṃ hāsaparāṅmukhaṃ niśvāsikleśitam
durmanasāṃ durmanaskaṃ saṃkrāmitamaṇḍanaṃ māninyānanaṃ kiṃ tava karasthitam ||]
maṇḍalena tu yatstrīṇāṃ nṛtyaṃ hallīsakaṃ tu tat
tatra netā bhavedeko gopastrīṇāṃ hariryathā || 156
hallīsakamidam
rāso yathā—
‘ai dummaṇaā ajja kiṇo pucchāmi tumam
jeṇa jivijjai jeṇa vilāso palihijjai kīsa jaṇo 395
[ayi durmanaska adya kiṃ no pṛcchāmi tvām
yena jīvyate yena vilāsaḥ parihriyate kimiti janaḥ ||]
tadidaṃ hallīsakameva tālabandhaviśeṣayuktaṃ rāsa evetyucyate
aṅgavāksatvajāhāryaḥ sāmānyaścitra ityamī
ṣaṭ citrābhinayāstadvadabhineyaṃ vaco viduḥ || 157
teṣvāṅgikābhinayavadyathā—
‘dordaṇḍāḥ kva dhṛtāṅgadāḥ kva nu śirānaddhau bhujau dvāvimau vakrāṇi kva nu kāntimanti balimatkvedaṃ mamaikaṃ mukham
vācastāḥ kva jitārṇavadhvanighanāḥ kvāyaṃ vacaḥsaṃyamo helākampitabhūdharaḥ kva caraṇanyāsaḥ kva mandā gatiḥ 396’
atrāṅgikābhinayānāṃ pratipāditatvādidamāṅgikābhinayam

‘durvārāṃ madanaśaravyathāṃ vahantyā tanvaṅgyā yadabhihitaṃ puraḥ sakhīnām
tadbhūyaḥ śiśuśukaśārikābhiruktaṃ dhanyānāṃ śravaṇapathātithitvameti || 397 ||’
atra vācikābhinayapratipādanādidaṃ vācikābhinayam

‘vāraṃvāraṃ tirayati dṛśorudgamaṃ bāṣpapūra- statsaṃkalpopahitajaḍima stambhamabhyeti gātram
sadyaḥ svidyannayamaviratotkampalolāṅgulīkaḥ pāṇirlekhāvidhiṣu nitarāṃ vartate kiṃ karomi || 398 ||’
atra bāṣpajāḍyastambhasvedakampānāṃ pratipāditatvādidaṃ sāttvikābhinayam

‘cūḍācumbitakaṅkapattramabhitastūṇīdvayaṃ pṛṣṭhato bhasmastokapavitralāñchanamuro dhatte tvacaṃ raukhīm
maurvyā mekhalayā niyantritamadho vāsaśca māñjiṣṭhakaṃ pāṇau kārmukamakṣasūtravalaye daṇḍo'paraḥ paippalaḥ || 399 ||’
atrāhāryābhinayānāṃ pratipāditatvādidamāhāryābhinayam

‘rāhoścandrakalāmivānanacarīṃ daivātsamāsādya me dasyorasya kṛpāṇapātaviṣayādācchindataḥ preyasīm
ātaṅkādvikalaṃ drutaṃ karuṇayā vikṣobhitaṃ vismayā- tkrodhena jvalitaṃ mudā vikasitaṃ cetaḥ kathaṃ vartatām 400’>

‘vyatikara iva bhīmastāmaso vaidyutaśca kṣaṇamupahatacakṣurvṛttirudbhūya śāntaḥ
kathamiha na vayasyastatkimetatkimanya- tprabhavati hi mahimnā svena yogeśvarīyam || 401 ||’
atra hastādhyāyapadādhyāyayoḥ kathitatvāccitrābhiyaṃmidam
catasro viṃśatiścaitāḥ śabdālaṃkārajātayaḥ
śabdasaṃdarbhamātreṇa hṛdayaṃ hartumīśate || 158
iti śrīrājādhirājabhojadevenaviracite sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇanāmni alaṃkāraśāstre'laṃkāranirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ
tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ
kṣobhasphuritacūḍendukhaṇḍaprakaravibhramāḥ
tāṇḍavāḍambare śambhoraṭṭahāsāḥ punantu vaḥ || 1
vivicyamānagambhīramūlagranthākulānprati
ito'pyataḥ paraṃ vyākhyā saṃkṣepeṇa nigadyate || 2
kramaprāptārthālaṃkāralakṣaṇāya tṛtīyaparicchedārambhaḥ
tatra vibhāgopayuktaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha—
alamarthamalaṃkartuṃ yavdyutpattyādivartmanā
jñeyā jātyādayaḥ prājñaiste'rthālaṃkārasaṃjñayā || 1
alamarthamiti
viśiṣṭā utpattirvyutpattirjāteravacchedakaḥ prakāraḥ
ādiśabdādvividhaśaktipratibandhādayo vibhāvanādyavacchedāstrayoviṃśatiḥ
arthālaṃkārasaṃjñayeti
arthaśobhānivṛttiheturvicchittirarthālaṃkāra iti sphuṭalakṣaṇam
jātirvibhāvanā heturahetuḥ sūkṣmamuttaram
virodhaḥ saṃbhavo'nyonyaṃ parivṛttirnidarśanā || 2
vibhāgāndarśayati—jātiriti
bhedaḥ samāhitaṃ bhrāntirvitarko mīlitaṃ smṛtiḥ
bhāvaḥ pratyakṣapūrvāṇi pramāṇāni ca jaimineḥ || 3
pratyakṣānumānopamānaśabdārthāpattyabhāvākhyāni jaimineḥ pramāṇāni ṣaṭ
tenaiva krameṇa lakṣaṇānyākhyātuṃ pratyakṣapūrvāṇītyuktam
sāhityasya sarvapariṣadyatvannānādarśanarītyupajīvanamucitameva
