anekeṣāmupamiteḥ prapañcophmātvam
ananvayopamā yathā—
‘tvanmukhaṃ tvanmukhamiva tvaddṛśau tvaddṛśāviva
tvanmūrtiriva mūrtiste tvamiva tvaṃ kṛśodari || 24 ||’
atra tvamevedṛśī nānyā tvatsadṛśītyananvaye sati upamānopameyabhāvavivakṣayaikasyāpi vastuno bhedamupakalpya pratīyamānasādṛśyamaupamyenābhihitamiti seyamananvayopamānāma vikṛtarūpopamāsu prapañcopamābhaktiḥ
tvadityādi
vivṛto'yaṃ lāṭānuprāse
ihānyā tvatsadṛśī netyupamānāntarasaṃbandhābhāvo'nanvayaḥ

tathā cābhede'pi bhedakalpanādadoṣaḥ
aupamyenopamāyāḥ, svārthe kaḥ ṣyañ
ityupamālaṃkāranirūpaṇam
rūpakālaṃkāranirūpaṇam

upameye bhavedvṛttistadā tadrūpakaṃ viduḥ || 24

kathamanyasyānyabodhakatātiprasaṅgāt
tatrāha—gauṇeti

tathā ca gauṇānyasyānyabodhakatā
evaṃ ca yatropamānopameyapadābhyāmabhedo guṇādipuraskāreṇa bodhyate tatra rūpakaṃ, yatra sādṛśyamātraṃ tatropameti tayorbhedaḥ
vibhāgamāha—
śabdārthobhayabhūyiṣṭhabhedāttradhā taducyate
śabdabhūyiṣṭhameteṣu prakṛtaṃ vikṛtaṃ tathā || 25

dvidhaivobhayabhūyiṣṭhaṃ śuddhasaṃkīrṇabhedataḥ || 26

prathamaṃ yāvadrūpakaṃ tridhā—śabdabhūyiṣṭhārthabhūyiṣṭhatadubhayabhūyiṣṭhabhedāt

tatra prakṛtaśabdabhūyiṣṭhavibhāgamāha—
caturdhā prakṛtaṃ teṣu śabdabhūyiṣṭhamucyate
samastaṃ vyastamubhayaṃ saviśeṣaṇamityapi || 27

smitamityādi

tadetaccatuṣṭayamapi prakṛtasamāsādiśabdairnibaddhamiti prakṛtamucyate

kathaṃ kathamapi dāśaratherjayakesaripañjaro gato ghanasamayaḥ

vavasāa ityādi
‘vyavasāyaravipradoṣo roṣagajendradṛḍhaśṛṅkhalāpratibandhaḥ
kathaṃ kathamapi dāśaratherjayakesaripañjaro gato ghanasamayaḥ

kīdṛśaḥ

tathā hi puṣpabhramarayoryuktiryogaḥ puṣpaiḥ saha bhramarāṇāṃ makarandapānakṛtaḥ saṃbandhaḥ
ata evopapadyate puṣpabhramarayorekatrāvasthānam, na hi puṣpāṇi bhramarairvinā śobhanta iti yuktarūpakatetyāśayavānāha—parasparamiti
nandanamiva nandanamiti śabdaprādhānye'pi nandayatīti nandanamiti kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśata iti vacanādanyaprādhānyameva vivakṣitamiti śaṅkottarābhyām

‘idamārdrasmitajyotsnaṃ snigdhanetrotpalaṃ mukham
jagannetrendurasmākaṃ kathaṃ tāpāya kalpate || 36 ||’
atra jyotsnotpalayorayogājjagannetrendośca mukhasya saṃtāpakāraṇamidamayuktaṃ nāmāṅgipradhānarūpakabhedeṣvartha bhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
atrāpi pūrvavanmuravākhyavastuno viśeṣaṇaiḥ pariṣkaraṇamiti tasyaiva prādhānyamavagamyate
idamityādi

ārdrasmitaṃ saraseṣaddhāsa eva jyotsnā yatra tat

arthaprādhānyaṃ pūrvoktayuktyātrāpītyāha—atrāpīti
arthabhūyiṣṭharūpake'ṅgapradhānaṃ vibhajate—
bhedānaṅgapradhānasya caturo'vayavāśrayān
sahajāhāryatadyogatadvaiṣamyaiḥ pracakṣate || 30

‘papphuriauṭṭhadalaaṃ takkhaṇavigaliaruhiramahuvicchaḍḍam
ukkhaḍidaaṇṭhaṇālaṃ paḍiaṃ phuḍadasaṇakesaraṃ muhakamalam || 37 ||’
[prasphuritoṣṭhadalaṃ tatkṣaṇavigalitarudhiramadhuvicchardam
utkhaṇḍitakaṇṭhanālaṃ patitaṃ sphuṭadaśanakesaraṃ mukhakamalam ||]

naitadvācyam—tāmrāṅgulidalaśreṇītyāderarthapradhānabhedādidaṃ na bhidyata iti
tatra hi bhūpālamaulidhāraṇakriyāsamāveśenāvayavinaḥ prādhānyaṃ vivakṣitam, iha tu patanakriyāyāmavayavānāmata eva te sphuritādiviśeṣaṇairviśiṣyante
bhedāniti

papphuria iti

vicchardaḥ pravāhaḥ

āhāryāvayavaṃ yathā—
‘to kuṃbhaaṇṇapaḍivaaṇadaṇḍapaḍighaṭṭiāmarisaghoraviso
galiaṃsuaṇiṃmoo jāo bhīsaṇaṇaro dasāṇaṇabhuao || 38 ||’
[tataḥ kumbhakarṇaprativacanadaṇḍaparighaṭṭitāmarṣaghoraviṣaḥ
galitāṃśukanirmoko jāto bhīṣaṇanaro daśānanabhujagaḥ ||]
atra kumbhakarṇaprativacanamamarṣo'śukamiti daśānanapakṣe daṇḍo ghora-viṣaṃ nirmoka iti bhujagapakṣe ye'vayavāsteṣāmāhāryatvādidamāhāryāvayavaṃ nāma rūpakamaṅgapradhānarūpakeṣvarthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
atrāpi kumbhakarṇasaṃbandhaparighaṭṭitagalitaviśiṣṭānāmavayavānāmeva daśānanabhujagabhīṣaṇatarīkaraṇakriyāyāṃ prādhānyamavagamyate
to ityādi
‘tataḥ kumbhakarṇaprativacanadaṇḍaparighaṭṭitāmarṣaghoraviṣaḥ
galitāṃśukanirmoko jāto bhīṣaṇanaro daśānanabhujagaḥ
’ tato'nantaraṃ daśānana eva bhujagaḥ sarpaḥ so'tibhayānako jātaḥ
kīdṛśaḥ
kumbhakarṇaprativacanameva daṇḍastena parighaṭṭita utthāpito'marṣa eva ghoraviṣaṃ yasya saḥ
galitaścyutoṃśukaṃ vasrameva nirmokaḥ kañcuko yasya saḥ
‘samau kañcukanirmokau’ ityamaraḥ
iha prativacanādīnāmavayavatvābhāvādāhāryāvayavatā, teṣāmeva prādhānyādāhāryāvayavarūpakamidam
ubhayāvayavaṃ yathā—
‘yasyā bījamahaṃkṛtirgurutaro mūlaṃ mametigraho nityatvasmṛtiraṅkuraḥ sutasuhṛdbhṛtyādayaḥ pallavāḥ
skandho dāraparigrahaḥ paribhavaḥ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ durgatiḥ sā me tvaccaraṇārhaṇāparaśunā tṛṣṇālatā lūyatām || 39 ||’
atra bījaṃ mūlamaṅkuraḥ puṣpaṃ phalamiti latāpakṣe sahajāḥ, tṛṣṇāpakṣe punarahaṃkṛtyādaya āhāryāvayavā iti tadidaṃ sahajāhāryāṇāmavayavānāṃ parasparamupamānopameyabhāvarūpaṇenobhayāvayavaṃ nāma rūpakamidamaṅgapradhānarūpakeṣvarthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
atrāpi cāhaṃkāramamatādhrauvyasmaraṇasutādidāraparigrahaparābhavadurgatīnāmavayavānāmeva bījādirūpeṇa rūpitānāṃ bhagavadārādhanakuṭhāreṇa tṛṣṇālatā lūyatāmiti prārthanakriyayā samāveśena prādhānyamavagamyate
yasyā ityādi
sā mama tṛṣṇaiva latā he kṛṣṇa, tvatpādapūjāparaśunā lūyatāṃ chidyatām, tvaccaraṇārhaṇaiva paraśuḥ kuṭhāraḥ
yasyāstṛṣṇālatāyā ahaṃkṛtirahaṃkāra eva bījamādikāraṇam, gurutaro mametigraho mamatvaniścayo mūlam, nityamidamiti smṛtiraṅkuraḥ, putramitrabhṛtyādayaḥ kisalayāḥ, dārāṇāṃ patnīnāṃ parigraho'nurāgaḥ skandhaḥ, paribhavaḥ parābhavaḥ kusumam, durgatirnarakaḥ phalam
sarvatra yasyā ityanvayaḥ
‘taruprakāṇḍe skandho nā’ iti viśvaḥ
‘narako nirayo durgatiḥ striyām’ ityamaraḥ
iha bījādīnāṃ sahajāvayavatā, ahaṃkṛtyādīnāmāhāryāvayavatā, teṣāmeva ca prādhānyaṃ vivakṣitamityubhayāvayavapradhānamidam
dhrauvyaṃ nityatā

‘madaraktakapolena manmathastvanmukhendunā
nartitabhrūlatenālaṃ mardituṃ bhuvanatrayam || 40 ||’
atrendunā mukhāvayavī rūpitaḥ, bhruvau ca tadavayavau latāvayavibhyām, madaraktau tu kapolau na kenāpīti sarvato veṣamyādviṣamāvayavaṃ nāma rūpakamidamaṅgapradhānarūpakeṣvarthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ

madetyādi
he priye, tvanmukhendunā manmatho bhuvanatrayaṃ mardituṃ jetumalaṃ samartho'sti
kīdṛśena
madaraktau kapolau yatra tena
nartite bhrūlate yena tena
iha mukhamavayavi candratvena rūpitam, bhruvau cāvayavau latātvena, gaṇḍastu na kenāpīti vaiṣamyam, prādhānyaṃ cāvayavānāmeveti viṣamāvayavarūpakatā

ādhāravannirādhāraṃ kevalaṃ vyatireki ca
iti śabdārthabhūyiṣṭhaṃ śuddhamāhuścaturvidham || 31

‘sohai visuddhakiraṇo gaaṇasamuddammi raaṇivelālaggo
tārāmuttāvaaro phuḍavihaḍiamehasippisampuḍavimukko || 41 ||’
[śobhate viśuddhakiraṇo gaganasamudre rajanīvelālagnaḥ
tārāmuktāprakaraḥ sphuṭavighaṭitameghaśuktisaṃpuṭavimuktaḥ ||]
atra samudratvena rūpitaṃ gaganamādhāraṃ parikalpya rajanīmeghatārakau-ghānāṃ velāśuktimuktāphalaprakarāṇāṃ ca pratīyamānābhidhīyamānasādṛśyānāṃ śabdaprādhānyato'rthaprādhānyataśca rūpakaṃ kṛtamityādhāravannāma rūpakamidaṃ śuddharūpakeṣu śabdārthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
ādhāravaditi
sohai ityādi
iha gaganameva samudrastatra tārā eva suktāstāsāṃ prakaraḥ samūhaḥ śobhate
kīdṛśaḥ
viśeṣeṇātiśayena śuddhakiraṇaḥ
rajanyeva velā tīrabhūmistatra lagnaḥ saṃbaddhaḥ

gaganasyādhāratayedamādhāravadrūpakam

‘vaṇarāikesahatthā kusumāuhasurahisaṃcarantadhaavaḍā

[vanarājikeśahastāḥ kusumāyudhasurabhisaṃcaracdvvajapaṭāḥ
śaśikaramuhūrtameghāstamaḥpratihastā vijñāyante dhūmotpīḍāḥ ||]
atra dhūmotpīḍānāṃ vanarājikeśahastatvena kusumāyudhasurabhisaṃcaracdvvajapaṭatvena śaśikaramuhūrtameghatvena ca tamaḥpratihastatvena ca rūpitānāṃ nirādhārāṇāmeva śabdaprādhānyamarthaprādhānyaṃ cāvadhāryata iti nirādhāraṃ nāma rūpakamidaṃ śuddharūpakeṣu śabdārthabhūyiṣṭharūpakabhedaḥ
vaṇetyādi

kīdṛśāḥ

’ ityamaraḥ

‘pratihastaḥ pratinidhau’ iti viśvaḥ

anāghrātamityādi

atra hetuḥ

anyasyānyatra saṃkramaṇe kalāmayatvaṃ hetuḥ
anyata iti saptamyāṃ tasiḥ

’ iha kayācinnāyikayā candreṇa spardhamānayā pākāsaktayā śyāmitahastena mukhe spṛṣṭe sati nāyakastanmukhasya candrasamatvaṃ sūcayannupahasatītyekāparasyai kathayati—gṛhiṇyā iti

śuddhetyādi
yadyāśramavāsino janasya vapuridaṃ śuddhānte'ntaḥpure durlabhamasti tadā khalu niścayena vanalatābhirudyānalatā guṇairdūrīkṛtāḥ santi

‘na mālatīdāma vimardayogyaṃ na prema navyaṃ sahate'parādhān | mlānāpi na mlāyati kesarasragdevī na khaṇḍapraṇayā kathaṃcit 67’

na mālatītyādi

atimṛdutvāt

tatra hyupamānopameyatā, atra tu ninditamarthāntaram, anyasya stutiriti
sā tvabhidhīyamānā pratīyamānā cetyāha—vācyeti
tatra hetudvārakamapi vibhāgamāha—sā tviti
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca teṣāmanyatasamasya prāyo bāhulyena bādhayā sarvatra svābhiprāyasya prakṛṣṭasidhdyā sotpadyamānā pratīyata ityarthaḥ
tāsu dharmabādhayā vācyā tathā—
‘medacchedakṛśodaraṃ laghu bhavatyutsāhayogyaṃ vapuḥ sattvānāmapi lakṣyate vikṛtimaccittaṃ bhayakrodhayoḥ
utkarṣaḥ sa ca dhanvināṃ yadiṣavaḥ sidhyanti lakṣye cale mithyaiva vyasanaṃ vadanti mṛgayāmīdṛgvinodaḥ kutaḥ 111’
atra yathoktairhetubhiḥ svābhiprāyasādhanena yadidamīdṛgvinodaḥ kuta iti sākṣānmṛgayābhinandanaṃ seyaṃ vācyā nāmāprastutastutiḥ ‘ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ’ iti dharmaṃ bādhate
bheda ityādi
santo mṛgayāmākheṭakaṃ vyasanamakartavyaṃ vadanti yattanmithyā
īdṛgvinoda utsāhaḥ kutaḥ kutra
kiṃtu na kutrāpi
hi yato vapurlaghu bhavati ninditamiva bhavati
kīdṛśam

kṛśodaratayaivotsāhayogyam
ata eva tundileṣvanutsāhaḥ

‘medastu vapā vasā’ ityamaraḥ
atroktahetudvārā nijābhiprāyasya sidhdyā mṛgayābhinandanaṃ dharmabādhanayābhidhīyamānamata iyamaprastutastutiḥ

‘kālākkharadu ssikkhia bālaa re lagga majjha kaṇṭhammi

[kālākṣaraduḥśikṣita bālaka re laga mama kaṇṭhe
dvayorapi narakanivāsaḥ samakaṃ yadi bhavati tadbhavatu ||]
atra kālākṣaraduḥ śikṣiṇetyanena lipijñānādibhiradhītadharmaśāstrābhimatarūpakapogaṇḍaḥ ko'pi kayāpyavinayavatyā sopālambhamehi re kaṇṭhe lagetyabhiyujyate
tatra te matamevaṃ kṛte yadi narakaḥ syāt; sa yadyāvayoḥ sahaiva, nāsau naraka iti; kiṃ tarhi svarga iti
so'yaṃ svābhiprāyasādhanānmahāsāhase niyogastasyeha sākṣādastutasyāstotavyasya stutiḥ pratīyate
seyaṃ pratyetavyā nāmāprastutapraśaṃsā ‘parasya dārānmanasāpi necchet’ iti dharmaṃ bādhate
kālākkharetyādi

ślādhyo mūka tvamapi kṛpaṇaṃ stauṣi nārthāśayā yaḥ stotavyastvaṃ badhira na giraṃ yaḥ khalānāṃ śrṛṇoṣi || 113 ||’

he badhira śravaṇaśūnya, tvaṃ stotavyo'si; yastvaṃ khalānāṃ durjanānāṃ giraṃ vārṇī na śrṛṇoṣi

[na muñcanti dīrghaśvāsaṃ na rudanti na bhavanti virahakṛśāḥ

atra dhanyāstā yāsāṃ tvaṃ na vallabha iti yeyamatiraktāyāḥ sākṣādastotavyastutiḥ seyaṃ vācyā nāmāprastutapraśaṃsā tasyā eva kāmasiddhiṃ bādhate
ṇetyādi

’ nāyikāṃ nāyakaviśeṣavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā tatsakhī nāyakamupagamya tasyā anurāgaṃ daśāṃ cāha—na muñcatīti
he bahuvallabha, tā nāthikā dhanyā dīrghaśvāsaṃ virahajaṃ na tyajanti, na rūdanti, virahakṛśāśca na bhavanti
yāsāṃ tvaṃ vallabho nāsi
atra dhanyā ityādinā anurāgiṇyāḥ sākṣātstutirabhihitā tasyā eva kāmasiddhibādhikā

atrānekapadāśritacakārairekākriyāyāṃ nānāguṇāḥ samuccayena niveśitā iti samuccayatā
tadabhāve doṣamāha—teneti
asamuccayaniveśe karuṇādaya ūṣuriti syādityarthaḥ
yasminniti
yadi yasminnityaikadravye guṇasamuccayavivakṣātra tadā so'pi bhavatītyarthaḥ
bahupadāśraya evottarapadāśritadyotakatvena guṇānāṃ kriyāsamuccayo yathā—
‘rūpamapratividhānamanojñaṃ prema kāryamanapekṣya vikāśi
cāṭu cākṛtakasaṃbhramamāsāṃ kārmaṇatvamagamadramaṇeṣu || 138 ||’
atra rūpaṃ prema cāṭu ceti bahavo guṇā uttarapadāśrayeṇa cakāreṇāgamadityekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ samuccayena niveśyante, tenāgamanniti bahuvacanaṃ dvandvo vā na syāt
kārmaṇatvamityapekṣāyāṃ cāyameva guṇānāṃ jātisamuccayo bhavati
rūpamityādi
āsāṃ srīṇāṃ ramaṇeṣu viṣaye idamidaṃ kārmaṇatvaṃ vaśīkaraṇe mūlakarmatvamāgamat yayau
apratividhānenānirbandhena
sahajeneti yāvat
manojñarūpaṃ kāryamanapekṣya vikāśi sahajaprakāśavatprem, akṛtakaḥ svābhāvikaḥ saṃbhrama ādaro yatredṛśaṃ cāṭu kauśalaṃ ca
‘mūlakarma tu kārmaṇam’ ityamaraḥ
atra rūpādayo guṇā antyapadasthitacakāreṇa gamanarūpākriyāyāṃ samuccayena niveśitā iti samuccayaḥ
tadabhāve doṣamāha—agamanniti
asamuccaye bahuvacanaṃ dvandvaśca syādityarthaḥ
idameva guṇānāṃ kārmaṇatvam
jātyā samuccayena jātisamuccayo'pītyāha—kārmaṇatvamiti
ubhayapadāśraya uttarapadāśritadyotakatvena dravyaguṇānāṃ kriyāsamuccayo yathā
‘vicintyamānaṃ manasāpi dehināmidaṃ hi lokeṣu cakāsti durlabham
niśā sacandrā madirā ca sotpalā priyānurāgo'bhinavaṃ ca yauvanam ||’
atra niśā madirā ca dravye, anurāgo yauvanaṃ ca guṇau, bahuṣvapi padeṣu dvandve satyapi uttarapadāśrayaniveśinā cakāreṇa cakāstītyekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ niveśyante; tena cakāsatīti bahuvacanaṃ samāsaśca na syāt
ayameva ca durlabhamityapekṣāyāṃ dravyaguṇānāṃ guṇasamuccayo bhavati
te'mī trayo'pi śuddhāḥ
vicintyetyādi
idaṃ lokeṣu bhuvaneṣu madhye dehināṃ prāṇināṃ vicintyamānaṃ manasāpi dulabhameva cakāsti
hiravadhāraṇe
kiṃ tat
sacandrā rātriḥ, sakamalaṃ madyam, priyāyā anurāgaḥ prītiḥ, abhinavaṃ yauvanaṃ ca
atra dvandvaśo yugalatvenāntyapadasthitacakāreṇaikakriyāniveśaḥ
tadabhāve doṣamāha—teneti
durlabhatvavivakṣayā duḥkhamayatve guṇasamuccayo'pītyāha—ayamiti
miśraḥ punarubhayapadāśrayavadbahupadāśrayaśca bhavati
yathā—
‘ādityacandrāvanilo'nalaśca dyaurbhūmirāpo hṛdayaṃ yamaśca
ahaśca rātriśca ubhe ca saṃdhye dharmaśca jānāti narasya vṛttam 140’
atrādityacandrādayo dravyaviśeṣā uttarapadaniveśinā pratipadaniveśinā ca cakāraṇa jānātītyekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ saṃniveśyante
tena ca bahuvacanābhāve samāsābhāve caiṣa miśraḥ samuccayabhedo bhavati
ādityetyādi
anilo vāyuḥ, analo'gniḥ dyaurākāśaḥ, āpo jalam, hṛdayam, yamaḥ, aho dinam, ubhe prātaḥsāyam, dharmo vidhātā cāyaṃ janasya vṛttaṃ caritraṃ jānāti
ādityacandrau jānīta iti vibhaktivipariṇāmenānvayaḥ
‘dharmo guṇādau lokeśe’ iti ratnakoṣaḥ
atrādityādaya uttarapadapratipadaniveśitacakāreṇaikakriyāyāṃ niveśitā iti miśratā
tadabhāve doṣamāha—teneti
anubhayāśrayastu samuccayo'nvācayaśca na bhavati
dvyorapi dīpakena viṣayāpahārāt
tenetaretarayogasamāhārayoḥ sa udāhriyate tatretaretarayogo yathā—
‘sāvaśeṣapadamuktamupekṣā srastamālyavasanābharaṇeṣu
gantumutthitamakāraṇataḥ sma dyotayanti madavibhramamāsām || 141 ||’
atroktam, upekṣā, utthitamityete kriyādravyaviśeṣā itaretarayogena madavilāsadyotanakriyāyāṃ niveśyante; tena dyotayantīti bahuvacanaṃ dvandvasamāsaśca tadvivakṣāyāṃ syāt
na ceha dyotakaścakāra uttarapade pratipadaṃ vā vidyata iti so'yamanubhayāśrayaḥ samuccayamedaḥ
anubhayeti
yatra dvipade bahupade vā cakāro nāsti samuccayo'nvācayo'pi na bhavati
dīpakalakṣaṇena tasya viṣayīkaraṇādekatravartinā kriyādivācakapadena sarvavākyopakārakatvasya dīpakatvāt, tādṛśasamuccayānvācayayośca tatsattvādityāśayaḥ
sāvaśeṣetyādi
āsāṃ strīṇāmetāni madavibhramaṃ mattatāvilāsaṃ dyotayanti sma
tānyāha —sahāvaśeṣairavaśiṣṭabhāgairvartate sāvaśeṣaṃ sakhaṇḍaṃ padaṃ yatredṛśamuktaṃ vacanam
khaṇḍākṣaravacanamityarthaḥ
srastāni skhalitāni yāni mālāvastrālaṃkaraṇāni teṣūpekṣā asaṃvaraṇam
akāraṇato hetuṃ vinaiva gantuṃ gamanaṃ kartumutthitamutthāna ca
uktamiti bhāve ktaḥ
utthitamityapi bhāve ktaḥ
akāraṇata iti pañcamyāstasiḥ
atroktādervacanādirūpakriyātmakasya tadāśrayasya dravyasya mitho yogena pradhānakriyāyāṃ niveśaḥ
ata eva dyotayantīti bahuvacanam
samuccayasvīkāre doṣamāha—dvandveti
samāhāro yathā—
‘vapurvirūpākṣamalakṣyajanmatā digambaratvena niveditaṃ vasu
vareṣu yadbālamṛgākṣi mṛgyate tadasti kiṃ vyastamapi trilocane 142’
atra ‘yadvareṣu mṛgyate tatkiṃ trilocane vyastamapyasti’ iti bruvan vapurvayovasūnāṃ samudāyaṃ samastamevābhisaṃdhatte
tasya cāvirbhūtāvayavabhedatvenetaretarayogaḥ, tirohitāvayavabhedatvena samāhāraḥ
sa iha yadityekavacanāntena napuṃsakena ca kathyate
na ceha kvacidapi cakāro'stīti so'yamapyanubhayāśrayaḥ samuccayamedaḥ
vapurityādi
he bālamṛgākṣi śiśuhariṇanetre gauri, vareṣu yanmṛgyate'nviṣyate tattrilocane śive vyastamapyekaikamapyasti kim
kiṃtu nāstyeva
tadāha—vapuḥ śarīraṃ virūpamakṣi yatra tādṛśaṃ virūpaṃ virūddhasvarūpam
netre dvitvasaṃbandhasyāviruddhatvāt, tritvasya viruddhatvāt
alakṣyamalakṣaṇīyaṃ janma utpattiḥ kulamiti yāvat
yasya so'lakṣyajanmā tasya bhāvo'lakṣyajanmatā
akulīnatetyarthaḥ
diśa evāmbaraṃ yasya tadbhāvena vasu dhanaṃ niveditaṃ kathitam
‘nagno'vāsā digambaraḥ’ ityamaraḥ
bhṛgyata iti mṛga anveṣaṇe karmaṇi lakāraḥ
atra vapurādisamuccaye yadā sphuṭāvayavabhedatāṃ tadetaretarayogaḥ
yadā tu tirohitāvayavabhedatā tadā samāhāraḥ
yadityekatvaklībatvābhyāmiha samāhāra evoktaḥ
cakārayoge'pītaretarayogamāha—na ceti
cayoge'pītaretarayogaḥ
sa uttarapadayoge'pi yathā—
‘tatkṣaṇaṃ viparivartitāhriyorneṣyatoḥ śayanamiddharāgayoḥ
sā babhūva vaśavartinī dvyoḥ śūlinaḥ suvadanā madasya ca || 143 ||’
atra śūlino madasya cetyattarapadāśrayeṇa cakāreṇa dvau dravyaviśeṣau ‘vaśavartinī’ ityetasmin guṇapade yadītaretarayogena saṃniveśyete tadā ‘viparivartitahriyoḥ’ ityādiṣu ‘dvyoḥ’ itiparyanteṣu dvivacanamekaśeṣo vā na syāt
so'yamapi dvipadāśraya uttarapadāśritadyotakaśca samuccayabhedaḥ
tatkṣaṇamityādi
sā suvadanā gaurī śūlino harasya madasya mattatāyāśca dvyorvaśavartinī āyattā babhūva
dvyoḥ kīdṛśayoḥ
tatkālaṃ viparivartitā vigatā hrīrlajjā yayostayoḥ
iddha upacito rāgo yayostayoḥ
ata eva śayanaṃ neṣyatoḥ śavyāṃ necchatoḥ

bahupadāśraya uttarapadāśritacakāreṇetaretarayogo bhavatītyāha—evamiti
samāhāramiti

dravyādiviṣayatve itaretarayogasamāhārayoḥ sattvādanvācaye viṣayāntaramāha—kriyeti
evamapare'pītaretarayoge'pi cayogā udāhāryāḥ

tatra cottarapadāśraya eva cakāro bhavati
yathā—
‘gacchantīnāṃ ramaṇavasatiṃ yoṣitāṃ tatra naktaṃ rūddhāloke narapatipathe sūcibhedyaistamobhiḥ
saudāminyā kanakanikaṣasnigdhayā darśayorvī toyotsargastanitamukharo mā ca bhūrviklavāstāḥ || 144’
atra pūrvaṃ ‘darśaya’ ityurvīkarmaviṣayatvena kriyāmupanyasya ‘toyotsargastanitamukharo mā ca bhūḥ’ iti tatkartaryeva dharmiṇyakarmakaṃ kriyāntaramanvācīyate, so'yaṃ bhinnakālatvabhinnaviṣayatvābhyāmanvācayaḥ samuccayādbhinno bhavati
nanvevaṃ yadi samuccaye'pi bhinnaviṣaye kriye tulyakālameva prayujyete; ko doṣaḥ syāt

vidhineti

atra ‘gaccha’ ityasya vidhivākyasya ‘mamāpi janma tatraiva bhūyāt’ ityāśiṣānukūlatayaiva maraṇasūcanānniṣedhaḥ kriyata iti śuddho'yaṃ vidhyākṣepaḥ
gacchetyādi
iha he kānta vallabha, cedyadi gacchasi tadā gaccha
videśamiti śeṣaḥ

miśro yathā—
‘alaṃ vivādena yathā śrutaṃ tvayā tathāvidhastāvadaśeṣamastu saḥ
mamātra bhāvaikarasaṃ manaḥ sthitaṃ na kāmavṛttirvacanīyamīkṣate 148’
atra ‘alaṃ vivādena’ iti niṣedhena, ‘tathāvidhaḥ so'stu—’ iti vidhinā ca tanmatamavasthāpya, ‘mamātra bhāvaikarasaṃ manaḥ sthitam’ iti vidhinā, ‘na kāmavṛttirvacanīyamīkṣate’ iti pratiṣedhena ca yatpunarākṣipati, so'yaṃ vidhiniṣedhābhyāṃ vidhimiśra ākṣepo bhavati
alamityādi
tvayā yathā śrutaṃ tatra vivādenālaṃ niṣphalam
aśeṣaṃ samagraṃ yathā syādevaṃ sa tāvattathāvidha evāstu
mama mano'tra bhāvaikarasamabhiprāyavaśaṃ sthitamasti
yadyapi bhave virūpākṣatvādikaṃ tvaduktaṃ vartate, tathāpi manmanastadekaparamityarthaḥ
atra hetuḥ kāmavṛttiricchāvyāpāro vacanīyaṃ vaktavyaṃ nekṣate na paśyati
icchā na parārthayojyā bhavatītyarthaḥ
atra niṣedhavidhibhyāṃ tanmatasthāpanarūpasya vidhervighiniṣedhābhyāmākṣepa iti vidhyākṣepo'yaṃ miśraḥ
niṣedhākṣepaḥ śuddho yathā—
‘kutaḥ kuvalayaṃ karṇe karoṣi kalabhāṣiṇi
kimapāṅgamaparyāptamasminkarmaṇi manyase || 149 ||’
atra ‘kutaḥ kuvalayaṃ karṇe karoṣi’ ityasya niṣedhavākyasya ‘kimapāṅgam—’ ityādinā praśnapareṇāpi niṣedhaparyavasāyinā vākyena samarthanaṃ kriyata ityayaṃ śuddho niṣedhākṣepaḥ
kuta ityādi
he kalabhāṣiṇi madhuravacane, kasmānnīlotpalaṃ karṇe karoṣi
kuta iti pratiṣedhe hetumāha—asmin karmaṇi kāmivaśīkaraṇādau kimapāṅgaṃ netraprāntamaparyāptamasamarthaṃ tvaṃ manyase
atra niṣedhasya niṣedhaparyavasāyivākyena kṣepaṇānniṣedhākṣepaḥ
śuddhatā ca kaivalyena
miśro yathā—
‘saccaṃ guruo giriṇo ko bhaṇai jalāsaā ṇa gambhīrā
dhīrehiṃ uvama māuṃ taha vi khu maha ṇatthi ucchāho || 150 ||’
[satyaṃ guravo girayaḥ ko bhaṇati jalāśayā na gambhīrāḥ
dhīrairupamātuṃ tathāpi khalu mama nāstyutsāhaḥ ||]
atra ‘satyaṃ guravo girayaḥ’ iti vidhiḥ, ‘ka āha jalāśayā na gambhīrāḥ’ iti paramatākṣepastābhyāṃ girīṇāṃ gurutvam sāgarāṇāṃ ca gāmbhīryaṃ yadayamuttarārdhena dhīrāpekṣayā niṣedhati, anyāpekṣayā tattadeva vidhatte; sa eṣa miśro niṣedhākṣepaḥ
saccamityādi
‘satyaṃ guravo girayaḥ ko bhaṇati jalāśayā na gambhīrāḥ
dhīrairupamātuṃ tathāpi mama nāstyutsāhaḥ
’ iha parvatā niścitaṃ gurutvāśrayāḥ
ko vadati jalāśayāḥ sāgarā na gambhīrāḥ kiṃtu gambhīrā eva
girisāgarau dhīraiḥ sahopamātuṃ sadṛśīkartuṃ tathāpi mama notsāho'sti dhīrāṇāṃ tayorādhikyāt

kumudavanena ca pulinaṃ pulinena ca śobhate haṃsakulam ||]
atra mālākrameṇa parasparagrathitāḥ kartāro hetavaśca śaśiprabhṛtayaḥ ‘śobhate’ iti kriyayā dīpyante; tadetanmālādīpakaṃ nāma dīpakasya bhedaḥ
kaḥ punarasya pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ
pūrvatra vṛtticchinnaṃ rasanāyāṃ sarvatra iha tu svatantraṃ mālāpuṣpavat padaṃ padena yujyamānaṃ kriyādibhiḥ saṃbadhyataiti tato bhidyate
imiṇetyādi
“anayā śaradā śaśī śaśināpi niśā niśayā kumudavanam
kumudavanena ca pulinaṃ pulinena ca śobhate haṃsakulam
” iha sarvatra śobhata iti kriyānvayaḥ
atrānyonyagrathanayā mālākramastena ca pradhānakriyāyāṃ dīpanam
parasparagrathanayā rasanāmālayorbhedaṃ pṛcchati—ka iti
uttaram
pūrvatreti
rasanāyāṃ sarvatra vṛttyā chandasā chinnaṃ bhinnībhūtaṃ padaṃ padena yujyate

cakravālaṃ yathā—
‘saṃgrāmāṅgaṇamāgatena bhavatā cāpe samāropite devākarṇaya yena yena sahasā yadyatsamāsāditam
kodaṇḍena śarāḥ śarairariśirastenāpi bhūmaṇḍalaṃ tena tvaṃ bhavatā ca kīrtiratulā kīrtyā ca lokatrayam || 206 ||’
atra ‘saṃgrāmāṅgaṇamāgatena bhavatā cāpe samāropite’ iti bhāvalakṣaṇākṣiptasya bhāvaviśeṣasya dvitīyapāde kārakavīpsayā yat saṃkṣepeṇābhidhānaṃ tadetaccakravālādriṇeva mālādīpakena vistāravatā veṣṭitamidaṃ cakravālaṃ nāma dīpakasya bhedaḥ
saṃgrāmetyādi
vivṛto'yaṃ vistāraguṇe

vistaravattvaina cakravālādisāmyamasya

atrālāpasmitadṛṣṭibhiḥ padārthaurvallakīkundasragindīvarasaṃpadaḥ padārthā jīyanta iti śabdaparipāṭyā bhaṇanam; seyaṃ padataḥ śabdaparipāṭī kramaḥ
tasyā ityādi
tasyā ālāpasmitadṛṣṭibhirvacaneṣaddhāsālokanairvallakīkundasragindīvarasaṃpado vīṇākundamālānīlābjasaṃpattayo jīyante
kīdṛśībhiḥ
upacitavilāsābhiḥ

vākyato yathā—
‘indurmūrdhni śivasya śailaduhiturvakro nakhāṅka stane deyādvo'bhyudayaṃ dvayaṃ tadupamāmālambamānaṃ mithaḥ
saṃvādaḥ praṇavena yasya dalatā kāyaikatāyāṃ tayo- rūrdhvadvāri vicintitena ca hṛdi dhyātasvarūpeṇa ca 208’
atra ‘indurmūrdhni śivasya', śailaduhiturvakro nakhāṅkaḥ stane’ iti vācyārthavācinau śabdasamudāyau krameṇa ‘ūrdhvadvāri vicintiteva ca’, ‘hṛdi dhyātasvarūpeṇa ca’ iti vākyārthadvayavācibhyāṃ śabdasamudāyābhyāṃ saṃbadhyete; seyaṃ vākyataḥ śabdaparipāṭi kramaḥ
indurityādi
vivṛto'yaṃ saṃmitatvaguṇe

arthaparipāṭī dvidhā—kālato deśataśca

‘haste līlākamalamalakaṃ bālakundānuviddhaṃ nītā lodhraprasavarajasā pāṇḍutāmānanaśrīḥ
cūḍāpāśe navakurabakaṃ cāru karṇe śirīṣaṃ sīmante ca tvadupagamajaṃ yatra nīpaṃ vadhūnām || 209 ||’
atra ‘haste’ līlākamalamalakaṃ bālakundānuviddham’ ityādyarthānāṃ śaradādikālakrameṇa bhaṇanam; seyaṃ kālato'rthaparipāṭī kramaḥ
haste ityādi
yatra puryāṃ vadhūnāṃ haste līlākamalam, alakaṃ cūrṇakuntalaṃ bālakundenānuviddhaṃ saṃbaddham
lodhraprasavasya lodhrapuṣpasya rajasā dhūlyā mukhaśrīḥ pāṇḍutāṃ śvetatāṃ nītā
cūḍāpāśe praśastaśikhāyāṃ nūtanakurabakapuṣpam, cāru manojñaṃ śirīṣapuṣpaṃ karṇe, sīmante nīpaṃ kadambapuṣpam
tvadupagamastvadīyāgamanaṃ tasmājjātam
idaṃ sarvapuṣpaviśeṣaṇam
‘cūḍā śikhāyāṃ bāhubhūṣaṇe’ iti medinīkāraḥ
śikhāparasyāpi pāśapadasya keśaparatvemeva

dvitīyā yathā—
‘pāyādvo racitatrivikramatanurdevaḥ sa daityāntako yasyākasmikavardhamānavapuṣastigmadyutermaṇḍalam

atra trivikramatonorvaikuṇṭhasya pravṛddhisamaye krameṇaiva mauliśrutivakṣaudaralakṣaṇeṣu śarīradeśeṣu bhāsvanmaṇḍalasya cūḍāratnatāṭaṅkakaustubhanābhyambujairyo'yamaupamyalābhaḥ; seyaṃ deśato'rthaparipāṭī kramaḥ

[paṅkajaṃ paṅke'vahelya kuvalayaṃ kṣiptvā hṛde vṛnte bimbaṃ viprakīrṇe nirastaścandro nabhasi

atra paṅkajakuvalayabimbiphalacandramasāṃ karanayanāgharavadanairyathāsaṃkhyaṃ parājayata iti śabdaparipāṭhyaiva paṅkajāni paṅke nyastāni, kuvalayāni hṛde kṣiptāni, bimbaṃ vṛnte prakīrṇam, candro nabhasi nirasta ityādhārāṇāmuparyuparibhāvaḥ, kriyāṇāṃ ca tyāgatāratamyamityarthaparipāṭī nyagbhavati; seyaṃ śabdapradhānobhayaparipāṭī kramaḥ
paṅka ityādi
“paṅkajāni paṅka nyastāni kuvalayāni kṣiptāni hrade kṛttau bimbaṃ vinikīrṇaṃ nirastaścandro nabhasi

‘gaṅge devi dṛśā punīhi yamune mātaḥ punardarśanaṃ saṃpraśno'stu pitaḥ prayāga bhagavannyagrodha māṃ dhyāsyasi
taṃ hārāsilatāvataṃsavipulasthūlaṃsavakṣobhujaṃ puṃbhāvaṃ bhavatāmavantinagarīnāthaṃ didṛkṣāmahe || 212 ||’
atra gaṅgāyamunāprayāganyagrodhatatpuṃbhāvāvantinagarīnāthalakṣaṇānāmarthānāṃ mukhyakrameṇa ‘ devi dṛśā punīhi’, ‘mātaḥ punardarśanam’, ‘pitaḥ saṃpraśnaḥ’, ‘bhagavanmāṃ dhyāsyasi’ iti mukhyakrameṇaiva saṃbhramadbhirvacoviśeṣairabhyarthya ‘bhavatāmeva puṃbhāvamavantinagarīnāthaṃ didṛkṣāmahe’ iti yeyamabhyarthanābhaṅgiḥ sārthaparipāṭīkṛtā tasyāṃ ca ‘gaṅge’ yamune, prayāga, nyagrodha’ iti, ‘hārāsilatāvataṃsavipulavakṣaḥsthūlāṃsa’ iti ca śabdaparipāṭī parasparamupamānopameyabhūte nyagbhavataḥ, seyamarthapradhānobhayaparipāṭī kramaḥ
gaṅgetyādi
he gaṅge devi, dṛśā māṃ punīhi, he mātaryamune, punardarśanamastu, he pitaḥ prayāga, bhavān svāpraśno'stu susaṃvādo'stu

‘ajjavi bālo dāmoaro tti ia jampie jasoāe

[adyāpi bālo dāmodara itīti jalpite yaśodayā
kṛṣṇamukhapreṣitākṣaṃ nibhṛtaṃ hasitaṃ vrajavadhvā ||]
atra ‘adyāpi bālo dāmodaraḥ’ iti yaśodayā kṛtaprastāvanasya kṛṣṇasya vakre vinyastalocanayā tadrahasyavedinyā vrajavadhūmatallikayā yadetannibhṛtaṃ hasitaṃ tat tavāmbā bālaṃ tvāṃ brūte, tvaṃ tu mādṛśībhirnidhuvanavidagdhābhirdivāniśaṃ yamunānikuñjodareṣu viharasītyādinārthajātena sākāṅkṣamiti sākāṅkṣo'yamavasaraḥ paryāyasya bhedaḥ
ajjavi ityādi
“adyāpi bālo dāmodaka itīti jalpite yaśodayā

janitvā ye na jāyante te'thavā vyabhicāriṇaḥ
smṛtyādayo hi premādau bhavanti na bhavanti ca || 22
ratau saṃcāriṇaḥ sarvān garvasnehau dhṛtiṃ matim
sthāsnūnevoddhatapreyaḥśāntodātteṣu jānate || 23
saṃskārapāṭavādibhyo'nubhāvaṃ vā nijāśraye
saṃcāriṇaṃ vā janayan sāttvikaṃ vā sa jāyate || 24
uddīpanavibhāvebhyaḥ smṛtihetau paṭīyasi
anubandho'nubhāvāderanubandho'sya kathyate || 25
vibhāvasyānubhāvasya sāttvikavyabhicāriṇoḥ
saṃyoge tasya niṣpattimātraṃ niṣpattirucyate || 26
viṣayāśrayasaṃskāraguṇaprakṛtipāṭavaiḥ
dīpanātiśayaiścāsya prakarṣaḥ puṣṭirucyate || 27
tulyakālabalotpattihetau bhāvāntarodaye
saṃsargastasya yastena saṃkaraḥ sa nigadyate || 28
rasāntaratiraskārādanyadrāgācca tasya yaḥ
bhavatyapacayo vṛddhestaddhrāsaṃ taṃ pracakṣate || 29
hīnapātreṣu tiryakṣu nāyakapratiyogiṣu
gauṇeṣveva padārtheṣu tamābhāsaṃ vijānate || 30
balavatsūpajāteṣu pratikūleṣu hetuṣu
sarvātmanā samucchedaḥ praśamastasya varṇyate || 31
āśrayātprakṛtervāpi saṃskārasthairyato'pi vā
yo'syātyantamanucchedaḥ sa śeṣa iti śabdyate || 32
śṛṅgārādyā rasā ye ca ye ca śāntoddhatādayaḥ
ye ca ratyādibhedāstānviśeṣānasya manvate || 33
vibhāvaścānubhāvaśca saṃcārī cāśrayaśca yaḥ
ye ca līlādayo yūnāṃ pariśeṣaḥ sa kīrtyate || 34
āśrayo yasya ratyādiḥ premāderupajāyate
viṣayo yatra yoṣādau so'sya janmādhigacchati || 35
ālambanavibhāvaḥ sa jñānakāraṇamucyate
tenādarādirūpeṇa saṃskārastasya jāyate || 36
ādṛtaḥ paṭurabhyasta āśrayāderguṇena saḥ
tatprabodhāya mālyartucandanendūdayādayaḥ || 37
uddīpanavibhāvāste sa taiḥ smarati vāñchati
dveṣṭi prayatate'vaiti manyate vakti ceṣṭate || 38
te'nubhāvāstadā ye syuḥ svedaromodgamādayaḥ
harṣāmarṣādayo ye ca jñeyāḥ saṃcāriṇo'tra te || 39
smṛtīcchāyatnajanmāno manovākvāyasaṃśrayāḥ
vilāsā ye varastrīṇāṃ jñeyā līlādayastu te || 40
līlā vilāso vicchittirvibhramaḥ kilakiñcitam
moṭṭāyitaṃ kuṭṭamitaṃ vivvoko lalitaṃ tathā || 41
vihṛtaṃ krīḍitaṃ keliriti strīṇāṃ svabhāvajāḥ
helāhāvādayaścānye jñeyāḥ strīpuṃsayorapi || 42
upasaṃkhyānameteṣāmanubhāveṣu manvate
paścādbhāvānubhūtibhyāṃ smaraṇādyanubhāvavat || 43
smṛtyādayo'nubhāvāśca bhāvāḥ saṃcāriṇaśca ye
nāṭyeṣu kriyamāṇāste naṭairabhinayāḥ smṛtāḥ || 44
bhāvo yadā ratirnāma prakarṣamadhigacchati
nādhigacchati cābhīṣṭaṃ vipralambhastadocyate || 45
pūrvānurāgo mānaśca pravāsaḥ karuṇaśca saḥ
puruṣastrīprakāṇḍeṣu catuḥkāṇḍaḥ prakāśate || 46
prāgasaṃgatayoryūnorabhilāṣaḥ pravartate
saṃkalparamaṇīyo'nurāgaḥ sa prācya ucyate || 47
aheriva gatiḥ premṇaḥ svabhāvakuṭileti saḥ
ahetormeti netyukterhetorvā māna ucyate || 48
deśāntarādibhiryūnorvyavadhānaṃ cirāya yat
nave'nurāge prauḍhe vā pravāsaḥ so'bhidhīyate || 49
lokāntaragate yūni vallabhe vallabhā yadā
bhṛśaṃ duḥkhāyate dīnā karuṇaḥ sa tadocyate || 50
ratireveṣṭasaṃprāptau puṣṭaḥ saṃbhoga ucyate
so'pi pūrvānurāgāderānantaryāccaturvidhaḥ || 51
na vinā vipralambhena saṃbhogaḥ puṣṭimaśnute
kaṣāyite hi vastrādau bhūyānrāgo'nuṣajyate || 52
strīpuṃsayorvipralambhe vaicittyākalpanādayaḥ
ceṣṭāviśeṣāḥ saṃbhoge cumbanāliṅganādayaḥ || 53
vipralambhe'bhiyogādyaiḥ saṃbhoge sādhvasādibhiḥ
mithaḥparīkṣā yāḥ premṇo nirdiṣṭāstāḥ parīṣṭayaḥ || 54
vipralambhādiśabdānāṃ lokasiddheṣu vastuṣu
prakṛtyādivibhāgena viniveśā niruktayaḥ || 55
saṃśrṛtya vipralambhārthāngṛdhivañcyoḥ pralambhane
ityādijñāpakājjñeyaḥ prapūrvo vañcane labhiḥ || 56
ādānaṃ ca pratiśrutya visaṃvādanameva ca
kālasya haraṇaṃ cāhuḥ pratyādānaṃ ca vañcanam || 57
pūrvānurāgapūrveṣu vipralambheṣu tatkramāt
viśeṣadyotakeneha vyupasargeṇa sūcyate || 58
pratiśravo hi pūrvānurāge vakrekṣitādibhiḥ
abhīṣṭāliṅganādīnāmadānaṃ hrībhayādibhiḥ || 59
māne nivāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ visaṃvādanamucyate
ayathāvatpradānaṃ vā vyalīkasmaraṇādibhiḥ || 60
pravāse kālaharaṇaṃ vyaktameṣāṃ pratīyate
proṣyāgateṣvihaitāni kāntāḥ kānteṣu yuñjate || 61
pratyādānaṃ punasteṣāṃ karuṇe ko na manyate
svayaṃ dattāni hi vidhistāni tatrāpakarṣati || 62
pralambhetyatra yadi vā vañcanāmātravācini
vinā samāse caturāścaturo'rthānniyuñjate || 63
vividhaśca viruddhaśca vyāviddhaśca krameṇa saḥ
viniṣiddhaśca pūrvānurāgādiṣu viṣajyate || 64
pūrvānurāge vividhaṃ vañcanaṃ vrīḍitādibhiḥ
māne viruddhaṃ tatprāhuḥ punarīrṣyāyitādibhiḥ || 65
vyāviddhaṃ dīrghakālatvātpravāse tatpratīyate
viniṣiddhaṃ tu karuṇe karuṇatvena gīyate || 66
rāgo'nu saha paścādvānurūpo'nugato'pi vā
yūnorapūrvaḥ pūrvānurāgaśabdena śabdyate || 67
rājate rañcatervāpi rāgaḥ karaṇabhāvayoḥ
ghañānyatkārake bhāve nalopena niyamyate || 68
mānyate preyasā yena yaṃ priyatvena manyate
manute vā mimīte vā premamānaḥ sa kathyate || 69
mahābhāṣyakṛtaḥ ko'sāvanumāna iti smṛteḥ
lyuḍanto'pi na puṃliṅgo mānaśavdaḥ praduṣyati || 70
yatrāṅganā yuvānaśca vasate na vasanti ca
sa pravāsaḥ praśabdena pratīpārthena kathyate || 71
citotkaṇṭhādibhiśceto bhṛśaṃ vāsayatīha yaḥ
pravāsayati vā yūnaḥ sa pravāso nirucyate || 72
prapūrvako vasirjñeyaḥ kāritāntaḥpramāpaṇe
tūṣṇīṃ pravāsayedenamiti vṛddhānuśāsanāt || 73
abhūtotpādanāyāṃ kṛñ dṛṣṭaḥ kuru ghaṭaṃ yathā
dṛṣṭaścoccāraṇe cauraṃkāramākrośatītivat || 74
dṛṣṭo'vasthāpane'śmānamitaḥ kuru yathocyate
abhyañjane'pi ca yathā pādau me sarpiṣā kuru || 75
mūrcchāvilāpau kurute kurute sāhase manaḥ
karoti cittaṃ duḥkhena yo'sau karuṇa ucyate || 76
bhujiḥ pālanakauṭilyābhyavahārānubhūtiṣu
bhunakti bhugno bhūṅkte'nnaṃ bhūṅkte sukhamitīṣyate || 77
samīcīnārthasaṃpūrvāttato ghañpratyaye sati
bhāve vā kārake vāpi rūpaṃ saṃbhoga iṣyate || 78
sa pālanārthaḥ pūrvānurāgānantara ucyate
utpannā hi ratistāsminnānukūlyena pālyate || 79
sa mānānantaraṃ prāptaḥ kauṭilyārthaṃ vigāhate
svato'pi kuṭilaṃ prema kiṃ nu mānānvaye sati || 80
pravāsānantare tasyābhyavahārārthateṣyate
tatra hyupoṣitairannamiva nirviśyate ratiḥ || 81
karuṇānantaragato'nubhāvārthaḥ sa kathyate
vistrambhavadbhirasminhi sukhamevānubhūyate || 82
yadi vā bhoga ityasya saṃprayogārthavācinaḥ
samā samāse catvāro viśeṣāstamupāsate || 83
sa saṃkṣipto'tha saṃkīrṇaḥ saṃpūrṇaḥ samyagṛddhimān
anantaropadiṣṭeṣu saṃbhogeṣūpapadyate || 84
nave hi saṅgame prāyo yuvānaḥ sādhvasādibhiḥ
saṃkṣiptāneva ratyarthamupacārānprayuñjate || 85
mānasyānantare teṣāṃ vyalīkasmaraṇādibhiḥ
roṣaśeṣānusaṃdhānātsaṃkaraḥ kena vāryate || 86
saṃpūrṇaḥ pūrṇakāmānāṃ kāmināṃ proṣyasaṃgame
utkaṇṭhitānāṃ bhūyiṣṭhamupabhogaḥ pravartate || 87
pratyāgate'pi yatraiṣā ratipuṣṭiḥ priye jane
sā kimāvarṇyate yūnāṃ tatraiva mṛtajīvite || 88
pūrvānurāgaḥ pūrvāṇāṃ vyutpattibhirudāhṛtaḥ
anantarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ tatsamāse niruktayaḥ || 89
vṛttistatrājahatsvārthā jahatsvārthāpi vartatām
pradhānamanupaskṛtya na tadartho nivartate || 90
prathamānantare vṛtterajahatsvārthateṣyate
nātyantamajahatsvārthāṃ tāṃ mānānantare viduḥ || 91
pravāsānantare tvīṣadajahatsvārthateṣyate
karuṇārthasya gandho'pi nāstyeva tadanantare || 92
aṣṭamīcandrakaḥ kundacaturthī suvasantakaḥ
āndolanacaturthyekaśālmalī madanotsavaḥ || 93
udakakṣveḍikāśokottaṃsikā cūtabhañjikā
puṣpāvacāyikāṃ cūtalatikā bhūtamātṛkā || 94
kadambayuddhāni navapatrikā bisakhādikā
śakrārcā kaumudī yakṣarātrirabhyūṣakhādikā || 95
navekṣubhakṣikā toyakrīḍā prekṣādidarśanam
dyūtāni madhupānaṃ ca prakīrṇānīti jānate || 96
nityo naimittikaścānyaḥ sāmānyo'nyo viśeṣavān
pracchanno'nyaḥ prakāśo'nyaḥ kṛtrimākṛtrimāvubhau || 97
sahajāhāryanāmānau parau yauvanajo'paraḥ
vistrambhajaśca premāṇo dvādaśaite maharddhayaḥ || 98
cakṣuḥprītirmanaḥsaṅgaḥ saṃkalpotpattisaṃtatiḥ
pralāpo jāgaraḥ kārśyamaratirviṣayāntare || 99
lajjāvisarjanaṃ vyādhirunmādo mūrcchanaṃ muhuḥ
maraṇaṃ ceti vijñeyāḥ krameṇa premapuṣṭayaḥ || 100
nāyakaḥ pratipūrvo'sāvupapūrvo'nunāyakaḥ
nāyikā pratipurvāsāvupapūrvānunāyikā || 101
nāyikānāyakābhāsāvubhayābhāsa ityapi
tiryakṣu ca tadābhāsa iti dvādaśa nāyakāḥ || 102
teṣu sarvaguṇopetaḥ kathāvyāpī ca nāyakaḥ
anyāyavāṃstaducchedya uddhataḥ pratināyakaḥ || 103
tataḥ kaiścidguṇairhīnaḥ pūjyaścaivopanāyakaḥ
samo nyūno'pi vā tasya kanīyānanunāyakaḥ || 104
syātkathāvyāpinī sarvaguṇayuktā ca nāyikā
heturīrṣyāyitādīnāṃ sapatnī pratināyikā || 105
tataḥ kaiścidguṇairhīnā pūjyā caivopanāyikā
samā nyūnāpi vā kiṃcitkanīyasyanunāyikā || 106
tadābhāsāstathaiva syurbhedāścaiṣāṃ guṇādibhiḥ
nāyakastatra guṇata uttamo madhyamo'dhamaḥ || 107
prakṛteḥ sāttvikaḥ sa syādrājasastāmasastathā
sādhāraṇo'nanyajātiḥ sa vijñeyaḥ parigrahāt || 108
uddhato lalitaḥ śānta udātto dhairyavṛttitaḥ
śaṭho dhṛṣṭo'nukūlaśca dakṣiṇaśca pravṛttitaḥ || 109
guṇato nāyikāpi syāduttamā madhyamādhamā
mugdhā madhyā pragalbhā ca vayasā kauśalena vā || 110
dhīrādhīrā ca dhairyeṇa svānyadīyāparigrahāt
ūḍhānūḍhopayamanātkramājjyeṣṭhā kanīyasī || 111
mānarddheruddhatodāttā śāntā ca lalitā ca sā
sāmānyā ca punarbhūśca svairiṇī ceti vṛttitaḥ || 112
ājīvatastu gaṇikā rūpājīvā vilāsinī
avasthāto'parāścāṣṭau vijñeyāḥ khaṇḍitādayaḥ || 113
nidrākulitatāmrākṣo nārīnakhavibhūṣitaḥ
prātareti priyo yasyāḥ kutaścitseha khaṇḍitā || 114
cāṭukāramapi prāṇanāthaṃ kopādapāsya yā
paścāttāpamavāpnoti kalahāntaritā tu sā || 115
dutīmaharahaḥ preṣya kṛtvā saṃketakaṃ kvacit
yasyā na militaḥ preyānvipralabdheti tāṃ viduḥ || 116
sā tu vāsakasajjā syātsajjite vāsaveśmani
priyamāstīrṇaparyaṅkā bhūṣitā yā pratīkṣate || 117
svādhīnapatikā sā tu yasyāḥ pārśvaṃ na muñcati
priyaścitraratakrīḍāsukhāsvādanalolupaḥ || 118
puṣpeṣupīḍitā kāntaṃ yāti yā sābhisārikā
priyo deśāntare yasyāḥ sā tu proṣitabhartṛkā || 119
yasyāḥ samucte'pyahni pravāsī naiti vallabhaḥ
virahotkaṇṭhitā sā tu dvātriṃśaditi nāyikāḥ || 120
hīnapātrāṇi śeṣāṇi pīṭhamardo vidūṣakaḥ
viṭaceṭau patākāśca sakhyaścaiṣāṃ parigrahaḥ || 121
mahākulīnataudārye mahābhāgyaṃ kṛtajñatā
rūpayauvanavaidagdhyaśīlasaubhāgyasaṃpadaḥ || 122
manitodāravākyatvamadaridrānurāgitā
dvādaśeti guṇānāhurnāyakeṣvābhigāmikān || 123
mṛdvīkānālikerāmrapākādyāḥ pākabhaktayaḥ
nīlīkusumbhamañjiṣṭhārāgādyā rāgabhaktayaḥ || 124
antarvyājabahirvyājanirvyājā vyājabhaktayaḥ
dharmārthakāmodarkāśca premasūdarkabhaktayaḥ || 125
vākyavacca prabandheṣu rasālaṃkārasaṃkarān
niveśayantyanaucityaparīhāreṇa sūrayaḥ || 126
caturvṛttyaṅgasaṃpannaṃ caturodāttanāyakam
caturvargaphalaṃ ko na prabandhaṃ bāndhavīyati || 127
mukhaṃ pratimukhaṃ garbho'vamarśaśca manīṣibhiḥ
smṛtānirvahaṇaṃ ceti prabandhe pañca saṃdhayaḥ || 128
avistṛtamasaṃkṣiptaṃ śravyavṛttaṃ sugandhi ca
bhinnasargāntavṛttaṃ ca kāvyaṃ loko'bhinandati || 129
puropavanarāṣṭrādimudrāśramavarṇanaiḥ
deśasaṃpatprabandhasya rasotkarṣāya kalpate || 130
ṛturātriṃdivārkendūdayāstamayakīrtanaiḥ
kālaḥ kāvyeṣu saṃpanno rasapuṣṭiṃ niyacchati || 131
rājakanyākumārastrīsenāsenāṅgabhaṅgibhiḥ
pātrāṇāṃ varṇanaṃ kāvye rasastroto'dhitiṣṭhati || 132
udyānasalilakrīḍāmadhupānaratotsavāḥ
vipralambhā vivāhāśca ceṣṭāḥ kāvye rasāvahāḥ || 133
mantradūtaprayāṇājināyakābhyudayādibhiḥ
puṣṭiḥ puruṣakārasya rasaṃ kāvyeṣu varṣati || 134
nāvarṇanaṃ nagaryāderdoṣāya viduṣāṃ matam
yadi śailarturātryādervarṇanenaiva tuṣyati || 135
guṇataḥ prāgupanyasya nāyakaṃ tena vidviṣām
nirākaraṇamityeṣa mārgaḥ prakṛtisundaraḥ || 136
vaṃśavīryaśrutādīni varṇayitvā riporapi
tajjayānnāyakotkarṣakathanaṃ ca dhinoti naḥ || 137
athaiṣāṃ lakṣaṇodāharaṇāni—
tatra,
manonukūleṣvartheṣu sukhasaṃvedanaṃ ratiḥ
asaṃprayogaviṣayā saiva prītirnigadyate || 138
tadrūpeṇa rasasya bhāvo yathā—
‘harastu kiṃcitparivṛttadhairyaścandroyārambha ivāmburāśiḥ
umāmukhe bimbaphalādharoṣṭhe byāpārayāmāsa vilocanāni || 1 ||’
atra bimboṣṭhatvādibhirmanonukūle pārvatīmukhe vilocanavyāpārānumito maheśvarasyābhilāṣaviśeṣaḥ sāttvikāderanutpādātsukhānubhavasyotpattimātramanumāpayati
tadrūpeṇaiva sāttvikotpattau janma yathā—
‘abhūdvaraḥ kaṇṭakitaprakoṣṭhaḥ khinnāṅguliḥ saṃvavṛte kumārī
tasmindvaye tatkṣaṇamātmavṛttiḥ samaṃ vibhakteva manobhavena || 2 ||’
atra svedaromodbhedayoḥ sāttvikayorutpādādrasasya ratirūpeṇāvirbhāvo'vagamyate
janmaiva saṃcāryutpattau yathā—
‘tayorapāṅgapravicāritāni kiṃcivdyavasthāpitasaṃhṛtāni
hrīyantraṇāmānaśire manojñāmanyonyalolāni vilocanāni || 3 ||’
atra hrīḥ saṃcāribhāvo jāyamāno rasasya janma jñāpayati
tadevānubhāvotpattau yathā—
‘tataḥ sunandāvacanāvasāne lajjāṃ mṛdūkṛtya narendrakanyā
dṛṣṭyā prasādāmalayā kumāraṃ pratyagrahītsaṃvaraṇasrajeva || 4 ||’
atra dṛṣṭilakṣaṇaḥ śarīrārambho'nubhāvo bhavan rasāvirbhāvaṃ lakṣayati
anubhāvāderanekasyaikasya vā punarutpattiranubandhaḥ
so'nekasya yathā—
‘vivṛṇvatī śailasutāpi bhāvamaṅgaiḥ kvacidbālakadambakalpaiḥ
sācīkṛtā cārutareṇa tasthau mukhena paryastavilocanena || 5 ||’
atra devyāḥ smarārau pūrvamutpannā ratiḥ sābhilāṣatadavalokanaviviktavasantādibhiruddīpyamānā romāñcāvahitthalakṣaṇābhyāṃ sāttvikavyabhicāribhyāmanubadhyate
ekasyaiva punaḥ punaryathā—
‘yāntyā muhurvalitakaṃdharamānanaṃ ta- dāvṛttavṛntaśatapattranibhaṃ vahantyā
digdho'mṛtena ca viṣeṇa ca pakṣmalākṣyā gāḍhaṃ nikhāta iva me hṛdaye kaṭākṣaḥ || 6 ||’
atra mālatyā mādhavaviṣaye pūrvamutpannā ratirvasantāvatāratatsaṃnidhiviśeṣapradarśanādibhiruddīpyamānā punaḥ punarutpannena valitagrīvakaṭākṣavikṣepalakṣaṇena śarīrārambhānubhāvenānubadhyate
atraiva mādhavasya mālatīviṣaye tadaharevotpannā ratistairevoddīpanairuddīpyamānā harṣadhṛtismṛtimativyādhyādibhiḥ saṃcāribhāvairvāgārambheṇa cānubhāvenānubadhyate
ratirūpeṇaiva rasaniṣpattiryathā—
‘taṃ vīkṣya vepathumatī sarasāṅgyaṣṭi- rnikṣepa eva padamuddhṛtamarpayantī
mārgācalavyatikarākuliteva sindhuḥ śailādhirājatanayā na yayau na tasthau || 7 ||’
atra janmāntarānubhavasaṃskārātpratikūle'pi śūlini śailātmajāyāḥ sarvakālamevāvicchinnā ratiściraviyuktasya duścareṇāpi tapasā prārthanīya-saṃgamasya tasyākasmikadarśanenoddīpyamānā sadyaḥsamupajāyamānasāttvikasvedastambhavepathūpalakṣitairharṣasmṛtyāvegasādhvasādibhirvyabhicāribhāvaiḥ padanikṣepalakṣaṇena ca śarīrānubhāvena saṃsṛjyate
so'yaṃ vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyoge ratirūpeṇa raso niṣpadyate
ratirūpeṇaiva rasapuṣṭiryathā—
‘pīnaśroṇi gabhīranābhi nibhṛtaṃ madhye bhṛśoccastanaṃ pāyādvaḥ parirabdhamabdhiduhituḥ kāntena kāntaṃ vapuḥ
svāvāsānupaghātanirvṛtamanāstatkālamīladdṛśe yasmai so'cyutanābhipadmavasatirvedhāḥ śivaṃ dhyāyati || 8 ||’
atra sarvadaiva śrīvatsalakṣmaṇo lakṣmīviṣaye mahākulīnataudāryasthirānurāgitārūpayauvanavaidagdhyaśīlasaubhāgyamahābhāgyādibhiḥ samutpannā ratistadavayavaviśeṣakāmanīyakavibhāvanenoddīpanavibhāvātiśayenoddīpyamānāṃ brahmaṇaḥ samakṣamapyāliṅganalakṣaṇena śarīrārambhānubhāvenānumīyamānāṃ lajjāpraṇāśalakṣaṇāṃ premapuṣṭeraṣṭamīmavasthāmadhyāste
atra cānuktā api sāttvikā vyabhicāriṇo'nye'pi cānubhāvaviśeṣāḥ pratīyante
śriyo'pi ca samagrātmaguṇasaṃpadāśraye śrīvatsalakṣmaṇi tathābhūtā tadabhyadhikā vā ratiḥ pravṛddhapremapriyatamāliṅganalakṣaṇenoddīpanavibhāvevoddīpyamānā nayananimīlanānumeyāṃ samastasāttvikānubhāvavyabhicārihetuṃ premapuṣṭeruttamāmavasthāmāśrayati
so'yaṃ viṣayasaundaryādāśrayaprakṛteḥ saṃskārapāṭavāduddīpanātiśayācca parāṃ koṭimāvahan rasaḥ puṣṭa ityucyate
atraiva brahmaṇaḥ śriyaṃ prati manoharā mameyaṃ sṛṣṭiriti, ratnākarasyeyamātmajeti, candrā-mṛtādīnāmiyaṃ sodaryeti, viṣṇoriyaṃ priyatameti, kāmasyeyaṃ jananītyādibhya ālambanebhyaḥ samutpannā prītiḥ svāvāsānupaghātinā śarīrasaṃniveśena dṛṅmimīlanajanitayā ca tadupaghātaśaṅkayoddīpyamānā tatkṣaṇopajāyamānatayā āvegasmṛtivitarkonmādamohacintādibhirvyabhicāribhāvaistadanumeyaiśca stambhavepathuprabhṛtisāttvikaiḥ śivānudhyānalakṣaṇena budhdyārambhānubhāvena saṃsṛjyamānā paraṃ prakarṣamārohantī pratīyate
ratau bhayādisaṃkaro yathā—
‘rāhoścandrakalāmivānanacarīṃ daivātsamāsādya me dasyorasya kṛpāṇapātaviṣayādācchindataḥ preyasīm
ātaṅkādvikalaṃ drutaṃ karuṇayā vikṣobhitaṃ vismayāt krodhena jvalitaṃ mudā vikasitaṃ cetaḥ kathaṃ vartatām || 9 ||’
atra mādhavasya mālatyāṃ pūrvamutpannā ratistadavasthālokanādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānā bhayaśokavismayakrodhaharṣairapi rasāntaraiḥ pṛthakpṛthagvibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogānniṣpadyamānaiḥ saṃkīryamāṇā manovāgbuddhiśarīrārambhānubhāvairbhayādyanurūpaiśca sāttvikavyabhicāribhiḥ saṃparke paraṃ prakarṣamārohantī pratīyate
tatra cetaso vaikalyādiparibhāvanaṃ manaārambhaḥ, vākyoccāraṇaṃ vāgārambhaḥ, rāhoriva dasyoścandrakalāmiva preyasīmityādi budhdyārambhaḥ, ācchindata ityādi śarīrārambhaḥ, bhayādīnāṃ ca pañcānāmapi yathākramaṃ rāhoriti, candrakalāmivānanacarīmiti, daivātsamāsādya me iti, dasyorasya kṛpāṇapātaviṣayāditi, ācchindataḥ preyasīmityālambanavibhāvāstatsvarūpaparibhāvanānyuddīpanavibhāvāḥ, vikalam, drutam, vikṣobhitam, jvalitam, vikasitaṃ ceta ityanubhāvāḥ, ātaṅkakaruṇāvismayakrodhamudanurūpāśca kampāśrustambhavaivarṇyaromāñcādayaḥ sāttvikāḥ, mohaviṣādavitarkogratādhṛtyādayo vyabhicāriṇaścānumīyamānā niṣpattihetavo bhavanti
so'yaṃ tulyakālabalotpattikāraṇānāṃ bhayādiniṣpattīnāṃ ratau saṃsargaḥ saṃkara ityucyate
ratirūpeṇa rasaprakarṣasya hrāso yathā—
‘kopo yatra bhrukuṭiracanā nigraho yatra maunaṃ yatrānyonyasmitamanunayo dṛṣṭipātaḥ prasādaḥ
tasya premṇastadidamadhunā vaiśasaṃ paśya jātaṃ tvaṃ pādānte luṭhasi na ca me manyumokṣaḥ khalāyāḥ || 10 ||’
atra yoṣiti roṣākhyarasāntaratiraskārātpuruṣe cānyarāgādratiprakarṣasya hrāso'vasīyate
ratirūpeṇa hīnapātreṣu rasābhāso yathā—
‘vikkiṇai māhamāsambhi pāmaro pāraḍiṃ vailleṇa
diṭṭhiṃ samummure sāmalīa thaṇae ṇiacchanto || 11 ||’
[vikrīṇīte māghamāse pāmaraḥprāvarakaṃ balīvardena
dṛṣṭiṃ samurmure śyāmalyāḥ stanake niyacchan ||]
tiryakṣu yathā—
‘pāaḍiaṃ sohaggaṃ taṃbāe uaha goṭṭhamajjhammi
duṭṭhavasahassa siṃge acchiuḍaṃ kaṇḍuantīe || 12 ||’
[prakaṭitaṃ saubhāgyaṃ gavā paśyata goṣṭhamadhye
duṣṭavṛṣabhasya śṛṅge'kṣipuṭaṃ kaṇḍūyamānayā ||]
nāyakapratiyogiṣu yathā—
‘pulaaṃ jaṇenti dahakaṃdharassa rāhavasarā sarīrammi
jaṇaasuāphaṃsamahagghavia karaalāaṭṭhiavimukkā || 13 ||’
[pulakaṃ janayanti daśakaṃdharasya rāghavaśarāḥ śarīre
janakasutāsparśamahārghā iva karatalākṛṣṭavimuktāḥ ||]
gauṇeṣu yathā—
‘uvvahai navataṇaṃkuraromañcapasāhiāiṃ aṃgāiṃ
pāusalacchīa paoharehiṃ paḍivelliovijjho || 14 ||’
[udvahati navatṛṇāṅkuraromāñcaprasādhitānyaṅgāni
prāvṛṭlakṣmyāḥ payodharābhyāṃ pratiprerito vindhyaḥ ||]
taṃ ete catvāro'pi rasābhāsā ucyante
ratāveva lajjāroṣarūparasāntarayoḥ praśamo yathā—
‘dṛṣṭe locanavanmanāṅyukulitaṃ pārśvasthitevakrava -nnyagbhūtaṃ bahirāsitaṃ pulakavatsparśaṃ samātanvati
nīvībandhavadāgataṃ śithilatāmābhāṣamāṇe tato mānenāpagataṃ hriyeva sudṛśaḥ pādaspṛśi preyasi || 15 ||’
atra balavabhdyāṃ priyapremānunayābhyāṃ hrīroṣayorupaśamaḥ kriyate
ratāveva roṣarūparasasya śeṣo yathā—
‘eṣyatyutsukamāgate vicalitaṃ saṃbhāṣiṇi sphāritaṃ saṃśliṣyatyaruṇaṃ gṛhītavasane kopāñcitabhrūlatam
māninyāścaraṇānativyatikare bāṣpāmbupūrṇaṃ kṣaṇāccakṣurjātamaho prapañcacaturaṃ jātāgasi preyasi || 16 ||’
atra kasyāścidbalavatā premṇonmūlitasyāpi mānasya śeṣo'nuvartate
ta ete bhāvādayo daśāpi rasaprakārā hāsādiṣvapi prāyo dṛśyante
granthagauravabhayātkvacitkvacidudāhriyante
tatra
nyaṅgavrīḍādibhiścetovikāro hāsa ucyate
tadrūpeṇa rasasya bhāvo yathā—
‘kanakakalaśasvacche rādhāpayodharamaṇḍale navajaladharaśyāmāmātmadyutiṃ pratibimbitām
asitasicayaprāntabhrāntyā muhurmuhurutkṣipan jayati janitavrīḍāhāsaḥ priyāhasito hariḥ || 17 ||’
atra rādhāyā harinyaṅgād, harestu vrīḍāto hāsasya sattāmātraṃ pratīyate
śokaścittasya vaidhuryamabhīṣṭavirahādibhiḥ || 139
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘hṛdayānnāpayāto'si dikṣu sarvāsu dṛśyase
vatsa rāma gato'sīti saṃtāpādanumīyase || 18 ||’
atra daśasthasya rāmaviyogādutpannastadguṇasmaraṇādibhiruddīpitaścintāsaṃtāpādirvāgārambheṇa cānuṣajyamānaḥ śokarūpeṇa raso niṣpadyate
pratikūleṣu taikṣṇyasya prabodhaḥ krodha ucyate
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘mayyevamasmaraṇadāruṇacittavṛttau vṛtaṃ rahaḥ praṇayamapratipadyamāne
bhedādbhuvoḥ kuṭilayoratilohitākṣya bhagnaṃ śarāsanamivātiruṣā smarasya || 19 ||’
atra yadyapi vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogalakṣaṇāyā rasaniṣpatteḥ 'adhikamatiruṣātilohitākṣyā’ iti prakarṣanimittamatiśabdopādānaṃ vidyate, tathāpyuttamanāyikāśrayaḥ priyaviṣaye na roṣaḥ prakarṣamāsādayati
kāryārambheṣu saṃrambhaḥ stheyānutsāha iṣyate || 140
tadrūpeṇa rasasya janma yathā—
‘mūrdhnā jāmbavato'bhivādya caraṇāvāpṛcchya senāpatī- nāśvāsyāśrumukhānmuhuḥ priyasakhīnpreṣyānsamādiśya ca
ārambhaṃ jagṛhe mahendraśikharādambhonidherlaṅghane raṃhasvī raghunāthapādarajasāmuccaiḥ smaranmārutiḥ || 20 ||’
atrābhivādanapraśnāśvāsanasamādeśanādriśikharārohaṇeṣṭadevatāsmaraṇānāṃ pūrvaraṅgaparyavasāyitvenānuddīpanavibhāvatvādanutsāhānubhāvatvācca nāyamanubandho niṣpattiḥ prakarṣo vā bhavati
bhayaṃ cittasya vaiklavyaṃ raudrādijanitaṃ viduḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānubandho yathā—
‘mantrānmṛtyujito japadbhirasakṛdhdyāyadbhiriṣṭānsurān śuṣyattālubhirākulākulapadairnirvāgbhirutkampibhiḥ
adhvanyairiha jīviteśamahiṣavyādhūmradhūmāvilā laṅghyante karimāṃsaghasmararaṇatkauleyakāḥ pallayaḥ || 21 ||’
atra yadyapi pallīnāmālambanatvam, tadviśeṣaṇayoruddīpanatvam, mantrajapāderanubhāvatvam, tāluśoṣādīnāṃ vyabhicāritvamiti vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogo'sti, tathāpi mantrajapeṣṭadevatānudhyānayorlaṅghanopāyaparatvānna bhayarūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiḥ
adhvanyānāṃ hi tanniṣpattāvalpasattvatayā stambhamohamūrcchāmaraṇādibhirupāyaprayogo na ghaṭate
jugupsā garhaṇārthānāṃ doṣasaṃdarśanādibhiḥ || 141
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānugamo yathā—
‘he hasta dakṣiṇa mṛtasya śiśordvijasya jīvātave visṛja śūdramunau kṛpāṇam
rāmasya gātramasi nirbharagarbhakhinnasītā- pravāsanapaṭoḥ karuṇā kutaste || 22 ||’
atra yadyapi dvijaśiśorjīvanāya munirapi śūdro vadhya iti na rāmasyātmakarmanindā tathāpyanapakāriṇaṃ jighāṃsato ghṛṇānuvartata eva
sītā-parityāgaviṣayatvenaivātra jugupsānugamo grahītavyaḥ
śambukaviṣaye punarasyā janmamātrameveti
vismayaścittavistāraḥ padārthātiśayādibhiḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasaniṣpattiryathā—
‘kṛṣṇenāmba gatena rantumasakṛnmṛdbhakṣitā svecchayā satyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ka evamāha musalī mithyāmba paśyānanam
vyādehīti vikāsite ca vadane dṛṣṭvā samastaṃ jaga- nmātā yasya jagāma vismayapadaṃ pāyātsa vaḥ keśavaḥ || 23 ||’
atra śiśormuṃkhe jagaddarśanamālambanavibhāvaḥ, tatsāmagryaśaiśavādyālocanamuddīpanavibhāvaḥ, vismayavaśaṃ jagāmetyanenānupāttā api sarve saṃcāriṇo'nubhāvāśca gṛhyante
stambhaśceṣṭāpratīghāto bhayarāgāmayādibhiḥ || 142
tadrūpeṇa rasasya puṣṭiryathā—
‘taṃ tāṇa haacchāaṃ ṇiccalaloaṇasihaṃ pautthapaāvaṃ
ālekkhapaīvāṇiva ṇiaaṃ paaicaḍulattaṇaṃ pi vialiaṃ || 24 ||’
[tatteṣāṃ hatacchāyaṃ niścalalocanaśikhaṃ proṣitapratāpam
ālekhyapradīpānāmiva nijakaṃ prakṛticaṭulatvamapi vigalitam ||]
ayaṃ ca puṣṭo'pi sāttvikatvāt sadaivānyānuyāyīti nānubhāvādibhiranubadhyate
harṣādbhutabhayādibhyo romāñco romavikriyā
tadrūpeṇa rasasya janma yathā—
‘karimari aālagajjirajalaāsaṇipauṇapaḍirao eso
paiṇo dhaṇuravakaṃkhiṇi romaṃcaṃ kiṃ muhā vahasi || 25 ||’
[bandi akālagarjanajaladāśanipatanapratirava eṣaḥ
patyurdhanūravākāṅkṣaṇaśīle romāñca kiṃ mudhā vahasi ||]
asyāpi sāttvikatvādanyānubandhādayo na jāyante
madapramadapīḍādervaisvaryaṃ gadgadaṃ viduḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘pipipriya sasasvayaṃ mumumukhāsavaṃ dehi me tatatyaja dududrutaṃ bhabhabhabhājanaṃ kāñcanam
iti skhalitajalpitaṃ madavaśātkuraṅgīdṛśaḥ prage hasitahetave sahacarībhiradhyeyata || 26 ||’
atrāpi sāttvikatvānniṣpanno nānyairanubadhyate
vaprurjalodgamaḥ khedo ratigharmaśramādibhiḥ || 143
tadrūpeṇa rasasya janma yathā—
‘himavyapāyādviśadādharāṇāmāpāṇḍurībhūtamukhacchavīnām
khedodgamaḥ kiṃpuruṣāṅganānāṃ cakre padaṃ citraviśeṣakeṣu || 27 ||’
atrāpi pūrvavadanyānuṣaṅgo na bhavati
rāgaroṣabhayādibhyaḥ kampo gātrasya vepathuḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasya janma yathā—
‘mā garvamudvaha kapolatale cakāsti kāntasvahastalikhitā mama mañjarīti
anyāpi kiṃ na sakhi bhājanamīdṛśānāṃ vairī na cedbhavati vepathurantarāyaḥ || 28 ||’
ayamapi prāgvadevānyairnānugamyate
viṣādamadaroṣādervarṇānyatvaṃ vivarṇatā || 144
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘sahi sāhasu teṇa samaṃ ahaṃ pi kiṃ ṇiggaā pahāammi
aṇṇacia dīsai jeṇa dappaṇe kāvi sā sumuho || 29 ||’
[sakhi sādhaya tena samamahamapi kiṃ nirgatā prabhāte
anyaiva dṛśyate yena darpaṇe kāpi sā sumukhī ||]
ayamapi nānyairanubadhyate
aśru netrodgataṃ vāri duḥkhaśokapraharṣajam
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānubandho yathā—
‘utpakṣmaṇornayanayoruparuddhavṛtti bāṣsaṃ kuru sthiratayā śithilānubandham
asminnalakṣitanatonnatabhūmibhāge mārge padāni khalu te viṣamībhavanti || 30 ||’
atra bāṣpaśavdena locanāśrayamaśrūcyate na kaṇṭhādyāśrayo duḥkhāveśaḥ
yathā—‘vilalāpa sa bāppagadgadam', ‘ muhurmagnaḥ kaṇṭhe taralayati bāṣpaḥ stanataṭīm’ ityādi
pralayastīvraduḥkhāderindriyāstamayo mataḥ || 145
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘tīvrābhiṣaṅgaprabhaveṇa vṛttiṃ mohena saṃstambhayatendriyāṇām
ajñātabhartṛvyasanā muhūrtaṃ kṛtopakāreva ratirbabhūva || 31 ||’
atra mohaśabdena mūrcchocyate, na vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇo mohaḥ
smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūtārthaviṣayaṃ jñānamucyate || 146
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānubandho yathā—
‘itaḥ pratyādeśātsvajanamanugantuṃ vyavasitā sthitā tiṣṭhetyuccairvadati guruśiṣye gurusame
punardṛṣṭiṃ bāṣpaprasarakaluṣāmarpitavatī mayi krūre yattatsaviṣamiva śalyaṃ dahati mām || 32 ||’
atra saviśeṣā smṛtiricchayā vāgārambheṇa cānubadhyate
niṣpattyādayaḥ punarasyā ratyādiniṣpattiṣveva draṣṭavyāḥ
ratyādayo'smṛtimūlatvāttatprakarṣāpakarṣāvanuvartante
ūho vitarka ityuktaḥ padārtheṣu yathāmati
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘citte niveśya parikalpitasattvayogā- nrūpoccayena ghaṭitā manasā kṛtā nu
strīratnasṛṣṭiraparā pratibhāti sā me dhāturvibhutvamanucintya vapuśca tasyāḥ || 33 ||’
so'yamasatyaḥ satyo vā smṛtijñānacintanādidvāreṇa nirṇayānto niṣpanna ityucyate
utkaṇṭheṣṭānavāptau yo'bhilāṣaḥ syāttadāptaye || 147
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattihrāsau yathā—
‘yāsyatyadya śakuntaleti hṛdayaṃ saṃspṛṣṭamutkaṇṭhyā kaṇṭhaḥ stambhitabāṣpavṛttikaluṣaścintājaḍaṃ darśanam
vaiklavyaṃ mama tāvadīdṛśamidaṃ snehādaraṇyaukasaḥ pīḍyante gṛhiṇaḥ kathaṃ nu tanayāviśleṣaduḥkhairnavaiḥ || 34 ||’
atra vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogāt prītirivotkaṇṭhāpi tadanuṣaṅgiṇī niṣpannā uttarārdhapratipādyena niṣedhenaiva vismayādinābhibhūyamānā hrāsa ityucyate
prakarṣaścāsyā mamāraṇyaukasa ityanena nivāryate
prayatnapūrvikārtheṣu smṛtiścinteti cocyate || 148
tadrūpeṇa rasasya prakarṣo yathā—
‘cintāṇiadaiasamāgamammi kaamaṇṇuāiṃ mariūṇa
suṇṇaṃ kalahāantī sahīhi~ ruṇṇā ṇa o hasiā || 35 ||’
[cintānītadayitasamāgame kṛtamanyukāni smṛtvā
śūnyaṃ kalahāyamānā sakhībhī ruditā na vā hasitā ||]
atra sakhīrodanena śūnyakalahaḥ, śūnyakalahena sākṣātkāraḥ, sākṣātkāreṇa cintā, cintayā tu mūlabhūtā ratiḥ prakṛṣyate
ātmaprakāśanaparā ceṣṭā capalatocyate || 149
tadrūpeṇa rasasya janma yathā—
‘kaścitkarābhyāmupagūḍhanālamālolapattrābhihatadvirepham
rajobhirantaḥpariveṣabandhi līlāravindaṃ bhramayāṃcakāra || 36 ||’
atra kaścillīlāravindabhramaṇaceṣṭayā indumatyai tiṣṭhate
śāstroktārthānusaṃdhānādarthanirdhāraṇaṃ matiḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānubandho yathā—
‘asaṃśayaṃ kṣattraparigrahakṣamā yadāryamasyāmabhilāṣi me manaḥ
satāṃ hi saṃdehapadeṣu vastuṣu pramāṇamantaḥkaraṇapravṛttayaḥ || 37 ||’
atra pūrvārdhoktārthanirdhāraṇarūpā matiruttarārdhenānubadhyate
garvo'nyeṣāmavajñānamātmasaṃbhāvanādibhiḥ || 150
tadrūpeṇa rasasya puṣṭiryathā—
‘dhṛtāyudho yāvadahaṃ tāvadanyaiḥ kimāyudhaiḥ
yadvā na siddhamastreṇa mama tatkena setsyati || 38 ||’
atra karṇasyātmasaṃbhāvanayāśvatthā manyavajñā prakṛṣyate
aheturanivartī ca snehaścittārdratā matā
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘anena kasyāpi kulāṅkureṇa spṛṣṭasya gātreṣu sukhaṃ mamaitat
kāṃ nirvṛtiṃ cetasi tasya kuryā- dyasyāyamaṅgātkṛtinaḥ prarūḍhaḥ || 39 ||’
atra duṣyantasya sattvadamanadarśanādutpannastadaṅgasparśasukhādibhiruddīpitaḥ spṛhāmativitarkavāgārambhaiḥ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ sneho niṣpadyate
abhīṣṭārthasya saṃprāptau spṛhāparyāptatā dhṛtiḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasya prakarṣo yathā—
‘nīto vikramabāhurātmasamatāṃ prāpteyamurvītale sāraṃ sāgarikā samāgaramahīprāptyekahetuḥ priyā
devī prītimupāgatā ca bhaginīlābhājjitāḥ kosalāḥ kiṃ nāsti tvayi satyamātyavṛṣabhe yasminkaromi spṛhām || 40 ||’
atra vatsarājasya sarvātmanā manorathasiddhayo dhṛteḥ prakarṣamāvahanti
cetonimīlanaṃ vrīḍānyaṅgarāgastavādibhiḥ || 151
tadrūpeṇa rasasya prakarṣe krodhaśokābhyāṃ saṃkaro yathā—
‘akṣudrārikṛtābhimanyunidhanaprodbhūtatīvrakrudhaḥ pārthasyākṛtaśātravapratikṛterantaḥśucā muhyataḥ
kīrṇā bāṣpakaṇaiḥ patanti dhanuṣi vrīḍājaḍā dṛṣṭayo hā vatseti giraḥ sphuranti na punarniryānti kaṇṭhādbahiḥ || 41 ||’
atrārjunasyānyāyenābhimanyuvadhādudbhūtau dīptāveva krodhaśokāvudbhūtavipratīkārotthayā tathāvidhayaiva vrīḍayā saṃkīryete
tathāhi krodhaśokayoranubhāvabhūtā dṛṣṭayo vācaśca vrīḍājaḍā iti viśeṣaṇāni saṃbadhyante
avahitthaṃ tu lajjāderharṣādyākāragopanam || 152
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānubandho yathā—
‘evaṃvādini devarṣau pārśve pituradhomukhī
līlākamalapattrāṇi gaṇayāmāsa pārvatī || 42 ||’
atra—
‘praṇamya śitikaṇṭhāya vibudhāstadanantaram
caraṇau rañjayantvasyāścūḍāmaṇimarīcibhiḥ || 43 ||’
ityāderdevarṣivākyādudbhūtaḥ praharṣākāro gurusaṃnidhau lajjitayā līlākamalapatragaṇanavyājena gauryā gopyate
sukhaduḥkhādijanito mohaścittasya mūḍhatā
tadrūpeṇa rasaniṣpattiryathā—
‘kānte talpamupāgate vigalitā nīvī svayaṃ bandhanā- dvāso viślathamekhalāguṇadhṛtaṃ kiṃcinnitambe sthitam
etāvatsakhi vedmi kevalamahaṃ tasyāṅgasaṅge punaḥ ko'yaṃ kā vayamatra kiṃ nu surataṃ svalpāpi me na smṛtiḥ 44’
atra sthāyinī ratirmohaniṣpattyā prakṛṣyate
saṃmohānandasaṃbhedo madirādikṛto madaḥ || 153
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘ghūrṇamānanayanaṃ skhalatkathaṃ khedabindumadakāraṇasmitam
ānanena na tu tāvadīśvaraścakṣuṣā ciramumāmukhaṃ papau || 45 ||’
atra nayanaghūrṇanākāraṇasmitādayaḥ saṃmohānandasaṃbhedādudbhavanto madaṃ niṣpādayanti
manaḥprasādo harṣaḥ syādiṣṭāvāptistavādibhiḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasya prakarṣo yathā—
‘jātasya te piturapīndrajito nihantu- rvatsasya vatsa kati nāma dinānyamūni
tasyāpyapatyamadhitiṣṭhati vīradharme diṣṭyā gataṃ daśarathasya kulaṃ pratiṣṭhām || 46 ||’
atra daśarathasuhṛdaḥ sumanttrasāratheḥ prabhukulasya pratiṣṭhāmāśaṃsatastatsūnumindrajito hantāraṃ paśyato manorathāvāptyā harṣo niṣpannastadapatye'pi vīradharmamācariṣṇau prakṛṣṭo diṣṭyetyavyayena sūcyate
krodhaḥ kṛtāparādheṣu sthiro'marṣatvamaśnute || 154

‘lākṣāgṛhānalaviṣānnasabhāpraveśaiḥ prāṇeṣu vittanicayeṣu ca naḥ prahṛtya
ākṛṣṭapāṇḍavavadhūparidhānakeśāḥ svasthā bhavanti mayi jīvati dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ || 47 ||’
atra bhīmasenasya dhārtarāṣṭreṣu svasthā iti nāmno'pyasahanāt lākṣāgṛhādyapakārajanmāmarṣaḥ pratīyate
asūyānyaguṇarddhīnāmauddhatyādasahiṣṇutā
