‘vandyāste na vicāraṇīyacaritāstiṣṭhantu huṃ vartate sundastrīnidhane'pyakhaṇḍayaśaso loke mahānto hi te
yāni trīṇi kutomukhānyapi padānyāsankharāyodhane yadvā kauśalamindrasūnudamane tatrāpyabhijño janaḥ || 48 ||’
atra yadyapi solluṇṭhadoṣakīrtanādibhirjugupsā niṣyadyate tathāpi na tayā svaniṣpattiheturasūyā saṃkīryate
īrṣāmāhuḥ samāneṣu mānadānādyamarṣaṇam || 155
tadrūpeṇa rasasya prakarṣo yathā—
‘huṃ ṇillajja samosara taṃ ccia aṇuṇesu jāi de eaṃ
pāaggaṃguṭṭhālattaeṇa tilaaṃ viṇimmaviaṃ || 49 ||’
[huṃ nirlajja samapasara tāmevānunaya yasyāsta etat
pādāgrāṅguṣṭhālaktakena tilakaṃ vinirmitam ||]
atra kasyāścit preyasi sapatnīṃ prasādayituṃ gate tanmānamamṛṣyamāṇāyāḥ samutpannerṣyā priyānunayādibhirbhṛśāyamānatayā niṣpannālaktakatilakānumeyaistatpādapatanādibhiruddīptā huṃkārākṣepabhartsanapratibhedāvinābhūtairbhrūbhaṅgatāḍanāṅgakṣepavepathusvedagadgadādibhiḥ saṃsṛjyamānā prakṛṣyate
viṣādaścetaso glānirupāyābhāvanāśayoḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasya prakarṣo yathā—
‘vyarthaṃ yatra kapīndrasakhyamapi me kleśaḥ kapīnāṃ vṛthā prajñāṃ jāmbavato'pi yatra na gatiḥ putrasya vāyorapi
mārgaṃ yatra na viśvakarmatanayaḥ kartuṃ nalo'pi kṣamaḥ saumitrerapi pattriṇāmaviṣayastatra priyā kvāpi me || 50 ||’
atra sītāsamāgamaviṣaye rāmasya dṛṣṭāvadānasugrīvasakhyāderupāyasyābhāvādviṣādaḥ prakṛṣyate
sattvatyāgādanutkarṣo vākyāderdainyamucyate || 156
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānubandho yathā—
‘asmānsādhu vicintya saṃyamadhanānuccaiḥ kulaṃ cātmana- stvayyasyāḥ kathamapyabāndhavakṛtāṃ bhāvapravṛttiṃ ca tām
sāmānyapratipattipūrvakamiyaṃ dāreṣu dṛśyā tvayā bhāgyādhīnamataḥ paraṃ na khalu tadvācyaṃ vadhūbandhubhiḥ || 51 ||’
atra snehaprabhavaṃ pādatrayoktamarthitādainyaṃ turīṃyapādopakṣiptayācñādainyāntareṇānubadhyate
vidurvāgdaṇḍapāruṣyamugratāmapakāriṣu
tadrūpeṇa rasasya prakarṣo yathā—
‘praṇayisakhīsalīlaparihāsarasādhigatai- rlalitaśirīṣapuṣpahananairapi tāmyati yat
vapuṣi vadhāya tatra tava śastramupakṣipataḥ patatu śirasyakāṇḍayamadaṇḍa ivaiṣa bhujaḥ || 52 ||’
atra mādhavasya prakṛṣṭāpakāriṇyaghoraghaṇṭe viṣaye prakṛṣṭameva vākpāruṣyaṃ daṇḍapāruṣyaṃ ca jāyate
trāsaścittacamatkāra ākasmikabhayādibhiḥ || 157
tadrūpeṇa rasasya janma yathā—
‘parisphuranmīnavighaṭṭito ravaḥ surāṅganāsrāsaviloladṛṣṭayaḥ
upāyayuḥ kampitapāṇipallavāḥ sakhījanasyāpi vilokanīyatām 53’
atra loladṛṣṭitā karābadhūnanaṃ ca strīṇāṃ svabhāvabhīrutvavilāsitvābhyāmapi bhavatīti trāsāvirbhāve'pyasamarthamiti nānubangho bhavati
aniṣṭābhyāgamotprekṣāṃ śaṅkāmācakṣate budhāḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasya prakarṣo yathā—
‘sahasā mā sāhijjau piāgamo tīa virahakisiāe
accaṃtapahariseṇa vi jā a muā sā muā ccea || 54 ||’
[sahasā mā sādhyatāṃ priyāgamastayā virahakṛśayā
atyantapraharṣeṇāpi yā ca mṛtā sā mṛtaiva ||]
atra virahiṇyāḥ kārśyātiśayamudvīkṣamāṇāyāḥ kasyāścidvayasyāyāḥ snehātiśayāt 'prema paśyati bhayānyapade'pī'ti priyāgamapraharṣātiśayabhāve'pyasahiṣṇutayā tanmaraṇaśaṅkā prakṛṣyate
virahādermanastāpaḥ śarīrātaṅkado gadaḥ || 158
tadrūpeṇa rasasya janma yathā—
‘sthitamurasi viśālaṃ padminīpattrametat kathayati na tathāntarmanmathotthāmavasthām
atiśayaparitāpaglāpitābhyāṃ yathāsyāḥ stanayugapariṇāhaṃ maṇḍalābhyāṃ bravīti || 55 ||’
atra sāgarikāyāḥ stananihitasarojinīdalaglāpanena vapuḥsaṃtāpo niṣpadyate
balasyāpacayo glānirādhivyādhiprakarṣabhūḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānubandho yathā—
‘kisalayamiva mugdhaṃ banghanādvipralūnaṃ hṛdayakusumaśoṣī dāruṇo dīrghaśokaḥ
glapayati paripāṇḍukṣāmamasyāḥ śarīraṃ śaradija iva gharmaḥ ketakīgarbhapattram || 56 ||’
atra prakṛṣṭaśokānubandhinī glānirvaivarṇyakṣāmatābhyāmanubadhyate
utkaṇṭhāharṣaśokāderunmādaścittaviplavaḥ || 159
tadrūpeṇa rasasya janma yathā—
‘kvākāryaṃ kva kalādharasya ca kulaṃ bhūyo'pi dṛśyeta sā doṣāṇāmupaśāntaye śrutamaho kope'pi śāntaṃ mukham
kiṃ vakṣyantyapakalmaṣāḥ kṛtadhiyo rekhaiva sānyādṛśī cetaḥ svāsthyamupaihi kaḥ khalu yuvā dhanyo'dharaṃ dhāsyati 57’
atra virahiṇaḥ purūravasa utkaṇṭhādibhiḥ premaprakarṣādasatpralāparūpa unmādo niṣpadyate
ādarātiśayāccetasyāvegaḥ saṃbhramo mataḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasya saṃkaro yathā—
‘alamalamatimātraṃ sāhasenāmunā te tvaritamapi vimuñca tvaṃ latāpāśamenam
calitamiva niroddhuṃ jīvitaṃ jīviteśe kṣaṇamiha mama kaṇṭhe bāhupāśaṃ nidhehi || 58 ||’
atra ratijanmā saṃbhramātiśayo ratijanmanaiva matiprakarṣeṇa saṃkīryate
manaḥśarīrayoḥ khedaḥ kriyātiśayataḥ śramaḥ || 160
tadrūpeṇa rasasya saṃkaro yathā—
‘skhalayati vacanaṃ te saṃśrayatyaṅgamaṅgaṃ janayati mukhacandrodbhāsinaḥ khedabindūn
mukulayati ca netre sarvathā subhru khedastvayi vilasati tulyaṃ vallabhālokanena || 59 ||’
atra mālatyāḥ puṣpāvacayajanmā śramaḥ, mādhavāvalokanajā ca ratiḥ, svedagadgadāṅgasādanayanamukulaistulyadharmiṇau mithaḥ saṃkīryete
cittasya khedo nirvedastattvajñānodayādibhiḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasya śeṣo yathā—
‘jarāmaraṇadaurgatyavyādhayastāvadāsatām
manye janmaiva dhīrāṇāṃ bhūyobhūyasttrapākaram || 60 ||’
atra mokṣāyotsahamānasya kasyacinnirvedāvadamo gamyate
kriyāsvapāṭavaṃ jāḍyaṃ cintotkaṇṭhābhayādibhiḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘śithilaśithilaṃ nyasya svairaṃ dhanuḥśikhare śiro nayanasalilaiḥ kurvanmaurvīlatāmaparāmiva
ahaha vikalaḥ śrutvā śrutvā ghanastanitadhvaniṃ kimapi kimapi dhyāyannāryo na yāti na tiṣṭhati || 61 ||’
atra virahiṇo rāmasya kriyāsvapāṭavaṃ niṣpādyate
kriyāvidveṣa ālasyaṃ sukhasaṃvinmadādibhiḥ || 161
tadrūpeṇa rasasya niṣpattiryathā—
‘ghariṇighaṇatthaṇapellaṇasuhellipaḍiassa hontapahiassa
avasauṇaṅgāraavāraviṭṭhidiahā suhāventi || 62 ||’
[gṛhiṇīghanastanapreraṇasukhakelipatitasya bhaviṣyatpathikasya
apaśakunāṅgārakavāraviṣṭidivasāḥ sukhayanti ||]
atra ratisukhānubhavājjigamiṣorapyagacchata ālasyaṃ niṣpadyate
nidrā vyāpāravaimukhyamindriyāṇāṃ śramādibhiḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānubandho yathā—
‘ṇiddālasaparighummirataṃsavalantaddhatāraāloā
kāmassa vi duvvisahā diṭṭhiṇivāā sasimuhīe || 63 ||’
[nidrālasaparighūrṇanaśīlatiryagvaladardhatārakālokāḥ
kāmasyāpi durviṣahā dṛṣṭinipātāḥ śaśimukhyāḥ ||]
atra ratiśramajāgarādijanitanidrālasā dṛṣṭinipātāstārakāghūrṇanatryasravalanādibhiranubadhyante
nidrādijanitaṃ suptamindriyādinimīlanam || 162
tadrūpeṇa rasaprakarṣo yathā—
‘osuai diṇṇapaḍivakkhaveaṇaṃ pasiḍhilehi~ aṅgehi~
ṇivvattiasuraarasāṇubaṃdhasuhaṇibbharaṃ soṇhā || 64 ||’
[avasvapiti dattapratipakṣavedanaṃ praśithilairaṅgaiḥ
nirvartitasuratarasānubandhasukhanirbharaṃ snuṣā ||]
atra nirbharapadenaiva prakarṣaḥ pratipādyate
nidrāpagamahetubhyaḥ prabodhaścetanāgamaḥ
tadrūpeṇa rasasyānubandho yathā—
‘pratyagronmeṣajihmā kṣaṇamanabhimukhī ratnadīṃpaprabhāṇāmātmavyāpāragurvī janitajalalavājṛmbhaṇaiḥ sāṅgabhaṅgaiḥ
nāgāṅkaṃ moktumicchoḥ śayanamuruphaṇācakravālopadhānaṃ nidrācchedābhitāmrā ciramavatu harerdṛṣṭirākekarā vaḥ || 65 ||’
atra dṛṣṭeḥ pratyagronmeṣajihmatādibhiḥ prabodho nādyāpi niṣpadyata iti pratīyate
uktā bhāvādibhedena te'mī ratyādayo rasāḥ
athaiteṣveva keṣāṃcidviśeṣānabhidadhmahe || 163
tatra
śṛṅgāravīrakaruṇaraudrādbhutabhayānakāḥ
bībhatsahāsyapreyāṃsaḥ śāntadāntoddhatā rasāḥ || 164
ratirnisargasaṃsargaupamyādhyātmābhiyogajā
saṃprayogābhimānotthā viṣayotthā ca kathyate || 165
prītirapyevameva syānna tvasyāṃ sāṃprayogikī
ābhyāsikī tu tatsthāne tadudāhṛtayo yathā || 166
‘mṛteti pretya saṃgantuṃ yayā me maraṇaṃ matam
saivāvantī mayā labghā kathamatraiva janmani || 66 ||’
atra sthāyino vibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārisaṃyogādrasaniṣpattiriti ratireva śṛṅgārarūpeṇa niṣpadyate
atrāvantyā vāsavadattāyā ālambanavibhāvabhūtāyāḥ sakāśādutpanno vatseśvarasya ratisthāyibhāvaḥ, tasyāḥ punarjīvanādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamāno mṛtetyādinā vāgārambhānubhāvenānumīyamānairharṣadhṛtiprabhṛtibhiḥ sukhātmakairvyabhicāribhiḥ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ karuṇānantaraḥ saṃbhogaḥ śṛṅgārākhyāṃ labhate
‘ajitvā sārṇavāmurvīmaniṣṭvā vividhairmakhaiḥ
adattvā cārthamarthibhyo bhaveyaṃ pārthivaḥ katham || 67 ||’
atra vasudhāvijayāderālambanavibhāvādutpannaḥ sthāyyutsāhabhāvaḥ sthairyadhairyādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaiḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumīyamāneṣu smṛtimativitarkādiṣu niṣpanno vīrarasasaṃjñayā vyavahriyate
‘yasyāḥ kusumaśayyāpi komalāṅgyā rujākarī
sādhiśete kathaṃ devī hutāśanavatīṃ citām || 68 ||’
atra cālambanavibhāvabhūtadevīmaraṇādutpannaḥ śokaḥ sthāyibhāvaścitāniveśanahutāśanāṅgajvālādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamāno vāgārambhānumeyairnirvedaglānivaivarṇyādibhirvyabhicāribhiḥ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ karuṇa iti jñāyate
‘nigṛhya keśeṣvākṛṣṭā kṛṣṇā yena mamāgrataḥ
so'yaṃ duḥśāsanaḥ pāpo lavdhaḥ kiṃ jīvati kṣaṇam || 69 ||’
atra duḥśāsanālambanavibhāvāya krudhyato bhīmasenasya pūrvamutpannaḥ krodhaḥ sthāyibhāvastadavāpteḥ smaryamāṇasamakṣakṛtadraupadīnigrahakeśakarṣaṇādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumīyamāneṣvasūyāvegavepathuśramādiṣu duḥkhātmakeṣu vyabhicāriṣu nippadyamāno raudra iti niṣpadyate
‘aṃśukāni pravālāni puṣpaṃ hārādibhūṣaṇam
phalaṃ madhūni harmyāṇi śākhā nandanaśākhinām || 70 ||’
atra śākhināṃ pravālapuṣpaphalaśākhāsaṃpannaṃ nijaṃ rūpaṃ nandanaśākhināṃ punaḥ pravālādisthāneṣvaṃśukahāramadhumandirāṇi tadetadāścaryam
ataścaitebhya ālambanavibhāvebhyaḥ kasyaciddevabhūyaṃgatasya samutpanno vismayaḥ sthāyibhāvastadīyāvayavadarśanādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumeyeṣu harṣaromodgamakhedagadgadādiṣu vyabhicāriṣu niṣpadyamāno'dbhuta ityucyate
‘idaṃ maghonaḥ kuliśaṃ dhārāsaṃnihitānalam
smaraṇaṃ yasya daityastrīgarbhapātāya kalpate || 71 ||’
atra mahendrakuliśāddhārāsaṃnihitānalādālambanavibhāvātsmaryamāṇādapi daityastrīṇāmutpanno bhayasthāyibhāvastadvidīrṇadānavamaraṇasmaraṇādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ svagarbhapātādibhiranubhāvādibhistadanumitaiśca svedastambhavepathuprabhṛtibhirvyabhicāribhiḥ saṃsṛjyamāno bhayānakarasarūpeṇa niṣpannaḥ kenacidākhyāyamāno'pi bhayānaka ityākhyāyate
‘pāyaṃ pāyaṃ tavārīṇāṃ śoṇitaṃ pāṇisaṃpuṭaiḥ
kauṇapāḥ saha nṛtyanti kabandhairanttrabhūṣaṇāḥ || 72 ||’
atrālambanavibhāvabhūtebhyaḥ kauṇapebhyaḥ kasyacidripujayaśaṃsinaḥ puṃsa utpanno jugupsāsthāyibhāvaḥ śiraśchedavigaladrudhiraghārāpariplutapraṇartitakabandhakauṇapānttrabhūṣaṇaśoṇitapānādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumeyeṣu bhayāveśaśaṅkāvahitthādiṣu vyabhicāriṣu niṣpanno bībhatsa iti nigadyate
‘idamamlānamānāyā lagnaṃ stanataṭe tava
chādyatāmuttarīyeṇa navaṃ nakhapadaṃ sakhi || 73 ||’
atra kācit sakhīṃ pūrvaṃ bhartari gṛhītamānāṃ tenaiva nakhapadāṅkitastanīmālambanavibhāvabhūtāmupalabhamānāyāḥ kasyāścitsakhyā utpanno hāsaḥ sthāyibhāvastadīyamānaparigrahasmaraṇādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samutpanneṣu vāgārambhānumiteṣu śaṅkāvahitthagadgadādivyabhicāriṣu niṣpadyamāno hāsyaśabdenābhidhīyate
‘yadeva rocate mahyaṃ tadeva kurute priyā
iti vetti na jānāti tatpriyaṃ yatkaroti sā || 74 ||’
atra vatsalaprakṛterdhīratayā lalitanāyakasya priyālambanavibhāvādutpannaḥ snehasthāyibhāvo viṣayasaukumāryātmaprakṛtyādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samupajāyamānairmohadhṛtismṛtyādibhirvyabhicāribhāvairanubhāvaiśca saṃsṛjyamāno niṣpannaḥ preyāniti pratīyate
ratiprītyorapi cāyameva mūlaprakṛtiriṣyate
yaditthamāhuḥ—
‘ahetuḥ pakṣapāto yastasya nāsti pratikriyā
sa hi snehātmakastanturantarmarmāṇi sīvyati || 75
sarvāḥ saṃpattayastasya saṃtuṣṭaṃ yasya mānasam
upānadgṛḍhapādasya nanu carmāstṛtaiva bhūḥ || 76 ||’
atra kasyacidupaśāntaprakṛterdhīraśāntanāyakasya yathopanatamanonukūladārādisaṃpatterālambanavibhāvabhūtāyāḥ samutpanno dhṛtisthāyibhāvo vastutattvālocanādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ samupajāyamānasmṛtyādibhirvyabhi-cāribhāvairvāgārambhādibhiranuṣajyamāno niṣpannaḥ śānta ityabhigīyate
anye punarasya śamaṃ prakṛtimāmananti sa tu dhṛtereva viśeṣo bhavati
‘sādhāraṇyānnirātaṅkaḥ kanyāmanyo'pi yācate
kiṃ punarjagatāṃ jetā prapautraḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 77 ||’
atra rāmasyodāttaprakṛternisargata eva tattvābhiniveśinī matirnākṛtyaviṣaye pravartate, na ca pravṛttopāramati, sā ca sīteyaṃ mama svīkārayogyetyevaṃrūpeṇa pravṛttā rāvaṇaprārthanālakṣmaṇaprotsāhanābhyāmuddīpyamānā samupajāyamānacintāvitarkavrīḍāvahitthasmṛtyādibhiḥ kālocitottarānumīyamānaiśca vivekacāturyaudāryadhairyādibhiḥ saṃsṛjyamānodāttarasarūpeṇa niṣpadyate
‘apakartāhamasmīti mā te manasi bhūdbhayam
vimukheṣu na me khaṅgaḥ prahartuṃ jātu vāñchati || 78 ||’
atra mayāsyāpakāraḥ kṛta iti yaccetasi bhayaṃ tanmābhūt ‘parāṅyukheṣu me khaṅgaḥ kadācidapi na prahartumutsahate’ iti sarvadaiva rūḍho'haṃkāraḥ pratīyate
so'yaṃ garvaprakṛtiruddhato nāma rasaḥ
kecit punaḥ—
‘āsthāmālambya nīteṣu vaśaṃ kṣudreṣvarātiṣu
vyaktimāyāti mahatāṃ māhātmyamanukampayā || 79 ||’
ityevamūrjakhītyudāttapakṣe nikṣipantaḥ pūrvoktameva garvaprakarṣodāharaṇaṃ dhṛtāyudho yāvadahamityādyuddhataniṣpattau varṇayanti
rativiśeṣeṣu naisargikī yathā—
‘iyaṃ mahendraprabhṛtīnadhiśriyaścaturdigīśānavamanya māninī
arūpahāryaṃ madanasya nigrahātpinākapāṇiṃ patimāptumicchati || 80 ||’
atra janmāntaravāsanayā nisargata iyaṃ bhavati
sāṃsargikī yathā—
‘bhittvā sadyaḥ kisalayapuṭān devadārudrumāṇāṃ ye tatkṣīrasrutisurabhayo dakṣiṇena pravṛttāḥ
āliṅgyante guṇavati mayā te tuṣārādrivātāḥ pūrvaspṛṣṭaṃ yadi kila bhavedaṅgamebhistaveti || 81 ||’
atra śaityasaurabhādibhirvirahijanodvejanīyā api vāyavaḥ priyatamāṅgasaṃsargasaṃbhāvanayā samāśliṣyanta iti saṃsargata iyaṃ bhavati
aupamānikī yathā—
‘api janakasutāyāstacca taccānurūpaṃ sphuṭamiha śiśuyugme naipuṇonneyamasti
nanu punariva tanme gocarībhūtamakṣṇo- rabhinavaśatapattraśrīmadāsyaṃ priyāyāḥ || 82 ||’
seyaṃ sītāviṣayiṇī ratistadupamānadarśanena rāmaṃ ramayati
ādhyātmikī yathā—
‘kāmaṃ pratyādiṣṭāṃ smarāmi na parigrahaṃ munestanayām
balavattu dūyamānaṃ pratyāyayatīva me cetaḥ || 83 ||’
atra seyaṃ durvāsasaḥ śāpādvismṛtavivāhādivṛttāntasya duṣyantasya śakuntalāyāṃ ratiradhyātmaṃ bhavati
ābhiyogikī yathā—
‘alasavalitamugdhasnigghaniṣpandamandairadhikavikasadantarvismayasmeratārai;
hṛdayamaśaraṇaṃ me pakṣmalākṣyāḥ kāṭākṣairapahṛtamapaviddhaṃ pītamunmūlitaṃ ca || 84 ||’
seyamanurāgātiśayasūcakamālatīkaṭākṣābhiyoge mādhavasya ratiratīvotpadyate
sāṃprayogikī yathā—
‘unnamayya sakacagrahamāsyaṃ cumbati priyatame haṭhavṛttyā
huṃhu~ muñca mamameti ca mandaṃ jalpitaṃ jayati mānadhanāyāḥ || 85 ||’
atra tarjanārtha—mokṣārtha—vāraṇārthānāṃ mandaṃ mandaṃ prayogānmānavatyāḥ saṃprayoge ratyutpattiḥ pratīyate
ābhimānikī yathā—
‘iyaṃ gehe lakṣmīriyamamṛtavartirnayanayo- rasāvasyāḥ sparśo vapuṣi bahalaścandanarasaḥ
ayaṃ bāhuḥ kaṇṭhe śiśiramasṛṇo mauktikasaraḥ kimasyā na preyo yadi paramasahyastu virahaḥ || 86 ||’
atra ruciviśeṣo'bhimānastata evaṃprāyā ratayo bhavanti
vaiṣayikīṣu śabde yathā—
‘vilāsamasṛṇollasanmusalaloladoṣkandalīparasparapariskhaladvalayaniḥkhanodbandhurāḥ
lasanti kalahuṃkṛtiprasabhakampitoraḥsthalatruṭadgamakasaṃkulāḥ kalamakaṇḍanīgītayaḥ || 87 ||’
sparśe yathā—
‘badhnannaṅgeṣu romāñcaṃ kurvanmanasi nirvṛtim
netre nimīlayanneṣa priyāsparśaḥ pravartate || 88 ||’
rūpe yathā—
‘tā rāghavaṃ dṛṣṭibhirāpibantyo nāryo na jagmurviṣayāntarāṇi
tathā hi śeṣendriyavṛttirāsāṃ sarvātmanā cakṣuriva praṃviṣṭā 89’
rase yathā—
‘kasya no kurute mugdhe pipāsākulitaṃ manaḥ
ayaṃ te vidrumacchāyo marumārga ivādharaḥ || 90 ||’
gandhe yathā—
‘randhaṇakammaṇiuṇie mā jūrasu rattapāḍalasuandham
muhamāruaṃ pianto dhūmāi sihī ṇa pajjalai || 91 ||’
[randhanakarmanipuṇike mā kradhyasva raktapāṭalasugandham
mukhamārutaṃ piban dhūmāyate śikhī na prajvalati ||]
prītiviśeṣeṣu naisargikī yathā—
‘ālakṣya dantamukulānanimittahāsā- navyaktavarṇaramaṇīyavacaḥphrvṛttīn
aṅkāśrayapraṇayinastanayānvahanto dhanyāstadaṅgarajasā malinībhavanti || 92 ||’
atra yadā yadā ratirjāyate tadā tadā putreṣu snihyati putrarūpeṇa vā jāyata iti janmāntaravāsanārūpo nisargaḥ saṃgacchate
sāṃsargikī yathā—
‘viśvaṃbharā bhagavatī bhavatīmasūta rājā prajāpatisamo janakaḥ pitā te
teṣāṃ vadhūstvamasi nandini pārthivānāṃ yeṣāṃ kule ca savitā ca gururvayaṃ ca || 93 ||’
atra viśvaṃbharādisaṃsargāt sītāyāṃ vasiṣṭhamiśrāḥ snihyanti
aupamānikī yathā—
‘kuvalayadalasnigdhaśyāmaḥ śikhaṇḍakamaṇḍano baṭupariṣadaṃ puṇyaśrīkaḥ śriyaiva sabhājayan
punariva śiśurbhūtvā vatsaḥ sa me raghunandano jhaṭiti kurute dṛṣṭaḥ ko'yaṃ dṛśoramṛtāñjanam || 94 ||’
atra rāmaupamyāllave janakaḥ prīyate
ādhyātmikī yathā—
‘paritastaṃ pṛthāsūnuḥ snehena paritastare
avijñāte'pi bandhau hi balātprahlādate manaḥ || 95 ||’
atrāvijñāto'pi vāsavaḥ svasūnumarjunaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ prīṇayati
ābhiyogikī yathā—
‘ajñātabandhurayamṛkṣaharīśvaro me paulastya eṣa samareṣu puraḥ prahartā
ityādṛtena kathitau raghunandanena vyutkrāntalakṣmaṇamubhau bharato vavande || 96 ||’
atra sītānveṣaṇāderabhiyogādrāmasya sugrīvabibhīṣaṇayoḥ prītirudayate
sāṃprayogikīsthāne ābhyāsikī yathā—
‘iti vismṛtānyakaraṇīyamātmanaḥ sacivāvalambitadhuraṃ narādhipam
parivṛddharāgamanubaddhasevayā mṛgayā jahāra catureva kāminī || 97 ||’
atra
‘śabdādibhyo bahirbhūtā yā karmābhyāsalakṣaṇā
prītiḥ sābhyāsikī jñeyā mṛgayādiṣu karmasu ||’
iti lakṣaṇaṃ ghaṭate
ābhimānikī yathā—
‘dattendrābhayadakṣiṇairbhagavato vaivasvatādāmano- rdṛptānāṃ dahanāya dīpitanijakṣāttrapratāpāgnibhiḥ
ādityairyadi vigraho nṛpatibhirdhanyaṃ mamaitattato dīptāstrasphuradugradīdhitiśikhānīrājitajyaṃ dhanuḥ || 98 ||’
atrābhimatapratidvandvilābhāllavānupadī kuśastuṣyati
vaiṣayikīṣu śabde yathā—
‘lāvaṇyaiḥ kṣaṇadāvirāmamadhurāḥ kiṃcidvinidrālasaśrotraiḥ savraṇamugdhacāraṇavadhūdantacchadāvāsinaḥ
pīyante mṛdutrakrapītamarutaḥ paurāṇarītikramavyālolāṅguliruddhaśuktasuṣiraśreṇīravā veṇavaḥ || 99 ||’
sparśe yathā—
‘praśāntagharmābhibhavaḥ śanairvivānvilāsinībhyaḥ parimṛṣṭapaṅkajaḥ
dadau bhujālambamivāttaśīkarastaraṅgamālāntaragocaro'nilaḥ || 100 ||’
rupe yathā—
‘ayamabhinavameghaśyāmalottuṅgasānu- rmadamukharamayūrīmuktasaṃsaktakekaḥ
śakuniśabalanīḍānokahasnigdhavarṣmā vitarati bṛhadaśmā parvataḥ prītimakṣṇoḥ || 101 ||’
rase yathā—
‘ikṣudaṇḍasya maṇḍasya dadhnaḥ piṣṭakṛtasya ca
varāhasya ca māṃsasya so'yaṃ gacchati phālgunaḥ || 102 ||’
gandhe yathā—
‘kapolakaṇḍūḥ karibhirvinetuṃ vighaṭṭitānāṃ saraladrumāṇām
yatra srutakṣīratayā prasūtaḥ sānūni ganghaḥ surabhīkaroti || 103’
upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat
tenotsāhasya yuddhadānadayāvīrādayaḥ, krodhasya bhāmamanyūtprāsādayaḥ, hāsasya smitahasitavihasitādayaḥ, suptapralayamatyādīnāṃ tu svapnamaraṇaśamādayo bhedā jāyante
tatra yadyapi ‘ajitvā sārṇavāmurvīm’ ityanena yuddhavīraḥ, ‘aniṣṭvā vividhairmakhaiḥ’ ityanena dānavīraḥ, ‘adattvā cārthamarthibhyaḥ’ ityanena dayāvīraścotsāharūpeṇa niṣpattau varṇitaḥ, tathāpyekaśo'pyete rasaniṣpattyai prabhavantīti pradarśyante
teṣu yuddhavīro yathā—
‘etāṃ paśya puraḥsthalīmiha kila krīḍākirāto haraḥ kodaṇḍena kirīṭinā sarabhasaṃ cūḍāntare tāḍitaḥ
ityākarṇya kathādbhutaṃ himanidhāvadrau subhadrāpate- rmandaṃ mandamakāri yena nijayordordaṇḍayormaṇḍanam 104’
dānavīro yathā—
‘dadhikṣīraghṛtāmbhodhivyañjanaspṛhaṇīyayā
mahādānotsave yasya hantakārāyitaṃ bhuvā || 105 ||’
dayāvīro yathā—
‘sa tvaṃ madīyena śarīravṛttiṃ dehena nirvartayituṃ yatasva
dināvasānotsukabālavatsā vimucyatāṃ dhenuriyaṃ maharṣeḥ || 106 ||’
krodhasya yadyapi bhāmādayo mānabhedāścaturviṃśatiḥ saṃbhavanti tathāpi lalitālalitobhayabhedena rūpeṇa krameṇa sarvasaṃgrahāttatra traya eva prakārāḥ pradarśyante
teṣu strīṇāṃ lalitakopo bhāmo yathā—
‘bhrūbhedibhiḥ prakampauṣṭhairlalitāṅgulitarjanaiḥ
yatra kopaiḥ kṛtā srīṇāṃ saṃprasādārthinaḥ priyāḥ || 107 ||’
priyāparādhajanmā duḥkhotpīḍo manyuryathā—
‘dhaṇuovappaṇavallariviraiakaṇṇāvaaṃsaduppecche
vāhaguruā ṇisammai vāhīea bahumuhe diṭṭhī || 108 ||’
[dhanudhanvapanavallarīviracitakarṇāvataṃsaduṣprekṣye
bāṣpagurukā niśāmyati bādhyā vadhūmukhe dṛṣṭiḥ ||]
nanviyamīrṣyā kasmānna bhavati, nātra mānadānāmarṣamātraṃ vivakṣitamapi tu tajjanito duḥkhātiśaya iti
priyādiṣu vyājanindotprāso yathā—
‘pahavaṃti ccia purisā mahilāṇaṃ kiṃ tha suhaa vihiosi
aṇurāaṇolliāe ko doso āhijāīe || 109 ||’
[prabhavantyeva puruṣā mahilānāṃ kimatra subhaga vihito'si
anurāganoditāyāḥ ko doṣa ābhijātyāyāḥ ||]
hāsasya yadyapyupahāsādayo bhedāḥ saṃbhavanti tathāpi vihasitena teṣāṃ saṃgrahādīṣannyūnādhikamiti trayastadbhedā udāhriyante—
tatreṣaddhasitaṃ smitaṃ yathā—
‘puṣpaṃ pravālopahitaṃ yadi syānmuktāphalaṃ vā sphuṭavidrumastham |’
tato'nukuryādviśadasya tasyāstāmrauṣṭhaparyastarucaḥ smitasya || 110 ||’
dṛṣṭadaśanakānti hasitaṃ yathā—
‘timiraniruddhabhīmarajanīmukhacandrikayā gaṇapatitāṇḍavābhinayadarśanadīpikayā
abhibhavasi tvamadya śaśinaḥ śriyamutkaṭayā daśanamayūkhamañjaritayā hasitaprabhayā || 111 ||’
tadeva saviśeṣaṃ hasitaṃ yathā—
‘cyutāmindorlekhāṃ ratikalahabhagnaṃ ca valayaṃ dvyaṃ cakrīkṛtya prahasitamukhī śailatanayā
avocadyaṃ paśyetyavatu sa śivaḥ sā ca girijā sa ca krīḍācandro daśanakiraṇāpūritatanuḥ || 112 ||’
suptaviśeṣaḥ svapno yathā—
‘jāne kopaparāṅmukhī priyatamā svapne'dya dṛṣṭā mayā mā mā saṃspṛśa pāṇineti rudatī gantuṃ pravṛttā puraḥ
no yāvatparirabhya cāṭukaśatairāśvāsayāmi priyāṃ bhrātastāvadahaṃ śaṭhena vidhinā nidrādaridrīkṛtaḥ || 113 ||’
mūrcchāviśeṣo maraṇaṃ yathā—
‘kṣaṇamātrasakhīṃ sujātayoḥ stanayostāmavalokya vihvaṃlā
nimimīla narendrasundarī hṛtacandrā tamaseva śarvarī || 114 ||’
mativiśeṣaḥ śamo yathā—
‘yadāsīdajñānaṃ smaratimirasaṃskārajanitaṃ tadā dṛṣṭaṃ nārīmayamidamaśeṣaṃ jagaditi
idānīmasmākaṃ paṭutaravivekāñjanajuṣāṃ samībhūtā dṛṣṭistribhuvanamapi brahma manute || 115 ||’
evamanye'pi vijñeyā rasabhāvādisaṃśrayāḥ
viśeṣāḥ prāptakālo'tha pariśeṣo nidarśyate || 167
tatrāśrayastridhā—pumān—strī—tiryagādayaḥ
teṣu pumān yathā—
‘āścaryamutpaladṛśo vadanāmalendu- sāṃnidhyato mama muhurjaḍimānametya
jātyena candramaṇineva mahīdharasya saṃdhāryate dravamayo manasā vikāraḥ || 116 ||’
strī yathā—
‘tenātha nātha durudāharaṇātapena saumyāpi nāma paruṣatvamabhiprapannā
jajvāla tīkṣṇaviśadāḥ sahasodgirarantī vāgarciṣastapanakāntaśileva sītā || 117 ||’
tiryagādiṣu yathā—
‘utkūjati śvasiti muhyati yāti tīraṃ tīrāttaruṃ tarutalātpunareti vāpīm
vāpyāṃ na rajyati na cātti mṛṇālakhaṇḍaṃ cakraḥ kṣapāsu virahe khalu cakravākyāḥ || 118 ||’
viṣayastridhā—cetanaḥ, tiryagū, acetanaśca
teṣu cetano yathā—
‘iyaṃ sā lolākṣī tribhuvanalalāmaikavasatiḥ sa cāyaṃ duṣṭātmā svasurapakṛtaṃ yena mama tat
itastīvraḥ kāmo gururayamitaḥ krodhadahanaḥ kṛto veṣaścāyaṃ kathamidamiti bhrāmyati manaḥ || 119 ||’
tiryagū yathā—
‘āyāte dayite marusthalabhuvāṃ saṃcintya durlaṅghyatāṃ gehinyā paritoṣabāṣpataralāmāsajya dṛṣṭiṃ mukhe
dattvā pīluśamīkarīrakavalān svenāñcalenādarā- dunmṛṣṭaṃ karabhasya kesarasaṭābhārāgralagnaṃ rajaḥ || 120 ||’
acetano yathā—
‘kṣiptaṃ puro na jagṛhe muhurikṣukāṇḍaṃ nāpekṣate sma nikaṭopagatāṃ kareṇum
sasmāra vāraṇapatiḥ parimīlitākṣa- micchāvihāravanavāsamahotsavānām || 121 ||’
jñānaṃ tridhā—dṛṣṭam, śrutam, anumānajaṃ ca
teṣu dṛṣṭaṃ yathā—
‘sarasijamanuviddhaṃ śaivalenāpi ramyaṃ malinamapi himāṃśorlakṣma lakṣmīṃ tanoti
iyamadhikamanojñā valkalenāpi tanvī kimiva hi madhurāṇāṃ maṇḍanaṃ nākṛtīnām || 122 ||’
śrutaṃ yathā—
‘kiṃ rūpaṃ sphuṭameva sā śaśimukhī dhatte tadatyadbhutaṃ māmutsāhayituṃ parāpakaraṇe cittaṃ kimasmatsvasuḥ
ityantarvikasadvitarkavidhuraṃ cetastathā vartate svalpo'pyeṣa mama prayāti purataḥ panthā yathā dīrghatām 123’
anumānaṃ yathā—
‘śāntamidamāśramapadaṃ sphurati ca bāhuḥ kutaḥ phalamihāsya
athavā bhavitavyānāṃ dvārāṇi bhavanti sarvatra || 124 ||’
saṃskārastridhā—ādṛtaḥ, paṭuḥ, abhyastaśceti
tatrāśrayaguṇenādarapratyayādutpanna ādṛto yathā—
‘kanyāratnamayonijanma bhavatāmāste vayaṃ cārthino ratnaṃ yatkvacidasti tatpariṇamatyasmāsu śakrādapi
kanyāyāśca parārthataiva hi matā tasyāḥ pradānādahaṃ bandhurvo bhavitā pulastyapulahapraṣṭhāśca saṃbandhinaḥ || 125 ||’
viṣayaguṇena paṭupratyayādutpannaḥ paṭuryathā—
‘utpattirdevayajanādbrahmavādī nṛpaḥ pitā
suprasannojjvalā mūrtirasyāḥ snehaṃ karoti me || 126 ||’
jñānapaunaḥpunyenābhyāsapratyayādutpanno'bhyastaḥ
sa yathā—
‘bhūyo bhūyaḥ savidhanagarīrathyayā paryaṭantaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā bhavanavalabhītuṅgavātāyanasthā
sākṣātkāmaṃ navamiva ratirmālatī mādhavaṃ yadgāḍhotkaṇṭhālulitalulitairaṅgakaistāmyatīti || 127 ||’
atra yadyapi viṣayaguṇāt paṭuḥ, āśrayaguṇādāhato'pi pratyayaḥ, paṭumāhataṃ ca saṃskāraṃ prasūte tathāpyabhyāsātpaṭīyānāhatatamaśca jāyamāno'bhyasta ityucyate
uddīpanavibhāveṣu mālyavastravibhūṣaṇādayo mālyādayaḥ
teṣu mālyaṃ yathā—
‘aśokanirbhartsitapadmarāgamākṛṣṭahemadyutikarṇikāram
muktākalāpīkṛtasindhuvāraṃ vasantapuṣpābharaṇaṃ vahantī || 128 ||’
vastraṃ yathā—
‘āvarjitā kiṃcidiva stanābhyāṃ vāso vasānā taruṇārkarāgam
sujātapuṣpastabakāvanamrā saṃcāriṇī pallavinī lateva || 129 ||’
vibhūṣaṇaṃ yathā—
‘kaṇṭhasya tasyāḥ stanabandhurasya muktākalāpasya ca nistalasya
anyonyaśobhājananādbabhūva sādhāraṇo bhūṣaṇabhūṣyabhāvaḥ 130’
ṛtuvayomadādaya ṛtvādayaḥ
teṣu ṛturyathā—
‘idamapulabhavastu prārthanādunirvāraṃ prathamamapi mano me pañcabāṇaḥ kṣiṇoti
kimuta malayavātonmūlitāpāṇḍupattrai- rupavanasahakārairdarśiteṣvaṅkureṣu || 131 ||’
vayo yathā—
‘māmūmuhatkhalu bhavantamananyajanmā mā te malīmasavikāraghanā matirbhūt
ityādi nanviha nirarthakameva yasmā- tkāmaśca jṛmbhitaguṇo navayauvanaṃ ca || 132 ||’
mado yathā—
‘tatkṣaṇaṃ viparivartitahriyorneṣyatoḥ śayanamiddharāgayoḥ
sā babhūva vaśavartinī dvayoḥ śūlinaḥ suvadanā madasya ca 133’
candanasnānadhūpādayaścandanādayaḥ
teṣu candanaṃ yathā—
‘candanaṃ viṣadharāśrayaḥ śaśī vāruṇī ca viṣasodarāvubhau
tāpayanti virahe kimucyate mārayanti na yadetadadbhutam 134’
snānaṃ yathā—
‘āambaloaṇāṇaṃ ollaṃsuapāaḍorujahaṇāṇaṃ
avaraṇhamajjirīṇaṃ kae ṇa kāmo dhaṇuṃ vahai || 135 ||’
[ātāmralocanānāmārdrāṃśukaprakaṭorujaghanānām
aparāhṇamajjanaśīlānāṃ kṛte na kāmo dhanurvahati ||]
dhūpo yathā—
‘snānārdramukteṣvanudhūpavāsaṃ vinyastasāyantanamallikeṣu
kāmo vasantātyayamandavīryaḥ keśeṣu lebhe balamaṅganānām 136’
candrodayo ghanadhvanirupakārasmaraṇamityādyāścandrodayādayaḥ
teṣu candrodayo yathā—
‘vilimpatyetasminmalayajarasārdreṇa mahasā diśāṃ vaktraṃ candre sukṛtamatha tasyā mṛgadṛśaḥ
dṛśorbāṣpaḥ pāṇau vadanamasavaḥ kaṇṭhakuhare hṛdi tvaṃ hrīḥ pṛṣṭhe vacasi ca guṇā eva bhavataḥ || 137’
ghanadhvaniryathā—
‘ajja mae teṇa viṇā aṇuhūasuhāi~ saṃmaraṃtīe
ahiṇavamehāṇa~ ravo ṇisāmio vajjhapaḍaho vva || 138 ||’
[adya mayā tena vinānubhūtasukhāni saṃsmarantyā
abhinavameghānāṃ ravo niśāmito vadhyapaṭaha iva ||]
upakārasmaraṇaṃ yathā—
‘tanme manaḥ kṣipati yatsarasaprahāramālokya māmagaṇitaskhaladuttarīyā
trastaikahāyanakuraṅgaviloladṛṣṭirāśliṣṭavatyamṛtasaṃvalitairivāṅgaiḥ || 139 ||’
anubhāveṣu smarati yathā—
‘khaṇamettaṃ pi ṇa phiṭṭai aṇudiahaṃ diṇṇagaruasaṃtāvā
pacchaṇṇapāvasaṃkavva sāmalī majjha hiaāhi~ || 140 ||’
[kṣaṇamātramapi nāpagacchatyanudivasaṃ dattagurukasaṃtāpā
pracchannapāpaśaṅkeva śyāmalāṅgī mama hṛdayāt ||]
vāñchati yathā—
‘emea akaauṇṇā appattamaṇorahā vivajjisaṃ
jaṇavāo vi ṇa jāo teṇa samaṃ haliautteṇa || 141 ||’
[evamevākṛtapuṇyāprāptamanorathā vipatsye
janavādo'pi na jātastena samaṃ halikaputreṇa ||]
dveṣṭi yathā—
‘gottakkhalaṇaṃ soūṇa piaame ajja māmi chaṇadiahe
vajjhamahisassa mālavva maṃḍaṇaṃ se ṇa paḍihāi || 142 ||’
[gotraskhalanaṃ śrutvā priyatame'dya sakhi kṣaṇadivase
vadhyamahiṣasya māleva maṇḍanamasyā na pratibhāti ||]
prayatate yathā—
‘anugacchanmunitanayāṃ sahasā vinayena vāritaprasaraḥ
svasthānādacalannapi gatveva punaḥ pratinivṛttaḥ || 143 ||’
avaiti yathā—
‘candasarisaṃ muhaṃ se sariso amaassa muharaso tissā
sakaaggaharahasujjalacuṃbaṇaaṃ kassa sarisaṃ se || 144 ||’
[candrasadṛśaṃ mukhamasyāḥ sadṛśo'mṛtasya mukharasastasyāḥ
sakacagraharabhasojjvalacumbanakaṃ kasya sadṛśamasyāḥ ||]
manyate yathā—
‘parivaṭṭaṃtiva ṇisaṃsa(ma)i maṃḍaliakusumāuhaṃ va aṇaṃgaṃ
virahammi maṇṇai harīṇahe aṇatthapaḍiuṭṭhiaṃ va miaṃkam || 145’
[parivartamāneva(?) niśāmyate maṇḍalitakusumāyudhamivānaṅgam
virahe manyate hārinakhe anarthapratyutthitamiva mṛgāṅkam ||]
vakti yathā—
‘ālāo mā dijjau loaviruddhatti ṇāma kāūṇa
samuhāvaḍie ko verie vi diṭṭhiṃ ṇa pāḍei || 146 ||’
[ālāpo mā dīyatāṃ lokaviruddha iti nāma kṛtvā
saṃmukhāpatite ko vairiṇyapi dṛpṭiṃ na pātayati ||]
ceṣṭate yathā—
‘ajja mae gaṃtavvaṃ ghaṇaṃdhaāre vi tassa suhaassa
ajjā ṇimīliacchī paaparivāḍiṃ ghare kuṇai || 147 ||’
[adya mayā gantavyaṃ ghanāndhakāre'pi tasya subhagasya
āryā nimīlitākṣī padaparipāṭīṃ gṛhe karoti ||]
saṃcāriṣu svedaromāñcavepathavo yathā—
‘diṭṭhe jaṃ pulaijjasi tharaharasi piammi jaṃ samāsaṇṇe
tuha saṃbhāsaṇaseulliphaṃsaṇe kiṃ vi ṇijjihisi || 148 ||’
[dṛṣṭe yatpulakāyase tharaharāyase priye yatsamāsanne
tava saṃbhāṣaṇasvedārdrīkṛtasparśe kimapi nīyase ||]
aśru yathā—
‘ṇaaṇabbhaṃtaragholaṃtabāhabharamaṃtharāi diṭṭhīe
puṇaruttapechirīe vālaa kiṃ jaṃ ṇa bhaṇio si || 149 ||’
[nayanābhyantaraghūrṇamānabāṣpabharamantharayā dṛṣṭayā
punaruktaprekṣaṇaśīlayā bālaka kiṃ yanna bhaṇito'si ||]
harṣo yathā—
‘savvassammi vidaddhe(ḍḍhe) taha vi hu hiaassa ṇivvudi ccea
jaṃ teṇa gāmaḍāhe hatthāhatthiṃ kuḍo gahio || 150 ||’
[sarvasve'pi dagdhe tathāpi khalu hṛdayasya nirvṛtireva
yattena grāmadāhe hastāhasti kuṇḍo gṛhītaḥ ||]
amarṣo yathā—
‘katto saṃpaḍai maha pi piasahi piasaṃgamo paose vi
jaṃ jiajai gahiakaraṇiara khiṃkhirī caṃdacaṃḍālo’
[kutaḥ saṃpatati mamāpi priyasakhi priyasaṃgamaḥ pradoṣe'pi
yajjīvati gṛhītakaranikarakhiṃkhirī candracaṇḍālaḥ ||]
līlādiṣu priyajanaceṣṭānukṛtilīṃlā yathā—
‘jaṃ jaṃ karesi jaṃ jaṃ jappasi jaṃ jaṃ ṇiacchesi
taṃ tamaṇusikkharīe dīho diaho ṇa saṃpaḍai || 152 ||’
[yadyatkaroṣi yadyajjalpasi yadyannirīkṣase
tattadanuśikṣaṇaśīlāyā dīrgho divaso na saṃpadyate ||]
netrabhrūvaktrakarmaṇāṃ viśeṣaṇe lasanaṃ vilāso yathā—
‘sabhrūvilāsamatha so'yamitīrayitvā sapratyabhijñamiva māmavalokya tasyāḥ
anyonyabhāvacatureṇa sakhījanena muktāstadā smitasudhāmadhurāḥ kaṭākṣāḥ || 153 ||’
vibhūṣaṇādīnāmanādaravinyāso vicchittiryathā—
‘aṅgāni candanarajaḥparidhūsarāṇi tāmbūlarāgasulabho'dharapallavaśca
acchāñjane ca nayane vasanaṃ tanīyaḥ kāntāsu bhūṣaṇamidaṃ vibhavaśca śeṣaḥ || 154 ||’
vibhūṣaṇādīnāmasthānaprayogo vibhramo yathā—
‘cakāra kācitsitacandanāṅke kāñcīkalāpaṃ stanabhārapṛṣṭhe
priyaṃ prati preṣitacittavṛtti- rnitambabimbe ca babhāra hāram || 155 ||’
smitaruditahasitādīnāṃ harṣādasakṛdekīkaraṇaṃ kilakiñcitaṃ yathā—
‘pāṇipallavavidhūnanamantaḥsītkṛtāni nayanārdhanimeṣāḥ
yoṣitāṃ rahasi gadgadavācāmastratāmupayayurmadanasya || 156 ||’
dṛṣṭajanakathāyāṃ tadbhāvabhāvanotthitavikāro moṭṭāyitaṃ yathā—
‘tava sā kathāsu parighaṭṭayati śravaṇaṃ yadaṅgulimukhena muhuḥ
ghanatāṃ dhruvaṃ nayati tena bhavadguṇapūgapūritamatṛptatayā || 157 ||’
keśastanādharādigrahaṇādduḥkhe'pi sukhabuddhiceṣṭā kuṭṭamitaṃ yathā—
‘hnībharādavanataṃ parirambhe rāgavānavaṭujeṣvavakṛṣya
arpitoṣṭhadalamānanapadmaṃ yoṣito mukulitākṣamadhāsīt || 158 ||’
abhīṣṭaprāptāvabhimānagarvasaṃbhāvanānādarakṛto viṃkāro vivvoko yathā—
‘nirvibhujya daśanacchadaṃ tato vāci bharturavadhīraṇāparā
śailarājatanayā samīpagāmālalāpa vijayāmahetukam || 159 ||’
sukumāratayā karacaraṇāṅganyāso lalitaṃ yathā—
‘gurutarakalanūpurānunādaṃ salalitanartitavāmapādapadmā
itaradanatilolamādadhānā padamatha manmathamantharaṃ jagāma 160’
vaktavyasamaye'pi vacasābhibhāṣya kriyānuṣṭhānaṃ vihṛtaṃ yathā—
‘patyuḥ śiraścandrakalāmanena spṛśeti sakhyā parihāsapūrvam
sā rañjayitvā caraṇau kṛtāśīrmālyena tāṃ nirvacanaṃ jaghāna || 161 ||’
bālyakaumārayauvanasādhāraṇo vihāraviśeṣaḥ krīḍitaṃ yathā—
‘mandākinīsaikatavedikābhiḥ sā kandukaiḥ kṛtrimaputrakaiśca
reme muhurmadhyagatā sakhīnāṃ krīḍārasaṃ nirviśatīva bālye || 162 ||’
krīḍitameva priyatamaviṣaye keliryathā—
‘vyapohitaṃ locanato mukhānilai- rapārayantaṃ kila puṣpajaṃ rajaḥ
payodhareṇorasi kācidunmanāḥ priyaṃ jaghānonnatapīvarastanī || 163 ||’
helādiṣu rāgataḥ sahasā pravṛttihetuścittollāso helā
sā striyāṃ yathā—
‘rehai piaparirambhaṇapasāriaṃ suraamaṃdiraddāre
helāhalahaliathorathaṇaharaṃ bhualaājualaṃ || 164 ||’
[rājate priyaparirambhaṇaprasāritaṃ suratamandiradvāre
vegakautukitasthūlastanabharaṃ bhujalatāyugalam ||]
saiva puruṣe yathā—
‘uttiṣṭhantyā ratānte bharamuragapatau pāṇinaikena kṛtvā dhṛtvā cānyena vāso vigalitakavarībhāramaṃse vahantyāḥ
bhūyastatkālakāntidviguṇitasurataprītinā śauriṇā vaḥ śayyāmāliṅgya nītaṃ vapuralasalasadbāhu lakṣmyāḥ punātu || 165 ||’
helaiva savacanavinyāso hāvaḥ
sa striyāṃ yathā—
‘jai ṇa chivasi pupphavaiṃ purao tā kīsa vārio ṭhāsi
chittosi culuculantehi~ pahāviūṇa maha hatthehiṃ || 166 ||’
[yadi na spṛśasi puṣpavatīṃ puratastatkiṃ vāritastiṣṭhasi
spṛṣṭo'si culuculāyamānaiḥ dhāvitvāsmākaṃ hastābhyām ||]
sa eva puruṣe yathā—
‘loo jūrai jūrau vaaṇijjaṃ hoi hou taṃ ṇāma
ehi ṇimajjasu pāse pupphavai ṇa ei me ṇiddā || 167 ||’
[lokaḥ khidyate khidyatu vacanīyaṃ bhavati bhavatu tannāma
ehi nimajja pārśve puṣpavati naiti me nidrā ||]
ādigrahaṇena bhāvādayo gṛhyante
teṣu bhāvāḥ striyāṃ yathā—
‘tāvaccia raisamae mahilāṇaṃ vibbhamā virāaṃti
jāva ṇa kuvalaadalasacchahāi~ mauleṃti ṇaaṇāiṃ || 168 ||’
[tāvadeva ratisamaye mahilānāṃ vibhramā virājante
yāvanna kuvalayadalasacchāyāni mukulībhavanti nayanāni ||]
vyājaḥ puṃso yathā—
‘aliapasuttaviṇimīliaccha de suhaa majjha oāsaṃ
gaṃḍapariuṃbaṇāpulaiaṃga ṇa puṇo cirāissaṃ || 169 ||’
[alīkaprasuptavinimīlitākṣa he subhaga mamāvakāśam
gaṇḍaparicumbanāpulakitāṅga na punaścirayiṣyāmi ||]
visrambhabhāṣaṇaṃ striyā yathā—
‘jāo so vi vilakkho mae vi hasiūṇa gāḍhamuvagūḍho
paḍhamosariassa ṇiaṃsaṇassa gaṃṭhiṃ vimagganto || 170 ||’
[jātaḥ so'pi vilakṣo mayāpi hasitvā gāḍhamupagūḍhaḥ
prathamāpasṛtasya nivasanasya granthiṃ vimārgayamāṇaḥ ||]
cāṭu strīpuṃsayoryathā—
‘ekkaṃ paharuvviṇṇaṃ hatthaṃ muhamāruṇṇaṃ eṇa vīaṃto
so vi hasaṃtīeॅ mae gahio vīeṇa kaṃṭhammi || 171 ||’
[ekaṃ prahārodvignaṃ hastaṃ mukhamārutena bījayan
so'pi hasantyā mayā gṛhīto dvitīyena kaṇṭhe ||]
premābhisaṃdhānaṃ puṃso yathā—
‘kelīgottakkhalaṇe varassa papphullaiṃ dihiṃ dehi
bahuvāsaavāsahare bahue vāholliā diṭṭhī || 172 ||’
[kelīgotraskhalane varasya praphullāṃ dhṛtiṃ dadhāti
bahuvāsakavāsagṛhe vadhvā bāṣpārditā dṛṣṭiḥ ||]
parihāsaḥ striyāṃ(yā) yathā—
‘ai diara kiṃ ṇa pecchasi āāsaṃ kiṃ muhā paloesi
jāāi bāhumūlaṃ mi addhaandāṇa~ paḍivāḍiṃ || 173 ||’
[ayi devara kiṃ na prekṣasa ākāśaṃ kiṃ mudhā pralokayasi
jāyāyā bāhumūle'rdhacandrāṇāṃ paripāṭīm ||]
kutūhalaṃ puṃso yathā—
‘asamattamaṃḍaṇaccia vacca gharaṃ se sakouhallassa
bolāviahalahalassaa[assa]putti citte ṇa laggihisi ||’
[asamāptamaṇḍanaiva vraja gṛhaṃ tasya sakautūhalasya
vyatikrāntautsukyasya putri citte na lagiṣyasi ||]
cakitaṃ striyā yathā—
‘ṇavalai pahāratuṭhṭhāi taṃ kaaṃ kiṃ pi haliasoṇhāe
jaṃ ajja vi juaijaṇo ghare ghare sikkhiuṃ bhamai || 175 ||’
[patināmapraśnapūrvakaprahāratuṣṭayā tatkṛtaṃ kimapi hālikasnuṣayā
yadadyāpi yuvatijano gṛhe gṛhe śikṣituṃ bhramati ||]
helā hāvaśca bhāvaśca vyājo visrambhabhāṣaṇam
cāṭu premābhisaṃdhānaṃ parihāsaḥ kutūhalam || 168
cakitaṃ ceti nirdiṣṭāśceṣṭāḥ kāścidvilāsinām
śeṣāṇāṃ vipralambhādau rūpamāvirbhaviṣyati || 169
tatra nāyakayoḥ prāgasaṃgatayoḥ, saṃgatayośca, saṃgataviyuktayorvā, mithodarśanaśravaṇābhyāmavasthitābhimānajanmā parasparānurāgo'nyatarānurāgo vābhilaṣaṇīyāliṅganādīnāmanavāptau satyāṃ samupajāyamānaistaistairutkaṇṭhādibhirvyabhicāribhāvairmanovāgbuddhiśarīrārambhajanmabhiścānubhāvairanubaddhaḥ prāptaprāpyaprakarṣāvastho vipralambhaśrṛṅgārākhyāṃ labhate
sa caturdhā—pūrvānurāgo, mānaḥ, pravāsaḥ, karuṇaśca
teṣu prāgasaṃgatayoḥ pūrvānurāgaḥ puruṣaprakāṇḍe yathā—
‘dūraṃ muktālatayā bisasitayā vipralobhyamāno me
haṃsa iva darśitāśo mānasajanmā tvayā nītaḥ || 176 ||’
atra puṇḍarīkasya mahāśvetāyāṃ prāgasaṃgatāyāṃ samutpannaḥ saṃkalparamaṇīyo'bhilāṣastadanāptāvuktaprakāreṇa prakṛṣyamāṇastvayā me mānasajanmā dūraṃ nīta ityuttarakāmāvasthayā prakāśyate
sa eva strīprakāṇḍe yathā—
‘dullahajaṇānurāo lajjā garuī paravaso appā
piasahi visamaṃ pemmaṃ maraṇaṃ saraṇaṃ ṇavari ekkaṃ || 177 ||’
[durlabhajanānurāgo lajjā gurvī paravaśa ātmā
priyasakhi viṣamaṃ prema maraṇaṃ śaraṇamanantaramekam ||]
atrāpi prāgvadeva sāgarikāyā vatsarāje'nurāgaḥ prakṛṣyamāṇo maraṇaṃ śaraṇamityuttarayaiva kāmāvasthayā kathyate
saṃgatayormānaḥ sa nirheturyathā—
‘atthakkarūsaṇaṃ khaṇapasijjaṇaṃ aliavaaṇaṇibbandho
ummaccharasaṃtāvo puttaa paavī siṇehassa || 178 ||’
[akasmādroṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaprasādanamalīkavacananirbandhaḥ
unmatsarasaṃtāpaḥ putraka padavī snehasya ||]
atra premagateḥ svabhāvakauṭilyāddhetumantareṇopajāyamāno nirheturucyate sa eva saheturyathā—
‘paḍiucchiā ṇa jaṃpai gahiā vi pphurai cumbiā rusai
tuṇhiṃkā ṇavabahuā kaāvarāheṇa daieṇa || 179 ||’
[paripṛṣṭā na jalpati gṛhītāpi sphurati cumvitā ruṣyati
tūṣṇīṃbhūtā navavadhūkā kṛtāparādhena dayitena ||]
atra yadyapyāliṅganāderneti netyādeḥ pratiṣedho na vidyate tathāpi tadartho'styeveti mānalakṣaṇaṃ ghaṭate
saṃgataviyuktayoḥ pravāsaḥ
sa navānurāgo yathā—
‘priyamādhave kimasi mayyavatsalā nanu so'hameva yamanandayatpurā
ayamāgṛhītakamanīyakaṅkaṇaḥ sakhi mūrtimāniva mahotsavaḥ karaḥ || 180
atra vivāhānantarameva mālatyāḥ kapālakuṇḍalayāpahārānmādhavamālatyorayaṃ navānurāgaḥ pravāsa ucyate
sa eva prauḍhānurāgo yathā—
‘tvāmālikhya praṇayakupitāṃ dhāturāgaiḥ śilāyāmātmānaṃ te caraṇapatitaṃ yāvadicchāmi kartum
asraistāvanmuhurupacitairdṛṣṭirālupyate me krūrastasminnapi na sahate saṃgamaṃ nau kṛtāntaḥ || 181 ||’
atra prācīnapraṇayaprasādanābhiranurāgasya prauḍhiravagamyate
saṃgatayorevānyataravyapāye karuṇaḥ
sa strīvyapāye puruṣasya yathā—
‘dhruvamasmi śaṭhaḥ śucismite kalitaḥ kaitavavatsalastvayā
paralokamasaṃnivṛttaye yadanāmantrya gatāsi māmitaḥ || 182 ||’
atrendumatīvyapāyādajasya duḥkhātiśayaḥ karuṇa ucyate
sa eva puruṣasya vyapāye striyā yathā—
‘hṛdaye vasasīti matpriyaṃ yadavocastadavaimi kaitavam
upacārapadaṃ na cedidaṃ tvamanaṅgaḥ kathamakṣatā ratiḥ || 183 ||’
atrānaṅgaviṣaye rateḥ śokaprakarṣaḥ karuṇa ityākhyāyate
hīnapātrādiṣu caitadābhāsā bhavanti
tatra hīnapātreṣu puṃsi premānurāgo yathā—
‘kaalīgabbhasaricche ūrū daṭṭhūṇa haliasoṇhāe
ullalai ṇaharaṃjaṇaṃ caṃdilassa seulliakarassa || 184 ||’
[kadalīgarbhasadṛkṣe ūrū dṛṣṭvā hālikasnuṣāyāḥ
ārdrībhavati nakharañjanaṃ nāpitasya svedārditakarasya ||]
atraiva striyāṃ māno yathā—
‘paḍhamaghariṇīa samaaṃ ua piṃḍāre daraṃ kuṇantammi
ṇavabahuāi sarosaṃ savva ccia vacchalā mukkā || 185 ||’
[prathamagṛhiṇyā samakaṃ paśyābhīre bhayaṃ kurvati
navavadhvā saroṣaṃ sarve'pi ca vatsakā muktāḥ ||]
tiryakṣu pakṣiṇi pravāso yathā—
‘āpṛcchāmi vyathayati mano durbalā vāsaraśrīre- hyāliṅga kṣapaya rajanīmekikā cakravāki
nānyāsakto na khalu kupito nānurāgacyuto vā daivādhīnaḥ sapadi bhavatīmasvatastrastyajāmi || 186 ||’
atraiva kariṇi karuṇo yathā—
‘nāntarvartayati dhvanatsu jaladeṣvāmandramudgarjitaṃ nāsannātsarasaḥ karoti kavalānāvarjitaiḥ śaivalaiḥ
dānajyāniviṣaṇṇamūkamadhupavyāsaṅgadīnānano nūnaṃ prāṇasamāviyogavidhuraḥ stamberamastāmyati || 187 ||’
atha saṃbhogaḥ
tatra nāyakayoḥ prāgasaṃgatayoḥ saṃgataviyuktayorvā mithaḥ samāgame prāgutpannastadānīṃtano vā ratyākhyaḥ sthāyibhāvo'bhilaṣaṇīyāliṅganādīnāmavāptau satyāṃ samupajāyamānairharṣa-dhṛti-smṛti-matiprabhṛtibhirvyabhicāribhāvaiḥ saṃsṛjyamānaḥ, ṛtūdyānopagamajalakrīḍāparvatopadeśaprasādhanagṛhamadhupānendūdayādibhiruddīpanavibhāvairuddīpyamānaḥ, savibhramabhrūkaṭākṣavikṣepālāpasaṃbhramasmitādibhiranubhāvairabhivyajyamāna īpsitamāsādayan, jihāsitaṃ vā jihānaḥ, prāptaprāpyaprakarṣārambhaḥ saṃbhogaśrṛṅgārākhyāṃ labhate
sa caturdhā—prathamānurāgānantaraḥ, mānānantaraḥ, pravāsānantaraḥ, karuṇānantara iti
teṣu prathamānurāgāntaro yathā—
‘pāṇiggahaṇe ccia pavvaīa ṇāaṃ sahīhiṃ sohaggam
pasuvaiṇā vāsuikaṃkaṇammi osārie dūram || 188 ||’
[pāṇigrahaṇa eva pārvatyā jñātaṃ sakhībhiḥ saubhāgyam
paśupatinā vāsukikaṅkaṇe'pasārite dūram ||]
mānāntaro yathā—
‘uvvahai dahaagahiāharoṭṭhajhijjantarosapaḍirāam
pāṇosarantamairaṃ casaaṃ va ṇiaṃ muhaṃ bālā || 189 ||’
[udvahati dayitagṛhitādharauṣṭhakṣīyamāṇaroṣapratirāgam
pānāpasaranmadiraṃ caṣakamiva nijaṃ sukhaṃ bālā ||]
pravāsānantaro yathā—
‘maṃgalavalaaṃ jīaṃ va rakkhiaṃ jaṃ pautthavaiāi
pattapiadaṃsaṇūsasiabāhulaiāiṃ taṃ bhiṇṇam || 190 ||’
[maṅgalavalayaṃ jīvitamiva rakṣitaṃ yatproṣitapatikayā
prāptapriyadarśanocchvasitabāhulatikāyāṃ tadbhinnam ||]
karuṇānantaro yathā—
‘ṇa muammi mue vi pie diṭṭho uṇa piṃaamo jiaṃtīe
ia lajjā a pahariso tīe hiae ṇa saṃmāi || 191 ||’
[na mṛtāsmi mṛte'pi priye dṛṣṭaḥ punaḥ priyatamo jīvantyā
iti lajjā ca praharṣastasyā hṛdaye na saṃmāti ||]
te'mī catvāro'pi saṃbhogāścaturbhireva vipralambhaiḥ prakarṣamāpadyante
teṣu prathamānurāgeṇa yathā—
‘induryatra na nindyate na madhuraṃ dūtīvacaḥ śrūyate nocchvāsā hṛdayaṃ dahantyaśiśirā nopaiti kārśyaṃ vapuḥ
svādhīnāmanukūlinīṃ svagṛhiṇīmāliṅgya yatsupyate tatkiṃ prema gṛhāśramavratamidaṃ kaṣṭaṃ samācaryate || 192 ||’
mānena yathā—
‘raiviggahammi kuṇṭhīkaāo dhārāo pemmakhaggassa
aṇamaāiṃ vva sijjhanti māṇasāiṃ ṇāi mihuṇāṇam 193’
[rativigrahe kuṇṭhīkṛtā dhārāḥ premakhaṅgasya
annamayānīva svidyanti mānasāni jñāyante mithunānām ||]
pravāsena yathā—
‘śāpānto me bhujagaśayanādutthite śārṅgapāṇau' māsānetān gamaya caturo locane mīlayitvā
paścādāvāṃ virahaguṇitaṃ taṃ tamātmābhilāṣaṃ nirvekṣyāvaḥ pariṇataśaraccandrikāsu kṣapāsu || 194 ||’
karuṇena yathā—
‘na martyalokastridivātprahīyate mriyeta nāgre yadi vallabho janaḥ
nivṛttameva tridivaprayojanaṃ mṛtaḥ sa cejjīvata eva jīvati 195’
tiryagādiṣu caitadābhāsā bhavanti
teṣu sarīsṛpamṛgayoryathā—
‘madhu dvirephaḥ kusumaikapātre papau priyāṃ svāmanuvartamānaḥ
śrṛṅgeṇa saṃsparśanimīlitākṣīṃ mṛgīmakaṇḍūyata kṛṣṇasāraḥ 196’
paśupakṣiṇoryathā—
‘dadau saraḥpaṅkajareṇugandhi gajāya gaṇḍūṣajalaṃ kareṇuḥ
ardhopabhuktena bisena jāyāṃ saṃbhāvayāmāsa rathāṅganāmā || 197 ||’
kiṃnareṣu yathā—
‘gītāntareṣu śramavārileśaiḥ kiṃcitsamucchvāsitapattralekham
puṣpāsavādhūrṇitanetraśobhi priyāmukhaṃ kiṃpuruṣaścacumbe || 198 ||’
taruṣu yathā—
‘paryāptapuṣpastabakastanībhyaḥ sphuratpravāloṣṭhamanoharābhyaḥ
latāvadhūbhyastaravo'pyavāpurvinamraśākhābhujabandhanāni || 199 ||’
vipralambhaceṣṭāsu prathamānurāge striyā yathā—
‘pecchai aladdhalakkhaṃ dīhaṃ ṇīsasai suṇṇaaṃ hasai
jai jaṃpai aphuḍatthaṃ taha se hiaaṭṭhiaṃ kiṃ vi || 200 ||’
[prekṣate'labdhalakṣyaṃ dīrghaṃ niḥśvasiti śūnyaṃ hasati
yathā jalpatyasphuṭārthaṃ tathāsyā hṛdayasthitaṃ kimapi ||]
puṃso yathā—
‘so tuha kaeṇa suṃdari taha jhīṇo sumahilo haliautto
jaha se macchariṇīa vi doccaṃ jāāe paḍibaṇṇam 201’
[sa tava kṛtena sundari tathā kṣīṇaḥ sumahilo hālikaputraḥ
yathāsya matsariṇyāpi dautyaṃ jāyayā pratipannam ||]
māne striyā yathā—
‘kaṇṇujjuā varāī sā ajja tae kaāvarāheṇa
jaṃbhāiarukkhapaloaiāiṃ diaheṇa sikkhiviā || 202 ||’
[karṇarjukā varākī sādya tvayā kṛtāparādhena
jṛmbhāyitarūkṣapralokitāni divasena śikṣitā ||]
puṃso yathā—
‘avibhāviaraaṇimuhaṃ tassa a saccariavimalacandujjoam
jāaṃ piāvirohe baḍhaṃtāṇuamūḍhalakkhaṃ hiaama || 203 ||’
[avibhāvitarajanīmukhaṃ tasyāśca saccaritavimalacandroddayotam
jātaṃ priyāvirodhe vardhamānānuśayamūḍhalakṣyaṃ hṛdayam ||]
pravāse striyā yathā—
‘piyasaṃbharaṇapalloṭṭatavāhadhārāṇivāabhiāe
dijjai vaṃkaggīvāi dīvao pahiajāāe || 204 ||’
[priyasaṃsmaraṇapraluṭhadbāṣpadhārānipātabhītayā
dīyate vakragrīvayā dīpakaḥ pathikajāyayā ||]
puṃso yathā—
‘majjhaṇṇapatthiassa vi gimhe pahiassa harai saṃtāvam
hiaaṭṭhiajāāmuhamiaṃkajoṇhājalappavaho || 205 ||’
[madhyāhnaprasthitasyāpi grīṣme pathikasya harati saṃtāpam
hṛdayasthitajāyāmukhamṛgāṅkajyotsnajalapravāhaḥ ||]
karuṇe striyā yathā—
‘ṇavari a pasāriaṃgī raabhariuppahapaiṇṇaveṇībaṃdhā
paḍiā urasaṃdāṇiamahialacakkalaiatthaṇī jaṇaasuā 206’
[anantaraṃ ca prasāritāṅgī rajobharitotpathaprakīrṇaveṇībandhā
patitoraḥsaṃdānitamahītalacakrīkṛtastanī janakasutā ||]
puṃso yathā—
‘aṃtohuṃtaṃ ḍajjhai jāāsuṇṇe dhare haliautto
ukkhittaṇihāṇāiṃ va ramiaṭhṭhāṇāiṃ pecchaṃto || 207 ||’
[antarabhimukhaṃ dahyate jāyāśūnye gṛhe hālikaputraḥ
utkṣiptanidhānānīva ramitasthānāni paśyan ||]
evamanyā api
karuṇavarjaṃ striyā yathā—
‘saudhādudvijate tyajatyupavanaṃ dveṣṭi prabhāmaindavīṃ dvārāttrasyati citrakelisadaso veṣaṃ viṣaṃ manyate
āste kevalamabjinīkisalayaprastāraśayyātale saṃkalpopanatatvadākṛtirasāyattena cittena sā || 208 ||’
striyā eva prathamānurāgavarjaṃ yathā—
‘tiṣṭhaḥ dvāri bhavāṅgaṇe vraja bahiḥ sadmeti vartmekṣate śālāmañca tamaṅgamañca valabhīmañceti veśmāñcati
dūtīṃ saṃdiśa saṃdiśeti bahuśaḥ saṃdiśya sāste tathā talpe kalpamayīva nirghṛṇa yathā nāntaṃ niśā gacchati 209’
prathamānurāgavarjaṃ puṃso yathā—
‘ramyaṃ dveṣṭiṃ pusa yathā prakṛtibhirna pratyahaṃ sevyate śayyo pāntavivartanaurviṃgamayatyunnidra eva kṣapāḥ
dākṣiṇyena dadāti vācamucitāmantaḥpurebhyo yadā gotreṣu skhalitastadā bhavati sa vrīḍāvanamraściram 210’
puṃsa eva pravāsakaruṇayoryathā—
‘sītāveśma yato nirīkṣya harate dṛṣṭiṃ jhaṭityākulā manyonyārpitacañcudattakavalaiḥ pārāvatairdūyate
indordūrata eva naśyati viśatyantargṛhaṃ duḥkhitaḥ pracchādyānanamañcalena rajanīpvastatrapaṃ roditi || 211 ||’
saṃbhogaceṣṭāsu pūrvānurāgāntare cumbanaṃ yathā—
‘āarapaṇāmioṭṭhaṃ aghaḍiaṇāsaṃ asaghaḍiaṇilāḍam
vaṇṇagghaalippamuhīa tīa pariuṃbaṃṇaṃ marimo || 212 ||’
[ādarapraṇāmitauṣṭhamaghaṭitanāsamasaṃghaṭitalalāṭam
varṇadhṛtaliptamukhyāstasyāḥ paricumbanaṃ smarāmaḥ ||]
atraivāliṅganaṃ yathā—
‘tāvamavaṇei ṇa tahā caṃdaṇapaṃko vi kāmimihuṇāṇam
jaha dūsahe vi gimhe aṇṇoṇṇāliṃgaṇasuhellī || 213 ||’
[tāpamapanayati na tathā candanapaṅko'pi kābhimithunānām
yathā duḥsahe'pi grīṣme'nyonyāliṅganasukham ||]
mānānantare cumbanaṃ yathā—
‘jaha jaha se pariuṃbai maṇṇubhariāiṃ’ ṇihuvaṇe daio
acchīiṃ uvari uvari taha taha bhiṇṇāiṃ vigalaṃti || 214 ||’
[yathā yathāsyāḥ paricumbati manyubharitāni nidhuvane dayitaḥ
akṣīṇyuparyupari tathā tathā bhinnāni vigalanti ||]
atraivāliṅganaṃ yathā—
‘māṇadumaparusapavaṇassa māmi savvaṃgaṇibbudiarassa
uvaūhaṇassa bhaddaṃ raiṇāḍaapuvvaraṃgassa || 215 ||’
[mānadrumaparuṣapavanasya mātulāni sarvāṅganirvṛtikarasya
upagūhanasya bhadraṃ ratināṭakapūrvaraṅgasya ||]
pravāsānantare cumbanaṃ yathā—
‘kenacinmadhuramulbaṇarāgaṃ bāṣpataptamadhikaṃ viraheṣu
oṣṭhapallavamapāsya muhūrtaṃ subhruvaḥ sarasamakṣi cucumbe || 216 ||’
karuṇānantaramāliṅganaṃ yathā—
‘candrāpīḍaṃ sā ca jagrāha kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhasthānaṃ jīvitaṃ ca prapede
tenāpūrvāṃ sā samullāsalakṣmīminduṃ spṛṣṭvā sindhuveleva bheje 217’
prathamānurāgānantare dantakṣataṃ yathā—
‘ṇāsaṃ va sā kavole ajja vi tuha daṃtamaṃḍalaṃ bālā
ubbhiṇṇapulaabaīveḍhaparigaaṃ rakkhai varāī || 218 ||’
[nyāsamiva sā kapole'dyāpi tava dantamaṇḍalaṃ bālā
udbhinnapulakavṛtiveṣṭaparigataṃ rakṣati varākī ||]
tadeva mānānantare yathā—
‘pavaṇuvvelliasāhuli ṭhaesu ṭhiadaṃtamaṃḍale ūrū
caḍuāraaṃ paiṃ mā hu putti jaṇahāsiaṃ kuṇasu || 299 ||’
[pavanodvellitavastrāñcale sthagaya sthitadaṇḍamaṇḍale ūrū
caṭukārakaṃ patiṃ mā khalu putri janahasitaṃ kuru ||]
pravāsānantare dantakṣatādayo yathā—
‘daṃtakkhaaṃ kavole kaaggahuvvelio a dhammillo
parighummirā a diṭṭhī piāgamaṃ sāhai vahūe || 220 ||’
[dantakṣataṃ kapole kacagrahodvellitaśca dhammillaḥ
parighūrṇanaśīlā ca dṛṣṭiḥ priyāgamaṃ sādhayati vadhvāḥ ||]
prathamānurāgānantare nakhakṣataṃ yathā—
‘ajjāi ṇavaṇahakkhaaṇirikkhaṇe garuajovvaṇuttuṃgam
paḍimāgaaṇiaṇaaṇuppalacciaṃ hoi thaṇavaṭṭham || 221 ||’
[āryāyā navanakhakṣatanirīkṣaṇe gurukayauvanottuṅgam
pratimāgatanijanayanotpalārcitaṃ bhavati stanapṛṣṭham ||]
atraiva puruṣāyitaṃ yathā—
‘daravevirorujualāsu mauliacchīsu luliaciurāsu
purisāiasīrisu kāmo piāsu sajjāuho vasai || 222 ||’
[īṣadvepanaśīloruyugalāsu mukulitākṣīṣu lulitacikurāsu
puruṣāyitaśīlāsu kāmaḥ priyāsu sajjāyudho vasati ||]
sarvaṃ sarvatra yathā—
‘poḍhamahilāṇaṃ jaṃ suṭṭhu sikkhiaṃ taṃ rae suhāvei
jaṃ jaṃ asikkhiaṃ ṇavavahūṇaṃ taṃ taṃ dhiiṃ deṭṭha || 223 ||’
[prauḍhamahilānāṃ yatsuṣṭhu śikṣitaṃ tadrate sukhayati
yadyadaśikṣitaṃ navavadhūnāṃ tattaddhṛtiṃ dadāti ||]
vipralambhaparīṣṭiṣvabhiyogataḥ premaparīkṣā yathā—
‘haṃho kaṇṇullīṇā bhaṇāmi re suhaa kiṃ pi mā jūra
ṇijjaṇapāraddhīsu tue kahiṃ vi puṇṇehiṃ laddhosi || 224 ||’
[haṃho karṇollīnā bhaṇāmi re subhaga kimapi mā khidyasva
nirjanarathyāsu tvaṃ kathamapi puṇyairlabdho'si ||]
pratyabhiyogato yathā—
‘golāvisamoāracchaleṇa appā urammi se mukko
aṇuaṃpāṇiddosaṃ teṇa vi sā gāḍhamuvaūḍhā || 225 ||’
[godāvarīviṣamāvatāracchalenātmā urasi tasya muktaḥ
anukampānirdoṣaṃ tenāpi sā gāḍhamupagūḍhā ||]
viṣahaṇena yathā—
‘ajja vi seaṃjalollaṃ pavvāi ṇa tīa haliasoṇhāe
phaggucchaṇacikkhi(kkha)llaṃ jaṃ tai diṇṇaṃ thaṇucchaṅge 226’
[adyāpi svedajalārdritaḥ pramlāyate na tasyā hālikasnuṣāyāḥ
phalgūtsavakardamo yastasyā dattāḥ stanotsaṅge ||]
vimarśena yathā—
‘tatto ccia ṇenti kahā viasaṃti tarhi samappanti
kiṃ maṇṇe māucchā ekkajuāṇo imo gāmo || 227 ||’
[tata eva niryānti kathā vikasanti tatra tatra samāpyante
kiṃ manye mātṛṣvasaḥ ekayuvako'yaṃ grāmaḥ ||]
bahumānena yathā—
‘teṇa ira ṇavalaāe diṇṇo paharo imīa thaṇavaṭṭhe
gāmataruṇīhiṃ ajja vi diahaṃ parivāliā bhamai || 228 ||’
[tena kila dolāvilāse daktaḥ prahāra etasyāḥ stanapṛṣṭhe
grāmataruṇībhiradyāpi divasaṃ pratipālitā bhramati ||]
ślāghayā yathā—
‘sā tai sahatthadiṇṇaṃ phaggucchaṇakaddamaṃ thaṇucchaṃge
parikuviā iva sāhai salāhirī gāmataruṇīṇam || 229 ||’
[sā tvayā svahastadattaṃ phalgūtsavakardamaṃ stanotsaṅge
parikupiteva sādhayati ślāghanaśīlā grāmataruṇīnām ||]
iṅgitena yathā—
‘jai so ṇa vallaha ccia ṇāmaggahaṇena tassa sahi kīsa
hoi muhaṃ te raviaraphaṃsavisaṭṭaṃ va tāmarasam || 230 ||’
[yadi sa na vallabha eva nāmagrahaṇena tasya sakhi kimiti
bhavati mukhaṃ te ravikarasparśavikasitamiva tāmarasam ||]
dūtasaṃpreṣaṇena yathā—
‘seulliasavvaṃgī ṇāmaggahaṇena tassa suhaassa
dūiṃ appāheṃtī tasse a gharaṃgaṇaṃ pattā || 231 ||’
[svedārdrīkṛtasarvāṅgī nāmagrahaṇena tasya subhagasya
dūtīṃ saṃdiśantī tasyaiva gṛhāṅgaṇaṃ prāptā ||]
dūtapreśne yathā—
‘kaha ṇu gaā kaha diṭṭhā kiṃ bhaṇiā kiṃ ca teṇa paḍivaṇṇaṃ
eaṃ cia ṇa samappai punaruttaṃ jaṃpamāṇīe || 232 ||’
[kathaṃ nu gatā kathaṃ dṛṣṭā kiṃ bhaṇitā kiṃ ca tena pratipannam
evameva na samāpyate punaruktaṃ jalpamānāyāḥ ||]
lekhavidhānena yathā—
‘vevirasiṇṇakaraṅgulipariggahakkhalialehaṇīmagge
sotthi ccia ṇa samappai piasahi lehammi kiṃ lihino || 233 ||’
[vepanaśīlasviṃnnakarāṅguliparigrahaskhalitalekhanīmārge
svastyeva na samāpyate priyasakhi lekhe kiṃ likhāmaḥ ||]
lekhavācanena yathā—
‘prītyā svastipadaṃ vilokitavatī sthānaṃ stutaṃ tuṣṭayā paścājjñātamanukrameṇa puratastattāvakaṃ nāmakam
tanvyā saṃmadanirbhareṇa manasā tadvācayantyā muhurna prāpto ghanabāṣpapūritadṛśā lekhe'pi kaṇṭhagrahaḥ || 234 ||’
saṃbhogaparīṣṭiṣu prathamānurāgānantare sādhvasena puṃso yathā—
‘līlāio ṇiasaṇe rakkhiu taṃ rāhiāi thaṇavaṭṭhe
hariṇo paḍhamasamāgamasajjhasavasarehiṃ veviro hattho || 235 ||’
[līlāyito nivasane rakṣatu tvāṃ rādhikāyāḥ stanapṛṣṭhe
hariṇaḥ prathamasamāgamasādhvasaprasarairvepanaśīlo hastaḥ ||]
atraiva dohadena mugdhāyā yathā—
‘kiṃ kiṃ de paḍihāsai sahīhi~ ia pucchiāi muddhāi~
paḍhamullaadohaliṇīa ṇavari daiaṃ gaā diṭṭhī || 236 ||’
[kiṃ kiṃ te pratibhāsate sakhībhiriti pṛṣṭāyā mugdhāyāḥ
prathamodgatadohadinyāḥ kevalaṃ dayitaṃ gatā dṛṣṭiḥ ||]
atraiva pragalbhāyāḥ priyavākyavarṇanena yathā—
‘huṃhuṃ he bhaṇasu puṇo ṇa suaṃti karei kālavikkheaṃ
ghariṇī hiaamuhāiṃ paiṇo kaṇṇe bhaṇaṃtassa || 237 ||’
[huṃhuṃ he bhaṇa punarna svapanti karoti kālavikṣepam
gṛhiṇī hṛdayasukhāni patyuḥ karṇe bhaṇataḥ ||]
mānānantare striyāḥ kaitavasmaraṇena yathā—
‘bharimo se saaṇaparammuhīa vialaṃtamāṇapasarāe
keavasuttuvvattaṇathaṇaharapellaṇasuhellim || 238 ||’
[smarāmastasyāḥ śayanaparāmukhyā vigalanmānaprasarāyāḥ
kaitavasuptodvartanastanabharapreraṇasukhakelim ||]
striyā eva sakhīvākyasyokṣepeṇa yathā—
‘bhiuḍīa puloissaṃ ṇivbhacchissaṃ parammuhī hossam
jaṃ bhaṇaha taṃ karissaṃ sahio jai taṃ ṇa pecchissam 239’
[bhrakuṭyā pralokayiṣye nirbhartsye parāṅmakhībhaviṣyāmi
yadbhaṇata tatkariṣye sakhyo yadi taṃ na prekṣiṣye ||]
tasyā eva tadanuṣṭhānavighnena yathā—
‘granthimudgrathayituṃ hṛdayeśe vāsasaḥ spṛśati mānadhanāyāḥ
bhrūyugena sapadi pratipede romabhiśca samameva vibhedaḥ || 240 ||’
pravāsānantaraṃ striyā yathā—
‘acchakkāgaahiae bahuā daiammi gurupurao
jūrai vialaṃtāṇaṃ harisavisaṭṭāṇa valaāṇam || 241 ||’
[akasmādāgatahṛdaye vadhūkā dayite gurupurataḥ
krudhyati vigalabhdyo harṣavikasabhdyo valayebhyaḥ||]
atraiva strīpuṃsayoryathā—
‘ramiūṇa paammi gae (o)jāhe avaūhiuṃ paḍinivṛtto
ahaaṃ pautthapaiavva takkhaṇaṃ so pavāsivva || 242 ||’
[ratvā padamapi gato yadopagūhituṃ pratinivṛttaḥ
ahaṃ proṣitapatikeva tatkṣaṇaṃ sa pravāsīva ||]
sāmānyata eva pravāsasādhvasena striyā yathā—
‘hoṃtapahiassa jāā āucchaṇajīaadhāraṇarahassam
pucchantīṃ bhamai gharaṃ ghareṇa piavirahasahirīo || 243 ||’
bhaviṣyatpathikasya jāyā āpṛcchanajīvadhāraṇarahasyam
pṛcchantī bhramati gṛhaṃ gṛheṇa priyavirahasahanaśīlāḥ ||]
pravāsavilambena puṃso yathā—
‘ekko vi kālasāro ṇa dei gaṃtuṃ paāhiṇa valanto
kiṃ uṇa bāhāuliaṃ loaṇajualaṃ miacchīe || 244 ||’
[eko'pi kṛṣṇasāro na dadāti gantu pradakṣiṇaṃ valan
kiṃ punarbāṣpākulitaṃ locanayugalaṃ mṛgākṣyāḥ ||]
parihāre svedādibhiḥ striyā yathā—
‘ullāai se aṃgaṃ ūrū vevanti kūvalo galai
ucchucchulei hiaaṃ piāame pupphavaiāi || 245 ||’
[ārdrībhavatyasyā aṅgamūrū vepete jaghanavasanaṃ galati
utkampate hṛdayaṃ priyāgame puṣpavatyāḥ ||]
karuṇānantaraṃ puṃso yathā—
‘karasparśārambhātpulakitapṛthūrojakalaśe śramāmbho vāmārdhe vahati madanākūtasubhagam
vibhorvāraṃvāraṃ kṛtasamadhikoddhūlanavidhe- stanau bhasmasnānaṃ kathamapi samāptaṃ vijayate || 246 ||’
vipralambhaniruktiṣu prathamānurāge pratiśrutyādānaṃ yathā—
‘kiṃ bhaṇiosi ṇa vālaa gāmaṇidhūāi guruaṇasamakkham
aṇimisavaṃkavalaṃtaaāṇaṇaṇaaṇaddhadiṭṭhehiṃ || 247 ||’
[kiṃ bhaṇito'si na bālaka grāmaṇīduhitrā gurujanasamakṣam
animiṣavakravaladānananayanārdhadṛṣṭaiḥ ||]
atra vakrekṣitādibhiḥ pratiśrutyāliṅganādayo hrībhayādibhirna dīyante
māne visaṃvādanaṃ yathā—
‘aṇṇua ṇāhaṃ kuviā uvaūhasu kiṃ muhā pasāemi
tuha maṇṇusamuppaṇṇeṇa majjha māṇeṇa viṇa kajjam || 248 ||’
[ajña nāhaṃ kupitā upagūhasva kiṃ mudhā prasādayāmi
tava manyusamutpannena mama mānenāpi na kāryam ||]
atra māninī pūrvamāliṅganādīnniṣidhya paścādayathāvatprayacchati yathā kaścidaṣṭau śatāni pradāsyāmīti pratiśrutyāṣṭabhiradhikaṃ śataṃ praya-cchati na tvaṣṭau śatānīti
tadetavdyalīkavipriyādibhirāliṅganādīnāṃ nirākaraṇamayathāvatpradānatvādvisaṃvādanamevocyate
pravāse kālaharaṇaṃ yathā—
‘ehii so vi pauttho ahaaṃ kuppejja so vi aṇuṇejja
ia kassa vi phalai maṇorahāṇa~ mālā piaamammi || 249 ||’
[eṣyati so'pi proṣito'haṃ kupiṣyāmi so'pyanuneṣyati
iti kasyāpi phalati manorathānāṃ mālā priyatame ||]
atrāliṅganādīnāṃ vyaktaiva kālaharaṇapratītiḥ
karuṇe pratyādānaṃ yathā—
‘samasokkhadukkhaparivaḍḍhiāṇa~ kāleṇa rūḍhapemmāṇaṃ
mihuṇāṇa~ marai jaṃ taṃ khu jiai iaraṃ muaṃ hoi || 250 ||’
[samasaukhyaduḥkhaparivardhitayoḥ kālena rūḍhapremṇoḥ
mithunayormriyate yattatkhalu jīvatītaranmṛtaṃ bhavati ||]
atra—
‘suhṛdiva prakaṭayya sukhapradaḥ prathamamekarasāmanukūlatām
punarakāṇḍavivartanadāruṇaḥ praviśinaṣṭi vidhirmanaso rujam 251’
ityayamarthaḥ saṃbadhyate
tasya ca pratyādānamevārtho bhavati
prathamānurāge vañcanamātraṃ vividhaṃ yathā—
‘diṭṭhāi jaṃ ṇa diṭṭho ālaviāe vi jaṃ ṇa ālatto
uvaāro jaṃ ṇa kao taṃ cia kaliaṃ chaillehiṃ || 252 ||’
[dṛṣṭayā yanna dṛṣṭa ālapitayā yannālāpitaḥ
upakāro yanna kṛtastadeva kalitaṃ vidagdhaiḥ ||]
atra vrīḍādibhiradarśanādibhirvañcanādibhirvaividhyaṃ pratīyate
māne viruddhaṃ yathā—
‘ṇa muaṃti dīhasāse ṇa ruaṃti ṇa honti virahakisiā o
dhaṇṇāò tāò jāṇaṃ bahuvallaha vallaho ṇa tumam || 253 ||’
[na muñcanti dīrghaśvāsān na rudanti na bhavanti virahakṛśāḥ
dhanyāstā yāsāṃ bahuvallabha vallabho na tvam ||]
atrerṣyāyitādibhirvallabhāliṅganādiviruddhairmānavatī vañcyate
pravāse vyāviddhaṃ yathā—
‘kaiā gao pio ajja putti ajjeṇa kai diṇā hoṃti
ekko eddahamette bhaṇie mohaṃ gaā kuṃvarī || 254 ||’
[kadā gataḥ priyo'dya putri adyeti kati dināni bhavanti
eka etāvanmātre bhaṇite mohaṃ gatā kumārī ||]
atraikasyāpi divasasya varṣāyamāṇatayā viśeṣato dairghyaṃ pratīyate
karuṇe niṣiddhaṃ yathā—
‘āvāabhaaaraṃ cia ṇa hoi dukkhassa dāruṇaṃ ṇivvahaṇam
ṇāha jiantīa mae diṭṭhaṃ sahiaṃ a tuha imaṃ avasāṇam ||’
[āpātabhayaṃkarameva na bhavati duḥkhasya dāruṇaṃ nirvahaṇam
nātha jīvantyā mayā dṛṣṭaṃ soḍhaṃ ca tavedamavasānam ||]
tadetadrāmaviṣaye sītāyāścirāśaṃsitasamāgamasukhāvāptivyapāyarūpaṃ vacanaṃ karuṇe niṣidhyate
prathamānurāgeṇa saha rāgo yathā—
‘sā mahai tassa ṇhāuṃ aṇusotte sovi se samuvvahai
thaṇavaṭṭabhiḍaṇaviluliakallolamahagghie salile || 256 ||’
[sā vāñchati tasya snātumanusrotasi so'pyasyāḥ samudvahati
stanapṛṣṭamilanavilulitakallolamahārghite salile ||]
atra dvayorapyekakālamanyo'nyānurāgaḥ pratīyate tatraikā lāvaṇyādinā rajyate'nyaḥ snehādineti
tatraiva paścādyathā—
‘māmi hiaaṃ va pīaṃ teṇa juāṇeṇa majjamāṇāe
ṇhāṇahaliddākaḍuaṃ aṇusottajalaṃ piaṃteṇa || 257 ||’
[mātulāni hṛdayameva pītaṃ tena yūnā majjamānāyāḥ
snānaharidrākaṭukamanusrotojalaṃ pibatā ||]
atraikasyānurāgaṃ dṛṣṭvā paścāddvitīyo rajyate
tatraivānurūpo yathā—
‘saccaṃ jāṇai daṭṭhuṃ sarisammi jaṇammi jujjae rāo
marau ṇa tumaṃ bhaṇisyaṃ maraṇaṃ vi salāhaṇijjaṃ se || 258 ||’
[satyaṃ jānāti draṣṭuṃ sadṛśe jane yujyate rāgaḥ
mriyatāṃ na tvāṃ bhaṇiṣyāmi maraṇamapi ślāghanīyamasyāḥ ||]
atra na kevalaṃ lāvaṇyādinaiva rajyate kiṃ tarhyanurūpaviṣayiṇābhilāṣeṇāpīti pratīyate
tatraivānugato yathā—
‘gahavaisueṇa samaaṃ saccaṃ aliaṃ va kiṃ viāreṇa
dhaṇṇāi haliakumāriāi jaṇammi jaṇavāo || 259 ||’
[gṛhapatisutena samakaṃ satyamalīkaṃ vā kiṃ vicāreṇa
dhanyāyā hālikakumārikāyā jane janavādaḥ ||]
atra yadyapi saubhāgyādiprasiddhikṛtasārūpyaṃ na vidyate tathāpi striyā uttamaprārthanamagarhitatvādanugatameva bhavati
so'yaṃ karaṇasādhanotpattipakṣe uktaḥ
bhāvasādhanapakṣe tu sahārthādiviśiṣṭā ratirdīptirvānurāgaśabdenocyate
prathamaṃ copajāyamānatvādayaṃ prathamānurāga iti prathate
māne mānyate yeneti yathā—
‘pāapaḍaṇāṇa~ muddhe rahasavalāmoḍiacciavvāṇam
daṃsaṇamettapasijjiri cukkā bahuāṇa sokkhāṇa~ || 260 ||’
[pādapatanānāṃ mugdhe rabhasabalātkṛtārcitavyānām
darśanamātraprasādanaśīle bhraṣṭā bahūnāṃ saukhyānām ||]
atra 'māna pūjāyām’ iti dhātoḥ svārthikaṇijantāṇṇici ghañi ca māna iti rūpam
sa hi preyāṃsamasyāḥ pādapatanādipūjāyāṃ prayojayati
yaṃ priyatvena manyate yathā—
‘kāraṇagahio vi mae māṇo emea jaṃ samosario
atthakkapphullaaṃkolla tujjha taṃ matthae paḍau || 261 ||’
[kāraṇagṛhīto'pi mayā māna evameva yatsamupasṛtaḥ
akasmātphullitāṅkolla tava tanmastake patatu ||]
atra ‘mana jñāne’ iti dhātuḥ
tathā hi mānaṃ priyatvena manyamānā tadapahāriṇe'ṅkollāya kāpi māninī kupyati
yaḥ prema manute yathā—
‘jattha ṇa ujjāgarao jattha ṇa īsāvisūraṇaṃ māṇam
sabbhāvacāṭuaṃ jattha ṇatthi ṇeho tahiṃ ṇatthi || 262 ||’
[yatra nāstyujjāgarako yatra nerṣyākhedī mānaḥ
sadbhāvacāṭukaṃ yatra nāsti snehastatra nāsti ||]
atra 'manu avabodhane’ iti dhātuḥ
mānena hi janaḥ premāsti nāsti veti budhyate
tasya ca karaṇabhūtasyāpi prādhānyādatra kartṛtvopacāraḥ
tadyathā 'prajñā paśyati no cakṣurdṛṣṭiḥ sārasvatī hi sā
’ iti
prema mimīte yathā—
‘kuviā a saccahāmā same vi bahuāṇa ṇavara māṇakkhalaṇe
pāaḍiahiaasāro pemmāsaṃghasariso paaṭṭai maṇṇū || 263 ||’
[kupitā ca satyabhāmā same'pi bandhūnāṃ kevalaṃ mānaskhalane
prakaṭitahṛdayasāraḥ premāśvāsasadṛśaḥ pravartate manyuḥ ||]
atra ‘māṅ māne’ iti dhātoḥ ‘kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam 3

‘ko'sāvanumāna’ iti bhāṣyaprayogāt
tena ca yadyapi karaṇabhūtenaivātmani rukmiṇyāṃ ca priyapremṇaḥ parimāṇaṃ satyabhāmā pratyāyayati tathāpi pūrvavadihāpyayaṃ pūrvavatkartṛtvenopacaryate
pravāse vasata ityupalakṣaṇenātmānamaṅganā na bhūṣayanti yathā—
‘sāhīṇe vi piaame patte vi khaṇe ṇa maṇḍio appā
dukkhiapautthavaiaṃ saajjiaṃ saṃṭhavaṃtīe || 264 ||’
[svādhīne'pi priyatame prāpte'pi kṣaṇe na maṇḍita ātmā
duḥkhitaproṣitapatikāṃ prativeśinīṃ saṃsthāpayantyā ||]
atra ‘vasa ācchādane’ ityasya 'prasmarati’ ityādivanniṣedhārthakaprapūrvasya ghañi pravāsa iti rūpaṃ nirūpyate
yuvānaḥ priyāsaṃnidhau na vasanti yathā—
‘virahāṇalo sahijjai āsābaṃdheṇa vallahajaṇassa
ekkaggāmapavāso māe maraṇaṃ visesei || 265 ||’
[virahānalaḥ sahyata āśābandhena vallabhajanasya
ekagrāmapravāso mātarmaraṇaṃ viśeṣayati ||]
atra dūrasthayorivāntikasthayorapi saṃnikarṣābhāvātpravāso bhavati
utkaṇṭhādibhiśceto vāsayati yathā—
‘āloaṃta disāo sasaṃta jaṃbhaṃta gaṃta roanta
mujjhaṃta paḍaṃta hasaṃta pahia kiṃ te pauttheṇa || 266 ||’
[ālokayan diśaḥ śvasan jṛmbhamāṇo gāyan rudan
muhyan patan hasan pathika kiṃ tena proṣitena ||]
atrotkaṇṭhādibhirvāsite cetasi śūnyāvalokanādayo'nubhāvā jāyante
pramāpayati yathā—
‘saṃjīvaṇosahimmiva suassa rakkhai aṇaṇṇavāvārā
sāsū ṇavambhadaṃsaṇakaṃṭhāgaajīviaṃ soṇham || 267 ||’
[saṃjīvanauṣadhimiva sutasya rakṣatyananyavyāpārā
śvaśrūrnavābhradarśanakaṇṭhāgatajīvitāṃ snuṣām ||]
atra prasādaṃ karotītyādivatpramāpaṇopakramo'pi pramāpaṇamucyate
karuṇe karoterbhūtopādanārthatve kurute mūrcchāṃ yathā—
‘vialiavioaviaṇaṃ takkhaṇapabbhaṭṭharāmamaraṇāāsam
jaṇaataṇaāi ṇavaraṃ laddhaṃ mucchāṇimīliacchīa suhaṃ 268’
[vigalitaviyogavedanaṃ tatkṣaṇaprabhraṣṭarāmamaraṇāyāsam
janakatanayayā kevalaṃ labdhaṃ mūrcchānimīlitākṣyā sukham ||]
atra sītāyāḥ patiśokaprakarṣeṇābhūtā mūrcchotpadyate
uccāraṇārthatve kurute vilāpaṃ yathā—
‘puhavīa hohii paī bahupurisavisesacaṃcalā rāasirī
kaha tā mahaccia imaṃ ṇīsāmaṇṇaṃ uvaṭhṭhiaṃ vehavvam || 269 ||’
[pṛthivyā bhaviṣyati patirbahupurūṣaviśeṣacañcalā rājyalakṣmīḥ
kathaṃ tanmamaivedaṃ niḥsāmānyamupasthitaṃ vaidhavyam ||]
atra rāmaduḥkhena vilapantī sītedamuccarati
avasthāpanārthe kurute sāhase mano yathā—
‘iyametya pataṅgavartmanā punaraṅkāśrayiṇī bhavāmi te
caturaiḥ surakāminījanaiḥ priya yāvanna vilupyase divi || 270 ||’
atra rateḥ kāmaśokena maraṇasāhase mano'vasthāpyate
abhyañjanārthatve karoti cittaṃ duḥkhena yathā—
‘dalati hṛdayaṃ gāḍhodvegaṃ dvidhā tu na bhidyate vahati vikalaḥ kāyo mohaṃ na muñcati cetanām
jvalayati tanūmantardāhaḥ karoti na bhasmasāt praharati vidhirmarmacchedī na kṛntati jīvitam || 271 ||’
atra rāmāderduḥkhena cittamabhyajyate
saṃbhoganiruktiṣu prathamānurāgānantare pālanārtho yathā—
‘dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭimadho dadāti kurute nālāpamābhāṣitā śayyāyāṃ parivṛtya tiṣṭhati balādāliṅgitā vepate
niryāntīṣu sakhīṣu vāsabhavanānnirgantumevehate bālā vāmatayaiva saṃprati mama prītyai navoḍhā priyā || 272 ||’
atrāprāgalbhyavāmatābhyāmanukūlāyāmapi navoḍhāyāmicchānuvṛttyā ratiḥ pālyate
mānānantare kauṭilyārtho yathā—
‘pāde mūrdhani tāmratāmupagate karṇotpale cūrṇite chinne hāralatāguṇe karatale saṃpātajātavraṇe
aprāptapriyatāḍanavyatikarā hantuṃ punaḥ kopitā vāñchantī muhureṇaśāvanayanā paryākulā roditi || 273 ||’
atra premṇaḥ svabhāvakuṭilatvānmānavatyāḥ kacagrahaṇena yatpādatāḍanādirūpāḥ kuṭilā eva saṃbhogā jāyante
pravāsānantare'bhyavahārārtho yathā—
‘vasiṣṭhadhenoranuyāyinaṃ tamāvartamānaṃ vanitā vanāntāt
papau nimeṣālasapakṣmapaṅktirupoṣitābhyāmiva locanābhyām || 274 ||’
atra uttarārdhenopoṣitasyānnopayoga iva priyālokajanmā pibaterabhyavahāraḥ kathyate
karuṇānantare'nubhavārtho yathā—
‘aṇumaraṇapatthiāe paccāgaajīvie piaamammi
vehavvamaṃḍaṇaṃ kulavahūa sohaggaaṃ jāam || 275 ||’
[anumaraṇaprasthitāyāḥ pratyāgatajīvite priyatame
vaidhavyamaṇḍanaṃ kulavadhvāḥ saubhāgyakaṃ jātam ||]
atra yatheyaṃ matprāṇabhūtaivamasyā ahamapi jīvitameveti patyā visrambhajo'nurāgaḥ patnyāḥ punaḥ pretyāpi yatsaṃgamo mayābhilaṣitaḥ so'yaṃ jīvantyaiva jīviteśvaraḥ samāsādita iti visrambhādatisukhamevānubhūyate
atra prathamānurāgānantare saṃbhogaḥ saṃkṣipto yathā—
‘apetavyāhāraṃ dhutavividhaśilpavyatikaraṃ karasparśārambhapragalitadukūlāntaśayanam
muhurbaddhotkampaṃ diśi diśi muhuḥ preritadṛśo- rahalyāsutrāmṇoḥ kṣaṇikamiha tatsaṃgatamabhūt || 276 ||’
atra saṃkṣepo nigadenaiva vyākhyāyate
sa eva mānānantare saṃkīrṇo yathā—
‘aṇuṇiakhaṇaladdhasuhe puṇo vi saṃbhariamaṇṇudūmiavihale
hiae māṇavaīṇaṃ cireṇa paṇaagaruo pasammaī roso 277’
[anunītakṣaṇalabdhasukhe punarapi saṃsmṛtamanyudūnitavihvale
hṛdaye mānavatīnāṃ cireṇa praṇayagurukaḥ praśāmyati roṣaḥ ||]
atrāvasthitā prakṛṣṭā ca ratirvyalīkasmaraṇādibhiḥ saṃkīryate
pravāsānantare saṃpūrṇo yathā—
‘śāpānto me bhujagaśayanādutthite śārṅgapāṇau māsānetāngamaya caturo locane mīlayitvā
paścādāvāṃ virahaguṇitaṃ taṃ tamātmābhilāṣaṃ nirvekṣyāvaḥ pariṇataśaraccandrikāsu kṣapāsu || 278 ||’
atrāmunā virahivākyenāpi nirvekṣyāva iti bhaviṣyatkālopādheḥ pravāsānantare'pyavirudhyamānena taṃ tamātmābhilāṣamityādinā tadānīntanasaṃbhogasya saṃpūrṇatvaṃ varṇyate
karuṇānantare samṛddho yathā—
‘tīrthe toyavyatikarabhave jahnukanyāsarayvordehatyāgādamaragaṇanālekhyamāsādya sadyaḥ
pūrvākārādhikatararucā saṃgataḥ kāntayāsau līlāgāreṣvaramata punarnandanābhyantareṣu || 279 ||’
atrottarārdhenendumatyajayorlokāntarapratyujjīvanena saṃbhogasamṛddhiḥ pratipādyate
prathamānurāgānantare sahārthānvayo yathā—
‘muhapecchao paī se sāvi hu piarūadaṃsaṇummaiā
do vi kaatthā puhaviṃ apurisamahilaṃ tti maṇṇaṃti || 280 ||’
[mukhaprekṣakaḥ patistasyāḥ sāpi khalu priyarūpadarśanonmattā
dvāvapi kṛtārthau pṛthivīmapuruṣamahileti manyete ||]
atra pūrvārdhe rañjayatyartha uttarārdhe rājatyarthaḥ prathamānurāge saha bhāvena siddhastadanantare'pi tathaivānuvartate
tatraiva paścādarthānvayo yathā—
‘adya prabhṛtyavanatāṅgi tavāsmi dāsaḥ krītastapobhiriti vādini candramaulau
ahvāya sā niyamajaṃ klamamutsasarja kleśaḥ phalena hi punarnavatāṃ vidhatte || 281 ||’
atra rañjayatyarthaḥ prathamānurāge puṃsi paścādbhāvena siddhastadanantare'pi tathaivānuvartate
atraivānurūpārthānvayo yathā—
‘śaśinamupagateyaṃ kaumudī meghamuktaṃ jalanidhimanurūpaṃ jahnukanyāvatīrṇā
iti samaguṇayogaprītayastatra paurāḥ śravaṇakaṭu nṛpāṇāmekavākyaṃ vivavruḥ || 282 ||’
atra rājatyarthaḥ prathamānurāge strīpuṃsayorapyānurūpyeṇa siddhastadanantare'pi tathaivānuvartate
tatraivānugatārthānvayo yathā—
‘sthāne tapo duścarametadarthamaparṇayā pelavayābhitaptam
yā dāsyamapyasya labheta nārī sā syātkṛtārtha kimutāṅkaśayyām || 283 ||’
atra pūrvārdhe rañjayatyarthaḥ prathamānurāge'nugatārthatvena siddhastadanantare tathaivānuvartate
so'yaṃ karaṇasādhanaḥ pratyayotpattipakṣa uktaḥ
bhāvasādhanapakṣe tu sarvatra sahārthādiviśiṣṭā ratirdīptirvānurāgaśabdenocyamānā tadanantare'pi samāsasāmarthyādanuvartate
kaḥ punaratra samāsaḥ
ṣaṣṭhīlakṣaṇastatpuruṣaḥ
prathamānurāgasyānantaraḥ prathamānurāgānantara iti
kā ca vṛttiḥ
ajahatsvārthā na hyatra nāyakau mithaḥ samāgatāvapi prathamānurāgamutsṛjataḥ
yuktaṃ punaryadajahatsvārthā parārthābhidhānarūpā vṛttiḥ syāt, avaśyaṃ hyanena parasyārthamabhidadhātā svārtha utsraṣṭavyaḥ
bāḍhaṃ yuktam
evaṃ hi dṛśyate loke bhikṣuko dvitīyā bhikṣāmāsādya pūrvāṃ na jahāti saṃcayāyaiva yatate, evaṃ tārhi dvayordvivacanamiti dvivacanaṃ prāpnoti
kasyā vibhakteḥ
ṣaṣṭhyāḥ
na ṣaṣṭhīsamartho'nantaraḥ
tarhi prathamāyāḥ
na prathamāsamarthaḥ prathamānurāgaḥ saṃbandhādhikyāt
abhihitaḥ so'rtho'nantarbhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ saṃpanna iti sāmarthyaṃ bhaviṣyati
maivam
iha prathamānurāgānantara ityetasmātsamudāyādvibhaktyā utpattavyam
tena ca samudāyenaiko'rthapiṇḍo mṛtpiṇḍa ivāvibhāgāpannapāṃsūdakavibhāgo'vayavārthaśaktyānugṛhītaḥ pṛthagavyapadeśyāvayavaśaktirabhidhīyate
tasmiṃśca samudāyārtha ekatvaṃ samavetamato vidyamānāyāmapyavayavasaṃkhyāyāṃ tadāśrayā subutpattirna bhaviṣyati
mānānantare pūjārthānvayo yathā—
‘na spṛṣṭo'pi tridaśasaritā dūramīrpyānubandhā- nnāpyunmṛṣṭo bhujagapatinā tarjanābhirjayāyāḥ
mānasyānte nayanasalilaiḥ kṣālitaḥ śailaputryā patyurmaulau natiyuji jayatyātmanaḥ pādapāṃsuḥ || 284 ||’
atra pādapatanādipūjā mānasiddhā tadanantare'pyanuvartate
atraiva mānaṃ prati priyatvābhimānārthānvayo yathā—
‘vihāyaitanmānavyasanamanayoruccakucayo- rnidheyaḥ preyāṃste yadi vayamanullaṅghyavacasaḥ
sakhībhyaḥ snigdhābhyo giramiti niśamyaiṇanayanā nivāpāmbho datte nayanasalilairmānasuhṛde || 285 ||’
atra mānaṃ prati priyatvābhimāno mānānantare'pyanuvartate
atraiva premāvarodhārthānvayo yathā—
‘dūmeṃti je muhuttaṃ kuviaṃ dāsavva je pasāeṃti
te ccia mahilāṇa piā sesā sāmi ccia varāā 286’
[dūnayanti ye muhurtaṃ kupitāṃ dāsā iva ye prasādayanti
ta eva mahilānāṃ priyāḥ śeṣāḥ svāmina eva varākāḥ ||]
atrāsyāmapi premāsti nāsti veti jijñāsuḥ priyaḥ priyāṃ kelīgotraskhalanādinā dunoti
sā ca premavatyavaśyamasmai kupyati
sa copalabdhapremā dāsavadenāṃ prasādayati
athaiṣātmani premāstitvamavabudhyate
so'yaṃ mānasiddho'rthastadanantare'pyanuvartate
tatraiva premapramāṇārthānvayo yathā—
‘surakusumehiṃ kalusiaṃ jai tehiṃ cia puṇo pasāemi tumaṃ
to pemmassa kisoari avarāhassaṃ a ṇa me kaaṃ aṇurūaṃ 287’
[surakusumaiḥ kaluṣitāṃ yadi taireva punaḥ prasādayāmi tvām
tataḥ premṇaḥ kṛśodari aparādhasya ca na me kṛtamanurūpam ||]
atra rukmiṇyāḥ surakusumamañjarī dattā mama tu suratarureva preyasā pratipannastadahamasyāḥ sahasraguṇatvena priyatameti satyabhāmā svapremāṇaṃ-mimīte
sa cāyamartho mānena siddhastadanantare'pi samāsamāmarthyādanuvartate
kaḥ punaratra samāsaḥ
ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa eva
kā vṛttiḥ
prathamānurāgānantaravadajahatsvārthaiva
yuktaṃ tatra visrambhaṇādāvapi prathamānurāgasya vidyamānatvāt
iha tu mānanivṛttau mānāpagamādayo jāyante
anvayādviśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati
tadyathā—ghṛtaghaṭastailaghaṭa iti niṣikte'pi ghṛte taile vā ghṛtaghaṭo'yaṃ tailaghaṭo'yamityanvayātpūrvapadārtho viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati
bhavati tatra yā ca yāvatī cārthamātrā ihāpi tattulyameva
tathā hi—
‘sakaaggahataṃsuṇṇāmiāṇaṇā piai piaamaviiṇṇam
thoaṃ thoaṃ rososadhaṃ va māṇaṃsiṇa mairam || 288 ||’
[sakacagrahatrastāvanāmitānanā pibati priyatamavitīrṇam
stokaṃ stokaṃ roṣauṣadhamiva māninī madirām ||]
sakaṣāyaireva vākyairnāyakaṃ nistudantī śayanīyaṃ gacchediti mānaśeṣānvayo dṛśyate
pravāsānantare priyā na vasata ityarthasyānvayo yathā—
‘vasane paridhūsare vasānā niyamakṣāmatanuḥ kṛtaikaveṇiḥ
atiniṣkaruṇasya śuddhaśīlā mama dīrghaṃ virahavrataṃ bibharti 289’
atra duṣyantena śakuntalāyāḥ pravāse vibhūṣaṇādyagrahaṇaṃ yadavagataṃ tattadanantare'pyanuvartamānaṃ premaprakarṣāya bhavati
tatraiva yuvānaḥ priyasaṃnidhau na vasantītyarthasyānvayo yathā—
‘samarthaye yatprathamaṃ priyāṃ prati kṣaṇena tanme parivartate'nyathā
ato vinidre sahasā vilocane karomi na sparśavibhāvitāpriyaḥ 290’
atra purūravāḥ pravāsānmatta urvaśībudhdyā latādikaṃ yadyadāsasāda tattadānekaśo'nyathā babhūva
tatsaṃskārāccāyaṃ yasyā latārūpaparivartanaṃ pratyeti so'yaṃ priyāsaṃnidhau yūnāmavāsaḥ saṃsiddhastadanantare'pyanuvartate
atraivotkaṇṭhādibhiśceto vāsayatītyarthasyānvayo yathā—
‘abbo dukkaraāraa puṇo vi tartti karesi gamaṇassa
ajja vi ṇa hoṃti saralā veṇīa taraṃgiṇo ciurā 291’
[he duṣkarakāraka punarapi cintāṃ karoṣi gamanasya
adyāpi na bhavanti saralā veṇyāstaraṅgiṇaścikurāḥ ||]
atra pravāsānubhūtabhṛśotkaṇṭhādicittavāsanāḥ pravāsānantare'pi tasyā nopaśāmyantīti veṇikāvarṇanādinā sūcyate
atraiva pramāpayatītyarthasyānvayo yathā—
‘tvadviyogodbhave caṇḍi mayā tamasi majjatā
diṣṭyā pratyupalabdhāsi cetaneva gatāsunā || 292 ||’
atrorvaśīvirahātpurūravā uttarāṃ kāmāvasthāṃ prapannaḥ priyāprāptau pretyeva pratyujjīvitastadevānusaṃdhatte
so'yaṃ pramāpaṇārthaḥ pravāsasiddhastadanantare'pi samāsasāmarthyādanuvartate
kaḥ punaratra samāsaḥ
ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa eva
kā vṛttiḥ
na tāvadanutsṛṣṭasvārthā, nahi proṣyasamāgatayoḥ pravāsasaṃbandho'pi vidyate
utsṛṣṭasvārthā tadiha bhavatu
yuktaṃ punaryadutsṛṣṭasvārthā nāma vṛttiḥ syāt
bāḍhaṃ yuktam
evaṃ hi dṛśyate lokepuruṣo'yaṃ parakarmaṇi pravartamānaḥ svakarmotsṛjati
tadyathā takṣā rājakarmaṇi pravartamānastakṣakarmotsṛjati
nanvevaṃ sati rājapuruṣamānayetyukte puruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti
naiṣa doṣaḥ
utsṛjannapyayaṃ svārthaṃ nātyantāyotsṛjati, yaḥ parārthavirodhī svārthastamevotsṛjati
tadyathā takṣā rājakarmaṇi pravartamānastakṣakarmotsṛjati na tu sthitavihasitakampitādīni
na cāyamarthaḥ parārthavirodhī viśeṣaṇaṃ nāma
tasmānnotsrakṣyati
karuṇānantare'nubhūtaprādurbhāvānvayārtho yathā—
‘jayanti jāyāśliṣṭasya śambhorambhodhimanthane
magnāmṛtaviṣāsvādamadamūrcchā manomudaḥ || 293 ||’
atra dākṣāyaṇyā haimavatītvena karuṇānantaratvam
tatra karuṇaduḥkhena mūrcchādayaḥ prādurāsan
iha tvānandena te prādurbhavanti
tatraivoccāraṇānvayārtho yathā—
‘klāmyantī yadupekṣitāsi purataḥ kāmo yadagre hataḥ kliṣṭaṃ yattapasā vapuryadapi ca proktā baṭucchadmanā
tatsarvaṃ praṇatasya me'dya dayite dākṣāyaṇi kṣamyatāmityuktvā caraṇābjayorvijayate luṇṭhañchivāyāḥ śivaḥ 294’
atra karuṇāvasthāyāṃ priyāpādābjayorluṇṭhatā śokena yo vilāpaḥ kṛtaḥ sa iha prakarṣālāpatvena vipariṇamati
atraiva mano'vasthāpanānvayārtho yathā—
‘akhaṇḍitaṃ prema labhasva patyurityucyate tābhirumā sma namrā
tayā tu tasyārdhaśarīralābhādadhaḥkṛtāḥ snigdhajanāśiṣo'pi 295’
atraiva—
‘yadaiva pūrvaṃ jvalane śarīraṃ sā dakṣaroṣātsudatī sasarja
tataḥprabhṛtyeva vimuktasaṅgaḥ patiḥ paśūnāmaparigraho'bhūt || 296 ||’
iti karuṇāvasthāyāmatisnehenāparigrahatvasāhase yanmano'vasthāpitaṃ tadihārdhaśarīrapradānamahāsāhasamevāvatiṣṭhate
tatraivābhyañjanānvayārtho yathā—
‘bhinna sadyaḥ samādhāvuparamati parajyotiṣi spandasaṃjñe saṃjñāmāpadyamāne mṛdumanasi manāgunmiṣatsvindriyeṣu
vyāpāre pāravaśyaṃ visṛjati maruti brahmasabrahmacārī vāmārdhasparśajanmā jayati purariporantarānandapūraḥ || 297 ||’
atra yatkaruṇāvasthāyāṃ manaḥ śokaprakarṣeṇābhyaktamāsīttadiha priyāśleṣajanmānā paramānandenābhyajyate
so'yaṃ karuṇadharmānvayastadanantare'pi samāsasāmarthyādbhavati
kaḥ punaratra samāsaḥ
ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣa eva
kā vṛttiḥ
jahatsvārthā
na hyatra karuṇārthasya gandho'pi
kathaṃ tarhyanvayaḥ
yathā mallikāpuṭaḥ campakapuṭa ityatra niḥkīrṇāsvapi sumanaḥsu mallikādirvāsanāvaśādviśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati—ayaṃ mallikāpuṭo'yaṃ campakapuṭa iti, evaṃ nivṛtte'pi svārthe vāsanāvaśātkaruṇo'nantarasya viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati
astu vā prathamānurāgādiṣvapi jahatsvārthaiva vṛttiḥ
nanvevaṃ rājapuruṣamānayetyukte puruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ prāpnoti
naiṣa doṣaḥ
vṛttau samarthādhikāraḥ kriyate
sāmarthyaṃ ca bhedaḥ saṃsarga ubhayaṃ vā
tatra rājña ityukte sarvaṃ svaṃ prasaktam
puruṣa ityukte sarvaḥ svāmī prasaktaḥ
ihedānīṃ rājapuruṣamānayetyukte rājā purūṣaṃ nivartayatyanyebhyaḥ svāmibhyaḥ;puruṣo'pi rājānamanyebhyaḥ svebhyaḥ
evamasminnubhayato vyavacchinne yadi rājārtho nivartate, kāmaṃ nivartatām
na jātucitpuruṣamātrasyānayanaṃ bhaviṣyati
prāk ca vṛtterakṛtārthasya nivṛttau sāmarthyābhāvādvṛttireva na syāt
vṛttinimittā ca nivṛttistasmādadoṣa iti
tatra rājñaḥ puruṣa ityatra yadā tāvadavadhṛtaparāyattavṛttirayaṃ puruṣo na svatantrastadā svāmisaṃsargasyāvagatatvātsvāmiviśeṣajñānāyopādīyamāno rājaśabdaḥ svāmyantarebhyaḥ puruṣaṃ vyāvartayati
so'yaṃ svāmyantaravyavacchedo bheda ityucyate
yadā punaranavagataparāyattabhāvasya puruṣasya svāmisaṃbandhadyotanāya rājaśabdaḥ prayujyate tadā viśeṣasaṃsargasya śabdopādānatvādanavakāśo viśeṣāntarasaṃpāta ityaśabdā svāmyantaranivṛttiravasīyate
yadā tvarthāntaranivṛttiṃ vārthasaṃsargaṃ vābhisaṃdhāyopasarjanapadāni prayujyante tadā śabdārthasāmarthyayoḥ pratipattinibandhanayorabhedāpekṣayā bhedasaṃsargasamudayaḥ sāmarthyaṃ bhavati
yathā nīlaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ ceti nīlotpalam
prathamaścāsāvanurāgaśceti prathamānurāga iti, prathamānurāgānantara ityādiṣu ca bhedasāmarthyaṃ yathā rājño bhṛtya iti
yato'nantara ityukte'vadhṛtamidaṃ kasyāpyavagheranantaro'yaṃ na svatantra iti sarvo'vadhiḥ prasaktaḥ
prathamānurāgasyetyukte sarvaḥ saṃbandhī prasaktaḥ
ihedānīṃ prathamānurāgānantara ityukte prathamānurāgo'nantaraṃ nivartayatyanyebhyo'vadhibhyaḥ
anantaraḥ prathamānurāgaṃ nivartayatyanyebhyaḥ saṃbandhibhyaḥ
tatra yo'sau bhedastatsāmarthyaṃ ca, tannimittā ca vṛttiḥ
bhedanimittāyāṃ ca vṛttau satyāṃ vṛttyabhimukhasya bhedamupajanayyopasarjanasya prathamānurāgasyārtho nivartate
yasyāpi pradhānasyānantarasyāvadhimato nivartate so'pyavadhimavacchinatti
evamubhayato vyavacchede nirjñāte'nantaraviśeṣe samudāyārthe cānyasminprādurbhavati
yadi prathamānurāgādyartho nivartate, kāmaṃ nivartatām, na jātucidavadhimanmātrasya saṃpratyayo bhaviṣyati
nanu cānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ jahatsvārthatvaṃ nopapadyate
tathā hi ‘prathamānurāgānantare’ ityukte kaścicchabdaḥ śrūyate
prathamānurāgetyanantareti ca pratīyamānavibhāgaḥ, artho'pi kaścidgamyate kanyāvisrambhaṇādiravadhimattvaṃ ca
‘mānānantare’ ityukte kaścicchabdabhāgo hīyate, kaścidupajāyate, kaścidanvayī
prathamānurāgeti hīyate, mānetyupajāyate, atantara ityanvayī
artho'pi kaściddhīyate, kaścidupajāyate, kaścidanvayī
kanyāvisrambhaṇādirhīyate, mānaśaithilyādipajāyate, avadhimattvamanvayi
tena manyāmahe yaḥ śabdabhāgo hīyate tasyāsāvarthaḥ; yo'rtho hīyate, ya upajāyate tasyāyamartho; yo'rtha upajāyate, yo'nvayī tasyāsāvartho; yo'rthaḥ so'nvayīti
maivam
yato'nanyathāsiddhābhyāmevānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ śabdā-rthayoḥ saṃbandhāvadhāraṇam
anyathāsiddhau cemau
tathā hi yatra bṛṃhitaṃ hīyate, hneṣitamupajāyate, reṇucakramanvayi; tatra hastino hīyante, aśvā upajāyante, pipīlikā anvayinyaḥ
na caitāvatā reṇucakrādipipīlikāḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavati
yatra vā kṣīraṃ hīyate, dadhyupajāyate, pātramanvayi, tatra mādhuryaṃ hīyate, amlatopajāyate, tṛptiranvayinī
na caitāvatā pātrasya tṛptiḥ kāryaṃ bhavati
avadhṛtaṃ hi sāmarthyamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ pravibhajyate
yathā loke badhiro'pi cakṣuṣmānālokayati, satyapi śrotra upahatacakṣurnālokayati rūpamityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ cakṣuḥśrotrasaṃnidhāne rūpālokanaṃ cakṣuṣa eva vyavasthāpyate na śrotrasya
yasya kevalasya yo'rtho'vadhṛtaḥ padārthāntarasaṃnidhāne'pi tasya sa eva
nahi rasanamasaṃnidhau darśanasya madhurādivyañjakaṃ darśanasaṃnidhau nīlādivyaktiṃ prati sāmarthyaṃ labhate
prathamānurāgaśabdasya kevalasyotkaṇṭhādiṣu, mānaśabdasyerṣyāyitādiṣu, anantaraśabdasya punaravadhimatsveva sāmarthyamavadhṛtamatasteṣāṃ tāvānevārtho bhavati
yaḥ punaḥ padayoranyonyopaśleṣādvisrambhaṇādirmānaśaithilyādirvāvadhimadviśeṣo'nyāvadhikaḥ pratīyate vākyārthaḥ sa bhavatīti
yadi vā yathānapekṣitāvayavārthā vṛkṣaśrotriyaśakragopādayaḥ svasāmarthyaniyatamarthamācakṣate tathā saṃghātā evaite prathamānurāgānantarādayo rājapuruṣādayaścānapekṣitāvayavārthā yathāsāmarthyamartheṣu niviśante
nanu cāvyapadeśyapūrvāparavibhāgā bhinnārthābhidhāyino vṛkṣādayaḥ pratīyamānabhāgabhedānuyātāḥ saṃbandhipadārthopahitabhedavṛttyabhidhāyinaḥ punarime tatkathaṃ prathamānurāgānantarādayo vṛkṣādivadrūḍhiśabdā bhavitumarhanti
tadasat
rūḍhiśabdā yaugikā iti vibhāgo'bhedadarśanādarśanābhyāmabhiniviṣṭa- buddheḥ pratipādanopāya eva
apathābhiniviṣṭo hyayaṃ krameṇa tasmādapathānnivartayitavyaḥ
tato'syāpratyabhijñāyamānaprakṛtayaḥ śrotriyakṣatriyādayo darśyante
na hyatra prakṛtirūpamavasīyate
yataḥ prakṛtyarthāvacchinnaḥ pratyayārtho'bhidhīyate
tato'navasīyamānāvayavavibhāgā rūḍhayaḥ kāścidupanyasyante
yatrātyantamasaṃbhavo'vayavārthasya yathā—śakragopāḥ, tailapāyikāḥ, maṇḍapeti
punaḥ kadācitsaṃnihitāvayavārthā jātiviśeṣābhidhāyinaḥ saptaparṇakṛtamālādaya udāhriyante
yataḥ prapalāśo'pyanudbhinnapalāśo'pi ca vanaspatiḥ sapta parṇānyasya parvaṇi parvaṇīti saptaparṇa ityākhyāyate
tathā niḥkīrṇakusumastaruranārabdhakalikājālako'pi kṛtā mālāneneti kṛtamāla ityabhidhīyate
atha ca pañcāṅgulamivāśvakarṇa iva parṇamasyetyupacaritārthāvayavā jātivācina eva pañcāṅgulāśvakarṇādayo varṇyante
teṣu hi pañcāṅgulādivyapadeśaḥ prodbhidyamānapravālamapi yāvadanuvartate
tataḥ saṃnidhāne'pyanāśrīyamāṇavṛttipadārthā lohitaśālirgaurakhara ityādayo nigadyante
tatra hi sannapi varṇaviśeṣaḥ samudāyasya jātivacanatvācchabdārthatvena nāvasīyate
tadevamayaṃ śakalīkṛtavṛttipadārthābhiniveśaḥ prathamānurāgānantarādāviva rājapuruṣādāvapyavayavābhiniveśaṃ śakyate tyājayitum
ata eva prathamānurāgādīnāṃ vipralambhasaṃbhogādīnāṃ ca pāribhāṣiko'pi saṃsargaḥ saṃnidhīyata iti
prakīrṇakeṣu spṛhayantīvratamaṣṭamīcandrakaḥ
sa hi caitracaturthīto'ṣṭamacaturthyāmupādīyamānaḥ kāminībhirarcyate
yathā—
‘avasahiajaṇo paiṇā salāhamāṇeṇa ecciraṃ hasio
cando tti tujjha muhasaṃmuhadiṇṇakusumaṃjalivilakkho || 298 ||’
[avaśahṛtajanaḥ patyā ślāghyamāneneyacciraṃ hasitaḥ
candra iti tava mukhasaṃmukhadattakusumāñjalivilakṣaḥ ||]
yasyāṃ yavasrastareṣvabalā lolanti sā kundacaturthī
yathā—
‘luliā gahavaidhūā diṇṇaṃ va phalaṃ javehiṃ savisesaṃ
eṇhiṃ aṇivāriameva gohaṇaṃ carau chettammi || 299 ||’
[lulitā gṛhapatisutā dattamiva phalaṃ yavaiḥ saviśeṣam
idānīmanivāritameva godhanaṃ caratu kṣetre ||]
vasantāvatāradivasaḥ suvasantako yathā—
‘chaṇapiṭṭhadhūsaratthaṇi mahumaatambacchi kuvalaāharaṇe
kaṇṇakaacūamaṃjari putti tue maṃḍio gāmo || 300 ||’
[kṣaṇapiṣṭadhūsarastani madhumadatāmrākṣi kuvalayābharaṇe
karṇakṛtacūtamañjari putri tvayā maṇḍito grāmaḥ ||]
yatra striyo dolāmārohanti sāndolanacaturthī
yathā—
‘aṃdolaṇakkhaṇoṭṭhiāe diṭṭhe tumammi muddhāe
āsaṃdhijjai kāuṃ karapellaṇaṇiccalā dolā || 301 ||’
[āndolanakṣaṇotthitayā dṛṣṭe tvayi mugdhayā
āśāsyate kartuṃ karapreraṇaniścalā dolā ||]
ekameva kusumanirbharaṃ śālmalivṛkṣamāśritya sunimīlitakādibhiḥ khelatāṃ krīḍaikaśālmalī
yathā—
‘ko esotti paloṭṭhuṃ siṃvalivaliaṃ piaṃ parikkhasai
haliasuaṃ muddhavahū seajalolleṇa hattheṇa || 302 ||’
[ka eṣa iti pratyāvartituṃ śālmalivalitaṃ priyaṃ paripātayati
hālikasutaṃ mugdhavadhūḥ svedajalārdreṇa hastena ||]
trayodaśyāṃ kāmadevapūjāmadanotsavaḥ
yathā—
‘gāmataruṇīo hiaaṃ haraṃti poḍhāṇa thaṇaharillīo
maaṇūsaammi kosuṃbhakaṃcuāharaṇamettāo || 303 ||’
[grāmataruṇyo hṛdayaṃ haranti prauḍhānāṃ stanabhāravatyaḥ
madanotsave kausumbhakañcukābharaṇamātrāḥ ||]
gandhodakapūrṇavaṃśanāḍīśṛṅgakādibhiryūnāṃ priyajanābhiṣekakardamena krīḍodakakṣveḍikā
yathā—
‘aha dhāviūṇa saṃjhāmaeṇa savvaṃgiaṃ paḍicchaṃti
phaggumahe taruṇīo gahavaisuahatthacikkhillaṃ || 304 ||’
[atha dhāvitvā saṃdhyāmadena sarvāṅgikaṃ pratīkṣante
phalgumahe taruṇyo gṛhapatisutahastakardamam ||]
yatrottamastriyaḥ pādābhighātenāśokaṃ vikāsya tatkusumamavataṃsayanti sāśokottaṃsikā
yathā—
‘uttaṃsiūṇa dohalaviasiāsoaminduvadaṇāe
vihiṇo ṇipphalakaṃkellikaraṇasaddo samuppusio || 305 ||’
[uttaṃsayitvā dohadavikasitāśokaminduvadanayā
vidherniṣphalakaṃkolakaraṇaśabdaḥ samutproñchitaḥ ||]
yatrāṅganābhiścūtamañjaryo'varujyānaṅgāya bāṇatvena dāyaṃ dāyamavataṃsyante sā cūtabhañjikā
yathā—
‘raiaṃ pi tā ṇa sohai raijoggaṃ kāmiṇīṇa chaṇaṇevacchaṃ
kaṇṇe jā ṇa raijjai kavolagholaṃtasahaāraṃ || 306 ||’
[racitamapi tāvanna śobhate ratiyogyaṃ kāminīnāṃ kṣaṇanepathyam
karṇe yāvanna racyate kapolaghūrṇamānasahakāram ||]
yatra yuvatayo madirāgaṇḍūṣadohadena bakulaṃ vikāsya tatpuṣpāṇyavacinvanti sā puṣpāvacāyikā
yathā—
‘pīṇathaṇaesu kesara dohaladāṇummuhīa ṇivalaṃto
tuṃgasiharaggapaḍaṇassa jaṃ phalaṃ taṃ tue pattaṃ || 307 ||’
[pīnastaneṣu kesara dohadadānonmukhyā nipatan
tuṅgaśikharāgrapatanasya yatphalaṃ tattvayā prāptam ||]
